label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_ExplainBattleRules
text:
The Set KO Tourney has special rules,
unlike standard battles.\pFirst, one battle lasts only
three turns.\pIf the outcome is not decided after
three turns, it goes to judging.\pThe REFEREE will choose the winner
based on how the POKéMON battled.\pAlso, a POKéMON cannot be switched out
until its battle's outcome is decided.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_ExplainBodyRules
text: The third judging factor is “Body.”\nThis factor is based on how much HP\lremained at the end of a battle.\pThe rating takes into account how much\nHP a POKéMON had at the start of\lbattle, and what remained at the end.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_ExplainMindRules
text: The first judging factor is “Mind.”\nThis factor evaluates how aggressive\lthe battlers were.\pThe judging is based on how often\nthe TRAINERS ordered the use of\loffensive moves.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_ExplainSkillRules
text:
The second judging factor is “Skill.”
This factor evaluates how effectively\lPOKéMON moves were used.\pIf a move worked successfully,
the Skill rating goes up.\pIf a move failed, the Skill rating
is lowered.\pIf it was an offensive move, the Skill
rating goes up if the move was “super\leffective” and goes down if it was\l“not very effective.”\pThe Skill rating will not go up for
moves such as PROTECT and DETECT.\pIf the opponent used PROTECT or
DETECT, and your POKéMON failed to\lhit with a move, its Skill rating will not\lgo down.$

has certain type disadvantages,\ltry making your second POKéMON one\lwith moves that are super effective\lagainst the first one.\pI think that will be a good way of
making an effective team.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_MakeWayForDomeAceTucker

text:
The REFEREES have reached
a decision!\pThe winner is…
Oh, my goodness!\lThe winner is our very own DOME ACE!\lIt's TUCKER!\pCongratulations! And thank you!
Let's hear it for the DOME ACE, TUCKER!$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_TuckerGoldIntro
text:
TUCKER: Ah…
The pummeling roar of the crowd…\lTheir furnace-like heat of excitement…\lThis is a wonderful place…\pTo the crowd, I am the DOME ACE…
I represent their hopes and dreams…\lI must never fade from their sight…\pI must burn!
Brighter and more brilliant!\lI must light all that gather here!$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_TuckerSilverIntro

TUCKER: Ahahah!\pDo you hear it? This crowd!
They're all itching to see our match!\pAhahah!\pI bet you're twitching all over from
the tension of getting to battle me!\pBut don't you worry about a thing!\pI'm the no. 1 star of the BATTLE DOME!
I, TUCKER the DOME ACE, will bathe you\lin my brilliant glow!$

the “Tree,” is available for viewing\lin the Waiting Room from any guide.\pThe Tournament Tree will provide
several kinds of data.\pThe data on view includes the previous
tournament's results, the POKéMON held\lby TRAINERS, and the battle styles of\lTRAINERS.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryBattleRoom_Text_HarderLookThanLastTime
text:
NOLAND: Hey, hey! How's it going?
You keeping up with your studies?\p…Oh?\pYou've taken on a harder look than
the last time I saw you.\pNow, this should be fun!
I'm getting excited, hey!$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryBattleRoom_Text_KnowledgeSymbolTookGoldenShine
text: The Knowledge Symbol took on\na golden shine!$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryBattleRoom_Text_LastTimeILoseToYou
text: Pfft, man!\pThat's absolutely the last time\nI lose to you!\pWe have to do this again, hey?$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryBattleRoom_Text_NextTimeNoHoldsBarred
text: Heh…\nYou're a pretty bright spark…\pNext time, I'll come after you hard.\nNo holds barred, understand?\pYou keep up your studies!$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryBattleRoom_Text_NolandImFactoryHead
text:
Hey, my name's NOLAND!
I'm basically in charge of this place,\lwhich is why I'm the FACTORY HEAD!\pI had a look at your Battle Swap data.\pYou seem to have the right idea,
but you're still square in your head!\pListen up, okay? Knowledge isn't only
about reading books or doing desk work.\pJust doing that sort of thing…
It may as well be useless!\pYou have to experience things with
your heart and your body, understand?\pI'll take you on under the same
conditions as you.\pI'll be using rental POKéMON, too!$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_CantFigureOutStaffHints
text: You know how the staff here give you\na few hints about your next opponent?\pWell, I'm a full-grown man, but I have\ntrouble figuring out their hints.$

text: Congratulations for defeating\nthe FACTORY HEAD and winning\lseven matches in a row!$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_CongratsSevenWins

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_ExplainBasicRules
text: In a Battle Swap event, you may use\nonly three POKéMON.\pWhether you are renting or swapping,\nyour team may not have two or more\lof the same POKéMON.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_ExplainOpenLvRules
text: In the Open Level, the rental POKéMON\nand the opposing TRAINERS' POKéMON\lare all Level 100.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_ExplainSwapNotesRules
text:
There are two key points to be aware
of when swapping POKéMON.\pFirst, when swapping, you can't check
the stats of the POKéMON you are\labout to receive.\pSecond, the POKéMON on your team
are lined up in sequence, depending on\lthe order in which you rented them.\pThis sequence remains unchanged
even when swaps are made.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_ExplainSwapNumberRules
text: After every battle you win, you may\nswap for one of your defeated\lopponent's POKéMON.\pYou will not be able to swap POKéMON\nwith the seventh TRAINER in the event.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_ExplainSwapPartnerRules
text: You may swap POKéMON only with\nthe TRAINER you have just defeated.\pYou may swap for only those POKéMON\nused by the beaten TRAINER.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_LookForwardToNextVisit

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_NeedKnowledgeOfMonsMoves
text:
Hi!
You, there!\pAre you thinking that the events here
are easy since you don't need to have\la raised team of POKéMON?\pI wouldn't be too sure about winning
that easily.\pIf you don't have thorough knowledge
about POKéMON and their moves,\lit will be tough to keep winning.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_NeedToCheckOpponentsMons

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceBattleRoom_Text_SpenserAwaitNextTime
text: SPENSER: Your POKéMON's eyes are \ntruly clear and unclouded.\pI will eagerly await the next\nopportunity to see you.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceBattleRoom_Text_SpenserComeSeeMeAgain
text: SPENSER: Gwahahah!\pCome see me time and again!\nMy brethren and I will be waiting!$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceBattleRoom_Text_SpenserFirstIntro
text:
SPENSER: My physical being is with
POKéMON always!\pMy heart beats as one with
POKéMON always!\pYoung one of a TRAINER!
Do you believe in your POKéMON?\pCan you believe them through
and through?\pIf your bonds of trust are frail,
you will never beat my brethren!$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceBattleRoom_Text_SpenserPostSilverBattle
text: SPENSER: Gwahahah!\pHah, you never fell for my bluster!\nSorry for trying that stunt!\pHere!\nBring me the thing!$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceBattleRoom_Text_SpenserThisTimeWontHoldBack
text:
SPENSER: Gwahahah!
You've battled your way up again?\pYou must have developed a truly
formidable bond with your POKéMON.\pSo be it!\pThis time, I won't bluster or hold back.
This time, there's no fooling around.\pReady now?
Prepare to lose!$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceBattleRoom_Text_SpenserYourTeamIsAdmirable
text: SPENSER: Well, that was some display!\nEven fully unleashed, my brethren\lcould not overpower you.\pYour team spirit is truly admirable!\pHere!\nBring me that thing, will you?$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceBattleRoom_Text_SpiritsSymbolTookGoldenShine

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceBattleRoom_Text_WishToQuitChallenge
text: Do you wish to quit your challenge?$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceCorridor_Text_BeginningToUnderstandNature
text: Are you beginning to understand how\na POKéMON's nature makes it behave?$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceCorridor_Text_HeartfeltBondBetweenYouAndMons
text: Ah… I see a strong, heartfelt bond\nbetween you and your POKéMON…$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceCorridor_Text_LetMonDoWhatItLikes
text: Rather than trying to make a POKéMON\ndo what it dislikes, try to let it do\lwhat it likes and is good at doing.\pPut yourself in the POKéMON's position\nand consider what moves it would like.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceCorridor_Text_MonDifferentWhenCornered
text: A POKéMON's nature is a remarkable\nthing…\pSome POKéMON behave in a completely\ndifferent way when they are cornered.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceCorridor_Text_PeopleAndMonAreSame
text: People and POKéMON, they are but\nthe same…\pTheir individual nature makes them\ngood at certain things, and not good\lat others.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ExplainRulesBasics
text: Here, POKéMON are required to think\nand battle by themselves.\pUnlike in the wild, POKéMON that live\nwith people behave differently\ldepending on their nature.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ExplainRulesMoves
text:
There are offensive moves that inflict
direct damage on the foe.\pThere are defensive moves that are
used to prepare for enemy attacks or\lused to heal HP and so on.\pThere are also other somewhat-odd
moves that may enfeeble the foes with\lstat problems including poison and \lparalysis.\pPOKéMON will consider using moves in
these three categories.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ExplainRulesNature
text:
Depending on its nature, a POKéMON
may prefer to attack no matter what.\pAnother POKéMON may prefer to protect
itself from any harm.\pYet another may enjoy vexing or
confounding its foes.\pDue to its nature, a POKéMON
will have favorite moves that it is good\lat using.\pIt may also dislike certain moves that
it has trouble using.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ExplainRulesUnderpowered
text:
When not under command by its TRAINER,
a POKéMON may be unable to effectively\luse certain moves.\pA POKéMON is not good at using any
move that it dislikes.\pIf a POKéMON only knows moves that
do not match its nature, it will often\lbe unable to live up to its potential.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ExplainRulesWhenInDanger
text: Depending on its nature, a POKéMON may\nstart using moves that don't match its\lnature when it is in trouble.\pIf a POKéMON begins behaving oddly\nin a pinch, watch it carefully.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_FailedToSaveBeforeEndingChallenge
text: Sigh…\pYou failed to save before you ended\nyour challenge the last time.\pAs a result, your challenge has been\ndisqualified. It is most unfortunate.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_FeatWillBeRecorded
text: Your feat will be recorded.\nI must ask you to briefly wait.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_FirmTrueBondsFor7WinStreak
text: To achieve a 7-win streak…\pThe bonds that bind your heart with\nyour POKéMON seem firm and true.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_FollowMe
text: Good.\nNow, follow me.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_LadyCanTellWhatMonsThink
text:
For a hardy fellow like me,
hardy POKéMON are the best.\pOffense is the best defense!
A relentless attack is the ultimate!\pBut that's not what I wanted to chat
about.\pEvery so often a really cute lady
swings by here.\pShe says that she can tell what
POKéMON are thinking.\pI don't know about that part,
but she is really cute.\pHuh?
Why are you looking at me like that?$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_LikeToRecordMatch
text: Would you like to record your latest\nBATTLE PALACE match on your\lFRONTIER PASS?$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_MonDocileButTransforms
text: My POKéMON is usually very docile.\pBut when it's in a BATTLE HALL,\nit sometimes seems to become\ltransformed into something wicked!\pIt becomes totally intimidating.\nIt's shocking, even.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_MustSaveBeforeChallenge
text: I must save before I show you to\nthe BATTLE HALL. Is that okay?$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_NatureAndMovesKeyHere
text:
Hmm…\pIt appears that the nature of POKéMON
and the moves that they have been\ltaught are the keys to battle here.\pTo be more precise, it's how well
the moves match the nature of\lthe POKéMON.\pIf your POKéMON is in trouble and
unable to live up to its potential,\lyou may need to examine how well\lits moves match its nature.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_PresentYouWithBattlePoints

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ResultsWillBeRecorded

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_WhatNatureFavorsChippingAway
text: I wonder what sort of nature a POKéMON\nwould have if it favored enfeebling its\lopponents and chipping away slowly.\pI'd be surprised if it was a LAX nature.\pBut, nah, that can't be right.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeLobby_Text_ExplainMonOrderRules

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeLobby_Text_ExplainPokenavBagRules

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeLobby_Text_FailedToSaveBeforeQuitting

I am LUCY…

Fine… I'll do it…$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_WillRestoreOneMon

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_BelieveMyFortunesOrNot
text: Whether you believe my fortunes\nor not, the choice is yours…\pThe future can be changed anytime…\nI wish you safe passage…$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_DidntSaveBeforeQuittingTakeBag
text:
A major problem, explorer!\pYou did not save before ending
your challenge the last time.\pConsequently, your challenge has
been disqualified, I'm sorry to say.\pHere is the BAG we've been holding
for you.\p{PLAYER} got the BAG back.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_DisappointingHereIsBag
text: How disappointing for you…\pHere is the BAG we've been holding\nfor you.\p{PLAYER} got the BAG back.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_ExchangedBagForBattleBag
text: {PLAYER} exchanged the BAG for\nthe BATTLE BAG.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_ExplainBagRules
text:
The BATTLE BAG serves as your BAG
while in the PYRAMID.\pThere are two separate BATTLE BAGS--
one each for the Level 50 and\lOpen Level adventures.\pThey each can hold up to 99 pieces
of ten kinds of items.\pThe contents of the BATTLE BAG are
lost if you fail in your quest.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_ExplainMazeRules
text:
The mazes in the PYRAMID rearrange
themselves every time you enter it.\pThe mazes are poorly lit.
You must advance with caution.\pThe light grows brighter whenever you
defeat a wild POKéMON or a TRAINER.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_ExplainMonRules
text: When the PYRAMID is conquered,\nthe wild POKéMON that appear in it\lare replaced by different kinds.\pExplore, observe, and learn what kinds\nof wild POKéMON you may encounter.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_ExplainTrainerRules
text:
TRAINERS are lying in wait for you
inside the PYRAMID.\pOn each floor, there are up to
eight TRAINERS.\pWhen you defeat a TRAINER, you will
get a helpful hint for your adventure.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_GiveYouTheseBattlePoints
text: Young explorer!\nIn commendation of your courage,\lwe give you these Battle Point(s)!$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HeldItemsMovedToBag
text: All items held by your POKéMON will be\nmoved to your BATTLE BAG, {PLAYER}.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HintBug
text: I see BUG-type POKéMON…\p…And, I see your POKéMON suffering\nfrom different kinds of attacks…$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HintBurn
text: I see bright red flames…\p…And, I see your POKéMON suffering\nfrom burns…$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HintDark
text: I see DARK-type POKéMON…\p…And, I see your POKéMON suffering\nfrom DARK-type moves…$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HintExplosion
text: I see a flurry of moves that imperil\nthe user…\p…And, I see your POKéMON falling\nto them…$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HintFighting
text: I see FIGHTING-type POKéMON…\p…And, I see your POKéMON pummeled\nby FIGHTING moves…$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HintFlyingDragon
text: I see flying POKéMON…\p…And, I see your POKéMON suffering\nfrom enormously powerful moves…$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HintGhost
text: I see GHOST-type POKéMON…\p…And, I see your POKéMON suffering\nfrom GHOST-type moves…$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HintIce
text: I see ICE-type POKéMON…\p…And, I see your POKéMON fighting\nthe freezing effects of ice…$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HintLevitate
text: I see POKéMON loftily airborne…\p…And, I see your POKéMON frustrated\nby powerless GROUND-type moves…$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HintNormal
text: I see NORMAL-type POKéMON…\p…And, I see your POKéMON suffering\nfrom enormously powerful moves…$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HintPPWaste
text: I sense the tremendous pressure of\nunrequited anger…\pIt is a curse…\p…And, I see your POKéMON drained of\nPower Points and having no recourse\lbut to use STRUGGLE…$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HintParalysis
text: I see a shower of sparks…\p…And in it, I see your POKéMON\nstruggling with paralysis…$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HintPoison
text: I see poison…\p…And, I see your POKéMON suffering\nfrom the effects of poison…$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HintPsychic
text: I see PSYCHIC-type POKéMON…\p…And, I see your POKéMON in torment\nfrom PSYCHIC moves…$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HintRock
text: I see ROCK-type POKéMON…\p…And, I see your POKéMON suffering\nfrom ROCK moves…$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HintSteel
text: I see STEEL-type POKéMON…\p…And, I see your POKéMON suffering\nfrom enormously powerful moves…$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HintStoneEvolve
text:
I see those that have evolved from
the power of stones…\pI also sense fire, water,
and electricity…\p…And, I see your POKéMON suffering
from those three powers…$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HintTrapAbility
text: I sense terrific energy rising from\nthe ground below…\p…And, I see your POKéMON unable to\nescape the power's clutches…$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HintWater
text: I see WATER-type POKéMON…\p…And, I see your POKéMON suffering\nfrom WATER-type moves…$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HintWeather
text:
RAIN DANCE… SUNNY DAY…
SANDSTORM… HAIL…\pI see POKéMON that become stronger
with the weather…\p…And, I see your POKéMON confounded
by different types of moves…$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_LeastOneMonHoldingItem
text: At least one POKéMON is still\nholding an item.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_LookForwardToNextChallenge
text: We look forward to your\nnext challenge!$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_LostLotOfItems
text: Awaaaaaaarrrrgh!\pI had a whole lot of items, but I lost\nthem all when I lost!\pAwaaaaaaarrrrgh!$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_MonHoldingItemCannotTake
text: Ah, a slight problem.\pAt least one POKéMON is holding\nan item.\pI'm sorry to say, items obtained in\nthe PYRAMID cannot be taken away.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_PickItemsToKeep
text: Please pick the items you'll keep in the\nBATTLE BAG, and with your POKéMON.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_PleaseTakePreviousBattleBag
text: In exchange, please take this BATTLE\nBAG, the one you used previously.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_PleaseTakeThisBattleBag
text: In exchange, please take this\nBATTLE BAG.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_ReadWhichHeading
text: Which heading do you want to read?$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_RecordResultsWait
text: I must record your results.\nPlease wait.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_RulesAreListed
text: The Battle Quest rules are listed.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_ShowYouIntoPyramid
text: Very good. I will now show you into\nthe BATTLE PYRAMID.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_StepOnFloorPanel
text: When you step on this floor panel,\nyou will be transported to a higher\lfloor in the PYRAMID.\pI hope for your sake that your\nquest goes safely!$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_TellYouWhatMisfortunesAwait
text: Welcome…\pI shall be pleased to tell you what\nmisfortunes await in the PYRAMID…$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_TrainersNoticeRunning
text: Did you know?\pIf you run fast, TRAINERS may notice\nand come after you for a battle.\pSo, if you want to avoid TRAINERS,\ndon't catch their eyes, but sneak\lcautiously and quietly past them.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_UsedBattleBagWillBeKept
text: The BATTLE BAG you used will be kept\nin readiness for your next challenge.\p{PLAYER} turned the BATTLE BAG over\nfor the BAG's return.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_WeWillHoldBagForSafekeeping
text: We will hold your BAG for safekeeping,\n{PLAYER}, while you are exploring.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_WelcomeToBattlePyramid
text: Where the courage of TRAINERS\nis put to the test!\pWelcome to the BATTLE PYRAMID!\pI am your guide to\nthe Battle Quest.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_YouveConqueredPyramid
text: Excellent to see you back!\pYou've conquered the PYRAMID!\nHow splendid!$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_YouveDefeatedPyramidKing
text: Welcome back!\nYou've done the unthinkable!\pYou've defeated the PYRAMID KING\nand conquered the BATTLE PYRAMID!$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidTop_Text_BrandonFrontierPassPlease
text: BRANDON: Hahahah! Grand it was!\nGrand, yes, indeed!\pWell done! You've earned recognition!\nYour FRONTIER PASS, please!$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidTop_Text_BrandonRemarkableHaveThis
text: BRANDON: Hahahah!\nRemarkable!\lYes, it's grand, indeed!\pYoung explorer!\pYou've bested me through and through!\nHere! I want you to have this!$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidTop_Text_BrandonYouveReturned
text:
BRANDON: …You've finally returned,
young explorer…\pYour love of adventure seems to come
deep from within your heart…\pYes… You are exactly as I was in
my own youth…\p… … …Ah…\pThe passionate!\pThe dangerous!\pThe desperate!\pThose days of death-defying,
life-affirming adventures are back…$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidTop_Text_BraveSymbolTookGoldenShine
text: The Brave Symbol took on\na golden shine!$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidTop_Text_BringCourageToOurBattle
text: Now, then!\nBring your courage to our battle!$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidTop_Text_ChiefBeatYouHere
text:
It is a delight to see you here!\pUnfortunately, you were second by
a mere fraction of time!\pOur chief has already conquered
the PYRAMID ahead of you.\pHowever, my young explorer…
You are a TRAINER!\pAssert your power and take the glory
of the pinnacle from our chief!\pNow, please! When you are ready,
take one more step of courage!$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidTop_Text_EverythingYouHave
text: Everything you have!\nI'm braced for it all!$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidTop_Text_ExplorationsAreGrandestAdventure
text: Young adventurer…\pWouldn't you agree that explorations\nare the grandest of adventures?\pYour own wits!\pYour own strength!\pYour own POKéMON!\pAnd, above all, only your own courage\nto lead you through unknown worlds…$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidTop_Text_FarewellForNow
text: Ah, yes! It just goes to show that\nI have much to learn still!\pMay our paths cross again!\nFarewell for now, young explorer!$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidTop_Text_ImPyramidKingBrandon
text:
Aah, yes, indeed this life is grand!
Grand, it is! Eh?\pI'm BRANDON!\pI'm the PYRAMID KING, which means
I'm in charge here.\pMost people call me the chief!\pYou coming here means you have
that much confidence in yourself,\lam I right?\pHahahah!
This should be exciting!$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidTop_Text_LookForwardToNextMeeting
text: Young explorer!\nI look forward to our next meeting!$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidTop_Text_MyCourageIsOffMeter
text: Now, then!\pI sense my own courage is off\nthe meter!$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidTop_Text_PlayerConqueredPyramid
text: The PYRAMID's new conqueror!\nLet the name {PLAYER} be known!$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidTop_Text_ReachedSummitUpYouGo
text:
It is a delight to see you here!
You have reached the summit of\lthe BATTLE PYRAMID!\pAbove here is the PYRAMID's
lookout point.\pIt is a place open only to those
who have conquered the PYRAMID.\pNow, please!
Up you go!$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidTop_Text_ReceivedBraveSymbol
text: The Brave Symbol was embossed on\nthe FRONTIER PASS!$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidTop_Text_StepForwardWhenReady
text: Now, when you are ready, take courage\nand step forward.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerBattleRoom_Text_AbilitySymbolTookGoldenShine
text: The Ability Symbol took on\na golden shine!$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerBattleRoom_Text_AnabelCongratsYourPassPlease
text: ANABEL: Fufu, congratulations…\nYour FRONTIER PASS, please…$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerBattleRoom_Text_AnabelTalentShallBeRecognized
text: ANABEL: Fufufu, nicely done…\pYour FRONTIER PASS, please…\nYour talent shall be recognized.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerBattleRoom_Text_AnabelYouCameBack
text:
ANABEL: You really did come back to
see me…\p… … … … … …\pYou've won straight matches to see me…
I won't have to hold back against you…\pIt's been too long now…\pToo long since I've been able to battle
without thinking about anything…$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerBattleRoom_Text_CancelYourChallenge
text: Would you like to cancel your BATTLE\nROOM challenge?$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerBattleRoom_Text_GreetingsImAnabel
text:
Greetings…
My name is ANABEL.\pI am the SALON MAIDEN, and I am in
charge of running the BATTLE TOWER…\pI have heard several rumors
about you…\pIn all honesty, what I have heard does
not seem attractive in any way…\pThe reason I've come to see you…
Well, there is but one reason…$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerBattleRoom_Text_LetMeSeeYourTalent
text: Let me see your talent in\nits entirety…$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerBattleRoom_Text_LetsBeginShallWe
text: Let's begin, shall we?$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerBattleRoom_Text_ReadyFor2ndOpponent
text: You will be facing opponent no. 2.\nAre you ready?$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerBattleRoom_Text_ReadyFor3rdOpponent
text: You will be facing opponent no. 3.\nAre you ready?$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerBattleRoom_Text_ReadyFor4thOpponent
text: You will be facing opponent no. 4.\nAre you ready?$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerBattleRoom_Text_ReadyFor5thOpponent
text: You will be facing opponent no. 5.\nAre you ready?$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerBattleRoom_Text_ReadyFor6thOpponent
text: You will be facing opponent no. 6.\nAre you ready?$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerBattleRoom_Text_ReadyFor7thOpponent
text: You will be facing opponent no. 7.\nAre you ready?$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerBattleRoom_Text_ReadyForSalonMaiden
text: You will be facing the SALON MAIDEN.\nAre you prepared?$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerBattleRoom_Text_ReceivedAbilitySymbol
text: The Ability Symbol was embossed on\nthe FRONTIER PASS!$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerBattleRoom_Text_RecordCouldntBeSaved
text: There was an error of some sort.\nYour record could not be saved.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerBattleRoom_Text_RecordYourBattle
text: Record your battle on your\nFRONTIER PASS?$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerBattleRoom_Text_RestoreMonsToFullHealth
text: We will restore your POKéMON to\nfull health.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerBattleRoom_Text_SalonMaidenOnHerWay
text: Excuse me, but…\pOur leader, the SALON MAIDEN, is on\nher way here in hopes of battling you.\pShe should be arriving very shortly.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerBattleRoom_Text_SaveAndQuitGame
text: Would you like to save and\nquit the game?$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerBattleRoom_Text_SavingPleaseWait
text: Saving your battle data.\nPlease wait.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerBattleRoom_Text_UntilNextTime
text:
… … … … … …\pYou have confidence in your POKéMON
battling talent, don't you?\pI urge you to keep battling and
keep on winning.\pI will be waiting for you.
Until the next time we meet…$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerBattleRoom_Text_WishICouldBattleYouAgain
text: That was fun…\pI have never had a POKéMON battle\nso enjoyable before…\pI wish I could battle with you again…$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_AboutToFace50thTrainer
text: You're finally about to face the\n50th TRAINER.\pFrom here on, every time you beat seven\nTRAINERS in a row, your POKéMON will\lreceive a commemorative RIBBON.\pGood luck!$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_AwardYouTheseBattlePoints
text: In recognition of your infinite talent,\nwe award you these Battle Point(s).$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_BattleRecordedOnPass
text: {PLAYER}'s battle was recorded\non the FRONTIER PASS.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_CanLeaveUntilLossOrSevenWins
text: Once you've entered the BATTLE TOWER,\nyou can't leave until you either lose\lor you beat seven TRAINERS in a row.\pYou'd best be certain that you're up\nto the challenge.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_ChangedYourMind
text: Hunh? You changed your mind?\nI guess you're fickle.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_CongratsBeatenSeven
text: Congratulations!\nYou've beaten all seven TRAINERS!\p$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_CongratsDefeatedMaiden
text: Congratulations!\nYou have defeated the SALON MAIDEN\land swept seven TRAINERS!$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_DescribeFeelingsAboutBattleTower
text: Excuse me, do you have a moment?\pCan you describe your feelings when\nyou're about to begin a BATTLE TOWER\lmatch, or when you've either won or\llost a match?$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_DescribeYourBattle
text: Oh, oh, may I ask one more question?\pIf you were to describe your\nimpressions about this battle with\lone saying, what would it be?$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_DidntSaveBeforeQuitting
text: Excuse me!\pYou didn't save before you quit your\nchallenge last time.\pBecause of that, your challenge so far\nhas been disqualified. Sorry!$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_DifficultToMakeBattleTurnOutAsPlanned
text: Oh, I see…\pWell, it certainly is difficult to make a\nbattle turn out exactly as planned.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_DontThinkMuchAboutIt
text: Oh, so you don't think much about it?\nYou're one cool customer.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_ExplainMonRules
text:
Depending on the BATTLE ROOM you are
entering, you will be required to take\la certain number of POKéMON.\pThe SINGLE BATTLE mode requires
three POKéMON.\pThe DOUBLE BATTLE mode requires four,
and the MULTI modes both require two.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_ExplainMultiLinkRules
text:
The LINK MULTI BATTLE Mode is for two
friends to mount a challenge together.\pYou and your friend must be linked with
Wireless Adapters or a GBA Game Link\lcable.\pYou must choose two POKéMON at
the registration counter.\pThese POKéMON must be different
from those of your friend.\pYou may not interrupt this challenge
in the middle, unlike other modes.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_ExplainSalonRules
text:
The BATTLE SALON is where you must
find a partner to form a tag team for\lthe MULTI BATTLE ROOM challenge.\pChoose the best partner for you by
examining other TRAINERS'\lPOKéMON and their moves.\pYou may choose a new tag partner
after winning seven straight matches.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_ExplainTowerRules
text:
The BATTLE TOWER is a facility where
four types of battles are waged--\lSINGLE BATTLE, DOUBLE BATTLE, MULTI\lBATTLE, and LINK MULTI BATTLE.\pFor each of these types, there are
separate BATTLE ROOMS.\pPlease speak with a guide offering
the type of battle you wish to enter.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_FeelWhatWhenYouBegin
text: Okay, what are your feelings when\nyou're about to begin a match?$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_FeelWhatWhenYouveLost
text: Can I hear about your feelings when\nyou have lost a match?$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_FeelWhatWhenYouveWon
text: What do you feel when you've won\na match?$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_HereAreSomeRibbons
text: Here are some RIBBONS for beating\nseven tough TRAINERS in a row.\p{PLAYER} received some RIBBONS!$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_HowDidBattleTowerTurnOut
text:
You will? Really?
Thank you!\lThen, uh…\pHow did things turn out in
the BATTLE TOWER today?\pWere you satisfied with the battle?
Or are you unhappy?$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_InterviewRequest
text:
Hello! You're the TRAINER who just had
a battle, right?\pI'm gathering interviews with TRAINERS
all over the place.\pMay I get a few words from you about
your impressions on battling?$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_LookForwardToAnotherChallenge
text: We look forward to seeing you on\nanother challenge!$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_LookingForwardToNextBattle
text: I'll be looking forward to your\nnext battle!$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_ObviousYouHadGreatBattle
text: Well, of course!\pThat unmistakable look of satisfaction\non your face…\pIt's obvious that you've had a great\nbattle.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_ProgressWillBeSaved
text: Before entering a BATTLE ROOM, your\nprogress will be saved. Please wait.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_PutRibbonOnMons
text: {PLAYER} put the RIBBONS on\nthe challenger POKéMON.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_ReadWhichHeading
text: Which heading do you want to read?$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_ReceivedPrize
text: {PLAYER} received the prize\n{STR_VAR_1}.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_RecordLastMatch
text: Shall I record your last BATTLE TOWER\nmatch on your FRONTIER PASS?$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_RecordWillBeSaved
text: Your record will be saved.\nPlease wait.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_RulesAreListed
text: The BATTLE TOWER rules are listed.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_SilentType
text: Oh, I see…\pStill, being the silent type is also\ncool, isn't it?\pI hope you'll give me the opportunity\nto share your thoughts again!$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_SorryWeDisturbedYou
text: Oh…\nSorry we disturbed you.\pPlease give us an interview the next\ntime you visit the BATTLE TOWER.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_ThankYouForPlaying
text: Thank you for playing!\p$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_ThatsGreatLine
text: Oh, that is stunningly cool!\pThat's a great line!\nI hope you'll do great next time, too.\pI hope to see you again!$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_ThatsHowYouFeel
text: Okay, so that's how you feel?\nThat's quite original.\pThanks!$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_WelcomSingleBattle
text: Where the talents of TRAINERS\nare put to the test!\pWelcome to the BATTLE TOWER!\pI am your guide to the SINGLE\nBATTLE ROOMS.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_WelcomeDoubleBattle
text: Where the talents of TRAINERS\nare put to the test!\pWelcome to the BATTLE TOWER!\pI am your guide to the DOUBLE\nBATTLE ROOMS.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_WelcomeLinkMultiBattle
text: Where the talents of TRAINERS\nare put to the test!\pWelcome to the BATTLE TOWER!\pI am your guide to the LINK MULTI\nBATTLE ROOMS.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_WelcomeMultiBattle
text: Where the talents of TRAINERS\nare put to the test!\pWelcome to the BATTLE TOWER!\pI am your guide to the MULTI\nBATTLE ROOMS.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_WeveBeenWaitingForYou
text: We've been waiting for you!\p$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_WinsInRowRecorded
text: The number of matches you win in a row\nis recorded.\pI'd better not get beaten in\nan embarrassing way!$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerMultiBattleRoom_Text_ReadyFor2ndOpponentSet
text: The 2nd set of opponents is next.\nAre you ready?$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerMultiBattleRoom_Text_ReadyFor3rdOpponentSet
text: The 3rd set of opponents is next.\nAre you ready?$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerMultiBattleRoom_Text_ReadyFor4thOpponentSet
text: The 4th set of opponents is next.\nAre you ready?$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerMultiBattleRoom_Text_ReadyFor5thOpponentSet
text: The 5th set of opponents is next.\nAre you ready?$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerMultiBattleRoom_Text_ReadyFor6thOpponentSet
text: The 6th set of opponents is next.\nAre you ready?$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerMultiBattleRoom_Text_ReadyFor7thOpponentSet

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge3_Text_GetToBattleFactoryDouble
text: Get to the BATTLE FACTORY's\nBattle Swap Double Tourney pronto!\pIt's a must-win situation!\nDon't blow your chance!\lBoth of our futures depend on you!$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge3_Text_GetToBattleFactorySingle
text: Get to the BATTLE FACTORY's\nBattle Swap Single Tourney pronto!\pIt's a must-win situation!\nDon't blow your chance!\lBoth of our futures depend on you!$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge3_Text_GetToBattlePalaceDouble
text: Get to the BATTLE PALACE's\nDOUBLE BATTLE HALLS pronto!\pIt's a must-win situation!\nDon't blow your chance!\lBoth of our futures depend on you!$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge3_Text_GetToBattlePalaceSingle
text: Get to the BATTLE PALACE's\nSINGLE BATTLE HALLS pronto!\pIt's a must-win situation!\nDon't blow your chance!\lBoth of our futures depend on you!$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge3_Text_GetToBattlePike
text: Get to the BATTLE PIKE's\nBattle Choice pronto!\pIt's a must-win situation!\nDon't blow your chance!\lBoth of our futures depend on you!$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge3_Text_GetToBattlePyramid
text: Get to the BATTLE PYRAMID's\nBattle Quest pronto!\pIt's a must-win situation!\nDon't blow your chance!\lBoth of our futures depend on you!$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge3_Text_GetToBattleTowerDouble
text: Get to the BATTLE TOWER's\nDOUBLE BATTLE ROOMS pronto!\pIt's a must-win situation!\nDon't blow your chance!\lBoth of our futures depend on you!$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge3_Text_GetToBattleTowerMulti
text: Get to the BATTLE TOWER's\nMULTI BATTLE ROOMS pronto!\pIt's a must-win situation!\nDon't blow your chance!\lBoth of our futures depend on you!$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge3_Text_GetToBattleTowerSingle
text: Get to the BATTLE TOWER's\nSINGLE BATTLE ROOMS pronto!\pIt's a must-win situation!\nDon't blow your chance!\lBoth of our futures depend on you!$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge3_Text_HelloChampHeresYourPoints
text:
Oh, yes!
Hello there, champ!\pI knew you could!
I knew you would!\lWe're both big winners!\pI'll return your Battle Points and,
of course, a little extra from me!$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge3_Text_HowAboutEnteringEventForMe
text: I'll see to it that you benefit, too.\nSo how about it?\lHow about entering that event for me?$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge3_Text_HowMuchCanYouSpot
text: Great, great!\nSo, how much can you spot me?$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge3_Text_KnowWinnerWhenISeeOne
text: Giggle!\nI know a winner when I see one!$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge3_Text_NiceTryCantReturnPoints
text:
Oh, it's you…
Nice try…\pI hate to break it to you, but I can't
return your Battle Points…\pI guess we'll have to let it motivate
us to try harder next time!$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge3_Text_NotInterested
text: Not interested?! You shouldn't be\nso afraid to take a chance!$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge3_Text_ObtainedBattlePoints
text: {PLAYER} obtained\n{STR_VAR_1} Battle Points.$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge3_Text_Oh
text: Oh…$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge3_Text_ShouldBeTakingChallenges
text: Those TRAINERS…\nWhat are they doing?\lThey should be taking challenges.$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge3_Text_SpotMeSomeBattlePoints
text: All right, that's perfect.\nSo, uh… How about spotting me some\lof your Battle Points?\pTrust me, I'll show you my gratitude\nafterward.$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge3_Text_ThanksOffYouGo
text: Heheh! Thanks much!\nSo, off you go!$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge3_Text_ThinkOfMeForAnotherChallenge
text: If you're up for another challenge,\nplease do think of me!$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge3_Text_TrainerGoodButRattled
text: That TRAINER…\pHe's good, but he gets rattled too\neasily to survive the BATTLE DOME…$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge3_Text_YouDontHaveEnoughPoints
text: Oh, no, no, no!\nYou don't have enough Battle Points!\pI wish you wouldn't monkey around and\nwaste everyone's time!$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge3_Text_YouLookToughExplainGambling
text:
…Huh?
You look to me like a tough TRAINER.\pHeheh…
Listen, I have this proposition.\pWe have a little group going here,
and we play a little game with what\lgoes on in the BATTLE FRONTIER.\pThe rules are really simple.\pFirst, we pick one of the facilities
in the BATTLE FRONTIER.\pThen, we each pick a different TRAINER
who's taking that facility's challenge,\land bet with our Battle Points.\pThe guy who bet on the TRAINER with
the best record takes all the Battle\lPoints in the pool.\pSounds simple, huh?
So, anyway…$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge4_Text_IfIOpenedRestaurantHere
text: If I opened a restaurant here,\nit'd make money for sure.$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge4_Text_NeedBreatherAfterBattles
text: Whew…\pI need to take a breather after\nsome intense battles…\pBut even now, I never take a break\nfrom plotting strategy and combos.$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge4_Text_WonderIfInterviewsAiring
text: I wonder if they'll be airing interviews\nwith tough TRAINERS today?$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge5_Text_GirlPlaysAtRedHouseALot
text: I know something!\pThat little girl plays at the red house\na lot!$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge5_Text_GirlSayingSomethingProfound
text: I have this feeling that the little girl\nis saying something profound.$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge5_Text_LadyClaimsSheUnderstandsPokemon
text: How charming!\nThat little lady claims she can\lunderstand POKéMON!$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge5_Text_NatureGirlAttackHighAttackLow
text: Hmhm…\pThis one says it likes to battle!\nIt will battle even if it has a lot\lof ouchies!$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge5_Text_NatureGirlAttackHighDefenseLow
text: Hmhm…\pThis one says it likes to battle!\nBut if it gets enough ouchies,\lit will worry about itself!$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge5_Text_NatureGirlAttackHighSupportLow
text: Hmhm…\pThis one says it likes to battle!\nBut if it gets enough ouchies,\lit will turn sneaky!$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge5_Text_NatureGirlDefenseHighAttackLow
text: Hmhm…\pThis one says it looks after itself!\nBut if it gets enough ouchies,\lit will hit back!$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge5_Text_NatureGirlDefenseHighDefenseLow
text: Hmhm…\pThis one says it looks after itself!\nIt says it worries about itself whether\lor not it has a lot of ouchies!$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge5_Text_NatureGirlDefenseHighSupportLow
text: Hmhm…\pThis one says it looks after itself!\nBut if it gets enough ouchies,\lit will turn sneaky!$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge5_Text_NatureGirlEgg
text: That's silly! An EGG is asleep!\nI can't talk to it!$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge5_Text_NatureGirlGreeting
text: Ehehe!\nI can tell what POKéMON are thinking!\pPlease!\nCan I see your POKéMON?$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge5_Text_NatureGirlNoneShown
text: Boo!\nCheapie!$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge5_Text_NatureGirlSupportHighAttackLow
text: Hmhm…\pThis one says it likes to be sneaky!\nBut if it gets enough ouchies,\lit will hit back!$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge5_Text_NatureGirlSupportHighDefenseLow
text: Hmhm…\pThis one says it likes to be sneaky!\nBut if it gets enough ouchies,\lit will worry about itself!$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge5_Text_NatureGirlSupportHighSupportLow
text: Hmhm…\pThis one says it likes to be sneaky!\nIt says it likes to be sneaky even\lif it has a lot of ouchies!$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge6_Text_DontTradeForAnythingButMon
text: Oh, I'm sorry!\nI don't intend to trade for anything\lbut a {STR_VAR_1}.$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge6_Text_PromiseIllBeGoodToIt
text: Oh, it's adorable!\nThank you!\lI promise I'll be good to it!\pOh! I hope you'll be good to\nmy {STR_VAR_2}, too!$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge6_Text_SkittySoMuchCuterThanImagined
text: Giggle!\nA SKITTY is so much cuter than I had\limagined. I'm delighted!$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge6_Text_WellThatsFineToo
text: Oh, you won't?\nWell, that's fine, too.\lPlease come visit us again.$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge6_Text_WouldYouLikeToTrade
text:
My POKéMON is a {STR_VAR_2}.
Do you know it?\lIt's quite cute and rather nice.\pThis little one, I could trade with
pride!\pWould you like to trade me a {STR_VAR_1}
for my {STR_VAR_2}?$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_HaventGotEnoughPoints
text: What the…\nYou haven't got enough Battle Points!$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_IllTakeBattlePoints
text: Do you see how skilled I am now?\nI'll take your Battle Points, thanks!$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_LadiesWereStrongAndBeautiful
text:
When I was just a wee YOUNGSTER,
those ladies were strong and beautiful.\pThey were idols among us TRAINERS.\pEven now, age hasn't dulled their
abilities.\pIn fact, their POKéMON moves have
grown even more polished.\pBut… For some reason, I can't help
but feel this…\pTime is so cruel…$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_LeftTutorIntro
text:
Buhahaha!\pYou couldn't tell it from looking now,
but I used to be one tough TRAINER.\pI had a reputation as the toughest
BEAUTY around, I tell you!\p… … … … … …\pWhat is it now?
You don't believe me.\pI'm not like that blowhard woman over
there. I'm actually talented!\pLet me prove it to you.
I can teach your POKéMON special and\lyet cute moves.\pBut my lessons don't come free.
How about paying for the moves I teach\lwith a wee bit of Battle Points?$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_LeftTutorWelcomeBack
text: Buhahaha!\pAre you back to learn special and\nyet cute POKéMON moves?$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_MoveWillBeXBattlePoints
text: The move {STR_VAR_1}, is it?\nThat will be {STR_VAR_2} Battle Points, okay?$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_RightTutorIntro
text:
Ihihihi!\pI know it's hard to see now, but I used
to be one fantastic TRAINER.\pI had a reputation as the most
invincible SWIMMER around, I tell you!\p… … … … … …\pWhat's wrong?
You don't believe me.\pI'm not like that buffoonish woman over
there. I'm actually experienced!\pI can prove it to you.
I can teach your POKéMON hard and\lyet pretty moves.\pBut my lessons don't come free.
How about paying for the moves I teach\lwith a wee bit of Battle Points?$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_RightTutorWelcomeBack
text: Ihihihi!\pHave you come to learn hard and\nyet pretty POKéMON moves?$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_TeachMoveToWhichMon
text: Fine, fine, now pick the POKéMON\nI should teach the move to.$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_TeachWhichMove
text: Fine, fine, look here!\nWhich move should I teach?$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_ThinkLadiesDontGetAlong
text: Those ladies, the way they bad-mouth\neach other, you probably think that\lthey don't get along.\pBut if that were true, they wouldn't\nstay out here together, would they?$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_YouDontWantTo
text: What's that?\nYou don't want to…\pIf you want to see how skilled I am,\nyou come see me anytime!$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge8_Text_KnowAboutFrontierBrains
text: Do you know about the FRONTIER\nBRAINS?\pThat's what SCOTT calls the seven\nspecial TRAINERS that run the seven\lfacilities in the BATTLE FRONTIER.$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge8_Text_ToldMeIHaveTalentForBattling
text: At the BATTLE TOWER, an older girl\ntold me that I have a lot of talent\lfor battling!\pI like POKéMON CONTESTS more!\pBut I'm no good at CONTESTS!\pI guess having talent and liking\nsomething aren't the same.$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge8_Text_WhatATrainerNeeds
text:
What a TRAINER needs…\pKnowledge…
Strategy…\lLuck…\lGuts…\lSpirit…\lBravery…\lAnd ability…\pWell, I'm all set in every way!
I'll be unstoppable at every building!\pHuh? POKéMON?
What's that?$

label: BattleFrontier_Mart_Text_ChaperonGrandson
text: We came here to chaperon our\ngrandson.\pBut since we're here, we thought\nwe should get some souvenirs.$

label: BattleFrontier_Mart_Text_FacilitiesDontAllowItems
text: A lot of the BATTLE FRONTIER's\nfacilities don't allow the use of items\lduring battles.\pThat rule makes things tougher than\nthey already are!$

label: BattleFrontier_Mart_Text_ProteinMakeNiceGift
text: Dear, what do you think of this?\nWouldn't this make a nice gift?\pIt's…PRO…TE…IN?\nIt sounds delicious, doesn't it?$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_BattleArenaSign
text: This is the BATTLE ARENA!\nLet the toughest teams gather!$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_BattlePalaceSign
text: This is the BATTLE PALACE!\nKeep your eyes on POKéMON battles!$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_BattlePyramidSign
text: This is the BATTLE PYRAMID!\nAdvance through the Battle Quest!$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_BattleTowerFeelsSpecial
text: Wow!\nIt's huge!\pThe BATTLE TOWER feels special.\nIt's different from the others.$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_BattleTowerSign
text: This is the BATTLE TOWER!\nKeep the win streak as the toughest\lTRAINER!$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_BelieveInYouBuddy
text: ZIGG!\nI believe in you, little buddy!\pI'll make my little ZIGG any favorite\ntasty treats you like if you win!$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_BetterThanDaddyAtPokemon
text: I'm better than my daddy\nat POKéMON.$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_CanDoAnythingWithYou
text: With you by my side, I can do anything.$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_ConquerLeagueAndFrontier
text: My grand ambition is to conquer both\nthe BATTLE FRONTIER and the POKéMON\lLEAGUE.\pAnd if my dream comes true…\pI… I'm going to ask MIMI next door\nif she will be friends with me!$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_DidScottBringYouHere
text:
Did SCOTT bring you here, too?
What is it with that guy?\pIt sounds like he really does know
how to spot talented TRAINERS, but…\pI've never seen him battling in person
ever.$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_EnoughBattlePointsForDoll
text: Yes!\nI've finally got enough Battle Points!\pI guess I'll trade for another giant\nplush DOLL!$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_ExchangeCornerSign
text: BATTLE POINT EXCHANGE SERVICE CORNER\nExchange your Battle Points!$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_FastOnBikeAndBattles
text: I'm fast on my BIKE, and that goes for\nthe way I battle, too.\pI win matches in the blink of\nan eye!$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_FrontierNotExclusivelyForToughTrainers
text:
The BATTLE FRONTIER isn't exclusively
for tough TRAINERS.\pMany people with special abilities
have been invited, it seems.\pThat man SCOTT…\pHe may have built this place to serve
a bigger objective…$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_GoRackUpSomeWinsForDaddy
text: Go on, my baby sweetie!\nGo rack up some wins for Daddy!\pYou're just like your mother,\nso you'll be dominating!$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_GotWipedOut
text:
Man! Oh man!
I've never lost once before!\pBut I got wiped out with no saving
grace at all!\pAnd then I'm told I don't have any
talent?! Man!$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_HeardPrettyGirlAtBattleArena
text:
It wasn't easy getting here,
but I'd heard about this knockout\lpretty girl at the BATTLE ARENA.\pInstead of her, do you know what
I found?\pA whole teeming mob of sweaty,
stinky, and primitive martial artists!$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_LegendOfBattlePyramid
text:
Do you know it?
The legend of the BATTLE PYRAMID?\pWhen there comes a confident TRAINER
reaching for the golden pinnacle,\lthere shall appear a man among men.\pDon't know that legend?
Well, of course not!\lI just made it up!\pWhat's it supposed to mean?
That, my friend, I can't say!$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_LikeToHaveNameRecordedHere
text: Oh, yeah, okay!\nSo this is the RANKING HALL!\pI'd like to go down in history as\na super champ and have my name\lrecorded here for posterity.$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_OddTreeHereSeemsToWiggle
text: Excuse me, young one.\nHave you good eyesight?\pThere is an odd tree past here, and to\nmy tired eyes it seems to wiggle.$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_OnceAnOddTreePastHere
text: Excuse me, young one.\nHave you a good memory?\pI have this feeling there once was\nan odd tree past here.$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_OnceBeatGymLeader
text: I may not look that impressive now,\nbut I once beat a GYM LEADER.\pWho knows, maybe I should give it\nanother shot at glory.$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_PeopleCallMeBusybody
text:
People call me a busybody,
but I can't help it.\pYour hat's on crooked!
Oh, no, trash on the ground!\lOops, it's almost dinnertime!\pI don't know if I can stand to just
watch at the BATTLE PALACE…$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_PowerOfOurLoveWillOvercome
text:
Ooh, darling, you are so wonderful!\pOoh, I just can't wait anymore!\pLet's go to a MULTI BATTLE ROOM
right this instant!\pIf we get together in the BATTLE SALON,
the power of our love will overcome\leveryone we meet.\pWhy, before us, darling, everything
will topple like dominoes!$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_PutTogetherUltimateTeam
text: I didn't sleep for a week, but then\nI put together the ultimate team!\pI can't see myself losing, no joke.\nWe're storming the BATTLE ARENA!$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_PyramidTooHarsh
text: The BATTLE PYRAMID's too harsh!\nI just can't make it to the top!\pSince I'm out of options, maybe I can\nclimb the outside…$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_RankingHallSign
text: BATTLE FRONTIER RANKING HALL\nSet your sights on new records!$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_SometimesImportantOldManInThere
text: I sometimes see this really important-\nlooking old man going in there.\pHe has these really awesome POKéMON.\nHe seems really nice, though.$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_StickyMonWithLongTail
text:
I…
I saw it!\pThere was a sticky sort of a POKéMON
with a long tail up ahead!\pIt was hiding under a boulder, and
it kept staring at me!$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_ThriveInDarkness
text: I thrive in darkness…\nYes… What is worthy of me?\lNone other than the BATTLE PYRAMID…\pWhat say you to wandering in darkness\nand in utter and total desperation?$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_ToughTrainerInBattleTower
text: This guy ran into a horribly tough\nTRAINER while he was on the BATTLE\lTOWER challenge.\pNow look at him…\pYou need to be cautious if you ever\ndecide to go to the BATTLE TOWER.$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_ZigzagoonLooksVacant
text: ZIGZAGOON looks vacant…$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_BattleDomeSign
text: This is the BATTLE DOME!\nYour path to the invincible superstar!$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_BattleFactorySign
text: This is the BATTLE FACTORY!\nSeek out the toughest POKéMON!$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_BattlePikeSign
text: This is the BATTLE PIKE!\nChoose one of three paths!$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_BestOutOfAllMyFriends
text: I'm the best out of all my friends.\nBut here…\lI've been useless!$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_BigGuySaidIllLendYouMons
text: Uh…\nI'm sure it'll be okay.\pI think…\pBut remember that big scary guy?\nHe said, “I'll lend you POKéMON!”$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_ChooseFishingOverBattling
text: I believe I'm the only person here who,\nfor some unknown reason, would choose\lfishing over battling.\pHuh? You can't catch anything here?\nThat's disappointing…$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_DomeAceIsMine
text:
Oh, shush!
Keep that racket down!\pYou fair-weather fans should stick
to cheering for some GYM LEADER!\pThe DOME ACE is mine!
The only idol for me!$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_DomeAceLookedBecauseOfMyCheering
text:
Whaaaaaat?!
Pfft!\pThat only happened because
I happened to be sitting next to you!\pThe DOME ACE only looked our way
because my cheering was so loud!$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_FansOverThereUsedToBeTrainers
text:
Those people squabbling over there…\pIt's hard to believe, but they once
were TRAINERS, and good ones, too.\pThey used to be incredibly tough,
and they were famous, too.\pBut they were obliterated by this
certain TRAINER at a tournament.\pThey were so thoroughly whipped,
they became smitten by the TRAINER.\pNow they're just fans of the TRAINER.
They go cheer for their idol at the\lBATTLE DOME every day now.$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_FinallyArrivedAtFrontier
text: I've finally arrived at the BATTLE\nFRONTIER!\pI'm sure to grab attention with\nmy looks and ability!$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_GotSeasickOnWayHere
text: I wanted to take a challenge as soon\nas I arrived here.\pBut on the way, I got seasick…\nUrrrrp…$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_KeepBattlingUntilIGetSymbol
text: Today, I'm going to keep battling, no\nmatter what, until I get a Symbol.$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_LastTimeOurEyesMet
text: Huh? Will you listen to yourself?\nThat's nothing!\pWhy, the last time I cheered for him,\nour eyes met and sparks flew!$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_LetsPlayRockPaperScissors
text: Let's play rock, paper, scissors!\nOne, two, three!\p… … … … … …$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_LilycoveItIs
text: LILYCOVE CITY it is, then!$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_LongDreamedAboutBattleFrontier
text: The BATTLE FRONTIER…\nI've long dreamed about a place like it.$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_LostIllPutOffPikeChallenge
text: Oh, no…\nI lost.\pI guess I'm not very lucky today.\nI'll put off my BATTLE PIKE challenge\luntil tomorrow.$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_MayISeeYourTicket
text: Hello, are you here for the ferry?\nMay I see your TICKET?$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_MetOlderGirlAtPike
text:
Crunch, munch…\pA while back, I met this older girl
at the BATTLE PIKE.\pShe had these eyes that were scary
in a real ornery way.\pCrunch, munch…\pShe got all furious: “Will you quit
eating!” Then she whaled on me.\pIt was a hair-raising kind of
scary experience, sure enough.\pCrunch, munch…$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_MonWithLongTailInFrontier
text: I heard a rumor that someone saw\na POKéMON with an unusually long tail\lsomewhere in the BATTLE FRONTIER.\pIt must be adorable. I'm sure of it…\pOh, challenges can wait. I feel driven\nto find the delightful creature!$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_MustHaveTicketToBoard
text: {PLAYER} doesn't have the TICKET…\pI'm terribly sorry.\pYou must have a TICKET to board\nthe ferry.$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_NothingHereNotLongAgo
text: There used to be nothing here not all\nthat long ago.\pBut, now look at this place! Amazing!\nI'll bring my mother out to see this.$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_OnlyToughTrainersBroughtHere
text:
It's not as if just anyone can come
here, you know?\pOnly those TRAINERS who've been
recognized as tough are brought here.\pThat's why many TRAINERS don't even
know about the BATTLE FRONTIER.$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_PleaseBoardFerry
text: Please board the ferry and wait for\ndeparture.$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_SailWithUsAnotherTime
text: Please sail with us another time!$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_ScaredOfPikeBecauseSeviper
text: I'm scared of going into the BATTLE\nPIKE because of SEVIPER…\pB-but I came all the way here, so I will\ntry to conquer everything!\l…Shudder…$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_SlateportItIs
text: SLATEPORT CITY it is, then!$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_SquareFilledWithToughPeople
text: Munch, munch…\pIt looks like this square's filled with\ntough people.\pMunch, munch…$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_SureWeCanChallengeWithNoMons
text: Hey, bro…\pAre you sure we can make challenges\neven if we don't have any POKéMON?$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_ThenWhereWouldYouLikeToGo
text: Then, where would you like to go?$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_WhereWouldYouLikeToGo
text: {PLAYER} flashed the TICKET.\pPerfect! That's all you need!\pAnd where would you like to go?$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_WhosRaisingThoseRentalMons
text: That's the BATTLE FACTORY.\nYou can rent strong POKéMON there.\pBut it makes me wonder.\nWho's raising those rental POKéMON?$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_WonIllTakePikeChallenge
text: Yay! I won!\nI will take the BATTLE PIKE challenge!$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_WontLetGentlemenBeatMe
text: Ah, so this here is the BATTLE DOME?\nI won't let GENTLEMEN beat me!\pBut where is the entrance?$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_YoureOffToChallengeDome
text: Oh? You're off to challenge\nthe BATTLE DOME?\pI'll wish you the best of luck.\nLet us both win our way up and meet\lin challenges.$

label: BattleFrontier_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_GoingThroughEveryChallenge
text: Giggle… I'm going to go through every\nchallenge with just this baby!$

label: BattleFrontier_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_NeverSeenPokemon
text:
There was someone here using a 
POKéMON I've never seen before.\pI never learned about it at
TRAINER'S SCHOOL at least.\pI wonder where you can catch POKéMON
like that.$

label: BattleFrontier_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_NextStopBattleArena
text: Okay! Next stop, the BATTLE ARENA!\nI'd better get the right POKéMON from\lthe PC Storage System.$

label: BattleFrontier_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Skitty
text: SKITTY: Mya myaaah!$

label: BattleFrontier_RankingHall_Text_DomePikeFactoryRecords
text: BATTLE DOME, BATTLE PIKE,\nand BATTLE FACTORY Records$

label: BattleFrontier_RankingHall_Text_ExplainRankingHall
text: This is the RANKING HALL.\pThis is where we recognize the immortal\nTRAINERS who left great records in\lBATTLE FRONTIER events.$

label: BattleFrontier_RankingHall_Text_IsYourNameOnThisList
text: Hi, is your name on this list?$

label: BattleFrontier_RankingHall_Text_MyNamesNotUpThere
text: Hmm…\nMy name's not up there…\pWell, it's only natural since I haven't\ntaken any challenges yet.$

label: BattleFrontier_RankingHall_Text_PalaceArenaPyramidRecords
text: BATTLE PALACE, BATTLE ARENA,\nand BATTLE PYRAMID Records$

label: BattleFrontier_RankingHall_Text_WorkHarderIfYouSawFriendsName
text: Oh, is that right?\pIf you saw your friend's name up here,\nI bet it would make you work harder!$

label: BattleFrontier_RankingHall_Text_WowThatsSuper
text: Wow, that's super!\nI'll have to try harder, too!$

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_BattleArenaInfo
text: The BATTLE ARENA is the dojo-like\nbuilding at the center-right of\lthe BATTLE FRONTIER.\pAn event called the Set KO Tourney\ntakes place at the BATTLE ARENA.$

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_BattleDomeInfo
text:
The BATTLE DOME is the large building
shaped like a huge egg.\pEvents named Battle Tourneys are held
in this facility.\pThe Battle Tourneys are offered in
two courses--for SINGLE and DOUBLE\lBATTLES.$

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_BattleFactoryInfo
text:
The BATTLE FACTORY is the large
building that is the closest to us.\pAn event called the Battle Swap
is conducted there.\pThe Battle Swap event is offered in
two courses for SINGLE and DOUBLE\lBATTLES.$

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_BattlePalaceInfo
text: The BATTLE PALACE is the red building\non the right of the BATTLE FRONTIER.\pThere are two kinds of BATTLE HALLS\nfor SINGLE and DOUBLE BATTLES.$

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_BattlePikeInfo
text: The BATTLE PIKE is the building shaped\nlike a POKéMON at the center-left of\lthe BATTLE FRONTIER.\pAn event called the Battle Choice\nis conducted there.$

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_BattlePointsInfo
text: Battle Points are rewards given to\nTRAINERS who battled outstandingly\lat the BATTLE FRONTIER.\pYou may trade in your Battle Points\nfor prizes at the EXCHANGE SERVICE\lCORNER.$

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_BattlePyramidInfo
text: The BATTLE PYRAMID is the enormous\npyramid.\pAn event called the Battle Quest\nis conducted there.$

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_BattleTowerInfo
text: It is the gigantic tower considered\nto be the BATTLE FRONTIER's symbol.\pThere are four kinds of BATTLE ROOMS\nin the tower for SINGLE, DOUBLE, MULTI,\land LINK MULTI BATTLES.$

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_EnjoyBattleFrontier
text: We hope you enjoy all that the BATTLE\nFRONTIER has to offer!$

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_ExchangeCornerInfo
text: The EXCHANGE SERVICE CORNER is near\nthe BATTLE TOWER.\pThe Battle Points you have earned in\nthe BATTLE FRONTIER may be exchanged\lfor fabulous prizes there.$

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_FirstTimeHereThisWay
text: Is it your first time here?\nPlease step this way!$

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_HoldItemsInfo
text: When entering a challenge at a BATTLE\nFRONTIER facility, POKéMON may not\lbe holding the same kind of item.\pPlease make sure that all POKéMON\nentering a challenge are holding\ldifferent items.$

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_IfItIsntPlayerYouCame
text: ???: Well, if it isn't {PLAYER}{KUN}!\nYou came out here!$

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_IssueFrontierPass
text: For a first-time visitor, we issue\nthe FRONTIER PASS.\pIt's for use at all the facilities\nin the BATTLE FRONTIER.\pHere you are!$

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_LearnAboutWhat
text: What would you like to learn about?$

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_LearnAboutWhich1
text: Which would you like to learn about?$

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_LearnAboutWhich2
text: Which would you like to learn about?$

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_Level50Info
text:
The Level 50 course is open to POKéMON
up to and including Level 50.\pPlease keep in mind, however, that
no TRAINER you face will have any\lPOKéMON below Level 50.\pThis course is the entry level for
battles at the BATTLE FRONTIER.\pTo begin, we hope you will challenge
this course.$

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_LevelModeInfo
text: All the challenges at the BATTLE\nFRONTIER's facilities come in\ltwo courses--Level 50 and Open Level.$

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_MonEntryInfo
text:
Virtually any kind of POKéMON may take
on the challenges at all facilities.\pEGGS and certain kinds of POKéMON,
however, are not permitted.\pThe numbers of POKéMON required for
challenges will depend on the facility.\pAt all facilities, however, two or more
of the same kind of POKéMON are not\lpermitted.$

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_ObtainedFrontierPass
text: {PLAYER} obtained\nthe FRONTIER PASS.$

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_OhMrScottGoodDay
text: GUIDE: Oh! MR. SCOTT, sir!\nGood day to you, sir!$

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_OpenLevelInfo
text:
The Open Level course places no limit
on the levels of POKéMON entering\lchallenges.\pThe levels of your opponents will
be adjusted to match the levels of\lyour POKéMON.\pHowever, no TRAINER you face will
have any POKéMON below Level 60.$

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_PlacedTrainerCardInFrontierPass
text: {PLAYER} placed the TRAINER CARD\nin the FRONTIER PASS.$

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_RankingHallInfo
text: The RANKING HALL is located near\nthe BATTLE TOWER.\pThere, you may see the most fantastic\nrecords left by the TRAINERS that\ltook on the many challenges of\lthe BATTLE FRONTIER.$

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_RecordedBattleInfo
text:
It is possible to record one battle
on your FRONTIER PASS.\pYou may record a battle you had with
a friend or friends.\pOr you may record a battle conducted
at the BATTLE FRONTIER excluding\lmatches at the BATTLE PIKE or\lthe BATTLE PYRAMID.\pYou may choose to record your match
at the end of a battle.$

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_ScottGreatToSeeYouHere
text:
SCOTT: It's great to see you here,
it really is!\pI hope you'll take your time and
explore everywhere.\pNaturally, I hope you'll also experience
the pure essence of battling.\pI also have my quarters here, so feel
free to visit if you have time.$

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_SymbolsInfo
text:
There are seven facilities at
the BATTLE FRONTIER.\pTRAINERS who gain recognition for
their abilities may be rewarded with\lsymbols from each of the facilities.\pTo earn a symbol, TRAINERS may need
to defeat other TRAINERS in a row,\land may need to win events repeatedly.\pIt's certainly not easy to win symbols.
I wish you the best of luck!$

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_WelcomeToBattleFrontier
text: The front lines of POKéMON battling!\nWelcome to the BATTLE FRONTIER!$

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_YourGuideToFacilities
text: I'm your guide to the various facilities\nhere in the BATTLE FRONTIER.$

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_YourGuideToFrontierPass
text: I'm your guide to the FRONTIER PASS.$

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_YourGuideToRules
text: I'm your guide to the basic rules that\nare common to all the challenges\loffered by the facilities in the BATTLE\lFRONTIER.$

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_Beat100TrainersInARow
text: SCOTT: Oh, my! I heard about you!\nHow you overwhelmed the BATTLE TOWER!\lYou beat over 100 TRAINERS in a row?\pThat's ridiculously spectacular!\nYou've got to have this!$

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_Beat50TrainersInARow
text: SCOTT: Oh, I heard about you!\nHow you ruled the BATTLE TOWER!\lYou beat over 50 TRAINERS in a row?\pThat's fantastic!\nI want you to have this!$

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_BerryPocketStuffed
text: Your BERRY POCKET seems to\nbe stuffed.$

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_ComeBackForThisLater
text: Oops, well, if you have too much\nstuff, come back for this later.$

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_ExpectingGreatThings
text: I'm expecting great things from you!$

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_ExpectingToHearEvenGreaterThings
text: I'll be expecting to hear even greater\nthings about you now!$

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_ExplainBattlePoints
text:
SCOTT: You can check your Battle
Points on your FRONTIER PASS.\pThe more success you have here at
the BATTLE FRONTIER, the more Battle\lPoints you will collect.\pUse your Battle Points the way you
see fit, like trading them for items.$

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_HaveThisAsMementoOfOurPathsCrossing
text:
But that's all in the past.
No point dwelling on that!\pAll I want for you is to enjoy battling
to your heart's content here.\p{PLAYER}{KUN}, I want you to have this
as a memento for all the time our\lpaths crossed on our journeys.$

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_HaveYouMetFrontierBrain
text:
SCOTT: Have you met any of
the FRONTIER BRAINS?\pBetter yet, have you obtained any
symbols from them?\pI handpicked the FRONTIER BRAINS
as the toughest TRAINERS anywhere.\pBut I'm sure that seeing how tough
you are will startle even them!$

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_HowMuchEffortItTookToMakeReal
text:
On reflection, it was a terribly long
journey…\pI left home alone on a quest to find
strong TRAINERS.\pNo one can imagine how much effort
or time it took to make this real.$

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_MayFindWildMonsInFrontier
text:
SCOTT: You don't just train for battle,
right?\pI think I remember you working on
a POKéDEX as well.\pWell, guess what?\pYou may run into wild POKéMON in
the BATTLE FRONTIER somewhere…\lFufufu!$

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_ObtainedXBattlePoints
text: {PLAYER} obtained\n{STR_VAR_1} Battle Point(s).$

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_SoGladIBroughtYouHere
text: I must say I have the gift of knowing\na good TRAINER when I see one.\pI'm so glad I had the foresight to\nbring you here!$

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_WelcomeToBattleFrontier
text:
SCOTT: Well, hello and welcome!
Heheh… Sorry about the cramped space.\pAnyway, {PLAYER}{KUN}, let me formally
welcome you to the BATTLE FRONTIER.\pThis is my dream come true.
It took me years and years, but I've\lfinally given shape to my dream.$

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_WhyIGoSeekingTrainers
text:
SCOTT: Every TRAINER is an individual.
They all lead lives of their own.\pBut when they're in a battle,
it doesn't matter who they are.\pThey're all the same!\pI love the purity of battle,
where everyone is equal.\pThat's why I go everywhere seeking
TRAINERS who are serious about\lbattling, and invite them here.$

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_YouveCollectedAllGoldSymbols
text:
SCOTT: I hope you're enjoying
everything in the BATTLE FRONTIER.\p…Wait a second…
Oh, my disbelieving eyes!\pYour FRONTIER PASS!
You've gathered up the full set\lof gold symbols!\pThat's more than stupendous!
You're incredible, just as I suspected!\p… … … … … …\p{PLAYER}, you've got to accept this!\pI think you will be able to
appreciate the value of my gift!$

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_YouveCollectedAllSilverSymbols
text:
SCOTT: Are you enjoying things in
the BATTLE FRONTIER?\p…Wait a second…
Oh!\pYour FRONTIER PASS!
You've collected the full set\lof silver symbols!\pThat's more than impressive!
You are tough, just as I suspected!\pNormally, I wouldn't do something
like this, but this is a special time!\pI want you to have this.
I'm sure you can put it to proper use.$

label: BattleFrontier_Text_ObtainedXBattlePoints
text: {PLAYER} obtained {STR_VAR_1} Battle Point(s).$

label: BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainLevelRules
text: At this BATTLE TENT, the levels of\nyour opponents will be adjusted to\lmatch the levels of your POKéMON.\pHowever, no TRAINER you face will\nhave any POKéMON below Level 30.$

label: BerryBlender_Text_AllPlayersArrived
text: {STR_VAR_1}, {STR_VAR_2}, and\n{STR_VAR_3} arrived.$

label: BerryBlender_Text_BlendMasterExplainBerryBlending
text: Hmmm!\pAh, but it is a simple process!\pWhen the BLENDER's arrow comes to\nyour marker, just press the A Button.\pThat's all you have to do.\pWhen you see how precisely I press\nthe A Button, you will understand.$

label: BerryBlender_Text_BlendMasterKnowHowToMakePokeblocks
text: Of course!\nOf course!\pIncidentally…\nYou do know how to blend {POKEBLOCK}S\lfrom BERRIES?$

label: BerryBlender_Text_BlendMasterLetsBerryBlender
text: Fine!\pLet's get started, then!\pAll together with the BLEND MASTER,\nlet's BERRY BLENDER!$

label: BerryBlender_Text_BlendMasterNoBerries
text: Hmmm!\pYou haven't got a single BERRY!\pI shall be here all day!\nHurry back with some BERRIES!$

label: BerryBlender_Text_BlendMasterNoPokeblockCase
text: Hmmm!\pYou don't appear to have gotten\nthe {POKEBLOCK} CASE!\pI shall be here all day!\nObtain the {POKEBLOCK} CASE and hurry back!$

label: BerryBlender_Text_BlendMasterPokeblockCaseFull
text: Hmmm!\pYour {POKEBLOCK} CASE appears to be full!\pI shall be here all day!\nUse some {POKEBLOCK}S and hurry back!$

label: BerryBlender_Text_BlendWithTheBlendMaster
text: BLEND MASTER: Indeed I am!\nThe BLEND MASTER am I!\pBlend with me, and you shall witness\nthe mastery I bring to blending!$

label: BerryBlender_Text_CanHaveOneOfMyBerries
text: Well, that won't do at all now, will it?\pIf you don't mind leftovers, you can\nhave one of my BERRIES.\pThat way, we could make some {POKEBLOCK}S\ntogether using the BERRY BLENDER.$

label: BerryBlender_Text_DontHaveAnyBerries
text: Oh?\nYou don't have any BERRIES?\pIf you don't have any BERRIES,\nyou can't make any {POKEBLOCK}S.$

label: BerryBlender_Text_DontHaveAnyBerries2
text:
Oh, but wait a second here…
You don't have any BERRIES.\pYou can't make any {POKEBLOCK}S without
BERRIES…\pWe'll always be around whenever you
get hold of some BERRIES to blend.$

label: BerryBlender_Text_DontHaveAnyBerries3
text:
You don't have any BERRIES,
do you?\pIf you don't have any BERRIES,
you can't make any {POKEBLOCK}S.\pWe'll always be making {POKEBLOCK}S here,
so let's make some together when\lyou get a BERRY or two.$

label: BerryBlender_Text_DontHaveAnyBerriesHaveOne
text: Oh?\nYou don't have any BERRIES?\pWell, that won't do at all now, will it?\pIf you don't mind leftovers, you can\nhave one of my BERRIES.$

label: BerryBlender_Text_DontHaveAnyBerriesNoneToSpare
text:
Oh?
You don't have any BERRIES?\pIf I had some left over, I'd gladly
give you one…\pBut, I don't have any to spare today.
Sorry about that.$

label: BerryBlender_Text_DontHaveAnyBerriesToSpare
text: If I had some BERRIES left over,\nI'd gladly give you one…\pBut, I don't have any to spare today.\nWe'll have to do this another time.$

label: BerryBlender_Text_DontHavePokeblockCase
text: But you don't have a {POKEBLOCK} CASE.\pYou should get a {POKEBLOCK} CASE and then\ncome see me.$

label: BerryBlender_Text_DontHavePokeblockCase2
text: Oh, but wait a second here…\nYou don't have a {POKEBLOCK} CASE.\pYou should get a {POKEBLOCK} CASE and\nthen come back.$

label: BerryBlender_Text_DontHavePokeblockCase3
text: You haven't gotten a {POKEBLOCK} CASE\nyet, it looks like.\pYou need to get a {POKEBLOCK} CASE before\nyou come back.$

label: BerryBlender_Text_DontHavePokeblockCaseLink
text: You don't have a {POKEBLOCK} CASE.\nThe BERRY BLENDER can't be used.$

label: BerryBlender_Text_Excellent
text: Excellent!$

label: BerryBlender_Text_ExplainBerryBlending
text: Okay, a little explanation, then.\pOh, don't worry, it's quite simple.\pWhen the BLENDER's arrow comes to\nyour marker, just press the A Button.\pThat's all you have to do.\nYou'll see how easy it is when you try.$

label: BerryBlender_Text_ExplainBerryBlending2
text:
Okay!
Let me explain it to you!\pWhen the spinning BLENDER's arrow
reaches your marker, just press\lthe A Button.\pThat's all it takes.
Pretty easy, don't you think?$

label: BerryBlender_Text_ExplainBerryBlending3
text: Oh, dear!\pThen, I'll explain it to you nicely.\pWhen the BLENDER's arrow spins to\nyour marker, press the A Button.\pThat's all it takes.\nIsn't it simple?$
