text: Do you know how to make a {POKEBLOCK}?$

label: BerryBlender_Text_KnowHowToMakePokeblocks2
text: Of course, you do know how to\nblend {POKEBLOCK}S, don't you?$

label: BerryBlender_Text_KnowHowToMakePokeblocks3
text: Naturally, you know how to make\n{POKEBLOCK}S, don't you?$

label: BerryBlender_Text_LeftUsInShock
text: Oh, dear me…\pYou've left us in shock!$

label: BerryBlender_Text_LetsBerryBlender
text: Let's get started, then!\pLet's BERRY BLENDER!$

label: BerryBlender_Text_LetsBerryBlender2
text: Let's get started, then!\pLet's BERRY BLENDER!$

label: BerryBlender_Text_LetsBerryBlender3
text: Okay, dear!\nLet's get started!\pLet's BERRY BLENDER!$

label: BerryBlender_Text_LetsGetBlendingAlready
text: Let's get blending already!$

label: BerryBlender_Text_LookGoodAtBlendingJoinUs
text: Oh, dear!\nYou look as if you're good at blending.\lWould you like to join us?$

label: BerryBlender_Text_LoveMakingPokeblocks
text: I love making {POKEBLOCK}S.\pI always have some BERRIES with me.$

label: BerryBlender_Text_MadeAmazingPokeblocksWithMaster
text: When I blended with the MASTER,\nwe made amazing {POKEBLOCK}S!$

label: BerryBlender_Text_MadeOldTimerSad
text: Oh…\nYou've made this old-timer sad…$

label: BerryBlender_Text_MakeDeliciousPokeblocks
text: I'm going to make delicious {POKEBLOCK}S\nand make my POKéMON cuter.$

label: BerryBlender_Text_MakePokeblocksUsingBerryBlender
text: If you'd like, we could make some\n{POKEBLOCK}S together using the\lBERRY BLENDER.$

label: BerryBlender_Text_MasterWorksOnSkillsInMountains
text: The BLEND MASTER's supposed to work\non his skills deep in the mountains.\pSometimes, he comes to LILYCOVE\nto blend BERRIES all day long.$

label: BerryBlender_Text_NoBerriesLink
text: You have no BERRIES.\nThe BERRY BLENDER can't be used.$

label: BerryBlender_Text_OhDear
text: Oh, dear!$

label: BerryBlender_Text_Okay
text: Okay!$

text: {STR_VAR_1} and {STR_VAR_2} arrived.$

label: BerryBlender_Text_Player1Arrived
text: {STR_VAR_1} arrived.$

label: BerryBlender_Text_PokeblockCaseIsFull
text: But your {POKEBLOCK} CASE is full.\pYou should use some {POKEBLOCK}S before\nyou come see me again.$

label: BerryBlender_Text_PokeblockCaseIsFull2
text: Oh, but wait a second here…\nYour {POKEBLOCK} CASE is full.\pYou should use some {POKEBLOCK}S and\nthen come back.$

text: Your {POKEBLOCK} CASE is full,\nit looks like.\pYou should use some {POKEBLOCK}S up\nand then come back.$

label: BerryBlender_Text_PokeblockCaseIsFullLink

label: BerryBlender_Text_QualitiesOfBlendMaster
text:
Eyes that track the arrow with
machinelike intensity…\pA hand that taps the A Button
with clockwork-like precision…\pPossessing these qualities makes
the BLEND MASTER truly great.$

label: BerryBlender_Text_SaveGameBeforeBerryBlenderLink
text: {POKEBLOCK}S will be made with your friends \nfrom BERRIES in the BERRY BLENDER.\pIs it okay to save the game before\nlinking with your friends?$

label: BerryBlender_Text_SearchingForFriends
text: Searching for your friends…\n… … B Button: Cancel$

label: BerryBlender_Text_SeeMyMasteryInAction
text: BLEND MASTER: Hmmm! So, you wish to\nsee my mastery in action?$

label: BerryBlender_Text_SetNewBlenderRecord
text: Okay! Today's going to be the day that\nI set a new BLENDER speed record!$

label: BerryBlender_Text_ThatsTooBad
text: That's too bad…\pBut we'll always be around whenever\nyou get the urge to blend!$

label: BerryBlender_Text_TooBusyNowIsee
text: Hmmm!\pSo, you are too busy now, I see!\pBut fear not!\nI shall be here all day!\lHurry back from your errand!$

label: BerryBlender_Text_UseItToMakePokeblocksTogether
text: We'll use it to make {POKEBLOCK}S together\nusing the BERRY BLENDER.$

label: CableClub_Text_ExplainBattleModes
text:
There are three Battle Modes.\pSINGLE BATTLE is for two TRAINERS
with one or more POKéMON each.\pEach TRAINER can have one POKéMON
in battle at a time.\pDOUBLE BATTLE is for two TRAINERS
with two or more POKéMON each.\pEach TRAINER will send out two
POKéMON in battle at a time.\pMULTI BATTLE is for four TRAINERS
with one or more POKéMON each.\pEach TRAINER can have one POKéMON
in battle at a time.$

label: CableClub_Text_ExplainWirelessClub
text:
Let me explain how the POKéMON
WIRELESS CLUB works.\pOn this, the top floor, there are
two rooms.\pFirst, the room on the left.
It's the UNION ROOM.\pYou may link up with TRAINERS
around you who have also entered\lthe UNION ROOM.\pWith them, you may do things like
chat, battle, and trade.\pSecond, the room on the right is
the DIRECT CORNER.\pYou may trade or battle POKéMON
with your friends in this room.\pSometimes, you may not be able to
find your friends in the UNION ROOM\lor the DIRECT CORNER.\pIn that case, please move closer
to your friends.\pIf the Wireless Adapter isn't
connected, you may still link up\lusing a GBA Game Link cable.\pIf that is the case, you must go
to the DIRECT CORNER.\pI hope you enjoy the Wireless 
Communication System.$

label: CaveOfOrigin_B1F_Text_ButWereInCaveOfOrigin
text: WALLACE: The CAVE OF ORIGIN?\pBut that's right here!\nI need you to do better than that!\pPlease, I need you to think about\nwhere RAYQUAZA might be right now.$

label: CaveOfOrigin_B1F_Text_CantYouRememberSomehow
text: WALLACE: Huh? You don't remember?\nHmm… That's a problem…\pCan't you remember somehow?$

label: CaveOfOrigin_B1F_Text_OldLadyDidntMentionThat
text:
WALLACE: MT. PYRE?\pBut when I met the old lady there
earlier, she made no mention of it.\pI very much doubt that the old lady
would try to hide something from me…\p{PLAYER}{KUN}, could you think about this
more carefully for me?$

label: CaveOfOrigin_B1F_Text_WallaceStory
text:
Ah, so you are {PLAYER}{KUN}?
I've heard tales of your exploits.\pMy name is WALLACE.\pI was once the GYM LEADER of
SOOTOPOLIS, but something came up.\pSo now, I've entrusted my mentor JUAN
with the GYM's operation.\p… … … … … …
… … … … … …\pGROUDON and KYOGRE, the two POKéMON
wreaking havoc here, are considered\lto be super-ancient POKéMON.\pBut there aren't just two super-
ancient POKéMON.\pThere is one more somewhere.\pSomewhere, there is a super-
ancient POKéMON named RAYQUAZA.\pIt's said that it was RAYQUAZA that
becalmed the two combatants in\lthe distant past.\pBut even I have no clue as to
RAYQUAZA's whereabouts…$

label: CaveOfOrigin_B1F_Text_WellHeadToSkyPillar
text: WALLACE: The SKY PILLAR?\pThat's it!\nIt must be the SKY PILLAR!\p{PLAYER}{KUN}, there's not a moment to lose!\nWe'll head to the SKY PILLAR right away!$

label: CaveOfOrigin_B1F_Text_WhereIsRayquaza
text: WALLACE: {PLAYER}{KUN}, do you perhaps\nknow where RAYQUAZA is now?\pIf you do, please tell me.$

text: For long outings, you should buy\nREVIVE.$

label: CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_2F_Text_FloorSign
text: Top-Grade Items for TRAINERS!\p2F: TRAINER'S MARKET$

label: CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_2F_Text_LanceComesToBuyCapes
text: We have a customer, LANCE, who\noccasionally comes.\pHe always buys capes.\pI wonder… Does he have many\nidentical capes at home?$

label: CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_3F_Text_AnRPG
text: An RPG!\nThere's no time for that!$

label: CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_3F_Text_BuddyTradingKangaskhanForHaunter
text: All right!\pMy buddy's going to trade me his\nKANGASKHAN for my HAUNTER!$

label: CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_3F_Text_CanIdentifyTradeMonsByID
text: You can identify POKéMON you get\nin trades by their ID Numbers.$

label: CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_3F_Text_FightingGame
text: A fighting game!\nLooks tough!$

label: CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_3F_Text_HaunterEvolvedOnTrade
text: Come on, HAUNTER!\pI love HAUNTER!\nI collect them!\pHuh?\pHAUNTER turned into a different\nPOKéMON while being traded!$

label: CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_3F_Text_ItsSuperNES
text: It's a Super NES.$

label: CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_3F_Text_OTStandsForOriginalTrainer
text: Captured POKéMON are registered\nwith an ID No. and the OT.\pOT stands for “Original TRAINER” -\nthe TRAINER that caught it first.$

label: CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_3F_Text_PuzzleGame
text: A puzzle game!\nLooks addictive!$

label: CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_3F_Text_RedGreenBothArePokemon
text: Red and Green!\nBoth are POKéMON!$

label: CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_3F_Text_SportsGame
text: A sports game!\nDad'll like that!$

label: CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_3F_Text_TVGameShop
text: 3F: TV GAME SHOP$

label: CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_4F_Text_CanRunAwayWithPokeDoll
text: I heard something useful.\pIf a wild POKéMON appears, you can\ndistract it with a POKé DOLL.\pYou can run away while the wild\nPOKéMON is distracted.$

label: CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_4F_Text_FloorSign
text: Express yourself with gifts!\n4F: WISE MAN GIFTS\pEvolution Special!\nElement STONES on sale now!$

label: CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_4F_Text_GettingPokeDollAsPresent
text: I'm getting a present for my\ngirlfriend.\pI guess a POKé DOLL will be it.\nIt's the popular thing.$

label: CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_5F_Text_Drugstore
text: 5F: DRUGSTORE$

label: CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_5F_Text_ExplainStatEnhancers
text:
POKéMON stat enhancers can be
bought only here.\pHP UP increases the base HP of a
POKéMON.\pCALCIUM raises the base SP. ATK
stat of one POKéMON.\pZINC boosts the base SP. DEF stat
of one POKéMON.\pCARBOS enhances the base SPEED
stat.$

label: CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_5F_Text_HereForStatEnhancers
text:
I'm here for POKéMON stat
enhancers.\pPROTEIN increases the base ATTACK
power.\pIRON increases the base DEFENSE
stat.$

label: CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_Roof_Text_DontHaveSpaceForThis
text: You don't have space for this!$

label: CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_Roof_Text_DrinkCanPoppedOut
text: A can of {STR_VAR_1} popped out!$

label: CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_Roof_Text_ExplainTM16
text: TM16 contains LIGHT SCREEN.\pIt's a move that weakens the power\nof special attacks by your foe.$

label: CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_Roof_Text_ExplainTM20
text: TM20 contains SAFEGUARD.\pIt's a move that prevents status\nproblems among your POKéMON.$

label: CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_Roof_Text_ExplainTM33
text: TM33 contains REFLECT.\pIt's a move that weakens the power\nof physical attacks by your foe.$

label: CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_Roof_Text_FloorSign
text: ROOFTOP SQUARE:\nVENDING MACHINES$

label: CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_Roof_Text_GiveWhichDrink
text: Give her which drink?$

label: CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_Roof_Text_ImNotThirstyAfterAll
text: No, thank you!\nI'm not thirsty after all!$

label: CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_Roof_Text_ImThirstyGiveHerDrink
text: I'm thirsty!\nI want something to drink!\p{FONT_NORMAL}Give her a drink?$

label: CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_Roof_Text_ImThirstyIWantDrink
text: I'm thirsty!\nI want something to drink!$

label: CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_Roof_Text_MySisterIsImmature
text: My sister is a TRAINER, believe it\nor not.\pBut, she's so immature, she drives\nme nuts!$

label: CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_Roof_Text_NoMoreRoomForStuff
text: There's no more room for stuff!$

label: CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_Roof_Text_NotEnoughMoney
text: Oops, not enough money!$

label: CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_Roof_Text_NotThirsty
text: Not thirsty!$

label: CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_Roof_Text_VendingMachineWhatDoesItHave
text: A vending machine!\nWhat does it have?$

label: CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_Roof_Text_YayFreshWaterHaveThis
text: Yay!\pFRESH WATER!\pThank you!\nYou can have this from me!$

label: CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_Roof_Text_YayLemonadeHaveThis
text: Yay!\pLEMONADE!\pThank you!\nYou can have this from me!$

label: CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_Roof_Text_YaySodaPopHaveThis
text: Yay!\pSODA POP!\pThank you!\nYou can have this from me!$

label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_PrizeRoom_Text_CoinCaseRequired
text: A COIN CASE is required…$

label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_PrizeRoom_Text_FancyThatPorygon
text: I sure do fancy that PORYGON!\nBut, it's hard to win at slots!$

label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_PrizeRoom_Text_NeedMoreCoins
text: Sorry, you'll need more COINS\nthan that.$

label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_PrizeRoom_Text_RakedItInToday
text: Gahaha! I raked it in today!\nIf only every day were like this…$

label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_PrizeRoom_Text_WeExchangeCoinsForPrizes
text: We exchange your COINS for prizes.$

label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_PrizeRoom_Text_WhichPrize
text: Which prize would you like?$

label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_PrizeRoom_Text_YouWantPrize
text: So, you want the {STR_VAR_1}?$

label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_PrizeRoom_Text_YouWantTM
text: Okay, a TM of {STR_VAR_2}\nis what you want?$

label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_BigSmileForPhoto
text: A big smile for the photo, please!\nThree… Two… One…\pFlash!$

label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_CanExchangeCoinsNextDoor
text: Welcome!\pYou can exchange your COINS for\nfabulous prizes next door.$

label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_CantAffordCoins
text: You can't afford the COINS.$

label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_ChoosePrintType
text: Please choose the print type.$

label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_CoinCaseIsFull
text: Whoops!\nYour COIN CASE is full.$

label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_CoinCaseIsRequired
text: A COIN CASE is required…$

label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_ComePlaySometime
text: No?\nPlease come play sometime!$

label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_DoYouWantToPlay
text: Kid, do you want to play?$

label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_DontHaveCoinCase
text: Oops!\nDon't have the COIN CASE!$

label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_DontHaveEnoughMoney
text: You don't have enough money.$

label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_DontNeedMyCoins
text: You don't need my COINS!$

label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_GruntDefeat
text: Dang!$

label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_GruntIntro
text: I'm guarding this poster!\nGo away, or else!$

label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_GruntPostBattle
text: The TEAM ROCKET HIDEOUT might\nbe discovered!\pI better tell BOSS!$

label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_GymGuyAdvice
text:
Hey!\pYou have better things to do,
champ in the making!\pCELADON GYM's LEADER is ERIKA.\pShe is a user of GRASS-type
POKéMON, and at one with nature.\pShe might appear docile because of
her flower arranging…\pBut she's not one to be taken
lightly!$

label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_HereAreSomeCoinsShoo
text: Hey, what? You're throwing me off!\nHere are some COINS, so shoo!$

label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_HereAreYourCoins
text: Thank you.\nHere are your COINS!$

label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_NeedMoreCoinsForMonIWant
text: Darn! I need more COINS for the\nPOKéMON I want!$

label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_OutOfOrder
text: OUT OF ORDER\nThis is broken.$

label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_OutToLunch
text: OUT TO LUNCH\nThis is reserved.$

label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_PrintIsReadyCheckTrainerCard
text: Your POKéMON print is ready!\nCheck your TRAINER CARD.$

label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_RareMonsForCoins
text: They offer rare POKéMON that can\nbe exchanged for your COINS.\pBut, I just can't seem to win!$

label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_Received10CoinsFromMan
text: {PLAYER} received 10 COINS\nfrom the man.$

label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_Received20CoinsFromMan
text: {PLAYER} received 20 COINS\nfrom the man.$

label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_Received20CoinsFromNiceGuy
text: {PLAYER} received 20 COINS\nfrom the nice guy.$

label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_RumoredTeamRocketRunsThisPlace
text: Keep this quiet.\pIt's rumored that this place is run\nby TEAM ROCKET.$

label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_SlotMachineWantToPlay
text: A slot machine!\nWant to play?$

label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_SoEasyToGetHooked
text: Games are scary!\nIt's so easy to get hooked!$

label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_SomeonesKeys
text: Someone's keys!\nThey'll be back.$

label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_SorryDontHaveCoinCase
text: Oh, I'm sorry.\nYou don't have a COIN CASE.$

label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_SwitchBehindPosterPushIt
text: Hey!\pA switch behind the poster!?\nLet's push it!$

label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_ThinkMachinesHaveDifferentOdds
text: I think these machines have\ndifferent odds.$

label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_TryPokemonPrinter
text: It's a POKéMON PRINTER!\pIt can put a print of your POKéMON\non the back of your TRAINER CARD.\pIt costs only ¥50.\nWould you like to try it?$

label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_WantSomeCoins
text: What's up?\nWant some COINS?$

label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_WatchReelsClosely
text: The trick is to watch the reels\nclosely.$

label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_WelcomeBuySomeCoins
text: Welcome to ROCKET GAME CORNER!\pDo you need some game COINS?\nWould you like to buy some?$

label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_WinOrLoseItsOnlyLuck
text: These slot games…\nWin or lose, it's only by luck.$

label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_WinsComeAndGo
text: Wins seem to come and go.\nNothing's a sure thing.$

label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_YouHaveLotsOfCoins
text: You have lots of COINS!$

label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_YouveGotPlentyCoins
text: You've got plenty of your own\nCOINS!$

label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_BridgetDefeat
text: My makeup!$

label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_BridgetIntro
text: Oh, welcome.\nI was getting bored.$

label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_BridgetPostBattle
text: GRASS-type POKéMON are tough\nagainst the WATER type.\pThey also have an edge on ROCK-\nand GROUND-type POKéMON.$

label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_ErikaDefeat
text: Oh!\nI concede defeat.\lYou are remarkably strong.\pI must confer on you the\nRAINBOWBADGE.$

label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_ErikaIntro
text:
Hello…
Lovely weather, isn't it?\lIt's so pleasant…\p…Oh, dear…
I must have dozed off. Welcome.\pMy name is ERIKA.
I am the LEADER of CELADON GYM.\pI am a student of the art of
flower arranging.\pMy POKéMON are solely of the
GRASS type.\p…Oh, I'm sorry, I had no idea that
you wished to challenge me.\pVery well, but I shall not lose.{PLAY_BGM MUS_RG_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}$

label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_ErikaPostBattle
text: You are cataloging POKéMON?\nI must say I'm impressed.\pI would never collect POKéMON if\nthey were unattractive.$

label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_ExplainRainbowBadgeTakeThis
text: The RAINBOWBADGE will make\nPOKéMON up to Lv. 50 obey.\pIt also allows POKéMON to use\nSTRENGTH in and out of battle.\pPlease also take this with you.$

label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_ExplainTM19
text: TM19 contains GIGA DRAIN.\pHalf the damage it inflicts is\ndrained to heal your POKéMON.\pWouldn't you agree that it's a\nwonderful move?$

label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_GymStatue
text: CELADON POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: ERIKA\pWINNING TRAINERS:\n{RIVAL}$

label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_GymStatuePlayerWon
text: CELADON POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: ERIKA\pWINNING TRAINERS:\n{RIVAL}, {PLAYER}$

label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_KayDefeat
text: You're too rough!$

label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_KayIntro
text: I should tell you about this GYM.\pOnly real ladies are allowed in\nhere!$

label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_KayPostBattle
text: Bleaah!\nI hope ERIKA wipes you out!$

label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_LisaDefeat
text: Oh!\nYou!$

label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_LisaIntro
text: Oh, hey!\pWe don't like BUG- or FIRE-type\nPOKéMON in here!$

label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_LisaPostBattle
text: Our LEADER ERIKA might be quiet,\nbut she's famous around here.$

label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_LoriDefeat
text: Oh!\nSplendid!$

label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_LoriIntro
text: Pleased to meet you.\nMy hobby is POKéMON training.$

label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_LoriPostBattle
text: I have a blind date coming up.\nI have to learn to be polite,\lespecially if I have to battle.$

label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_MaryDefeat
text: Oh!\nBeaten!$

label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_MaryIntro
text: Welcome to CELADON GYM!\pYou'd better not underestimate\nthe nice ladies here.$

label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_MaryPostBattle
text: I didn't bring my best POKéMON.\nWait until next time!$

label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_ReceivedTM19FromErika
text: {PLAYER} received TM19\nfrom ERIKA.$

label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_ShouldMakeRoomForThis
text: You should make room for this.$

label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_TamiaDefeat
text: No!$

label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_TamiaIntro
text: Look, look!\nSee my POKéMON!\pI like the GRASS type.\nI like how they're easy to raise.$

label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_TamiaPostBattle
text: We only use GRASS-type POKéMON at\nour GYM.\pWhy? We also use them for making\nflower arrangements!$

label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_TinaDefeat
text: You're an eye-opener!$

label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_TinaIntro
text: …Weren't you peeking in here\nearlier?$

label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_TinaPostBattle
text: Oh, you were looking at ERIKA…\nYou weren't looking at me…$

label: CeladonCity_Hotel_Text_OnVacationWithBrotherAndBoyfriend
text: I'm on vacation with my brother and\nboyfriend.\pCELADON is such a pretty city!$

label: CeladonCity_Hotel_Text_SisBroughtMeOnVacation
text: Yippee! I'm on vacation!\nMy sis brought me along! Awesome!$

label: CeladonCity_Hotel_Text_ThisHotelIsForPeople
text: POKéMON?\nNo, this is a hotel for people.\pWe're full up, unfortunately.$

label: CeladonCity_Hotel_Text_WhyDidSheBringBrother
text: Why?\nWhy did she bring her brother?$

label: CeladonCity_House1_Text_DontTouchGameCornerPoster
text: Don't touch the poster at the GAME\nCORNER!\pThere's no secret switch behind it!$

label: CeladonCity_House1_Text_ShippedMonsAsSlotPrizes
text: CHIEF!\pWe just shipped two thousand\nmore POKéMON as slot prizes\lagain today!$

label: CeladonCity_House1_Text_SlotsReelInTheDough
text: Hehehe!\pThe slots just reel in the dough,\nbig-time!$

label: CeladonCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_GoToCyclingRoadIfIHadBike
text: If I had a BIKE, I would go to\nCYCLING ROAD!$

label: CeladonCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_PokeFluteAwakensSleepingMons
text: A POKé FLUTE awakens sleeping\nPOKéMON. You know that.\pIt does so with a sound that only\nthey can hear.$

label: CeladonCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_RodeHereFromFuchsia
text: I rode here from FUCHSIA.\pIt's an uphill ride on CYCLING\nROAD, so I'm exhausted.$

label: CeladonCity_Restaurant_Text_MakeRoomForThis
text: Make room for this!$

label: CeladonCity_Restaurant_Text_ManLostItAllAtSlots
text: Munch…\pThe man at that table lost it all\nat the slots.$

label: CeladonCity_Restaurant_Text_OftenGoToDrugstore
text: My POKéMON are weak, so I often\nhave to go to the DRUGSTORE.$

label: CeladonCity_Restaurant_Text_PsstBasementUnderGameCorner
text: Psst! There's a basement under the\nGAME CORNER, I hear.$

label: CeladonCity_Restaurant_Text_ReceivedCoinCaseFromMan
text: {PLAYER} received a COIN CASE\nfrom the man.$

label: CeladonCity_Restaurant_Text_TakeThisImBusted
text:
Go ahead! Laugh!
I'm flat-out busted!\pNo more slots for me!
I'm going straight!\pHere!
I won't be needing this anymore!$

label: CeladonCity_Restaurant_Text_TakingBreakRightNow
text: Hi!\pSorry, but we're taking a break\nright now.$

label: CeladonCity_Restaurant_Text_ThoughtIdWinItBack
text: I always thought I was going to\nwin it back…$

label: CeladonCity_Text_BlewItAllAtSlots
text: Moan…\nI blew it all at the slots!\pI knew I should have cashed in my\nCOINS for prizes!$

label: CeladonCity_Text_CitySign
text: CELADON CITY\nThe City of Rainbow Dreams$

label: CeladonCity_Text_DeptStoreSign
text: Find what you need at the\nCELADON DEPT. STORE!$

label: CeladonCity_Text_ExplainXAccuracyDireHit
text:
TRAINER TIPS\pX ACCURACY boosts the accuracy of
techniques.\pDIRE HIT jacks up the likelihood
of critical hits.\pGet your items at the CELADON
DEPT. STORE!$

label: CeladonCity_Text_GameCornerIsBadForCitysImage
text: CELADON takes pride in its efforts\nto keep the city beautiful.\pThat's why the new GAME CORNER is\nbad for our city's image.$

label: CeladonCity_Text_GameCornerSign
text: ROCKET GAME CORNER\nThe playground for grown-ups!$

label: CeladonCity_Text_GetLostOrIllPunchYou
text: What are you staring at?\nGet lost, or I'll punch you.$

label: CeladonCity_Text_GotMyKoffingInCinnabar
text: I got my KOFFING in CINNABAR.\pIt's usually nice, but it breathes\npoison when it's angry.$

label: CeladonCity_Text_GuardSpecProtectsFromStatus
text: TRAINER TIPS\pGUARD SPEC. protects POKéMON\nfrom status-reduction moves during\lbattle.\pGet your items at the\nCELADON DEPT. STORE!$

label: CeladonCity_Text_GymIsGreatFullOfWomen
text: Heheh! This GYM is great!\nIt's full of women!$

label: CeladonCity_Text_GymSign
text: CELADON CITY POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: ERIKA\lThe Nature-Loving Princess!$

label: CeladonCity_Text_KeepOutOfTeamRocketsWay
text: Keep out of TEAM ROCKET's way!$

label: CeladonCity_Text_MansionSign
text: CELADON MANSION$

label: CeladonCity_Text_MyTrustedPalPoliwrath
text: This is my trusted pal, POLIWRATH.\pIt evolved from a POLIWHIRL when\nI used a WATER STONE.$

label: CeladonCity_Text_Poliwrath
text: POLIWRATH: Ribi ribit!$

label: CeladonCity_Text_PrizeExchangeSign
text: COINS exchanged for prizes!\nPRIZE EXCHANGE$

label: CeladonCity_Text_ScaldedTongueOnTea
text:
Aaaagh, ow…
I scalded my tongue!\pThis nice old lady in the MANSION
gave me some TEA.\pBut it was boiling hot!
Gotta cool it to drink it.$

label: CeladonCity_Text_SomeoneStoleSilphScope
text: Oh, what am I to do…\pSomeone stole our SILPH SCOPE.\pThe thief came running this way,\nI'm sure of it.\pBut I lost sight of him!\nWhere'd he go?$

label: CeruleanCave_B1F_Text_Mew
text: Mew!$

label: CeruleanCity_BikeShop_Text_BikesCoolButExpensive
text: These bikes are cool, but they're\nway expensive!$

label: CeruleanCity_BikeShop_Text_CityBikeGoodEnoughForMe
text: A plain city bike is good enough\nfor me.\pAfter all, you can't put a shopping\nbasket on a mountain bike.$

label: CeruleanCity_BikeShop_Text_ExchangedVoucherForBicycle
text: {PLAYER} exchanged the\nBIKE VOUCHER for a BICYCLE.$

label: CeruleanCity_BikeShop_Text_HowDoYouLikeNewBicycle
text: How do you like your new BICYCLE?\nDo you like how it rides?\pYou can take it out on CYCLING\nROAD and even into caves!$

label: CeruleanCity_BikeShop_Text_OhBikeVoucherHereYouGo
text: Oh, that's…\pA BIKE VOUCHER!\pOkay!\nHere you go!$

label: CeruleanCity_BikeShop_Text_ShinyNewBicycle
text: A shiny new BICYCLE!$

label: CeruleanCity_BikeShop_Text_SorryYouCantAffordIt
text: Sorry!\nYou can't afford it!$

label: CeruleanCity_BikeShop_Text_ThankYouComeAgain
text: Thank you!\nCome back again sometime!$

label: CeruleanCity_BikeShop_Text_WelcomeToBikeShop
text: Hi!\nWelcome to our BIKE SHOP.\pHave we got just the BIKE for\nyou!$

label: CeruleanCity_BikeShop_Text_WowYourBikeIsCool
text: Wow.\nYour BIKE is really cool!$

label: CeruleanCity_Gym_Text_BetterMakeRoomForThis
text: You better make room for this!$

label: CeruleanCity_Gym_Text_DianaDefeat
text: You overwhelmed me!$

label: CeruleanCity_Gym_Text_DianaIntro
text: What? You?\nI'm more than good enough for you!\pMISTY won't have to be bothered.$

label: CeruleanCity_Gym_Text_DianaPostBattle
text: You have to face other TRAINERS\nto see how good you really are.$

label: CeruleanCity_Gym_Text_ExplainCascadeBadge
text:
The CASCADEBADGE makes all
POKéMON up to Lv. 30 obey.\pThat includes even outsiders you
got in trades.\pThere's more. You can now use CUT
anytime, even out of battle.\pYou can CUT down small trees to
open new pathways.\pYou can also have my favorite TM.$

label: CeruleanCity_Gym_Text_ExplainTM03
text: TM03 teaches WATER PULSE.\pUse it on an aquatic POKéMON!$

label: CeruleanCity_Gym_Text_GymGuyAdvice
text:
Yo!
Champ in the making!\pLet me give you some advice!\pThe LEADER, MISTY, is a pro who
uses WATER-type POKéMON.\pYou can drain all their water with
GRASS-type POKéMON.\pOr, you might use ELECTRIC-type
POKéMON and zap them!$

label: CeruleanCity_Gym_Text_GymStatue
text: CERULEAN POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: MISTY\pWINNING TRAINERS:\n{RIVAL}$

label: CeruleanCity_Gym_Text_GymStatuePlayerWon
text: CERULEAN POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: MISTY\pWINNING TRAINERS:\n{RIVAL}, {PLAYER}$

label: CeruleanCity_Gym_Text_LuisDefeat
text: That can't be!$

label: CeruleanCity_Gym_Text_LuisIntro
text: Splash!\pI'm first up!\nLet's do it!$

label: CeruleanCity_Gym_Text_LuisPostBattle
text: MISTY is a TRAINER who's going to\nkeep improving.\pShe won't lose to someone like you!$

label: CeruleanCity_Gym_Text_MistyDefeat
text: Wow!\nYou're too much!\pAll right!\pYou can have the CASCADEBADGE to\nshow you beat me.$

label: CeruleanCity_Gym_Text_MistyIntro
text:
Hi, you're a new face!\pOnly those TRAINERS who have a
policy about POKéMON can turn pro.\pWhat is your approach when you
catch and train POKéMON?\pMy policy is an all-out offensive
with WATER-type POKéMON!{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_RG_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}$

label: CeruleanCity_Gym_Text_ReceivedTM03FromMisty
text: {PLAYER} received TM03\nfrom MISTY.$

label: CeruleanCity_Gym_Text_WeMakePrettyGoodTeam
text: You beat MISTY!\nSee, what'd I tell ya?\pYou and me, kid, we make a pretty\ndarn-good team!$

label: CeruleanCity_House1_Text_AllMonsWillObeyYou
text: All POKéMON will obey you!$

label: CeruleanCity_House1_Text_AnyInterestInBerries
text:
I concoct a variety of medicine
from BERRY POWDER.\pUsing good BERRY POWDER, I can
make any kind of medicine.\pNow tell me, have you any interest
in BERRIES?$

label: CeruleanCity_House1_Text_AttackStatFlash
text: The ATTACK stat of all your\nPOKéMON increases a little bit.\pIt also lets you use the move\nFLASH outside of battle.$

label: CeruleanCity_House1_Text_BadgesHaveAmazingSecrets
text: Only skilled TRAINERS can collect\nPOKéMON BADGES.\pI see you have at least one.\pThose BADGES have amazing secrets,\ndid you know?$

label: CeruleanCity_House1_Text_ComeVisitAnytime
text: Come visit me anytime you wish.$

label: CeruleanCity_House1_Text_DefenseStatSurf
text: The DEFENSE stat of all your\nPOKéMON increases a little bit.\pIt also lets you use the move\nSURF outside of battle.$

label: CeruleanCity_House1_Text_DescribeWhichBadge
text: Now then…\pWhich of the eight BADGES should\nI describe?$

label: CeruleanCity_House1_Text_DontHaveEnoughBerryPowder
text: Hm? You don't have enough\nBERRY POWDER.$

label: CeruleanCity_House1_Text_GoCrushBerriesAtDirectCorner
text:
There's something new on the second
floor of POKéMON CENTERS, at the\lDIRECT CORNER.\pThey installed a Wireless Adapter
machine for crushing BERRIES.\pThis is where you come in.\pI have a favor to ask, one that
I can entrust only to you.\pCould you make BERRY POWDER for
me using that machine?\pDon't forget, the machine is at the
DIRECT CORNER of POKéMON CENTERS.\pI'll concoct medicine for you if
you bring me some BERRY POWDER.\pDon't forget, crush BERRIES into
BERRY POWDER and bring it to me.$

label: CeruleanCity_House1_Text_HaveJustTheThing
text: Ah, good! For you, then, I have\njust the thing.$

label: CeruleanCity_House1_Text_HaveYouBroughtBerryPowder
text: Er-hem! Have you brought me some\nBERRY POWDER?$

label: CeruleanCity_House1_Text_HopeToSeeYouAgain
text: That's fine, then.\nI'll hope to see you back again.$

label: CeruleanCity_House1_Text_ObeyLv30Cut
text:
POKéMON up to Lv. 30 will obey
you.\pThat includes even outsiders you
obtain in trades.\pPOKéMON of higher levels will
be unruly in battle, however.\pIt also lets you use the move
CUT outside of battle.$

label: CeruleanCity_House1_Text_ObeyLv50Strength
text:
POKéMON up to Lv. 50 will obey
you.\pThat includes even outsiders you
obtain in trades.\pPOKéMON of higher levels will
be unruly in battle, however.\pIt also lets you use the move
STRENGTH outside of battle.$

label: CeruleanCity_House1_Text_ObeyLv70RockSmash
text:
POKéMON up to Lv. 70 will obey
you.\pThat includes even outsiders you
obtain in trades.\pPOKéMON of higher levels will
be unruly in battle, however.\pIt also lets you use the move
ROCK SMASH outside of battle.$

label: CeruleanCity_House1_Text_SeeMeIfYoudLikeToTradePowder
text: Come see me if you'd like to trade\nyour BERRY POWDER.$

label: CeruleanCity_House1_Text_SpStatsWaterfall
text: The SP. ATK and SP. DEF stats of\nall your POKéMON rise a little bit.\pIt also lets you use the move\nWATERFALL outside of battle.$

label: CeruleanCity_House1_Text_SpeedStatFly
text: The SPEED stat of all your\nPOKéMON increases a little bit.\pIt also lets you use the move\nFLY outside of battle.$

label: CeruleanCity_House1_Text_TakeInterestInAllSortsOfThings
text: You have no interest in BERRIES?\pYoung one, it's important to take an\ninterest in all sorts of things.$

label: CeruleanCity_House1_Text_TradeMoreBerryPowder
text: This is fine BERRY POWDER indeed.\nIt will make excellent medicine.\pWould you like to trade more BERRY\nPOWDER for something else?$

label: CeruleanCity_House1_Text_WhyMustYouLieNoBerries
text: Why must you lie to me?\pHow many BERRIES do you have?\nNot a one!$

label: CeruleanCity_House1_Text_YoullExchangeBerryPowderForItem
text: Fine, you'll exchange your BERRY\nPOWDER for one {STR_VAR_1}?$

label: CeruleanCity_House2_Text_RocketsStoleTMForDig
text:
Those miserable ROCKETS!\pLook what they've done to my
house!\pThey stole a TM for teaching
POKéMON how to DIG holes!\pI was going to use it on a
MANKEY or a SANDSHREW…\pThat cost me a bundle, it did!$

label: CeruleanCity_House2_Text_TeachDiglettDigWithoutTM
text: I figure what's lost is lost.\pI decided to teach DIGLETT how to\nDIG without a TM.$

label: CeruleanCity_House2_Text_TeamRocketLeftWayOut
text: TEAM ROCKET left a way out!$

label: CeruleanCity_House2_Text_TeamRocketTryingToDigIntoNoGood
text: TEAM ROCKET must be trying to DIG\ntheir way into no good!$

label: CeruleanCity_House3_Text_PleaseTradeWithMyHusband
text: My husband likes trading POKéMON.\pYou're collecting POKéMON for your\nPOKéDEX, aren't you?\pWould you please trade with him?$

label: CeruleanCity_House4_Text_EnjoyingMyselfWithAllSortsOfNews
text: I'm quite enjoying myself with all\nsorts of news.\pYes, I am satisfied!\nI won't be bored for a while.$

label: CeruleanCity_House4_Text_IncredibleNewsHaveBerries
text:
Oh, oh!
Th-this news report!\pHmm…\pAmazing!
What an incredible piece of news!\pI haven't seen a news story this
incredible in too long a time!\pThanks for sharing this fantastic
news. Have a bunch of BERRIES!$

label: CeruleanCity_House4_Text_MagnificentNewsSpreadHaveBerries
text:
You've spread the news some more?
Magnificent!\pThat piece of news must be
delighted to be passed around so.\pYes, indeed!\pConsider this a show of
appreciation from me and the news.\pI'll give you more BERRIES than
I usually do.$

label: CeruleanCity_House4_Text_NewNewsInformativeHaveThis
text:
Ah!
A new news report!\pHmm…\pI see!
That was quite informative!\pI applaud you for taking interest
in the news at your young age.\pAs my thanks for sharing the news
with me, I want you to have this.$

label: CeruleanCity_House4_Text_NothingEntertaining
text: Sigh…\nToo much time, too little to do…\pIs nothing entertaining happening\nanywhere?$

label: CeruleanCity_House4_Text_ThanksForSpreadingNewsTakeThis
text: Ah, you've spread the news for me?\pGood news becomes worthwhile when\nall sorts of people share it.\pAs my thanks for your spreading\nthe news, take this!$

label: CeruleanCity_House4_Text_WishCouldShareNewsWithOthers
text: It seems such a shame to not share\nthis news with other folks…\pI wish I could tell someone…\nLet others know the news…$

label: CeruleanCity_House4_Text_YourBerryPouchIsFull
text: Hm? Your BERRY POUCH is full.\nMy gift remains ungiven, then.$

label: CeruleanCity_House5_Text_ExchangeWithWhat
text: With what would you like to \nexchange it?$

label: CeruleanCity_Mart_Text_DoYouKnowAboutRareCandy
text: Do you know about RARE CANDY?\nThey don't sell it in shops.\pI think it makes POKéMON grow\nvery quickly all of a sudden.$

label: CeruleanCity_Mart_Text_RepelWorksOnWeakMons
text:
REPEL not only keeps bugs away,
it also works on weak POKéMON.\pPut your strongest POKéMON at the
left of the POKéMON LIST.\pIf your first POKéMON is strong,
REPEL's effect is boosted.$

label: CeruleanCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_BillCollectsRareMons
text: BILL has lots of POKéMON!\nHe collects rare ones, too!$

label: CeruleanCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_BillDoesWhateverForRareMons
text: That BILL!\pI heard that he'll do whatever it\ntakes to get rare POKéMON.\pHe's not above doing all sorts\nof things, I've heard.$

label: CeruleanCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_EveryoneCallsBillPokemaniac
text: Have you heard about BILL?\pEveryone calls him a POKéMANIAC!\pI think people are just jealous of\nBILL, though.\pWho wouldn't want to boast about\ntheir POKéMON?$

label: CeruleanCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_TryTradingUpstairs
text:
Why don't you go upstairs and try
trading POKéMON with your friends?\pYou could get a lot more variety
by trading.\pThe POKéMON you get in trades grow
quickly, too.$

label: CeruleanCity_Text_BetterGetMovingBye
text: I better get moving!\nBye!$

label: CeruleanCity_Text_BikeShopSign
text: Grass and caves handled easily!\nBIKE SHOP$

label: CeruleanCity_Text_CitySign
text: CERULEAN CITY\nA Mysterious, Blue Aura Surrounds\lIt$

label: CeruleanCity_Text_ExplainFameCheckerSmellYa
text:
A chatty gossip like you…
That thing's perfect.\pI don't need it because I don't
give a hoot about others.\pAll right, this time I really am
gone. Smell ya!$

label: CeruleanCity_Text_GruntDefeat
text: GRUNT: Stop! I give up!\nI'll leave quietly!$

label: CeruleanCity_Text_GruntIntro
text:
Hey! Stay out!
It's not your yard!\p…Huh?
Me?\pI'm an innocent bystander!
Don't you believe me?{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_RG_ENCOUNTER_ROCKET}$

label: CeruleanCity_Text_GymSign
text: CERULEAN CITY POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: MISTY\lThe Tomboyish Mermaid!$

label: CeruleanCity_Text_HardToControlMonsObedience
text: No! That's wrong!\nIt's so hard to control POKéMON!\pYour POKéMON's obedience depends\non your abilities as a TRAINER.$

label: CeruleanCity_Text_IfSlowbroWasntThereCouldCutTree
text:
If that SLOWBRO wasn't there, you
could CUT down the small tree.\pThat way, you could get to the
other side.\pI think there's a way around it,
though.$

label: CeruleanCity_Text_MakeRoomForThisCantRun
text: Make room for this!\nI can't run until I give it to you!$

label: CeruleanCity_Text_NoYouBlewItAgain
text: No!\nYou blew it again!$

label: CeruleanCity_Text_OhRightLittlePresentAsFavor
text: Oh, yeah, right.\pI feel sorry for you. No, really.\nYou're always plodding behind me.\pSo here, I'll give you a little\npresent as a favor.$

label: CeruleanCity_Text_OkayIllReturnStolenTM
text: …Okay.\nI'll return the TM I stole.$

label: CeruleanCity_Text_PeopleHereWereRobbed
text: The people here were robbed.\pIt's obvious that TEAM ROCKET is\nbehind this most heinous crime!\pEven our POLICE FORCE has\ntrouble with the ROCKETS!$

label: CeruleanCity_Text_PokemonEncyclopediaAmusing
text: You're making an encyclopedia on\nPOKéMON? That sounds amusing.$

label: CeruleanCity_Text_RecoveredTM28FromGrunt
text: {PLAYER} recovered TM28 from\nthe TEAM ROCKET GRUNT.$

label: CeruleanCity_Text_RivalDefeat
text: Hey!\nTake it easy!\lYou won already!$

label: CeruleanCity_Text_RivalIntro
text:
{RIVAL}: Yo! {PLAYER}!\pYou're still struggling along back
here?\pI'm doing great! I caught a bunch
of strong and smart POKéMON!\pHere, let me see what you caught,
{PLAYER}!$

label: CeruleanCity_Text_RivalPostBattle
text:
{RIVAL}: Hey, guess what?\pI went to BILL's and got him to
show me his rare POKéMON.\pThat added a lot of pages to my
POKéDEX!\pAfter all, BILL's world famous as a
POKéMANIAC.\pHe invented the POKéMON Storage
System on PC, too.\pSince you're using his system,
you should go thank him.\pWell, I better get rolling!
Smell ya later!$

label: CeruleanCity_Text_SlowbroIgnoredOrders
text: SLOWBRO ignored orders…$

label: CeruleanCity_Text_SlowbroLoafingAround
text: SLOWBRO is loafing around…$

label: CeruleanCity_Text_SlowbroPayAttention
text: Come on, SLOWBRO, pay attention!$

label: CeruleanCity_Text_SlowbroPunch
text: SLOWBRO, punch!$

label: CeruleanCity_Text_SlowbroTookSnooze
text: SLOWBRO took a snooze…$

label: CeruleanCity_Text_SlowbroTurnedAway
text: SLOWBRO turned away…$

label: CeruleanCity_Text_SlowbroUseSonicboom
text: Okay! SLOWBRO!\nUse SONICBOOM!$

label: CeruleanCity_Text_SlowbroWithdraw
text: SLOWBRO, WITHDRAW!$

label: CeruleanCity_Text_ThisIsCeruleanCave
text:
This is CERULEAN CAVE.\pHorribly strong POKéMON live inside
there.\pIt takes a very special TRAINER to
be allowed inside there.\pYou'd have to be strong enough to
become the POKéMON LEAGUE\lCHAMPION for starters.\pAnd, you would have to have
made a great achievement.$

label: CeruleanCity_Text_TrainerLifeIsToughIsntIt
text: You're a TRAINER, too?\pCollecting, battling…\nIt's a tough life, isn't it?$

label: CeruleanCity_Text_TrainerTipsHeldItems
text: TRAINER TIPS\pA POKéMON can be made to hold\nan item.\pSome items can even be used by\nthe holding POKéMON in battle.$

label: CeruleanCity_Text_WantBrightRedBicycle
text: I want a bright red bicycle.\pI'll keep it at home, so it won't\nget dirty.$

label: CeruleanCity_Text_YouCanCutDownSmallTrees
text:
Did you know that you can CUT down
small trees?\pEven that small tree in front of
the shop can be CUT down.\pI think there's a way around it,
though.$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_AveryDefeat
text: Waah!\nMy studies were insufficient!$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_AveryIntro
text: I've studied POKéMON thoroughly.\nYou can't win!$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_AveryPostBattle
text: My theories are too complicated\nfor you to understand.$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_BlaineDefeat
text: I have burned down to nothing!\nNot even ashes remain!\pYou have earned the VOLCANOBADGE.$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_BlaineIntro
text:
Hah!\pI am BLAINE, the red-hot LEADER
of CINNABAR GYM!\pMy fiery POKéMON are all rough
and ready with intense heat!\pThey incinerate all challengers!\pHah!
You better have BURN HEAL!{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_RG_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_BlainePostBattle
text: TM38 contains FIRE BLAST.\nTeach it to FIRE-type POKéMON.\pVULPIX or CHARMELEON would be\nideal for that move.$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_CorrectGoOnThrough
text: You're absolutely correct!\pGo on through!$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_DerekDefeat
text: Ow!$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_DerekIntro
text: I know why BLAINE became a\nTRAINER.$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_DerekPostBattle
text:
Our LEADER, BLAINE, became lost
in the mountains but good.\pNight fell when a fiery bird
POKéMON appeared.\pIts light allowed BLAINE to find
his way down safely.$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_DustyDefeat
text: Yowza!\nToo hot!$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_DustyIntro
text: I've been to many GYMS, but this\none best suits my style.$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_DustyPostBattle
text: PONYTA, NINETALES…\nThose are popular FIRE POKéMON.$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_ErikDefeat
text: Yow!\nHot, hot, hot!$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_ErikIntro
text: Do you know how hot POKéMON fire\nbreath can get?$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_ErikPostBattle
text: Fire, or to be more precise,\ncombustion…\p…Oxygen in the air…\nBlah, blah, blah, blah…$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_ExplainVolcanoBadge
text: Hah!\pThe VOLCANOBADGE heightens the\nSPECIAL stats of your POKéMON.\pHere, you can have this, too!$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_FireBlastIsUltimateFireMove
text: FIRE BLAST is the ultimate fire\ntechnique.\pDon't waste it on WATER POKéMON.$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_GymGuyAdvice
text:
Yo!
Champ in the making!\pThe hotheaded BLAINE is a FIRE
POKéMON pro.\pDouse his spirits with water!\pYou'd better take some
BURN HEALS, too.$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_GymGuyPostVictory
text: {PLAYER}!\nYou beat that firebrand!$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_GymStatue
text: CINNABAR POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: BLAINE\pWINNING TRAINERS:\n{RIVAL}$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_GymStatuePlayerWon
text: CINNABAR POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: BLAINE\pWINNING TRAINERS:\n{RIVAL}, {PLAYER}$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_MakeSpaceForThis
text: Make space for this, child!$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_PhotoOfBlaineAndFuji
text: It's a photo of BLAINE and\nMR. FUJI.\pThey're standing shoulder to\nshoulder with big grins.$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_PokemonQuizRules
text:
POKéMON Quiz!\pGet it right, and the door opens to
the next room.\pGet it wrong, and face a TRAINER!\pIf you want to conserve your
POKéMON for the GYM LEADER…\pThen get it right!
Here we go!$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_QuinnDefeat
text: I surrender!$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_QuinnIntro
text: I was a thief, but I went straight\nas a TRAINER.$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_QuinnPostBattle
text: I get this uncontrollable urge to\nsteal other people's POKéMON.$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_QuizQuestion1
text: CATERPIE evolves into METAPOD?$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_QuizQuestion2
text: There are nine certified POKéMON\nLEAGUE BADGES?$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_QuizQuestion3
text: POLIWAG evolves three times?$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_QuizQuestion4
text: Are electric moves effective\nagainst GROUND-type POKéMON?$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_QuizQuestion5
text: POKéMON of the same kind and level\nare not identical?$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_QuizQuestion6
text: TM28 contains TOMBSTONY?$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_RamonDefeat
text: Too hot to handle!$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_RamonIntro
text: I like using FIRE-type POKéMON.\nI just do.$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_RamonPostBattle
text: I wish there were a thief POKéMON.\nI'd use that!$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_ReceivedTM38FromBlaine
text: {PLAYER} received TM38\nfrom BLAINE.$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_SorryBadCall
text: Sorry!\nBad call!$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_ZacDefeat
text: Oh!\nSnuffed out!$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_ZacIntro
text: Fire is weak against H2O.$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_ZacPostBattle
text: Water beats fire, of course.\pBut fire melts ice, so the FIRE\ntype beats ICE-type POKéMON.$

label: CinnabarIsland_Mart_Text_DontTheyHaveXAttack
text: Don't they have X ATTACK?\pI like it because it raises the\nATTACK stat in battle.$

label: CinnabarIsland_Mart_Text_ExtraItemsNeverHurt
text: It never hurts to have extra items.\nYou never know what might happen.$

label: CinnabarIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_CinnabarGymLocked
text:
I came to visit the CINNABAR GYM,
but the door is locked tight.\pThere should be a key for it
somewhere.\pCould it be in that burned-out
mansion?\pThe GYM LEADER's friend used to
live there, they say.$

label: CinnabarIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_EvolutionCanWaitForNewMoves
text: POKéMON can still learn techniques\nafter canceling evolution.\pEvolution can wait until new moves\nhave been learned.$

label: CinnabarIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_LetsGo
text: Well, that's it.\nLet's go!$

label: CinnabarIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_OhNotDoneYet
text: Oh, you're still not done yet?$

label: CinnabarIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_ReadyToSailToOneIsland
text: BILL: Hey, you kept me waiting!\nReady to set sail to ONE ISLAND?$

label: CinnabarIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_VisitUnionRoom
text:
Do you have lots of friends?\pLinking up with the usual friends
is fun, of course.\pBut how about visiting the
UNION ROOM every so often?\pWho knows, you may end up making
new friends.\pI think it would be worth your time
to check the UNION ROOM.$

label: CinnabarIsland_PokemonLab_Entrance_Text_MeetingRoomSign
text: POKéMON LAB\nMeeting Room$

label: CinnabarIsland_PokemonLab_Entrance_Text_PhotoOfLabFounderDrFuji
text: A photo of the LAB's founder…\nDR. FUJI?!$

label: CinnabarIsland_PokemonLab_Entrance_Text_RAndDRoomSign
text: POKéMON LAB\nR & D Room$

label: CinnabarIsland_PokemonLab_Entrance_Text_StudyMonsExtensively
text: We study POKéMON extensively\nevery day.\pPeople often bring us rare POKéMON\nfor examination.$

label: CinnabarIsland_PokemonLab_Entrance_Text_TestingRoomSign
text: POKéMON LAB\nTesting Room$

label: CinnabarIsland_PokemonLab_ExperimentRoom_Text_FossilMonBackToLife
text: You late.\nWhere were you?\pYour fossil is back to life!\nIt was {STR_VAR_1} like I think!$

label: CinnabarIsland_PokemonLab_ExperimentRoom_Text_HandedFossilToWeirdDoctor
text: So!\nYou hurry and give me that!\p{FONT_NORMAL}{PLAYER} handed over the\n{STR_VAR_2} to the weird doctor.$

label: CinnabarIsland_PokemonLab_ExperimentRoom_Text_HaveYouAFossilForMe
text:
Hiya!\pI am important doctor.
Yes, very much so, indeed.\pHere, I study rare POKéMON fossils.
All the time, I study.\pYou!
Have you a fossil for me?$

label: CinnabarIsland_PokemonLab_ExperimentRoom_Text_NoIsTooBad
text: No!\nIs too bad!$

label: CinnabarIsland_PokemonLab_ExperimentRoom_Text_ReceivedMonFromDoctor
text: {PLAYER} received the {STR_VAR_1}\nfrom the doctor.$

label: CinnabarIsland_PokemonLab_ExperimentRoom_Text_TakesTimeGoForWalk
text: I take a little time!\nYou go for walk a little while!$

label: CinnabarIsland_PokemonLab_ExperimentRoom_Text_ThatFossilIsOfMonMakeItLiveAgain
text:
Oh!
That is {STR_VAR_2}, it is!\pIt is fossil of {STR_VAR_1},
a POKéMON that is already extinct!\pMy Resurrection Machine will make
that POKéMON live again!$

label: CinnabarIsland_PokemonLab_ExperimentRoom_Text_YouComeAgain
text: Aiyah!\nYou come again!$

label: CinnabarIsland_PokemonLab_Lounge_Text_FoundFossilInMtMoon
text: I found this most remarkable fossil\ninside MT. MOON.\pI think it's of a rare, prehistoric\nPOKéMON.$

label: CinnabarIsland_PokemonLab_ResearchRoom_Text_AnAmberPipe
text: An amber pipe!$

label: CinnabarIsland_PokemonLab_ResearchRoom_Text_EeveeCanEvolveIntroThreeMons
text: EEVEE can evolve into one of three\nkinds of POKéMON.$

label: CinnabarIsland_PokemonLab_ResearchRoom_Text_LegendaryBirdEmail
text:
There's an e-mail message.\p… … …\pThere are three legendary bird
POKéMON.\pThey are ARTICUNO, ZAPDOS, and
MOLTRES.\pTheir whereabouts are unknown.\pWe plan to explore the cavern
close to CERULEAN.\pFrom: POKéMON RESEARCH TEAM…$

label: CinnabarIsland_Text_AllRightLetsGo
text: All right, then.\nLet's go!$

label: CinnabarIsland_Text_BlaineLivedHereSinceBeforeLab
text: CINNABAR GYM's BLAINE is quite the\nodd fellow.\pHe's lived on the island since way\nbefore the LAB was built.$

label: CinnabarIsland_Text_ComeWithMeToOneIsland
text:
Look, it's me, BILL.
Long time no see!\pI hope you're still using my
PC system.\pWell, listen, since we met up here,
how about spending time with me?\pThere's this little island in the far
south called ONE ISLAND.\pA friend invited me, so I'm on my
way out there.\pHow about it?
Do you feel like coming with me?$

label: CinnabarIsland_Text_DoorIsLocked
text: The door is locked…$

label: CinnabarIsland_Text_GymSign
text: CINNABAR ISLAND POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: BLAINE\lThe Hotheaded Quiz Master!$

label: CinnabarIsland_Text_HeyIfItIsntPlayer
text: Huh?\nHey, if it isn't {PLAYER}!$

label: CinnabarIsland_Text_IfYouHaveTriPassYouCanGoAgain
text:
Hey, wasn't that a long cruise?\pMy buddy CELIO seemed to enjoy
your company.\pI'm sure he'd welcome you if you
were to visit him again.\pIf you have a TRI-PASS, you can
always take a ferry there from\lVERMILION PORT.\pAll right, thanks for your company!$

label: CinnabarIsland_Text_IllBeWaitingInPokeCenter
text:
What, are you too busy?\pWell, all right.
The boat hasn't arrived yet anyway.\pI'll be waiting at the POKéMON
CENTER over there.\pCome see me when you're done with
your business here.$

label: CinnabarIsland_Text_IslandSign
text: CINNABAR ISLAND\nThe Fiery Town of Burning Desire$

label: CinnabarIsland_Text_MyPalsBoatArrived
text: Looks like my pal's boat arrived,\ntoo.\pHe sent it specially here to\nCINNABAR to pick me up.$

label: CinnabarIsland_Text_PokemonLab
text: POKéMON LAB$

label: CinnabarIsland_Text_ScientistsExperimentInMansion
text: Scientists conduct experiments \nin the burned-out building.\pYou know, the one they call the\nPOKéMON MANSION.$

label: Common_Text_LookCloserAtMap
text: {PLAYER} took a closer look at the\n{REGION} region map.$

label: ContestHall_Text_AcceptYourPrize
text: MC: Here you are!\nPlease accept your prize!$

label: ContestHall_Text_AudienceWillVote
text: The audience will vote on their\nfavorite POKéMON contestants.$

label: ContestHall_Text_ConferRibbonAsPrize
text: We confer on you this RIBBON\nas your prize!$

label: ContestHall_Text_CongratsPleaseCompeteAgain
text: MC: Congratulations!\nPlease do compete again!$

label: ContestHall_Text_CongratsTrainerXandMon
text: MC: Entry No. {STR_VAR_2}!\p{STR_VAR_3} and {STR_VAR_1},\ncongratulations!$

label: ContestHall_Text_EntryXTrainersMon
text: MC: Entry No. {STR_VAR_2}!\n{STR_VAR_1}'s {STR_VAR_3}!$

text: MC: Hello! We're just getting started\nwith a {STR_VAR_3} Rank POKéMON\l{STR_VAR_2}!\pThe participating TRAINERS and their\nPOKéMON are as follows:$

text: MC: Hello! We're just getting started\nwith a 4-player linked POKéMON\l{STR_VAR_2}!\pThe participating TRAINERS and their\nPOKéMON are as follows:$

text: MC: Hello! We're just getting started\nwith a 4-player linked POKéMON\l{STR_VAR_2}!$

label: ContestHall_Text_JudgeLooksReady
text: Now, all that remains is the pulse-\npounding proclamation of the winner.\pThe JUDGE looks ready to make\nthe announcement!$

label: ContestHall_Text_LetVotingBegin
text: Without any further ado,\nlet the voting begin!$

label: ContestHall_Text_LetsAppeal
text: Let's see a little enthusiasm!\nLet's appeal!$

text: The participating TRAINERS and their\nPOKéMON are as follows:$

label: ContestHall_Text_PickUpPrizeAtCounterLater
text: Please pick up your prize at\nthe reception counter later.\lPlease do compete again!$

label: ContestHall_Text_PutRibbonOnMon
text: {PLAYER} put the RIBBON on\n{STR_VAR_1}.$

label: ContestHall_Text_ReceivedRibbon
text: {PLAYER} received a RIBBON.$

label: ContestHall_Text_SecondStageOfJudging
text: The second stage of judging is\nthe much-anticipated appeal time!\pMay the contestants amaze us with\nsuperb appeals of dazzling moves!$

label: ContestHall_Text_SeenContestantsAudienceWillVote
text:
MC: We've just seen the four POKéMON
contestants.\pNow it's time for primary judging!\pThe audience will vote on their
favorite POKéMON contestants.\pWithout any further ado, let the
voting begin!$

label: ContestHall_Text_ThankYouForAppeals
text: Thank you all for a most wonderful\ndisplay of quality appeals!\pThis concludes all judging!\nThank you for your fine efforts!$

label: ContestHall_Text_ThatsItForJudging
text: MC: That's it for judging!$

label: ContestHall_Text_VotingComplete
text: Voting is now complete!\pWhile the votes are being tallied,\nlet's move on to secondary judging!$

label: ContestHall_Text_VotingCompleteLetsAppeal
text:
Voting is now complete!\pWhile the votes are being tallied,
let's move on to secondary judging!\pThe second stage of judging is the
much anticipated appeal time!\pMay the contestants amaze us with
superb appeals of dazzling moves!\pLet's see a little enthusiasm!
Let's appeal!$

label: ContestHall_Text_VotingUnderWay
text: Voting under way…$

label: ContestHall_Text_WeWillNowDeclareWinner
text: JUDGE: We will now declare the winner!$

label: ContestHall_Text_WeveSeenContestants
text: MC: We've just seen the four POKéMON\ncontestants.\pNow it's time for primary judging!$

label: Cozy_Text_AlreadyFollowing
text: You already have company!\nI refuse to become a queue.$

label: Cozy_Text_AskComment
text: Ask {STR_VAR_1} about it?$

label: Cozy_Text_BagFull
text: Your BAG is full. Come back later.\nWe will keep this safe for you.$

label: Cozy_Text_Decline
text: I will be here. Practicing being\nan interesting local landmark.$

label: Cozy_Text_GardenDecline
text: Of course. The shrub has been\nvery patient with us so far.$

label: Cozy_Text_GardenDone
text: It has not said a word.\nI think it likes the neighborhood.$

label: Cozy_Text_GardenHelper
text: I wrote HELLO, I AM A SHRUB.\nIt is important to feel seen.$

label: Cozy_Text_GardenRequest
text: We are welcoming this shrub.\nMy neighbor made it a name tag.\lCould you spare an ORAN BERRY?\lI can trade a PECHA BERRY.$

label: Cozy_Text_GardenThanks
text: Thank you! A fine housewarming gift.\nFor a house with mostly roots.$

label: Cozy_Text_GoingHome
text: PIP: See you in LITTLEROOT!\nTake a little walk before you\llook for me. I am a slow goodbye.$

label: Cozy_Text_HeadHome
text: Ask PIP to head home?$

label: Cozy_Text_Joining
text: PIP: Great! You navigate.\nI will handle moral support.\lAnd identifying suspicious chairs.$

label: Cozy_Text_NoBerry
text: No ORAN BERRY? Another time.\nWe will offer it encouraging words.$

label: Cozy_Text_NotYet
text: You look busy getting settled.\nFind me after you get your\lRUNNING SHOES. No rush.$

label: Cozy_Text_Recruit
text: PIP: Hey! I am Pip.\pHeading out? I could come along.\nI know a shortcut to most places.\lIt is usually the regular path.\lWant some company?$

label: Cozy_Text_Welcome
text: Welcome to LITTLEROOT!\nWe practiced saying that together.\lHe came in on the wrong beat.$

label: Cozy_Text_WelcomeAgain
text: Welcome back!\nThat one was completely unrehearsed.$

label: Cozy_Text_WelcomeGift
text: A POTION for your travels!\nHe wanted to give you a shrub.\lWe are working on boundaries.$

label: Cozy_Text_WelcomeHelper
text: I was the welcome committee.\nThen she joined. Now we have minutes.\lMost of them are about shrubs.$

label: DayCare_Text_ComeAgain
text: Fine.\nCome again.$

label: DayCare_Text_DoYouWantEgg
text: Ah, it's you!\pWe were raising your POKéMON, and\nmy goodness, were we surprised!\pYour POKéMON had an EGG!\pWe don't know how it got there,\nbut your POKéMON had it.\pYou do want it, yes?$

label: DayCare_Text_FineThenComeAgain
text: Oh, fine, then.\nCome again.$

label: DayCare_Text_GoodToSeeYou
text: Ah, it's you!\nGood to see you.\pYour POKéMON can only be doing\ngood!$

label: DayCare_Text_HeresYourMon
text: Perfect!\nHere's your POKéMON.$

label: DayCare_Text_HusbandWasLookingForYou
text: My husband was looking for you.$

label: DayCare_Text_IWillKeepDoYouWantIt
text: I really will keep it.\nYou do want this, yes?$

label: DayCare_Text_IllKeepIt
text: Well then, I'll keep it.\nThanks!$

label: DayCare_Text_ImDaycareManSpeakToMyWife
text: I'm the DAY-CARE MAN.\pI help take care of the precious\nPOKéMON of TRAINERS.\pIf you'd like me to raise your\nPOKéMON, have a word with my wife.$

label: DayCare_Text_ItWillCostX
text: If you want your {STR_VAR_1} back,\nit will cost ¥{STR_VAR_2}.$

label: DayCare_Text_NotEnoughMoney
text: You don't have enough money…$

label: DayCare_Text_ReceivedEgg
text: {PLAYER} received the EGG from\nthe DAY-CARE MAN.$

label: DayCare_Text_TakeGoodCareOfIt
text: Take good care of it.$

label: DayCare_Text_TakeOtherOneBackToo
text: Will you take back the other one,\ntoo?$

label: DayCare_Text_TakeYourMonBack
text: Will you take your POKéMON back?$

label: DayCare_Text_TookBackMon
text: {PLAYER} took back {STR_VAR_1} from\nthe DAY-CARE LADY.$

label: DayCare_Text_WeCanRaiseOneMore
text: We can raise two of your POKéMON.\pWould you like us to raise one\nmore POKéMON for you?$

label: DayCare_Text_WellRaiseYourMon
text: Fine, we'll raise your {STR_VAR_1}\nfor a while.\pCome back for it later.$

label: DayCare_Text_WhatWillYouBattleWith
text: If you leave me that POKéMON,\nwhat will you battle with?\pCome back another time.$

label: DayCare_Text_WhichMonShouldWeRaise
text: Which POKéMON should we raise for\nyou?$

label: DayCare_Text_WouldYouLikeUsToRaiseMon
text: I'm the DAY-CARE LADY.\pWe can raise POKéMON for you.\pWould you like us to raise one?$

label: DayCare_Text_YouHaveJustOneMon
text: Oh? But you have just one\nPOKéMON.\pCome back another time.$

label: DayCare_Text_YouHaveNoRoomForIt
text: You have no room for it…\nCome back when you've made room.$

label: DayCare_Text_YourMonHasGrownXLevels
text: By level, your {STR_VAR_1} has\ngrown by {STR_VAR_2}.$

label: DayCare_Text_YourMonIsDoingFine
text: Ah, it's you! Good to see you.\nYour {STR_VAR_1}'s doing fine.$

label: DayCare_Text_YourMonsAreDoingFine
text: Ah, it's you! Your {STR_VAR_1} and\n{STR_VAR_2} are doing fine.$

label: DayCare_Text_YourPartyIsFull
text: Your POKéMON party is full.\nMake room, then come see me.$

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_BrawlyDefeat
text: Whoah, wow! You made a much bigger\nsplash than I expected!\pYou swamped me!\pOkay, you've got me.\nTake this GYM BADGE!$

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_BrawlyIntro
text:
I'm BRAWLY!
DEWFORD's GYM LEADER!\pI've been churned in the rough waves
of these parts, and I've grown tough\lin the pitch-black cave!\pSo you wanted to challenge me?
Let me see what you're made of!$

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_BrawlyPostBattle
text: I can see your talent becoming a giant\nwave to cause a storm of astonishment\lamong TRAINERS one day!$

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_BrawlyPostRematch
text: BRAWLY: Battling is vast and it's deep.\nYou can't see the bottom.\lIt's just like the sea of HOENN!$

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_BrawlyPreRematch
text:
BRAWLY: A wave may draw back, but it
always returns to the shore.\pA giant wave of a talent like you…
I knew you would return!\pShow me how much higher
you've gone!$

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_BrawlyRematchDefeat
text: Wow!\nSwamped again!$

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_BrawlyRematchNeedTwoMons
text:
BRAWLY: A wave may draw back, but it
always returns to the shore.\pA giant wave of a talent like you…
I knew you would return!\pOh? You only have one POKéMON
that can battle.\pI'm sorry, but I'd like you to come back
with at least two POKéMON.$

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_BrendenDefeat
text: How'd this happen?\nIt's not like me to lose this way!$

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_BrendenIntro
text: I'll show you the gumption of\na sailing man!$

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_BrendenPostBattle
text: Oh, aye! You're worthy of seeing\nour GYM LEADER.$

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_CristianDefeat
text: Grrrrr!\nVastly overpowered!$

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_CristianIntro
text: If you mean to pass, it has to be\nthrough me!$

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_CristianPostBattle
text: You win!\nGo after that BADGE!$

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_ExplainBulkUp
text: That TM08 contains BULK UP.\pIt's a move that raises both ATTACK\nand DEFENSE stats.\p… … … … … …$

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_GymGuideAdvice
text:
Hey, how's it going, CHAMPION-
bound {PLAYER}?\pDEWFORD's GYM LEADER BRAWLY commands
FIGHTING-type POKéMON.\pGoing against him with NORMAL-type
POKéMON is asking for trouble.\pFIGHTING POKéMON will lay a serious
smack down on NORMAL POKéMON,\lso be careful!\pWhat's worse, the GYM is as dark as
the ocean floor.\pBut it will get brighter after defeating
the TRAINERS in your way.\pHey, okay, go for it!$

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_GymGuidePostVictory
text: Whoah! It's turned too bright in here!\pYour future is bright, too!$

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_GymStatue
text: DEWFORD TOWN POKéMON GYM$

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_GymStatueCertified
text: DEWFORD TOWN POKéMON GYM\pBRAWLY'S CERTIFIED TRAINERS:\n{PLAYER}$

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_JocelynDefeat
text: But… How?\nHow could I lose so easily?$

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_JocelynIntro
text: There's no need for BRAWLY to be\ninvolved!\pI'll crush you!$

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_JocelynPostBattle
text: I'm not going to waste this loss.\nI'll use it to motivate me to train!\pOne day I'll become a GYM LEADER…\pNo, I'll become the POKéMON LEAGUE\nCHAMPION!$

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_KnuckleBadgeInfoTakeThis
text:
The KNUCKLE BADGE makes all POKéMON
up to Level 30, even those you get in\ltrades, obey without question.\pAnd, you'll be able to use the HM move
FLASH outside of battle.\pIf you'd like, use this TECHNICAL
MACHINE, too.$

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_LauraDefeat
text: Waaaaaaah!\nI lost!$

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_LauraIntro
text: Don't you dare brush me off!\nIt's not my fault if you cry!$

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_LauraPostBattle
text: I battle in the dark to make my heart\nstronger.\pBut because it's so dark, I can never\nsee BRAWLY's face…$

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_LilithDefeat
text: Oh, you…\nI don't want to know you!$

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_LilithIntro
text: Ufufu…\nAre you stumbling around in the dark?$

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_LilithPostBattle
text: You deserve to stay lost and end up\nback at the entrance again!$

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_ReceivedKnuckleBadge
text: {PLAYER} received the KNUCKLE BADGE\nfrom BRAWLY.$

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_RegisteredBrawly
text: Registered GYM LEADER BRAWLY\nin the POKéNAV.$

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_TakaoDefeat
text: Not enough power…$

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_TakaoIntro
text: Might is right!\nCome on!$

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_TakaoPostBattle
text: Your skill overcame my strength!\nYour technique is commendable!$

label: DewfordTown_Hall_Text_AllegedTrendNotAuthentic
text: Oh, no, no, no.\pThat alleged\n“{STR_VAR_1}”\lyou claim to have seen--it's not.\pThe authentic article is much…\nHow should I say it?\lSharper, yet more mellow!\pAh, no matter. It's astonishing!$

label: DewfordTown_Hall_Text_BirthOfTrend
text: It's titled “THE BIRTH OF\n{STR_VAR_1}”.$

label: DewfordTown_Hall_Text_BooksAboutTrend
text:
IDENTIFYING GOOD
“{STR_VAR_1}” &\lBAD “{STR_VAR_1}”…\pTHE LINK BETWEEN
“{STR_VAR_1}” AND\lPOKéMON…\pUSEFUL
“{STR_VAR_1}”…\pIt's neatly jammed with books about
“{STR_VAR_1}.”$

label: DewfordTown_Hall_Text_BrilliantIndeed
text: Oh, a smashing good idea!\pIt will settle once and for all\nwho is the best at\l“{STR_VAR_1}.”\lBrilliant, indeed!\pStarting today, our lives will revolve\naround “{STR_VAR_1}”!$

label: DewfordTown_Hall_Text_CantImagineLifeWithoutTrend
text: What's in vogue? Why, it has to be\n“{STR_VAR_1}”!\pI can't imagine what life would be like\nwithout “{STR_VAR_1}”!$

label: DewfordTown_Hall_Text_CollectTrendMerchandise
text:
I collect official
“{STR_VAR_1}”\llicensed merchandise.\pI have official
“{STR_VAR_1}” DOLLS…\pOfficial “{STR_VAR_1}”
brand clothing…\pAnd officially licensed
“{STR_VAR_1}”\lpicture books.\pHeheh, I own!
I'm not sharing anything with you!$

label: DewfordTown_Hall_Text_ComposedTrendThemeSong
text:
Hey, listen, I composed a theme song
for “{STR_VAR_1}.”\p“{STR_VAR_1}”
is really popular right now.\pOkay, listen!
… …\pOh!
{STR_VAR_1}!\pWonderful
{STR_VAR_1}!$

label: DewfordTown_Hall_Text_DeepLinkBetweenXAndY
text: I'm studying up on the hip and trendy\n“{STR_VAR_1}” now.\pIs it true that there's a deep link\nbetween “{STR_VAR_1}”\land “{STR_VAR_2}”?$

label: DewfordTown_Hall_Text_GettingBoredOfTrend
text: What's in vogue? Why, it has to be\n“{STR_VAR_1}”!\pBut I'm getting kind of bored with it.\pI should look for the next big thing.$

label: DewfordTown_Hall_Text_GiveYouSludgeBomb
text:
For me, SLUDGE BOMB is at the peak
of popularity. It's the one.\pHunh? You're telling me that you don't
know about SLUDGE BOMB?\pThat's outright pitiful.
I'll give you one.$

label: DewfordTown_Hall_Text_IfWeTeamUpWellBeInvincible
text: If you and me team up as a combo,\nwe'll be invincible when it comes to all\lthings “{STR_VAR_1}”!$

label: DewfordTown_Hall_Text_IsTrendMorePopularAcrossSea
text: Across the sea…\pIs “{STR_VAR_1}”\neven more popular?$

label: DewfordTown_Hall_Text_LastTrend
text: It's titled “THE LAST\n{STR_VAR_1}”.$

label: DewfordTown_Hall_Text_LoveSludgeBombButTrendInToo
text: I love SLUDGE BOMB.\pBut POKéMON with the move\n“{STR_VAR_1}”\lare in, too.$

label: DewfordTown_Hall_Text_MyHunchWasRight
text: Oh!\nSo, my hunch was right!\pI'm one step closer to being hip and\nhappening, yowza!$

label: DewfordTown_Hall_Text_NotEasyToKeepUp
text: What?!\nIs that so?!\pIt's not easy for an older fellow like\nme to keep up with trends!$

label: DewfordTown_Hall_Text_OrganizeTrendParty
text: Anyway, as I was saying earlier, we\nshould get together and organize a\l“{STR_VAR_1}” party\lon the island.$

label: DewfordTown_Hall_Text_SawTrendCoolestThing
text: I saw “{STR_VAR_1}”!\nCool, huh?\pIt's, like, the coolest thing going!\pIt was awesome!\nIt was the real thing, oh yeah!$

label: DewfordTown_Hall_Text_TVShowAboutTrend
text: This whole business about\n“{STR_VAR_1}”…\lIsn't there a TV show on it?$

label: DewfordTown_Hall_Text_TeachingMonAboutTrend
text: I'm teaching my POKéMON about\n“{STR_VAR_1},”\lbut it's not going well.\pIt's a bit too much, I think.$

label: DewfordTown_Hall_Text_TrendHasBecomePartOfLife
text: I was thinking, though…\pWouldn't you agree that\n“{STR_VAR_1}” has\lgrown from being something trendy to\lbeing a part of our daily lives?$

label: DewfordTown_Hall_Text_TrendWeighsHeavilyOnMind
text:
Beg pardon?
That much, what?\pHowever, it's true that
“{STR_VAR_1}”\lweighs heavily on your mind, whether\lyou're awake or asleep.\pAbsolutely, you're the
“{STR_VAR_1}”\lPROFESSOR, old sport!$

label: DewfordTown_Hall_Text_TrendsScream
text: “{STR_VAR_1}'S\nSCREAM” is the title.$

label: DewfordTown_Hall_Text_TrendsSmile
text: “{STR_VAR_1}'S\nSMILE” is the title.$

label: DewfordTown_Hall_Text_WellBeTrendDuo
text: Spot on, my friend!\pWe shall be the\n“{STR_VAR_1}” DUO!\pIsn't that a ripe image?\nHahahah!$

label: DewfordTown_Hall_Text_WorkOnYourSinging
text: … …\pI dare say, chap, it would pay for you\nto work on your singing before you\ltrifle yourself with\l“{STR_VAR_1}.”$

label: DewfordTown_House1_Text_LifeGoesSlowlyOnIsland
text: I left the major port of SLATEPORT\nCITY when I married my husband here.\pLife goes by slowly on this little\nisland. But being surrounded by the\lbeautiful sea--that's happiness, too.$

label: DewfordTown_House1_Text_LotToBeSaidForLivingOnIsland
text: There's a lot to be said for living on\na small island like this in harmony with\lPOKéMON and the family.$

label: DewfordTown_House1_Text_Zigzagoon
text: ZIGZAGOON: Guguuh!$

label: DewfordTown_House2_Text_BrawlySoCool
text:
Wow, you bothered to cross the sea
to visit DEWFORD?\pDid you maybe come here because you
heard about BRAWLY?\pHe's so cool…
Everyone idolizes him.$

label: DewfordTown_House2_Text_ExplainSilkScarf
text: The SILK SCARF raises the power of\nNORMAL-type moves.\pIt's a marvelous SCARF that will go\nwith almost all POKéMON!$

label: DewfordTown_House2_Text_NoRoom
text: Oh, you don't have room?\pNow, listen tight, this SCARF is a must-\nhave! Why, I would sell all my items\lin order to get it!$

label: DewfordTown_House2_Text_WantYouToHaveSilkScarf
text:
Gorge your eyes on this!\pIt's a SILK SCARF. It's right at the
cutting edge of fashion, yeah!\pOh, I can see your eyes twinkling!
You appreciate my dazzling style!\pOh, you're a delight!
Here you go. I want you to have it!$

label: DewfordTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_FaintedMonCanUseHM
text: Even if a POKéMON faints and can't\nbattle, it can still use a move learned\lfrom a HIDDEN MACHINE (HM).$

label: DewfordTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_StoneCavern
text: There's a stone cavern at the edge\nof town.\pI've heard you can find rare stones\nthere.$

label: DewfordTown_Text_BrineyLandedInDewford
text: MR. BRINEY: Ahoy!\nWe've hit land in DEWFORD!\pYou just go on and tell me whenever\nyou want to set sail again!$

label: DewfordTown_Text_BrineyLandedInSlateport
text: MR. BRINEY: Ahoy! We've made land in\nSLATEPORT!\pYou just go on and tell me whenever\nyou want to set sail again!$

label: DewfordTown_Text_BrineyLandedInSlateportDeliverGoods
text: MR. BRINEY: Ahoy!\nWe've made land in SLATEPORT!\pI suppose you're going to visit CAPT.\nSTERN and deliver the DEVON GOODS?$

label: DewfordTown_Text_FishingAdvice
text:
Oh, hey, don't get down on yourself!
I'll give you a little fishing advice.\pFirst, you want to face the water,
then use the ROD.\pFocus your mind…
If you get a bite, pull the ROD.\pSometimes you can snag something
immediately, but with bigger catches,\lyou need to time the pulls on your ROD\lto haul them in.$

label: DewfordTown_Text_GettingItchToFish
text: This is a renowned fishing spot.\nAre you getting the itch to fish?$

label: DewfordTown_Text_GiveYouOneOfMyRods
text: I hear you, and I like what\nyou're saying!\pI'll give you one of my fishing RODS.$

label: DewfordTown_Text_GoDeliverIllBeWaiting
text: MR. BRINEY: Then you go on and deliver\nthe LETTER. I'll be waiting.$

label: DewfordTown_Text_GreatHaulInSomeBigOnes
text: Is that right! That's great!\nHaul in some big ones!$

label: DewfordTown_Text_GymSign
text: DEWFORD TOWN POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: BRAWLY\l“A big wave in fighting!”$

label: DewfordTown_Text_HallSign
text: DEWFORD HALL\n“Everyone's information exchange!”$

label: DewfordTown_Text_HearOfAnyTrendsComeShareWithMe
text: Well, if you hear of any happening new\ntrends, come share them with me, okay?$

label: DewfordTown_Text_HowsYourFishing
text: Yo!\nHow's your fishing?$

label: DewfordTown_Text_JustTellMeWhenYouNeedToSetSail
text: MR. BRINEY: You just tell me whenever\nyou need to set sail again!$

label: DewfordTown_Text_OfCourseIKnowAboutThat
text:
Hunh?
“{STR_VAR_2}”?\p… …\p…Uh… Yeah! That's right!
Yeah, I knew that! Knew it all along!\pOf course I know about that!
“{STR_VAR_2},” right?\pYeah, that's it, it's there!
Isn't “{STR_VAR_2}”\lthe coolest, or what?\pIt's the hippest thing in hip.
You think I'd not know about it?\p“{STR_VAR_1}”…
It's, like, so five minutes ago.\pNow, “{STR_VAR_2}” is
what's vital and in tune with the times!$

label: DewfordTown_Text_PetalburgWereSettingSail
text: MR. BRINEY: PETALBURG, is it?\pAnchors aweigh!\nPEEKO, we're setting sail, my darling!$

label: DewfordTown_Text_PetalburgWereSettingSail2
text: MR. BRINEY: PETALBURG it is, then!\pAnchors aweigh!\nPEEKO, we're setting sail, my darling!$

label: DewfordTown_Text_SetSailBackToPetalburg
text: MR. BRINEY: Have you delivered your\nLETTER?\pOr were you meaning to sail back to\nPETALBURG?$

label: DewfordTown_Text_SlateportWereSettingSail
text: MR. BRINEY: SLATEPORT, is it?\pAnchors aweigh!\nPEEKO, we're setting sail, my darling!$

label: DewfordTown_Text_TellMeWhatsNewAndIn
text: Hunh?\nIt's not the hip and happening thing?\pWell, hey, you have to tell me,\nwhat's new and what's “in”?$

label: DewfordTown_Text_ThatsTooBadThen
text: Oh, is that so?\nThat's too bad, then.$

label: DewfordTown_Text_ThrowInFishingAdvice
text:
And, as an added bonus, I'll even throw
in a little fishing advice!\pFirst, you want to face the water,
then use the ROD.\pFocus your mind…
If you get a bite, pull on the ROD.\pSometimes you can snag something
immediately, but with bigger catches,\lyou need to time the pulls on your ROD\lto haul them in.$

label: DewfordTown_Text_TinyIslandCommunity
text: DEWFORD is a tiny island community.\nIf something gets trendy here,\leveryone picks up on it right away.$

label: DewfordTown_Text_TownSign
text: DEWFORD TOWN\n“A tiny island in the blue sea.”$

label: DewfordTown_Text_WhereAreWeBound
text: MR. BRINEY: Ahoy!\nFor you, I'll go out to sea anytime!\pNow, my friend, where are we bound?$

label: DewfordTown_Text_XHuhIThinkYIsCool
text: Hmm…\n“{STR_VAR_2},” huh?\pBut personally, I think\n“{STR_VAR_1}”\lis what's real in cool.$

label: DewfordTown_Text_XIsTheBiggestHappeningThingRight
text:
I like what's hip, happening, and trendy.
I'm always checking it out.\pListen, have you heard about this new
“{STR_VAR_1}”?\pThat's right!
Of course you know!\pI mean, sheesh,
“{STR_VAR_1}”…\lIt's the hottest thing in cool!\pWherever you're from,
“{STR_VAR_1}”\lis the biggest happening thing, right?$

label: DewfordTown_Text_YeahDefinitionOfInRightNow
text: Yeah, absolutely right!\p“{STR_VAR_1}” is the\ndefinition of “in” right now.$

label: DiglettsCave_NorthEntrance_RockTunnelPitchBlack
text: I went inside ROCK TUNNEL, but it's\npitch-black and scary in there.\pIf I could get a POKéMON to use\nFLASH and light it up…$

label: DiglettsCave_SouthEntrance_Text_DiglettDugThisTunnel
text: Well, isn't this a surprise!\nDIGLETT dug this long tunnel!\pIt goes right to VIRIDIAN CITY,\nthey tell me.$

label: EventScript_ExplainPokemonJumpRequirements_Frlg
text: It doesn't look like you have any\nPOKéMON that you can enter…\pWould you like me to explain what\nkinds of POKéMON can enter?$

label: EventTicket_Text_AsYouLike
text: Aye, right, as you like, then.$

label: EventTicket_Text_BrineyHoldOnASecond
text: BRINEY: Hold on a second!\pWhat's the idea of turning down\nsomeone that I owe so much to?$

label: EventTicket_Text_BrineyLetsSail
text: {PLAYER}{KUN}, I'm terribly sorry.\pYou came to me seeking my help,\nand we almost turned you away.\pWell, let me make things right.\pWe'll sail right away, of course!\pLet's find this island on\nthis OLD SEA MAP!$

label: EventTicket_Text_OddTicketGetOnBoard
text:
Is it you who brought that odd
ticket?\pWhere you're trying to go is an island
that's far, far away.\pNo one knows what awaits there…\pThe very thought excites my blood
as a sailing man!\pGet on board, youngster!$

label: EventTicket_Text_OddTicketsWhereTo
text:
Is it you who brought those
odd tickets?\p… … …Hm.\pThese tickets will get you to islands
that are far, far away.\pNo one knows what awaits there,
or what may happen there.\pThe very thought excites my blood
as a sailing man!\pGet on board, youngster!
Where shall we sail first?$

label: EventTicket_Text_OldSeaMapTooFar
text:
What's up, youngster?\pWhat, it's you who's supposed to have
a tattered old map?\pLet's have a look.
… … … … … …\pBoy, this is quite a ways away.
I'm afraid I can't help you…$

label: EventTicket_Text_SailHome
text: Aye, right, then!\nSail home we will!$

label: EventTicket_Text_ShowEonTicket
text:
Aye, mate, are you the one who brought
that mighty odd PASS?\pI'll tell you, you're trying to reach a
tiny spit of an island far in the south.\pThere's no telling what we'll encounter
once we reach there, aye.\lThat shivers my timbers!\pAll aboard!$

label: EventTicket_Text_ShowOldSeaMap
text: The ferry to SLATEPORT is…\pI beg your pardon?\nCan we sail to this place on the map?\pI know someone who will help you better.\nPlease wait.$

label: EventTicket_Text_SouthernIslandSailBack
text: Aye, mate, there's nothing here to\nsee or do on this forgettable island.\pWhat say we sail back to LILYCOVE?$

label: EventTicket_Text_ThatPass
text: The ferry to SLATEPORT is…\pOh?\nThat PASS…$

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_BirchArriveRatePokedex
text:
PROF. BIRCH: See?
What did I tell you, {RIVAL}?\pDidn't I tell you that you don't need
to worry about {PLAYER}{KUN}?\p… … … … … … … …
{PLAYER}{KUN}, you've finally done it.\pWhen I heard that you defeated your
own father at the PETALBURG GYM,\lI thought perhaps you had a chance…\pBut to think you've actually become
the CHAMPION!\pAh, yes!\pWhat became of your POKéDEX?
Here, let me see.$

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_BirchCongratulations
text: PROF. BIRCH: Anyways,\ncongratulations!\pNow, go proudly into the final room!$

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_BrendanAdvice
text: BRENDAN: {PLAYER}!\pHow would you like some advice before\nyou challenge the CHAMPION?…$

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_BrendanCongratulations
text: BRENDAN: Whaaaat?! … … … … …\n… … … … … … … …\pIt can't be helped if that's the rule.\p{PLAYER}, way to go!\nCongratulations!$

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_BrendanYouveWon
text: BRENDAN: {PLAYER}…\pAre you trying to tell me…\nYou've beaten the CHAMPION?$

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_Defeat
text: I, the CHAMPION, fall in defeat…\pThat was wonderful work.\nYou were elegant, infuriatingly so.\lAnd yet it was utterly glorious!\pKudos to you, {PLAYER}{KUN}!\pYou are a truly noble POKéMON\nTRAINER!$

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_IntroSpeech
text:
WALLACE: Welcome, {PLAYER}{KUN}.\pThat incident in SOOTOPOLIS CITY…
That was superb work, putting an end\lto that crisis all by yourself.\pOops!\pIt wouldn't be fair to say that you
alone ended the crisis.\pYou overcame that difficult situation
by working as one with your POKéMON.\pWe TRAINERS raise POKéMON by giving
them items and by teaching them new\ltechniques for battle.\pBut we ourselves also learn many
