things from POKéMON.\pAnd this is where your achievements
are put to the test against what\lothers like you have achieved.\pNow!\pWho can most elegantly dance with
their POKéMON in HOENN?\pShow me right here and now!$

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_MayAdvice
text: MAY: {PLAYER}{KUN}!\pHere's some advice before you challenge\nthe CHAMPION…$

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_MayCongratulations
text:
MAY: Groan…\p… … … … … … … …
… … … … … … … …\pI'm just joking! That's okay!
That's the rule!\p{PLAYER}{KUN}!
Honestly, congratulations!$

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_MayItsAlreadyOver
text: MAY: Huh?\nWhat, what, what?\p{PLAYER}{KUN}…\nCould it be that…\lIt's already over?$

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_PostBattleSpeech
text:
WALLACE: The POKéMON you sent into
battle…\pAt times they danced like a spring
breeze, and at times they struck\llike lightning.\pIt was with light, yet surefooted,
elegance that you led your POKéMON.\pEven I felt bedazzled by your
masterful performance!\pYou now stand at the glorious peak
of the POKéMON LEAGUE.\pI now proclaim you to be the new
HOENN region…$

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_WallaceComeWithMe
text: WALLACE: {PLAYER}{KUN}…\pNo, let me rephrase that properly.\pThe new CHAMPION!\pCome with me.$

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_WallaceWaitOutside
text: WALLACE: I'm sorry, but…\pFrom here on, only those TRAINERS who\nhave become CHAMPIONS may enter.\pYou'll have to wait outside with\nPROF. BIRCH.$

label: EverGrandeCity_DrakesRoom_Text_Defeat
text: Superb, it should be said.$

label: EverGrandeCity_DrakesRoom_Text_IntroSpeech
text:
I am the last of the POKéMON LEAGUE
ELITE FOUR, DRAKE the DRAGON master!\pIn their natural state, POKéMON are
wild living things. They are free.\pAt times, they hinder us.
At times, they help us.\pFor us to battle with POKéMON as
partners, do you know what it takes?\pDo you know what is needed?\pIf you don't, then you will never
prevail over me!$

label: EverGrandeCity_DrakesRoom_Text_PostBattleSpeech
text:
You deserve every credit for coming
this far as a TRAINER of POKéMON.\pYou do seem to know what is needed.\pYes, what a TRAINER needs is a
virtuous heart.\pPOKéMON touch the good hearts of
TRAINERS and learn good from wrong.\pThey touch the good hearts of
TRAINERS and grow strong.\pGo! Go onwards!
The CHAMPION is waiting!$

label: EverGrandeCity_GlaciasRoom_Text_Defeat
text: You and your POKéMON…\nHow hot your spirits burn!\pThe all-consuming heat overwhelms.\pIt's no surprise that my icy skills\nfailed to harm you.$

label: EverGrandeCity_GlaciasRoom_Text_IntroSpeech
text:
Welcome, my name is GLACIA
of the ELITE FOUR.\pI've traveled from afar to HOENN
so that I may hone my ice skills.\pBut all I have seen are challenges by
weak TRAINERS and their POKéMON.\pWhat about you?\pIt would please me to no end if I could
go all out against you!$

label: EverGrandeCity_GlaciasRoom_Text_PostBattleSpeech
text: Advance to the next room.\pAnd there, confirm the truly fearsome\nside of the POKéMON LEAGUE.$

label: EverGrandeCity_HallOfFame_Text_HereWeHonorLeagueChampions
text: WALLACE: This room…\pThis is where we keep records of\nPOKéMON that prevailed through\lharsh battles.\pIt is here that the LEAGUE CHAMPIONS\nare honored.$

label: EverGrandeCity_HallOfFame_Text_LetsRecordYouAndYourPartnersNames
text: WALLACE: Come on, let's record your\nname as a TRAINER who triumphed over\lthe POKéMON LEAGUE, and the names of\lthe partners who battled with you.$

label: EverGrandeCity_PhoebesRoom_Text_Defeat
text: Oh, darn.\nI've gone and lost.$

label: EverGrandeCity_PhoebesRoom_Text_IntroSpeech
text:
Ahahaha!\pI'm PHOEBE of the ELITE FOUR.
I did my training on MT. PYRE.\pWhile I trained, I gained the ability
to commune with GHOST-type POKéMON.\pYes, the bond I developed with POKéMON
is extremely tight.\pSo, come on, just try and see if you can
even inflict damage on my POKéMON!$

label: EverGrandeCity_PhoebesRoom_Text_PostBattleSpeech
text:
There's a definite bond between you
and your POKéMON, too.\pI didn't recognize it, so it's only
natural that I lost.\pYup, I'd like to see how far your bond
will carry you.\pGo ahead, move on to the next room.$

label: EverGrandeCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_BelieveInYourPokemon
text: The long and harrowing VICTORY ROAD…\pIt's like reliving the path one has\ntraveled in life…\pBelieve in your POKéMON and give it\nyour very best!$

label: EverGrandeCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_LeagueAfterVictoryRoad
text: The POKéMON LEAGUE is only a short\ndistance after the VICTORY ROAD.\pIf you've come this far, what choice\ndo you have but to keep going?$

label: EverGrandeCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_ScottHappyForYou
text:
SCOTT: {PLAYER}{KUN}, you've clawed your
way up to face the POKéMON LEAGUE!\pI'm happy for you!
You made my cheering worthwhile!\p{PLAYER}{KUN}, if you were to become
the POKéMON LEAGUE CHAMPION…\pI'll get in touch with you then.\pOkay, {PLAYER}{KUN}.
Go for greatness!$

label: EverGrandeCity_PokemonLeague_1F_Text_GoForth
text: TRAINER! Believe in yourself and your\nPOKéMON, and go forth!$

label: EverGrandeCity_PokemonLeague_1F_Text_HaventObtainedAllBadges
text: You haven't obtained all the BADGES.\pIf you're bound for the POKéMON\nLEAGUE, you must return with them.$

label: EverGrandeCity_PokemonLeague_1F_Text_MustHaveAllGymBadges
text: Beyond this point, only those TRAINERS\nwho have collected all the GYM BADGES\lare permitted to enter.\pTRAINER, let us confirm that you have\nall the GYM BADGES.$

label: EverGrandeCity_SidneysRoom_Text_Defeat
text: Well, how do you like that? I lost!\nEh, it was fun, so it doesn't matter.$

label: EverGrandeCity_SidneysRoom_Text_IntroSpeech
text:
Welcome, challenger!
I'm SIDNEY of the ELITE FOUR.\pI like that look you're giving me.
I guess you'll give me a good match.\lThat's good! Looking real good!\pAll right! You and me, let's enjoy
a battle that can only be staged\lhere in the POKéMON LEAGUE!$

label: EverGrandeCity_SidneysRoom_Text_PostBattleSpeech
text: Well, listen to what this loser has\nto say.\pYou've got what it takes to go far.\nNow, go on to the next room and enjoy\lyour next battle!$

label: EverGrandeCity_Text_CitySign
text: EVER GRANDE CITY\p“The paradise of flowers, the sea,\nand POKéMON.”$

label: EverGrandeCity_Text_EnteringPokemonLeague
text: ENTERING POKéMON LEAGUE\nCENTER GATE$

label: EverGrandeCity_Text_EnteringVictoryRoad
text: ENTERING VICTORY ROAD$

label: FallarborTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_AwaitAnotherChallenge2
text: We await your challenge on\nanother occasion!$

label: FallarborTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_BagFullReturnForPrize
text: Oh?\nYour BAG seems to be full.\pI urge you to clear space and\nreturn for your prize.$

label: FallarborTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_BeatThreeTrainers
text: How splendid! You have beaten\nthree TRAINERS in succession!$

label: FallarborTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_CameToCampOut
text:
I heard something about some tent,
so I came to camp out.\pI didn't know that tents these days
are so luxurious!\pSince I'm here, I may as well try
my hand at battling!$

label: FallarborTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_DidntSaveBeforeQuitting
text:
My dear challenger!\pYou did not save the game before
shutting down, did you?\pIt is unfortunate, but that has
resulted in your disqualification\lfrom your challenge.\pYou may, of course, start with a fresh
challenge.$

label: FallarborTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_FallarborTentMyFavorite
text:
You know how BATTLE TENTS offer
different events in different towns?\pMy favorite is definitely the BATTLE
TENT in FALLARBOR TOWN.\pI think it's fantastic how TRAINERS
try to win with all their faith in\ltheir POKéMON.$

label: FallarborTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_GuideYouToBattleTent
text: I shall now guide you to\nthe BATTLE TENT.$

label: FallarborTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_LookingForwardToArrival
text: We have been looking forward to\nyour arrival.\pBefore I show you to the BATTLE TENT,\nI must save the game. Please wait.$

label: FallarborTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_MakeThinkImJustKid
text: Fufufufufu.\pI'm going to make everyone think\nI'm just a kid and let them play down.\pThen, I'll shock them and grab\nthe title!$

label: FallarborTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_PresentYouWithPrize
text: In commemoration of your 3-win streak,\nwe present you with this prize.$

label: FallarborTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_ReceivedPrize
text: {PLAYER} received the prize\n{STR_VAR_1}.$

label: FallarborTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_ScottLookingForSomeone
text:
SCOTT: Hi, {PLAYER}{KUN}!
So you came out to this BATTLE TENT!\pThe people in these parts tend to be
easygoing and laid-back.\pBut, you see, what I'm looking for are
people with…\pHow should I say this?\pSomeone bursting with the desire
and the drive to win.\pIf there were a TRAINER like that,
I'd immediately…\pWhoops! Never mind!
Keep working at it!$

label: FallarborTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_ScottMakeChallenge
text: SCOTT: Instead of wasting your\ntime with the likes of me, why not\lmake a challenge?$

label: FallarborTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_ThankYouWaitWhileSaving
text: Thank you so much for participating!\pPlease wait while I save the game.$

label: FallarborTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_WaitWhileSaveGame
text: Please wait while I save the game.$

label: FallarborTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_WelcomeToBattleTent
text: I welcome you to the BATTLE TENT\nFALLARBOR SITE!\pI am your guide to the Set KO Tourney!$

label: FallarborTown_CozmosHouse_Text_CozmoIsSoHappy
text: Look at PROF. COZMO…\nHe's so happy! I think it's cute.$

label: FallarborTown_CozmosHouse_Text_CozmoWentToMeteorFalls
text: PROF. COZMO went off to METEOR FALLS\non ROUTE 114 with some people from\lTEAM MAGMA.$

label: FallarborTown_CozmosHouse_Text_CrushedWithDisappointment
text: PROF. COZMO: Oh, but…\nI'm crushed with disappointment…$

label: FallarborTown_CozmosHouse_Text_FeelSorryForCozmo
text: Poor PROF. COZMO…\nHe's so depressed… I feel sorry for him.$

label: FallarborTown_CozmosHouse_Text_IsThatMeteoriteMayIHaveIt
text:
Oh!
Hah?\pThat item…\pCould it be?\pIs it the METEORITE that TEAM MAGMA
took from METEOR FALLS?\pPlease, may I have it?\pI'm not asking for it for free.
How about in exchange for this TM?$

label: FallarborTown_CozmosHouse_Text_MayIHaveMeteorite
text: PROF. COZMO: Please, may I have that\nMETEORITE?\pI'm not asking for it for free.\nHow about in exchange for this TM?$

label: FallarborTown_CozmosHouse_Text_MeteoriteWillNeverBeMineNow
text: PROF. COZMO: Oh…\nI never should have let myself be\lconned into telling TEAM MAGMA where\lyou can find METEORITES…\pThat METEORITE from METEOR FALLS…\nIt's never going to be mine now…$

label: FallarborTown_CozmosHouse_Text_PleaseUseThisTM
text: PROF. COZMO: This TM, it represents\nmy feeling of gratitude.\lPlease use it!$

label: FallarborTown_CozmosHouse_Text_ReallyGoingToHelpMyResearch
text: PROF. COZMO: Oh, I can't believe it.\nThis is really, really great!\pThis is really going to help my research!$

label: FallarborTown_Mart_Text_DecidingSkittyEvolve
text:
I'm having a hard time deciding if I
should make my SKITTY evolve or not.\pI only have to use this MOON STONE,
but it's so hard to decide…\pIf I make it evolve, it will become
much stronger.\pBut it will look so different, too.$

label: FallarborTown_Mart_Text_SellNuggetIFound
text: This NUGGET I found here…\nI suppose I'll have to sell it, seeing\las how it has no other use.$

label: FallarborTown_Mart_Text_Skitty
text: SKITTY: Miyao?$

label: FallarborTown_MoveRelearnersHouse_Text_CantTeachEgg
text: Hunh? There isn't a single move that\nI can teach an EGG.$

label: FallarborTown_MoveRelearnersHouse_Text_ComeBackWithHeartScale
text: If your POKéMON need to learn a move,\ncome back with a HEART SCALE.$

label: FallarborTown_MoveRelearnersHouse_Text_DontHaveMoveToTeachPokemon
text: Sorry…\pIt doesn't appear as if I have any move\nI can teach that POKéMON.$

label: FallarborTown_MoveRelearnersHouse_Text_HandedOverHeartScale
text: {PLAYER} handed over one HEART SCALE\nin exchange.$

label: FallarborTown_MoveRelearnersHouse_Text_ImTheMoveTutor
text:
I'm the MOVE TUTOR.\pI know all the moves that POKéMON
learn--every one of them--and I can\lteach POKéMON those moves.\pI can teach a move to a POKéMON
of yours if you'd like.\pI'll do it for a HEART SCALE.
I'm collecting those now.$

label: FallarborTown_MoveRelearnersHouse_Text_TeachWhichMove
text: Which move should I teach?$

label: FallarborTown_MoveRelearnersHouse_Text_ThatsAHeartScaleWantMeToTeachMove
text: Oh! That's it! That's an honest to\ngoodness HEART SCALE!\pLet me guess, you want me to teach\na move?$

label: FallarborTown_MoveRelearnersHouse_Text_TutorWhichMon
text: Which POKéMON needs tutoring?$

label: FallarborTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_FossilManiacEdgeOfTown
text: I wonder what POKéMON looked like\nlong, long ago?\pMaybe the FOSSIL MANIAC at the edge\nof town will know.$

label: FallarborTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_LanetteGreeting
text:
Oh, hello.
You are?\pOkay, your name's {PLAYER}{KUN}.
I can see that you're a TRAINER.\pSo that means you use the POKéMON
Storage System I developed.\pHow I arrived at that conclusion is
a simple deductive process.\pYou spoke to me because you wanted
to access something on this PC.\pOh, I'm sorry. I'm LANETTE.\pHonestly, I'm glad to meet you--it's
great you're using the Storage System.\pIf you could, please visit me at home.
My house is on ROUTE 114.$

label: FallarborTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_PlantHardyTrees
text: In the fields of FALLARBOR, we plant\nseedlings of hardy trees that thrive\leven in volcanic ash.$

label: FallarborTown_Text_Azurill
text: AZURILL: Rooreelooo.$

label: FallarborTown_Text_BattleTentSign
text: BATTLE TENT FALLARBOR SITE\n“May the Greatest Teams Gather!”$

label: FallarborTown_Text_HaveYouChallengedFlannery
text:
Have you already challenged FLANNERY,
the LEADER of LAVARIDGE GYM?\pThe girl's grandfather was famous.
He was one of the ELITE FOUR in the\lPOKéMON LEAGUE at one point.\pIt wouldn't surprise me to see FLANNERY
become a great TRAINER in her own\lright.$

label: FallarborTown_Text_MoveTutorSign
text: MOVE TUTOR'S HOUSE\n“New moves taught to POKéMON.”$

label: FallarborTown_Text_MyPreciousAzurill
text: See! Take a look!\nThis is my precious AZURILL!\pIt's slick and smooth and plushy, too!$

label: FallarborTown_Text_RegionKnownForMeteors
text: This region's been known for meteors\nsince the olden days.\pThey say METEOR FALLS was gouged out\nby a falling meteorite long ago.$

label: FallarborTown_Text_ShadyCharactersCozmosHome
text: Something's happening,\nand I don't like it!\pI've seen shady characters wandering\nin and out of PROF. COZMO's home…$

label: FallarborTown_Text_TownSign
text: FALLARBOR TOWN\n“A farm community with small gardens.”$

label: FarawayIsland_Entrance_Text_SailorReturn
text: CAPT. BRINEY can be so maddeningly\nfickle…\pDo you want to return to LILYCOVE?$

label: FarawayIsland_Entrance_Text_Sign
text: The writing is fading as if it was\nwritten a long time ago…\p“…ber, 6th day\nIf any human…sets foot here…\lagain…et it be a kindhearted pers…\l…ith that hope, I depar…”$

label: FarawayIsland_Interior_Text_Mew
text: Myuu…$

label: FiveIsland_House1_Text_HusbandWentOffFishing
text:
Don't worry about buying anything
for dinner tonight!\p…That's what my husband said when
he went off fishing today.\pI'm not sure if I can count on him
to live up to that promise.$

label: FiveIsland_House2_Text_MeadowBelongedToFamily
text:
That MEADOW has belonged to our
family for generations.\pI should have had a giant mansion
built on it.\pIt would be preferable to having
those thugs run wild on it!$

label: FiveIsland_LostCave_Room10_Text_MayIAskYouToTakeMeHome
text:
I am so glad that you happened
here.\pI grew rather bored of walking,
and I am feeling fatigued.\pMay I ask you to take me home
from here?$

label: FiveIsland_LostCave_Room10_Text_SelphyDefeat
text: Oh… I was afraid that you meant to\nharm me.$

label: FiveIsland_LostCave_Room10_Text_SelphyIntro
text: W-what do you intend to do with\nme?$

label: FiveIsland_LostCave_Room1_Text_LawsonDefeat
text: Aiyeeeeeh!\nMercy!$

label: FiveIsland_LostCave_Room1_Text_LawsonIntro
text: Aiyeeeeeh!\pI thought this was an ancient ruin.\nBut it's teeming with ghosts!$

label: FiveIsland_LostCave_Room1_Text_LawsonPostBattle
text: I'm trying to get out of here, but\nI always end up at the same spot.\pMaybe the number of boulders is\na hint…$

label: FiveIsland_LostCave_Room4_Text_LauraDefeat
text: If you don't go into the right\ntunnel, you won't get ahead.$

label: FiveIsland_LostCave_Room4_Text_LauraIntro
text: I think there is a mysterious power\nat work in this cave.$

label: FiveIsland_LostCave_Room4_Text_LauraPostBattle
text: Earlier, a lady went into the caves\nahead.$

label: FiveIsland_Meadow_Text_EnteredPasswordAnotherNeeded
text: {PLAYER} entered a password.\p“GOLDEEN need log.”\p… …  … …  … …\pAnother password is needed to\nopen the door…$

label: FiveIsland_Meadow_Text_EnteredPasswordDoorOpened
text: {PLAYER} entered two passwords.\p“GOLDEEN need log.”\n“Yes, nah, CHANSEY.”\p… …  … …  … …\pThe WAREHOUSE's door opened!$

label: FiveIsland_Meadow_Text_Rocket1Defeat
text: Is this for real?$

label: FiveIsland_Meadow_Text_Rocket1Intro
text: This area's strictly off-limits!\nOut, out!$

label: FiveIsland_Meadow_Text_Rocket1PostBattle
text: You don't have any business here!\nGo home!$

label: FiveIsland_Meadow_Text_Rocket2Defeat
text: That wasn't supposed to happen…$

label: FiveIsland_Meadow_Text_Rocket2Intro
text: There's nothing past here except\nour WAREHOUSE.\pSo what brings you here?$

label: FiveIsland_Meadow_Text_Rocket2PostBattle
text: You're wanting to know what's inside\nthis WAREHOUSE?\pIt's better you didn't know.\nFor your own sake, I mean.$

label: FiveIsland_Meadow_Text_Rocket3Defeat
text: Oh, that makes me furious!$

label: FiveIsland_Meadow_Text_Rocket3Intro
text: You'd be wasting time even if you\nwere to get by me.$

label: FiveIsland_Meadow_Text_Rocket3PostBattle
text: You won't be able to get in without\nthe passwords anyway.$

label: FiveIsland_Meadow_Text_WarehouseDoorAlreadyOpen
text: The WAREHOUSE's door is already\nopen.$

label: FiveIsland_MemorialPillar_Text_BeGoodToYourMonsToo
text: Please be good to your POKéMON,\ntoo.$

label: FiveIsland_MemorialPillar_Text_ChazDefeat
text: Flap, flap!$

label: FiveIsland_MemorialPillar_Text_ChazIntro
text: I'm the middle kid of the BIRD\nBROTHERS.\pThe best thing about birds…\nIt has to be the wings.$

label: FiveIsland_MemorialPillar_Text_ChazPostBattle
text: There was a really somber guy\nover that way.$

label: FiveIsland_MemorialPillar_Text_ChazRematchIntro
text: I'm the middle kid of the BIRD\nBROTHERS.\pI'm the one that loves wings.\nLet's battle again!$

label: FiveIsland_MemorialPillar_Text_DontHaveRoomForIt
text: If you don't have room for it,\nI'll hold it for you till next time.$

label: FiveIsland_MemorialPillar_Text_HaroldDefeat
text: Down is so comfy…\nIt makes me drowsy…$

label: FiveIsland_MemorialPillar_Text_HaroldIntro
text: I'm the youngest of the BIRD\nBROTHERS.\pThe best thing about birds…\nIt has to be the down.$

label: FiveIsland_MemorialPillar_Text_HaroldPostBattle
text: It fills me with happiness when\nbird POKéMON beg playfully…$

label: FiveIsland_MemorialPillar_Text_HaroldRematchIntro
text: I'm the youngest of the BIRD\nBROTHERS.\pI love birds for their down.\nI didn't think I'd see you again!$

label: FiveIsland_MemorialPillar_Text_HereLiesTectonix
text: Boulders and rocks are neatly piled\nup as a cairn.\p“Here lies TECTONIX” is engraved\non a boulder.$

label: FiveIsland_MemorialPillar_Text_HereLiesTectonixLemonadeOffering
text: “Here lies TECTONIX” is engraved\non a boulder.\pThere is a LEMONADE placed as an\noffering in front of the grave.$

label: FiveIsland_MemorialPillar_Text_LeaveAnotherLemonadeOffering
text: Would you like to leave another\nLEMONADE as an offering?$

label: FiveIsland_MemorialPillar_Text_MiloDefeat
text: Oh, so sharp!$

label: FiveIsland_MemorialPillar_Text_MiloIntro
text: I'm the eldest of the BIRD\nBROTHERS.\pThe best thing about birds…\nIt has to be the beak.$

label: FiveIsland_MemorialPillar_Text_MiloPostBattle
text: You can fly to FOUR ISLAND from\nhere.$

label: FiveIsland_MemorialPillar_Text_MiloRematchIntro
text: I'm the eldest of the BIRD\nBROTHERS. Remember me?\pThat's right, I'm the one who loves\nbirds for their beaks!$

label: FiveIsland_MemorialPillar_Text_PlacedCanOfLemonade
text: {PLAYER} placed a can of LEMONADE\nin front of the grave.$

label: FiveIsland_MemorialPillar_Text_ScrubScrub
text: Scrub, scrub…$

label: FiveIsland_MemorialPillar_Text_ScrubScrubTectonix
text: Scrub, scrub…\p… … …\nTECTONIX…$

label: FiveIsland_MemorialPillar_Text_StillHaveThingAsMyThanks
text: Oh, it's you from that time…\pI still have that thing I wanted\nyou to have as my thanks.$

label: FiveIsland_MemorialPillar_Text_ThankYouPleaseTakeThis
text:
Th-thank you…\pThat was my TECTONIX's favorite
drink…\pI don't even know you, but your
act of kindness…\pIt's uplifted me a little.\pCan you please take this as my
thanks?$

label: FiveIsland_MemorialPillar_Text_ThisIsWhereIBuriedMyOnix
text: This is where I buried my ONIX…\nIt was named TECTONIX…$

label: FiveIsland_MemorialPillar_Text_YourMonsLookHealthy
text: Hello…\nYour POKéMON look healthy…$

label: FiveIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_OnMyWayToPrepareMeal
text: I'm on my way to prepare a meal\nfor a certain high-society person.$

label: FiveIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_YoureOnQuestToCatchEveryMon
text: You're on a quest to catch every\nsingle kind of POKéMON?\p…How incredible. Please tell me if\nyou catch a strong one!$

label: FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_House_Text_ButlerBagAppearsToBeFull
text: Butler: Your BAG appears to be\nunfortunately full.$

label: FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_House_Text_ButlerIShallDoAsYouBid
text: Butler: I shall do as you bid,\nmy lady.$

label: FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_House_Text_ButlerPleaseAcceptThisAsHerThanks
text: Butler: I sincerely thank you for\npleasing Lady SELPHY.\pPlease accept this as her thanks…$

label: FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_House_Text_ButlerYesMyLady
text: Butler: Yes, my lady.$

label: FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_House_Text_LadySelphySmileHasBrillianceOfSun
text: Butler: The smile of Lady SELPHY\nhas the brilliance of the sun.\pPlease, I beg you to bring joy\nto Lady SELPHY.$

label: FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_House_Text_MonYouCaughtForMeThankYou
text:
SELPHY: Oh, hello, there.\pOh, my gracious. That must be the
{STR_VAR_1} you caught for me.\pGiggle…
I see a resemblance to you.\pThank you so kindly.\p… …  … …  … …
Is something the matter?\pYou may leave.\p… …  … …  … …
Oh, fine. I understand now.\pSEBASTIAN!
I need you here this instant!$

label: FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_House_Text_OhHowDisappointing
text: Oh…\nHow disappointing.$

label: FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_House_Text_OhImTiredOfWaiting
text: SELPHY: Oh, I'm tired of this.\nI'm tired of waiting for you.\pI'll forgive you this time, but\nplease don't fail me next time.$

label: FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_House_Text_PleaseHearMyWish
text: SELPHY: Oh?\nDo I know you from somewhere?\pOh, but that doesn't matter.\pI am exquisitely bored.\nPlease, hear my wish.$

label: FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_House_Text_SelphyGiveTokenOfAppreciation
text: SELPHY: See to it that this person\nis given a token of appreciation.$

label: FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_House_Text_SelphyWishYouBestOfLuck
text: SELPHY: I wish you the best of\nluck.$

label: FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_House_Text_WishToSeeMonPlease
text: I wish to see a POKéMON.\nA darling {STR_VAR_1}.\pI want to see one right away.\nPlease, make my wish come true.$

label: FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_CelinaDefeat
text: This loss…\nI feel like I'm whiting out…$

label: FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_CelinaIntro
text: Excuse me!\nI'm trying to paint.\lPlease keep out of my sight!$

label: FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_CelinaPostBattle
text: GILLIAN?\nPlease tilt your head slightly…\lThere! That's the look I want!$

label: FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_CelinaRematchIntro
text: Must I repeat myself?\nI'm trying to paint.\lPlease keep out of my sight!$

label: FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_DaisyDefeat
text: The shame of this…\nI'm red-faced…$

label: FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_DaisyIntro
text: With these hands, I will create\nmy victory!$

label: FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_DaisyPostBattle
text: Uh-oh, my paint tubes have\nscattered everywhere!$

label: FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_DaisyRematchIntro
text: With these hands, I will create\nmy victory today.$

label: FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_DestinDefeat
text: Oops!\nI rushed things!$

label: FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_DestinIntro
text: I'm a good runner.\nI'm really fast!$

label: FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_DestinPostBattle
text: When I run with the wind, it feels\nlike I could fly!$

label: FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_DestinRematchIntro
text: I'm a good runner.\nI've gotten even faster!$

label: FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_GillianDefeat
text: Oh, my goodness gracious!$

label: FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_GillianIntro
text: I'm thinking of having a pool\nmade specially for POKéMON.$

label: FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_GillianPostBattle
text: A pool would be nice, but I must\nsay, a sun-room may be sublime.$

label: FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_GillianRematchIntro
text: They're almost finished making the\npool for my POKéMON.\pYou must drop in for a visit.$

label: FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_JackiDefeat
text: Oh, my, so strong.$

label: FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_JackiIntro
text: I am visiting my friend's retreat,\nif you must know.$

label: FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_JackiPostBattle
text: I find it pleasurable to leisurely\nbattle in the gentle sea breeze.$

label: FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_JackiRematchIntro
text: Oh, you will give me another\nopportunity to match wits with you?$

label: FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_RaynaDefeat
text: Oh…\nMy feelings, they are blue…$

label: FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_RaynaIntro
text: Hmm…\nThe angle, it is not quite there…$

label: FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_RaynaPostBattle
text: The sky and the sea…\nThey are so fickle.\pTheir changing expressions make\nthem difficult to capture.$

label: FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_RaynaRematchIntro
text: I haven't made any progress…\nI still can't get the right angle…$

label: FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_SelphyThanksYouMayGoNow
text: SELPHY: Thank you.\pYou may go now.$

label: FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_SelphysHouse
text: SELPHY'S HOUSE$

label: FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_TobyDefeat
text: That's a shocker!\nYou must be joking.$

label: FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_TobyIntro
text: I say, this marine life here at\nthis resort agrees with me.$

label: FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_TobyPostBattle
text: Getting so serious over this…\nHow nonsensical.$

label: FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_TobyRematchIntro
text: I say, friend!\nLet us enjoy our time together!$

label: FiveIsland_RocketWarehouse_Text_Admin1Defeat
text: I…\nI'm shattered…$

label: FiveIsland_RocketWarehouse_Text_Admin1Intro
text: I don't know or care if what I'm\ndoing is right or wrong…\pI just put my faith in GIOVANNI\nand do as I am told.$

label: FiveIsland_RocketWarehouse_Text_Admin1PostBattle
text: You're doing things according to\nyour beliefs and morals.\pI understand now…$

label: FiveIsland_RocketWarehouse_Text_Admin2Defeat
text:
Urgh…
You were too strong…\p…
Th-that's GIOVANNI's BADGE!\pSo it's true?
TEAM ROCKET really has disbanded?$

label: FiveIsland_RocketWarehouse_Text_Admin2Intro
text:
That's quite enough of you 
playing the hero, kid.\pSpreading lies about how TEAM
ROCKET has disbanded…\pIt's such an obvious attempt to
cause confusion in our ranks.\pFortunately, we're not so ignorant
to fall for the lies of a newcomer!\pAnd now, I'll show you how scary
an angry adult can be!$

label: FiveIsland_RocketWarehouse_Text_Admin2PostBattle
text: We will abandon this WAREHOUSE…\pBut don't think this is over.\nI won't let this be the end.\pI will find GIOVANNI.\nAnd I will resurrect TEAM ROCKET!\lI will…\pUntil then, farewell!$

label: FiveIsland_RocketWarehouse_Text_GetLostLeaveMeBe
text: What do you want now?\nGo on, get lost, leave me be.$

label: FiveIsland_RocketWarehouse_Text_GideonDefeat
text: Gah! Darn!\nDarn! Darn!$

label: FiveIsland_RocketWarehouse_Text_GideonIntro
text:
I almost managed to sell the
SAPPHIRE for huge money…\pThen, you just had to come along
and blow the whole deal apart!\pFufu… Fufufufu…
There's no forgiveness for you!$

label: FiveIsland_RocketWarehouse_Text_GideonPostBattle
text: If I can't sell it, it's worthless!\nGo ahead, take it!$

label: FiveIsland_RocketWarehouse_Text_GiovannisKidHasRedHair
text:
What, you again?\pYou… You're not GIOVANNI's kid,
are you?\pNo, that can't be right!
GIOVANNI's kid has red hair.\pYou don't have any reasons for
bugging me. Leave me alone!$

label: FiveIsland_RocketWarehouse_Text_Grunt1Defeat
text: Oh, but…\nToo much!$

label: FiveIsland_RocketWarehouse_Text_Grunt1Intro
text: Oh, now your POKéMON look strong.\nYou're willing to sell them?\pOh?\nYou wanted to battle?$

label: FiveIsland_RocketWarehouse_Text_Grunt1PostBattle
text: We can give you a great price.\nSell us your POKéMON!$

label: FiveIsland_RocketWarehouse_Text_Grunt2Defeat
text: What do you think you're doing?!$

label: FiveIsland_RocketWarehouse_Text_Grunt2Intro
text: Did you come here knowing it's\nTEAM ROCKET's WAREHOUSE?$

label: FiveIsland_RocketWarehouse_Text_Grunt2PostBattle
text: TEAM ROCKET broke up?\nWhat planet are you from?$

label: FiveIsland_RocketWarehouse_Text_Grunt3Defeat
text: Don't…you…dare…laugh…$

label: FiveIsland_RocketWarehouse_Text_Grunt3Intro
text: I got word about you from the\nothers.\pBut there's no way a rookie like you'd\nknow our BOSS GIOVANNI!$

label: FiveIsland_RocketWarehouse_Text_Grunt3PostBattle
text: Don't mess in the doings of adults,\nyou jumped-up pip-squeak!$

label: FiveIsland_RocketWarehouse_Text_MadeItSoYouCanComeBackThrough
text:
I've made it so you can come back
in through there.\pWhy don't you go get rested and
refreshed for what lies ahead?\pThe ADMIN after me outranks me
thoroughly as a TRAINER.\pYou'd better steel yourself for one
harsh challenge.$

label: FiveIsland_RocketWarehouse_Text_ManyMonsLockedInPen
text: There are many POKéMON locked\naway in the pen…$

label: FiveIsland_RocketWarehouse_Text_PenUnlockedMonsFled
text: The pen door is unlocked.\nThe POKéMON appear to have fled.$

label: FiveIsland_RocketWarehouse_Text_ReportWithGraphsAndText
text: A report with graphs and text is on\nthe PC monitor.\p“The Influence of Magnetic Waves\non POKéMON Evolution”…\p… … … … … …\pIt's too difficult to understand…$

label: FiveIsland_Text_BeenGettingBusierAroundHere
text: It's been getting busier around\nthese parts lately.\pI haven't been catching many good\nfish lately, either.$

label: FiveIsland_Text_IslandSign
text: FIVE ISLAND\nChrono Island: Where Time Goes$

label: FiveIsland_Text_WeirdBuildingInMeadow
text: Oh, this stinks. I wanted to play in\nthe MEADOW.\pBut they put up a weird building\non it, so I can't play there.$

label: FiveIsland_WaterLabyrinth_Text_AlizeDefeat
text: Your POKéMON are growing up\nadmirably well!$

label: FiveIsland_WaterLabyrinth_Text_AlizeIntro
text: This is an excellent environment\nfor raising POKéMON.$

label: FiveIsland_WaterLabyrinth_Text_AlizePostBattle
text: You know, I think you have the\ntalent to be a good BREEDER.$

label: FiveIsland_WaterLabyrinth_Text_AlizeRematchIntro
text: Oh, hello!\pAre you raising your POKéMON in a\ngood environment?$

label: FiveIsland_WaterLabyrinth_Text_CuteMonRemindsMeOfDaisy
text:
Oh, hello.
That's a cute {STR_VAR_2}.\pSeeing it reminds me of a sweet 
little girl I met while traveling.\pShe was gently grooming POKéMON…
She was a little angel.\pThat little girl's name…
I think it was DAISY.$

label: FiveIsland_WaterLabyrinth_Text_DontHaveSpaceInYourParty
text: …Unfortunately, you don't have\nspace for this in your party.\pYou'd better come back for it\nanother time.$

label: FiveIsland_WaterLabyrinth_Text_GladIMetSomeoneLikeYou
text: I received that EGG while I was\ntraveling.\pI'm glad I met someone like you.$

label: FiveIsland_WaterLabyrinth_Text_HmmISeeIsee
text: Ah, hmm…\nI see, I see…$

label: FiveIsland_WaterLabyrinth_Text_LetMeTakeLookAtMons
text:
You travel all over the place,
don't you?\pYou're not driving your POKéMON
too harshly, are you?\pLet me take a look.
… … …   … … …$

label: FiveIsland_WaterLabyrinth_Text_ReceivedEggFromMan
text: {PLAYER} received an EGG\nfrom the man!$

label: FiveIsland_WaterLabyrinth_Text_TreatMonRightHaveThis
text: Oh, impressive.\nYou treat your POKéMON right.\pI think you can be entrusted with\nthis.\pPlease, I'd like you to have this.$

label: FortreeCity_DecorationShop_Text_BuyingDeskForDolls
text: I'm buying a pretty desk and I'm\nputting my cute DOLLS on it.\pIf I don't, when I decorate my\nSECRET BASE, my DOLLS will get\ldirty or poked with splinters.$

label: FortreeCity_DecorationShop_Text_MerchandiseSentToPC
text: Merchandise you buy here is sent to\nyour own PC.\pThat's fantastic! I wish they could\nalso deliver me home like that.$

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_AshleyDefeat
text: I was beaten…$

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_AshleyIntro
text: WINONA taught me personally!\nYou can't beat me easily!$

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_AshleyPostBattle
text: Thanks to WINONA, the people of\nFORTREE can live without fear.$

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_DariusDefeat
text: You seem to know your stuff!$

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_DariusIntro
text: You'd better know that there are all\nsorts of FLYING-type POKéMON.\pYou do know that, right?$

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_DariusPostBattle
text: Sure, you beat me all right.\nBut you'd better watch it! Our LEADER\lWINONA's POKéMON are all business.$

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_EdwardoDefeat
text: It was too much of a load for me\nto bear…$

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_EdwardoIntro
text: The lovers of BIRD POKéMON aspire\nto join this GYM.\pAs a member of the FORTREE GYM,\nI'm not allowed to lose!$

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_EdwardoPostBattle
text: The world is huge, and there are\ncountless tough TRAINERS.\pI'm going to keep training and make\nmyself even stronger.$

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_ExplainAerialAce
text: TM40 contains AERIAL ACE.\pIts speed…\nNo POKéMON should be able to avoid it.\p… … … … … …$

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_ExplainFeatherBadgeTakeThis
text:
With the FEATHER BADGE, all POKéMON up
to LV 70, even those received through\ltrades, will obey your every command.\pYou will also be able to use
the HM move FLY outside of battle.\pAnd this…
This is a gift from me.$

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_FlintDefeat
text: WINONA, I…\nI lost!$

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_FlintIntro
text: There's no need for WINONA, our GYM\nLEADER, to deal with you!\pI'm plenty good enough for you!$

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_FlintPostBattle
text: WINONA is cute and she's strong.\nShe's the ultimate LEADER!\pBlush…$

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_GymGuideAdvice
text:
Yo, how's it going, CHAMPION-
bound {PLAYER}?\pFORTREE GYM LEADER WINONA is
a master of FLYING-type POKéMON.\pShe's waiting at the back of this GYM,
behind the rotating doors.\pShe's waiting for new challengers
who are trying to take wing!\pOkay, go for it!$

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_GymGuidePostVictory
text: You did it!\nYou've achieved liftoff!$

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_GymStatue
text: FORTREE CITY POKéMON GYM$

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_GymStatueCertified
text: FORTREE CITY POKéMON GYM\pWINONA'S CERTIFIED TRAINERS:\n{PLAYER}$

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_HumbertoDefeat
text: Urk!\nI couldn't stop you.$

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_HumbertoIntro
text: When WINONA takes to battle, her face\nshines with beautiful determination…\pI'm not letting you witness that\nlovely sight!$

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_HumbertoPostBattle
text: You'd better watch it!\nDon't get distracted staring at WINONA\lor you'll go crashing down in a heap!$

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_JaredDefeat
text: You…\nYou're strong…$

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_JaredIntro
text: Behold the elegant battle style of\nBIRD POKéMON!$

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_JaredPostBattle
text: A TRAINER has to be smart to keep\nup with unexpected turns of events.\pDo you have the smarts to get to\nour LEADER?$

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_ReceivedFeatherBadge
text: {PLAYER} received the FEATHER BADGE\nfrom WINONA.$

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_RegisteredWinona
text: Registered GYM LEADER WINONA\nin the POKéNAV.$

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_WinonaDefeat
text: Never before have I seen a TRAINER\ncommand POKéMON with more grace\lthan I…\pIn recognition of your prowess,\nI present to you this GYM BADGE.$

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_WinonaIntro
text:
I am WINONA. I am the LEADER of
the FORTREE POKéMON GYM.\pI have become one with BIRD POKéMON
and have soared the skies…\pHowever grueling the battle, we have
triumphed with grace…\pWitness the elegant choreography
of BIRD POKéMON and I!$

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_WinonaPostBattle
text: Though I fell to you, I will remain\ndevoted to BIRD POKéMON.$

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_WinonaPostRematch
text: WINONA: Even though I have lost,\nthe wings of my heart remain unbroken.\pI can rise and soar again and\nyet again.\pI am convinced of it!$

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_WinonaPreRematch
text:
WINONA: We humans can never escape
gravity's pull on the ground.\pBut by striving for excellence,
we have the power to soar!\pYou have scaled the pinnacle as
the reigning CHAMPION.\pPlease, allow me to see your power
at full flight!$

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_WinonaRematchDefeat
text: I failed to reach your height again…$

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_WinonaRematchNeedTwoMons
text:
WINONA: We humans can never escape
gravity's pull on the ground.\pBut by striving for excellence,
we have the power to soar!\pYou have scaled the pinnacle as
the reigning CHAMPION.\pPlease, allow me to see your power
at full flight!\pOh, no… Do you have but one
POKéMON with you?\pPlease return with two POKéMON
at the very least.$

label: FortreeCity_House1_Text_GoingToMakeVolbeatStrong
text: I'm going to make VOLBEAT super\nstrong from this moment on!\pI hope you do the same with PLUSLE!$

label: FortreeCity_House1_Text_MonYouTakeCare
text: Oh, yeah, right on!\p{STR_VAR_1}, welcome!\n{STR_VAR_2}, you take care!$

label: FortreeCity_House1_Text_ThisIsntAMon
text: Uh, no, I don't think so.\nThat isn't a {STR_VAR_1}.$

label: FortreeCity_House1_Text_TradingMemoriesWithOthers
text: Trading POKéMON with others…\pIt's as if you're trading your own\nmemories with other people.$

label: FortreeCity_House1_Text_YouWillTradeWontYou
text:
Wrooooaaar! I need it!
I have to get me a {STR_VAR_1}!\lI'll do anything for it!\p…Uh… Did you hear that?
My shout from the bottom of my heart?\pHaving heard that, you will trade
your {STR_VAR_1} for my {STR_VAR_2},\lwon't you?$

label: FortreeCity_House1_Text_YouWontTradeMe
text: No? You won't trade me?\nEven after I bared my heart to you?$

label: FortreeCity_House1_Text_Zigzagoon
text: ZIGZAGOON: Gumomoh?$

label: FortreeCity_House2_Text_CoinInWhichHand
text: Let this old woman see if your hidden\npower has awoken…\pI hold a coin in my hand.\pNow, tell me, have I palmed it in\nthe right hand? Or in the left?$

label: FortreeCity_House2_Text_CorrectTryAgainWhichHand
text: Oh! Yes, correct!\pWe shall try again.\pIn which hand have I palmed the coin?\nThe right or left?$

label: FortreeCity_House2_Text_CorrectTryAgainWhichHand2
text: Oh! Yes, correct!\pWe shall try again.\pIn which hand have I palmed the coin?\nThe right or left?$

label: FortreeCity_House2_Text_ExplainHiddenPower
text: HIDDEN POWER is a move that changes\nwith the POKéMON.$

label: FortreeCity_House2_Text_HiddenPowersArousedByNature
text: People… POKéMON…\pTheir hidden powers are aroused by\nliving in natural environments…$

label: FortreeCity_House2_Text_YouGuessedWrong
text: No, too bad.\nYou guessed wrong.$

label: FortreeCity_House2_Text_YourHiddenPowerHasAwoken
text: Oh! Splendid!\nYour hidden power has awoken!\pHere, take this and awaken the hidden\npower of your POKéMON.$

label: FortreeCity_House3_Text_MetStevenHadAmazingPokemon
text:
While speaking about POKéDEXES,
I remembered something.\pI met this TRAINER, STEVEN, when
I was searching for rare stones.\pHoo, boy, he had some amazing POKéMON
with him.\pThey weren't just rare, they were
trained to terrifying extremes!\pHe might even be stronger than the
GYM LEADER in this town…$

label: FortreeCity_House3_Text_OhYouHavePokedex
text: What's that thing you have there?\p… … … … … …\pOh, it's called a POKéDEX?\nIt's really awesome!$

label: FortreeCity_House4_Text_AskedWingullToRunErrand
text: Heheh, I asked my WINGULL to run\nan errand for me.$

label: FortreeCity_House4_Text_BringsWorldCloserTogether
text: By being together with POKéMON,\npeople make more and more friends.\pAnd that brings the world closer\ntogether. I think it's wonderful!$

label: FortreeCity_House4_Text_FriendsFarAwayThanksToWingull
text: Thanks to my WINGULL, I have friends\nwho live far away.$

label: FortreeCity_House4_Text_GoBirdPokemon
text: There!\nGo, BIRD POKéMON!$

label: FortreeCity_House4_Text_WelcomeWingullTakeMentalHerb
text:
Good!
Welcome back, WINGULL!\pHuh? What is this?
What is it holding?\pA MENTAL HERB?
It must have picked it up somewhere.\pBut I'm not a TRAINER, so you can
have it.$

label: FortreeCity_House4_Text_Wingull
text: WINGULL: Pihyoh!$

label: FortreeCity_House5_Text_AdaptedToNature
text: POKéMON and people have adapted to\nnature for survival.\pThere's no need to make nature\nconform to the way we want to live.$

label: FortreeCity_House5_Text_TreeHousesAreGreat
text: The tree houses of FORTREE are great!\pI think it's the number one town for\nliving together with POKéMON.$

label: FortreeCity_House5_Text_Zigzagoon
text: ZIGZAGOON: Bufuu!$

label: FortreeCity_Mart_Text_RareCandyMakesMonGrow
text: A RARE CANDY makes a POKéMON grow\nimmediately by one level.$

label: FortreeCity_Mart_Text_StockUpOnItems
text: I always stock up on more items than\nI'm sure I'll need.\pYou never know what might happen.\nBetter to be safe than sorry!$

label: FortreeCity_Mart_Text_SuperRepelBetter
text: SUPER REPEL lasts a long time,\nand it gets the job done.\pIt's much better than an ordinary\nREPEL.$

label: FortreeCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_DoYouKnowAboutPokenav
text:
Oh, wow, you have a POKéNAV!
And it's just like mine!\pDo you know about POKéNAV's
MATCH CALL system?\pAccess it, and you can chat with
registered TRAINERS anytime.\pIt also shows you which TRAINERS
want a rematch with you.\pIt's really nifty! Those DEVON guys
sure know what they're doing!$

label: FortreeCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_GoToSafariZone
text: Listen, kid, are you working\non a POKéDEX?\pHmm… Go to the SAFARI ZONE.\nThat's my suggestion.$

label: FortreeCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_RecordCornerIsNeat
text:
Have you done anything at
the RECORD CORNER?\pIt's pretty neat. It mixes and matches
the records of TRAINERS.\pI don't know quite how it works,
but it's cool. It's exciting, even!$

label: FortreeCity_Text_BugPokemonComeThroughWindow
text: Living on top of trees is okay.\pBut sometimes BUG POKéMON come in\nthrough windows.\lIt can be really startling.$

label: FortreeCity_Text_CitySign
text: FORTREE CITY\n“The treetop city that frolics with\lnature.”$

label: FortreeCity_Text_EveryoneHealthyAndLively
text:
The CITY consists of homes built on
trees.\pPerhaps because of that lifestyle,
everyone is healthy and lively.\pWhy, even myself--I feel as if I've
grown thirty years younger.$

label: FortreeCity_Text_GymSign
text: FORTREE CITY POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: WINONA\p“The bird user taking flight into\nthe world.”$

label: FortreeCity_Text_PokemonThatEvolveWhenTraded
text: There are POKéMON that evolve when\nyou trade them! That's what I heard.$

label: FortreeCity_Text_SawGiganticPokemonInSky
text:
No one believes me, but I saw this
gigantic POKéMON in the sky.\pIt seemed to squirm as it flew toward
ROUTE 131.\pBy the way… Sniff…
Um… You, uh…smell singed.\pWere you at a volcano or something?$

label: FortreeCity_Text_SomethingBlockingGym
text: I want to go to the POKéMON GYM,\nbut something's blocking the way.\pAfter all the bother I went through\ntraining on ROUTE 120…$

label: FortreeCity_Text_SomethingUnseeable
text: Something unseeable is in the way.$

label: FortreeCity_Text_ThisTimeIllBeatWinona
text: I've got my pride-and-joy POKéMON\nwith me. This time, I'll beat WINONA.$

label: FortreeCity_Text_TreesGrowByDrinkingRainwater
text: The ground absorbs rainwater, and\ntrees grow by drinking that water…\pOur FORTREE CITY exists because\nthere's both water and soil.$

label: FortreeCity_Text_UnseeableUseDevonScope
text: Something unseeable is in the way.\pWant to use the DEVON SCOPE?$

label: FortreeCity_Text_UsedDevonScopePokemonFled
text: {PLAYER} used the DEVON SCOPE.\pAn invisible POKéMON became completely\nvisible!\pThe startled POKéMON fled!$

label: FourIsland_House1_Text_YoureAwfullyHeavy
text: There! Boing!\nYou're awfully heavy!$

label: FourIsland_House2_Text_BragAboutSomethingForMe
text: Brag about something for me.\nI'll give you a STICKER.$

label: FourIsland_House2_Text_BragAboutWhatToday
text: Oh, hi!\nHere comes the braggart.\pWhat are you going to brag about\ntoday?$

label: FourIsland_House2_Text_ComeBackWithBetterStoryEggs
text: Hmm…\pCome back with a better story next\ntime, okay?$

label: FourIsland_House2_Text_ComeBackWithBetterStoryHoF
text: Hmm…\pCome back with a better story next\ntime, okay?$

label: FourIsland_House2_Text_ComeBackWithBetterStoryLinkWins
text: Hmm…\pCome back with a better story next\ntime, okay?$

label: FourIsland_House2_Text_EggStickerApplied
text: The EGG STICKER was applied\nto the TRAINER CARD.$

label: FourIsland_House2_Text_GiveYouStickerIfYouBrag
text:
Oh, excellent!
You've come to the right place!\pLook, look! See? See?
These are my STICKERS!\lLook how many I got!\pI bet you want some.
I bet you do!\pI'll give a STICKER if you can tell
me something awesome about\lyourself.\pWhat will you brag about?$

label: FourIsland_House2_Text_HoFStickerApplied
text: The HALL OF FAME STICKER was\napplied to the TRAINER CARD.$

label: FourIsland_House2_Text_LivingLegendEggs
text: Oh, no, no can do.\pYou're practically a living legend.\nI have no SITCKERS left to give.$

label: FourIsland_House2_Text_LivingLegendHoF
text: Oh, no, no can do.\pYou're practically a living legend.\nI have no SITCKERS left to give.$

label: FourIsland_House2_Text_LivingLegendLinkWins
text: Oh, no, no can do.\pYou're practically a living legend.\nI have no SITCKERS left to give.$

label: FourIsland_House2_Text_VictoryStickerApplied
text: The VICTORY STICKER was applied\nto the TRAINER CARD.$

label: FourIsland_House2_Text_WishICouldShowOffStickers
text: Giggle…\nI collected a ton of STICKERS.\lI wish I could show them off…$

label: FourIsland_House2_Text_WowEggsHigh
text: Whoa! You've hatched a whole\nbunch of EGGS!\pYou're an EGG-hatching machine!\nI'll give you one of these.$

label: FourIsland_House2_Text_WowEggsHighest
text: Wh… You hatched that many EGGS?\pWhat's behind your love of EGGS?\nIt's beyond incredible, yup!\pYou're too awesome, I tell you.\nThat's it, I have to give you this.$

label: FourIsland_House2_Text_WowEggsLow
text: You've hatched that many EGGS?\nYou really must like them!\pThat's impressive, yup!\nI'll give you one of these.$

label: FourIsland_House2_Text_WowEggsLowest
text: Oh, wow, there are POKéMON EGGS?\nI didn't know that!\pThat's pretty good, yup!\nI'll give you one of these.$

label: FourIsland_House2_Text_WowHoFHigh
text: Whoa! You've made it into the\nHALL OF FAME that often?\lThat's seriously incredible, yup!\pYou own the POKéMON LEAGUE!\nI'll give you one of these.$

label: FourIsland_House2_Text_WowHoFHighest
text: No way! You've gone into the\nHALL OF FAME that many times?\pYou're beyond incredible, yup!\nThat's it, I have to give you this.$

label: FourIsland_House2_Text_WowHoFLow
text: Oh, wow, you've entered the\nHALL OF FAME often!\pThat's impressive, yup!\nI'll give you one of these.$

label: FourIsland_House2_Text_WowHoFLowest
text: Oh, wow, you made it into the\nHALL OF FAME.\pThat's pretty good, yup!\nI'll give you one of these.$

label: FourIsland_House2_Text_WowLinkWinsHigh
text: Whoa! You've beaten your friends\na frightful number of times.\pHave you lost friends over this?\nI'll give you one of these.$

label: FourIsland_House2_Text_WowLinkWinsHighest
text:
Wh… Wickedly whoa!
You've won mind-blowingly often!\pIt just knocks me out thinking
about how tough you are.\pYou're the stuff of nightmares!
That's it, I have to give you this.$

label: FourIsland_House2_Text_WowLinkWinsLow
text: You've beaten your friends a lot\nlink battling, huh?\pYou're impressively strong, yup!\nI'll give you one of these.$

label: FourIsland_House2_Text_WowLinkWinsLowest
text: Oh, wow, you've had success\nlink battling?\pYou're pretty strong, yup!\nI'll give you one of these.$

label: FourIsland_IcefallCave_Back_Text_GruntDefeat
text: We didn't plan on this!$

label: FourIsland_IcefallCave_Back_Text_GruntIntro
text: W-what?!\pWho says we can't do what we want\nwith the POKéMON we catch?$

label: FourIsland_IcefallCave_Back_Text_LoreleiKeepHandsOffMons
text: LORELEI: Keep your filthy hands\noff the POKéMON in the cave!\pDo as I say, or you'll have me to\nanswer to!$

label: FourIsland_IcefallCave_Back_Text_LoreleiPlayerHelpMeKickPoachersOut
text:
LORELEI: {PLAYER}?!
What are you doing here?\pNo, we can catch up later.
Right now, I need your help.\pHelp me kick these poachers out
before they do anything else.\pThey've been catching POKéMON
here, then selling them off!\pAre you ready?
You take that one, please!$

label: FourIsland_IcefallCave_Back_Text_LoreleiWellDeepFreezeYou
text:
LORELEI: If you won't confess,
we'll deep-freeze you.\pMy LAPRAS is furious for what
you've done to its friends.\pGo, LAPRAS!
ICE BEAM…$

label: FourIsland_IcefallCave_Back_Text_LoreleiWhereHaveYouTakenMons
text:
LORELEI: Humph.
So despicably weak.\pYou!
Tell me!\pWhere have you taken the captured
POKéMON?\pI'm smashing your ring once and
for all!$

label: FourIsland_IcefallCave_Back_Text_NotTellingYouThat
text: N-no way!\nI'm not telling you that!$

label: FourIsland_IcefallCave_Back_Text_OkayRocketWareHouseFiveIsland
text:
Wawaah! Okay!
I'll talk!\pThe POKéMON are in the ROCKET
WAREHOUSE on FIVE ISLAND.\pThere! I said it!
We'll be going now!\p…But I doubt you'll ever make it
into the ROCKET WAREHOUSE!\pHeheheheh!$

label: FourIsland_IcefallCave_Back_Text_ShutItLadyLeaveUsBe
text: Aww, shut it, lady, and leave\nus be.\pDon't let your glasses get all\nsteamed up!$

label: FourIsland_IcefallCave_Back_Text_ThankYouThisIsAwful
text:
{PLAYER}, thank you.
But this is awful…\pI was born and raised here on
these islands.\pI had no idea that those horrible
criminals were loose here…$

label: FourIsland_LoreleisHouse_Text_IfAnythingWereToHappenToIsland
text:
LORELEI: There's something weighing
heavily on my mind.\pIf anything were to happen on
the island where I was born…\pI wouldn't know about it if I were
in the POKéMON LEAGUE.\pI wonder if that would make me
irresponsible to my home…$

label: FourIsland_LoreleisHouse_Text_IllReturnToLeagueInShortWhile
text:
LORELEI: So, you managed to solve
all the problems here?\pThat's wonderful.\pThat means there isn't any reason
for me to be here all the time.\pThank you…\pI'll return to the POKéMON LEAGUE
in a short while.$

label: FourIsland_LoreleisHouse_Text_StuffedMonDollsGalore
text: Stuffed POKéMON dolls galore!$

label: FourIsland_LoreleisHouse_Text_WillDoWhatICanHereAndNow
text: I don't know what will happen in\nthe future, but…\pI will do what I can here and now.\nThat's all I can do.$

label: FourIsland_Mart_Text_IcefallCaveIsFrigid
text:
The SEVII ISLANDS are in a warm
region overall.\pBut there is one exception you
need to know about.\pThe ICEFALL CAVE is frigid because
of the POKéMON that live in it.$

label: FourIsland_Mart_Text_LoreleiGrewUpOnThisIsland
text:
We've had a great and powerful
TRAINER grow up on this island.\pI bet even you'd know her.
It's LORELEI of the ELITE FOUR!\pWhen LORELEI was just a tyke,
I taught her about POKéMON.$

label: FourIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_DayCarePeopleFoundEggBefore
text:
Oh? A POKéMON EGG?
…I have no idea.\p…Oh, wait. The DAY-CARE people
in town were saying something.\pThey said that they'd found EGGS
before on their property.$

label: FourIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_NewPokemonJournalHasntArrived
text: What's this?\pThe new POKéMON JOURNAL hasn't\narrived on this island?$

label: FourIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_RareIceMonsInCave
text: There's a rare kind of ICE POKéMON\nthat lives in the cave.\pWe get a lot of visitors hoping to\nsee that POKéMON.$

label: FourIsland_Text_IslandSign
text: FOUR ISLAND\nThe Warm, Blue, Floe Island$

label: FourIsland_Text_LoreleiHasLotsOfStuffedDolls
text:
Oh, you found me!
Please don't tell LORELEI.\pDid you know that LORELEI has lots
and lots of stuffed dolls?\pEvery time she comes back to
FOUR ISLAND, her collection grows!$

label: FourIsland_Text_LoreleiHasReturned
text: LORELEI has returned.\pDid she find the city life too\nstressful, I wonder?$

label: FourIsland_Text_LoreleiMetLaprasAsChild
text:
LORELEI has gone back.\pThe LAPRAS she has, I imagine it
to be the one she met as a child.\pI believe it was in ICEFALL CAVE
that she caught it.\pPerhaps that POKéMON has been with
her ever since.$

label: FourIsland_Text_LoreleisHouse
text: LORELEI'S HOUSE$

label: FourIsland_Text_MadeSlushieUsingIcefallCaveIce
text: Ooh, chilly!\pI made a slushie using ice I\nshaved inside ICEFALL CAVE.\pIt's chilly and tasty!$

label: FourIsland_Text_RivalAlreadyGotEggBeSmellingYa
text:
{RIVAL}: Hey!
{PLAYER}!\pWhat are you doing here in the
SEVII ISLANDS?\pYou should quit copying me,
you know?\pAnyways, I already got my POKéMON
EGG, so I'm done with this island.\pHeh, I bet you don't even know
about POKéMON EGGS.\pYou'll never fill your NATIONAL
POKéDEX that way.\pBy the way, I saw someone we both
know on this island.\pWhy don't you go look around if
it makes you curious?\pMe, I don't have the time to
waste.\pBe smelling ya!$

label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_EdgarDefeat
text: Awoo!$

label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_EdgarIntro
text: I also study the way of the ninja\nwith Master KOGA!\pNinja have a long history of using\nanimals!$

label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_EdgarPostBattle
text: I still have much to learn.$

label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_GymGuyAdvice
text:
Yo!
Champ in the making!\pFUCHSIA GYM is a tricked-up place.
It's riddled with invisible walls!\pKOGA might appear close, but he's
blocked off.\pYou have to find gaps in the walls
to reach him.$

label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_GymGuyPostVictory
text: It's amazing how ninja can terrify,\neven now!$

label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_GymStatue
text: FUCHSIA POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: KOGA\pWINNING TRAINERS:\n{RIVAL}$

label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_GymStatuePlayerWon
text: FUCHSIA POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: KOGA\pWINNING TRAINERS:\n{RIVAL}, {PLAYER}$

label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_KaydenDefeat
text: What?\nExtraordinary!$

label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_KaydenIntro
text: Strength isn't the key for POKéMON.\nDo you understand this?\pPOKéMON is about strategy!\pI'll show you how strategy can\nbeat brute strength.$

label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_KaydenPostBattle
text: So, you mix brawn with brains?\nGood strategy!\pThat's remarkable for a trainer\nTRAINER.$

label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_KirkDefeat
text: I'm done for!$

label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_KirkIntro
text: I was a magician once upon a time.\pBut I dreamt of becoming a ninja,\nso I joined this GYM.$

label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_KirkPostBattle
text: Even though I've lost, I will keep\ntraining according to the teachings\lof KOGA, my ninja master.$

label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_KogaDefeat
text: Humph!\nYou have proven your worth!\pHere!\nTake the SOULBADGE!$

label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_KogaExplainSoulBadge
text:
Now that you have the SOULBADGE,
the DEFENSE of your POKéMON rises.\pIt also lets you SURF outside of
battle.\pAh!
Take this, too!$

label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_KogaExplainTM06
text: Sealed within that TM06 lies\nTOXIC!\pIt is a secret technique dating\nback some four hundred years.$

label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_KogaIntro
text:
KOGA: Fwahahaha!\pA mere child like you dares to
challenge me?\pThe very idea makes me shiver
with mirth!\pVery well, I shall show you true
terror as a ninja master.\pPoison brings steady doom.
Sleep renders foes helpless.\pDespair to the creeping horror of
POISON-type POKéMON!{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_RG_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}$

label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_KogaPostBattle
text: When afflicted by TOXIC, a POKéMON\nsuffers more and more.\pIt suffers worsening damage as the\nbattle wears on!\pIt will surely terrorize foes!$

label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_MakeSpaceForThis
text: Make space for this, child!$

label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_NateDefeat
text: You had me fooled!$

label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_NateIntro
text: Let's see you beat my special\ntechniques!$

label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_NatePostBattle
text: I like poison and sleep techniques,\nas they linger after battle!$

label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_PhilDefeat
text: Whoa!\nYou've got it!$

label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_PhilIntro
text: Stop right there!\pThe famed invisible walls of\nFUCHSIA GYM have you frustrated?$

label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_PhilPostBattle
text: You impressed me!\nHere's a hint!\pLook very closely for gaps in the\ninvisible walls!$

label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_ReceivedTM06FromKoga
text: {PLAYER} received TM06\nfrom KOGA.$

label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_ShawnDefeat
text: You're more skilled than I'd\nthought!$

label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_ShawnIntro
text: Master KOGA comes from a long line\nof ninjas.\pWhat did you descend from?$

label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_ShawnPostBattle
text: Where there is light, there is\nshadow!\pLight and shadow!\nWhich do you choose?$

label: FuchsiaCity_House1_Text_BillFilesHisOwnMonData
text: BILL files his own POKéMON data on\nhis PC.\pDid he show you?$

label: FuchsiaCity_House1_Text_BillIsMyGrandson
text: Hmm?\nYou've met BILL?\pHe's my grandson!\pHe always liked collecting things,\neven as a child!$

label: FuchsiaCity_House1_Text_WardenIsOldHasFalseTeeth
text: The SAFARI ZONE's WARDEN is old, \nbut he's still very much active.\pAll his teeth are false, though.$

label: FuchsiaCity_House2_Text_DoYouLikeToFish
text: I'm the FISHING GURU's older\nbrother.\pI simply looove fishing!\nI can't bear to go without.\pTell me, do you like to fish?$

label: FuchsiaCity_House2_Text_GoodRodCanCatchBetterMons
text:
Fishing is a way of life!
It is like the finest poetry.\pA crummy OLD ROD could only catch
MAGIKARP, yes?\pBut with a GOOD ROD, you can
catch much better POKéMON.$

label: FuchsiaCity_House2_Text_HowAreTheFishBiting
text: Hello there, {PLAYER}!\pHow are the fish biting?$

label: FuchsiaCity_House2_Text_LikeYourStyleTakeThis
text: Grand! I like your style.\nI think we can be friends.\pTake this and fish, young friend!$

label: FuchsiaCity_House2_Text_OhThatsDisappointing
text: Oh…\nThat's so disappointing…$

label: FuchsiaCity_House2_Text_ReceivedGoodRod
text: {PLAYER} received a GOOD ROD from\nthe FISHING GURU's brother.$

label: FuchsiaCity_House2_Text_YouHaveNoRoomForGift
text: Oh, no!\pI had a gift for you, but you have\nno room for it!$

label: FuchsiaCity_House3_Text_ComeAgainToForgetOtherMoves
text: Come again if there are other\nmoves to be forgotten.$

label: FuchsiaCity_House3_Text_MonHasForgottenMoveCompletely
text: It worked to perfection!\p{STR_VAR_1} has forgotten\n{STR_VAR_2} completely.$

label: FuchsiaCity_House3_Text_MonOnlyKnowsOneMove
text: {STR_VAR_1} seems to know only one\nmove…$

label: FuchsiaCity_House3_Text_MonsMoveShouldBeForgotten
text: Hm! {STR_VAR_1}'s {STR_VAR_2}?\nThat move should be forgotten?$

label: FuchsiaCity_House3_Text_NoEggShouldKnowMoves
text: What?\nNo EGG should know any moves.$

label: FuchsiaCity_House3_Text_WhichMonShouldForgetMove
text: Which POKéMON should forget a\nmove?$

label: FuchsiaCity_House3_Text_WhichMoveShouldBeForgotten
text: Which move should be forgotten?$

label: FuchsiaCity_House3_Text_WouldYouLikeToForgetMove
text: Uh…\nOh, yes, I'm the MOVE DELETER.\pI can make POKéMON forget their\nmoves.\pWould you like me to do that?$

label: FuchsiaCity_Mart_Text_DidYouTryXSpeed
text: Did you try X SPEED?\nIt speeds up a POKéMON in battle.$

label: FuchsiaCity_Mart_Text_DontTheyHaveSafariZonePennants
text: Don't they have any pennants\npromoting the SAFARI ZONE?\pHow about some paper lanterns?\nAren't there even any calendars?$

label: FuchsiaCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_CantBecomeGoodTrainerWithOneMon
text: You can't become a good TRAINER\nwith just one strong POKéMON.\pBut raising many POKéMON evenly\nis no easy task, either.$

label: FuchsiaCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_PokemonLeagueWestOfViridian
text: There's a narrow trail west of\nVIRIDIAN CITY.\pIt goes to the POKéMON LEAGUE HQ.\nThe HQ governs all TRAINERS.$

label: FuchsiaCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_VisitSafariZoneForPokedex
text: If you're working on a POKéDEX,\nvisit the SAFARI ZONE.\pAll sorts of rare POKéMON breed\nthere.$

label: FuchsiaCity_SafariZone_Entrance_Text_CallYouOnPAWhenYouRunOut
text: We'll call you on the PA when you\nrun out of time or SAFARI BALLS.\pWell, I'll wish you the best of\nluck!$

label: FuchsiaCity_SafariZone_Entrance_Text_CatchFairShareComeAgain
text: Did you catch your fair share?\nCome again!$

label: FuchsiaCity_SafariZone_Entrance_Text_ExplainSafariZone
text:
The SAFARI ZONE actually has
four zones in it.\pEach zone has different kinds of
POKéMON, even some rare ones.\pUse the supplied SAFARI BALLS to
catch them.\pYou can also throw BAIT or ROCKS
besides the SAFARI BALLS.\pIf you throw BAIT, the POKéMON
becomes less likely to flee, but\lharder to catch.\pIf you throw ROCKS, the POKéMON
becomes more likely to flee, but\leasier to catch.\pWhen you run out of time or SAFARI
BALLS, it's game over for you!$

label: FuchsiaCity_SafariZone_Entrance_Text_FirstTimeAtSafariZone
text: Hi! Is it your first time here at\nthe SAFARI ZONE?$

label: FuchsiaCity_SafariZone_Entrance_Text_GoingToLeaveSafariZoneEarly
text: Are you going to leave the\nSAFARI ZONE early?$

label: FuchsiaCity_SafariZone_Entrance_Text_GoodLuck
text: Good luck!$

label: FuchsiaCity_SafariZone_Entrance_Text_OkayPleaseComeAgain
text: Okay.\nPlease come again!$

label: FuchsiaCity_SafariZone_Entrance_Text_OopsNotEnoughMoney
text: Oops!\nNot enough money!$

label: FuchsiaCity_SafariZone_Entrance_Text_PlaySafariGameFor500
text: For just ¥500, you can play the\nSAFARI GAME.\pYou can roam the wide-open safari\nand catch what you like.\pWould you like to play?$

label: FuchsiaCity_SafariZone_Entrance_Text_PlayerReceived30SafariBalls
text: {PLAYER} received 30 SAFARI BALLS\nfrom the attendant.$

label: FuchsiaCity_SafariZone_Entrance_Text_PleaseReturnSafariBalls
text: Please return any SAFARI BALLS\nyou may have left.$

label: FuchsiaCity_SafariZone_Entrance_Text_SorryYoureARegularHere
text: Sorry, you're a regular here!$

label: FuchsiaCity_SafariZone_Entrance_Text_ThatllBe500WeOnlyUseSpecialBalls
text: That'll be ¥500, please!\pWe only use a special kind of \nPOKé BALLS here.$

label: FuchsiaCity_SafariZone_Entrance_Text_WelcomeToSafariZone
text: Welcome to the SAFARI ZONE!$

label: FuchsiaCity_SafariZone_Office_Text_CouldntUnderstandWarden
text: WARDEN SLOWPOKE came in, but\nI couldn't understand him.\pI think he's got a speech problem!$

label: FuchsiaCity_SafariZone_Office_Text_NicknamedWardenSlowpoke
text: We nicknamed the WARDEN\n“SLOWPOKE.”\pYou know, he has that vacant look\nlike a SLOWPOKE.$

label: FuchsiaCity_SafariZone_Office_Text_PrizeInSafariZone
text:
WARDEN SLOWPOKE is running a
promotion campaign right now.\pTry to get to the farthest corner
of the SAFARI ZONE.\pIf you can make it, you'll win a
very convenient prize.$

label: FuchsiaCity_SafariZone_Office_Text_WardenIsVeryKnowledgeable
text: WARDEN SLOWPOKE is very\nknowledgeable about POKéMON.\pHe even has some fossils of rare,\nextinct POKéMON.$

label: FuchsiaCity_Text_ChanseySign
text: Name: CHANSEY\nCatching one is all up to chance.$

label: FuchsiaCity_Text_CitySign
text: FUCHSIA CITY\nBehold! It's Passion Pink!$

label: FuchsiaCity_Text_DidYouTrySafariGame
text: Did you try the SAFARI GAME?\pThere are some rare POKéMON that\ncan only be caught there.$

label: FuchsiaCity_Text_GymSign
text: FUCHSIA CITY POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: KOGA\lThe Poisonous Ninja Master$

label: FuchsiaCity_Text_ItemBallInThere
text: That item ball in there…\nWere you wanting that?\pMe, too!\n…Huh? That's a POKéMON?$

label: FuchsiaCity_Text_KabutoSign
text: Name: KABUTO\nAn extremely rare POKéMON that was\lregenerated from a fossil.$

label: FuchsiaCity_Text_KangaskhanSign
text: Name: KANGASKHAN\pA maternal POKéMON that raises its\nyoung in a pouch on its belly.$

label: FuchsiaCity_Text_LaprasSign
text: Name: LAPRAS\nAKA the king of the seas.$

label: FuchsiaCity_Text_MyFatherIsGymLeader
text: My father is the GYM LEADER of\nthis town.\pI'm training to use POISON POKéMON\nas well as my father.$

label: FuchsiaCity_Text_OmanyteSign
text: Name: OMANYTE\nAn extremely rare POKéMON that was\lregenerated from a fossil.$

label: FuchsiaCity_Text_SafariGameSign
text: SAFARI GAME\nPOKéMON-U-CATCH!$

label: FuchsiaCity_Text_SafariZoneSign
text: POKéMON PARADISE\nSAFARI ZONE$

label: FuchsiaCity_Text_SafariZoneZooInFront
text: The SAFARI ZONE has a zoo in front\nof the entrance.\pOut back is the SAFARI GAME for\ncatching POKéMON.$

label: FuchsiaCity_Text_SlowpokeSign
text: Name: SLOWPOKE\nFriendly and very slow moving.$

label: FuchsiaCity_Text_VoltorbSign
text: Name: VOLTORB\nThe very image of a POKé BALL.$

label: FuchsiaCity_Text_WardensHomeSign
text: SAFARI ZONE\nWARDEN'S HOME$

label: FuchsiaCity_Text_WheresSara
text: ERIK: Where's SARA?\nI said I'd meet her here.$

label: FuchsiaCity_WardensHouse_Text_AhHowheeHoHoo
text: Ah howhee ho hoo!\nEef ee hafahi ho!$

label: FuchsiaCity_WardensHouse_Text_ExplainStrength
text:
WARDEN: Inside HM04 you'll find
STRENGTH.\pIt lets POKéMON move boulders when
you're outside of battle.\pOh yes, did you find the SECRET
HOUSE in the SAFARI ZONE?$

label: FuchsiaCity_WardensHouse_Text_GaveGoldTeethToWarden
text: {PLAYER} gave the GOLD TEETH\nto the WARDEN.$

label: FuchsiaCity_WardensHouse_Text_HM04NoRoom
text: There is no room for the WARDEN's\ngift. You keep the GOLD TEETH\lfor now.$

label: FuchsiaCity_WardensHouse_Text_HeOhayHeHaHoo
text: Ha?\nHe ohay heh ha hoo ee haheh!$

label: FuchsiaCity_WardensHouse_Text_HifFuffHefifoo
text: WARDEN: Hif fuff hefifoo!\pHa lof ha feef ee hafahi ho.\nHeff hee fwee!$

label: FuchsiaCity_WardensHouse_Text_MonPhotosFossilsOnDisplay
text: POKéMON photos and fossils are on\ndisplay.$

label: FuchsiaCity_WardensHouse_Text_OldMonMerchandiseOnDisplay
text: Old POKéMON merchandise is on\ndisplay.$

label: FuchsiaCity_WardensHouse_Text_ReceivedHM04FromWarden
text: {PLAYER} received HM04\nfrom the WARDEN.$

label: FuchsiaCity_WardensHouse_Text_ThanksLassieGiveYouSomething
text:
WARDEN: Thank you, lassie!
You're a real lifesaver!\pNo one could understand a word
that I said, not a one!\pI was too ashamed to show my face
around the OFFICE, even.\pLet me give you something for your
trouble.$

label: FuchsiaCity_WardensHouse_Text_ThanksSonGiveYouSomething
text:
WARDEN: Thanks, son!
You're a real lifesaver!\pNo one could understand a word
that I said, not a one!\pI was too ashamed to show my face
around the OFFICE, even.\pLet me give you something for your
trouble.$

label: FuchsiaCity_WardensHouse_Text_WardenPoppedInHisTeeth
text: The WARDEN popped in his teeth!$

label: GabbyAndTy_Text_CleverItemSkillsInterviewAgain
text: The last time we battled, your item\nskills cleverly did us in.\pAnyway, what do you think?\nDo you want to be interviewed again?$

label: GabbyAndTy_Text_DescribeYourFeelings
text: You will?\nThank you!\pOkay, I need you to describe your\nfeelings about our battle, but it\lhas to be short and sweet. Go!$

label: GabbyAndTy_Text_DontGiveUpKeepingEyeOut
text: GABBY: Oh…\pOkay, but don't give up!\nWe'll be keeping an eye out for you!$

label: GabbyAndTy_Text_GabbyDefeat
text: GABBY: That was an intense battle!\nDid you get all that on camera?$

label: GabbyAndTy_Text_GabbyDefeatFirstTime
text: GABBY: My eyes didn't lie!\nI did discover an astonishing TRAINER!$

label: GabbyAndTy_Text_GabbyIntro
text: GABBY: Oh! You're {PLAYER}! Hi!\nDo you remember us from last time?\pCan you show us how much stronger\nyou've become? Okay, cue interview!$

label: GabbyAndTy_Text_GabbyNotEnoughMons
text: GABBY: Is there a strong TRAINER\nanywhere with a lot of POKéMON?$

label: GabbyAndTy_Text_GabbyPreFirstBattle
text: GABBY: Oh! We've just spotted a tough-\nlooking TRAINER here of all places!\pOkay, roll camera!\nLet's get this interview.$

label: GabbyAndTy_Text_GiveUsAnInterviewThisTime
text:
GABBY: Wow, you are something!\pYou've gotten a lot stronger--a lot--
since we last battled.\pWe were right about you when we
spotted you as a hot TRAINER.\pSo, anyway, what do you think?
Are you willing to give us an interview\lthis time?$

label: GabbyAndTy_Text_InterviewAgain
text: Anyway, what do you think?\nDo you want to be interviewed again?$

label: GabbyAndTy_Text_KeepingAnEyeOutForYou
text: GABBY: We'll be keeping an eye out\nfor you!$

label: GabbyAndTy_Text_PerfectWellBeSeeingYou
text:
GABBY: Mmm, yeah!
That's the perfect clincher!\pI get the feeling that this will make
a great TV show.\pThere's a chance that they'll air this
on TV, so make sure to look for us!\pOkay!
We'll be seeing you!$

label: GabbyAndTy_Text_QuoteFromLastInterview
text: GABBY: “{STR_VAR_1}!”\pRemember? That's the quote you gave\nus as the battle clincher last time.\pI never, ever forget stuff like that!$

label: GabbyAndTy_Text_TyDefeat
text: TY: Yep, I got it all.\nThat whole battle's on camera.$

label: GabbyAndTy_Text_TyDefeatFirstTime
text: TY: Yep, we sure spotted a hot TRAINER.\nThis is a huge scoop for us!$

label: GabbyAndTy_Text_TyIntro
text: TY: Hey, lookie here!\nI remember you!\pI'll get this battle all on this\nhere camera!$

label: GabbyAndTy_Text_TyNotEnoughMons
text: TY: Do you only have the one POKéMON\nand that's it?\pIf you had more POKéMON, it'd make for\nbetter footage, but…$

label: GabbyAndTy_Text_TyPostBattle
text: TY: You're a natural!\nGot me some prime footage right here!$

label: GabbyAndTy_Text_TyPreFirstBattle
text: TY: Hey, lookie here! A tough-looking\nTRAINER here, of all places!\lCamera's rolling!$

label: GabbyAndTy_Text_WeLookedRespectableInterviewAgain
text: The last time we battled, we managed\nto look respectable.\pAnyway, what do you think?\nDo you want to be interviewed again?$

label: GabbyAndTy_Text_WhoAreYouInterview
text:
GABBY: Awesome! Awesome!
Who are you?!\pI knew we were onto something wild
when we spotted you!\pOh, please let me explain. We travel
around everywhere interviewing all\lsorts of TRAINERS.\pSo, would you give us a bit of your time
for an interview?$

label: GabbyAndTy_Text_YouStompedUsInterviewAgain
text: The last time we battled, you stomped\nus before we could brace ourselves…\pAnyway, what do you think?\nDo you want to be interviewed again?$

label: GabbyAndTy_Text_YouThrewABallAtUsInterviewAgain
text:
The last time we battled, didn't you
throw a POKé BALL at us?\pWe were shocked! So we told everyone,
just everyone, about it!\pAnyway, what do you think?
Do you want to be interviewed again?$

label: GraniteCave_1F_Text_ExplainFlash
text:
Teach that hidden move FLASH to
a POKéMON and use it.\pIt lights up even the inky darkness
of caves.\pBut, to use it, you need the GYM BADGE
from DEWFORD's POKéMON GYM.$

label: GraniteCave_1F_Text_GetsDarkAheadHereYouGo
text:
Hey, you.
It gets awfully dark ahead.\lIt'll be tough trying to explore.\pThat guy who came by earlier…
STEVEN, I think it was.\pHe knew how to use FLASH, so he ought
to be all right, but…\pWell, for us HIKERS, helping out those
that we meet is our motto.\pHere you go, I'll pass this on to you.$

label: GraniteCave_StevensRoom_Text_CouldBecomeChampionLetsRegister
text:
STEVEN: Your POKéMON appear quite
capable.\pIf you keep training, you could even
become the CHAMPION of the POKéMON\lLEAGUE one day. That's what I think.\pI know, since we've gotten to know each
other, let's register one another in\lour POKéNAVS.\p… … … … … …$

label: GraniteCave_StevensRoom_Text_ImStevenLetterForMe
text: My name is STEVEN.\pI'm interested in rare stones,\nso I travel here and there.\pOh?\nA LETTER for me?$

label: GraniteCave_StevensRoom_Text_IveGotToHurryAlong
text: Now, I've got to hurry along.$

label: GraniteCave_StevensRoom_Text_OhBagIsFull
text: Oh, your BAG is full…\nThat's too bad, then.$

label: GraniteCave_StevensRoom_Text_RegisteredSteven
text: Registered STEVEN\nin the POKéNAV.$

label: GraniteCave_StevensRoom_Text_ThankYouTakeThis
text:
STEVEN: Okay, thank you.\pYou went through all this trouble to
deliver that. I need to thank you.\pLet me see…
I'll give you this TM.\pIt contains my favorite move,
STEEL WING.$

label: IndigoPlateau_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_AgathaWhuppedUs
text:
AGATHA's GHOST-type POKéMON are
horrifically terrifying in toughness.\pI took my FIGHTING-type POKéMON
and raised them to the max.\pI went at AGATHA feeling pretty
confident, but she whupped us.\pThat old lady's also got a really
short fuse, too.\pIt doesn't take anything to get
that scary lady hollering.$

label: IndigoPlateau_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_FaceEliteFourGoodLuck
text: From here on, you face the\nELITE FOUR one by one.\pIf you win, a door opens to the\nnext TRAINER. Good luck!$

label: IndigoPlateau_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_GymGuyAdvice
text:
Yo!
Champ in the making!\pAt the POKéMON LEAGUE, you will
face the ELITE FOUR all in a row.\pIf you lose, you have to start all
over again!\pThis is it!
Go for it!$

label: IndigoPlateau_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_LancesCousinGymLeaderFarAway
text: Maybe becoming an ELITE FOUR\nmember is in the blood.\pFrom what I've heard, LANCE has\na cousin who's a GYM LEADER\lsomewhere far away.$

label: IndigoPlateau_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_LoreleiIsAbsentClosedForTimeBeing
text:
I am so sorry, but you've wasted
your time coming here.\pLORELEI of the ELITE FOUR is
absent, you see.\pAs a result, the POKéMON LEAGUE is
closed for the time being.$

label: InsideOfTruck_Text_BoxPrintedWithMonLogo
text: The box is printed with a POKéMON logo.\pIt's a POKéMON brand moving and\ndelivery service.$

label: JaggedPass_Text_AutumnDefeat
text: Hmm…\nWhat went wrong?$

label: JaggedPass_Text_AutumnIntro
text: I climb this hill every day.\nI have confidence in my strength!$

label: JaggedPass_Text_AutumnPostBattle
text: What is that odd rock protrusion\na little up the hill from here?$

label: JaggedPass_Text_BoulderShakingInResponseToEmblem
text: Oh! This boulder is shaking in response\nto the MAGMA EMBLEM!$

label: JaggedPass_Text_DianaDefeat
text: Ohhh, no!\nThe ground is too bumpy…$

label: JaggedPass_Text_DianaIntro
text: This place isn't your casual hike.\nIt's not suited for a picnic.$

label: JaggedPass_Text_DianaPostBattle
text: Did you know?\pSome people cleverly ride their\nbicycles up this horribly bumpy pass.$

label: JaggedPass_Text_DianaPostRematch
text: I'll forget about losing and just\nenjoy this bumpy hike.$

label: JaggedPass_Text_DianaRegister
text: Will you ever be back in this area?\nIf you do return, I'd like a rematch.$

label: JaggedPass_Text_DianaRematchDefeat
text: I only lost because the ground is\ntoo bumpy!$

label: JaggedPass_Text_DianaRematchIntro
text: Picnics are fun wherever you go.\nJust like POKéMON!$

label: JaggedPass_Text_EricDefeat
text: Losing left me bitter!$

label: JaggedPass_Text_EricIntro
text: MT. CHIMNEY's JAGGED PASS…\pNow this is what I've always wanted\nin a mountain.\pThis jagged bumpiness…\nIt rocks my soul!$

label: JaggedPass_Text_EricPostBattle
text: Yes, I did lose at POKéMON…\pBut, when it comes to the love of\nthe mountains, I have you beat!$

label: JaggedPass_Text_EthanDefeat
text: It was all over while we were still\ntrying to find a good footing…$

label: JaggedPass_Text_EthanIntro
text: JAGGED PASS is hard to walk on.\nIt's a good place for training.$

label: JaggedPass_Text_EthanPostBattle
text: If I had an ACRO BIKE, I'd be able to\njump ledges.$

label: JaggedPass_Text_EthanPostRematch
text: I should get an ACRO BIKE from RYDEL\nin MAUVILLE CITY…$

label: JaggedPass_Text_EthanRegister
text: When I get more used to this bumpiness,\nI'll be sure to win!\pCan you register me in your POKéNAV?$

label: JaggedPass_Text_EthanRematchDefeat
text: It's still not easy to battle on this\nbumpy ground…$

label: JaggedPass_Text_EthanRematchIntro
text: I got used to this bumpiness.\nI sing while I climb now.$

label: JaggedPass_Text_GoWhereverYouWant
text: Okay, oh-kay!\nI admit it--you're strong!\pDon't worry about me.\nGo wherever you want!$

label: JaggedPass_Text_GruntDefeat
text: Urrrgh…\pI should've ducked into our HIDEOUT\nright away…$

label: JaggedPass_Text_GruntIntro
text: Wah!\nWhat are you doing here?\pWhat am I doing in a place like this?\pWhat business is it of yours?$

label: JaggedPass_Text_JulioDefeat
text: I feel like I'm falling apart…$

label: JaggedPass_Text_JulioIntro
text: Aiyeeh! It's awfully scary to shoot\ndown the mountain in one go!$

label: JaggedPass_Text_JulioPostBattle
text: My bicycle bounced around so much,\nmy rear end's sore…$

label: Kecleon_Text_SomethingUnseeable
text: Something unseeable is in the way.$

label: Kecleon_Text_UseDevonScopeMonAttacked
text: {PLAYER} used the DEVON SCOPE.\pAn invisible POKéMON became completely\nvisible!\pThe startled POKéMON attacked!$

label: Kecleon_Text_WantToUseDevonScope
text: Something unseeable is in the way.\pWant to use the DEVON SCOPE?$

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_AxleDefeat
text: I hope FLANNERY flames you good!$

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_AxleIntro
text: I'm trying to relieve my stress.\nDon't come along and stress me out!$

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_AxlePostBattle
text: Haaah… Whew…\pIf you spend too much time buried in\nhot sand, it tuckers you out…$

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_ColeDefeat
text: I'm blinded by sweat in my eyes…$

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_ColeIntro
text: Owowowowow!\nYikes, it's hot!$

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_DanielleDefeat
text: Oh, but you're too strong.$

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_DanielleIntro
text: Um…\nOkay, I'll battle with you.$

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_DaniellePostBattle
text: I'm going to be a pretty and strong\nTRAINER just like FLANNERY.$

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_ExplainHeatBadgeTakeThis
text:
If you have a HEAT BADGE, all POKéMON
up to Level 50, even those you get in\ltrades from other people, will obey\lyou completely.\pAnd, it lets POKéMON use the HM move
STRENGTH outside of battle.\pThis is a token of my appreciation.
Don't be shy about taking it!$

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_ExplainOverheat
text: That TM50 contains OVERHEAT.\pThat move inflicts serious damage on\nthe opponent.\pBut it also sharply cuts the SP. ATK\nof the POKéMON using it. It might not\lbe suitable for longer battles.$

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_FlanneryDefeat
text:
Oh…
I guess I was trying too hard…\pI… I've only recently become
a GYM LEADER.\pI tried too hard to be someone
I'm not.\pI have to do things my natural way. If
I don't, my POKéMON will be confused.\pThanks for teaching me that.
For that, you deserve this.$
