label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_FlanneryIntro
text:
Welcome… No, wait.\pPuny TRAINER, how good to see you've
made it here!\pI have been entrusted with the…
No, wait.\pI am FLANNERY, and I'm the GYM
LEADER here!\pUh…
Dare not underestimate me, though\lI have been LEADER only a short time!\pWith skills inherited from my grand-
father, I shall, uh…demonstrate the\lhot moves we have honed on this land!$

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_FlanneryPostBattle
text: Your power reminds me of someone…\pOh! I know! You battle like NORMAN,\nthe GYM LEADER of PETALBURG.$

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_FlanneryPostRematch
text:
FLANNERY: I lost the match,
but I'm completely satisfied.\pIt's not often I get to enjoy a battle
this heated.\pLet's have another one like this
again sometime!$

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_FlanneryPreRematch
text:
FLANNERY: Losing a battle isn't going
to deflate me.\pI love POKéMON.
I love to battle.\lAnd… I love this GYM!\pLet's exchange superhot moves
in another battle!$

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_FlanneryRematchDefeat
text: Whew!\nOn the verge of eruption!$

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_FlanneryRematchNeedTwoMons
text:
FLANNERY: Losing a battle isn't going
to deflate me.\pI love POKéMON.
I love to battle.\lAnd… I love this GYM!\pLet's exchange superhot moves
in another battle!\pOh, wait. Do you only have one POKéMON
that can battle?\pI hate to say this, but when you come
see me, bring at least two POKéMON.$

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_GeraldDefeat
text: It didn't burn hotly enough…$

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_GeraldIntro
text: Can your POKéMON withstand\n392-degree heat?$

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_GeraldPostBattle
text: The temperature of magma is\n392 degrees.\pYour POKéMON beat me, so they should\neasily survive in magma.$

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_GymGuideAdvice
text:
Hey, how's it going, CHAMPION-
bound {PLAYER}?\pLAVARIDGE's GYM LEADER FLANNERY
uses FIRE-type POKéMON.\pHer passion for POKéMON burns stronger
and hotter than a volcano.\pDon't get too close to her--you'll burn!
Hose her down with water and then\lgo for it!$

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_GymGuidePostVictory
text: Yow! That was a scorching-hot battle!$

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_GymStatue
text: LAVARIDGE TOWN POKéMON GYM$

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_GymStatueCertified
text: LAVARIDGE TOWN POKéMON GYM\pFLANNERY'S CERTIFIED TRAINERS:\n{PLAYER}$

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_ReceivedHeatBadge
text: {PLAYER} received the HEAT BADGE\nfrom FLANNERY.$

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_RegisteredFlannery
text: Registered GYM LEADER FLANNERY\nin the POKéNAV.$

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_B1F_Text_EliDefeat
text: Well, it seems to me I lost without\never being in control.$

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_B1F_Text_EliIntro
text: As much as I love mountains,\nI especially love volcanoes.$

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_B1F_Text_EliPostBattle
text: I stay here because I became a fan\nof FLANNERY's power.\pHehehehe.$

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_B1F_Text_JaceDefeat
text: It's so hot, and yet my heart is\nclutched by ice…$

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_B1F_Text_JaceIntro
text: Come on, get with it!\nLet's go before my feelings cool!$

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_B1F_Text_JacePostBattle
text: The way the battling spirit burns\nwithin you, you may stand a chance\lagainst our LEADER.$

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_B1F_Text_JeffDefeat
text: Something didn't go right.$

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_B1F_Text_JeffIntro
text: See how the flames blaze wildly?\nThey flare in anticipation of my win!$

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_B1F_Text_JeffPostBattle
text: Well, so what? I say so what?\nI can walk on hot coals barefoot!\p…Don't even think about trying it!$

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_B1F_Text_KeeganDefeat
text: Play with fire, and be burned…$

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_B1F_Text_KeeganIntro
text: You must be getting tired by now.\nYou'd like to rest in the hot sand,\lwouldn't you?\pBut you should know that maintaining\nyour willpower is an important ability\lfor all TRAINERS.$

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_B1F_Text_KeeganPostBattle
text: Your skill is real…\nBut our LEADER FLANNERY is strong.\pIf you don't watch yourself, you'll be\nburned seriously.$

label: LavaridgeTown_HerbShop_Text_ExplainCharcoal
text:
That CHARCOAL I gave you, it's used
for making herbal medicine.\pIt also does wonders when held by
a POKéMON.\pIt intensifies the power of FIRE-type
moves.$

label: LavaridgeTown_HerbShop_Text_HerbalMedicineWorksButMonWillDislike
text: Herbal medicine works impressively well.\nBut your POKéMON will dislike you for it.\lIt must be horribly bitter!$

label: LavaridgeTown_HerbShop_Text_WelcomeToHerbShop
text: Welcome to the HERB SHOP, home of\neffective and inexpensive medicine!$

label: LavaridgeTown_HerbShop_Text_YouveComeToLookAtHerbalMedicine
text: You've come to look at herbal medicine\nin LAVARIDGE?\pThat's rather commendable.\pI like you! Take this!$

label: LavaridgeTown_House_Text_WifeWarmingEggInHotSprings
text: My wife's warming an EGG in the hot\nsprings. This is what she told me.\pShe left two POKéMON with the DAY CARE.\nAnd they discovered that EGG!$

label: LavaridgeTown_House_Text_Zigzagoon
text: ZIGZAGOON: Pshoo!$

label: LavaridgeTown_Mart_Text_LocalSpecialtyOnMtChimney
text: On MT. CHIMNEY's peak, there's a local\nspecialty that you can buy only there.\pGive it to a POKéMON--it will be elated.$

label: LavaridgeTown_Mart_Text_XSpeedFirstStrike
text: Use X SPEED to add to a POKéMON's\nSPEED in battle.\pThat will help it get in the first\nstrike--a decided advantage!$

label: LavaridgeTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_HotSpringCanInvigorate
text: It's sort of magical how just sitting\nin a hot-spring pool can invigorate.\pI wish I could let my POKéMON\nsoak, too.$

label: LavaridgeTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_TrainersPokemonSpendTimeTogether
text: I think POKéMON get closer to their\nTRAINERS if they spend time together.\pThe longer the better.\nThat's what I think.$

label: LavaridgeTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_TrainersShouldRestToo
text: Hohoho! Hey, kid, you can reach\nthe hot springs from here.\pIf POKéMON are getting rest, so too\nshould their TRAINERS.$

label: LavaridgeTown_Text_AsYouWishThen
text: As you wish, then…\pIf you have a change of heart about\nhatching this EGG, I will be here.$

label: LavaridgeTown_Text_BatheInHotSpringsEveryDay
text: I bathe in the hot springs every day.\pI want to become a beautiful and strong\nGYM LEADER like FLANNERY.$

label: LavaridgeTown_Text_BrendanExplainGoGogglesChallengeDad
text:
BRENDAN: Keep those with you if you're
planning on going into that desert near\lROUTE 111.\pThere should be some POKéMON that
are exclusively desert-dwellers.\lYou might look around for those.\pAs for me…
I'm considering challenging NORMAN,\lthe GYM LEADER of PETALBURG.\pUnlike you, {PLAYER}, your dad looks like
he really is tough.\pSee you around!$

label: LavaridgeTown_Text_BrendanNiceBadgesTakeThis
text:
BRENDAN: {PLAYER}, hey, it's been a while.
How's it going?\pHmm…
That's a decent collection of BADGES.\pAll right, then.
You may as well have this.$

label: LavaridgeTown_Text_EverySoOftenEggFoundAtDayCare
text: Every so often, an EGG will be found at\nthe POKéMON DAY CARE.\pOr at least that's how the rumor goes.$

label: LavaridgeTown_Text_GymSign
text: LAVARIDGE TOWN POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: FLANNERY\l“One with a fiery passion that burns!”$

label: LavaridgeTown_Text_HaveEggWillYouTakeIt
text:
I have here an EGG.\pI'd hoped to hatch it by covering it in
hot sand by the hot springs.\lBut that doesn't seem to be enough…\pI've heard it would be best if it were
kept together with POKéMON and\lcarried about.\pYou are a TRAINER, yes?
And your POKéMON radiate vitality.\pSo, what say you?
Will you take this EGG to hatch?$

label: LavaridgeTown_Text_HerbShopSign
text: POKéMON HERB SHOP\n“Bitter taste--better cure!”$

label: LavaridgeTown_Text_HopeYoullWalkPlentyWithEgg
text: Good! I hope you'll walk plenty with\nthis here EGG!$

label: LavaridgeTown_Text_HotSpringsClaims
text: They're claiming that these hot springs\nare good for calming nervous tension,\lrelieving aching muscles, solving\lromantic problems, and attracting\lmoney…$

label: LavaridgeTown_Text_HotSpringsNeverRunDry
text: We draw as much hot water as we need,\nand yet the hot springs never run dry.\pIsn't it magical?\pThese hot springs appear near active\nvolcanoes. Veins of water under the\lground are heated by magma to well up\las hot springs.$

label: LavaridgeTown_Text_IfPokemonInHotSprings
text: If people put POKéMON in hot springs,\nit might be seriously strange.\pWhy, it might be an electric bath, or\na bubble bath, or even a lava bath…$

label: LavaridgeTown_Text_MayExplainGoGogglesChallengeDad
text:
MAY: With those GO-GOGGLES, you'll
have no trouble getting through the\ldesert near ROUTE 111.\pBut, wow, {PLAYER}{KUN}…
Challenging GYMS…\pYou're trying hard because you don't
want to lose to me, I bet!\p{PLAYER}{KUN}, I think I should challenge
your dad in PETALBURG GYM.\pSee you again!$

label: LavaridgeTown_Text_MayNiceBadgesTakeThis
text:
MAY: {PLAYER}{KUN}! Long time no see!\pOh? While I visited the hot springs,
you got the LAVARIDGE GYM BADGE.\pYou must have collected
good POKéMON…\lNo, I believe you raised some.\pI guess it would be okay for you to
have this.$

label: LavaridgeTown_Text_NoRoomForThisEgg
text: Oh? You've too many POKéMON.\nThere's no room for this EGG…$

label: LavaridgeTown_Text_OhYouLikeHotSprings
text: Oh, you like hot springs, do you?\pThat's surprising for one as young\nas you.$

label: LavaridgeTown_Text_PokemonNippedBackside
text: Being buried in this hot sand is…\nSigh…\pSo warm and heavenly…\pEh? Gyaah! Ouch!\pA POKéMON nipped my backside!$

label: LavaridgeTown_Text_ReceivedTheEgg
text: {PLAYER} received the EGG.$

label: LavaridgeTown_Text_TownSign
text: LAVARIDGE TOWN\p“POKéMON CENTER HOT SPRINGS\nAn excellent place for relaxing!”$

label: LavenderTown_House1_Text_Cubone
text: CUBONE: Kyarugoo!$

label: LavenderTown_House1_Text_GhostOfPokemonTowerIsGone
text: The ghost of POKéMON TOWER is\ngone!\pSomeone must have soothed its\nrestless spirit!$

label: LavenderTown_House1_Text_RocketsKilledCubonesMother
text: Those horrible ROCKETS!\nThey deserve no mercy!\pThat poor CUBONE's mother…\pIt was killed trying to escape from\nTEAM ROCKET.$

label: LavenderTown_House2_Text_CritiqueWhichMonsNickname
text: Which POKéMON's nickname should\nI critique?$

label: LavenderTown_House2_Text_FromNowOnShallBeKnownAsName
text: Done! From now on, this POKéMON\nshall be known as {STR_VAR_1}!\pIt is a better name than before!\nHow fortunate for you!$

label: LavenderTown_House2_Text_FromNowOnShallBeKnownAsSameName
text: Done! From now on, this POKéMON\nshall be known as {STR_VAR_1}!\pIt looks no different from before,\nand yet, this is vastly superior!\pHow fortunate for you!$

label: LavenderTown_House2_Text_GiveItANicerName
text: {STR_VAR_1}, is it?\nThat is a decent nickname!\pBut, would you like me to give it\na nicer name?\pHow about it?$

label: LavenderTown_House2_Text_ISeeComeVisitAgain
text: I see.\nDo come visit again.$

label: LavenderTown_House2_Text_ThatIsMerelyAnEgg
text: Now, now.\nThat is merely an EGG!$

label: LavenderTown_House2_Text_TrulyImpeccableName
text: {STR_VAR_1}, is it?\nThat is a truly impeccable name!\pTake good care of {STR_VAR_1}!$

label: LavenderTown_House2_Text_WantMeToRateNicknames
text: Hello, hello!\nI am the official NAME RATER!\pWant me to rate the nicknames of\nyour POKéMON?$

label: LavenderTown_House2_Text_WhatShallNewNicknameBe
text: Ah, good. Then, what shall the new\nnickname be?$

label: LavenderTown_Mart_Text_DidYouBuyRevives
text: Did you buy some REVIVES?\nThey revive any fainted POKéMON!$

label: LavenderTown_Mart_Text_SearchingForStatRaiseItems
text:
I'm searching for items that raise
the stats of POKéMON.\pThey're effective over the course
of a single battle.\pX ATTACK, X DEFEND, X SPEED, 
and X SPECIAL are what I'm after.\pDo you know where I can get them?$

label: LavenderTown_Mart_Text_TrainerDuosCanChallengeYou
text: Sometimes, a TRAINER duo will\nchallenge you with two POKéMON\lat the same time.\pIf that happens, you have to send\nout two POKéMON to battle, too.$

label: LavenderTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_CubonesMotherKilledByRockets
text: I saw CUBONE's mother trying to\nescape from TEAM ROCKET.\pShe was killed trying to get away…$

label: LavenderTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_HearMrFujiNotFromAroundHere
text: I recently moved to this town.\pI hear that MR. FUJI's not from\nthese parts originally, either.$

label: LavenderTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_PeoplePayForCuboneSkulls
text: You know how the CUBONE species\nwears skulls, right?\pPeople will pay a lot for one.$

label: LavenderTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_RocketsDoAnythingForMoney
text: TEAM ROCKET will do anything for\nthe sake of money!\pThere is no job too dirty, no deed\ntoo heinous, no crime too wicked!$

label: LavenderTown_Text_DoYouBelieveInGhosts
text: Do you believe in ghosts?$

label: LavenderTown_Text_GhostsAppearedInTower
text: Ghosts appeared in POKéMON TOWER.\pI think they're the spirits of\nPOKéMON that the ROCKETS killed.$

label: LavenderTown_Text_JustImaginingWhiteHand
text: Hahaha, I guess not.\pThat white hand on your shoulder…\nI'm just imagining it.$

label: LavenderTown_Text_PokemonTowerSign
text: POKéMON TOWER\nBecalm the Spirits of POKéMON$

label: LavenderTown_Text_SilphScopeNotice
text: New SILPH SCOPE!\nMake the Invisible Plain to See!\pSILPH CO.$

label: LavenderTown_Text_SoThereAreBelievers
text: Really?\nSo there are believers…$

label: LavenderTown_Text_TownKnownAsMonGraveSite
text: This town is known as the grave\nsite of POKéMON.\pMemorial services are held in\nPOKéMON TOWER.$

label: LavenderTown_Text_TownSign
text: LAVENDER TOWN\nThe Noble Purple Town$

label: LavenderTown_Text_VolunteerPokemonHouse
text: LAVENDER VOLUNTEER\nPOKéMON HOUSE$

label: LavenderTown_VolunteerPokemonHouse_Text_ExplainPokeFlute
text: Upon hearing the POKé FLUTE,\nsleeping POKéMON will spring awake.\pTry using it on POKéMON that are\nsleeping obstacles.$

label: LavenderTown_VolunteerPokemonHouse_Text_GrandPrizeDrawingClipped
text: POKéMON FAN MAGAZINE\nMonthly Grand Prize Drawing!\pThe application form is…\pGone! It's been clipped out.\nSomeone must have applied already.$

label: LavenderTown_VolunteerPokemonHouse_Text_HasPokeFluteHelpedYou
text: MR. FUJI: Has my POKé FLUTE\nhelped you?$

label: LavenderTown_VolunteerPokemonHouse_Text_IdLikeYouToHaveThis
text:
MR. FUJI: {PLAYER}…\pYour POKéDEX quest is one that
requires strong dedication.\pWithout deep love for POKéMON,
your quest may fail.\pI'm not sure if this will help you,
but I'd like you to have it.$

label: LavenderTown_VolunteerPokemonHouse_Text_MonsNiceToHug
text: It's so warm!\nPOKéMON are so nice to hug.$

label: LavenderTown_VolunteerPokemonHouse_Text_MrFujiLooksAfterOrphanedMons
text: This is really MR. FUJI's house.\pHe's really kind.\pHe looks after abandoned and\norphaned POKéMON.$

label: LavenderTown_VolunteerPokemonHouse_Text_MrFujiWasPrayingForCubonesMother
text: MR. FUJI had been praying alone\nfor CUBONE's mother.$

label: LavenderTown_VolunteerPokemonHouse_Text_MustMakeRoomForThis
text: You must make room for this!$

label: LavenderTown_VolunteerPokemonHouse_Text_Nidorino
text: NIDORINO: Gaoo!$

label: LavenderTown_VolunteerPokemonHouse_Text_PokemonMagazinesLineShelf
text: POKéMON magazines line the shelf.\pPOKéMON INSIDER…\pPOKéMON FAN…$

label: LavenderTown_VolunteerPokemonHouse_Text_Psyduck
text: PSYDUCK: Gwappa!$

label: LavenderTown_VolunteerPokemonHouse_Text_ReceivedPokeFluteFromMrFuji
text: {PLAYER} received a POKé FLUTE\nfrom MR. FUJI.$

label: LavenderTown_VolunteerPokemonHouse_Text_WhereDidMrFujiGo
text: That's odd, MR. FUJI isn't here.\nWhere'd he go?$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_AllSeemToUseDifferentMoves
text: Even when TRAINERS enter the same\nkind of POKéMON, they all seem to use\ldifferent moves for appeals.\pIt's just like the way people have\ndifferent styles for battling.$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_AreYouEnjoyingThisContest
text: JUDGE: Are you enjoying this CONTEST?\pCome back with three friends, and\nall of you may enter a CONTEST!$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_AreYouEnteringBeautyContest
text: MC: Are you entering the BEAUTY\nCONTEST, too? Good luck!$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_BeautyContestStage
text: BEAUTY CONTEST STAGE\nBE ALLURED BY BEAUTIFUL POKéMON!$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_CantWinOnBeautyAlone
text: You can't always win on just beauty\nalone.\pYou have to groom your POKéMON so\nit's nice and glossy like mine.$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_ComeOnDear
text: Come on, dear. Go for it!\nYour POKéMON is the best!$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_CuteContestStage
text: CUTENESS CONTEST STAGE\nBE CHARMED BY CUTE POKéMON!$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_DontAppreciateCuteLeechLife
text: Oh, dear, no!\pMy darling ZUBAT's LEECH LIFE is so\ncute I kept using it over and over!\pBut these mean people don't appreciate\nit at all!$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_EnteredBunchOfContests
text:
I've entered a bunch of CONTESTS,
so I'm seeing how things work.\pIf you're in a COOLNESS CONTEST,
cool moves go over as appeals.\pBut smart moves and cute moves
don't go over well, for instance.$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_EnteredWrongContest
text:
Ayayayay…
I entered the wrong CONTEST.\pI entered this tough POKéMON in
the SMARTNESS CONTEST…\pCome on, wow them with a smart-looking
ROCK SMASH.$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_EveryPokemonPristineBeauty
text: JUDGE: Ah, every POKéMON here is\na model of pristine beauty!\pWhy, I almost forgot to score them!$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_EyesWillBeGluedToMyBeauty
text: A POKéMON this beautiful…\nThere isn't another one like it.\pEveryone's eyes will be glued to\nmy beauty.$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_GanderAtAllThosePrettyPokemon
text: Wahahahah!\pWill you take a gander at all those\npretty POKéMON!\lI just love this sort of glitz!$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_GiveItBestSmartAppeal
text: MC: Okay, SMART POKéMON and their\nTRAINERS, are you ready?!\pGive it your best showing!\nLet's appeal!$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_IfMonPullsSmartMoveNext
text: There it is!\pIf my POKéMON pulls a smart move next,\nthe audience's excitement will peak!$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_InTheMiddleOfContest
text: MC: Uh-oh! Hello!\nWe're in the middle of a CONTEST!\pPlease enter at our registration\ncounter and come out, okay?$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_IsntThisPlaceHumongous
text: Whoa, isn't this place humongous!\pThe tension in the air… It's not\nlike a CONTEST hall in the sticks.$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_JudgeWontSeeAuroraBeam
text: This AURORA BEAM is so dazzling,\nthe JUDGE won't be able to see it.\pUh, wait a second…\nThat'll be meaningless, then!$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_ManWhoWonEarlierHadPokeblocks
text: That young man who won earlier had\na whole bunch of different {POKEBLOCK}S.\pCan you win if you had that many\nof those things?$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_MyAzurillWasDistracted
text: Oh, no… My sweet AZURILL was\ndistracted by another POKéMON.$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_MyChildIsInContest
text: My child is in this CONTEST.$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_MyMonAppealSoMuchCuter
text: Everyone's POKéMON are very cute.\pHowever, if my POKéMON were to make\na cute appeal…\pI'm sure that it would be so much \ncuter than the others.$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_NeverWonBattleButContest
text: My POKéMON has never won in a battle,\nbut put it in a CONTEST and look out!$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_OverdidGrooming
text: Waaaah!\pI brushed and groomed my POKéMON\ncarefully for this CONTEST…\pBut I overdid it…\nMy POKéMON's coat turned all scraggly…\pWhat should I do?$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_PetalDanceIsMarvel
text: My POKéMON's PETAL DANCE is a marvel\nof elegance.\pI won't let anyone disturb its\nperformance.$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_PokemonLooksLikeYoungerMe
text: This pretty POKéMON looks just like\nme when I was younger.\pRight when I said that, my husband\nspewed the coffee he was drinking.\pDid I say something funny?$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_PokemonSmarterThanTrainers
text: I think the POKéMON look smarter\nthan their TRAINERS. By a lot.$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_RaisedMonToBeSmart
text: I've spent many a year, and all my\nwisdom besides, raising this POKéMON\lto be smart.\pIt won't be easily bested by some\nyoung pup's POKéMON.\pMy dear wife, are you seeing this?$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_SmartContestStage
text: SMARTNESS CONTEST STAGE\nBE IMPRESSED BY SMART POKéMON!$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_StillLoveSmartnessContests
text: When all's said and done, I still love\nSMARTNESS CONTESTS.\pThat intellectual green color…\nIt's so… So… Cool.$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_SuchCharmingCuteAppeals
text: JUDGE: Oh, such charming and cute\nappeals!\pOh, my goodness! What a perfectly\nadorable WATER SPORT appeal!$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_ThatGirlThereIsCutest
text: I think that girl over there is\nthe cutest of the lot.\pWhat's that? They're judging\nPOKéMON by their looks?$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_TodayWonSmartnessContest
text: This POKéMON won the BEAUTY CONTEST\nhere before.\pWell, guess what? Today, I made it\nwin a SMARTNESS CONTEST!\pMy abilities scare even me…$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_WantCuteMonOfMyOwn
text: Ohh, seeing all these cute POKéMON,\nthey make we want to get my own!\pI'm going to go catch some!$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_WinBeautyContestMakesMeHappy
text: You know, if I win at a BEAUTY\nCONTEST, sure it makes me\lhappy. More than usual, anyway.$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_YoureBeautifulGrandpa
text: Kiyaaah! You're beautiful, Grandpa!$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_AlreadyWonEnterAnyway
text: Oh, but that RIBBON…\pYour POKéMON has won this CONTEST\nbefore, hasn't it?\pWould you like to enter it in this\nCONTEST anyway?$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ComeBackForPrizeLater
text: Please come back for your prize\nlater on.$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ComeThroughHere
text: Please come in through here.\nGood luck!$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ContestBeginShortly
text: The CONTEST will begin shortly.$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ContestFeastForEyes
text: Wow, coming out to a CONTEST is\na feast for these eyes!\pWould you look at all the POKéMON\nthat just scream to be painted?$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ContestReception
text: Hello!\pThis is the reception counter for\nPOKéMON CONTESTS.$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_DescribeContest
text: Oh, you will?\nThank you.\pBriefly, how would you describe the\nCONTEST you just entered?$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_EggCannotTakePart
text: I'm sorry, but an EGG cannot take part\nin a POKéMON CONTEST.$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_EggCannotTakePart2
text: I'm sorry, but an EGG cannot take part\nin a POKéMON CONTEST.$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_EnterContest1
text: Would you like to enter your POKéMON\nin our CONTESTS?$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_EnterContest3
text: Would you like to enter a CONTEST?$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_EnterWhichContest1
text: Which CONTEST would you like to enter?$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_EnterWhichContest3
text: Which CONTEST would you like to enter?$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_EnterWhichPokemon1
text: Which POKéMON would you like to enter?$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_EnterWhichPokemon3
text: Which POKéMON would you like to enter?$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_EnterWhichRank
text: Which Rank would you like to enter?$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ExplainContestRanks
text:
There are four ranks of POKéMON
CONTESTS.\pNORMAL, SUPER, HYPER, and MASTER
are the four ranks.\pIn the NORMAL Rank, any POKéMON may
enter.\pAny POKéMON that won a NORMAL Rank
CONTEST may move up to the SUPER Rank\lin the same category.\pIn the same way, a SUPER Rank winner
can move up to the HYPER Rank, and\la HYPER Rank winner can advance to\lthe MASTER Rank in the same category.\pA POKéMON that won in the MASTER Rank
may compete in the MASTER Rank as\loften as its TRAINER wants.$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ExplainContestTypes
text: There are five kinds of CONTESTS.\pCOOL, BEAUTY, CUTE, SMART, and\nTOUGH are the five categories.\pChoose the CONTEST that is right for\nthe POKéMON you plan to enter.$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ExplainContests
text:
A POKéMON CONTEST involves four
TRAINERS entering one POKéMON each\lin competitive judging.\pA CONTEST has two stages of judging,
primary and secondary.\pPrimary judging is a popularity poll
involving the audience.\pSecondary judging features appeals
by the POKéMON using their moves.\pPlan appeals carefully to earn the
most attention of the JUDGE and\lexcite the audience.\lDo your best to stand out.\pThe primary and secondary scores are
added at the end.\pThe POKéMON garnering the highest
score is declared the winner.$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ExplainEMode
text:
In E-MODE (EMERALD MODE),
a LINK CONTEST can be held with\ltwo to four players. Each player must\lhave a POKéMON Emerald Game Pak.\pThe players must be linked with each
other using Wireless Adapters or\lGBA Game Link cables.\pIf there are fewer than four players,
TRAINERS in the hall will join to fill\lthe 4-player CONTEST lineup.\pPlease be aware that E-MODE is not
available in POKéMON Ruby or Sapphire.$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ExplainGMode
text:
G-MODE (GLOBAL MODE) is specifically
for four players who are linked using\lGBA Game Link cables.\pEach player must have a POKéMON
Emerald, Ruby, or Sapphire Game Pak.\pThe CONTEST starts after all players
choose G-MODE (POKéMON Emerald) or\lenter through the 4-player reception\lcounter (POKéMON Ruby or Sapphire).$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ExplainLinkContest
text:
This is a CONTEST for two to four
players linked using a Wireless\lAdapter or a GBA Game Link cable.\pParticipants are first asked to choose
the mode they wish to enter.\pThere are two different modes.\pE-MODE (EMERALD MODE) is for
two to four players, each with a\lPOKéMON Emerald Game Pak.\pG-MODE (GLOBAL MODE) is only for
four players, each with a POKéMON\lEmerald, Ruby, or Sapphire Game Pak.\pThe players should discuss which mode
they want, then choose the same mode.\pOnce all the players have chosen
the same CONTEST in the same mode,\lthe entry registration is complete.\pAfter that, a CONTEST will start in
the usual manner.$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_FineThatsTheWayItIs
text: Oh, fine, that's the way it is.\nI will hang this in my own house.\pI'll just have to try harder next time.\nWell, be seeing you.$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_IllTakePaintingToMuseum
text:
What, really? Then, sure, I will take
this painting there right now.\pI'll give it a proper title, too.\pI hope they'll like it and consider
exhibiting this.\pPlease check if they did accept this.
Thank you!$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_InterviewRequest
text:
Oh, hello! You were in a POKéMON
CONTEST, weren't you?\lIt's easy to tell from your POKéMON.\pI'm a reporter. I'm working on a story
on POKéMON CONTESTS.\pIf I may, would you be willing to answer
a few questions?$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_LadyGaveMePokeblockCase
text: Yippee!\pThe lady at the reception counter\ngave me a case for {POKEBLOCK}S!$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_LavishedCareOnMon
text: Day in and day out, I lavished my care\non this POKéMON.\pIts condition is peaking.\nToday, victory is mine!$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_LinkContestReception
text: Welcome! This is the POKéMON CONTEST\nlink reception counter.\pYou may enter CONTESTS together with\none or more friends.$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_LookingForwardToNextContest
text: I'll be looking forward to your next\nPOKéMON CONTEST.$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_MadePokeblocksWithFamily
text: I made {POKEBLOCK}S with Mom, Dad, and\nBig Sister. They turned out great!\pI bet you can make smoother, better\n{POKEBLOCK}S if you have more people.$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_MakePokeblocksDifferentBerries
text: Make {POKEBLOCK}S and put them in there.\pWhen you make a {POKEBLOCK}, everyone\nhas to put in a different BERRY.$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_MasterRankHereICome
text: Hoo, boy… Master Rank CONTESTS,\nhere I come.\pThe world will know that my dearest\nPOKéMON is the cutest being in all\lexistence. The time has come!\lUheheheh.$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_MonInNoCondition2
text: Your POKéMON appears to be in no\ncondition to take part in a CONTEST…$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_MonInNoConditionForContest
text: Your POKéMON appears to be in no\ncondition to take part in a CONTEST…$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_MonNotQualifiedForRank
text: I'm terribly sorry, but your POKéMON\nis not qualified to compete at this\lRank yet…$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_NoWirelessAdapterInGMode
text: I'm terribly sorry.\pG-MODE does not function\nwith Wireless Adapters.\pPlease select E-MODE or try\nagain using a GBA Game Link cable.$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_NowThatWeveClearedThatUp
text: Okay, now that we've cleared that\nup…\pHello!\pThis is the reception counter for\nPOKéMON CONTESTS.$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_OkaySeeYou
text: Okay, see you!$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ParticipateAnotherTime
text: We hope you will participate another\ntime.$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_PlayerAt4PCounterUseGMode
text:
At least one player has entered using
the 4-player reception counter.\pThere must be four players connected
using a GBA Game Link cable.\pWhen the four players are ready,
select G-MODE (GLOBAL MODE),\lthen register to enter again, please.$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_PlayersChoseDifferentContest
text: You may have chosen a different\nCONTEST than another player.$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_PlayersMadeDifferentChoice
text: You may have made a different\nchoice than another player.$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_PleaseDecideLinkLeader
text: Please decide which of you will\nbecome the GROUP LEADER.\pThe other players must then choose\n“JOIN GROUP.”$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_PleaseDoShareStoryWithMe
text: Oh, too bad…\pWell, if you come across a good story,\nplease do share it with me.$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_PleaseWaitBButtonCancel
text: Please wait.\n… … B Button: Cancel$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_PokemonWonWeHavePrize
text: Congratulations! Your POKéMON is the\nCONTEST winner!\pWe have your prize right here.\nPlease, right this way!$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ProgressWillBeSaved
text: Before entering a CONTEST, your\nprogress will be saved.$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_PutTheRibbonOnMon
text: {PLAYER} put the RIBBON on\n{STR_VAR_1}.$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ReceivedARibbon
text: {PLAYER} received a RIBBON.$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ReceptionDontHavePokeblockCase
text:
Hello!\pThis is the reception counter for
POKéMON CONTESTS.\pOh? It appears that you don't have
a {POKEBLOCK} CASE yet.\pIn that case, we need to provide you
with this!$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ShouldITakePaintingToMuseum
text:
What do you think? I'm confident in
what I've done, but do you like it?\pA work of this caliber, it wouldn't look
out of place in an art museum.\pHuh? An art museum really is looking
for paintings?\pDo you think I should take this there?$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_TakeHomeButIdLikeToTakeToMuseum
text: Oh… Then, I guess I'll just take\nthis home with me…\pBut, you know, I would like to take\nthis to the art museum… Okay?$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_TakeMementoOfPainting
text: Oh, that's right!\pAs a memento of me painting your\nPOKéMON, please take this.$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ThatsAllForInterview
text:
I see!\pSo that's how you imagine the concept
of “{STR_VAR_2}” to be.\pThank you!
You've given me some good ideas.\pI think I can write a good story on
POKéMON CONTESTS now.\pMaybe, just maybe, this story will even
make it to television.\lI hope you'll look forward to it!$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ToughContestIsExtreme
text: The TOUGHNESS CONTEST is like\nextreme, man!\pThose muscular appeals…\nCascading sweat… I swoon!$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_TransmissionError
text: Transmission error…$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_Transmitting
text: Transmitting…$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_WhatImageWhenYouHearX
text:
Ah, I see.
That's a very edifying comment.\pYou get a good feel for what
the CONTEST was like.\pI've got one last question.\pWhen you hear the word “{STR_VAR_2},”
what image do you get?$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_WhichContestMode
text: Which CONTEST MODE would you like\nto enter?$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_WhichTopic1
text: Which topic would you like?$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_WhichTopic2
text: Which topic would you like?$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_WholeVarietyOfPokemonHere
text: You can see a whole variety of\nPOKéMON here.\pThat's why I make this place a regular\npart of my daily stroll.$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_YourMonIsEntryNum4
text: Okay, your POKéMON will be entered\nin this CONTEST.\pYour POKéMON is Entry No. 4.\nThe CONTEST will begin shortly.$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_YourMonIsEntryNumX
text: Your POKéMON will be entered in\nthe CONTEST.\pYour POKéMON is Entry No. {STR_VAR_2}.$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_YourPokemonSpurredMeToPaint
text: Congratulations!\pI did a painting of your POKéMON to\ncommemorate its victory…\pWell, your POKéMON's appeals were\nso fantastic, it spurred me into\lpainting better than I usually do.\lLook, see?$

label: LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_1F_Text_BetterGetWorkingOnGuestsDinner
text:
Oh, sorry, sorry!
I was too involved in watching TV.\pOh, yes. A big group of guests arrived
a little while ago.\pThey booked in as GAME FREAK,
so I guess they must make games.\pUh-oh, I'd better get working on
their dinner!$

label: LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_1F_Text_CantSeeTheTV
text: Hey, down in front!\nI can't see the TV!$

label: LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_1F_Text_GuestsDoubledByMascot
text:
Hm, so they doubled the guests by
using POKéMON as attractions?\pHm, well, maybe I should make a cute
POKéMON our inn's mascot.\pI wonder if that will attract more
guests to stay with us?$

label: LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_1F_Text_HeardAquaHideoutBusted
text:
Oh, sorry, sorry!
I was too involved in watching TV!\pI heard that someone busted
the TEAM AQUA HIDEOUT.\pThanks to that, we just booked
a reservation from a big group.\pIt was a company called… Uh…
GAME something…$

label: LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_1F_Text_HouseSittingMonCaughtBurglar
text:
Amazing! A house-sitting POKéMON
caught a burglar?\pThat's something. If we had a tough
POKéMON as a security guard…\pWe would be able to provide our guests
with greater safety.$

label: LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_1F_Text_MonFoundLostItem
text:
Amazing! You're telling me a POKéMON
found someone's lost item?\pThat's something. If we had some smart
POKéMON like that…\pWe could recover anything that our
guests mislaid…$

label: LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_1F_Text_NoGuestsWithTeamAqua
text: Oh, sorry, sorry!\nI was too involved in watching TV!\pSince that TEAM AQUA came to town,\nthe tourists have been staying away.$

label: LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_2F_Text_ContestsDoTakeStrategy
text: SCOTT: I think it does take strategy\nto win a CONTEST.\pDevising CONTEST strategies is one way\nof becoming a better TRAINER, I'd say.$

label: LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_2F_Text_FilledPokedexGiveYouThis
text:
Wow! That's awesome!
Yep, it's totally awesome!\pThis POKéDEX is completely filled!
You really must love POKéMON!\pI'm so impressed!\pLet me give you something in
recognition of your feat!$

label: LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_2F_Text_GirlsAreCute
text: The girl TUBERS, they're cute, hey?\nTo battle against a cute TUBER…\pWhoop, it's so awesome!\pAnd the TWINS! Aren't they cute?\nA 2-on-2 battle with TWINS…\pWhoop, it's unbearably fun!$

label: LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_2F_Text_ImTheGraphicArtist
text: I'm the GRAPHIC ARTIST! Aren't the\nPOKéMON of HOENN interesting?$

label: LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_2F_Text_ImTheProgrammer
text: Me? You're talking to me?\nI'm the PROGRAMMER.\pI wonder what the SLOTS are\nlike here.$

label: LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_2F_Text_NeverLeaveWithoutGameBoy
text: You never know when and where\npeople will challenge you.\pThat's why I never leave home without\nmy GAME BOY ADVANCE.$

label: LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_2F_Text_SeaBreezeTicklesHeart
text: The sea breeze tickles my heart.\nIt feels wonderful here!$

label: LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_2F_Text_ShowMeCompletedDex
text:
I'm the GAME DESIGNER.\pOh, is that right?
You're working on a POKéDEX?\pIt's tough trying to complete it,
but don't give up.\pIf you do complete it, please come
show me.$

label: LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_2F_Text_SnoozingPreferBattles
text:
SCOTT: … … … … …
… … … … … Zzz…\p… … … … … Huh?!
Oh, sorry, sorry! I was snoozing!\pI came to check out this POKéMON
CONTEST thing.\pI have to admit, it does look quite
entertaining, but…\pConsider me a purist--I prefer
battles and tough TRAINERS.\pBut that's just me.\p{PLAYER}{KUN}, I hope you'll enjoy everything
like the GYMS, CONTESTS, BATTLE TENT,\lthe whole works!$

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStoreRooftop_Text_BeenWaitingForClearOutSale
text: Yes! I've been waiting a long time for\nthis clear-out sale.\pThey have items that you can only get\nhere. I'm going to load up, that I am!$

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStoreRooftop_Text_BoneDryThirsty
text: Ohh… I'm bone-dry thirsty!$

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStoreRooftop_Text_CanOfDrinkDroppedDown
text: Clang!\pA can of {STR_VAR_1} dropped down.$

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStoreRooftop_Text_DecidedAgainstBuyingDrink
text: Decided against buying a drink.$

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStoreRooftop_Text_ExtraCanOfDrinkDroppedDown
text: Clang!\pScore! An extra can of {STR_VAR_1}\ndropped down!$

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStoreRooftop_Text_NotEnoughMoney
text: Not enough money…$

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStoreRooftop_Text_SetDatesForClearOutSales
text: Don't they have set dates for their\nclear-out sales?\pI watch TV, but they never show any\ncommercials.$

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStoreRooftop_Text_WhichDrinkWouldYouLike
text: It's a VENDING MACHINE.\nWhich drink would you like?$

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_1F_Text_AllFiveDigitsMatched
text: Oh, my goodness, all five digits\nmatched!\pYou've won the jackpot prize!\nYou've won the {STR_VAR_1}!$

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_1F_Text_Azumarill
text: AZUMARILL: Maririroo!$

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_1F_Text_BuyingSomethingForAzumarill
text: I'm buying something for my AZUMARILL\nas a reward for winning a CONTEST.$

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_1F_Text_ComeBackTomorrow
text: Please come back tomorrow.$

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_1F_Text_FloorNamesSign
text: 1F: SERVICE COUNTER\n    LOTTERY CORNER\p2F: TRAINER'S ZONE\p3F: BATTLE COLLECTION\p4F: TM CORNER\p5F: POKé DOLL FLOOR\pROOFTOP: ROOFTOP PLAZA$

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_1F_Text_FourDigitsMatched
text: Four digits matched, so you win the\nfirst prize!\lYou've won the {STR_VAR_1}!$

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_1F_Text_IBuyAllSortsOfThings
text: Whenever I come to the DEPARTMENT\nSTORE, I always end up buying all sorts\lof things because it's so fun.$

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_1F_Text_LotteryCornerDrawTicket
text:
This is the POKéMON LOTTERY CORNER.\pAll shoppers at our DEPARTMENT STORE
get to draw a POKéMON LOTO TICKET.\pIf the LOTO TICKET's number matches
the ID number of any of your POKéMON,\lyou will receive a fabulous gift.\pWould you like to draw a POKéMON
LOTO TICKET?$

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_1F_Text_MomBuyingMeFurniture
text: Today, my mom is going to buy me some\nnice furniture.$

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_1F_Text_NoNumbersMatched
text: I'm sorry.\nNone of the numbers matched.$

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_1F_Text_NoRoomForThis
text: Oh?\nYou seem to have no room for this.\pPlease make room in your BAG and\nlet me know.$

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_1F_Text_PleasePickTicket
text: Please pick a LOTO TICKET.\n…{PAUSE 15}{PAUSE 15}{PAUSE 15}{PAUSE 15}…{PAUSE 15}{PAUSE 15}{PAUSE 15}{PAUSE 15}…{PAUSE 15}{PAUSE 15}{PAUSE 15}{PAUSE 15}$

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_1F_Text_PleaseVisitAgain
text: Please do visit again.$

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_1F_Text_PleaseVisitAgain2
text: Please do visit again.$

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_1F_Text_PrizeWeveBeenHolding
text: {PLAYER}?\nYes, I've been expecting you.\pThis is the prize we've been holding\nfor you.$

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_1F_Text_ThreeDigitsMatched
text: Three digits matched, so you win the\nsecond prize!\lYou've won the {STR_VAR_1}!$

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_1F_Text_TicketMatchesPCMon
text: Congratulations!\pThe ID number of your PC-boxed\n{STR_VAR_1} matches your\lLOTO TICKET's number!$

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_1F_Text_TicketMatchesPartyMon
text: Congratulations!\pThe ID number of your team's\n{STR_VAR_1} matches your\lLOTO TICKET's number!$

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_1F_Text_TicketNumberIsXPleaseWait
text: The LOTO TICKET number is {STR_VAR_1}.\pI need to run a check on this number\nto see if it matches any of your\lPOKéMON's ID numbers. Please wait.$

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_1F_Text_TwoDigitsMatched
text: Two digits matched, so you win the\nthird prize!\lYou've won the {STR_VAR_1}!$

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_1F_Text_WelcomeToDeptStore
text: Welcome to LILYCOVE DEPARTMENT STORE.$

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_2F_Text_GoodGiftForHusband
text: My husband is waiting at home.\nWhat would make a good gift for him?$

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_2F_Text_LearnToUseItemsProperly
text: Learn to use items properly.\nThat's basic, really.$

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_2F_Text_StockUpOnItems
text: I'm leaving on a long journey soon.\nI need to stock up on items.$

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_3F_Text_GaveCarbosToSpeedUpMon
text: I gave a CARBOS to my POKéMON,\nand its SPEED went up.$

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_3F_Text_ItemsBestForTougheningPokemon
text: For quickly toughening up POKéMON,\nitems are the best.\pPROTEIN boosts ATTACK,\nand CALCIUM raises SP. ATK.$

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_3F_Text_WantMoreEndurance
text: I want my POKéMON to have more\nendurance.\pI'm trying to decide whether to raise\nDEFENSE with IRON, or SP. DEF with ZINC.$

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_4F_Text_AttackOrDefenseTM
text: Hmm…\pAn attacking move…\nOr a defensive move…\pIt's no easy matter to decide which TM\nmoves should be taught to POKéMON…$

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_4F_Text_FiftyDifferentTMs
text: There are so many different kinds of\nTM moves.\pA catalog I read said there are fifty\ndifferent kinds.$

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_4F_Text_PokemonOnlyHaveFourMoves
text: I'd like to get all the different TMs,\nbut a POKéMON learns only four moves.$

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_5F_Text_ClosedRooftopForWeather
text: I think they closed the rooftop\nbecause the weather is wild today.$

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_5F_Text_GettingDollInsteadOfPokemon
text: I'm not big enough to raise POKéMON,\nso I'm getting a cute DOLL instead.$

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_5F_Text_PlaceFullOfCuteDolls
text: This place is full of cute DOLLS.\pI should buy some for me, instead of\njust for my children.$

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_5F_Text_SellManyCuteMatsHere
text: They sell many cute MATS here.\pI wonder which one I should get?\nMaybe I'll buy them all…$

label: LilycoveCity_Harbor_Text_BattleFrontierItIs
text: BATTLE FRONTIER it is, then!$

label: LilycoveCity_Harbor_Text_FerryUnavailable
text: I beg your pardon?\nYou're looking for a ship?\pI'm sorry, the ferry service isn't\navailable at present…$

label: LilycoveCity_Harbor_Text_FlashTicketWhereTo
text: {PLAYER} flashed the TICKET.\pPerfect! That's all you need!\pAnd where would you like to go?$

label: LilycoveCity_Harbor_Text_MayISeeYourTicket
text: Hello, are you here for the ferry?\nMay I see your TICKET?$

label: LilycoveCity_Harbor_Text_PleaseBoard
text: Please board the ferry and wait for\ndeparture.$

label: LilycoveCity_Harbor_Text_SailAnotherTime
text: Please sail with us another time!$

label: LilycoveCity_Harbor_Text_SailorFerryAvailable
text: The ferry S.S. TIDAL is finally in\noperation.\pThe folks at the SHIPYARD in SLATEPORT\nmust've worked extra hard.\pWell, it's my turn to get busy now!$

label: LilycoveCity_Harbor_Text_SailorFerryUnavailable
text: Until they finish making the ferry,\nwe sailors have nothing to do…\pI wish they'd get a move on, the folks\nat the SHIPYARD in SLATEPORT.$

label: LilycoveCity_Harbor_Text_SlateportItIs
text: SLATEPORT CITY it is, then!$

label: LilycoveCity_Harbor_Text_WhereWouldYouLikeToGo
text: Then, where would you like to go?$

label: LilycoveCity_House1_Text_Kecleon
text: KECLEON: Ruroro?$

label: LilycoveCity_House1_Text_PokemonPartnersNotTools
text: POKéMON are partners to people.\nThey aren't our tools.\pUnfortunately, there are some people\nwho fail to understand that…$

label: LilycoveCity_House2_Text_NotAwakeYetHaveThis
text: Huh? What? What's that?\pI'm not near awake yet…\nYou can have this…$

label: LilycoveCity_House2_Text_SleepIsEssential
text: Yawn…\pSleep is essential for good health…\nSleep and regain health…$

label: LilycoveCity_House3_Text_ExplainPokeblocks
text:
Oh, good! You're a smart soul!
This is a bit long, so listen up!\pAre you ready?\pIf you look at {POKEBLOCK}S, you should see
that they are rated on how they feel.\pThe lower the feel rating,
the better it is. Don't forget this!\pA good {POKEBLOCK} has a low feel
rating and a high level.\pA POKéMON can eat more good
{POKEBLOCK}S than ordinary ones, too.\pAnd this is important.\pIf you want to make smooth {POKEBLOCK}S,
use different kinds of BERRIES.\pDon't be stingy--the kinds of BERRIES
affect the smoothness of {POKEBLOCK}S.\pAnd another thing.\pThe more people blending BERRIES,
the smoother the {POKEBLOCK}S.\pThat's why you should talk to other
people and make {POKEBLOCK}S together.\pThat's about all you need to know to
make good {POKEBLOCK}S.\pIf everyone had POKéMON they love,
smooth {POKEBLOCK}S, and a loving family,\lthe world would be a happier place.\pDon't give up, dear!$

label: LilycoveCity_House3_Text_GoingToEnterContest
text: I want to brag about how tough my\nPOKéMON is, so we're going to enter\la CONTEST together.$

label: LilycoveCity_House3_Text_GoingToWinMultiBattles
text: We're having MULTI BATTLES, but I know\nI'm going to win.$

label: LilycoveCity_House3_Text_HappyToHaveQuadruplets
text: When my wife gave birth to quadruplets,\nyou bet I was shocked.\pBut, now, seeing them play together,\nit makes me happy.$

label: LilycoveCity_House3_Text_LearnFromMasterOfPokeblocks
text:
Oh, my, my! Are you traveling alone?
But you're so young! Good for you!\pI'm sure my kids could learn a thing
or two from you!\pMe? I'm a master of {POKEBLOCK}S.\pIf I get serious just a little, why,
I can concoct great {POKEBLOCK}S.\pWould you like to learn from me,
a master of {POKEBLOCK}S?$

label: LilycoveCity_House3_Text_LikeMixingAtRecordCorner
text: We like mixing stuff at\nthe RECORD CORNER.\pBut what gets mixed up?$

label: LilycoveCity_House3_Text_MakePokeblocksWithBerryBlender
text: We're going to make super {POKEBLOCK}S\nwith a BERRY BLENDER!$

label: LilycoveCity_House3_Text_OhAreYouSure
text: Oh? Are you sure?\pYou shouldn't always try to do\neverything by yourself, dear!$

label: LilycoveCity_House4_Text_MysteriesAtBottomOfSea
text: This planet's biggest mysteries are\nat the bottom of the sea.\pSomebody said that, but I don't know…$

label: LilycoveCity_House4_Text_UnderwaterTrenchMossdeepSootopolis
text: There's a deep underwater trench\nbetween MOSSDEEP and SOOTOPOLIS.\pThat's what someone told me, anyway.$

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_AimToSeeGreatPaintings
text: I aim to see many great paintings\nhere and learn from them.\pI have this dream of one day having\nmy artwork exhibited here.$

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_BigPokeBallCarvedFromStone
text: It's a big POKé BALL carved from\na black stone.\pIt was apparently used in festivals\nin the olden days.$

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_CuratorHasBeenCheerful
text: Lately, the CURATOR has been\nunusually cheerful.\pI bet something good happened for him.\nDefinitely.$

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_ExcellentCanYouComeWithMe
text: Ah, excellent!\nYou do like paintings!\pThen, may I ask you to come with me?$

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_HaveYouAnInterestInPaintings
text: Oh? I do believe that you seem to\nbe a POKéMON TRAINER.\pHave you an interest in paintings,\ntoo?$

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_HeardMuseumGotNewPaintings
text: I'd heard that this ART MUSEUM got\nin some new paintings.\pSo, naturally I hurried over.\pAre the new paintings up on\nthe second floor?$

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_HonoredYoudVisitInSpiteOfThat
text: I see…\pI'm honored that you would visit\nus in spite of that.$

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_ImCuratorHaveYouViewedOurPaintings
text:
I'm the CURATOR of this MUSEUM of
fine arts.\pIt's heartening to see someone so
young as you in our MUSEUM.\pHave you viewed our collection of
paintings already?$

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_MuseumTouristDestination
text:
The ART MUSEUM has become a favorite
tourist destination.\pIt's great for LILYCOVE…
No, great for the HOENN region!\pThis is what I've heard--a lone TRAINER
procured all the paintings upstairs.$

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_MustntForgetLoveForFineArts
text: Battling with POKéMON is fun,\nI'll grant you that.\pBut one mustn't forget our love for\nthe fine arts.$

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_NotDisturbYouTakeYourTime
text: Ah, then let me not disturb you.\nPlease, do take your time.$

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_OddLandscapeFantasticScenery
text: It's an odd landscape with bizarre\nand fantastic scenery.$

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_PaintingOfBeautifulWoman
text: It's a painting of a beautiful, smiling\nwoman with a POKéMON on her lap.$

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_PaintingOfBerries
text: It's a delicious-looking painting\nof BERRIES.\pThis painting could make you hungry!$

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_PaintingOfGrassPokemon
text: It's a painting of GRASS POKéMON\nswaying in a breeze.\pThey appear to be enjoying the wind's\ngentle caress.$

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_PaintingOfLegendaryPokemon
text: It's a painting of a legendary POKéMON\nfrom long ago.\pThe artist painted this from\nimagination.$

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_StoneTabletWithAncientText
text: It's a huge stone tablet inscribed\nwith POKéMON and dense text in the\lsmall characters of an ancient,\lunreadable language.$

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_ThisLadyIsPretty
text: This lady is pretty!\nShe's like Mommy!$

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_ThisMuseumIsInspiration
text: This ART MUSEUM… Well, you could\nsee many fantastic paintings.\pAnd the CURATOR is a wonderful person.\pAmong artists like myself, this MUSEUM\nis an inspiration.$

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_ThisPokemonIsAdorable
text: This POKéMON is adorable!\nJust like our little boy!$

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_VeryOldPainting
text: It's a very old painting.\nThe paint is peeling here and there.$

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_WelcomeToLilycoveMuseum
text: Welcome to LILYCOVE MUSEUM.\pPlease take the time to enjoy our\ncollection of fantastic artwork\lfeaturing POKéMON.$

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_ExplainExhibitHall
text:
As you can plainly see, there is not
a single painting on exhibit.\pHere, I don't wish to exhibit works of
so-called classical art.\pSuch classical works you can see on
our ground floor.\pI wish to exhibit work that is far
different from the classics.\pArt, after all, is not restricted to old,
famous works!\pThis exhibit hall, I wish to fill it with…\pModern and vibrant artworks of
POKéMON seemingly ready to spring\lforth into glorious life!$

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_HonorToHaveYouVisit
text: Ah, so good to see you, {PLAYER}!\pIt's an honor to have you visit us\non your busy journeys.\pPlease, relax and do enjoy your\nvisit with us.$

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_ItsBluePictureFrame
text: It's a picture frame with\nblue-colored adornments.$

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_ItsGreenPictureFrame
text: It's a picture frame with\ngreen-colored adornments.$

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_ItsPaintingOfPokemon
text: It's a painting of POKéMON.$

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_ItsPinkPictureFrame
text: It's a picture frame with pink-colored\nadornments.$

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_ItsRedPictureFrame
text: It's a picture frame with\nred-colored adornments.$

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_ItsYellowPictureFrame
text: It's a picture frame with\nyellow-colored adornments.$

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_ItsYouPlayer
text: Ah! It's you!\n{PLAYER}!$

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_KeepThisForYou
text: I will keep this for you until we\nmeet again.$

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_NewPaintingsRatherAmusing
text: Well… So this is where they show\nthe topical POKéMON paintings.\pI see, these new paintings are indeed\nrather amusing.$

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_NewPaintingsSurprisedMe
text: I've been away awhile, so the new\npaintings up here surprised me.\pI wish someone would paint my POKéMON\nthis pretty.$

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_PaintingsAttractedMoreGuests
text:
Isn't this marvelous?
This collection of paintings!\pEach one of them flawless!
None better than another!\pThese paintings have attracted
more guests to our ART MUSEUM.\pSincerely, I thank you, {PLAYER}.
This is my dream come true!$

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_PleaseObtainPaintingsForExhibit
text:
I beg your pardon. I didn't intend
to monopolize the conversation.\pNow, as you are young, and yet
obviously well traveled…\pYou must encounter lively POKéMON
and works of art depicting them.\pIf you were to come across such
a painting, may we ask you to obtain\lthe artist's permission to exhibit\lit here?$

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_ThanksAddedNewPainting
text: Thanks to you, we've added a new\npainting to our collection!\pI've heard it depicts your POKéMON.\nTruly magnificent!\pThank you so very, very much!$

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_ThesePaintingsOfYourPokemon
text: Wow, is that right?\nThese paintings are of your POKéMON.\pIsn't that just the ultimate joy for\na TRAINER?$

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_ThisIsExhibitHall
text: This is our special exhibit hall.$

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_TokenOfGratitude
text: This is merely a token of my gratitude.$

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_WishToFillExhibit
text: I wish to fill this exhibit hall with\nmodern and vibrant paintings of\lPOKéMON.$

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_Text_BirdPokemonSculptureReplica
text: It's a replica of a famous sculpture.\pIt depicts an ancient BIRD POKéMON.$

text: Hm!\pYour {STR_VAR_1} doesn't seem willing\nto forget SURF.$

label: LilycoveCity_MoveDeletersHouse_Text_ComeAgain

label: LilycoveCity_MoveDeletersHouse_Text_MonHasForgottenMove

text: Which move should be forgotten?$

label: LilycoveCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_HeardAboutRottenScoundrels

label: LilycoveCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_HowManyKindsOfPokemon
text: I wonder how many kinds of POKéMON\nthere are in the world.\pIt'd be great to cross seas and\ntrade POKéMON with people far away.$

text:
Oh…\pThat's a quite {STR_VAR_1}
{STR_VAR_2}…\pIsn't it nice?
It's so dreamy…\pThank you…
I will cherish this…$

label: LilycoveCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_IWillTreasureThis

…Oh, oh, oh…\pThis is amazing!
This really is {STR_VAR_1}!\pI never knew that one {STR_VAR_2}
could be this {STR_VAR_1}!\pThank you!\pI will treasure this for the rest
of my life!$

label: LilycoveCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_PlayerGaveMeGreatThing

text:
I'll always cheer for you, {PLAYER}!

{PLAYER}.\pBecause I know you're really,

BRAWLY…\pOh, no! Wait!

I've heard the news!
You're really strong, aren't you?\pWe always argue about who is the
strongest of all TRAINERS here.\pSo when I heard about you, I decided
to be your fan!\pI hope you'll keep on battling other
tough TRAINERS.\pThat way, we'll be able to see more
of your hot, hot battles.\pThat will make the others here see
exactly how great you are.\pRemember, I'm cheering for you,
{PLAYER}!$

label: LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_HearingAboutToughNewTrainer
text:
I've been hearing things about
a tough new TRAINER.\pThis TRAINER's supposed to be beating
GYM LEADERS, even.\pDo you know anything about this
new TRAINER?$

label: LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_ICantHelpLikingBrawly

label: LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_ImPullingForYou
text: Oh!\n{PLAYER}!\pGo for it!\nI'm pulling for you!$

NORMAN battled with more power,

label: LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_NeverGoingToStopBeingTrainersFan

label: LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_NoOneCanKnockYouButTrainerStronger
text: You are really popular…\pYou're strong, and you're caring to\nPOKéMON. No one can knock you.\pBut, you know, I believe in {STR_VAR_1}.\p{STR_VAR_1} is definitely stronger!\nI'm positive!$

text: Oh, wow!\nIt's {PLAYER}!$

text: The others, they don't know that\nyou're the best of the best!\pIsn't that right, {PLAYER}?\nShow them you've got guts!$

text: I see, I see.\pThank you!\nThat's very useful to know.\pI'll share this information with other\n{STR_VAR_1} fans and discuss it.$

text: Darn it… I've been telling people\nthat {STR_VAR_1} is the best now…\pBut no one wants to listen…$

label: LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_TrainerIsReallyCoolItsJustMe
text: {STR_VAR_1} really is cool, don't\nyou think so?\pEven if it's just me, I'm going to keep\ncheering my favorite TRAINER.$

label: LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_TrainerIsStandout
text: Among the recently hot TRAINERS,\n{STR_VAR_1} is the standout.\pThat toughness, it's simply not normal.\pYou're doing okay, but you're not in\nthe same class as {STR_VAR_1}.$

text: I hate to say this, but the TRAINER\neverybody's talking about is\l{STR_VAR_1}, no question about it!\pThat TRAINER's power…\nIt's out of the ordinary.$

text: Whoa! It's {PLAYER}!\nWicked!\pWhen I grow up, I want to be strong\nlike you, {PLAYER}!$

label: LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_WeDiscussStrongestTrainers
text:
Everyone here, we're all huge fans
of POKéMON battles.\pWe discuss who we consider to be
the strongest of all TRAINERS.\pIf you were to become famous,
we might even become your fans!$

label: LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_WhatsYourOpinionOfTrainer
text: Hi, there!\pI'm a big fan of {STR_VAR_1}.\nWhat's your opinion of {STR_VAR_1}?$

text: I'm a big fan of {STR_VAR_1}.\nWhat's your opinion of {STR_VAR_1}?$

label: LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_YouAndNormanAreDifferent
text:
You're beginning to get the same
air of awe NORMAN exudes.\pBut there's something conclusively
different between you and NORMAN.\pI can't tell you what that is.
You'll have to find it yourself.$

label: LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_YouBattleAttractivelyInToughSituation
text: The tougher the situation, the more\nattractively you battle.\pI can't wait for your next battle!$

label: LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_YouChangedMyMind
text: You've changed my mind!\nYou are strong, aren't you?\pI'd like you to tell me how you managed\nto get so strong!$

label: LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_YouImpressive
text: You…\pImpressive!$

label: LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_YouShouldMeetTrainer
text: Oh, I see!\nYou should meet {STR_VAR_1} sometime.\lI'm sure you'll become a fan, too!$

label: LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_YourFatherNeverGaveUpSoKeepOnBattling
text: Even when things turned bleak,\nyour father never gave up.\pThis I know to be true.\pYou never give up even if you lose!\nSo keep on battling!$

label: LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_YoureAmazingAfterAll
text: {PLAYER}!\nYou are amazing after all!\pEver since I set eyes on you,\nI knew that you were great.\pIt looks like my eyes didn't deceive me.$

label: LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_YoureMaybeStrongerThanTrainer
text: Wow, you really are strong.\nMaybe even stronger than {STR_VAR_1}.\pBut {STR_VAR_1} needs me.\pIf I don't cheer for {STR_VAR_1},\nwho will?$

label: LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_YoureOneWeWantToWin
text: Yo, {PLAYER}!\nYou're the one we want to win!$

label: LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_YourePowerfulButNotTrueStrength
text:
It is true that you are tremendously
powerful.\pBut!
I can tell…\pThat strength cannot be considered
true strength yet!\pTrue strength is…!
… …\pActually, I have no idea, either.$

label: LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_YouveSurpassedYourFather
text: You've surpassed your own father in\nevery regard!\pI'm telling you, so there's no question\nabout it at all!$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_BecauseYoureTrainer
text: When it gets right down to it…\pIt's because you're a TRAINER!$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_BerrySuitsYou
text: When it gets right down to it…\pThe same way suits suit me perfectly,\na crisp breeze suits the sea.\pAnd you, a BERRY suits you to a “T”…\pWhy should that be so?$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_BrendanBattleMe
text: BRENDAN: Want to battle to see who's\nbeen raising POKéMON better?$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_BrendanDefeat
text: Humph…\nYou've done a lot of raising.\pThat stings a bit--I had a head start\non you as a TRAINER…$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_BrendanGoingBackToLittleroot
text: BRENDAN: I…\nI plan on going home to LITTLEROOT.\pYou know I'm helping out my dad on his\nPOKéDEX. It's coming together pretty\ldecently, so I should go show him.$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_BrendanNoConfidence
text: BRENDAN: Oh, what's the matter?\nDon't have the confidence?$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_BrendanShoppingLetsBattle
text: BRENDAN: Oh, hey, it's {PLAYER}.\pI'm running an errand for my dad.\nNo, I'm not buying any DOLLS.\pAnyways, it's been a while.\pWant to have a battle to see who's been\nraising POKéMON better?$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_BrendanWontBeBeaten
text: BRENDAN: Aww, but you know I'm not\ngoing to lose to no {PLAYER}.$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_BrendanYouGoingToBattleFrontier
text:
{PLAYER}, what are you going to do?\pAre you taking the BATTLE FRONTIER
challenge?\pOr, are you going to complete your
POKéDEX?\pSince you're that strong, you should
consider the BATTLE FRONTIER.\pHeh, if I train my POKéMON a bit more,
I'll get stronger than you, {PLAYER}.\pMaybe I should go to the BATTLE
FRONTIER.\pWell, anyway, hang in there!$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_BrendanYouGoingToCollectBadges
text: {PLAYER}, what are you going to do?\pCollect all the GYM BADGES and take\nthe POKéMON LEAGUE challenge?\pMaybe I'll do that, too…\pWell, anyway, hang in there!$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_BrendanYouGoingToPokemonLeague
text: {PLAYER}, what are you going to do?\pSince you're that strong, are you\ntaking the POKéMON LEAGUE challenge?\pHeh, even me--if I trained my POKéMON\na bit more, I should be stronger than\lyou, {PLAYER}.\pWell, anyway, hang in there!$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_ChanceToDoBigThings
text:
I'm just a GRUNT, so I don't know what
the BOSS is thinking…\pBut being on TEAM AQUA, I know I'll get
the chance to do big things!\pWh-who are you?!
I was just talking to myself!$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_CitySign
text: LILYCOVE CITY\p“Where the land ends and the\nsea begins.”$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_ContestHallInTown
text: There's a POKéMON CONTEST HALL\nright in this here town. \pThat means well-raised POKéMON will\ncome from all over the country.\pMy heart swells with excitement!$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_ContestHallSign
text: POKéMON CONTEST HALL\n“The gathering place for TRAINERS!”$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_DepartmentStoreSign
text: LILYCOVE DEPARTMENT STORE\p“Overflowing with great merchandise\nand excitement!\p“A great place to find that something\nyou need!”$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_DoYouKnowAboutBerryBlender
text: Do you know about the machine\nBERRY BLENDER?$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_DontGoNearCaveInCove
text: Hey, you!\pDon't go near the cave in the cove!\pWhy? You don't need a reason why!\nI'm an adult, so you just listen to me!$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_ExplainBerryBlender
text: It's used for making a kind of candy\ncalled a {POKEBLOCK}.\pIf you give a good {POKEBLOCK} to a POKéMON,\nits condition will improve by a lot.$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_FasterSpinBetterPokeblocks
text: People have to work together to get it\nto spin faster.\pThe faster you can make it spin, the\nbetter {POKEBLOCK}S you can get, I've heard.$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_GetLostMessingUpTraining
text: Hunh? What do you want?\pYou're messing up our training,\nso can you, like, get lost?$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_GoingToMoveDeleterForHMs
text: I'm going to teach my POKéMON some new\nmoves for entering a CONTEST.\pSo, I'm going to see the MOVE DELETER\nand make it forget HM moves.$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_HarborSign
text: LILYCOVE CITY HARBOR\p“Enjoy a delightful cruise on\nthe ferry S.S. TIDAL.”$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_HarborSignUnderConstruction
text: LILYCOVE CITY HARBOR\p“The ferry S.S. TIDAL is under\nconstruction in SLATEPORT CITY.\p“Service is scheduled to begin\nshortly.”$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_HeardTowerCalledSkyPillar
text: I heard there's a tower somewhere out\non the sea routes.\pIt's called the SKY PILLAR, I hear.$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_HoneymoonVowToSeeRarePokemon
text: On our honeymoon, we vowed to see as\nmany rare POKéMON as we can.\pSo we were delighted to see a rare\nPOKéMON as soon as we arrived.\pI mean, we are totally happy!$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_IfWorldBecomesOurs
text: If this whole wide world becomes ours,\nTEAM AQUA's, it will be a happier\lplace for POKéMON, too.$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_ImArtDealer
text: I'm an ART DEALER.\pI am a buyer and seller of fine art,\nespecially paintings.\pI've heard that the MUSEUM here has\nmagnificent works on exhibit…$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_ImFromKanto
text: I came from KANTO.\pThe HOENN region is beautiful with\nall its water and verdant nature.\pHunh? Wait a second…\pCould there be rare POKéMON that live\nonly in this area?$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_JustArrivedAndSawRarePokemon
text:
We just arrived here on our
honeymoon vacation.\pWe happened to see a DRAGON-type
POKéMON flying way up in the sky.\pDo cool POKéMON like that live in
the HOENN region?$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_MayBattleMe
text: MAY: Come on, battle with me, so I can\ncheck out your POKéMON!$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_MayDefeat
text: … … … … … … … …\pI remember the battle I had with you,\n{PLAYER}{KUN}, on ROUTE 103.\pThat battle helped you become this\nstrong, {PLAYER}{KUN}, didn't it?$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_MayGoingBackToLittleroot
text: MAY: I'm thinking of going back to\nLITTLEROOT soon.\pI've caught a decent group of POKéMON,\nand my POKéDEX is coming along, so\lI'm going home to show my dad.$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_MayNotRaisingPokemon
text: MAY: Oh, why? {PLAYER}{KUN}, haven't you\nbeen raising your POKéMON?\pThat's not a very good showing as a\nTRAINER…$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_MayShoppingLetsBattle
text:
MAY: Oh, hey?
{PLAYER}{KUN}, are you shopping, too?\pI bought a whole bunch of DOLLS and
POSTERS.\pOf course, I've also caught a lot of
POKéMON, and I'm raising them\lproperly, too.\pActually, I'm more worried if you're
raising POKéMON properly, {PLAYER}{KUN}.\pI'll battle with you, so you can show
me your POKéMON, {PLAYER}{KUN}.$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_MayWontBeBeaten
text: MAY: The POKéMON I raised won't be\nbeaten by your POKéMON, {PLAYER}{KUN}!$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_MayYouGoingToBattleFrontier
text:
{PLAYER}{KUN}, what are you going to do?\pAre you taking the BATTLE FRONTIER
challenge?\pOr, are you going to complete your
POKéDEX?\pI might've lost to you in battling,
but I'll finish my POKéDEX before you!\pSee you!$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_MayYouGoingToCollectBadges
text: {PLAYER}{KUN}, what are you going to do?\pCollect all the GYM BADGES and take\nthe POKéMON LEAGUE challenge?\pWell, while you're collecting BADGES,\n{PLAYER}{KUN}, I'm going to work on my\lPOKéDEX. I'll complete it before you!\pSee you!$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_MayYouGoingToPokemonLeague
text:
{PLAYER}{KUN}, what are you going to do?\pAre you taking the POKéMON LEAGUE
challenge?\pOr, are you going to complete your
POKéDEX?\pI might've lost to you in battling,
but I'll finish my POKéDEX before you!\pSee you!$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_MissingPokemonCameBack
text: My missing POKéMON…\nIt came back without me noticing!$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_MotelSign
text: COVE LILY MOTEL\p“Remember us as COVE LILY of\nLILYCOVE.”$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_MoveDeletersHouseSign
text: MOVE DELETER'S HOUSE\p“Unwanted POKéMON moves deleted.”$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_MovedLootIntoHideoutToday
text: Fufufu…\pWe moved more loot into our secret\nHIDEOUT today…\pWh-who are you?!\nI was just talking to myself!$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_MuseumSign
text: LILYCOVE MUSEUM\p“POKéMON Masterpiece Collection\non exhibit!”$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_MuseumSignPlayersExhibit
text: LILYCOVE MUSEUM\p“{PLAYER}'s POKéMON Collection\non exhibit!”$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_PokeblocksSuitPokemon
text: When it gets right down to it…\pThe way dignified simplicity suits me,\n{POKEBLOCK}S perfectly suit POKéMON.$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_SawTallTowerOnRoute131
text: I saw this tall tower somewhere\naround ROUTE 131.\pCould that possibly be…?$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_SeaRemainsForeverYoung
text: Even as we grow old and wrinkled,\nthe sea remains forever young with\lthe vivid brilliance of life…\pFwohoho fwohohohoho…$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_SixtyYearsAgoHusbandProposed
text: It was sixty years ago that my husband\nproposed to me here.\lThe sea remains as beautiful as ever.\pMufufufu mufufufufufu…$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_SomeonePuntedTeamAquaOut
text: Ahoy, did you know?\pSomeone punted TEAM AQUA out of\nthe way for us!\pThat got the WAILMER out of the cove,\nso we can get our boats out again.$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_SomeoneStoleMyPokemon
text: I was taking a relaxing snooze at the\nseaside inn to the sound of waves…\pWhen someone stole my POKéMON!\pWho's the abductor?\nTEAM AQUA? Is it TEAM AQUA?$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_StrangeCaveInCove
text: Have you seen that strange cave in\nthe cove at the edge of town?$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_TeamAquaBeenTrainingWailmer
text: TEAM AQUA's been training their\nWAILMER in the cove.\pWe SAILORS can't get our boats out\nto sea with them in the way!$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_TeamAquaLotGoneForGood
text: That cave in the cove…\pI didn't notice it right away,\nbut it's completely empty now.\pThat TEAM AQUA lot, they must\nhave gone away for good.$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_TeamAquaRenovatedCavern
text:
Hm, you know of the peculiar cavern
in this cove?\pThat had been a natural formation,
but then that TEAM AQUA lot came\lalong and made their renovations.\pThey call themselves
the “nature-loving TEAM AQUA”!\pBut what they do and what they say
don't match at all!$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_TrainerFanClubSign
text: POKéMON TRAINER FAN CLUB\pThe names of TRAINERS are scribbled\nall over the sign…$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_WailmerLeapOutOfWater
text: There! WAILMER!\nLeap out of the water now!$

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_BetterLeaveOthersAlone
text: You received the promised POKéMON.\nBetter leave the others alone.$

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_BirchAwayOnFieldwork
text:
Hunh? PROF. BIRCH?\pThe PROF's away on fieldwork.
Ergo, he isn't here.\pOh, let me explain what fieldwork is.\pIt is to study things in the natural
environment, like fields and mountains,\linstead of a laboratory.\pThe PROF isn't one for doing desk work.
He's the type of person who would\lrather go outside and experience\lthings than read about them here.$

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_BirchEnjoysRivalsHelpToo
text: PROF. BIRCH is studying the habitats\nand distribution of POKéMON.\pThe PROF enjoys {RIVAL}'s help, too.\nThere's a lot of love there.$

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_BirchIsntOneForDeskWork
text: The PROF isn't one for doing desk work.\nHe's the type of person who would\lrather go outside and experience\lthings than read about them here.$

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_BirchRivalGoneHome
text:
PROF. BIRCH: {RIVAL}?
Gone home, I think.\pOr maybe that kid's scrabbling around
in tall grass again somewhere…\pIf you or your POKéMON get tired,
you should get some rest at home.$

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_BookTooHardToRead
text: It's a book that's too hard to read.$

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_BrendanGotPokedexTooTakeThese
text: BRENDAN: Huh…\nSo you got a POKéDEX, too.\pWell then, here.\nI'll give you these.$

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_BrendanHaveYouGoneToBattleFrontier
text: BRENDAN: Hey, {PLAYER}!\nHave you gone out to that place,\lthe BATTLE FRONTIER?$

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_BrendanPreferCollectingSlowly
text: BRENDAN: Rather than collecting\nPOKéMON, I prefer slowly and \lsteadily raising the one I chose.$

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_BrendanTakeBreakFromFieldwork
text: BRENDAN: For the time being,\nI'm taking a break from fieldwork.\pI'll be helping out the PROF here\nfor a while.$

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_BrendanWhereShouldIGoNext
text: BRENDAN: Where should I look for\nPOKéMON next…$

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_BrendanYouCanThankMe
text: BRENDAN: I went out all over HOENN\nand checked out POKéMON.\pYou can thank me for getting\nthe NATIONAL Mode POKéDEX.\pYep, you're lucky, {PLAYER}!$

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_CanHaveAnyOneOfRarePokemon
text: PROF. BIRCH: These are rare POKéMON\nonly found in another region!\pYou can have any one of these\nthree POKéMON!$

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_CatchCoolPokemonWithPokeBalls
text:
BRENDAN: You know it's more fun to
have a whole bunch of POKéMON.\pI'm going to explore all over the place
to find different POKéMON.\pIf I find any cool POKéMON, you bet
I'll try to get them with POKé BALLS.$

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_CatchCutePokemonWithPokeBalls
text:
MAY: It's fun if you can get a lot of
POKéMON!\pI'm going to look all over the place
because I want different POKéMON.\pIf I find any cute POKéMON, I'll catch
them with POKé BALLS!$

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_CompletedDexChoosePokemon
text:
PROF. BIRCH: Oh, {PLAYER}{KUN}!
Let's have a look at your POKéDEX.\p… … … … … …
… … … … … …\pYes, there's no doubt about it.\pYou really have completed the HOENN
region's POKéDEX.\pThat's more than just impressive.\pI have a gift for you.\pConsider it my show of appreciation
for the fantastic work you've done.\pMy gift is a rare POKéMON only found
in another region!\pYou can have any one of these
three POKéMON!$

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_CountlessPokemonAwait
text: PROF. BIRCH: Countless POKéMON\nawait you!\pArgh, I'm getting the itch to get out\nand do fieldwork again!$

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_CrammedWithBooksOnPokemon
text: It's crammed with books on POKéMON.$

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_DontBeThatWay
text: PROF. BIRCH: Oh, don't be that way.\nYou should go meet my kid.$

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_ExplainPokedex
text:
PROF. BIRCH: The POKéDEX is a high-tech
tool that automatically makes a record\lof any POKéMON you meet or catch.\pMy kid, {RIVAL}, goes everywhere
with it.\pWhenever my kid catches a rare POKéMON
and records its data in the POKéDEX,\lwhy, {RIVAL} looks for me while I'm out\ldoing fieldwork, and shows me.$

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_GetRivalToTeachYou
text: PROF. BIRCH: Great!\n{RIVAL} should be happy, too.\pGet {RIVAL} to teach you what it\nmeans to be a TRAINER.$

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_GrassyPatchWaiting
text:
PROF. BIRCH: Listen, {PLAYER}{KUN}.
You've completed the HOENN POKéDEX,\lbut your POKéMON journey isn't over.\pThere is no end to the road
that is POKéMON.\pSomewhere, there is a grassy patch
that's waiting for you!$

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_GrassyPatchWaiting2
text:
PROF. BIRCH: But listen.
You've become the CHAMPION,\lbut your POKéMON journey isn't over.\pThere is no end to the road
that is POKéMON.\pSomewhere, there is a grassy patch
that's waiting for you!$

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_HeardYouBeatRivalTakePokedex
text:
PROF. BIRCH: Oh, hi, {PLAYER}{KUN}!\pI heard you beat {RIVAL} on
your first try. That's excellent!\p{RIVAL}'s been helping with my research
for a long time.\p{RIVAL} has an extensive history as
a TRAINER already.\pHere, {PLAYER}{KUN}, I ordered this for my
research, but I think you should have\lthis POKéDEX.$

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_HeyYourBagsFull
text: Hey, your BAG's full.$

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_LikeYouToHavePokemon
text:
PROF. BIRCH: So, {PLAYER}{KUN}.\pI've heard so much about you from
your father.\pI've heard that you don't have your
own POKéMON yet.\pBut the way you battled earlier,
you pulled it off with aplomb!\pI guess you have your father's blood
in your veins after all!\pOh, yes. As thanks for rescuing me,
I'd like you to have the POKéMON you\lused earlier.\p{PLAYER} received the {STR_VAR_1}!$

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_MayGotPokedexTooTakeThese
text: MAY: Oh, wow, {PLAYER}{KUN}!\nYou got a POKéDEX, too!\pThat's great! Just like me!\nI've got something for you, too!$

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_MayHaveYouGoneToBattleFrontier
text: MAY: Oh, hi, {PLAYER}{KUN}!\nHave you gone to that place,\lthe BATTLE FRONTIER?$

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_MayTakeBreakFromFieldwork
text: MAY: I think I'll take a short break\nfrom fieldwork.\pI think I'll help the PROF here for\na while.$

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_MayUpgradeSoCool
text: MAY: Eheheh!\pIt's so cool that even my POKéDEX\nis getting updated!\pIt's because you went out and caught\nso many POKéMON, {PLAYER}{KUN}!$

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_MayWhatNextImStayingHere
text:
MAY: {PLAYER}{KUN}, after this…
