label: MoveTutor_Text_DoubleEdgeTaught
text: I won't live for love anymore!\nI'll become tough!$

label: MoveTutor_Text_DoubleEdgeTeach
text:
Sigh…\pSOOTOPOLIS's GYM LEADER is really
lovably admirable.\pBut that also means I have many
rivals for his attention.\pHe's got appeal with a DOUBLE-EDGE.
I couldn't even catch his eye.\pPlease, let me teach your POKéMON
the move DOUBLE-EDGE!$

label: MoveTutor_Text_DoubleEdgeWhichMon
text: Okay, which POKéMON should I teach\nDOUBLE-EDGE?$

label: MoveTutor_Text_DynamicPunchDeclined
text: Darn! You're even making fun of me?\nPunch! Punch! Punch!$

label: MoveTutor_Text_DynamicPunchTaught
text: I want you to win at the MOSSDEEP GYM\nusing that DYNAMICPUNCH!$

label: MoveTutor_Text_DynamicPunchTeach
text:
I can't do this anymore!\pIt's utterly hopeless!\pI'm a FIGHTING-type TRAINER,
so I can't win at the MOSSDEEP GYM\lno matter how hard I try!\pArgh! Punch! Punch! Punch!
Punch! Punch! Punch!\pWhat, don't look at me that way!
I'm only hitting the ground!\pOr do you want me to teach your
POKéMON DYNAMICPUNCH?$

label: MoveTutor_Text_DynamicPunchWhichMon
text: What? You do? You're a good person!\nWhich POKéMON should I teach?$

label: MoveTutor_Text_ExplosionDeclined
text: Gaah! You're turning me down because\nI live in the country?$

label: MoveTutor_Text_ExplosionTaught
text: For a long time, I've taught POKéMON\nhow to use EXPLOSION, but I've yet\lto ignite my own EXPLOSION…\pMaybe it's because deep down,\nI would rather stay here…$

label: MoveTutor_Text_ExplosionTeach
text:
I don't intend to be going nowhere
fast in the sticks like this forever.\pYou watch me, I'll get out to the city
and become a huge hit.\pSeriously, I'm going to cause
a huge EXPLOSION of popularity!\pIf you overheard that, I'll happily
teach EXPLOSION to your POKéMON!$

label: MoveTutor_Text_ExplosionWhichMon
text: Fine! An EXPLOSION it is!\nWhich POKéMON wants to blow up?$

label: MoveTutor_Text_FuryCutterDeclined
text: We're not on the same wavelength.$

label: MoveTutor_Text_FuryCutterTaught
text: I get a thrill watching to see if\nthe move keeps hitting in succession!$

label: MoveTutor_Text_FuryCutterTeach
text:
There's a move that gets stronger
when you keep using it in a row.\pIt's a BUG-type move, and it is
wickedly cool.\pIt's called FURY CUTTER.
Want me to teach it to a POKéMON?$

label: MoveTutor_Text_FuryCutterWhichMon
text: Yay!\nShow me which POKéMON I should teach.$

label: MoveTutor_Text_MetronomeDeclined
text: Okay. I'll be here if you change\nyour mind.$

label: MoveTutor_Text_MetronomeTaught
text: When a POKéMON waggles its finger\nlike a METRONOME, all sorts of nice\lthings happen.\pWouldn't it be nice if we could\nuse it, too?$

label: MoveTutor_Text_MetronomeTeach
text:
I want all sorts of things!
But I used up my allowance…\pWouldn't it be nice if there were
a spell that made money appear when\lyou waggle a finger?\pIf you want, I can teach your POKéMON
the move METRONOME.\pMoney won't appear, but your POKéMON
will waggle a finger. Yes?$

label: MoveTutor_Text_MetronomeWhichMon
text: Okay! I'll teach it!\nWhich POKéMON should I teach?$

label: MoveTutor_Text_MimicTaught
text: MIMIC is a move of great depth.\pCould you execute it to perfection\nas well as me…?$

label: MoveTutor_Text_MimicWhichMon
text: Fwofwo! And so I shall!\nLet me see the POKéMON\lyou wish me to teach.$

label: MoveTutor_Text_RolloutDeclined
text: You don't need to be shy about it.\nLet's roll!$

label: MoveTutor_Text_RolloutTaught
text: Rolling around in the grass makes me\nhappy. Come on, let's roll!$

label: MoveTutor_Text_RolloutTeach
text:
Did you know that you can go from
here a long way in that direction\lwithout changing direction?\pI might even be able to roll
that way.\pDo you think your POKéMON will
want to roll, too?\pI can teach one the move ROLLOUT
if you'd like.$

label: MoveTutor_Text_RolloutWhichMon
text: Ehehe, sure thing! It'd be great if\nthe POKéMON looked like me.$

label: MoveTutor_Text_SleepTalkDeclined
text: Oh, fine, fine. You want to stay awake\nwith HIDDEN POWER, too…$

label: MoveTutor_Text_SleepTalkTaught
text: I've never once gotten my wife's\ncoin trick right.\pI would be happy if I got it right\neven as I SLEEP TALK…$

label: MoveTutor_Text_SleepTalkTeach
text:
Humph! My wife relies on HIDDEN
POWER to stay awake.\pShe should just take a nap like I do,
and SLEEP TALK.\pI can teach your POKéMON how to
SLEEP TALK instead. Interested?$

label: MoveTutor_Text_SleepTalkWhichMon
text: Ah, an appreciative child!\nWhich POKéMON should I teach?$

label: MoveTutor_Text_SubstituteDeclined
text: Oh, no?\pA POKéMON can make a copy of\nitself using it, you know.$

label: MoveTutor_Text_SubstituteTaught
text: We human beings should enjoy our\nown lives to the utmost!\pI hope you'll get that way, too!$

label: MoveTutor_Text_SubstituteTeach
text:
When I see the wide world from up
here on the roof…\pI think about how nice it would be
if there were more than just one me\lso I could enjoy all sorts of lives.\pOf course it's not possible.
Giggle…\pI know! Would you be interested in
having a POKéMON learn SUBSTITUTE?$

label: MoveTutor_Text_SubstituteWhichMon
text: Giggle…\nWhich POKéMON do you want me to\lteach SUBSTITUTE?$

label: MoveTutor_Text_SwaggerDeclined
text: What, no? Can't you get into\nthe spirit of things?$

label: MoveTutor_Text_SwaggerTaught
text: I'll just praise my POKéMON from now\non without the swagger.$

label: MoveTutor_Text_SwaggerTeach
text:
Heh! My POKéMON totally rules!
It's cooler than any POKéMON!\pI was lipping off with a swagger in
my step like that when the CHAIRMAN\lchewed me out.\pThat took the swagger out of my step.\pIf you'd like, I'll teach the move
SWAGGER to a POKéMON of yours.$

label: MoveTutor_Text_SwaggerWhichMon
text: All right, which POKéMON wants to\nlearn how to SWAGGER?$

label: MtChimney_CableCarStation_Text_CableCarReadyGetOn
text: The CABLE CAR is ready to go down.\nWould you like to be on it?$

label: MtChimney_CableCarStation_Text_RideAnotherTime
text: Please ride with us another time.$

label: MtChimney_CableCarStation_Text_StepThisWay
text: Please step this way.$

label: MtChimney_Text_AquasNameSimilar
text: We're TEAM MAGMA!\pThey're TEAM AQUA!\pIt totally annoys me that they'd\nuse a name like ours!$

label: MtChimney_Text_ArchieGoStopTeamMagma
text:
ARCHIE: Grr, {PLAYER}!
I should've guessed you'd show up!\pSee for yourself what the fanatics
of TEAM MAGMA are up to!\pThey're trying to inject the stolen
METEORITE's power into the volcano!\pDoing something like that will cause
the volcano's eruption!$

label: MtChimney_Text_ArchieIHaveMyHandsFull
text: ARCHIE: Grrr…\pI want to stop that MAXIE,\nbut I can't!\pNot when I have my hands full battling\nthree opponents at once!$

label: MtChimney_Text_ArchieThankYou
text:
ARCHIE: {PLAYER}!
Thank you!\pWith your help, we thwarted TEAM
MAGMA's destructive plan!\pBut… You…
Whose side are you on?\pAh, it doesn't matter.\pWe will remain vigilant and keep up
our pursuit of TEAM MAGMA.\p{PLAYER}, we shall meet again!$

label: MtChimney_Text_Bufoh
text: Bufoh!$

label: MtChimney_Text_Bushaa
text: Bushaa!$

label: MtChimney_Text_DouseThemInFire
text: Yeah!\nDouse them in fire!$

label: MtChimney_Text_Grunt1Defeat
text: My dream of a big house…$

label: MtChimney_Text_Grunt1Intro
text: If there were more land, I'd be able\nto get a big house of my own!\pI'm going to build it on hardened lava!$

label: MtChimney_Text_Grunt1PostBattle
text: A rookie like you should be\nsplashing about in the waves!$

label: MtChimney_Text_Grunt2Defeat
text: Hunh?\nWhat do you mean I lost?$

label: MtChimney_Text_Grunt2Intro
text: We of TEAM MAGMA are working hard for\neveryone's sake.\pLike, if that thing's power made more\nland, there'd be more places to live.\pEveryone'd be happy!$

label: MtChimney_Text_Grunt2PostBattle
text: Our BOSS says, “It will make everyone\nhappy.”\pBut why does everyone keep getting\nin our way?$

label: MtChimney_Text_KeepMakingMoreLand
text: We're going to keep making more land!$

label: MtChimney_Text_LavaCookiesJust200
text: LAVA COOKIES are MT. CHIMNEY's local\nspecialty.\pTry one. It's just ¥200.$

label: MtChimney_Text_LessHabitatForWaterPokemon
text: If they expand the land, there'll be\nless habitats for WATER POKéMON!$

label: MtChimney_Text_MachineMakesNoResponse
text: This mysterious machine…\nIt makes no response whatsoever.$

label: MtChimney_Text_MagmaOutnumbersUs
text: Darn… TEAM MAGMA outnumbers us!\nWe can't keep up with them!$

label: MtChimney_Text_MagmasNameSimilar
text: We're TEAM AQUA!\pThey're TEAM MAGMA!\pIt burns me up that they'd use such\na confusing name!$

label: MtChimney_Text_MaxieDefeat
text: What?!\pI, MAXIE, was caught off guard?!$

label: MtChimney_Text_MaxieIntro
text:
MAXIE: Hm?
Who are you?\p… … … … … …
… … … … … …\pI'd heard ARCHIE bemoaning a child
who's been meddling in TEAM AQUA's\laffairs.\pIt must be you he meant.\pHumph! So you're thinking of
interfering with us, TEAM MAGMA?\pNow you listen.
Long ago, living things used the\lland to live and grow.\pThat is why land is all important!
It is the cradle of all!\pThat is why TEAM MAGMA is dedicated
to the expansion of the land mass.\pIt is for further advancement of
humankind and POKéMON!\pAnd for that, we need the power of
what sleeps within this mountain…\pOh! There was no need for you to
learn that much.\pBut, no matter!
I'll teach you the consequences of\lmeddling in our grand design!$

label: MtChimney_Text_MaxieYouHaventSeenLastOfMagma
text:
MAXIE: But, enough.
I will back off this time.\pBut don't think that this is the last
you've seen of TEAM MAGMA.\pFufufu…\pEven without the METEORITE, if we
obtain that ORB… Fufufu…$

label: MtChimney_Text_MelissaDefeat
text: Ooh, that was a scorching-hot match!$

label: MtChimney_Text_MelissaIntro
text: I've got the fire in me, baby.\nI can't stand it! I have to battle!$

label: MtChimney_Text_MelissaPostBattle
text: The heat of MT. CHIMNEY warms\nme up, baby!$

label: MtChimney_Text_MeteoriteFittedOnMachine
text: A METEORITE is fitted on a mysterious\nmachine…\pThe machine seems to be storing\nenergy in the METEORITE.$

label: MtChimney_Text_MeteoriteWillActivateVolcano
text: The power contained in the METEORITE…\pBy amplifying its power with this\nmachine, MT. CHIMNEY's volcanic\lactivity will instantly intensify…\pIts energy will grow deep inside\nthe crater and…\lFufufu…$

label: MtChimney_Text_MeteoritesPackAmazingPower
text: METEORITES pack amazing power!$

label: MtChimney_Text_OhFineThen
text: Oh, fine then.$

label: MtChimney_Text_PlayerLeftMeteorite
text: {PLAYER} left the METEORITE where\nit was.$

label: MtChimney_Text_PlayerRemovedMeteorite
text: {PLAYER} removed the METEORITE from\nthe mysterious machine.$

label: MtChimney_Text_RemoveTheMeteorite
text: A METEORITE is fitted on a mysterious\nmachine…\pDo you want to remove the METEORITE?$

label: MtChimney_Text_RouteSign
text: {DOWN_ARROW} JAGGED PATH\nLAVARIDGE TOWN AHEAD$

label: MtChimney_Text_SawyerDefeat
text: Oh, you're a real firebrand, too!$

label: MtChimney_Text_SawyerIntro
text: This is one fine mountain! Plenty of\nhot people around for company!$

label: MtChimney_Text_SawyerPostBattle
text: I think I need a dip in LAVARIDGE\nHOT SPRING with the locals!$

label: MtChimney_Text_SawyerPostRematch
text: Actually, it really is hot here.\nI'm overdressed for these parts.$

label: MtChimney_Text_SawyerRegister
text: I like little fireballs like you.\nLet me register you in my POKéNAV.$

label: MtChimney_Text_SawyerRematchDefeat
text: Gosh, you're still the same\nfirebrand as before!$

label: MtChimney_Text_SawyerRematchIntro
text: I'm happily surrounded by hot people\naround these parts. I won't lose!$

label: MtChimney_Text_SheilaDefeat
text: The way you battle…\nIt's like a MT. CHIMNEY eruption!$

label: MtChimney_Text_SheilaIntro
text: I've finally made it to MT. CHIMNEY.\nI want to make my POKéMON battle!$

label: MtChimney_Text_SheilaPostBattle
text: Like I said, I've finally made it to\nMT. CHIMNEY. It would be a shame if\lI only do a little sightseeing…\pI want to get in some battles and buy\nCOOKIES as souvenirs.$

label: MtChimney_Text_ShelbyDefeat
text: Oh, my goodness.\nNow, aren't you something!$

label: MtChimney_Text_ShelbyIntro
text: I've been to the hot springs and\nrefreshed my tired bones.\lRight now I'm feeling strong!$

label: MtChimney_Text_ShelbyPostBattle
text: Well, well, I've lost. I can't call\nmyself an EXPERT now, can I?$

label: MtChimney_Text_ShelbyPostRematch
text: Perhaps your heart has become one\nwith the hearts of your POKéMON.$

label: MtChimney_Text_ShelbyRegister
text: Thank you, child. It was fun, as if\nI were battling my own grandchild.\pPlease, come see me again for\na rematch.$

label: MtChimney_Text_ShelbyRematchDefeat
text: Oh, my goodness.\nNow, aren't you something!$

label: MtChimney_Text_ShelbyRematchIntro
text: If you can mesh your heart with those\nof your POKéMON, why, you should be\lable to achieve great things.$

label: MtChimney_Text_ShirleyDefeat
text: Yowch!\nI'm getting a chill out of the water.$

label: MtChimney_Text_ShirleyIntro
text: Since I bathed in the hot springs,\nI've been feeling great!\lI'm sure I'm going to win!$

label: MtChimney_Text_ShirleyPostBattle
text: I'll have to take another dip in the\nhot springs. Want to join me?\pJust joking!$

label: MtChimney_Text_TabithaDefeat
text: Hehehe…\pEven though I've lost, if our leader\nawakens that thing…$

label: MtChimney_Text_TabithaIntro
text: Hehehe!\pSo you've come all the way here!\pBut you're too late!\nI've already delivered the METEORITE\lfrom METEOR FALLS to the BOSS!$

label: MtChimney_Text_TabithaPostBattle
text: BOSS, hurry!\nGive it the METEORITE's energy!\pHehehe…$

label: MtChimney_Text_TeamAquaAlwaysMessingWithPlans
text: That annoying TEAM AQUA…\nThey always mess with our plans!$

label: MtChimney_Text_ThankYouDear
text: Thank you, dear!$

label: MtChimney_Text_YouBetterNotMessWithUs
text: You'd better not mess with us!\pWe're trying to awaken that thing\nfor the benefit of everyone!$

label: MtChimney_Text_YouveNotGotTheMoney
text: Oh, dear. You can't buy a thing if\nyou've not got the money.$

label: MtEmber_Exterior_Text_BethDefeat
text: Atchah!\nYou're shockingly good!$

label: MtEmber_Exterior_Text_BethIntro
text: Do you know how caves form inside\nvolcanoes?$

label: MtEmber_Exterior_Text_BethPostBattle
text: When lava at the surface of magma\nhardens, and the magma inside flows\lout, caverns are left behind.$

label: MtEmber_Exterior_Text_FirstPasswordGoldeen
text: What, you forgot the password?\nThere're actually two.\pThe first one's “GOLDEEN need\nlog.”\pAnd the second one is…$

label: MtEmber_Exterior_Text_Grunt1Defeat
text: Huh, what?$

label: MtEmber_Exterior_Text_Grunt1Intro
text: You've been eavesdropping on us,\nhaven't you?$

label: MtEmber_Exterior_Text_Grunt1PostBattle
text: Why'd you have to win?$

label: MtEmber_Exterior_Text_Grunt2Defeat
text: Wait!\nBut how?$

label: MtEmber_Exterior_Text_Grunt2Intro
text: Trying to horn in on our treasure?\nDon't bet on it!$

label: MtEmber_Exterior_Text_Grunt2PostBattle
text: Develop amnesia conveniently and\nforget everything you heard!$

label: MtEmber_Exterior_Text_JocelynDefeat
text: I think I tried to overdo it…$

label: MtEmber_Exterior_Text_JocelynIntro
text: I've been in training so I can mend\nmy broken heart…\pIt toughened me up physically at\nleast! Hi-yah!$

label: MtEmber_Exterior_Text_JocelynPostBattle
text: The way you battle, it reminds me\nof the guy who dumped me…$

label: MtEmber_Exterior_Text_LoganDefeat
text: Whew… That was hot!\nSweat's erupting from me!$

label: MtEmber_Exterior_Text_LoganIntro
text: An active volcano is one that's\nerupting, or about to.$

label: MtEmber_Exterior_Text_LoganPostBattle
text: They say there're over 1,500\nactive volcanoes in the world.\pJust thinking about them makes me\nfeel all hot and gooey inside!$

label: MtEmber_Exterior_Text_PunchedThroughAtLast
text: Whew, punched through at last.\nLet's go treasure hunting!$

label: MtEmber_Exterior_Text_SnoopsBeenListeningIn
text: Hey!\nThis snoop's been listening in!$

label: MtEmber_Exterior_Text_WellRegroupDontStepInsideThere
text:
What a setback…
We'll have to regroup.\pYou! Don't even think about taking
a step inside here!\pIf you know what's good for you,
don't even think about this!$

label: MtEmber_Exterior_Text_WellTryDiggingHere
text: Over here.\nWe'll try digging here.\pThat treasure the ADMINS've been\ntalking about should be here.$

label: MtEmber_Exterior_Text_WhatsPasswordAgain
text: Any treasure we find, we haul back\nto the WAREHOUSE, understood?\p…Oh, and what're the passwords?\nAt the ROCKET WAREHOUSE, I mean.$

label: MtEmber_Exterior_Text_YoureInTheWayGetLost
text: What the…?\nYou're in the way. Get lost.$

label: MtEmber_RubyPath_B3F_Text_FoundARuby
text: {PLAYER} found a RUBY!$

label: MtMoon_1F_Text_BrockHelpsExcavateFossils
text: Hi, I'm excavating for fossils here\nunder MT. MOON.\pSometimes, BROCK of PEWTER GYM\nlends me a hand.$

label: MtMoon_1F_Text_IrisDefeat
text: I lost?$

label: MtMoon_1F_Text_IrisIntro
text: What?\nI'm waiting for my friends to find\lme here.$

label: MtMoon_1F_Text_IrisPostBattle
text: I came because I heard there are\nsome very rare fossils here.$

label: MtMoon_1F_Text_JoshDefeat
text: Losing stinks!\nIt's so uncool.$

label: MtMoon_1F_Text_JoshIntro
text: Did you come to explore the cave,\ntoo?$

label: MtMoon_1F_Text_JoshPostBattle
text: I came all the way down here to\nshow off to girls.$

label: MtMoon_1F_Text_JovanDefeat
text: My POKéMON won't do!$

label: MtMoon_1F_Text_JovanIntro
text: What!\nDon't sneak up on me!$

label: MtMoon_1F_Text_JovanPostBattle
text: I have to find stronger POKéMON.\nWhere might they be?$

label: MtMoon_1F_Text_KentDefeat
text: You got me!$

label: MtMoon_1F_Text_KentIntro
text: Suspicious men are in the cave.\nWhat about you?$

label: MtMoon_1F_Text_KentPostBattle
text: I saw them!\nI'm sure they're from TEAM ROCKET!$

label: MtMoon_1F_Text_MarcosDefeat
text: Wow!\nShocked again!$

label: MtMoon_1F_Text_MarcosIntro
text: WHOA!\nYou shocked me!\l…Oh, you're a new trainer!$

label: MtMoon_1F_Text_MarcosPostBattle
text: Kids like you shouldn't be\nwandering around here in the dark.$

label: MtMoon_1F_Text_MiriamDefeat
text: Oh!\nI lost it!$

label: MtMoon_1F_Text_MiriamIntro
text: Wow! It's way bigger in here than\nI thought!$

label: MtMoon_1F_Text_MiriamPostBattle
text: How do you get out of here?\nIt's so big, I may get lost.$

label: MtMoon_1F_Text_RobbyDefeat
text: I lost.$

label: MtMoon_1F_Text_RobbyIntro
text: You need to go through this cave\nto get to CERULEAN CITY.$

label: MtMoon_1F_Text_RobbyPostBattle
text: ZUBAT is tough!\nBut if you can catch one, you'll\lbe able to count on it.$

label: MtMoon_1F_Text_ZubatIsABloodsucker
text: Beware!\nZUBAT is a bloodsucker!$

label: MtMoon_B2F_Text_Grunt1Defeat
text: Urgh!\nNow I'm mad!$

label: MtMoon_B2F_Text_Grunt1Intro
text: We, TEAM ROCKET, shall find the\nfossils!\pReviving POKéMON from them will\nearn us huge riches!$

label: MtMoon_B2F_Text_Grunt1PostBattle
text: You made me mad!\nTEAM ROCKET will blacklist you!$

label: MtMoon_B2F_Text_Grunt2Defeat
text: I blew it!$

label: MtMoon_B2F_Text_Grunt2Intro
text: We, TEAM ROCKET, are POKéMON\ngangsters!\lWe strike fear with our strength!$

label: MtMoon_B2F_Text_Grunt2PostBattle
text: Darn it all!\nMy associates won't stand for this!$

label: MtMoon_B2F_Text_Grunt3Defeat
text: So, you are good…$

label: MtMoon_B2F_Text_Grunt3Intro
text: We're pulling a big job here!\nGet lost, kid!$

label: MtMoon_B2F_Text_Grunt3PostBattle
text: If you find a fossil, give it to me\nand scram!$

label: MtMoon_B2F_Text_Grunt4Defeat
text: I'm steamed!$

label: MtMoon_B2F_Text_Grunt4Intro
text: Little kids shouldn't be messing\naround with grown-ups!\pIt could be bad news!$

label: MtMoon_B2F_Text_Grunt4PostBattle
text: POKéMON lived here long before\npeople came.$

label: MtMoon_B2F_Text_LabOnCinnabarRegeneratesFossils
text: Far away, on CINNABAR ISLAND,\nthere's a POKéMON LAB.\pThey do research on regenerating\nfossils.$

label: MtMoon_B2F_Text_MiguelDefeat
text: Okay!\nI'll share!$

label: MtMoon_B2F_Text_MiguelIntro
text: Hey, stop!\pI found these fossils!\nThey're both mine!$

label: MtMoon_B2F_Text_ObtainedDomeFossil
text: Obtained the DOME FOSSIL!$

label: MtMoon_B2F_Text_ObtainedHelixFossil
text: Obtained the HELIX FOSSIL!$

label: MtMoon_B2F_Text_ThenThisFossilIsMine
text: All right.\nThen this fossil is mine!$

label: MtMoon_B2F_Text_WellEachTakeAFossil
text: We'll each take a fossil!\nNo being greedy!$

label: MtMoon_B2F_Text_YouWantDomeFossil
text: Do you want the DOME FOSSIL?$

label: MtMoon_B2F_Text_YouWantHelixFossil
text: Do you want the HELIX FOSSIL?$

label: MtPyre_1F_Text_ComeToPayRespects
text: Did you come to pay your respect\nto the spirits of departed POKéMON?\pYou must care for your POKéMON a lot.$

label: MtPyre_1F_Text_ExplainCleanseTag
text: Have a POKéMON hold that\nCLEANSE TAG.\pIt will help ward off wild POKéMON.$

label: MtPyre_1F_Text_RestingPlaceOfZigzagoon
text: This is the final resting place of my\nZIGZAGOON. I cherished it…$

label: MtPyre_1F_Text_TakeThisForYourOwnGood
text: All sorts of beings wander the slopes\nof MT. PYRE…\pThere is no telling what may happen.\nTake this. It's for your own good.$

label: MtPyre_2F_Text_DezDefeat
text: DEZ: Waaaah! I'm scared!$

label: MtPyre_2F_Text_DezIntro
text:
DEZ: I came here on a dare with my
boyfriend.\pIt's really scary, but I'm with my
boyfriend. It's okay.\pI know! I'll get my boyfriend to look
cool by beating you!$

label: MtPyre_2F_Text_DezNotEnoughMons
text: DEZ: If you want to challenge us, you\nshould bring at least two POKéMON.\pMy boyfriend's strong.\nJust one POKéMON won't do at all.$

label: MtPyre_2F_Text_DezPostBattle
text: DEZ: We're lovey-dovey, so we don't\ncare if we lose!$

label: MtPyre_2F_Text_LeahDefeat
text: Hmm…\nYou're durable.$

label: MtPyre_2F_Text_LeahIntro
text: You are an unfamiliar sight…\nDepart before anything befalls you!$

label: MtPyre_2F_Text_LeahPostBattle
text: Our family has been TRAINERS here\nsince my great-grandmother's time…\pIt is my duty to protect this\nmountain…$

label: MtPyre_2F_Text_LukeDefeat
text: LUKE: Whoopsie!$

label: MtPyre_2F_Text_LukeIntro
text: LUKE: We're here on a dare.\pHeheh, if I show her how cool I am,\nshe'll fall for me. I know it!\pI know! I'll cream you and show her\nhow cool I am!$

label: MtPyre_2F_Text_LukeNotEnoughMons
text: LUKE: If you want to take me on,\nbring some more POKéMON.\pIf you don't, I won't be able to show\noff to my girl how cool I am!$

label: MtPyre_2F_Text_LukePostBattle
text: LUKE: Well, we lost but that's okay!\nI'm right here by your side.\lWe'll make it through this dare!$

label: MtPyre_2F_Text_MarkDefeat
text: Ayieeeeh!\nI'm sorry, forgive me, please!$

label: MtPyre_2F_Text_MarkIntro
text: Hey! Are you searching for POKéMON?\nYou came along after me! You're rude!$

label: MtPyre_2F_Text_MarkPostBattle
text: People don't come here often, so\nI thought there'd be rare POKéMON.$

label: MtPyre_2F_Text_MemoriesOfSkitty
text: Memories of my darling SKITTY…\nMy eyes overflow thinking about it.$

label: MtPyre_2F_Text_TumbledFromFloorAbove
text: Ooch, ouch… There are holes in the\nground here and there.\pI didn't notice and took a tumble from\nthe floor above.$

label: MtPyre_2F_Text_ZanderDefeat
text: Nooooooo!\nI lost my wits!$

label: MtPyre_2F_Text_ZanderIntro
text: Kiyaaaaah!\nI'm terrified!$

label: MtPyre_2F_Text_ZanderPostBattle
text: I get freaked out every time I see\nanything move…\pI shouldn't have come here to train…$

label: MtPyre_3F_Text_GabrielleDefeat
text: That was amazing!\nYou're a very special TRAINER.$

label: MtPyre_3F_Text_GabrielleIntro
text: Why have you come here?$

label: MtPyre_3F_Text_GabriellePostBattle
text:
POKéMON no longer of this world.
POKéMON that are with you now.\pAnd the POKéMON that you will meet
in the future…\pThey are all to be equally cherished.
Please remember that.$

label: MtPyre_3F_Text_GabriellePostRematch
text:
POKéMON no longer of this world.
POKéMON that are with you now.\pAnd the POKéMON that you will meet
in the future…\pThey are all to be equally cherished.
I see that you've remembered that.$

label: MtPyre_3F_Text_GabrielleRegister
text: I would like to see your POKéMON\nwhen they grow up some more…\pPlease, I need to see your POKéNAV.$

label: MtPyre_3F_Text_GabrielleRematchDefeat
text: How amazing!\nYou are a special person.$

label: MtPyre_3F_Text_GabrielleRematchIntro
text: Oh, it's you…\pHave you come to show me your grown\nPOKéMON?$

label: MtPyre_3F_Text_KaylaDefeat
text: I lost that cleanly…$

label: MtPyre_3F_Text_KaylaIntro
text: Ahahahaha!\pThis is no place for children, least\nof all you!$

label: MtPyre_3F_Text_KaylaPostBattle
text: This means my training is still not\nenough…\pI've got to keep working toward the\nsummit…\pGo, me!$

label: MtPyre_3F_Text_WilliamDefeat
text: I drown in self-pity…$

label: MtPyre_3F_Text_WilliamIntro
text: The rich atmosphere of the mountain\nhas elevated my psychic power!\pA mere child like you…\nYou dream of winning?$

label: MtPyre_3F_Text_WilliamPostBattle
text: My psychic powers have surely\ngrown several times, but…$

label: MtPyre_4F_Text_TashaDefeat
text: Losing, I dislike…$

label: MtPyre_4F_Text_TashaIntro
text: I love all things horrifying…\nIt's like a disease…\pWhen I'm here…\nI shiver with fear…$

label: MtPyre_4F_Text_TashaPostBattle
text: I want to see dreadful things…\nI can't leave…\pStay…\nWon't you stay with me?$

label: MtPyre_5F_Text_AtsushiDefeat
text: Teacher…\nPlease forgive me!$

label: MtPyre_5F_Text_AtsushiIntro
text: Teacher…\nPlease watch over my progress!$

label: MtPyre_5F_Text_AtsushiPostBattle
text: Until I improve, my teacher, who rests\nhere, will never find true peace…$

label: MtPyre_6F_Text_CedricDefeat
text: Weren't you lost?$

label: MtPyre_6F_Text_CedricIntro
text: Have you lost your bearings?\nHave no fear for I am here!$

label: MtPyre_6F_Text_CedricPostBattle
text: I had this feeling that a lost TRAINER\nwould be panicked and easy to beat.\pIt's dirty and I won't try it again…$

label: MtPyre_6F_Text_ValerieDefeat
text: The power is ebbing away…$

label: MtPyre_6F_Text_ValerieIntro
text: When I'm here…\nA curious power flows into me…$

label: MtPyre_6F_Text_ValeriePostBattle
text: Perhaps the power is from the spirits\nof POKéMON in fitful sleep here…$

label: MtPyre_6F_Text_ValeriePostRematch
text: The POKéMON at rest here…\nSometimes, they play…$

label: MtPyre_6F_Text_ValerieRegister
text: Fufufu… I lost the match, but…\nI have this little ability…\pWithout ever laying my hands on\nyour POKéNAV… Hiyah!$

label: MtPyre_6F_Text_ValerieRematchDefeat
text: Something faded away…$

label: MtPyre_6F_Text_ValerieRematchIntro
text: Behind you…\nWhat is it…$

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_ArchieWeGotTheOrbLetsGo
text:
ARCHIE: TEAM MAGMA's MAXIE got ahead
of us, but we also got what we wanted.\pThe RED ORB preserved at MT. PYRE…
I, ARCHIE, now have it in my possession!\pFufufu… Now we can bring our ultimate
objective to fruition!\pOkay, TEAM!
We're pulling out!$

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_BothOrbsTakenMagmaLeftThis
text:
Oh, no…
This cannot happen…\pNot only the BLUE ORB, but even
the RED ORB has been taken…\pThe BLUE ORB and RED ORB must never
be separated. They belong together.\pWhat are those men trying to do with
the two ORBS?\p… … … … … …
… … … … … …\pOh, yes. Was it TEAM MAGMA who came
and took the BLUE ORB first?\pWell, in their haste, they left this
behind.\pI couldn't imagine what exactly it
could be.\pI would like you to have it.
Perhaps it will be useful in some way.$

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_GroudonKyogreAwakened
text:
Oh, my goodness…\pYou say that both GROUDON and KYOGRE
have been awakened?\pIt is said that the BLUE ORB and
the RED ORB quelled the rage of\lthe two POKéMON…\pIt is also said that the true owner
of the ORBS still exists.\pHowever, no one knows who, or what
exactly, the ORBS belong to.\pIt could be a human, or perhaps
a POKéMON, but no one knows.$

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_GroudonKyogreTale
text:
It happened long, long ago…\pThe world was wracked by a ferocious
clash between the POKéMON of the land\land the POKéMON of the sea…\pThe POKéMON of the land raised
mountains and created continents…\pThe POKéMON of the sea raised huge
waves and carved out oceans…\pTheir fierce duel raged without end.\pThe world was engulfed in massive
infernos and vicious storms.\pThe BLUE ORB and the RED ORB brought
an end to the calamity.\pLight poured from the two ORBS and
becalmed the enraged adversaries.\pThe pair, made docile, dove deep into
the sea where eventually they\ldisappeared…$

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_Grunt1Defeat
text: I thought you were one of the MAGMAS\nwho happened to come back…$

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_Grunt1Intro
text: No! Those TEAM MAGMA goons got\nhere ahead of us!\pWe can't fall behind!$

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_Grunt1PostBattle
text: Yeah, so you are strong…\nBut there're a lot of us!$

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_Grunt2Defeat
text: Urgh… I should've let you take on\nTEAM MAGMA first…$

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_Grunt2Intro
text:
Hah!
Too bad for you!\pIf you came earlier, you only would've
had to battle the wimpy TEAM MAGMA.\pBut since you arrived now, you have
to take on us toughies!$

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_Grunt2PostBattle
text: You don't know anything!\nSo why are you messing with us?$

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_Grunt3Defeat
text: If you're going to mess with anyone,\nlet it be TEAM MAGMA…$

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_Grunt3Intro
text: You…\nWe saw you at MT. CHIMNEY.\pYou don't belong to either TEAM,\nso why would you be here?$

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_Grunt3PostBattle
text: Heh, it doesn't matter!\nWe bought ourselves some time!\pThe BOSS should have snatched what\nhe was after!$

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_Grunt4Defeat
text: If you want to join TEAM AQUA that\nbadly, we can consider it…$

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_Grunt4Intro
text: Oh, I know!\nYou tried to join TEAM MAGMA,\lbut they wouldn't have you!\pWell, don't think that we'll let you\njoin our TEAM AQUA!$

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_Grunt4PostBattle
text: We have a great combination going\nwith us members and our leader.$

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_HearTheNewLegendOfHoenn
text:
It is my role to pass on the legends
of HOENN to future generations.\pAnd the crisis that just ended in
SOOTOPOLIS rewrote a legend…\pHave you the time to hear the new
legend of HOENN?$

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_HoennTrioTale
text:
It happened long, long ago…\pThe world was wracked by a ferocious
clash between the POKéMON of the land\land the POKéMON of the sea…\pThe POKéMON of the land raised
mountains and created continents…\pThe POKéMON of the sea raised huge
waves and carved out oceans…\pTheir fierce duel raged without end.\pThe world was engulfed in massive
fires and vicious storms.\pIt was then that the POKéMON of
the sky descended from a storm.\pThe POKéMON, shining a vivid green,
becalmed the two enraged POKéMON.\pThen, its duty done, the green POKéMON
flew off into the wild blue yonder…$

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_MaxieSilence
text: MAXIE: {PLAYER}…\p… … … … … …\n… … … … … …$

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_OrbsHaveBeenTaken
text: The BLUE ORB and RED ORB taken by\nthose sinister men…\pThey must never be apart…\nI fear something terrible will happen…$

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_SuperAncientPokemonTaughtUs
text:
The embodiments of the land, sea,
and the sky…\pThat is said to be the identities of
the super-ancient POKéMON…\pIn the same way that we humans and
POKéMON have life, our world, too,\lis alive…\pThe super-ancient POKéMON have
taught us that…$

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_ThoseTwoMenReturnedOrbs
text: The two men who took the ORBS came\nback to return them on their own.\pThose men…\nPerhaps they are not so evil after all…$

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_WellThatTooIsFine
text: I see…\nWell, that, too, is fine…$

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_WillYouHearOutMyTale
text:
MT. PYRE is where we calm the spirits
of POKéMON that have passed on…\pThis is a high place where one can
see all of HOENN…\pThe disembodied spirits of POKéMON
must find solace here…\pIs it coincidence that you are here…\pWill you hear out my tale? A tale long
told in the HOENN region?$

label: MysteryGift_Text_TheresATicketForYou
text: Thank you for using the MYSTERY\nEVENT System.\pYou must be {PLAYER}.\nThere is a ticket here for you.$

label: MysteryGift_Text_TryUsingItAtLilycovePort
text: It appears to be for use at\nthe LILYCOVE CITY port.\pWhy not give it a try and see what\nit is about?$

label: NavelRock_Harbor_Text_SailorReturn
text: Did… Did you hear that?\nThat low growling from deep in there.\pAre you sure it's safe?\nDo you think we should leave?$

label: NewMauville_Entrance_Text_DoorIsLocked
text: The door is locked.$

label: NewMauville_Entrance_Text_UseBasementKey
text: Use the BASEMENT KEY?$

label: NewMauville_Entrance_Text_UsedBasementKey
text: {PLAYER} used the BASEMENT KEY.\pThe door opened!$

label: NewMauville_Inside_Text_GeneratorQuietedDown
text: The generator quieted down.$

label: NewMauville_Inside_Text_GeneratorRadiatingHeat
text: The generator is radiating heat that\ncan be felt even at a distance.\pIt looks like it should be turned off\nas soon as possible.$

label: NewMauville_Inside_Text_SteppedOnSwitchGeneratorStopped
text: {PLAYER} stepped on the switch.\pClick…\p… … … … … … … …\n… … … … … … … …\pThe generator appears to have\nstopped…$

label: OldaleTown_House1_Text_LeftPokemonGoesOutFirst
text: When a POKéMON battle starts, the one\nat the left of the list goes out first.\pSo, when you get more POKéMON in your\nparty, try switching around the order\lof your POKéMON.\pIt could give you an advantage.$

label: OldaleTown_House2_Text_PokemonLevelUp
text: When POKéMON battle, they eventually\nlevel up and become stronger.$

label: OldaleTown_House2_Text_YoullGoFurtherWithStrongPokemon
text: If the POKéMON with you become\nstronger, you'll be able to go farther\laway from here.$

label: OldaleTown_Mart_Text_ImGoingToBuyPokeBalls
text: I'm going to buy a bunch of POKé BALLS\nand catch a bunch of POKéMON!$

label: OldaleTown_Mart_Text_PokeBallsAreSoldOut
text: The clerk says they're all sold out.\nI can't buy any POKé BALLS.$

label: OldaleTown_Mart_Text_RestoreHPWithPotion
text: If a POKéMON gets hurt and loses its HP\nand faints, it won't be able to battle.\pTo prevent your POKéMON from fainting,\nrestore its HP with a POTION.$

label: OldaleTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_PokemonCentersAreGreat
text: POKéMON CENTERS are great!\pYou can use their services as much\nas you like, and it's all for free.\lYou never have to worry!$

label: OldaleTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_TradedInWirelessClub
text: The POKéMON WIRELESS CLUB on\nthe second floor was built recently.\pI traded POKéMON right away.$

label: OldaleTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_TrainersCanUsePC
text: That PC in the corner there is\nfor any POKéMON TRAINER to use.\pNaturally, that means you're welcome\nto use it, too.$

label: OldaleTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_WirelessClubNotAvailable
text: The POKéMON WIRELESS CLUB on\nthe second floor was built recently.\pBut they say they're still making\nadjustments.$

label: OldaleTown_Text_BrendanLetsGoBack
text: BRENDAN: I'm heading back to my dad's\nLAB now.\l{PLAYER}, you should hustle back, too.$

label: OldaleTown_Text_DiscoveredFootprints
text: I just discovered the footprints of\na rare POKéMON!\pWait until I finish sketching\nthem, okay?$

label: OldaleTown_Text_FinishedSketchingFootprints
text: I finished sketching the footprints of\na rare POKéMON.\pBut it turns out they were only my\nown footprints…$

label: OldaleTown_Text_IWorkAtPokemonMart
text: Hi!\nI work at a POKéMON MART.\pCan I get you to come with me?$

label: OldaleTown_Text_MayLetsGoBack
text: MAY: {PLAYER}{KUN}!\nOver here!\lLet's hurry home!$

label: OldaleTown_Text_PotionExplanation
text: A POTION can be used anytime, so it's\neven more useful than a POKéMON CENTER\lin certain situations.$

label: OldaleTown_Text_SavingMyProgress
text: I want to take a rest, so I'm saving my\nprogress.$

label: OldaleTown_Text_ThisIsAPokemonMart
text:
This is a POKéMON MART.
Just look for our blue roof.\pWe sell a variety of goods including
POKé BALLS for catching POKéMON.\pHere, I'd like you to have this as
a promotional item.$

label: OldaleTown_Text_TownSign
text: OLDALE TOWN\n“Where things start off scarce.”$

label: OldaleTown_Text_WaitDontComeInHere
text:
Aaaaah! Wait!
Please don't come in here.\pI just discovered the footprints of
a rare POKéMON!\pWait until I finish sketching
them, okay?$

label: OneIsland_House1_Text_GazeUponVolcanoOnSunnyDays
text: On sunny days, I step out and gaze\nupon the volcano.\pThat's my daily routine.$

label: OneIsland_House1_Text_LastTimeMtEmberErupted
text: Let me think… When was the last\ntime MT. EMBER erupted?$

label: OneIsland_House2_Text_IWantToStayHereForever
text: Young people all want to go off to\nbig cities.\pBut I want to stay here forever!$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_EmberSpa_Text_BrunoVisitsSpaOnOccasion
text:
After an honest day of training,
nothing beats a relaxing soak in\lthe hot spring pool.\pBRUNO, who's a senior ahead of me,
visits the SPA on occasion.\pHe comes to rehab injuries, both
his own and his POKéMON's.$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_EmberSpa_Text_EnjoyBowlOfChowder
text: My favorite part of bathing comes\nup right after this.\pI enjoy a bowl of chowder to\nwarm me from the inside, too!$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_EmberSpa_Text_ExplainHM06
text: That shatters boulders as if they\nwere made of crackers.$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_EmberSpa_Text_HotSpringIsTherapeutic
text: Soaking in a hot spring pool is\ntherapeutic, people say.$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_EmberSpa_Text_SeeHowSmoothMySkinIs
text: Have a look at my face.\nSee how smooth my skin is?\pThe hot spring's water keeps my\nskin younger than my age.$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_EmberSpa_Text_UsedThisToMakeEmberSpa
text:
Hot springs go hand-in-hand with
volcanoes.\pThe EMBER SPA here, well,
I made it years ago.\pI hewed the pool right out of a
gigantic boulder by hand.\pI was using this at the time.
I suppose I can part with it.$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_EmberSpa_Text_WaterExquisiteFullyRefreshed
text: The water is perfectly warm.\nIt feels exquisite…\p{PLAYER} and the POKéMON were\nfully refreshed!$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_EmberSpa_Text_WaterWarmsMeToCore
text:
Hm!
Haaaaaaaaaaah!\pAaaah! This is heavenly!
The water warms me to my core!\pYou should jump in, too.\pGo to the middle, relax, and get
good and warm!$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_AbigailDefeat
text: Oh, you're so awful.$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_AbigailIntro
text: I'm beginning to get a sunburn…$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_AbigailPostBattle
text: I like that cap you have.\nMaybe I should wear one, too…$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_AbigailRematchIntro
text: My sunburn is starting to hurt…$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_BryceDefeat
text: Awww, blown!$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_BryceIntro
text: You know, everything tastes great\nwhen you're out in the wild.$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_BrycePostBattle
text: The water in volcanic regions is\ndelicious.$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_BryceRematchIntro
text: You know, everything tastes great\nwhen you're out in the wild.$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_ClaireDefeat
text: That made me all sweaty.$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_ClaireIntro
text: My lunch filled us up, so will you\nbattle us for some exercise?$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_ClairePostBattle
text: What should I do?\nI feel famished again.$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_ClaireRematchIntro
text: I ate too much again, so will you\nbattle us for some exercise?$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_EmberSpaSign
text: Light the Fire in Your Heart!\nEMBER SPA$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_FinnDefeat
text: Well, aren't you tough?$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_FinnIntro
text: Seen from here, MT. EMBER towers\ninto the sky.$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_FinnPostBattle
text: The sky is immense around these\nparts.$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_FinnRematchIntro
text: The fire bird's mountain casts\na huge shadow…$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_GarrettDefeat
text: Hey, what the…\nYou're good, you!$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_GarrettIntro
text: I took a break from swimming,\nonly to have you challenge me?$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_GarrettPostBattle
text: Instead of using SURF all the time,\nyou should swim some.$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_GarrettRematchIntro
text: I have this strong feeling that\nI can win this time!$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_HughDefeat
text: Why me?!$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_HughIntro
text: Dress appropriately for battle!\nLose that frivolous outfit!$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_HughPostBattle
text: Even martial artists are becoming\nfashion conscious these days…$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_HughRematchIntro
text: Dress appropriately for battle!\nLose that frivolous outfit, I said!$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_KiaDefeat
text: KIA: Huh?!\nI can't believe it!$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_KiaIntro
text: KIA: My big brother and I make\nan awesome combination!$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_KiaNotEnoughMons
text: KIA: If you want to battle with\nus, you have to bring at least two\lPOKéMON with you.$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_KiaPostBattle
text: KIA: How could there be anyone\nbetter than my big brother?$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_KiaRematchIntro
text: KIA: My big brother and I make\nan awesome combination!\pWe won't lose this time!$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_MariaDefeat
text: Aiyeeeeh!$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_MariaIntro
text: The weather's gorgeous!\nPerfect for a battle!$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_MariaPostBattle
text: Please don't splash my face!\nYou'll ruin the makeup.$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_MariaRematchIntro
text: The weather's gorgeous!\nI'll try not to spoil it.$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_MikDefeat
text: MIK: Whoa!\nThat's too much!$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_MikIntro
text: MIK: Together with KIA, I'm afraid\nof nothing!$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_MikNotEnoughMons
text: MIK: Hey, do you want to battle\nwith us two?\pBring two or more POKéMON with\nyou, then.$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_MikPostBattle
text: MIK: How could my combination\nwith KIA fail?$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_MikRematchIntro
text: MIK: Together with KIA, we're\nafraid of nothing!\pWe'll prove it to you this time!$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_RouteSign
text: This is KINDLE ROAD.\pGo straight for MT. EMBER.$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_SharonDefeat
text: You were a cut above me.$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_SharonIntro
text: Could you help me out with my\ntraining?$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_SharonPostBattle
text: It's clear that you're skilled.\nI like you!$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_SharonRematchIntro
text: You'll help me out with my\ntraining again?$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_SheaDefeat
text: Gasp…\nGasp…$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_SheaIntro
text: Every morning, before breakfast,\nI swim around this island.$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_SheaPostBattle
text: I lost because I'm pooped from all\nthe running I did…$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_SheaRematchIntro
text: Every morning, before breakfast,\nI swim around this island…\lThree times!$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_TanyaDefeat
text: I'm such a fool!$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_TanyaIntro
text: There isn't a day in which we don't\ntrain!$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_TanyaPostBattle
text: I'll train even harder from now on!$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_TanyaRematchIntro
text: We haven't missed a single day of\ntraining yet!$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_TommyDefeat
text: I've lost it all again…$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_TommyIntro
text: Wait! Wait a second!\nI think I've hooked a big one!$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_TommyPostBattle
text: Not only did I lose, the big one\ngot away from me, too!$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_TommyRematchIntro
text: Wait! Wait a second!\nI'm sure I've hooked a big one!$

label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_AcceptedMeteoriteFromBill
text: {PLAYER} accepted the METEORITE\nfrom BILL.$

label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_AnotherGemstoneInSeviiIslands
text:
While I was studying gemstones,
I discovered something important.\pThere is another gem that forms
a pair with this RUBY.\pThat other gemstone is supposed to
be in the SEVII ISLANDS.\p{PLAYER}, please, I need you to go
find the other gem.\p{PLAYER}, may I have your ferry
PASS and the TOWN MAP?$

label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_BillBringMeUpToSpeed
text: BILL: So, bring me up to speed.\nHow's your machine running?$

label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_BillCantStomachMilk
text: {PLAYER}, is there anything that\nyou can't stand?\pApparently, BILL simply can't\nstomach milk at all.$

label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_BillCatchYouLater
text: BILL: I'll catch you later!\nSay hi to the guy for me!$

label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_BillHeyThereCelio
text: BILL: Hey, there!\nCELIO!$

label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_BillHowsYourResearchComing
text: BILL: Well, absolutely!\nHow's your research coming along?\p…Oh, wait a sec.$

label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_BillLetMeHelpYou
text: BILL: Oh, yeah?\nOkay, let me take a look-see.\p…Hang on here…\nI think we can make it work.\lLet me help you, okay?$

label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_BillOhHeyPlayer
text: BILL: Oh, hey!\n{PLAYER}!$

label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_BillWeGotItDone
text: BILL: What kept you so long?\nBeen out having a good time?\pWe got it done.\nThe PCs are up and running!$

label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_BillWeShouldHeadBackToKanto
text: BILL: Well, there you have it.\nI'm finished with the job.\lWe should head back to KANTO.\pCELIO, I'll be seeing you again.$

label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_BillYouveLearnedALot
text: BILL: No, no! There was almost\nnothing left for me to do.\pCELIO, I have to hand it to you.\nYou've learned a lot.$

label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_BillsFirstMonWasAbra
text:
{PLAYER}, what's your favorite kind
of POKéMON?\pBILL is a POKéMANIAC, so he loves
every kind.\pApparently, the first one he caught
was an ABRA.$

label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_BillsHometownInGoldenrod
text:
By the way, {PLAYER}, you're from
PALLET TOWN, aren't you?\pI've heard that it's a quiet and
pleasant place.\pBILL's hometown is GOLDENROD CITY,
where his folks still live.\pI've heard that it's quite the
festive, bustling city.\pI'd like to go there one day.$

label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_CameFromPalletDontKnowIt
text: Oh, you're a stranger here!\nHi! Where did you come from?\p…PALLET TOWN?\nI don't know it!$

label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_CanYouDeliverThisMeteoritePlayer
text:
{PLAYER}, can I get you to wait for
me just a bit?\p…Actually, can I get you to do
me a favor?\pThe island next to this one's
called TWO ISLAND.\pThere's a guy there that runs
a GAME CORNER.\pHe has this thing for rare rocks
and gems.\pWe keep in touch, being fellow
maniacs.\pSo, can I get you to deliver this
METEORITE to him?$

label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_CelioCantBelieveYouCameOut
text: CELIO: BILL!\nI can't believe you came out here.$

label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_CelioCaughtMoreMonMaybeICanBeUseful
text:
CELIO: {PLAYER}, how have things
been for you?\pOh, is that right?
You've caught more POKéMON.\pDo you know what?
Maybe I can be useful to you.$

label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_CelioHearingRumorsAboutYou
text: CELIO: Hello!\p{PLAYER}, I've been hearing rumors\nabout you.$

label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_CelioImModifyingMyNetworkMachine
text:
CELIO: Hello!
You look awfully busy as always.\pHow am I doing?\pWell, I'm modifying my Network
Machine.\pWhen I get done with the machine,
I hope you'll be first to use it,\l{PLAYER}.$

label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_CelioJobWentQuick
text: CELIO: The job went incredibly\nquick.\pBILL is one amazing guy…$

label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_CelioOhReallyEhehe
text: CELIO: Oh, really?\nEhehe…$

label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_CelioPCsCantLinkWithYours
text: CELIO: It's running fine, but we're\ntoo remote out here.\pThe PCs on this island just can't\nlink with your PC, BILL.$

label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_CelioPleaseTakeThis
text: CELIO: {PLAYER}, if you are going\nto TWO ISLAND, please take this.$

label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_CelioPromiseIllShowYouAroundSometime
text: CELIO: {PLAYER}, I'm really sorry\nthat we sent you off alone today.\pI promise, I will show you around\nthese islands sometime.$

label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_CelioThatsReallyImpressive
text: CELIO: That's really impressive.\pI hate to say it, but I have zero\naptitude for battling.\pAnyways, I'm glad to meet you.$

label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_EnormousVolcanoOnIsland
text: On this island, there's an enormous\nvolcano.\pIt hasn't erupted lately, so why\nnot enjoy a hike?$

label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_GotPCWorkingStrollAWhileMore
text:
Oh, hey, {PLAYER}!\pDid you see?
We got the PC working!\pI've got a few things to show
CELIO here.\pCan you go out on a stroll or
something for a while more?$

label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_HandedRubyToCelio
text: {PLAYER} handed the RUBY\nto CELIO.$

label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_HandedSapphireToCelio
text: {PLAYER} handed the SAPPHIRE\nto CELIO.$

label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_HmmHowAboutLikeThis
text: Hmm…\pHow about we try this like this…$

label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_LinkedUpWithLanette
text: I did it!\nI linked up with LANETTE!$

label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_MachineLinkedWithKanto
text: Network Machine\nLink Level 1\pLink established with the KANTO\nregion.$

label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_MachineLinkedWithKantoAndHoenn
text: Network Machine\nLink Level 2\pLink established with the KANTO\nand HOENN regions.$

label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_MachineUnderAdjustment
text: Network Machine\nLink Level 0\p…POKéMON Storage System under\nadjustment…$

label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_ManagedToLinkWithHoennThankYou
text:
{PLAYER}…
{PLAYER}, I did it!\pI've managed to link up with
TRAINERS in the HOENN region!\pFinally, the Network Machine is
fully operational!\p{PLAYER}, I owe it all to you!\pThanks to you, my dream came
true…$

label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_MayIAskOneMoreFavor
text: Thank you!\n{PLAYER}, you're simply amazing.\p… … …  … … …\pUm… May I ask one more giant favor\nof you?$

label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_NeedsSpecialGemstone
text: But, there is a slight catch.\pFor the link to work, the Machine\nneeds a special gemstone.\pIt's supposed to be on ONE ISLAND,\nbut I haven't found one yet.\pWho knows where it could be.$

label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_ObtainedExtraMapPage
text: Obtained an extra page for the\nTOWN MAP!$

label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_ObtainedTriPass
text: Obtained the TRI-PASS!$

label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_OhThats
text: Oh!\nTh-that's…$

label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_OkayThisIsGood
text: Okay, this is good…$

label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_PassLetYouGetToAllIslands
text: This is my own ferry PASS.\pIt will let you get to all the\nSEVII ISLANDS.\p{PLAYER}, please, I can't do\nit without your help.$

label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_PassLetsYouTravelBetweenIslands
text: It's a PASS for the ferry service\nserving the local islands.\pIt will let you travel between the\nISLANDS ONE, TWO, and THREE.\pOh, you should have this, too.$

label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_PlayerIsReigningPokemonChamp
text: CELIO, this is {PLAYER}, the\nreigning POKéMON CHAMP!$

label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_PlayerIsRisingPokemonChamp
text: CELIO, this is {PLAYER}, a rising\ncontender as the POKéMON CHAMP!$

label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_PleaseINeedYourHelp
text: It… It's not anything weird.\nPlease, I need your help.$

label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_ReceivedExtraPageForTownMap
text: {PLAYER} received an extra page\nfor the TOWN MAP!$

label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_ReceivedTownMap
text: {PLAYER} received\na TOWN MAP!$

label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_ReturnedTriPassForRainbowPass
text: {PLAYER} returned the TRI-PASS and\nreceived the RAINBOW PASS.$

label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_SorryForBeingPoorHost
text: I'm sorry for taking up so much of\nBILL's time.\pI'm also sorry for being such a \npoor host on your visit here.$

label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_ThankYouGiveMeTime
text:
CELIO: So this is the gem that
forms a pair with the RUBY…\p{PLAYER}, you've gone through a lot
to get this, didn't you?\pYou don't have to tell me. I know
it wasn't easy.\pThank you so much!\pNow it's my turn to work for you!
Please give me a little time.$

label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_ThisIsMyBuddyCelio
text: {PLAYER}, this is my buddy CELIO.\nHe's one dedicated PC MANIAC!$

label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_TradedWithFarAwayBoyfriend
text: I traded POKéMON with my boyfriend\nfar away!\pEveryone's saying that we can\nthank you and CELIO.\pSo, thank you!$

label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_TryingToFindGem
text:
I was trying to find the gem
even while I was studying.\pAs a result, I've made no headway
in both my search and studies…\pIf I relied on BILL, I'm sure my
research would progress.\pBut this time, I want to try to do
things by myself.$

label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_WishICouldTradeWithBoyfriend
text: I wish I could trade POKéMON with\nmy boyfriend who lives far away…$

label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_WishYouBestOfLuck
text: I…\nI'm not crying.\pThat's enough about me!\p{PLAYER}, you're going to keep\nlooking for exotic POKéMON, right?\pI wish you the best of luck!$

label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_YoullBeTradingFromTrainersFarAway
text:
I'm modifying the Network Machine
right now.\pI'm changing it so it can handle
trades over long distances.\pWhen I get finished, you'll be
trading for exotic POKéMON from\lTRAINERS far away.$

label: OneIsland_Text_BillLetsGoSeeCelio
text:
BILL: Here we are!
This is ONE ISLAND.\pThere are several islands around
here, and this is one of them.\pMy friend CELIO sent the boat to
fetch me here.\pHe's in charge of the island's PC
network by his lonesome.\p…Why am I telling you this now?
Let's just go see CELIO!$

label: OneIsland_Text_HavePCLinkageWithHoenn
text:
My granddaughter was in a tizzy
over a new breakthrough.\pShe said we finally have PC linkage
with people in HOENN.\pI'm not sure what that means, but
CELIO is quite the man.\pHe would make a fine husband for
my granddaughter!$

label: OneIsland_Text_HavePCLinkageWithKanto
text:
My granddaughter was in a tizzy
over a new breakthrough.\pShe said we now have PC linkage
with people in KANTO.\pI'm not sure what that means, but
CELIO is quite the man!$

label: OneIsland_Text_IslandSign
text: ONE ISLAND\nFriends Gather at Knot Island$

label: OneIsland_Text_IsntWarmClimateHereGreat
text: Hi, sight-seeing, are you?\nIsn't the warm climate here great?$

label: OneIsland_Text_LuckyToHaveCelioHere
text:
Here we are on an island smack in
the middle of nowhere.\pWe're lucky to have an upstanding
young man like CELIO here.\pMy granddaughter was in a tizzy
over CELIO's friend.\pSomething about a famous
POKéMANIAC?\pI'm not sure what that means, but
CELIO is quite the man!$

label: OneIsland_Text_PokemonNetCenterSign
text: Expanding the POKéMON World!\nPOKéMON NET CENTER$

label: OneIsland_TreasureBeach_Text_AmaraDefeat
text: I lost…\nIt feels awful.$

label: OneIsland_TreasureBeach_Text_AmaraIntro
text: Lying back, rocked by the waves…\nIt's exquisite.$

label: OneIsland_TreasureBeach_Text_AmaraPostBattle
text: The sea is pleasantly warm in these\nparts.$

label: OneIsland_TreasureBeach_Text_AmaraRematchIntro
text: Lying back, rocked by the waves…\nI don't notice time slipping by…$

label: OneIsland_TreasureBeach_Text_GoodThingsWashUpOnBeach
text: Good things get washed up by the\nocean current onto this beach.\pThat's why I often come here for\nsome beachcombing.$

label: PacifidlogTown_House1_Text_RegiStory
text:
In the HOENN region, there are three
POKéMON that represent the power of\lrock, ice, and steel.\pEach of them is said to hide away deep
inside caves.\pThat's the story I heard when I was
just a little kid.$

label: PacifidlogTown_House1_Text_SixDotsOpenThreeDoors
text: “Six dots open three doors.”\pGrandpa used to say that, but I don't\nknow what he meant.$

label: PacifidlogTown_House2_Text_AdoringPokemonTakeThis
text: It clearly likes you very much.\pA POKéMON that adoring and adorable\ndeserves a TM like this, no?$

label: PacifidlogTown_House2_Text_AhYourPokemon
text: Ah!\nYour POKéMON…$

label: PacifidlogTown_House2_Text_ChairmansYoungerBrotherOnVacation
text: Er-hem!\pI am the POKéMON FAN CLUB's most\nimportant person, the CHAIRMAN's\lyounger brother.\pI'm here enjoying my vacation with\nPOKéMON, yes, indeed.$

label: PacifidlogTown_House2_Text_DoesntLikeTrainerVeryMuch
text: It doesn't appear to like the TRAINER\nvery much.$

label: PacifidlogTown_House2_Text_ExplainReturnFrustration
text: If a POKéMON likes you a lot, RETURN's\npower is enhanced.\pIf it doesn't like you, FRUSTRATION's\npower goes up.$

label: PacifidlogTown_House2_Text_GetGoodTMInXDays
text: Oh, yes. In about {STR_VAR_1} or so days,\nI should be getting a good TM or two.\pYou should come see me then.\nI'll give you a TM that's suitable for\lyour POKéMON.$

label: PacifidlogTown_House2_Text_PutInSomeMoreEffort
text: Hmm…\nIt's not bad, but it's also not good.\pYou, as the TRAINER, need to put in\nsome more effort.$

label: PacifidlogTown_House2_Text_Rurii
text: AZURILL: Rurii.$

label: PacifidlogTown_House2_Text_Rururi
text: AZURILL: Rururi!$

label: PacifidlogTown_House2_Text_VeryFriendlyWithTrainer
text: It appears to be very friendly with the\nTRAINER.$

label: PacifidlogTown_House2_Text_ViciousPokemonTakeThis
text: It has a vicious look to it.\pA frightening POKéMON like that\ndeserves a TM like this.$

label: PacifidlogTown_House3_Text_IsThatAPokedex
text: Is that a POKéDEX?\pDid you get to meet a lot of different\nPOKéMON?\pI wish I was like you.$

label: PacifidlogTown_House3_Text_ItsSubtlyDifferentThankYou
text: Oh, so this is a {STR_VAR_1}?\pIt's sort of like a {STR_VAR_2},\nand yet it's subtly different.\pThank you!$

label: PacifidlogTown_House3_Text_NotDesperateOrAnything
text: Oh, so you're not going to go through\nwith this?\pThat's cool. I'm not desperate to make\na trade or anything.$

label: PacifidlogTown_House3_Text_ReallyWantedToGetBagon
text: I know I could go looking for one\non my own, but…\pBut I really wanted to get a BAGON\nthat another TRAINER caught…$

label: PacifidlogTown_House3_Text_WillingToTradeIt
text:
Check out this {STR_VAR_2}!\pIt's the {STR_VAR_2} that I caught
yesterday to celebrate my birthday!\pOh, I can see that you want it!
After all, it's priceless!\pI'll tell you what. I might be willing
to trade it for a {STR_VAR_1}.$

label: PacifidlogTown_House3_Text_WontAcceptAnyLessThanRealMon
text: No, no, no! I won't accept any\nless than a real {STR_VAR_1}!$

label: PacifidlogTown_House4_Text_PeopleSawHighFlyingPokemon
text: People were saying they saw a POKéMON\nflying high above HOENN.\pIs it flying around all the time?\nDoesn't it need to rest somewhere?$

label: PacifidlogTown_House4_Text_SkyPokemon
text: A sky POKéMON!\nA sky POKéMON!$

label: PacifidlogTown_House4_Text_WhereDidYouComeFrom
text: Where did you come from?$

label: PacifidlogTown_House4_Text_YesTown
text: Yes?\nYES TOWN?\pI've never heard of a place like that.$

label: PacifidlogTown_House4_Text_YouHaveToComeFromSomewhere
text: No? That doesn't make any sense.\nYou have to come from somewhere.\pOh! Wait! You're not going to say you\nwere born at the bottom of the sea?$

label: PacifidlogTown_House5_Text_CanSeeMirageIslandToday
text: Oh! Oh my!\nI can see MIRAGE ISLAND today!$

label: PacifidlogTown_House5_Text_CantSeeMirageIslandToday
text: I can't see MIRAGE ISLAND today…$

label: PacifidlogTown_House5_Text_MirageIslandAppearDependingOnWeather
text: MIRAGE ISLAND…\pIt must become visible and invisible\ndepending on the weather conditions\lthat make mirages appear.\pOr is it really appearing and\ndisappearing?$

label: PacifidlogTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_AncestorsLivedOnBoats
text: The ancestors of the people in\nPACIFIDLOG were said to have been\lborn on boats and then lived and died \laboard them.\pI understand that they lived that way\nbecause they were searching for\lsomething.$

label: PacifidlogTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_OnColonyOfCorsola
text: PACIFIDLOG TOWN floats on top of\na colony of CORSOLA.\pIf I told you that, would you believe\nme?$

label: PacifidlogTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_WhatColorTrainerCard
text: What color is your TRAINER CARD?\nMine's copper!$

label: PacifidlogTown_Text_FastRunningCurrent
text: The sea between PACIFIDLOG and\nSLATEPORT has a fast-running tide.\pIf you decide to SURF, you could end\nup swept away somewhere else.$

label: PacifidlogTown_Text_NeatHousesOnWater
text: See, isn't it neat?\nThese houses are on water!\pI was born here!$

label: PacifidlogTown_Text_SkyPillarTooScary
text:
The SKY PILLAR?\p…Oh, you must mean that tall, tall
tower a little further out.\pIf you asked me, I wouldn't climb it.
It's too scary to get up that high.\pLife at sea level in PACIFIDLOG,
that suits me fine.$

label: PacifidlogTown_Text_TownSign
text: PACIFIDLOG TOWN\p“Where the morning sun smiles upon\nthe waters.”$

label: PalletTown_PlayersHouse_1F_Text_AllBoysLeaveOakLookingForYou
text: MOM: …Right.\nYou chose your own time to set out.\lIt said so on TV.\pOh, yes. PROF. OAK, next door, was\nlooking for you.$

label: PalletTown_PlayersHouse_1F_Text_AllGirlsLeaveOakLookingForYou
text: MOM: …Right.\nYou chose your own time to set out.\lIt said so on TV.\pOh, yes. PROF. OAK, next door, was\nlooking for you.$

label: PalletTown_PlayersHouse_1F_Text_LookingGreatTakeCare
text: MOM: Oh, good! You and your\nPOKéMON are looking great.\lTake care now!$

label: PalletTown_PlayersHouse_1F_Text_MovieOnTVFourBoysOnRailroad
text: There's a movie on TV.\nFour boys are walking on railroad\ltracks.\p…I better go, too.$

label: PalletTown_PlayersHouse_1F_Text_MovieOnTVGirlOnBrickRoad
text: There's a movie on TV.\nA girl with her hair in pigtails is\lwalking up a brick road.\p…I better go, too.$

label: PalletTown_PlayersHouse_1F_Text_OopsWrongSide
text: Oops, wrong side…$

label: PalletTown_PlayersHouse_1F_Text_YouShouldTakeQuickRest
text: MOM: {PLAYER}!\nYou should take a quick rest.$

label: PalletTown_PlayersHouse_2F_Text_PlayedWithNES
text: {PLAYER} played with the NES.\p…Okay!\nIt's time to go!$

label: PalletTown_PlayersHouse_2F_Text_PressLRForHelp
text: It's a posted notice…\pIf you're confused, ask for HELP!\nPress the L or R Button!$

label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_AllMonTypesHaveStrongAndWeakPoints
text: All POKéMON types have strong and\nweak points against others.$

label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_BlankEncyclopedia
text: It's like an encyclopedia, but the\npages are blank.$

label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_DaisyWillGroomMons
text:
Hi, {PLAYER}. I bet you've become
good friends with your POKéMON.\pBy the way, did you know about
DAISY?\pIf you show DAISY your POKéMON,
she can tell how much it likes you.\pOccasionally, she will even groom
a POKéMON for you.\pThis is a secret, so please don't
tell anyone.$

label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_DeliveredOaksParcel
text: {PLAYER} delivered OAK'S PARCEL.$

label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_EmailMessage
text:
There's an e-mail message here.\p…\pFinally!
The ultimate TRAINERS of the\lPOKéMON LEAGUE are ready to\ltake on all comers!\pBring your best POKéMON and see
how you rate as a TRAINER!\pPOKéMON LEAGUE HQ
INDIGO PLATEAU\pPROF. OAK, please visit us!
…$

label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakAddedNothingToPokedex
text:
Ah, {PLAYER}!
How is your POKéDEX shaping up?\p{RIVAL} has already caught some
POKéMON and added to the data.\pSo, {PLAYER}, let's have a look at
your POKéDEX.\p…What's the matter?
You've added no new data at all.\pI'll give you these, so do try a
little harder.$

label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakBattleMonForItToGrow
text: OAK: {PLAYER}, raise your young\nPOKéMON by making it battle.\pIt has to battle for it to grow.$

label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakBePatientRival
text: OAK: Be patient, {RIVAL}.\nYou can have one, too!$

label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakCanReachNextTownWithMon
text: OAK: If a wild POKéMON appears,\nyour POKéMON can battle it.\pWith it at your side, you should be\nable to reach the next town.$

label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakCatchMonsForDataTakeThese
text:
OAK: You can't get detailed data
on POKéMON by just seeing them.\pYou must catch them to obtain
complete data.\pSo, here are some tools for
catching wild POKéMON.$

label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakChoosingBulbasaur
text: I see! BULBASAUR is your choice.\nIt's very easy to raise.\pSo, {PLAYER}, you want to go with\nthe GRASS POKéMON BULBASAUR?$

label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakChoosingCharmander
text: Ah! CHARMANDER is your choice.\nYou should raise it patiently.\pSo, {PLAYER}, you're claiming the\nFIRE POKéMON CHARMANDER?$

label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakChoosingSquirtle
text: Hm! SQUIRTLE is your choice.\nIt's one worth raising.\pSo, {PLAYER}, you've decided on the\nWATER POKéMON SQUIRTLE?$

label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakComeSeeMeSometime
text: OAK: Come see me sometime.\pAfter all, I want to know how your\nPOKéDEX is coming along.$

label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakCompleteMonGuideWasMyDream
text:
To make a complete guide on all
the POKéMON in the world…\pThat was my dream!\pBut, I'm too old.
I can't get the job done.\pSo, I want you two to fulfill my
dream for me.\pGet moving, you two.\pThis is a great undertaking in
POKéMON history!$

label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakCustomBallIOrdered
text: Ah! \nIt's the custom POKé BALL!\pI had it on order.\nThank you!$

label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakExplainCatching
text:
When a wild POKéMON appears,
it's fair game.\pJust throw a POKé BALL at it and
try to catch it!\pThis won't always work, however.\pA healthy POKéMON can escape.
You have to be lucky!$

label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakFavorToAskYouPlayer
text: Ah, now this is excellent!\p{PLAYER}, I have another important\nfavor to ask of you.\pI need you to listen closely.$

label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakHaveRequestForYouTwo
text: OAK: Oh, right!\nI have a request for you two.$

label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakHaveSomethingForMe
text:
OAK: Oh, {PLAYER}!
How is my old POKéMON?\pWell, it seems to be growing more
attached to you.\pYou must be talented as a POKéMON
TRAINER.\pWhat's that?
You have something for me?$

label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakHeyDontGoAwayYet
text: OAK: Hey!\nDon't go away yet!$

label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakIsAuthorityOnMons
text: PROF. OAK may not look like much,\nbut he's the authority on POKéMON.\pMany POKéMON TRAINERS hold him in\nhigh regard.$

label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakIsGoingToHaveRadioShow
text: PROF. OAK is going to have his own\nradio show soon.\pThe program will be called PROF.\nOAK's POKéMON SEMINAR.$

label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakMonsAroundWorldWait
text: POKéMON around the world wait for\nyou, {PLAYER}!$

label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakMustReallyWorkToFillPokedex
text:
Now, {PLAYER} and {RIVAL}!\pThis time, you really must work
towards filling your POKéDEXES.\pI urge you to make them the best
and the most complete of all time!\pTruly, this is a monumentally great
undertaking in POKéMON history!$

label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakNeedYourHelpTooNeedToSeePokedexes
text: OAK: I know, I know.\nOf course I need your help, too.\pNow, I need to see both your\nPOKéDEXES.$

label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakNowTheseUnitsCanRecordMoreData
text: … … …  … … …\p… … …  … … …\p…And that's done!\pNow these units can record data on\na lot more POKéMON.$

label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakPokedexOnDesk
text: On the desk there is my invention,\nthe POKéDEX!\pIt automatically records data on\nPOKéMON you've seen or caught.\pIt's a high-tech encyclopedia!$

label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakSightingsOfRareMons
text:
Recently, there have been sightings
of many rare POKéMON species.\pI'm talking about POKéMON that
have never been seen in KANTO.\pI would love to go see things for
myself, but I'm much too old.\pSince I can't do it, {PLAYER}, I'd
like you to go in my place.$

label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakTakeTheseWithYou
text: OAK: {PLAYER} and {RIVAL}.\nTake these with you.$

label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakThisMonIsEnergetic
text: This POKéMON is really quite\nenergetic!$

label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakThreeMonsChooseOne
text:
OAK: {RIVAL}?
Let me think…\pOh, that's right, I told you to
come! Just wait!\pHere, {PLAYER}.\pThere are three POKéMON here.\pHaha!\pThe POKéMON are held inside
these POKé BALLS.\pWhen I was young, I was a serious
POKéMON TRAINER.\pBut now, in my old age, I have
only these three left.\pYou can have one.
Go on, choose!$

label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakTookBothPokedexUnits
text: PROF. OAK took both POKéDEX\nunits.$

label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakWhichOneWillYouChoose
text: OAK: Now, {PLAYER}.\pInside those three POKé BALLS are\nPOKéMON.\pWhich one will you choose for\nyourself?$

label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OaksLastMon
text: That's PROF. OAK's last POKéMON.$

label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_PlayersPokedexWasUpgraded
text: {PLAYER}'s POKéDEX was upgraded!$

label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_PressStartToOpenMenu
text: Press START to open the MENU!$

label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_ReceivedFivePokeBalls
text: {PLAYER} received five POKé BALLS.$

label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_ReceivedMonFromOak
text: {PLAYER} received the {STR_VAR_1}\nfrom PROF. OAK!$

label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_ReceivedPokedexFromOak
text: {PLAYER} received the POKéDEX\nfrom PROF. OAK.$

label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_RivalDefeat
text: WHAT?\nUnbelievable!\lI picked the wrong POKéMON!$

label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_RivalFedUpWithWaiting
text: {RIVAL}: Gramps!\nI'm fed up with waiting!$

label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_RivalGoChoosePlayer
text: {RIVAL}: Heh, I don't need to be\ngreedy like you. I'm mature!\pGo ahead and choose, {PLAYER}!$

label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_RivalGoToughenMyMon
text: {RIVAL}: Okay! I'll make my\nPOKéMON battle to toughen it up!\p{PLAYER}! Gramps!\nSmell you later!$

label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_RivalGramps
text: {RIVAL}: Gramps!$

label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_RivalGrampsIsntAround
text: {RIVAL}: What, it's only {PLAYER}?\nGramps isn't around.$

label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_RivalIllCompleteThePokedex
text:
{RIVAL}: Gramps, calm down.
Don't get so excited.\pI'll get the POKéDEX completed,
don't you worry about a thing.\pI think I'll try looking around
ONE ISLAND first…\pAnyways, I'm outta here!$

label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_RivalIllTakeThisOneThen
text: {RIVAL}: I'll take this one, then!$

label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_RivalJustLetMeHandleEverything
text:
{RIVAL}: Hey, I heard that!\pGramps, what's with favoring
{PLAYER} over me all the time?\pI went and collected more POKéMON,
and faster, too.\pYou should just let me handle
everything.$

label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_RivalLeaveItToMeGramps
text: {RIVAL}: All right, Gramps!\nLeave it all to me!$

label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_RivalLetsCheckOutMons
text: {RIVAL}: Wait, {PLAYER}!\nLet's check out our POKéMON!\pCome on, I'll take you on!$

label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_RivalMyMonLooksTougher
text: {RIVAL}: My POKéMON looks a lot\ntougher than yours.$

label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_RivalNoFairWhatAboutMe
text: {RIVAL}: Hey! Gramps! No fair!\nWhat about me?$

label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_RivalReceivedMonFromOak
text: {RIVAL} received the {STR_VAR_1}\nfrom PROF. OAK!$

label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_RivalTellSisNotToGiveYouMap
text:
{PLAYER}, I hate to say it, but you
won't be necessary for this.\pI know! I'll borrow a TOWN MAP
from my sis!\pI'll tell her not to lend you one,
{PLAYER}! Hahaha!\pDon't bother coming around to
my place after this!$

label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_RivalWhatDidYouCallMeFor
text: {RIVAL}: I almost forgot!\nWhat did you call me for?$

label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_SaveOptionInMenu
text: The SAVE option is on the MENU.\nUse it regularly.$

label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_StudyAsOaksAide
text: I study POKéMON as PROF. OAK's\nAIDE.$

label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_ThoseArePokeBalls
text: Those are POKé BALLS.\nThey contain POKéMON!$

label: PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_CantGroomAnEgg
text: Oh, sorry. I honestly can't\ngroom an EGG.$

label: PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_CouldntLoveYouMore
text: It couldn't possibly love you\nany more than it does now.\pYour POKéMON is happy beyond\nwords.$

label: PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_DontHaveSpaceForThis
text: You don't have space for this in\nyour BAG.$

label: PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_DontLikeWayItGlaresAtYou
text: {PLAYER}, I don't like the way it\nglares at you.\pCould you try being a little nicer\nto it?$

label: PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_DontNeedAnyGrooming
text: You don't need any grooming done?\nOkay, we'll just have tea.$

label: PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_ErrandForGrandpaThisWillHelp
text: Grandpa asked you to run an\nerrand?\pGee, that's lazy of him.\nHere, this will help you.$

label: PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_ExplainTownMap
text: You can use the TOWN MAP to find\nout where you are, or check the\lnames of places.$

label: PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_GroomWhichOne
text: Which one should I groom?$

label: PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_HeardYouBattledRival
text: DAISY: {PLAYER}, I heard you had\na battle against {RIVAL}.\pI wish I'd seen that!$

label: PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_HiBrothersAtLab
text: DAISY: Hi, {PLAYER}!\pMy brother, {RIVAL}, is out at\nGrandpa's LAB.$

label: PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_ItLooksVeryHappy
text: It looks very happy.\pI wish {RIVAL} could see this and\nlearn something from it.$

label: PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_ItsBigMapOfKanto
text: It's a big map of the KANTO region.\nNow this would be useful!$

label: PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_ItsQuiteFriendly
text: It's quite friendly with you.\nKeep being good to it!$

label: PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_ItsWarmingUpToYou
text: It's warming up to you.\nTrust must be growing between you.$

label: PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_LikeMeToGroomMon
text:
DAISY: Hi, {PLAYER}!
Good timing.\pI'm about to have some tea.
Would you like to join me?\pOh, but look.
Your POKéMON are a little dirty.\pWould you like me to groom one?$

label: PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_LookingNiceInNoTime
text: DAISY: Okay, I'll get it looking\nnice in no time.$

label: PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_LovelyAndSweetClefairy
text: “The lovely and sweet\nCLEFAIRY”$

label: PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_MayISeeFirstMon
text: DAISY: Your POKéMON grow to love\nyou if you raise them with love.\pFor example, {PLAYER}, may I see\nyour first POKéMON?$

label: PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_NotFamiliarWithYouYet
text: It's not quite familiar with you\nyet.\pPOKéMON are all quite wary when\nyou first get them.$

label: PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_PleaseGiveMonsRest
text: DAISY: Just like people, POKéMON\nare living things.\pWhen they get tired, please give\nthem a rest.$

label: PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_ReceivedTownMapFromDaisy
text: {PLAYER} received a TOWN MAP\nfrom DAISY.$

label: PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_ShelvesCrammedFullOfBooks
text: The shelves are crammed full of\nbooks on POKéMON.$

label: PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_WhyWouldMonHateYouSoMuch
text: …Um, it's not easy for me to say\nthis, but…\pIs there some reason why your\nPOKéMON would hate you so much?$

label: PalletTown_Text_CanStoreItemsAndMonsInPC
text: Technology is incredible!\pYou can now store and recall items\nand POKéMON as data via PC.$

label: PalletTown_Text_CaughtXImpressiveFollowMe
text:
You've caught… {STR_VAR_2}!?
Now, this is impressive!\pThere's something I wanted to ask
of you, {PLAYER}.\pCome.
Follow me.$

label: PalletTown_Text_CaughtXPuttingInHonestEffort
text: You've caught {STR_VAR_2}…\pHm, it looks as if you're putting\nin an honest effort.\pWhen you manage to fill it some\nmore, come show me, please.$

label: PalletTown_Text_HmmIsThatRight
text: Hmm…\nIs that right…$

label: PalletTown_Text_LookCopiedTrainerTipsSign
text: Look, look!\pI copied what it said on one of\nthose TRAINER TIPS signs!$

label: PalletTown_Text_OakDontGoOut
text: OAK: Hey! Wait!\nDon't go out!$

label: PalletTown_Text_OakGrassUnsafeNeedMon
text:
OAK: It's unsafe!
Wild POKéMON live in tall grass!\pYou need your own POKéMON for
your protection.\pI know!
Here, come with me!$

label: PalletTown_Text_OakLetMeSeePokedex
text: OAK: Ah, {PLAYER}!\nYou're back, are you?\pHow much have you filled in your\nPOKéDEX?\pMay I see it?\pLet's see…$

label: PalletTown_Text_OakPokemonResearchLab
text: OAK POKéMON RESEARCH LAB$

label: PalletTown_Text_OakYouEnjoyingTraveling
text:
OAK: Ah, {PLAYER}!
You seem to be enjoying traveling.\pKnowing you, {PLAYER}, I can easily
imagine you going out to even more\lexotic locales.\pGood for you, good for you.
Hohoho.$

label: PalletTown_Text_OhLookLook
text: Oh!\nLook, look!$

label: PalletTown_Text_PlayersHouse
text: {PLAYER}'s house$

label: PalletTown_Text_PressStartToOpenMenu
text: TRAINER TIPS\pPress START to open the MENU!$

label: PalletTown_Text_PressStartToOpenMenuCopy
text: TRAINER TIPS!\pPress START to open the MENU!$

label: PalletTown_Text_RaisingMonsToo
text: I'm raising POKéMON, too.\pWhen they get strong, they can\nprotect me.$

label: PalletTown_Text_ReadItReadIt
text: Read it, read it!$

label: PalletTown_Text_RivalsHouse
text: {RIVAL}'s house$

label: PalletTown_Text_SignsAreUsefulArentThey
text: Signs are useful, aren't they?$

label: PalletTown_Text_TownSign
text: PALLET TOWN\nShades of your journey await!$

label: ParallelWatch_Text_Found
text: The hands turn in opposite directions.$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_AlexiaDefeat
text: Our defenses weren't enough…$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_AlexiaIntro
text: The higher the DEFENSE, the more\nreckless I can be in attack.$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_AlexiaPostBadge
text: Hi! Have you tried using SURF?$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_AlexiaPostBattle
text:
I think you've taught me a valuable
lesson here.\pNow, go on! The left door goes to
the STRENGTH ROOM.\pThe right door opens to
the ONE-HIT KO ROOM.\pBoth of them have TRAINERS who are
skilled at offense.$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_BerkeDefeat
text: Your power…\nYou're the real deal.$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_BerkeIntro
text: I'm not going to take it easy just\nbecause you're our LEADER's kid.\pI'll show you how horrid it is for\na POKéMON to take a critical hit!$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_BerkePostBadge
