text: Since your dad became the LEADER,\nthe TRAINERS of PETALBURG CITY have\lbecome a lot tougher.$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_BerkePostBattle
text:
Your father really is strong.
He's a TRAINER worth my respect.\pAnd, I sense the same glow coming
from you as your father.\pI hope that you'll stage a terrific
battle with your father!$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_DadGoCollectBadges
text:
DAD: Now…\p{PLAYER}, if you want to become a
strong TRAINER, here's my advice.\pHead for RUSTBORO CITY beyond this
town.\pThere, you should challenge
the GYM LEADER, ROXANNE.\pAfter her, go on to other POKéMON
GYMS and defeat their LEADERS.\pCollect BADGES from them,
understood?\pOf course, I'm a GYM LEADER, too.
We'll battle one day, {PLAYER}.\pBut that's only after you become
stronger.$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_DadGoingToKeepTraining
text:
DAD: {PLAYER}, you should go visit
your mother every so often.\pI'm going to stay here and redouble
my training.\pIt would bother me as a TRAINER to
not avenge my loss to you, {PLAYER}!$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_DadHappyAndSad
text: DAD: As the GYM LEADER, I can't\nexpress how upset I am…\pBut as a father, it makes me both\nhappy and a little sad. It's odd…$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_DadHmISee
text: DAD: Hm. I see.$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_DadNoAmountOfTrainingIsEnough
text: DAD: {PLAYER}, how are things going?\pThe world of POKéMON is deep.\pI honestly think that no amount of\ntraining would ever be enough.$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_DadOhYoureWallyRight
text: DAD: Hm? You're… Uh… Oh, right.\nYou're WALLY, right?$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_DadPlayerGoWithWally
text: DAD: {PLAYER}, you heard that,\nright?\pGo with WALLY and make sure that he\nsafely catches a POKéMON.$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_DadSoDidItWorkOut
text: DAD: So, did it work out?$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_DadYoureHereWithYourPokemon
text:
DAD: Hm?\pWell, if it isn't {PLAYER}!
So you're all finished moving in?\pI'm surprised that you managed to
get here by yourself.\pOh, I see.
You're with your POKéMON.\pHm… Then I guess you're going to
become a TRAINER like me, {PLAYER}.\pThat's great news!
I'll be looking forward to it!$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_DoorAppearsLocked
text: This door appears to be locked\nright now…$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_EnterAccuracyRoom
text: “ACCURACY ROOM,” the sign says.\pDo you want to go through?$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_EnterConfusionRoom
text: “CONFUSION ROOM,” the sign says.\pDo you want to go through?$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_EnterDefenseRoom
text: “DEFENSE ROOM,” the sign says.\pDo you want to go through?$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_EnterGymLeadersRoom
text: “GYM LEADER'S ROOM\p“See for yourself what POKéMON await\nyou!” the sign says.\pDo you want to go through?$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_EnterOHKORoom
text: “ONE-HIT KO ROOM,” the sign says.\pDo you want to go through?$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_EnterRecoveryRoom
text: “RECOVERY ROOM,” the sign says.\pDo you want to go through?$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_EnterSpeedRoom
text: “SPEED ROOM,” the sign says.\pDo you want to go through?$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_EnterStrengthRoom
text: “STRENGTH ROOM,” the sign says.\pDo you want to go through?$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_ExplainBalanceBadgeTakeThis
text:
DAD: With that BADGE, the DEFENSE
of all your POKéMON will increase.\pPOKéMON that know the HM move SURF
will be able to travel over water.\pThis is my gift to you. {PLAYER}, I'm
sure you can use it correctly.$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_ExplainFacade
text: DAD: TM42 contains FACADE.\pIt doubles the power of moves if\nthe POKéMON is poisoned, paralyzed,\lor burned.\pIt might be able to turn a bad\nsituation into an advantage.$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_GeorgeDefeat
text: I couldn't restore HP enough…\nWhat ATTACK power…$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_GeorgeIntro
text:
Just when you think you're going to
win, your opponent restores HP…\pCan you just imagine how awful that
must feel?\pI'll show you exactly how awful it
feels!$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_GeorgePostBadge
text: I'm going to keep training at GYMS.\nOne day, I'll become a LEADER.$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_GeorgePostBattle
text:
I should have expected no less from
our LEADER's kid.\pNo, wait! A TRAINER's abilities are
earned only through effort.\pI lost because my own efforts
weren't enough.\pGo on! The ONE-HIT KO ROOM is next.$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_GiveEnigmaBerry
text: DAD: Hi, {PLAYER}!\pI just received a very rare BERRY.\nI'd like you to have it.$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_GymGuideAdvice
text:
Hey, how's it going, CHAMPION-
bound {PLAYER}?\pThe doors in this GYM open when you
beat the awaiting TRAINERS.\pWhoops! The doors in this room are
already open, so don't attack me!\pThe TRAINERS of PETALBURG GYM
use all kinds of items.\pThe door at the left leads to
the SPEED ROOM.\pThe door at the right leads to
the ACCURACY ROOM.\pThe room's name will be on
the door, so choose carefully.\pOnce you've chosen the door…
Well, hey, go for it!$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_GymGuidePostVictory
text: {PLAYER}! Whoa! You've overcome even\nyour own father!\pLike, whoa!\nWhat a stunning turn of events!$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_GymStatue
text: PETALBURG CITY POKéMON GYM$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_GymStatueCertified
text: PETALBURG CITY POKéMON GYM\pNORMAN'S CERTIFIED TRAINERS:\n{PLAYER}$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_IllLoanYouMyZigzagoon
text: WALLY, here, I'll loan you my POKéMON.\pWALLY received a ZIGZAGOON!$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_JodyDefeat
text: But… I went all out!$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_JodyIntro
text: Our GYM LEADER told us to go all out\nand beat you.\pEven if you happen to be the\nLEADER's kid!$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_JodyPostBadge
text: Sure, it's fine to make your POKéMON\nstronger.\pBut what decides the winner?\pWhy, it's the feelings TRAINERS have\nfor their POKéMON.$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_JodyPostBattle
text: The way you use your POKéMON…\nIt's like your father's style.\pGo on through! The GYM LEADER, your\nfather, is waiting!$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_LetMeBorrowPlayer
text: NORMAN, you don't mind, do you?\pLet me borrow your {PLAYER}{KUN} for\na minute or two.$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_MaryDefeat
text: You were a cut above me…$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_MaryIntro
text: Giggle…\nThis is the ACCURACY ROOM.\pIt's pretty nasty when every attack\nlands without fail.$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_MaryPostBadge
text: Do you know what we're trying to\nachieve as TRAINERS?\pWe're striving to become soul mates\nwith our POKéMON.$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_MaryPostBattle
text:
There are some even stronger
TRAINERS waiting for you.\pThe left is the DEFENSE ROOM, and
the right is the RECOVERY ROOM.\pYour POKéMON's ATTACK power will be
on trial either way.$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_NormanDefeat
text: …\pI… I can't…\pI can't believe it. {PLAYER}…\pI lost to {PLAYER}?\pBut, rules are rules!\nHere, take this.$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_NormanGoToDewford
text:
DAD: I see… So, you've beaten
the GYM LEADER in RUSTBORO CITY.\pBut there are many more TRAINERS
who are stronger than you, {PLAYER}.\pAcross the sea in DEWFORD TOWN is a
GYM LEADER named BRAWLY.\pYou should go challenge him.$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_NormanGoToRustboro
text:
DAD: Hm? Aren't you going to the
POKéMON GYM in RUSTBORO CITY?\pThere's no challenge for me to
battle a greenhorn TRAINER.\p{PLAYER}, I want you to challenge me
when you become a lot stronger.\pI'll battle you, {PLAYER}, when you
can show me four GYM BADGES, okay?$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_NormanIntro
text:
DAD: Hm…
So, you did get four GYM BADGES.\pFine, as I promised, we will have
a POKéMON battle.\p{PLAYER}…\pI'm so happy that I can have
a real battle with my own child.\pBut, a battle is a battle!\pI will do everything in my power as
a GYM LEADER to win.\p{PLAYER}, you'd better give it your
best shot, too!$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_NormanPostRematch
text: DAD: {PLAYER}…\nWhat is your dream?\pMy dream…\nHahaha…\lIt has already come true, actually.$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_NormanPreRematch
text:
DAD: {PLAYER}…
I had a feeling that you would come.\pI would never refuse to accept
a challenge from you.\pYou do understand, don't you?\pInside a GYM, it doesn't matter that
we are a parent and child.\p…No, because we are parent and child,
we owe it to each other to do the best\lwe can. Isn't that right, {PLAYER}?$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_NormanRematchDefeat
text: Uh… Haha…\nMaybe that was going too hard…$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_NormanRematchNeedTwoMons
text:
DAD: {PLAYER}…
I had a feeling that you would come.\pI would never refuse to accept
a challenge from you.\pYou do understand, don't you?\pInside a GYM, it doesn't matter that
we are a parent and child.\pHm? Wait a second, {PLAYER}.\pDo you only have one POKéMON that is
capable of battle?\pSorry, but you'll have to come back
with at least two POKéMON.$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_ParkerDefeat
text: I couldn't confuse your team enough…\nYou share a strong bond together.$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_ParkerIntro
text: This is the CONFUSION ROOM.\pLet me see how well bonded you are\nwith your POKéMON!$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_ParkerPostBadge
text: After you beat our LEADER, the\ntraining has become a lot tougher.$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_ParkerPostBattle
text: The next room is the STRENGTH ROOM.\nCan you withstand brute force?$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_PleaseComeWithMe
text: Ah, there you are, {PLAYER}{KUN}!\pPlease come with me.\nI have something I want you to have.$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_RandallDefeat
text: That was a magnificent battle!$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_RandallIntro
text: The ability to attack before the\nopponent…\pJust that alone puts me at a great\nadvantage, don't you agree?$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_RandallPostBadge
text: Whomever you beat, and whomever you\nmay lose to, you never shirk from\ltraining yourself and your POKéMON.\pThat's what I think being a\nGYM LEADER is all about.$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_RandallPostBattle
text: Go on to the next room where a new\nchallenge awaits you.\pAt the left is the CONFUSION ROOM.\pThe right door leads to the DEFENSE\nROOM.$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_ReceivedBalanceBadge
text: {PLAYER} received the BALANCE BADGE\nfrom DAD!$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_WallyIdLikeAPokemon
text: Um… I…\nI'd like to get a POKéMON, please…$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_WallyIveNeverCaughtAPokemon
text:
WALLY: I'm going to go stay with my
relatives in VERDANTURF TOWN.\pI thought I would be lonely by myself,
so I wanted to take a POKéMON along.\pBut I've never caught a POKéMON before.
I don't know how…$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_WallyOhWowThankYou
text: WALLY: Oh, wow!\nThank you!$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_WallyThankYouAndDadGivesPokeBall
text: WALLY: Oh, wow!\nA POKéMON!\pDAD: Hm. I'll give you a POKé BALL, too.\nGo for it!\pWALLY received a POKé BALL!$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_WallyThankYouBye
text:
WALLY: Thank you, yes, it did.
Here's your POKéMON back.\p{PLAYER}, thank you for coming along
with me.\pYou two are why I was able to catch
my POKéMON.\pI promise I'll take really good
care of it.\pOh! My mom's waiting for me,
so I have to go!\pBye, {PLAYER}!$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_WouldYouReallyComeWithMe
text: {PLAYER}… Would you really come\nwith me?$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_YouHaveGottenStronger
text: DAD: Hm… {PLAYER}, you have gotten\nstronger.\pI can tell by the number of BADGES\nthat you've earned.$

label: PetalburgCity_House1_Text_GoOnAdventure
text:
Sigh…\pI wish I could go on an adventure
with some POKéMON…\pCrawl through some damp grass…
Climb rocky, rugged mountains…\pCross the raging seas…
Wander about in dark caves…\pAnd, sometimes, even get a little
homesick…\pIt must be fabulous to travel!$

label: PetalburgCity_House1_Text_TravelingIsWonderful
text: Traveling is wonderful!\pWhen I was young, I roamed the seas\nand the mountains!$

label: PetalburgCity_House2_Text_BattledNormanOnce
text: I battled NORMAN once, but, whew,\nhe was way too strong.\pHow would I put it?\pI just got the feeling that he\nlives for POKéMON.$

label: PetalburgCity_House2_Text_NormanBecameGymLeader
text: NORMAN became our town's new\nGYM LEADER.\pI think he called his family over from\nsomewhere far away.$

label: PetalburgCity_Mart_Text_RepelIsUseful
text: Do you use REPEL?\nIt keeps POKéMON away, so it's\luseful when you're in a hurry.$

label: PetalburgCity_Mart_Text_TakeSomeAntidotesWithYou
text: Do you have any ANTIDOTES with\nyou?\pIf you walk around with a poisoned\nPOKéMON, it will lose HP until it faints.\lTake some ANTIDOTES with you.$

label: PetalburgCity_Mart_Text_WeakWillGrowStronger
text: Even if a POKéMON is weak now,\nit will grow stronger.\pThe most important thing is love!\nLove for your POKéMON!$

label: PetalburgCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_ManyTypesOfPokemon
text: There are many types of POKéMON.\pAll types have their strengths and\nweaknesses against other types.\pDepending on the types of POKéMON,\na battle could be easy or hard.$

label: PetalburgCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_OranBerryRegainedHP
text: When my POKéMON ate an\nORAN BERRY, it regained HP!$

label: PetalburgCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_PCStorageSystem
text: That PC-based POKéMON Storage\nSystem…\pWhoever made it must be some kind\nof a scientific wizard!$

label: PetalburgCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_StarterTypes
text: Your starter has its own strengths\nand weaknesses, too.\pCheck its types on the SUMMARY\nscreen and try different moves!$

label: PetalburgCity_Text_AreYouATrainer
text: Excuse me!\pLet me guess, from the way you're\ndressed, are you a POKéMON TRAINER?$

label: PetalburgCity_Text_AreYouRookieTrainer
text:
Hiya! Are you maybe…
A rookie TRAINER?\pDo you know what POKéMON TRAINERS
do when they reach a new town?\pThey first check what kind of GYM
is in the town.$

label: PetalburgCity_Text_CitySign
text: PETALBURG CITY\n“Where people mingle with nature.”$

label: PetalburgCity_Text_FullPartyExplanation
text: Let's say you have six POKéMON.\nIf you catch another one…\pIt is automatically sent to a STORAGE\nBOX over a PC connection.$

label: PetalburgCity_Text_GymSign
text: PETALBURG CITY POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: NORMAN\l“A man in pursuit of power!”$

label: PetalburgCity_Text_ImLookingForTalentedTrainers
text: I'm roaming the land in search of\ntalented TRAINERS.\pI'm sorry to have taken your time.$

label: PetalburgCity_Text_ThisIsGymSign
text: This is the GYM's sign. Look for it\nwhenever you're looking for a GYM.$

label: PetalburgCity_Text_ThisIsPetalburgGym
text: See? This is PETALBURG CITY's GYM.$

label: PetalburgCity_Text_WallyHouseSign
text: WALLY'S HOUSE$

label: PetalburgCity_Text_WaterReflection
text: My face is reflected in the water.\pIt's a shining grin full of hope…\pOr it could be a look of somber silence\nstruggling with fear…\pWhat do you see reflected in your face?$

label: PetalburgCity_Text_WellMaybeNot
text: … … … … … …\pWell, maybe not.\nYour clothes aren't all that dirty.\pYou're either a rookie TRAINER,\nor maybe you're just an ordinary traveler.$

label: PetalburgCity_Text_WhereIsWally
text: Where has our WALLY gone?\pWe have to leave for VERDANTURF TOWN\nvery soon…$

label: PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_PleaseExcuseUs
text:
{PLAYER}{KUN}! Please excuse us for
dragging you here this way.\pBut our WALLY's become very healthy
since he went to VERDANTURF TOWN.\pWe owe it all to you!\pWhen WALLY left town, you helped
him catch a POKéMON, right?\pI think that made WALLY really
happy.\pActually, not just WALLY.
It made me, his father, happy too.\pHappy that he's gained such a great
friend as you.\pThis isn't a bribe or anything, but
I'd really like you to have this.$

label: PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_SurfGoAllSortsOfPlaces
text: If your POKéMON can SURF, you'll be\nable to go to all sorts of places.$

label: PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_ThanksForPlayingWithWally
text:
You're…
Ah, you must be {PLAYER}{KUN}, right?\pThank you for playing with WALLY a
little while ago.\pHe's been frail and sickly ever
since he was a baby.\pWe've sent him to stay with my relatives
in VERDANTURF TOWN for a while.\pThe air is a lot cleaner there
than it is here.\pWhat's that? Where's WALLY?
He's already left, our WALLY.\pI wonder where he could have
gotten by now?$

label: PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_WallyIsComingHomeSoon
text: WALLY's coming home soon.\nI'm looking forward to that.$

label: PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_WallyLeftWithoutTelling
text:
I want you to keep this a secret
from my husband…\pBut our WALLY left VERDANTURF TOWN
without telling anyone.\pYou know, WALLY is frail, but
he's surprisingly strong-willed.\pI'm sure that he'll come back safe
and sound one day!$

label: PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_WallyWasReallyHappy
text: WALLY was really happy when he told\nus that he caught a POKéMON.\pIt's been ages since I've seen him\nsmile like that.$

label: PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_WonderHowWallyIsDoing
text: I wonder how our WALLY is doing?$

label: PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_YouMetWallyInEverGrandeCity
text: Oh? You met WALLY in\nEVER GRANDE CITY?\pOh, {PLAYER}{KUN}, don't be silly.\pHe may have gotten healthy, but he\ncan't go somewhere far away like\lthat all by himself.$

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_CantBePopularIfILose
text: I can't be popular if I lose.$

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_CantBePopularIfLose
text: I can't be popular if I lose.$

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_GoBugPokemonTeam
text: I caught a whole bunch of POKéMON!\pGo, go, go!\nMy BUG POKéMON team!$

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_HandOverThosePapers
text: You! DEVON RESEARCHER!\pHand over those papers!$

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_HaveYouSeenShroomish
text: Hello, have you seen any POKéMON\ncalled SHROOMISH around here?\pI really love that POKéMON.$

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_HiddenItemsExplanation
text: Sometimes, there are things on the\nground even if you can't see them.\pThat's why I always check where I'm\nwalking.$

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_ICantBeWastingTime
text: Uh-oh! It's a crisis!\nI can't be wasting time!$

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_ICouldntWin
text: I have all these POKéMON,\nbut I couldn't win…$

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_IWantRematch1
text: I want a rematch when my BUG\nPOKéMON grow up!\pI'm registering you in my POKéNAV!$

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_IWantRematch2
text: I want a rematch when my BUG \nPOKéMON grow up!\pI'm registering you in my POKéNAV!$

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_IWasGoingToAmbushYou
text: I was going to ambush you, but you\nhad to dawdle in PETALBURG WOODS\lforever, didn't you?\pI got sick of waiting, so here I am!$

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_ImOutOfPokeBalls
text: I caught a bunch of POKéMON.\nNow I'm out of POKé BALLS.$

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_InstantlyPopularWithBugPokemon
text: If you take BUG POKéMON to school,\nyou get to be instantly popular!$

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_IveBeenTrainingHard
text: You get to be popular if you have\nstrong POKéMON, right?\lSo, I've been training hard.$

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_MiracleSeedExplanation
text: It's a MIRACLE SEED.\nIf a POKéMON holds that item, its\lGRASS-type moves become stronger.\pBesides MIRACLE SEED, I think there are\nother convenient items for POKéMON\lto hold.$

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_MyPokemonHaveGrown
text: My BUG POKéMON have grown.\nI'll be popular again.$

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_NoOneCrossesTeamAqua
text: Hunh? What do you think you're doing?\nWhat, you're going to protect him?\pNo one who crosses TEAM AQUA\ngets any mercy, not even a kid!\pCome on and battle me!$

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_NotAOneToBeFound
text: Hmmm…\nNot a one to be found…$

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_PeopleRespectYou
text: If you have a big BUG POKéMON,\npeople respect you for it.$

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_StayOutOfTallGrass
text: Yo, there!\nYour POKéMON doing okay?\pIf your POKéMON are weak and you want\nto avoid battles, you should stay out\lof tall grass.$

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_TeamAquaAfterSomethingInRustboro
text: Didn't that TEAM AQUA thug say\nthey were after something in\lRUSTBORO, too?$

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_ThatWasAwfullyClose
text:
Whew…
That was awfully close!\pThanks to you, he didn't rob me of
these important papers.\pI know, I'll give you a GREAT BALL as
my thanks!$

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_TrainerTipsExperience
text:
TRAINER TIPS\pAny POKéMON that appears even once
in a battle is awarded EXP Points.\pTo raise a weak POKéMON, put it at the
left of the team list.\pAs soon as a battle starts, switch it
out. It will earn EXP Points without\lbeing exposed to any harm.$

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_TrainerTipsPP
text: TRAINER TIPS\pIn addition to Hit Points (HP), POKéMON\nhave Power Points (PP) that are used to\lmake moves during battle.\pIf a POKéMON runs out of PP, it must be\ntaken to a POKéMON CENTER.$

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_TryUsingThisItem
text: Oh, neat!\nThat's the BADGE from RUSTBORO GYM!\pYou must be a TRAINER.\nYou should try using this item.$

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_YouHaveToHelpMe
text: Aiyeeeh!\pYou're a POKéMON TRAINER, aren't you?\nYou've got to help me, please!$

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_YoureKiddingMe
text: You're kidding me! You're tough!$

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_YoureLoadedWithItems
text: You're loaded with items.\nI can't give you this GREAT BALL.$

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_YouveGotSomeNerve
text:
Grrr… You've got some nerve
meddling with TEAM AQUA!\lCome on and battle me again!\pI wish I could say that, but I'm out of
POKéMON…\pAnd, hey, we of TEAM AQUA are also
after something in RUSTBORO.\pI'll let you go today!$

label: PewterCity_Gym_Text_BrockDefeat
text:
I took you for granted, and so
I lost.\pAs proof of your victory, I confer
on you this…the official POKéMON\lLEAGUE BOULDERBADGE.\p{FONT_NORMAL}{PLAYER} received the BOULDERBADGE
from BROCK!{PAUSE_MUSIC}{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_OBTAIN_BADGE}{PAUSE 0xFE}{PAUSE 0x56}{RESUME_MUSIC}\p{FONT_MALE}Just having the BOULDERBADGE makes
your POKéMON more powerful.\pIt also enables the use of the
move FLASH outside of battle.\pOf course, a POKéMON must know the
move FLASH to use it.$

label: PewterCity_Gym_Text_BrockIntro
text:
So, you're here. I'm BROCK.
I'm PEWTER's GYM LEADER.\pMy rock-hard willpower is evident
even in my POKéMON.\pMy POKéMON are all rock hard, and
have true-grit determination.\pThat's right - my POKéMON are all
the ROCK type!\pFuhaha! You're going to challenge
me knowing that you'll lose?\pThat's the TRAINER's honor that
compels you to challenge me.\pFine, then!
Show me your best!{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_RG_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}$

label: PewterCity_Gym_Text_BrockPostBattle
text:
There are all kinds of TRAINERS in
this huge world of ours.\pYou appear to be very gifted as a
POKéMON TRAINER.\pSo let me make a suggestion.\pGo to the GYM in CERULEAN and test
your abilities.$

label: PewterCity_Gym_Text_DontHaveRoomForThis
text: You don't have room for this.$

label: PewterCity_Gym_Text_ExplainTM39
text:
A TM, Technical Machine, contains a
technique for POKéMON.\pUsing a TM teaches the move it
contains to a POKéMON.\pA TM is good for only one use.\pSo, when you use one, pick the
POKéMON carefully.\pAnyways…
TM39 contains ROCK TOMB.\pIt hurls boulders at the foe and
lowers its SPEED.$

label: PewterCity_Gym_Text_GymStatue
text: PEWTER POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: BROCK\pWINNING TRAINERS:\n{RIVAL}$

label: PewterCity_Gym_Text_GymStatuePlayerWon
text: PEWTER POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: BROCK\pWINNING TRAINERS:\n{RIVAL}, {PLAYER}$

label: PewterCity_Gym_Text_ItsFreeLetsGetHappening
text: It's a free service!\nLet's get happening!$

label: PewterCity_Gym_Text_LetMeTakeYouToTheTop
text:
Hiya!
Do you want to dream big?\pDo you dare to dream of becoming
the POKéMON champ?\pI'm no TRAINER, but I can advise
you on how to win.\pLet me take you to the top!$

label: PewterCity_Gym_Text_LetsGetHappening
text: All right!\nLet's get happening!$

label: PewterCity_Gym_Text_LiamDefeat
text: Darn!\pLight-years isn't time…\nIt measures distance!$

label: PewterCity_Gym_Text_LiamIntro
text: Stop right there, kid!\pYou're ten thousand light-years \nfrom facing BROCK!$

label: PewterCity_Gym_Text_LiamPostBattle
text: You're pretty hot.\n…But not as hot as BROCK!$

label: PewterCity_Gym_Text_ReceivedTM39FromBrock
text: {PLAYER} received TM39\nfrom BROCK.$

label: PewterCity_Gym_Text_TakeThisWithYou
text: Wait!\nTake this with you.$

label: PewterCity_Gym_Text_TryDifferentPartyOrders
text:
The first POKéMON out in a match is
at the left of the POKéMON LIST.\pBy changing the order of POKéMON,
you may gain an advantage.\pTry different orders to suit your
opponent's party.$

label: PewterCity_Gym_Text_YoureChampMaterial
text: Just as I thought!\nYou're POKéMON champ material!$

label: PewterCity_House1_Text_Nidoran
text: NIDORAN♂: Bowbow!$

label: PewterCity_House1_Text_NidoranSit
text: NIDORAN, sit!$

label: PewterCity_House1_Text_TradeMonsAreFinicky
text:
Our POKéMON's an outsider, so it's
finicky and hard to handle.\pAn outsider is a POKéMON that you
get in a trade.\pIt grows fast, but it may ignore an
unskilled TRAINER in battle.\pIf only we had some BADGES…$

label: PewterCity_House2_Text_MonsEasierCatchIfStatused
text:
A POKéMON becomes easier to 
catch if it has a status problem.\pSleep, poison, burn, or paralysis…
Those are all effective.\pBut catching POKéMON is never
a sure thing!$

label: PewterCity_House2_Text_MonsLearnTechniquesAsTheyGrow
text: POKéMON learn new techniques as\nthey grow.\pBut some moves must be taught to\nthem by people.$

label: PewterCity_Mart_Text_BoughtWeirdFishFromShadyGuy
text: A shady old guy sucked me into\nbuying this weird fish POKéMON!\pIt's totally weak and it cost ¥500!$

label: PewterCity_Mart_Text_GoodThingsIfRaiseMonsDiligently
text: Good things can happen if you raise\nPOKéMON diligently.\pEven the weak ones can surprise\nyou if you don't give up on them.$

label: PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_AerodactylFossil
text: AERODACTYL Fossil\nA primitive and rare POKéMON.$

label: PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_AmberContainsGeneticMatter
text: AMBER contains the genetic matter\nof ancient POKéMON.\pThere's a LAB somewhere trying to\nresurrect POKéMON from AMBER.$

label: PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_AmberIsFossilizedSap
text: AMBER is actually sap, that gooey\nstuff that oozes from trees.\pThe ancient sap fossilized over\ntime to become rock-hard AMBER.$

label: PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_AskedDaddyToCatchPikachu
text: I want a PIKACHU!\nIt's so cute!\pI asked my daddy to catch me one!$

label: PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_BeautifulPieceOfAmber
text: There is a beautiful piece of\nAMBER in a clear gold color.$

label: PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_BoughtColorTVForMoonLanding
text: July 20, 1969!\pHumankind first set foot on the\nmoon that day.\pI bought a color TV just so I\ncould watch that news.$

label: PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_ComeAgain
text: Come again!$

label: PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_DoYouKnowWhatAmberIs
text: You can't sneak in the back way!\nNice try, kid, but no.\pOh, whatever!\nDo you know what AMBER is?$

label: PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_DontHaveEnoughMoney
text: You don't have enough money.$

label: PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_DontHaveSpaceForThis
text: You don't have space for this.$

label: PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_GetOldAmberChecked
text: Ssh!\nGet the OLD AMBER checked!$

label: PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_Its50YForChildsTicket
text: Yes, yes.\nIt's ¥50 for a visitor's ticket.\pWould you like to come in?$

label: PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_KabutopsFossil
text: KABUTOPS Fossil\nA primitive and rare POKéMON.$

label: PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_MeteoriteThatFellOnMtMoon
text: A meteorite that fell on MT. MOON.\nIt is thought to be a MOON STONE.$

label: PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_PikachuSoonIPromise
text: Yeah, a PIKACHU soon, I promise!$

label: PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_PleaseEnjoyYourself
text: Please enjoy yourself.$

label: PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_ReceivedOldAmberFromMan
text: {PLAYER} received the OLD AMBER\nfrom the man.$

label: PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_Right50YThankYou
text: Right, ¥50!\nThank you!$

label: PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_RunningSpaceExhibitThisMonth
text: This month, we're running a space\nexhibit.$

label: PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_ShouldBeGratefulForLongLife
text: I should be grateful for my long\nlife.\pNever did I think I would get to\nsee the bones of a dragon!$

label: PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_SpaceShuttle
text: Space Shuttle$

label: PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_WantYouToGetAmberExamined
text:
Ssh! Listen, I need to share a
secret with someone.\pI think that this chunk of AMBER
contains POKéMON DNA!\pIt would be a shattering scientific
breakthrough if POKéMON could be\lresurrected from it.\pBut, my colleagues just ignore
what I have to say.\pSo, I have a favor to ask!\pI want you to get this examined at
a POKéMON LAB somewhere.$

label: PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_WeHaveTwoFossilsOnExhibit
text: We have two fossils of rare,\nprehistoric POKéMON on exhibit.$

label: PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_WhatsSpecialAboutMoonStone
text: MOON STONE, huh?\pWhat's so special about it?\nLooks like an ordinary rock to me.$

label: PewterCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Jigglypuff
text: JIGGLYPUFF: Puu pupuu!$

label: PewterCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_TeamRocketMtMoonImOnPhone
text: What!?\pTEAM ROCKET is at MT. MOON?\nHuh?\pI'm on the phone!\nScram!$

label: PewterCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_TradingMyClefairyForPikachu
text: I really want a PIKACHU, so I'm\ntrading my CLEFAIRY for one.$

label: PewterCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_TradingPikachuWithKid
text: I'm trading POKéMON with that kid\nthere.\pI had two PIKACHU, so I figured\nI might as well trade one.$

label: PewterCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_WhenJiggylypuffSingsMonsGetDrowsy
text: Yawn!\pWhen JIGGLYPUFF sings, POKéMON get\ndrowsy…\p…Me, too…\nSnore…$

label: PewterCity_Text_AskedToDeliverThis
text: I'm glad I caught up to you.\nI'm PROF. OAK's AIDE.\pI've been asked to deliver this,\nso here you go.$

label: PewterCity_Text_BrockOnlySeriousTrainerHere
text:
There aren't many serious POKéMON
TRAINERS here.\pThey're all like BUG CATCHERS,
you know, just hobbyists.\pBut PEWTER GYM's BROCK isn't like
that, not one bit.$

label: PewterCity_Text_BrocksLookingForChallengersFollowMe
text: You're a TRAINER, right?\pBROCK's looking for new\nchallengers. Follow me!$

label: PewterCity_Text_CallPoliceIfInfoOnThieves
text: NOTICE!\pThieves have been stealing POKéMON\nfossils from MT. MOON.\pPlease call the PEWTER POLICE if\nyou have any information.$

label: PewterCity_Text_CitySign
text: PEWTER CITY\nA Stone Gray City$

label: PewterCity_Text_ClefairyCameFromMoon
text: CLEFAIRY came from the moon.\nThat's what the rumor is.\pThey appeared after MOON STONES\nfell on MT. MOON.$

label: PewterCity_Text_DidYouCheckOutMuseum
text: Did you check out the MUSEUM?$

label: PewterCity_Text_DoYouKnowWhatImDoing
text: Psssst!\nDo you know what I'm doing?$

label: PewterCity_Text_ExplainRunningShoes
text: Press the B Button to run.\nBut only where there's room to run!$

label: PewterCity_Text_GoTakeOnBrock
text: If you have the right stuff,\ngo take on BROCK!$

label: PewterCity_Text_GymSign
text: PEWTER CITY POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: BROCK\lThe Rock-Solid POKéMON TRAINER!$

label: PewterCity_Text_MuseumOfScience
text: PEWTER MUSEUM OF SCIENCE$

label: PewterCity_Text_MustBeGoingBackToLab
text: Well, I must be going back to\nthe LAB.\pBye-bye!$

label: PewterCity_Text_OhPlayer
text: Oh, {PLAYER}{KUN}!$

label: PewterCity_Text_ReallyYouHaveToGo
text: Really?\nYou absolutely have to go!$

label: PewterCity_Text_ReceivedRunningShoesFromAide
text: {PLAYER} received the\nRUNNING SHOES from the AIDE.$

label: PewterCity_Text_RunningShoesLetterFromMom
text: There's a letter attached…\pDear {PLAYER},\pHere is a pair of RUNNING SHOES\nfor my beloved challenger.\pRemember, I'll always cheer for\nyou! Don't ever give up!\pFrom Mom$

label: PewterCity_Text_SprayingRepelToKeepWildMonsOut
text: I'm spraying REPEL to keep wild\nPOKéMON out of my garden!$

label: PewterCity_Text_SwitchedShoesWithRunningShoes
text: {PLAYER} switched shoes with the\nRUNNING SHOES.$

label: PewterCity_Text_ThatsRightItsHardWork
text: That's right!\nIt's hard work!$

label: PewterCity_Text_ThisIsTheMuseum
text: This is it, the MUSEUM.\pYou have to pay to get in, but it's\nworth it. See you around!$

label: PewterCity_Text_TrainerTipsEarningEXP
text: TRAINER TIPS\pAll POKéMON that appear in battle,\nhowever briefly, earn EXP Points.$

label: PewterCity_Text_WerentThoseFossilsAmazing
text: Weren't those fossils from MT. MOON\namazing?$

label: Pip_Text_RecruitAgain
text: PIP: Ready to head out again?\nMy shoes were getting bored.$

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_ArentYouInterestedInRoom
text: MOM: Well, {PLAYER}?\pAren't you interested in seeing your\nvery own room?$

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_BetterGetBackToGym
text: I'd better get back to PETALBURG GYM.\pMOM, thanks for looking after the house\nwhile I'm away.$

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_DadShouldStayLonger
text: MOM: That DAD of yours…\pHe comes home for the first time in a\nwhile, but all he talks about is POKéMON.\pHe should relax and stay a little longer.$

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_DidYouMeetProfBirch
text: MOM: Did you introduce yourself to\nPROF. BIRCH?$

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_DontPushYourselfTooHard
text: Don't push yourself too hard, dear.\nYou can always come home.\pGo for it, honey!$

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_GoIntroduceYourselfNextDoor
text: Oh, yes.\nOne of DAD's friends lives in town.\pPROF. BIRCH is his name.\pHe lives right next door, so you should\ngo over and introduce yourself.$

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_GoSetTheClock
text: MOM: {PLAYER}.\pGo set the clock in your room, honey.$

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_GotDadsBadgeHeresSomethingFromMom
text: MOM: Oh? Did DAD give you that BADGE?\pThen here's something from your MOM!$

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_IsThatABreakingStory
text: MOM: Is that a breaking news story?$

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_IsThatAPokenav
text: MOM: What is that, honey? A POKéNAV?\nSomeone from DEVON gave it to you?\pWell, honey, how about registering\nyour mom?\p… … …$

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_IsntItNiceInHere
text: MOM: See, {PLAYER}?\nIsn't it nice in here, too?$

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_ItsOverWeMissedHim
text: MOM: Oh… It's over.\pI think DAD was on, but we missed him.\nToo bad.$

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_LatiEmergencyNewsFlash
text:
We bring you this emergency
news flash!\pIn various HOENN locales, there have
been reports of a BZZT…colored\lPOKéMON in flight.\pThe identity of this POKéMON is
currently unknown.\pWe now return you to the regular
movie program.$

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_MaybeDadWillBeOn
text: MOM: Look! It's PETALBURG GYM!\nMaybe DAD will be on!$

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_MoversPokemonGoSetClock
text:
The mover's POKéMON do all the work
of moving us in and cleaning up after.\lThis is so convenient!\p{PLAYER}, your room is upstairs.
Go check it out, dear!\pDAD bought you a new clock to mark
our move here.\lDon't forget to set it!$

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_OhComeQuickly
text: MOM: Oh! {PLAYER}, {PLAYER}!\nQuick! Come quickly!$

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_PortsInSlateportLilycove
text: DAD: Hm, a TICKET for a ferry?\pIf I recall, there are ferry ports in\nSLATEPORT and LILYCOVE.$

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_RegisteredMom
text: Registered MOM\nin the POKéNAV.$

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_ReportFromPetalburgGym
text: INTERVIEWER: …We brought you this\nreport from in front of PETALBURG GYM.$

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_RunningShoesManual
text:
It's the instruction booklet for the
RUNNING SHOES.\p“Press the B Button to run while
wearing your RUNNING SHOES.\p“Lace up your RUNNING SHOES and hit
the road running!”$

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_SeeYouHoney
text: MOM: See you, honey!$

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_StillUnknownPokemon
text: MOM: Well, isn't that something!\nThere are still unknown POKéMON.$

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_TakeCareHoney
text: MOM: Take care, honey!$

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_TheresAMovieOnTV
text: There is a movie on TV.\pTwo men are dancing on a big piano\nkeyboard.\pBetter get going!$

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_TicketFromBrineyCameForYou
text:
DAD: Hm?\pHey, it's {PLAYER}!\pIt's been a while since I saw you,
but you look…stronger, somehow.\pThat's the impression I get.
But your old man hasn't given up yet!\pOh, yes, I have something for you.
This came to you from someone named\lMR. BRINEY.$

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_Vigoroth1
text: Fugiiiiih!$

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_Vigoroth2
text: Huggoh, uggo uggo…$

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_WhatColorDidTheySay
text: MOM: {PLAYER}, did you catch that?\pWhat color did the announcer say\nthat POKéMON was?$

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_YouShouldRestABit
text: MOM: How are you doing, {PLAYER}?\nYou look a little tired.\pI think you should rest a bit.$

label: PlayersHouse_2F_Text_ClockIsStopped
text: The clock is stopped…\pBetter set it and start it!$

label: PlayersHouse_2F_Text_HowDoYouLikeYourRoom
text:
MOM: {PLAYER}, how do you like your
new room?\pGood! Everything's put away neatly!\pThey finished moving everything in
downstairs, too.\pPOKéMON movers are so convenient!\pOh, you should make sure that
everything's all there on your desk.$

label: PlayersHouse_2F_Text_ItsAGameCube
text: It's a Nintendo GameCube.\pA Game Boy Advance is connected to\nserve as the Controller.$

label: PlayersHouse_2F_Text_Notebook
text: {PLAYER} flipped open the notebook.\pADVENTURE RULE NO. 1\nOpen the MENU with START.\pADVENTURE RULE NO. 2\nRecord your progress with SAVE.\pThe remaining pages are blank…$

label: PokedexRating_Text_Complete
text: Your POKéDEX is entirely complete!\nCongratulations!!$

label: PokedexRating_Text_HowIsPokedexComingAlong
text: OAK: Good to see you!\nHow is your POKéDEX coming along?\pHere, let me take a look.$

label: PokedexRating_Text_LessThan10
text: You still have lots to do.\pGo into every patch of grass you\nsee and look for POKéMON!$

label: PokedexRating_Text_LessThan100
text: I'm impressed!\nIt must have been difficult to do!$

label: PokedexRating_Text_LessThan110
text: You've finally hit 100 species!\nI can't believe how good you are!$

label: PokedexRating_Text_LessThan120
text: You even have the evolved forms\nof POKéMON! Super!$

label: PokedexRating_Text_LessThan130
text: Excellent! Trade with friends to\nget some more!$

label: PokedexRating_Text_LessThan140
text: Outstanding!\nYou've become a real pro at this!$

label: PokedexRating_Text_LessThan150
text: I have nothing left to say!\nYou're the POKéMON PROFESSOR now!$

label: PokedexRating_Text_LessThan20
text: It looks as if you're getting on\nthe right track!\pI've given one of my AIDES a FLASH\nHM. Make sure you go get it!$

label: PokedexRating_Text_LessThan30
text: Your POKéDEX could use a bit more\nvolume still!\pTry to catch other species of\nPOKéMON!$

label: PokedexRating_Text_LessThan40
text: Good, it's apparent that you're\ntrying hard!\pI've given one of my AIDES an\nITEMFINDER. Be sure to collect it!$

label: PokedexRating_Text_LessThan50
text: Your POKéDEX is coming along quite\nwell!\pI've given one of my AIDES an\nAMULET COIN. Be sure to get it!$

label: PokedexRating_Text_LessThan60
text: Ah, you've finally topped 50\nspecies!\pI've given one of my AIDES an EXP.\nSHARE. Be sure to go get it!$

label: PokedexRating_Text_LessThan70
text: Hoho! This is turning into quite the\nrespectable POKéDEX!$

label: PokedexRating_Text_LessThan80
text: Very good!\pI think you'll collect even more\nPOKéMON by going fishing!$

label: PokedexRating_Text_LessThan90
text: Wonderful! Let me guess… You\nlike to collect things, don't you?$

label: PokedexRating_Text_LookForwardToFilledNationalDex
text: I'll be looking forward to seeing\nyou fill the NATIONAL POKéDEX!$

label: PokedexRating_Text_LoveSeeingYourPokedex
text: OAK: Ah, welcome!\pTell me, how is your POKéDEX\ncoming along?\pWahaha!\pActually, I know how it is, but I\nlove seeing it anyway!\pLet's see…$

label: PokedexRating_Text_NationalDexSeenXOwnedY
text: And your NATIONAL POKéDEX is:\p{STR_VAR_1} POKéMON seen and\n{STR_VAR_2} POKéMON owned.$

label: PokedexRating_Text_SeenXOwnedY
text: The amount of progress you've made\non your POKéDEX is:\p{STR_VAR_1} POKéMON seen and\n{STR_VAR_2} POKéMON owned.\p{FONT_NORMAL}PROF. OAK's rating:$

label: PokedexRating_Text_ThankYouMadeDreamReality
text: Thank you, {PLAYER}!\nSincerely, thank you!\lYou've made my dream a reality!$

label: PokedexRating_Text_Wroooaaarrr
text: Wroooooooaaaaaarrrr!$

label: PokedexRating_Text_YouveCompletedDex
text: Finally…\pYou've finally completed the\nPOKéDEX!\pIt's magnificent!\nTruly, this is a fantastic feat!$

label: PokemonJournal_Text_SpecialFeatureAgatha
text: POKéMON JOURNAL\pSpecial Feature:\nELITE FOUR's AGATHA!\pIn her youth, AGATHA and PROF.\nOAK were rivals who vied for\lsupremacy as TRAINERS.$

label: PokemonJournal_Text_SpecialFeatureBlaine
text: POKéMON JOURNAL\pSpecial Feature: CINNABAR GYM\nLEADER BLAINE!\pBLAINE is said to remove his dark\nshades only when he is thinking up\lnew quiz questions.$

label: PokemonJournal_Text_SpecialFeatureBrock
text: POKéMON JOURNAL\pSpecial Feature: PEWTER GYM\nLEADER BROCK!\pBROCK rarely laughs, but is said to\nbe unable to stop if he starts.$

label: PokemonJournal_Text_SpecialFeatureBruno
text: POKéMON JOURNAL\pSpecial Feature:\nELITE FOUR's BRUNO!\pBRUNO apparently joined the ELITE\nFOUR out of his burning ambition to\lbattle the best TRAINERS.$

label: PokemonJournal_Text_SpecialFeatureDaisyOak
text:
This is a POKéMON JOURNAL from
years ago…\pPOKéMON JOURNAL
CONTEST Special!\pThe Spring POKéMON CONTEST's
Grand Champion is DAISY OAK of\lPALLET TOWN!$

label: PokemonJournal_Text_SpecialFeatureErika
text: POKéMON JOURNAL\pSpecial Feature: CELADON GYM\nLEADER ERIKA!\pRumor has it that if you peek into\nCELADON GYM, you can often\lsee ERIKA snoozing.$

label: PokemonJournal_Text_SpecialFeatureKoga
text:
POKéMON JOURNAL\pSpecial Feature: FUCHSIA GYM
LEADER KOGA!\pKOGA is said to have a thorough
knowledge of medicine.\pHe even concocts medicine to nurse
his POKéMON to health.$

label: PokemonJournal_Text_SpecialFeatureLance
text: POKéMON JOURNAL\pSpecial Feature:\nELITE FOUR's LANCE!\pLANCE's grandfather is thought to\nbe the elder of a famous clan of\ldragon masters.$

label: PokemonJournal_Text_SpecialFeatureLorelei
text: POKéMON JOURNAL\pSpecial Feature:\nELITE FOUR's LORELEI!\pKnown for her logical, calculated,\nand cool battling style, LORELEI\lhas a surprising secret!$

label: PokemonJournal_Text_SpecialFeatureLtSurge
text:
POKéMON JOURNAL\pSpecial Feature: VERMILION GYM
LEADER LT. SURGE!\pLT. SURGE is rumored to have been
a pilot while home in America.\pHe used the electricity generated
by POKéMON to power his plane.$

label: PokemonJournal_Text_SpecialFeatureMisty
text: POKéMON JOURNAL\pSpecial Feature: CERULEAN GYM\nLEADER MISTY!\pMISTY is said to worship LORELEI\nof the ELITE FOUR.$

label: PokemonJournal_Text_SpecialFeatureMrFuji
text:
POKéMON JOURNAL\pSpecial Feature:
MR. FUJI of POKéMON HOUSE!\pEditor: The shy MR. FUJI turned
down our interview requests.\pHe is a kindly man who is adored
and respected in LAVENDER TOWN.$

label: PokemonJournal_Text_SpecialFeatureProfOak
text: POKéMON JOURNAL\pSpecial Feature: PROF. OAK,\nthe POKéMON Researcher!\pPROF. OAK reportedly lives with his\ngrandchildren DAISY and {RIVAL}.$

label: PokemonJournal_Text_SpecialFeatureSabrina
text: POKéMON JOURNAL\pSpecial Feature: SAFFRON GYM\nLEADER SABRINA!\pPeople say that SABRINA can\ncommunicate with her POKéMON\lduring battle without speaking.$

label: PokemonLeague_AgathasRoom_Text_Defeat
text: Oh, my!\nYou're something special, trainer!$

label: PokemonLeague_AgathasRoom_Text_Intro
text:
I am AGATHA of the ELITE FOUR.\pI hear OAK's taken a lot of
interest in you, child.\pThat old duff was once tough and
handsome.\pBut that was decades ago.
He's a shadow of his former self.\pNow he just wants to fiddle with
his POKéDEX.\pHe's wrong.
POKéMON are for battling!\p{PLAYER}! I'll show you how a real
TRAINER battles!{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_RG_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}$

label: PokemonLeague_AgathasRoom_Text_PostBattle
text: You win!\pI see what the old duff sees in\nyou now.\pI have nothing else to say.\nRun along now, child!$

label: PokemonLeague_AgathasRoom_Text_RematchIntro
text:
I am AGATHA of the ELITE FOUR.\pYou're the trainer OAK has taken
under his wing, aren't you?\pThat old duff was once tough and
handsome.\pBut that was decades ago.
He's a shadow of his former self.\pNow he just wants to fiddle with
his POKéDEX.\pHe's wrong.
POKéMON are for battling!\p{PLAYER}! I'll show you how a real
TRAINER battles!{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_RG_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}$

label: PokemonLeague_BrunosRoom_Text_Defeat
text: Why?\nHow could I lose?$

label: PokemonLeague_BrunosRoom_Text_Intro
text:
I am BRUNO of the ELITE FOUR!\pThrough rigorous training, people
and POKéMON can become stronger\lwithout limit.\pI've lived and trained with my

text:

the LEAGUE CHAMP?\pMy reign is over already?

label: PokemonLeague_ChampionsRoom_Text_Intro
text:
{RIVAL}: Hey, {PLAYER}!\pI was looking forward to seeing
you, {PLAYER}.\pMy rival should be strong to keep
me sharp.\pWhile working on my POKéDEX, I
looked all over for POKéMON.\pNot only that, I assembled teams
that would beat any POKéMON type.\pAnd now…\pI'm the POKéMON LEAGUE CHAMPION!\p{PLAYER}!
Do you know what that means?\pI'll tell you.\pI am the most powerful TRAINER in
the world!$

label: PokemonLeague_ChampionsRoom_Text_OakCongratulations
text:
OAK: So, you've won!
Sincerely, congratulations!\pYou're the new POKéMON LEAGUE
CHAMPION!\pYou've grown up so much since you
first left with {STR_VAR_1} to work\lon the POKéDEX.\p{PLAYER}, you have come of age!$

label: PokemonLeague_ChampionsRoom_Text_OakImDisappointedRival
text:
OAK: {RIVAL}…
I'm disappointed in you.\pI came when I heard you'd beaten
the ELITE FOUR.\pBut, when I got here, you had
already lost!\p{RIVAL}, do you understand why
you lost?\pYou have forgotten to treat your
POKéMON with love and trust.\pWithout them, you will never
become a CHAMP again!$

label: PokemonLeague_ChampionsRoom_Text_OakPlayer
text: OAK: {PLAYER}!$

label: PokemonLeague_ChampionsRoom_Text_OakPlayerComeWithMe
text:
OAK: {PLAYER}.\pYou understand that your victory
was not just your own doing.\pThe bond you share with your
POKéMON is marvelous.\p{PLAYER}!
Come with me!$

label: PokemonLeague_ChampionsRoom_Text_PostBattle
text:
Why?
Why did I lose?\pI never made any mistakes raising
my POKéMON…\pDarn it! You're the new POKéMON
LEAGUE CHAMPION!\pAlthough I don't like to admit it…$

label: PokemonLeague_ChampionsRoom_Text_RematchIntro
text:

Hahah, that is so great!\pMy rival should be strong to keep

looked all over for POKéMON.\pNot only that, I assembled teams

Do you know what that means?\pI'll tell you.\pI am the most powerful TRAINER in
the world!$

text:

Congratulations, {PLAYER}!\pThis floor is the POKéMON HALL OF
FAME.\pPOKéMON LEAGUE CHAMPIONS are
honored for their exploits here.\pTheir POKéMON are also recorded in
the HALL OF FAME.\p{PLAYER}!\pYou have worked hard to become
the new LEAGUE CHAMPION.\pCongratulations, {PLAYER}, you and
your POKéMON are HALL OF FAMERS!$

label: PokemonLeague_LancesRoom_Text_Defeat
text: That's it!\pI hate to admit it, but you are a\nPOKéMON master!$

label: PokemonLeague_LancesRoom_Text_Intro
text:
Ah! I've heard about you,
{PLAYER}!\pI lead the ELITE FOUR.\pYou can call me LANCE the dragon
TRAINER.\pYou know that dragons are
mythical POKéMON.\pThey're hard to catch and raise,
but their powers are superior.\pThey're virtually indestructible.
There's no being clever with them.\pWell, are you ready to lose?\pYour LEAGUE challenge ends with
me, {PLAYER}!{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_RG_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}$

label: PokemonLeague_LancesRoom_Text_PostBattle
text:
I still can't believe my dragons
lost to you, {PLAYER}.\pYou are now the POKéMON LEAGUE
CHAMPION!\p…Or, you would have been, but
you have one more challenge left.\pThere is one more TRAINER to face!
His name is…\p{RIVAL}!\pHe beat the ELITE FOUR before
you.\pHe is the real POKéMON LEAGUE
CHAMPION.$

label: PokemonTower_2F_Text_RivalDefeat
text: What?\nYou stinker!\pI took it easy on you, too!$

label: PokemonTower_2F_Text_RivalIntro
text: {RIVAL}: Hey, {PLAYER}!\nWhat brings you here?\lIs your POKéMON dead?\pHey! It's alive!\pI can at least make them faint!\nLet's go!$

label: PokemonTower_2F_Text_RivalPostBattle
text:
How's your POKéDEX coming?
I just caught a CUBONE!\pI can't find the bigger MAROWAK.
Where could they be?\pI bet there aren't any left!\pWell, I better get going.
I've got a lot to accomplish,\lunlike you.\pSmell ya later!$

label: PokemonTower_3F_Text_HopePostBattle

label: PokemonTower_3F_Text_PatriciaPostBattle

label: PokemonTower_4F_Text_JodyIntro

label: PokemonTower_4F_Text_JodyPostBattle

label: PokemonTower_4F_Text_PaulaIntro

label: PokemonTower_4F_Text_PaulaPostBattle

label: PokemonTower_5F_Text_JanaeDefeat

label: PokemonTower_5F_Text_JanaeIntro
text: Urgah…\nUrff…$

label: PokemonTower_5F_Text_JanaePostBattle

label: PokemonTower_5F_Text_KarinaIntro

label: PokemonTower_5F_Text_KarinaPostBattle

text: What a nightmare!$

label: PokemonTower_5F_Text_RuthIntro
text: You…shall…\njoin…us…$

label: PokemonTower_5F_Text_RuthPostBattle
text: I was possessed.$

text: Gasp!$

label: PokemonTower_5F_Text_TammyIntro
text: Give…me…\nyour…all…$

label: PokemonTower_5F_Text_TammyPostBattle
text: I was under possession.$

label: PokemonTower_6F_Text_AngelicaDefeat
text: Groan!$

label: PokemonTower_6F_Text_AngelicaIntro
text: Give…me…\nblood…$

label: PokemonTower_6F_Text_AngelicaPostBattle
text: I feel anemic and weak…$

text: Something fell out!$

text: Urff…\nKwaah!$

label: PokemonTower_6F_Text_JenniferDefeat
text: Keee!$

label: PokemonTower_6F_Text_JenniferIntro
text: Ke…ke…ke…\nke…ke…ke!$

label: PokemonTower_6F_Text_JenniferPostBattle
text: What's going on here?$

label: PokemonTower_6F_Text_MothersSpiritWasCalmed

label: PokemonTower_7F_Text_Grunt1Defeat

text: What do you want?\nWhy are you here?$

label: PokemonTower_7F_Text_Grunt1PostBattle
text: I'm not going to forget this!$

label: PokemonTower_7F_Text_Grunt2Defeat
text: Please!\nNo more!$

label: PokemonTower_7F_Text_Grunt2Intro
text:
This old guy marched right up to
our HIDEOUT.\pThen, he starts ranting about how
TEAM ROCKET's abusing POKéMON.\pSo, we're just talking it over as
adults.$

label: PokemonTower_7F_Text_Grunt2PostBattle
text: POKéMON are only good for making\nmoney. Why not use them?\pYou stay out of our business!$

label: PokemonTower_7F_Text_Grunt3Defeat
text: Don't fight us ROCKETS!$

label: PokemonTower_7F_Text_Grunt3Intro
text: You're not saving anyone, kid!$

label: PokemonTower_7F_Text_Grunt3PostBattle
text: You're not getting away with this!$

label: PokemonTower_7F_Text_MrFujiThankYouFollowMe
text:
MR. FUJI: Heh?
You came to save me?\pThank you. But, I came here of my
own free will.\pI came to calm the spirit of
CUBONE's mother.\pI think MAROWAK's spirit has
finally left us.\pI must thank you for your kind
concern.\pFollow me to my home, POKéMON
HOUSE, at the foot of this tower.$

label: ProfileMan_Text_CollectTrainerProfiles
text: Hello there, TRAINER!\nYou've got a wonderful smile, there.\pI have a hobby--collecting the profiles\nof POKéMON TRAINERS.$

label: ProfileMan_Text_EasyChatExplanation
text:
You make your own profile by putting
together four words or phrases.\pHere, I'll show you an example of a
profile using four pieces of text.\pYou can switch those four pieces with
other text pieces any which way you\llike to make your own profile.\pThere are a lot of text pieces that
you can use.\pThey are arranged in groups like
POKéMON, lifestyles, and hobbies so\lit is easier to look them up.\pSo, first, choose the group of text
pieces to display a list of choices.\pThen, pick the choice you want.\pRepeat for the remaining text choices,
and you'll have your very own profile.$

label: RivalsHouse_1F_Text_BrendanWhoAreYou
text:
Hey!
You…\pWho are you?\pOh, you're {PLAYER}, aren't you?
Moved in next door, right?\pI didn't know that you're a girl.\pDad, PROF. BIRCH, said that our new
next-door neighbor is a GYM LEADER's\lkid, so I assumed you'd be a guy.\pMy name's BRENDAN.
So, hi, neighbor!\pHuh? Hey, {PLAYER}, don't you have
a POKéMON?\pDo you want me to go catch you one?\pAw, darn, I forgot…\pI'm supposed to go help my dad catch

my dad, PROF. BIRCH.\pI was hoping that you would be nice,
{PLAYER}{KUN}, and that we could be friends.\pOh, this is silly, isn't it?
I… I've just met you, {PLAYER}{KUN}.\pEheheh…\pOh, no! I forgot!\pI was supposed to go help Dad catch
some wild POKéMON!\p{PLAYER}{KUN}, I'll catch you later!$

label: RockTunnel_1F_Text_ArianaDefeat
text: You play hard!$

label: RockTunnel_1F_Text_ArianaIntro
text: You have POKéMON!\nLet's start!$

label: RockTunnel_1F_Text_ArianaPostBattle
text: Whew!\nI'm all sweaty now.$

label: RockTunnel_1F_Text_AshtonDefeat
text: Game over!$

label: RockTunnel_1F_Text_AshtonIntro
text: POKéMON fight!\nReady, go!$

label: RockTunnel_1F_Text_AshtonPostBattle
text: Oh well, I'll get a ZUBAT as I go!$

label: RockTunnel_1F_Text_DanaDefeat
text: I'm out of POKéMON!$

label: RockTunnel_1F_Text_DanaIntro
text: I came this far looking for wild\nPOKéMON.$

label: RockTunnel_1F_Text_DanaPostBattle
text: You looked cute and harmless.\nWas I ever wrong!$

label: RockTunnel_1F_Text_LeahDefeat
text: It was too dark…$

label: RockTunnel_1F_Text_LeahIntro
text: Eek!\pDon't try anything funny in the\ndark!$

label: RockTunnel_1F_Text_LeahPostBattle
text: I saw a MACHOP in this tunnel.$

label: RockTunnel_1F_Text_LennyDefeat
text: Doh!\nYou win!$

label: RockTunnel_1F_Text_LennyIntro
text: This tunnel goes a long way, kid!$

label: RockTunnel_1F_Text_LennyPostBattle
text: Watch for ONIX.\nThey appear only occasionally.\pHigh-level ones can put the\nsqueeze on you!$

label: RockTunnel_1F_Text_LucasDefeat
text: I give!$

label: RockTunnel_1F_Text_LucasIntro
text: Outsiders like you need to show me\nsome respect!$

label: RockTunnel_1F_Text_LucasPostBattle
text: You're talented enough to hike!$

label: RockTunnel_1F_Text_OliverDefeat
text: Ease up!\nWhat am I doing?\lWhich way is out?$

label: RockTunnel_1F_Text_OliverIntro
text: Hmm.\nMaybe I'm lost in here…$

label: RockTunnel_1F_Text_OliverPostBattle
text: That sleeping POKéMON on ROUTE 12\nforced me to take this detour.$

label: RockTunnel_1F_Text_RouteSign
text: ROCK TUNNEL\nCERULEAN CITY - LAVENDER TOWN$

label: RockTunnel_B1F_Text_AllenDefeat
text: I give!\nYou're a better technician!$

label: RockTunnel_B1F_Text_AllenIntro
text: My POKéMON techniques will leave\nyou crying!$

label: RockTunnel_B1F_Text_AllenPostBattle
text: In mountains, you'll often find\nROCK-type POKéMON.$

label: RockTunnel_B1F_Text_CooperDefeat
text: Shoot!\nI am so jealous!$

label: RockTunnel_B1F_Text_CooperIntro
text: You have a POKéDEX?\nI want one, too.$

label: RockTunnel_B1F_Text_CooperPostBattle
text: When you finish your POKéDEX,\ncan I have it?$

label: RockTunnel_B1F_Text_DudleyDefeat
text: Oops!\nOutmuscled!$

label: RockTunnel_B1F_Text_DudleyIntro
text: Hahaha!\nCan you beat my power?$

label: RockTunnel_B1F_Text_DudleyPostBattle
text: I go for power because I hate\nthinking.$

label: RockTunnel_B1F_Text_EricDefeat
text: Fired away!$

label: RockTunnel_B1F_Text_EricIntro
text: Hit me with your best shot!$

label: RockTunnel_B1F_Text_EricPostBattle
text: I'll raise my POKéMON to beat\nyours, kid.$

label: RockTunnel_B1F_Text_MarthaDefeat
text: Oh!\nI lost!$

label: RockTunnel_B1F_Text_MarthaIntro
text: I don't often come here, but I will\nbattle you.$

label: RockTunnel_B1F_Text_MarthaPostBattle
text: I like tiny POKéMON.\nBig ones are too scary!$

label: RockTunnel_B1F_Text_SofiaDefeat
text: Ohhh!\nI did my best!$

label: RockTunnel_B1F_Text_SofiaIntro
text: Do you know how you can avoid\ngetting lost in the mountains?\pYou can bend twigs as trail\nmarkers.$

label: RockTunnel_B1F_Text_SofiaPostBattle
text: I want to go home!$

label: RockTunnel_B1F_Text_SteveDefeat
text: Well, that's that.$

label: RockTunnel_B1F_Text_SteveIntro
text: Um… Do you know about POKéMON\ncosplay?$

label: RockTunnel_B1F_Text_StevePostBattle
text: POKéMON cosplay is dressing up as\nPOKéMON for fun.\pCLEFAIRY is a favorite.$

label: RockTunnel_B1F_Text_WinstonDefeat
text: Whew…\nI'm exhausted…$

label: RockTunnel_B1F_Text_WinstonIntro
text: I draw illustrations of POKéMON\nwhen I'm home.$

label: RockTunnel_B1F_Text_WinstonPostBattle
text: I'm an artist, not a fighter.\nI'll go home to draw.$

label: RocketHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt1Defeat
text: Oww!\nBeaten!$

label: RocketHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt1Intro
text: Who are you?\nHow did you get here?$

label: RocketHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt1PostBattle
text: Blast it… You're dissing TEAM\nROCKET, aren't you?$

label: RocketHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt2Defeat
text: Boom!$

label: RocketHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt2Intro
text: You broke into TEAM ROCKET's\noperation? What nerve!$

label: RocketHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt2PostBattle
text: You're not going to get away with\nthis, brat!$

label: RocketHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt3Defeat
text: I can't do it!$

label: RocketHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt3Intro
text: Intruder alert!$

label: RocketHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt3PostBattle
text: SILPH SCOPE? Humph!\nI don't know where it is.$

label: RocketHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt4Defeat
text: This won't do!$

label: RocketHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt4Intro
text: Why did you come here?$

label: RocketHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt4PostBattle
text: Okay, I'll talk…\nTake the elevator to see my BOSS.$

label: RocketHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt5Defeat
text: Why…?$

label: RocketHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt5Intro
text: Are you lost, you little mouse?$

label: RocketHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt5PostBattle
text: Uh-oh, that ruckus somehow opened\nthe door!$

label: RocketHideout_B2F_Text_GruntDefeat
text: I surrender!$

label: RocketHideout_B2F_Text_GruntIntro
text: BOSS said you can see ghosts with\nthe SILPH SCOPE.$

label: RocketHideout_B2F_Text_GruntPostBattle
text: The TEAM ROCKET HQ has four\nunderground floors.\pThink you can reach the BOSS?$

label: RocketHideout_B3F_Text_Grunt1Defeat
text: Oof!\nTaken down!$

label: RocketHideout_B3F_Text_Grunt1Intro
text: Stop meddling in TEAM ROCKET's\naffairs or else!$

label: RocketHideout_B3F_Text_Grunt1PostBattle
text: SILPH SCOPE?\nOh, that machine the BOSS stole.\pIt's here somewhere.$

label: RocketHideout_B3F_Text_Grunt2Defeat
text: What?\nI lost? No!$

label: RocketHideout_B3F_Text_Grunt2Intro
text: We got word from upstairs that you\nwere coming!$

label: RocketHideout_B3F_Text_Grunt2PostBattle
text: Go ahead and go!\pBut you can't run the elevator\nwithout the LIFT KEY.$

label: RocketHideout_B4F_Text_GiovanniDefeat
text: WHAT!\nThis can't be!$

label: RocketHideout_B4F_Text_GiovanniIntro
text:
So! I must say, I am impressed you
got here.\pTEAM ROCKET captures POKéMON from
around the world.\pThey're important tools for keeping
our criminal enterprise going.\pI am the leader, GIOVANNI!\pFor your insolence, you will feel a
world of pain!$

label: RocketHideout_B4F_Text_GiovanniPostBattle
text: I see that you raise POKéMON with\nutmost care.\pA newcomer like you would never\nunderstand what I hope to achieve.\pI shall step aside this time!\pI hope we meet again…$

label: RocketHideout_B4F_Text_Grunt1Defeat
text: No!$

label: RocketHideout_B4F_Text_Grunt1Intro
text: The elevator doesn't work?\nWho has the LIFT KEY?$

label: RocketHideout_B4F_Text_Grunt1PostBattle
text: Oh, no!\nI dropped the LIFT KEY!$

label: RocketHideout_B4F_Text_Grunt2Defeat
text: Burned again!$

label: RocketHideout_B4F_Text_Grunt2Intro
text: I know you!\nYou ruined our plans at MT. MOON!$

label: RocketHideout_B4F_Text_Grunt2PostBattle
text: Do you have something against TEAM\nROCKET?$

label: RocketHideout_B4F_Text_Grunt3Defeat
text: Ayaya!$

label: RocketHideout_B4F_Text_Grunt3Intro
text: How can you not see the beauty of\nour evil?$

label: RocketHideout_B4F_Text_Grunt3PostBattle
text: BOSS!\nI'm sorry I failed you!$

label: RocketHideout_Elevator_Text_AppearsToNeedAKey
text: It appears to need a key.$

label: Route101_Text_DontLeaveMe
text: Wh-Where are you going?!\nDon't leave me like this!$

label: Route101_Text_HelpMe
text: H-help me!$

label: Route101_Text_PleaseHelp
text: Hello! You over there!\nPlease! Help!\pIn my BAG!\nThere's a POKé BALL!$

label: Route101_Text_RouteSign
text: ROUTE 101\n{UP_ARROW} OLDALE TOWN$

label: Route101_Text_TakeTiredPokemonToPokeCenter
text: If POKéMON get tired, take them to\na POKéMON CENTER.\pThere's a POKéMON CENTER in OLDALE\nTOWN right close by.$

label: Route101_Text_WildPokemonInTallGrass
text: Wild POKéMON will jump out at you in\ntall grass.\pIf you want to catch POKéMON, you have\nto go into the tall grass and search.$

label: Route101_Text_YouSavedMe
text:
PROF. BIRCH: Whew…\pI was in the tall grass studying wild
POKéMON when I was jumped.\pYou saved me.
Thanks a lot!\pOh?\pHi, you're {PLAYER}{KUN}!\pThis is not the place to chat, so come
by my POKéMON LAB later, okay?$

label: Route102_Text_AllenDefeated
text: I called you because I thought\nI could beat you…$

label: Route102_Text_AllenIntro
text: Did you just become a TRAINER?\nWe're both beginners!$

label: Route102_Text_AllenPostBattle
text: I haven't won once yet…\nI wish I would win soon…$

label: Route102_Text_CalvinDefeated
text: Arrgh, I lost…\nI should have trained mine more…$

label: Route102_Text_CalvinIntro
text: If you have POKéMON with you, then\nyou're an official POKéMON TRAINER!\lYou can't say no to my challenge!$

label: Route102_Text_CalvinPostBattle
text: Listen, you. If you're strong,\nyou should have told me before!$

label: Route102_Text_CalvinRegister
text: I've been working hard at this since\nI saw you before.\pI'd like to battle you again, so can\nyou register me in your POKéNAV?$

label: Route102_Text_CalvinRegisterShort
text: I'd like to battle you again, so can\nyou register me in your POKéNAV?$

label: Route102_Text_CalvinRematchDefeated
text: Arrgh, I lost…\nIs my training method not right?$

label: Route102_Text_CalvinRematchIntro
text: Ever since I lost to you, I desperately\ntrained my POKéMON.\lYou can't say no to my challenge!$

label: Route102_Text_CalvinRematchPostBattle
text: If you're going to get stronger,\nI'll get stronger, too.$

label: Route102_Text_CatchWholeBunchOfPokemon
text: I'm going to catch a whole bunch of\nPOKéMON!$

label: Route102_Text_ImNotVeryTall
text: I'm…not very tall, so I sink right\ninto tall grass.\pThe grass goes up my nose and…\nFwafwafwafwafwa…\pFwatchoo!$

label: Route102_Text_LetsGoBack
text: {PLAYER}, thank you!\nLet's go back to the GYM!$

label: Route102_Text_RickDefeated
text: Ow! Down and out!$

label: Route102_Text_RickIntro
text: Hahah! Our eyes met!\nI'll take you on with my BUG POKéMON!$

label: Route102_Text_RickPostBattle
text: If you lock eyes with a TRAINER,\nyou have to challenge! It's a rule!$

label: Route102_Text_RouteSignOldale
text: ROUTE 102\n{RIGHT_ARROW} OLDALE TOWN$

label: Route102_Text_RouteSignPetalburg
text: ROUTE 102\n{LEFT_ARROW} PETALBURG CITY$

label: Route102_Text_TianaDefeated
text: I ended up furthering your career…$

label: Route102_Text_TianaIntro
text: I'm going to keep winning and aim\nto be the best TRAINER.\pHelp me further my career!$

label: Route102_Text_TianaPostBattle
text: To keep winning my way up, I see that\nI have to catch more POKéMON.$

label: Route102_Text_WallyIDidIt
text: WALLY: I did it… It's my…\nMy POKéMON!$

label: Route102_Text_WatchMeCatchPokemon
text: WALLY: {PLAYER}…\nPOKéMON hide in tall grass like this,\ldon't they?\pPlease watch me and see if I can\ncatch one properly.\p…Whoa!$

label: Route103_Text_AmyDefeated
text: AMY: Uh-oh, we lost.$

label: Route103_Text_AmyIntro
text: AMY: I'm AMY.\nAnd this is my little sister LIV.\lWe battle together!$

label: Route103_Text_AmyLivRegister
text: LIV: Really, we're a lot better…\nIt's true! We'll show you next time!$

label: Route103_Text_AmyNotEnoughPokemon
text: AMY: Uh-oh, you have only one\nPOKéMON with you.\lYou can't battle us like that.$

label: Route103_Text_AmyPostBattle
text: AMY: You have to think about all\nkinds of things when you're battling\lagainst two TRAINERS.$

label: Route103_Text_AmyRematchDefeated
text: AMY: Aww, boo!\nWe couldn't win again…$

label: Route103_Text_AmyRematchIntro
text: AMY: I'm AMY.\nAnd this is my little sister LIV.\lWe battle together!$

label: Route103_Text_AmyRematchNotEnoughPokemon
text: AMY: Uh-oh, you have only one\nPOKéMON with you.\lYou can't battle us like that.$

label: Route103_Text_AmyRematchPostBattle
text: AMY: You have to think about all\nkinds of things when you're battling\lagainst two TRAINERS.$

label: Route103_Text_AndrewDefeated
text: Gah! Lost it!\nI'm even more annoyed now!$

label: Route103_Text_AndrewIntro
text: Gah! My fishing line's all snarled up!\nI'm getting frustrated and mean!\lThat's it! Battle me!$

label: Route103_Text_AndrewPostBattle
text: Gah, I'm still boiling mad…\nGrrrrr…$

label: Route103_Text_BrendanDefeated
text: Huh, {PLAYER}, you're not too shabby.$

label: Route103_Text_BrendanLetsBattle
text: Hey, it's {PLAYER}!\p…Oh, yeah, Dad gave you a POKéMON.\pSince we're here, how about a little\nbattle?\pI'll teach you what being a TRAINER's\nabout!$

label: Route103_Text_BrendanRoute103Pokemon
text: BRENDAN: Okay, so it's this one and\nthat one that live on ROUTE 103…$

label: Route103_Text_BrendanTimeToHeadBack
text:
BRENDAN: I think I get it.
I think I know why my dad has his eye\lout for you now.\pLook, your POKéMON already likes you,
even though you just got it.\p{PLAYER}, I get the feeling that you
could befriend any POKéMON with ease.\pWe should head back to the LAB.$

label: Route103_Text_DaisyDefeated
text: You weren't led astray by our aroma…$

label: Route103_Text_DaisyIntro
text: Did you feel the tug of our\nsoul-soothing fragrance?$

label: Route103_Text_DaisyPostBattle
text: Aromatherapy is a form of mental\nhealing that works with fragrances.$

label: Route103_Text_IsabelleDefeated
text: Groan…$

label: Route103_Text_IsabelleIntro
text: Watch where you're going!\nWe're going to crash!$

label: Route103_Text_IsabellePostBattle
text: I'm a poor swimmer so I was practicing…\nSorry for almost crashing into you.$

label: Route103_Text_LivDefeated
text: LIV: Oh, we lost, big sister…$

label: Route103_Text_LivIntro
text: LIV: We battle together as one\nteam.$

label: Route103_Text_LivNotEnoughPokemon
text: LIV: If you want to battle us,\nyou have to have two POKéMON!\lIt's not fair if you don't!$

label: Route103_Text_LivPostBattle
text: LIV: We work perfectly together,\nme and my big sister…\pBut we still lost…$

label: Route103_Text_LivRematchDefeated
text: LIV: Awww, we lost again…\nBig sister…$

label: Route103_Text_LivRematchIntro
text: LIV: We battle together as one\nteam.$

label: Route103_Text_LivRematchNotEnoughPokemon
text: LIV: If you want to battle us, you\nhave to have two POKéMON!\lIt's not fair if you don't!$

label: Route103_Text_LivRematchPostBattle
text: LIV: We work perfectly together,\nme and my big sister…\pBut why did we lose again?$

label: Route103_Text_MarcosDefeated
text: My one-man show is ruined…$

label: Route103_Text_MarcosIntro
text: Did my guitar's wailing draw you in?$

label: Route103_Text_MarcosPostBattle
text: I was playing my guitar where few\npeople were around, but a lot of fans\lhave gathered.\pHeh, maybe I should turn pro.$

label: Route103_Text_MayDefeated
text: Wow! That's great!\n{PLAYER}{KUN}, you're pretty good!$

label: Route103_Text_MayLetsBattle
text:
Oh, hi, {PLAYER}{KUN}!\p…Oh, I see, my dad gave you
a POKéMON as a gift.\pSince we're here, let's have a quick
battle!\pI'll give you a taste of what being
a TRAINER is like.$

label: Route103_Text_MayRoute103Pokemon
text: MAY: Let's see… The POKéMON found\non ROUTE 103 include…$

label: Route103_Text_MayTimeToHeadBack
text:
MAY: I think I know why my dad has
an eye out for you now.\pI mean, you just got that POKéMON,
but it already likes you.\pYou might be able to befriend any
kind of POKéMON easily.\pWell, it's time to head back to
the LAB.$

label: Route103_Text_MiguelDefeated
text: Oh, my gosh!\nMy darling POKéMON!$

label: Route103_Text_MiguelIntro
text: My POKéMON is delightfully adorable!\nDon't be shy--I'll show you!$

label: Route103_Text_MiguelPostBattle
text: My delightful POKéMON looks darling\neven when it's fainted!$

label: Route103_Text_MiguelRegister
text: I'll get you to come out and look in\non my delightful POKéMON again!$

label: Route103_Text_MiguelRematchDefeated
text: Oh!\nMy darling POKéMON!$

label: Route103_Text_MiguelRematchIntro
text: Hi, you! My delightfully adorable\nPOKéMON has become more darling!$

label: Route103_Text_MiguelRematchPostBattle
text: The more I spend time with it,\nthe more adorable my POKéMON becomes.$

label: Route103_Text_PeteDefeated
text: Oh, that's good going!$

label: Route103_Text_PeteIntro
text: This sort of distance…\nYou should just swim it!$

label: Route103_Text_PetePostBattle
text: Oh, I understand where you're coming\nfrom now.\pIf I had a POKéMON that trusty,\nI'd want to SURF on it, too!$

label: Route103_Text_RhettDefeated
text: Whoa!\nThe kid can rock!$

label: Route103_Text_RhettIntro
text: Whoa!\nHow'd you get into a space this small?$

label: Route103_Text_RhettPostBattle
text: Do you like cramped quarters\nlike this?$

label: Route103_Text_RouteSign
text: ROUTE 103\n{DOWN_ARROW} OLDALE TOWN$

label: Route103_Text_ShortcutToOldale
text: If you cross the sea from here,\nit'll be a shortcut to OLDALE TOWN.\pFufufu, that's useful, isn't it?$

label: Route103_Text_ShouldHaveBroughtPotion
text: My POKéMON is staggeringly tired…\nI should have brought a POTION…$

label: Route104_MrBrineysHouse_Text_DeclineDeliverySail
text: MR. BRINEY: Is that so?\nYour deliveries can wait?\pYou just go on and tell me whenever\nyou want to set sail!$

label: Route104_MrBrineysHouse_Text_ItsYouLetsSailToDewford
text:
Hm? You're {PLAYER}{KUN}!
You saved my darling PEEKO!\lWe owe so much to you!\pWhat's that?
You want to sail with me?\pHmhm…\pYou have a LETTER bound for DEWFORD
and a package for SLATEPORT, then?\pQuite the busy life you must lead!\pBut, certainly, what you're asking is
no problem at all.\pYou've come to the right man!
We'll set sail for DEWFORD.$

label: Route104_MrBrineysHouse_Text_NeedToDeliverPackageSailToDewford
text:
MR. BRINEY: Ahoy!
I know exactly what you want to say!\pYou're to deliver a package to
CAPT. STERN in SLATEPORT.\pWhat you need me to do is no problem
at all--I'm the man for the job!\pFirst, we'll set sail for DEWFORD.$

label: Route104_MrBrineysHouse_Text_NeedToMakeDeliveriesSailToDewford
text:
MR. BRINEY: Ahoy!
I know exactly what you want to say!\pYou're to deliver a LETTER to DEWFORD
and a package to SLATEPORT.\pWhat you need me to do is no problem
at all--I'm the man for the job!\pFirst, we'll set sail for DEWFORD.$

label: Route104_MrBrineysHouse_Text_Peeko
text: PEEKO: Pii piihyoro!$

label: Route104_MrBrineysHouse_Text_SetSailForDewford
text: MR. BRINEY: DEWFORD it is, then!\pAnchors aweigh!\nPEEKO, we're setting sail, my darling!$

label: Route104_MrBrineysHouse_Text_TellMeWheneverYouWantToSail
text: MR. BRINEY: Is that so?\nWell, PEEKO owes her life to you.\pYou just go on and tell me whenever\nyou want to set sail!$

label: Route104_MrBrineysHouse_Text_WaitUpPeeko
text: MR. BRINEY: Hold on, lass!\nWait up, PEEKO!$

label: Route104_MrBrineysHouse_Text_WhereAreWeBound
text: MR. BRINEY: Ahoy!\nFor you, I'll go out to sea anytime!\pNow, my friend, where are we bound?$

label: Route104_PrettyPetalFlowerShop_Text_BerriesExplanation
text:
BERRIES grow on trees that thrive
only in soft, loamy soil.\pIf you take some BERRIES, be sure to
plant one in the loamy soil again.\pA planted BERRY will soon sprout,
grow into a plant, flower beautifully,\lthen grow BERRIES again.\pI want to see the whole wide world
filled with beautiful flowers.\lThat's my dream.\pPlease help me, {PLAYER}{KUN}. Plant BERRIES
and bring more flowers into the world.$

label: Route104_PrettyPetalFlowerShop_Text_FlowersBringHappiness
text: Flowers bring so much happiness to\npeople, don't they?$

label: Route104_PrettyPetalFlowerShop_Text_ImGrowingFlowers
text: I'm trying to be like my big sisters.\nI'm growing flowers, too!\pHere you go!\nIt's for you!$

label: Route104_PrettyPetalFlowerShop_Text_IntroLearnAboutBerries
text: Your name is?\p{PLAYER}{KUN}.\nThat's a nice name.\p{PLAYER}{KUN}, would you like to learn about\nBERRIES?$

label: Route104_PrettyPetalFlowerShop_Text_LearnAboutBerries
text: {PLAYER}{KUN}, would you like to learn about\nBERRIES?$

label: Route104_PrettyPetalFlowerShop_Text_MachineMixesBerries
text: You can plant a BERRY and grow it big,\nor you can make a POKéMON hold it.\pBut now they have a machine that mixes\nup different BERRIES and makes candies\lfor POKéMON.\pI want some candy, too.$

label: Route104_PrettyPetalFlowerShop_Text_ThisIsPrettyPetalFlowerShop
text: Hello!\pThis is the PRETTY PETAL flower shop.\nSpreading flowers all over the world!$

label: Route104_PrettyPetalFlowerShop_Text_WailmerPailExplanation
text:
While BERRY plants are growing,
water them with the WAILMER PAIL.\pOh, another thing.\pIf you don't pick BERRIES for a while,
they'll drop off onto the ground.\lBut they'll sprout again.\pIsn't that awesome?
It's like they have the will to live.$

label: Route104_PrettyPetalFlowerShop_Text_YouCanHaveThis
text: Hello!\pThe more attention you give to flowers,\nthe more beautifully they bloom.\pYou'll like tending flowers. I'm sure\nof it. You can have this.$

label: Route104_Text_BillyDefeat
text: Waah! I got sand in my runners!\nThey're all gritty!$

label: Route104_Text_BillyIntro
text: Leaving footprints in the sand is\nso fun!$

label: Route104_Text_BillyPostBattle
text: I want to leave my footprints in\nthe sand everywhere, but they\ldisappear quickly…$

label: Route104_Text_BrendanDefeat
text: Hmm…\nYou're pretty good.$

label: Route104_Text_BrendanDoingGreatLetsBattle
text: Me, I'm doing great!\pWant to check out how good I am with\na battle?$

label: Route104_Text_BrendanHowsYourPokedex
text: BRENDAN: {PLAYER}, how's your POKéDEX?\nHave you filled in any pages yet?$

label: Route104_Text_BrendanIntro
text: BRENDAN: I know you just became\na TRAINER, but I won't go easy!$

label: Route104_Text_BrendanLetsBattle
text: BRENDAN: What's up?\nWant to have a battle with me?$

label: Route104_Text_BrendanNoConfidence
text: BRENDAN: What's the matter? Don't have\nany confidence in your POKéMON?$

label: Route104_Text_BrendanPostBattle
text:
BRENDAN: You've gotten pretty decent
at handling POKéMON.\pBut, you know, you shouldn't just be
making POKéMON battle.\pLike MR. BRINEY, it's important to
become friends with your POKéMON.$

label: Route104_Text_BrendanWeShouldRegister
text: BRENDAN: Oh, hey, {PLAYER}!\pCool, you had DEVON install the MATCH\nCALL system on your POKéNAV!\pLet's register each other in our\nPOKéNAVS so we can keep in touch.$

label: Route104_Text_BrineyLivesInSeasideCottage
text: That seaside cottage is where\nMR. BRINEY lives.\pHe was once a mighty sailor who never\nfeared the sea, however stormy.$

label: Route104_Text_CindyDefeat
text: Oh, my!$

label: Route104_Text_CindyIntro
text: We must have been fated to meet.\nMay I ask you for a battle?$

label: Route104_Text_CindyPostBattle
text: “Hello” is the beginning of “good-bye.”\nI hope we meet again.$

label: Route104_Text_CindyPostRematch
text: “Hello” is the beginning of “good-bye.”\nI hope we meet again.$

label: Route104_Text_CindyRegister1
text: Hello, we meet again.\pWe seem to be drawn together. Let's\nregister each other in our POKéNAVS.$

label: Route104_Text_CindyRegister2
text: We should commemorate how we seem\nto be drawn to each other.\pLet's register each other in our\nPOKéNAVS.$

label: Route104_Text_CindyRematchDefeat
text: Oh, my…\nI did the best that I could…$

label: Route104_Text_CindyRematchIntro
text: Hello, we meet again.\nMay I ask you for a battle?$

label: Route104_Text_DadPokenavCall
text:
… … … … … …
… … … … … Beep!\pDAD: Oh, {PLAYER}?\p… … … … … …
Where are you now?\lIt sounds windy wherever you are.\pI just heard from DEVON's MR. STONE
about your POKéNAV, so I decided\lto give you a call.\pIt sounds like you're doing fine,
so that's fine with me.\pYou take care now.\p… … … … … …
… … … … … Click!$

label: Route104_Text_DarianDefeat
text: What the…$

label: Route104_Text_DarianIntro
text: I fished up a tough-looking POKéMON!\pIt has this magical quality to it!\nIt surely looks tough, yes it does!$

label: Route104_Text_DarianPostBattle
text: Hey, MAGIKARP, you sure don't live up\nto your name, do you?$

label: Route104_Text_DontNeedThisTakeIt
text:
This FLOWER SHOP started selling
saplings recently.\pIt made me so happy, I went overboard
shopping.\pI don't need this WHITE HERB anymore.
Would you take it, please?$

label: Route104_Text_FlowerShopSellingSaplings
text: This FLOWER SHOP started selling\nsaplings recently.\pIt made me so happy, I went overboard\nshopping. Where should I put them?$

label: Route104_Text_GinaDefeat
text: GINA: Losing upsets me!$

label: Route104_Text_GinaIntro
text: GINA: Okay, let's battle with our\nPOKéMON!$

label: Route104_Text_GinaNotEnoughMons
text: GINA: Oh? Only one POKéMON?\nThen, we don't battle with you.\pIf there's only one POKéMON, it will\nbe lonesome. That's not nice.$

label: Route104_Text_GinaPostBattle
text: GINA: You are strong!\nWe have to train lots more!$

label: Route104_Text_HaleyDefeat
text: I shouldn't have battled…$

label: Route104_Text_HaleyIntro
text: Should I…\nOr shouldn't I?\pOkay, sure, I will battle!$

label: Route104_Text_HaleyPostBattle
text: If you're faced with a decision and\nyou let someone else choose for you,\lyou will regret it, however things\lturn out.$

label: Route104_Text_HaleyPostRematch
text: I made the decision to battle, so\nI can accept this loss with grace.\pI am still upset about losing!$

label: Route104_Text_HaleyRegister1
text: You're strong, but should I register\nyou in my POKéNAV?\lMaybe I shouldn't…\pOkay, sure, I will register you!$

label: Route104_Text_HaleyRegister2
text: You're strong, but should I register\nyou in my POKéNAV?\lMaybe I shouldn't…\pOkay, sure, I will register you!$

label: Route104_Text_HaleyRematchDefeat
text: Ohh…\nI thought I could win…$

label: Route104_Text_HaleyRematchIntro
text: Come on, battle with me!$

label: Route104_Text_ImNotATrainer
text: Oh, no, I'm not a TRAINER.\pBut that's right, if TRAINERS lock eyes,\nit's a challenge to battle.\pIf you don't want to battle, stay out\nof their sight.$

label: Route104_Text_IvanDefeat
text: I thought I wasn't too bad, if I may\nsay so, but I guess not… Bleah…$

label: Route104_Text_IvanIntro
text: Why keep it a secret?\nI'm the WATER POKéMON expert!\pHuh?\nYou don't know me?$

label: Route104_Text_IvanPostBattle
text: I got too into fishing.\nI forgot I had to raise my POKéMON…$

label: Route104_Text_LandedInDewfordDeliverLetter
text: MR. BRINEY: Ahoy!\nWe've hit land in DEWFORD.\pI suppose you're off to deliver that\nLETTER to, who was it now, STEVEN!$

label: Route104_Text_LikeFillingMouthWithSeedsTakeThis
text: I like filling my mouth with seeds,\nthen spitting them out fast!\pYou can have this, so you try it out!\pUse it on a POKéMON, and it will learn\na move for firing seeds rapidly.$

label: Route104_Text_MayDefeat
text: Yikes!\nYou're better than I expected!$

label: Route104_Text_MayHaventRaisedPokemon
