label: Route123_Text_BraxtonDefeat
text: Oh, you're worthy, all right!$

label: Route123_Text_BraxtonIntro
text: You seem to have a big collection\nof GYM BADGES.\pLet me see if you're actually worthy of\nthose BADGES!$

label: Route123_Text_BraxtonPostBattle
text: You did your BADGES proud in that\nmatch!$

label: Route123_Text_CameronDefeat
text: I feel sad…$

label: Route123_Text_CameronIntro
text: Being a psychic is about willpower.\pI've willed myself not to lose to\nanyone. That makes me strong!$

label: Route123_Text_CameronPostBattle
text: Being a psychic is about willpower.\nI thought I wouldn't lose to you…$

label: Route123_Text_CameronPostRematch
text: I should train at MT. PYRE…\nI'll never beat you this way…$

label: Route123_Text_CameronRegister
text: I sense it!\nYou and I shall battle again!\lI can't tell if I'll win, though…\pLet's see your POKéNAV.$

label: Route123_Text_CameronRematchDefeat
text: I feel sad…$

label: Route123_Text_CameronRematchIntro
text: I've convinced myself that I won't\nlose anymore. That makes me strong!$

label: Route123_Text_CheckTreesWithMyGrassMon
text: I check trees with my GRASS-type\nPOKéMON. I'm like a tree doctor.$

label: Route123_Text_DavisDefeat
text: Waaaah!\nYou meanie!$

label: Route123_Text_DavisIntro
text: This is my awesome BUG POKéMON!\nMy big brother got it for me.$

label: Route123_Text_DavisPostBattle
text: Don't tell my brother I lost.\nYou have to keep it a secret!$

label: Route123_Text_EdDefeat
text: I kind of like your POKéMON.$

label: Route123_Text_EdIntro
text: When there are no TRAINERS around,\nI let my POKéMON battle each other.\lI watch them.$

label: Route123_Text_EdPostBattle
text: Hehe, I'm swiping your battling ideas!\nI think they'll make me better.$

label: Route123_Text_FernandoDefeat
text: Hey, hold it!\nI was still playing the intro!$

label: Route123_Text_FernandoIntro
text: I'll turn your lights out while\nI rip through this tune!$

label: Route123_Text_FernandoPostBattle
text: You're rock steady.\nI'd like to write a tune about you.$

label: Route123_Text_FernandoPostRematch
text: I thought you'd be so enthralled\nby my tune, you'd lose.$

label: Route123_Text_FernandoRegister
text: The next time, lend your ears to\nthe full tune, will you?$

label: Route123_Text_FernandoRematchDefeat
text: Hey, hold it!\nI haven't even hit the chorus!$

label: Route123_Text_FernandoRematchIntro
text: Today's the day I'm going to do it!\nI'll turn out your lights before\lI finish singing my song!$

label: Route123_Text_FrederickDefeat
text: Ah, a mighty capable child!\nLet me contribute to your allowance.$

label: Route123_Text_FrederickIntro
text: Hello, child!\nCan you spare some time?$

label: Route123_Text_FrederickPostBattle
text: Contribute to your allowance?\nWasn't the prize money enough?$

label: Route123_Text_JackiDefeat
text: Overwhelmed!$

label: Route123_Text_JackiIntro
text: Don't be too happy if your POKéMON\ndevelop psychic powers.\pYou need to refine those powers to\nmake them really useful.$

label: Route123_Text_JackiPostBattle
text: We all have psychic powers.\nWe've just forgotten how to use them.$

label: Route123_Text_JackiPostRematch
text: Your power with POKéMON…\nThat could be a psychic power, too.$

label: Route123_Text_JackiRegister
text: I would like to face you again.\nIs that okay with you?$

label: Route123_Text_JackiRematchDefeat
text: Astounding!$

label: Route123_Text_JackiRematchIntro
text: Have you awoken the psychic powers\nwithin you?$

label: Route123_Text_JazmynDefeat
text: There goes my confidence…$

label: Route123_Text_JazmynIntro
text: My confidence will get a boost by\nbeating someone obviously strong!$

label: Route123_Text_JazmynPostBattle
text: They say that you can't judge a person\nby their appearance.\pBut often, their looks don't lie…$

label: Route123_Text_JonasDefeat
text: If you don't lose, how am I supposed\nto have fun playing ninja?$

label: Route123_Text_JonasIntro
text: I lay in ambush, and a TRAINER has\nlanded in my trap!$

label: Route123_Text_JonasPostBattle
text: I'm going to ambush a weaker-looking\nTRAINER next time.$

label: Route123_Text_KayleyDefeat
text: You're better than me by about\nfive times!$

label: Route123_Text_KayleyIntro
text: I just bought this parasol.\nMy cuteness should be up by a third!$

label: Route123_Text_KayleyPostBattle
text: Using accessories effectively is\nthe secret behind fashion appeal.$

label: Route123_Text_KindraDefeat
text: Overflowing with vitality…$

label: Route123_Text_KindraIntro
text: MT. PYRE…\nWhere the spirits of POKéMON sleep…\lWill your POKéMON sleep?$

label: Route123_Text_KindraPostBattle
text: MT. PYRE…\nWhere the spirits of POKéMON sleep…\pIt must overflow with a power that\nsoothes spirits…$

label: Route123_Text_LoveGrassMonsHaveAny
text: I love GRASS-type POKéMON!\pDo you have any GRASS-type POKéMON?$

label: Route123_Text_MiuDefeat
text: MIU: Uh-oh, we lost.$

label: Route123_Text_MiuIntro
text: MIU: Hello, TRAINER. I hope your\nPOKéMON won't cry when they lose.$

label: Route123_Text_MiuNotEnoughMons
text: MIU: It's no fun to battle if you\ndon't have two POKéMON.$

label: Route123_Text_MiuPostBattle
text: MIU: TRAINER, your POKéMON are\nstrong because you are friends.$

label: Route123_Text_RouteSign
text: {RIGHT_ARROW} ROUTE 123\n{LEFT_ARROW} ROUTE 118$

label: Route123_Text_RouteSignMtPyre
text: {UP_ARROW} MT. PYRE\n“Forbidden to the faint of heart.”$

label: Route123_Text_VioletDefeat
text: Oh…\nI smell the bitter scent of misery…$

label: Route123_Text_VioletIntro
text: They say that good times are filled\nwith good aromas.$

label: Route123_Text_VioletPostBattle
text: The BERRY MASTER's garden is filled\nwith uplifting fragrances.$

label: Route123_Text_WendyDefeat
text: You passed with flying colors!$

label: Route123_Text_WendyIntro
text: Want to determine how strong you are?\nI'll be the test!$

label: Route123_Text_WendyPostBattle
text: To best even me…\nYour strength is marvelous!$

label: Route123_Text_YouLikeGrassMonsTooHaveThis
text: Oh?\pYou like GRASS-type POKéMON, too,\ndon't you?\pI'm so happy, you can have this!\nIt's a token of our friendship.$

label: Route123_Text_YukiDefeat
text: YUKI: Uh-oh, we lost.$

label: Route123_Text_YukiIntro
text: YUKI: Okay!\nWe're beating the TRAINER's POKéMON!$

label: Route123_Text_YukiNotEnoughMons
text: YUKI: It's no fun to battle if you\ndon't have two POKéMON.$

label: Route123_Text_YukiPostBattle
text: YUKI: Why are you so strong?\nWe've never lost before.$

label: Route124_DivingTreasureHuntersHouse_Text_BagFull
text: Whoops, your BAG's full.\nGet rid of some items, friend!$

label: Route124_DivingTreasureHuntersHouse_Text_ComeBackIfYouChangeMind
text: No? That's a downer.\nWell, if you change your mind, come back.$

label: Route124_DivingTreasureHuntersHouse_Text_Greeting
text: I'm the DIVING TREASURE HUNTER!\pI'm the awesome dude who makes\ndeep-sea dives to gather treasures\lresting at the bottom.$

label: Route124_DivingTreasureHuntersHouse_Text_HaveYouSeenAnyShards
text: Tell me, have you seen any SHARDS of\ntools made in ancient times?$

label: Route124_DivingTreasureHuntersHouse_Text_ItsADeal
text: It's a done deal!\nUse that wisely!$

label: Route124_DivingTreasureHuntersHouse_Text_ShardTradeBoard
text:
{CLEAR_TO 10}Wanted item{CLEAR_TO 124}Trade item
{CLEAR_TO 15}RED SHARD{CLEAR_TO 89}{LEFT_ARROW}{RIGHT_ARROW}{CLEAR_TO 123}FIRE STONE{CLEAR_TO 200}\p{CLEAR_TO 10}Wanted item{CLEAR_TO 124}Trade item
{CLEAR_TO 6}YELLOW SHARD{CLEAR_TO 89}{LEFT_ARROW}{RIGHT_ARROW}{CLEAR_TO 115}THUNDERSTONE{CLEAR_TO 200}\p{CLEAR_TO 10}Wanted item{CLEAR_TO 124}Trade item
{CLEAR_TO 12}BLUE SHARD{CLEAR_TO 89}{LEFT_ARROW}{RIGHT_ARROW}{CLEAR_TO 121}WATER STONE{CLEAR_TO 200}\p{CLEAR_TO 10}Wanted item{CLEAR_TO 124}Trade item
{CLEAR_TO 8}GREEN SHARD{CLEAR_TO 89}{LEFT_ARROW}{RIGHT_ARROW}{CLEAR_TO 123}LEAF STONE$

label: Route124_DivingTreasureHuntersHouse_Text_ThatsAShardIllTradeYou
text: Oh, hey! That…\nThat's a SHARD! I'm looking for those!\pOh, man, you've got to trade that\nwith me! I'll give you something good!$

label: Route124_DivingTreasureHuntersHouse_Text_TradeSomethingElse
text: Do you want to trade something else?$

label: Route124_DivingTreasureHuntersHouse_Text_WhatDoYouWantToTrade
text: What do you want to trade?$

label: Route124_DivingTreasureHuntersHouse_Text_YouHaventGotAnyShards
text: You haven't got any treasures\nfor me…\pIf you see any SHARDS, like the RED\nSHARD, you've got to trade it with me!$

label: Route124_DivingTreasureHuntersHouse_Text_YoullTradeShardForStone
text: You'll trade your {STR_VAR_1} for\nmy {STR_VAR_2}, then?$

label: Route124_Text_ChadDefeat
text: Glub, glub, glub…\nI'm sinking…$

label: Route124_Text_ChadIntro
text: Fufufufu… I dive deep underwater\nto go deep under cover.\lPlumbing the depths is where I excel!$

label: Route124_Text_ChadPostBattle
text: I have it on good authority that\nthere's a DIVE spot around here.\pIt gives me the urge to go deep\nagain…$

label: Route124_Text_DeclanDefeat
text: I'm feeling blue.\nBlue as the sky…$

label: Route124_Text_DeclanIntro
text: Here I am swimming by my lonesome\non this wide, beautiful sea.\pThere's no other word for it.\nThis is pathetic!$

label: Route124_Text_DeclanPostBattle
text: I should chat up lady SWIMMERS\nand invite them on a long swim.$

label: Route124_Text_GraceDefeat
text: I had no idea that you were\nthis strong!$

label: Route124_Text_GraceIntro
text: I'm growing bored of swimming…\nHow about a battle?$

label: Route124_Text_GracePostBattle
text: All the effort you put in must have\nmade you this strong.$

label: Route124_Text_HuntersHouse
text: HUNTER'S HOUSE$

label: Route124_Text_IsabellaDefeat
text: I've only got sweat in my eyes!\nI am not crying!$

label: Route124_Text_IsabellaIntro
text: I'm not going to lose to some\nsurfer TRAINER.$

label: Route124_Text_IsabellaPostBattle
text: You can find pretty colored shards\nof things around here.$

label: Route124_Text_JennyDefeat
text: Oh, darn.\nI've gone and lost.$

label: Route124_Text_JennyIntro
text: If you just float in the sea like\nthis, POKéMON come around to play.$

label: Route124_Text_JennyPostBattle
text: While swimming, I noticed that some\nPOKéMON attack, and some just watch.\pI guess POKéMON have personalities\nof their own.$

label: Route124_Text_JennyPostRematch
text: This has nothing to do with anything,\nbut maybe I'll visit the TRICK HOUSE.$

label: Route124_Text_JennyRegister
text: It's only on a whim, but maybe I'll get\nyou to register me in your POKéNAV.$

label: Route124_Text_JennyRematchDefeat
text: That's strange…\nI lost again…$

label: Route124_Text_JennyRematchIntro
text: If you just float in the sea like this,\nTRAINERS challenge you!$

label: Route124_Text_LilaDefeat
text: LILA: ROY! It's your fault we lost!\nYou're in for it later!$

label: Route124_Text_LilaIntro
text: LILA: Sigh…\pHere I am in the sea, but who's with me?\nMy little brother!\pLet's battle so I won't have to dwell\non that!$

label: Route124_Text_LilaNotEnoughMons
text: LILA: You're planning to battle us?\nNot unless you have two POKéMON.$

label: Route124_Text_LilaPostBattle
text: LILA: Sigh…\pIf only it wasn't my little brother\nnext to me, but a nice boyfriend…$

label: Route124_Text_LilaPostRematch
text: LILA: Sigh…\pIf I had a nice boyfriend, we'd beat\nanyone with lovely combinations…$

label: Route124_Text_LilaRematchDefeat
text: LILA: ROY!\nIt's your fault we lost again!\pWe're having a training session later!$

label: Route124_Text_LilaRematchIntro
text: LILA: Sigh…\pHere I am in the sea, but who's with me?\nMy little brother!\pOh, hi, it's been a while. Let's battle\nso I won't have to dwell on things!$

label: Route124_Text_LilaRematchNotEnoughMons
text: LILA: You're planning to battle us?\nNot unless you have two POKéMON.$

label: Route124_Text_LilaRoyRegister
text: ROY: Will you battle with us again?\nBut take it easy next time, okay?$

label: Route124_Text_RolandDefeat
text: Oh!\nI can't…$

label: Route124_Text_RolandIntro
text: Hm! You're riding a POKéMON instead\nof swimming yourself…\pI am envious!$

label: Route124_Text_RolandPostBattle
text: I'm getting chilled…\nI've been in the water too long…\pI wish I could ride a POKéMON like you…$

label: Route124_Text_RoyDefeat
text: ROY: Uh-oh…\nMy big sister will chew me out…$

label: Route124_Text_RoyIntro
text: ROY: My big sister is tough at POKéMON!\pDon't cry when you lose!$

label: Route124_Text_RoyNotEnoughMons
text: ROY: Did you want to battle us?\nBring two POKéMON, then.$

label: Route124_Text_RoyPostBattle
text: ROY: My big sister is really scary\nwhen she gets angry.\pThat's why she doesn't have a\nboyfriend.$

label: Route124_Text_RoyPostRematch
text: ROY: My big sister is really scary\nwhen she gets angry.\pShe's going to make me train really\nhard with POKéMON later…$

label: Route124_Text_RoyRematchDefeat
text: ROY: Uh-oh…\nMy big sister will chew me out again.$

label: Route124_Text_RoyRematchIntro
text: ROY: If we lose, I'll catch heck.\nI'm going to go totally all out!$

label: Route124_Text_RoyRematchNotEnoughMons
text: ROY: Did you want to battle us?\nBring two POKéMON, then.$

label: Route124_Text_SpencerDefeat
text: I lost my bearings in battle!$

label: Route124_Text_SpencerIntro
text: Hey, are you lost at sea?\pIf you can beat my POKéMON,\nI can serve as your pilot.$

label: Route124_Text_SpencerPostBattle
text: Many people lose their bearings at sea.\pIf you're that sort, you should refer\nto the POKéNAV's MAP.$

label: Route125_Text_AuronDefeat
text: Oh, you weren't throwing trash into\nthe sea.$

label: Route125_Text_AuronIntro
text: Hey! Was it you throwing garbage\ninto the sea?$

label: Route125_Text_AuronPostBattle
text: I found an unsightly bottle bobbing\nin the waves earlier.\pIt angers me that someone would\npollute the sea!$

label: Route125_Text_ErnestDefeat
text: Gwrroooar!\nI couldn't win!$

label: Route125_Text_ErnestIntro
text: Ahoy! I'm a buff, tough SAILOR!\nI've braved the world's seas!$

label: Route125_Text_ErnestPostBattle
text: The tide ebbs and flows inside the\nSHOAL CAVE.\pBy the way, it's about six hours from\nhigh tide to low tide. Did you know?$

label: Route125_Text_ErnestRegister
text: Register me in your POKéNAV,\nand I'll tell you something good.$

label: Route125_Text_ErnestRematchDefeat
text: I couldn't win!\nI flat out couldn't win!$

label: Route125_Text_ErnestRematchIntro
text: It's high time I get my payback\nfrom you! Come on, we're battling!$

label: Route125_Text_ErnestRematchPostBattle
text: The SHOAL CAVE…\pThere are places you can and can't\nget to depending on the rise and fall\lof the tide.\pBy the way, it's about six hours from\nhigh tide to low tide. Don't forget!$

label: Route125_Text_IrisDefeat
text: IRIS: Oh, we came sort of close.$

label: Route125_Text_IrisIntro
text: IRIS: KIM, can you tell me what we're\nlooking for out here?$

label: Route125_Text_IrisNotEnoughMons
text: IRIS: Oh, we could never, ever do\nanything like a 2-on-1 battle.$

label: Route125_Text_IrisPostBattle
text: IRIS: KIM, are we really going into\nthe SHOAL CAVE?\lWe'll get all wet.$

label: Route125_Text_KimDefeat
text: KIM: I thought we would win.$

label: Route125_Text_KimIntro
text: KIM: A funny old man lives in the\nSHOAL CAVE. Someone told me.\lAre you going to see him, too?$

label: Route125_Text_KimNotEnoughMons
text: KIM: No, no, no! You need two POKéMON,\nor it's just no good!$

label: Route125_Text_KimPostBattle
text: KIM: A funny old man lives in the\nSHOAL CAVE, doesn't he?\pLet's go see him, IRIS!$

label: Route125_Text_NolenDefeat
text: I surrender!$

label: Route125_Text_NolenIntro
text: I heard you approaching, so I hung\naround for you!$

label: Route125_Text_NolenPostBattle
text: Sound travels faster in water than\nit does through air.$

label: Route125_Text_PresleyDefeat
text: Okay.\nI'll tell you why I'm here.$

label: Route125_Text_PresleyIntro
text: Why would a BIRDKEEPER like me\ncome out to the sea?$

label: Route125_Text_PresleyPostBattle
text: I put a message in a bottle and put\nit out to sea.\pI'm sure that a girl SWIMMER will\nfind it!$

label: Route125_Text_SharonDefeat
text: Lost it…$

label: Route125_Text_SharonIntro
text: How would you like to take on the\nWATER-type POKéMON I raised?$

label: Route125_Text_SharonPostBattle
text: Your power… You're the real deal.\nI'm amazed!$

label: Route125_Text_StanDefeat
text: I floundered…$

label: Route125_Text_StanIntro
text: Hey, there!\nCheck out my sweet POKéMON!$

label: Route125_Text_StanPostBattle
text: I was blown away by HORSEA's charm,\nso I started swimming, too.$

label: Route125_Text_TanyaDefeat
text: You're too much!$

label: Route125_Text_TanyaIntro
text: I'm tired of swimming.\nAre you up for a battle with me?$

label: Route125_Text_TanyaPostBattle
text: Whew…\nWhich way is it to MOSSDEEP CITY?$

label: Route126_Text_BarryDefeat
text: I admit it!\nYou win!$

label: Route126_Text_BarryIntro
text: Swimming is a full-body workout!\nYou will get fit!$

label: Route126_Text_BarryPostBattle
text: Thanks to my daily swimming routine…\nLook! Feast your eyes on this physique!$

label: Route126_Text_BrendaDefeat
text: Oh, noooooh!$

label: Route126_Text_BrendaIntro
text: Hello, kiddo!\nWant a battle with me?$

label: Route126_Text_BrendaPostBattle
text: I love frolicking with POKéMON in\nthe sea like this!$

label: Route126_Text_DeanDefeat
text: I was done in?$

label: Route126_Text_DeanIntro
text: This towering white mountain of rock\nis SOOTOPOLIS CITY.$

label: Route126_Text_DeanPostBattle
text: I can't find the entrance to\nSOOTOPOLIS. Where could it be?$

label: Route126_Text_IsobelDefeat
text: Ack! Why, you…\nGlub!$

label: Route126_Text_IsobelIntro
text: If seawater gets up your nose,\ndoesn't it feel terrible?$

label: Route126_Text_IsobelPostBattle
text: Ooh, I choked on some water!\nIt's bitter! It's salty!!$

label: Route126_Text_LeonardoDefeat
text: Sheesh, getting greedy didn't do\na thing for me.$

label: Route126_Text_LeonardoIntro
text: I couldn't even swim last year,\nbut now I'm a decent SWIMMER.\pI think I'm capable of anything now.$

label: Route126_Text_LeonardoPostBattle
text: If you practice at something,\nyou will get better at it.\pYou're young--don't be afraid to\ntry all sorts of things!$

label: Route126_Text_NikkiDefeat
text: My fantasy burst as if it were a bubble!\nBlub, blub, blub…$

label: Route126_Text_NikkiIntro
text: Ufufufufu!\nI'm a mermaid!$

label: Route126_Text_NikkiPostBattle
text: You thrashed me… I want to\ndisappear in a wave of despair…$

label: Route126_Text_PabloDefeat
text: Whoops! Too strong!\nNot bad! Not bad at all!$

label: Route126_Text_PabloIntro
text: Check out this sculpted body!\nI'm more cut than a BLACK BELT!$

label: Route126_Text_PabloPostBattle
text: Losing to you stimulated my senses!\nI'll train myself and POKéMON harder!$

label: Route126_Text_PabloPostRematch
text: I'm going to train even harder!\nYou're a great motivator!\lYou have to come back again!$

label: Route126_Text_PabloRegister
text: Yep, you're not bad at all!\nI'd like to get to know you more!$

label: Route126_Text_PabloRematchDefeat
text: Whoops! Really too strong!\nNot bad! Not bad at all!$

label: Route126_Text_PabloRematchIntro
text: Check out this beautiful body!\nI'm more shapely than a SWIMMER!$

label: Route126_Text_SiennaDefeat
text: You had more heart!$

label: Route126_Text_SiennaIntro
text: I'm throwing my whole heart\ninto this!$

label: Route126_Text_SiennaPostBattle
text: I need to cool down now…\nI think I'll go for a dive.$

label: Route127_Text_AidanDefeat
text: Whew… I give up.$

label: Route127_Text_AidanIntro
text: BIRD POKéMON have excellent vision.\nThey spot prey from great heights.$

label: Route127_Text_AidanPostBattle
text: There're lots of diving spots in\nthe sea around here.\pYou can spot them easily from the sky\nbecause of their darker color.$

label: Route127_Text_AthenaDefeat
text: You didn't give me the chance to\ndo any strategizing.$

label: Route127_Text_AthenaIntro
text: We should have a slow and methodical\nmatch.$

label: Route127_Text_AthenaPostBattle
text: When I'm surrounded by the blue sea\nand sky, it feels as if time slows down.$

label: Route127_Text_CamdenDefeat
text: Awawawawawa…$

label: Route127_Text_CamdenIntro
text: I can see it in your face.\nYou want to challenge me.$

label: Route127_Text_CamdenPostBattle
text: A well-played match leaves me feeling\nrefreshed and serene.$

label: Route127_Text_DonnyDefeat
text: Arrrgh!\nI hate losing!$

label: Route127_Text_DonnyIntro
text: Do you have a rival whom you just\nhate to lose against?$

label: Route127_Text_DonnyPostBattle
text: If you have a rival, don't you get the\nfeeling that you have to keep getting\lbetter?$

label: Route127_Text_HenryDefeat
text: I can't keep up!$

label: Route127_Text_HenryIntro
text: Whoops! Don't tell me I snagged\na SURFING POKéMON?$

label: Route127_Text_HenryPostBattle
text: It'd be a handful if I hooked\nyour tough POKéMON!$

label: Route127_Text_JonahDefeat
text: Though I have lost, my heart remains\ncalm…$

label: Route127_Text_JonahIntro
text: Through fishing, I have attained a\nstate of becalmed serenity…\pPlease, allow me to demonstrate…$

label: Route127_Text_JonahPostBattle
text: It matters not that I catch nothing.\nThe line remains in the water…$

label: Route127_Text_KojiDefeat
text: Yowch!\nI got a pebble under a toenail!$

label: Route127_Text_KojiIntro
text: Run in your bare feet.\nThat will toughen up your soles!$

label: Route127_Text_KojiPostBattle
text: Going barefoot feels great.\nBut your RUNNING SHOES are cool, too.$

label: Route127_Text_KojiPostRematch
text: Want to go barefoot for a while?\nSo I can try your RUNNING SHOES?$

label: Route127_Text_KojiRegister
text: This is what I do to people who beat me!\nI hope we can do this again.$

label: Route127_Text_KojiRematchDefeat
text: Yowch!\nPebbles dug into my arches!$

label: Route127_Text_KojiRematchIntro
text: I still run in my bare feet daily.\nMy soles are tough!$

label: Route127_Text_RogerDefeat
text: No! My line's all tangled!\nThe party's over!$

label: Route127_Text_RogerIntro
text: Well, hey! This is a match between\na POKéMON fan and a fishing buff!$

label: Route127_Text_RogerPostBattle
text: My fishing line's doing a dance!\nThe tangle tango! Hahaha, snarl!$

label: Route128_Text_AlexaDefeat
text: Oh!\nHow could this happen?!$

label: Route128_Text_AlexaIntro
text: We've been working so hard to mount\na POKéMON LEAGUE challenge…\pWe can't afford to lose now!$

label: Route128_Text_AlexaPostBattle
text: After all I've done to get here,\nI won't give up after one setback.$

label: Route128_Text_ArchieIOnlyWanted
text: I…\nI only wanted…$

label: Route128_Text_ArchieWhatHappened
text: ARCHIE: What happened…\nWhat is this wretched scene…\pDid I…make a horrible mistake?$

label: Route128_Text_CarleeDefeat
text: I couldn't see very well because of\nthe sun's glare.$

label: Route128_Text_CarleeIntro
text: The sunlight seems to be more harsh\nin this area.$

label: Route128_Text_CarleePostBattle
text: I should go back soon.\nI need to reapply my sunscreen.$

label: Route128_Text_HarrisonDefeat
text: Ouch!\nI guess it was impossible to win.$

label: Route128_Text_HarrisonIntro
text: You're looking awfully tough.\nI wonder if I can win?$

label: Route128_Text_HarrisonPostBattle
text: There are tough TRAINERS galore\naround EVER GRANDE.\pDo you think I may be out\nof my league?$

label: Route128_Text_IsaiahDefeat
text: My first victory seems to be far\naway, too…$

label: Route128_Text_IsaiahIntro
text: EVER GRANDE CITY is still a long ways\naway…$

label: Route128_Text_IsaiahPostBattle
text: My whole life has been about losing,\nbut I will never give up!$

label: Route128_Text_IsaiahPostRematch
text: I'll eventually reach EVER GRANDE CITY\nwhere I can eventually win…$

label: Route128_Text_IsaiahRegister
text: I know I'm not good now, but I think\nI can win eventually.\pPlease register me in your POKéNAV.$

label: Route128_Text_IsaiahRematchDefeat
text: I've yet to taste my first victory…$

label: Route128_Text_IsaiahRematchIntro
text: I'm still feeling good. I'll keep on\nswimming to EVER GRANDE CITY.$

label: Route128_Text_KatelynDefeat
text: A POKéMON battle is grueling, too…$

label: Route128_Text_KatelynIntro
text: You have to swim, cycle, and then run\na marathon in a triathlon.\pIt's a grueling race that consists\nof three events.$

label: Route128_Text_KatelynPostBattle
text: I have to ride a BIKE next, but…\nI'm about to throw in the towel…$

label: Route128_Text_KatelynPostRematch
text: You should give serious thought to\nchallenges on VICTORY ROAD.$

label: Route128_Text_KatelynRegister
text: Well, I may as well make the best\nof this. I'd like a rematch sometime.$

label: Route128_Text_KatelynRematchDefeat
text: A POKéMON battle really is harsh\nand unforgiving…$

label: Route128_Text_KatelynRematchIntro
text: A triathlon is long. But I guess the\nroad to become the POKéMON CHAMPION\lis also a long and grueling one.$

label: Route128_Text_MaxieDoYouUnderstandNow
text:
MAXIE: Do you understand now,
ARCHIE?\pDo you finally see how disastrous
your dream turned out to be?\pWe have to hurry! We have to do
something before the situation goes\lcompletely out of control!$

label: Route128_Text_MaxieResposibilityFallsToArchieAndMe
text:
MAXIE: {PLAYER}, don't say anything.\pI know that I have no right to be
critical of ARCHIE…\pBut the way things are now, I doubt
that we humans will be capable of\ldoing anything about it.\pBut neither can we stand by and
just watch helplessly.\pThe responsibility for putting an end
to this falls to ARCHIE and me…$

label: Route128_Text_MaxieThisDefiesBelief
text: MAXIE: This defies belief…\pThose super-ancient POKéMON…\pTheir power is unbelievable.\nThey've upset the balance of nature…$

label: Route128_Text_RubenDefeat
text: This can't be!$

label: Route128_Text_RubenIntro
text: There is no stronger TRAINER than I!$

label: Route128_Text_RubenPostBattle
text: There probably is no stronger TRAINER\nthan you!$

label: Route128_Text_StevenImGoingToSootopolis
text: {PLAYER}{KUN}…\nI don't know what you intend to do,\lbut don't do anything reckless.\pOkay.\nI'm going to SOOTOPOLIS.$

label: Route128_Text_StevenWhatIsHappening
text: STEVEN: {PLAYER}{KUN}!\nWhat is happening?$

label: Route128_Text_StevenWholeWorldWillDrown
text:
This is terrible…\pAfter the scorching heat wave ended,
this deluge began.\pIf this doesn't stop, all of HOENN…
No, the whole world will drown.\pThis huge rain cloud is spreading
from above SOOTOPOLIS…\pWhat in the world is taking place there?\pThere's no point arguing here…
SOOTOPOLIS might provide answers…$

label: Route128_Text_WayneDefeat
text: I'm crestfallen!$

label: Route128_Text_WayneIntro
text: I want to visit EVER GRANDE, so I\ncaught myself a POKéMON that knows\lthe move WATERFALL to crest the falls.$

label: Route128_Text_WaynePostBattle
text: Awww, phooey!\pMy POKéMON knows WATERFALL, but\nI don't have the SOOTOPOLIS GYM BADGE!$

label: Route129_Text_AllisonDefeat
text: I was sure I'd win!$

label: Route129_Text_AllisonIntro
text: I'm in the middle of a triathlon,\nbut, sure, why don't we battle?$

label: Route129_Text_AllisonPostBattle
text: Do you know what's the greatest thing\nabout triathlons?\pTesting the limits of your own\nstrength and endurance against\lMother Nature!$

label: Route129_Text_ChaseDefeat
text: Wroooaaar!\nI failed to win!$

label: Route129_Text_ChaseIntro
text: This is my first triathlon.\nI'm all tense and nervous!$

label: Route129_Text_ChasePostBattle
text: If I'm all tensed up, I won't be able to\ngive it my all.$

label: Route129_Text_ClarenceDefeat
text: Winning sure isn't easy.$

label: Route129_Text_ClarenceIntro
text: Surfing isn't as easy as it seems,\nisn't that right?$

label: Route129_Text_ClarencePostBattle
text: You have your sights on the POKéMON\nLEAGUE? Keep at it!$

label: Route129_Text_ReedDefeat
text: Beat, I'm beaten.\nThat's it, done!$

label: Route129_Text_ReedIntro
text: Say hey, hey!\nLet's get on with it!$

label: Route129_Text_ReedPostBattle
text: There's nothing for a loser.\nTime for me to beat it home.$

label: Route129_Text_TishaDefeat
text: Oh, my.\nI wanted to relax a little more…$

label: Route129_Text_TishaIntro
text: What's the hurry?\nLet's take it slow and easy.$

label: Route129_Text_TishaPostBattle
text: Don't you hate making mistakes when\nyou're in a rush?\pThat's why I try to take things\nslowly.$

label: Route12_FishingHouse_Text_BlankChartOfSomeSort
text: It's a blank chart of some sort.\pIt has spaces for writing in\nrecords of some kind.$

label: Route12_FishingHouse_Text_DoYouLikeToFish
text: I'm the FISHING GURU's younger\nbrother.\pI simply looove fishing!\nI can't bear to go without.\pTell me, do you like to fish?$

label: Route12_FishingHouse_Text_DoesntLookLikeMagikarp
text: Uh… That doesn't look much like\na MAGIKARP.$

label: Route12_FishingHouse_Text_HmmXSizeDoesntMeasureUp
text: Hmm…\nThis one is {STR_VAR_2} long.\pIt doesn't measure up to the\n{STR_VAR_3} one you brought before.$

label: Route12_FishingHouse_Text_HuhXSizeSameSizeAsLast
text: Huh?\n{STR_VAR_2}?\pThis is the same size as the one\nI saw before.$

label: Route12_FishingHouse_Text_IfYouCatchBigMagikarpShowMe
text:
Fishing is a way of life!
It is like the finest poetry.\pFrom the seas to rivers, go out
and land the big one, my friend.\pNow, I have a request.\pIf you catch a big MAGIKARP 
with that ROD, I want to see it.\pAs much as I love to fish, I also
love seeing gigantic MAGIKARP.$

label: Route12_FishingHouse_Text_LookForwardToGreaterRecords
text: I'll look forward to seeing greater\nrecords from you!$

label: Route12_FishingHouse_Text_MostGiganticMagikarpXSize
text: The most gigantic MAGIKARP\nI have ever witnessed…\p{STR_VAR_3}!$

label: Route12_FishingHouse_Text_NoRoomForGift
text: Oh, no!\pI had a gift for you, but you have\nno room for it.$

label: Route12_FishingHouse_Text_OhMagikarpAllowMeToSee
text: Oh? {PLAYER}?\nWhy, if it isn't a MAGIKARP!\pAllow me to see it, quick!$

label: Route12_FishingHouse_Text_OhThatsDisappointing
text: Oh…\nThat's so disappointing…$

label: Route12_FishingHouse_Text_ReceivedSuperRod
text: {PLAYER} received a SUPER ROD from\nthe FISHING GURU's brother.$

label: Route12_FishingHouse_Text_TakeThisAndFish
text: Grand! I like your style.\nI think we can be friends.\pTake this and fish, young friend!$

label: Route12_FishingHouse_Text_TryFishingBringMeMagikarp
text:
Hello there, {PLAYER}!
Have you been fishing?\pTry fishing with the SUPER ROD in
any body of water.\pYou'll find different POKéMON in
different places.\pOh, and don't forget to bring me
gigantic MAGIKARP.$

label: Route12_FishingHouse_Text_WhoaXSizeTakeThis
text:
… … …Whoa!
{STR_VAR_2}!\pYou have a rare appreciation for
the fine, poetic aspects of fishing!\pYou must take this.
I insist!$

label: Route12_NorthEntrance_1F_Text_LookoutSpotUpstairs
text: There's a lookout spot upstairs.\nThe view is magnificent.$

label: Route12_NorthEntrance_2F_Text_DontHaveRoomForThis
text: You don't have room for this.$

label: Route12_NorthEntrance_2F_Text_ExplainTM27
text: TM27 is a move called RETURN…\pIf you treat your POKéMON good,\nit will return your love by working\lits hardest in battle.$

label: Route12_NorthEntrance_2F_Text_ItsPokemonTower
text: Let's see what the binoculars have\nto show…\pIt's POKéMON TOWER!$

label: Route12_NorthEntrance_2F_Text_ReceivedTM27FromLittleGirl
text: {PLAYER} received TM27\nfrom the little girl.$

label: Route12_NorthEntrance_2F_Text_TakeTMDontNeedAnymoreFemale
text: My POKéMON's ashes are stored in\nPOKéMON TOWER.\pYou can have this TM.\nI don't need it anymore…$

label: Route12_NorthEntrance_2F_Text_TakeTMDontNeedAnymoreMale
text: My POKéMON's ashes are stored in\nPOKéMON TOWER.\pYou can have this TM.\nI don't need it anymore…$

label: Route12_NorthEntrance_2F_Text_TheresManFishing
text: Let's see what the binoculars have\nto show…\pThere's a man fishing!$

label: Route12_Text_AndrewDefeat
text: Lost it!$

label: Route12_Text_AndrewIntro
text: What's catching?\pYou never know what you could\ncatch!$

label: Route12_Text_AndrewPostBattle
text: What, MAGIKARP?\pI catch them all the time, sure.\nBut, boy are they wimpy.$

label: Route12_Text_AndrewRematchIntro
text: What's catching?\pYou'll never know unless you beat\nme!$

label: Route12_Text_ChipDefeat
text: That one got away!$

label: Route12_Text_ChipIntro
text: Be patient.\nFishing is a waiting game.$

label: Route12_Text_ChipPostBattle
text: With a better ROD, I could catch\nbetter POKéMON…$

label: Route12_Text_ChipRematchIntro
text: You're finally here.\nFishing is a waiting game.$

label: Route12_Text_ElliotDefeat
text: It's not easy…$

label: Route12_Text_ElliotIntro
text: I love fishing, don't get me wrong.\pBut it'd be best if I also had more\nwork.$

label: Route12_Text_ElliotPostBattle
text: It's all right.\nLosing doesn't bug me anymore.$

label: Route12_Text_ElliotRematchIntro
text: I love fishing, don't get me wrong.\nBut, I wish I had more work…\l…It's hard to give up fishing!$

label: Route12_Text_GiaDefeat
text: GIA: Oh, but why?$

label: Route12_Text_GiaIntro
text: GIA: Hey, JES…\pIf we win, I'll marry you!$

label: Route12_Text_GiaNotEnoughMons
text: GIA: I can't bear to battle\nwithout my JES!\pDon't you have one more POKéMON?$

label: Route12_Text_GiaPostBattle
text: GIA: JES, you silly!\nYou ruined this!$

label: Route12_Text_GiaRematchIntro
text: GIA: Hey, JES…\nI've been waiting a long time now.\pIf we win today, I'll marry you!$

label: Route12_Text_HankDefeat
text: Touch too much!$

label: Route12_Text_HankIntro
text: The FISHING FOOL versus POKéMON\nKID!$

label: Route12_Text_HankPostBattle
text: I guess you get to be good at\nwhat you like.\pWell, you beat me at POKéMON,\nbut you can't top me at fishing.$

label: Route12_Text_HankRematchIntro
text: The FISHING FOOL vs. POKéMON KID!\nAnother round, fight!$

label: Route12_Text_JesDefeat
text: JES: Oh, please, why couldn't you\nlet us win?$

label: Route12_Text_JesIntro
text: JES: If I win, I'm going to\npropose to GIA.$

label: Route12_Text_JesNotEnoughMons
text: JES: GIA and I, we'll be\ntogether forever.\pWe won't battle unless you have\ntwo POKéMON of your own.$

label: Route12_Text_JesPostBattle
text: JES: Oh, GIA, forgive me,\nmy love!$

label: Route12_Text_JesRematchIntro
text: JES: I'll win here today and\npropose to my GIA.$

label: Route12_Text_JustinDefeat
text: Oww!$

label: Route12_Text_JustinIntro
text: I'm searching for a MOON STONE.\nHave you found one?$

label: Route12_Text_JustinPostBattle
text: I could have made my POKéMON\nevolve with a MOON STONE.\pI would have won then, I bet.$

label: Route12_Text_JustinRematchIntro
text: Still can't find a MOON STONE…\nHave you found one?$

label: Route12_Text_LucaDefeat
text: Unplugged!$

label: Route12_Text_LucaIntro
text: Electricity is my specialty.\pI don't know a thing about POKéMON\nof the sea, though.$

label: Route12_Text_LucaPostBattle
text: Water conducts electricity, so you\nshould zap sea POKéMON.$

label: Route12_Text_LucaRematchIntro
text: Electricity has always been my\nspecialty.\pI don't know a thing about POKéMON\nof the sea, though.$

label: Route12_Text_MonSprawledOutInSlumber
text: A POKéMON is sprawled out in\na deep and comfortable slumber.$

label: Route12_Text_NedDefeat
text: Tch!\nJust a small fry…$

label: Route12_Text_NedIntro
text: Yeah!\nI got a bite here!$

label: Route12_Text_NedPostBattle
text: Hang on!\nMy line's snagged!$

label: Route12_Text_NedRematchIntro
text: Yeah!\nI got a bite, here!\lTh-this might be the real thing!$

label: Route12_Text_RouteSign
text: ROUTE 12 \nNorth to LAVENDER$

label: Route12_Text_SportfishingArea
text: SPORTFISHING AREA$

label: Route130_Text_KatieDefeat
text: Like the vast blue sea,\nthe world of POKéMON spans\ldepths beyond belief.$

label: Route130_Text_KatieIntro
text: In the deep blue sea,\nmy shattered blue heart finds\lcomfort among waves.$

label: Route130_Text_KatiePostBattle
text: The world's children dream\nof one day becoming\lthe POKéMON CHAMPION.$

label: Route130_Text_RodneyDefeat
text: This kid's awfully tough…$

label: Route130_Text_RodneyIntro
text: What a surprise! I didn't expect to\nsee a TRAINER out in the sea.\pI think we should battle!$

label: Route130_Text_RodneyPostBattle
text: Your eyes have that look of someone\nwho's experienced harsh challenges\land won. It suits you well!$

label: Route130_Text_SantiagoDefeat
text: I needed to be a little less peaceful!$

label: Route130_Text_SantiagoIntro
text: Floating on the open sea like this…\nIt's peaceful.$

label: Route130_Text_SantiagoPostBattle
text: Swimming and battling like this…\nI'm one happy guy…$

label: Route131_Text_HermanDefeat
text: Bleah!$

label: Route131_Text_HermanIntro
text: The sea… The sea… The sea…\nThe sea as far as these eyes can see!\lI'm sick and tired of the sea!$

label: Route131_Text_HermanPostBattle
text: Bored I am by the sea, but swim I must.\pI'm a born swimmer!\nThat's what I am.$

label: Route131_Text_IanDefeat
text: IAN: I did my best with my sis,\nbut we still couldn't win…$

label: Route131_Text_IanIntro
text: IAN: I'm doing my best together with\nmy sis!$

label: Route131_Text_IanNotEnoughMons
text: IAN: If you have two POKéMON,\nwe'll take you on!$

label: Route131_Text_IanPostBattle
text: IAN: You know how PACIFIDLOG is\na floating town?\pSo, wherever there is the sea,\nthat's a part of PACIFIDLOG!$

label: Route131_Text_KaraDefeat
text: I'm out of my depth!$

label: Route131_Text_KaraIntro
text: Why do men love bathing suits so much?\pThey all ogle me!$

label: Route131_Text_KaraPostBattle
text: Maybe it's not my bathing suit that\nmakes men look. It must be my beauty!$

label: Route131_Text_KevinDefeat
text: Oops!$

label: Route131_Text_KevinIntro
text: The people of PACIFIDLOG are\na peaceful bunch.\pThey never get angry.\nThat goes for me, too.$

label: Route131_Text_KevinPostBattle
text: Tch! …Oh, wait.\nI'm not angry. Honestly!\pBut, boy, you're strong!\nHahaha!$

label: Route131_Text_ReliDefeat
text: RELI: We couldn't win even though we\nworked together…$

label: Route131_Text_ReliIntro
text: RELI: We'll work together as siblings\nto take you on!$

label: Route131_Text_ReliNotEnoughMons
text: RELI: You don't have two POKéMON?\nWe can't enjoy a battle, then.$

label: Route131_Text_ReliPostBattle
text: RELI: The people of PACIFIDLOG are\ntogether with the sea and POKéMON from\lthe time they are born.$

label: Route131_Text_RichardDefeat
text: POKéMON raised by TRAINERS are\nseriously tough…$

label: Route131_Text_RichardIntro
text: The sea is teeming with POKéMON.\nIt's not easy swimming, I tell you.$

label: Route131_Text_RichardPostBattle
text:
Gasp… Gasp…
I'm wiped out…\pThe going's easy. It's the leaving
that's the hard part.\pWill I have any energy left to make
the return trip?$

label: Route131_Text_SusieDefeat
text: You're tough in spite of the way\nyou look!$

label: Route131_Text_SusieIntro
text: Hi, sweetie, wait!\nWe should battle, you and I!$

label: Route131_Text_SusiePostBattle
text: Did you see a guy over there who whines\nthat he's bored of the sea?\pThat's all talk.\nHe's hopelessly in love with the sea!$

label: Route131_Text_TaliaDefeat
text: Oh?\nDid I lose?$

label: Route131_Text_TaliaIntro
text: If you can beat me, I'll give you some\ngreat information!$

label: Route131_Text_TaliaPostBattle
text: There is an odd place nearby.\nThere's a huge tower there.\lWhy don't you go take a look?$

label: Route132_Text_DanaDefeat
text: Oh, please, no!$

label: Route132_Text_DanaIntro
text: I try not to swim where the currents\nare too strong.$

label: Route132_Text_DanaPostBattle
text: If I get swept away, I'll lose all my\nsense of place…$

label: Route132_Text_DarcyDefeat
text: Okay! I won't complain about other\npeople being here.$

label: Route132_Text_DarcyIntro
text: I liked training here by myself.\nIt's awful that all these people came!$

label: Route132_Text_DarcyPostBattle
text: I suppose I can partner up with that\nold man and challenge that other team.$

label: Route132_Text_GilbertDefeat
text: I crave more power…$

label: Route132_Text_GilbertIntro
text: I used to catch colds all the time as\na kid, but I became totally fit after\lI started swimming.$

label: Route132_Text_GilbertPostBattle
text: TRAINERS travel the fields and\nmountains, so they must be fit, too.$

label: Route132_Text_JonathanDefeat
text: Wow!\nThat's pretty strong, all right!$

label: Route132_Text_JonathanIntro
text: Someone's been watching me intently.\nWas it you?$

label: Route132_Text_JonathanPostBattle
text: I can't shake this feeling that\nsomeone's watching me.\pI can't concentrate!$

label: Route132_Text_KiyoDefeat
text: I lose.\nI will concede defeat.$

label: Route132_Text_KiyoIntro
text: I contemplate POKéMON 24 hours a day.\nHow could you possibly beat me?$

label: Route132_Text_KiyoPostBattle
text: Urggh…\nYou're a POKéMON fanatic, aren't you?\pYou must contemplate POKéMON 24 hours\na day, don't you?$

label: Route132_Text_MakaylaDefeat
text: Oh, I guess I wasn't good enough.$

label: Route132_Text_MakaylaIntro
text: I'm always with my husband,\nbut I can win even without him.$

label: Route132_Text_MakaylaPostBattle
text: That young man over there looks just\nlike my husband when he was young.\pHe's making me blush!$

label: Route132_Text_PaxtonDefeat
text: Ah, I see that I couldn't manage\nto win on my own after all.$

label: Route132_Text_PaxtonIntro
text: Now where could my wife have gone?\nI'm always with her.\lI wonder if I can win on my own.$

label: Route132_Text_PaxtonPostBattle
text: My wife must be looking for me.\nI'd best go find her right away.$

label: Route132_Text_RonaldDefeat
text: Waah!\nI sank in defeat!$

label: Route132_Text_RonaldIntro
text: Win or lose, you'll never know until\nyou try!$

label: Route132_Text_RonaldPostBattle
text: I never battle when I know I'll win.\nI like to battle at the razor's edge of\lvictory and defeat!$

label: Route133_Text_BeckDefeat
text: You…\nYou're stunningly cool!$

label: Route133_Text_BeckIntro
text: I came all the way out here with my\nBIRD POKéMON.$

label: Route133_Text_BeckPostBattle
text: I'd like to go back to FORTREE,\nbut I've grown to like this place, too.$

label: Route133_Text_ConorDefeat
text: You have a firm sense of purpose.$

label: Route133_Text_ConorIntro
text: Young people are too happy to go with\nthe flow. They're without direction.$

label: Route133_Text_ConorPostBattle
text: Don't let others lead you astray.\nDon't lose direction as you grow older.$

label: Route133_Text_DebraDefeat
text: Another loss…$

label: Route133_Text_DebraIntro
text: I've led a life of woe and misery…\nI've been cast away, and this is where\lI've drifted…$

label: Route133_Text_DebraPostBattle
text: A life adrift…\nI don't want it anymore!$

label: Route133_Text_FranklinDefeat
text: Strong!\nToo much so!$

label: Route133_Text_FranklinIntro
text: Did the currents carry you here, too?\nThis must have been fated.\lLet's battle!$

label: Route133_Text_FranklinPostBattle
text: It's just my luck that a tough TRAINER\nlike you would drift here…\lI must be cursed…$

label: Route133_Text_LindaDefeat
text: No! Please!$

label: Route133_Text_LindaIntro
text: Welcome!\nI've been expecting you!$

label: Route133_Text_LindaPostBattle
text: A strong child TRAINER…\nThat's so annoying!$

label: Route133_Text_MollieDefeat
text: I may have lost thousands of times,\nbut a loss still stings.$

label: Route133_Text_MollieIntro
text: I must have battled thousands\nof times. I've lost count.$

label: Route133_Text_MolliePostBattle
text: Keep at this, youngster. So you can\nbecome like my husband and me.$

label: Route133_Text_WarrenDefeat
text: Darn it!\nMy way is still too slack!$

label: Route133_Text_WarrenIntro
text: I want to win like everyone else, but I\nwon't raise POKéMON like everyone else.$

label: Route133_Text_WarrenPostBattle
text: It's way more fun to do things the way\nI want than to be like everybody else.\lI mean, that's obvious!$

label: Route134_Text_AaronDefeat
text: I willingly concede defeat.$

label: Route134_Text_AaronIntro
text: The savage tide in this area serves to\nmake us stronger than ever.$

label: Route134_Text_AaronPostBattle
text: We will return for more training at\nMETEOR FALLS.\pIf you'd like, you should go, too.\nIt will definitely toughen you up!$

label: Route134_Text_AlexDefeat
text: Tuckered out again…$

label: Route134_Text_AlexIntro
text: Okeydokey! That's enough rest, gang!\nIt's time for a match!$

label: Route134_Text_AlexPostBattle
text: My BIRD POKéMON get tired quickly after\na long flight…$

label: Route134_Text_HitoshiIntro
text: You're a POKéMON TRAINER.\nNo need for words. We battle now.$

label: Route134_Text_HitoshiPostBattle
text: It was I who challenged you, and yet\nI lost. I am deeply shamed…$

label: Route134_Text_HudsonDefeat
text: Now, that's something!$

label: Route134_Text_HudsonIntro
text: Listen, have you seen another SAILOR\naround here?$

label: Route134_Text_HudsonPostBattle
text: Our boat drifted out to sea.\pMy buddy's a timid fellow, so I'm\nworried about him.$

label: Route134_Text_JackDefeat
text: Aiyeeeeh!$

label: Route134_Text_JackIntro
text: Even those POKéMON that can swim are\ncarried along by the rapid currents.$

label: Route134_Text_JackPostBattle
text: I think POKéMON enjoy the fast-running\ncurrents around these parts.$

label: Route134_Text_KelvinDefeat
text: Awawawawah!\nPlease, stop! Please!$

label: Route134_Text_KelvinIntro
text: O-our boat!\nThe tide carried it away!$

label: Route134_Text_KelvinPostBattle
text: If we can't SURF, how are we supposed\nto get home?\pActually, I know a fainted POKéMON\ncan still SURF, but it feels wrong.$

label: Route134_Text_LaurelDefeat
text: Oopsie!$

label: Route134_Text_LaurelIntro
text: My LUVDISC are looking for a fun\nmatch. Will you join us?$

label: Route134_Text_LaurelPostBattle
text: There's a collector who's after\nthe SCALES of LUVDISC.$

label: Route134_Text_MarleyDefeat
text: I never knew such a technique existed!\nYou've defeated us thoroughly.$

label: Route134_Text_MarleyIntro
text: Can your POKéMON dodge our\nlightning-quick attacks?$

label: Route134_Text_MarleyPostBattle
text: I haven't lost my passion for speed.\nI will try harder.$

label: Route134_Text_ReynaDefeat
text: You're kidding!\nExplain how I lost!$

label: Route134_Text_ReynaIntro
text: My POKéMON can't be taken down\neasily!$

label: Route134_Text_ReynaPostBattle
text: Haha!\nYou won, all right!\pI'll work my way back up by taking on\nTRAINERS I happen to meet!$

label: Route13_Text_AlmaDefeat
text: Oh, too bad!\nI just messed up!$

label: Route13_Text_AlmaIntro
text: I found CARBOS in a cave once\nwhile I was spelunking.$

label: Route13_Text_AlmaPostBattle
text: CARBOS boosted the SPEED of my\nPOKéMON.$

label: Route13_Text_AlmaRematchIntro
text: I cleaned out my savings and\nbought more CARBOS.$

label: Route13_Text_GwenDefeat
text: Good going!\nYou totally won!$

label: Route13_Text_GwenIntro
text: My cute POKéMON wish to make your\nacquaintance.$

label: Route13_Text_GwenPostBattle
text: You have to make POKéMON battle\nto toughen them up.$

label: Route13_Text_GwenRematchIntro
text: My cutely grown POKéMON wish to\nbecome reacquainted with you.$

label: Route13_Text_JaredDefeat
text: Dang!\nStripped gears!$

label: Route13_Text_JaredIntro
text: What're you lookin' at?$

label: Route13_Text_JaredPostBattle
text: Get lost!$

label: Route13_Text_JaredRematchIntro
text: What're you starin' at?$

label: Route13_Text_LolaDefeat
text: Oh!\nYou little beast!$

label: Route13_Text_LolaIntro
text: Sure, I'll play with you, sweetie.$

label: Route13_Text_LolaPostBattle
text: I wonder which is stronger, male or\nfemale POKéMON?$

label: Route13_Text_LolaRematchIntro
text: Oh, you're back?\pSure, I'll play again with you,\nsweetie.$

label: Route13_Text_LookToLeftOfThatPost
text: TRAINER TIPS\pLook, look!\nLook to the left of that post!$

label: Route13_Text_PerryDefeat
text: The wind turned!$

label: Route13_Text_PerryIntro
text: I'm not going to lose.\nNot when the wind's blowing my way!$

label: Route13_Text_PerryPostBattle
text: I'm beat.\nI guess I'll FLY home.$

label: Route13_Text_PerryRematchIntro
text: I'm not going to lose this time.\nThe wind's blowing my way!$

label: Route13_Text_RobertDefeat
text: Out of power!$

label: Route13_Text_RobertIntro
text: I always go with bird POKéMON.\nI've dedicated myself to them.$

label: Route13_Text_RobertPostBattle
text: I wish I could fly like PIDGEY and\nPIDGEOTTO…$

label: Route13_Text_RobertRematchIntro
text: I always go with bird POKéMON.\nI've dedicated myself to them.$

label: Route13_Text_RouteSign
text: ROUTE 13\nNorth to SILENCE BRIDGE$

label: Route13_Text_SebastianDefeat
text: My PIDGEY and PIDGEOTTO combo\nlost?$

label: Route13_Text_SebastianIntro
text: My bird POKéMON want to battle\nwith you!$

label: Route13_Text_SebastianPostBattle
text: My POKéMON look happy even though\nthey lost.$

label: Route13_Text_SebastianRematchIntro
text: My bird POKéMON remember you!$

label: Route13_Text_SelectToSwitchItems
text: TRAINER TIPS\pUse SELECT to switch items in the\nITEMS window.$

label: Route13_Text_SheilaDefeat
text: It's over already?$

label: Route13_Text_SheilaIntro
text: Do you want to battle some\nPOKéMON with me?$

label: Route13_Text_SheilaPostBattle
text: I don't know anything about\nPOKéMON actually.\pThe ones I use… I picked them\nfor their looks!$

label: Route13_Text_SheilaRematchIntro
text: Can't you forget that you battled\nwith me?$

label: Route13_Text_SusieDefeat
text: Ohh!\nI lost!$

label: Route13_Text_SusieIntro
text: I'm told I'm good for a kid.$

label: Route13_Text_SusiePostBattle
text: I want to become a good TRAINER.\nI'll train hard, just watch.$

label: Route13_Text_SusieRematchIntro
text: I want to be the best TRAINER \nwhile I'm a kid!$

label: Route13_Text_ValerieDefeat
text: Not enough!$

label: Route13_Text_ValerieIntro
text: Wow!\nYour BADGES are too cool!$

label: Route13_Text_ValeriePostBattle
text: You got those BADGES from GYM\nLEADERS. I know!$

label: Route13_Text_ValerieRematchIntro
text: Wow!\nYou got more cool BADGES!$

label: Route14_Text_BeckDefeat
text: Aww, bummer!$

label: Route14_Text_BeckIntro
text: They have TMs on sale at the\nCELADON DEPT. STORE.\pTMs aren't really rare, but not\nmany people have HMs.$

label: Route14_Text_BeckPostBattle
text: Try teaching POKéMON a move that's\nthe same type as it.\pThat apparently boosts the power\nof the move.$

label: Route14_Text_BeckRematchIntro
text: Are you using TMs on POKéMON?\nJust holding them is useless.$

label: Route14_Text_BennyDefeat
text: I knew it!$

label: Route14_Text_BennyIntro
text: I'm not into it, but okay.\nLet's go!$

label: Route14_Text_BennyPostBattle
text: Winning, losing… It's insignificant\nunder this huge sky.$

label: Route14_Text_BennyRematchIntro
text: I'm really not into it, but okay.\nLet's go!$

label: Route14_Text_CarterDefeat
text: Not good enough quite yet.$

label: Route14_Text_CarterIntro
text: You need to use TMs to teach good\nmoves to POKéMON.$

label: Route14_Text_CarterPostBattle
text: You have some HMs, right? POKéMON\ncan't forget those moves easily.$

label: Route14_Text_CarterRematchIntro
text: I used TMs to teach good moves\nto my POKéMON.$

label: Route14_Text_DonaldDefeat
text: Why?\nWhy'd I lose?$

label: Route14_Text_DonaldIntro
text: Have you heard the legend of the\nwinged mirages?$

label: Route14_Text_DonaldPostBattle
text: Well, the winged mirages are the\nlegendary bird POKéMON.\pThere are three of them: ARTICUNO,\nZAPDOS, and MOLTRES.$

label: Route14_Text_DonaldRematchIntro
text: The legend of the winged mirages…\nYou've heard it, right?$

label: Route14_Text_GeraldDefeat
text: Wipeout!$

label: Route14_Text_GeraldIntro
text: We ride out here because of the\nwide-open spaces.$

label: Route14_Text_GeraldPostBattle
text: It's cool you made your POKéMON so\nstrong.\pMight is right!\nAnd you know it!$

label: Route14_Text_GeraldRematchIntro
text: We've been riding here because of\nthe wide-open spaces.$

label: Route14_Text_IsaacDefeat
text: What?\nYou!?$

label: Route14_Text_IsaacIntro
text: I need to burn some time.\nShut up and battle.$

label: Route14_Text_IsaacPostBattle
text: Raising POKéMON is a drag, man.$

label: Route14_Text_IsaacRematchIntro
text: You're here again, huh?\nShut up and battle.$

label: Route14_Text_JanDefeat
text: JAN: Eeeeh!\nNo fair!$

label: Route14_Text_JanIntro
text: JAN: KIRI, here we go!\nWe have to try hard!$

label: Route14_Text_JanNotEnoughMons
text: JAN: You want to battle?\nYou don't have enough POKéMON.$

label: Route14_Text_JanPostBattle
text: JAN: KIRI, don't cry!\nWe'll just try harder next time.$

label: Route14_Text_JanRematchIntro
text: JAN: KIRI, here we go!\nLet's win for sure this time!$

label: Route14_Text_KiriDefeat
text: KIRI: Whimper…\nWe lost, didn't we?$

label: Route14_Text_KiriIntro
text: KIRI: JAN, let's try really,\nreally hard together.$

label: Route14_Text_KiriNotEnoughMons
text: KIRI: We can battle if you have\ntwo POKéMON.$

label: Route14_Text_KiriPostBattle
text: KIRI: Did we lose because of me?$

label: Route14_Text_KiriRematchIntro
text: KIRI: JAN, I hope we win today.$

label: Route14_Text_LukasDefeat
text: Arrg!\nLost! Get lost!$

label: Route14_Text_LukasIntro
text: C'mon, c'mon.\nLet's go, let's go, let's go!$

label: Route14_Text_LukasPostBattle
text: What, what, what?\nWhat do you want still?$

label: Route14_Text_LukasRematchIntro
text: Hey!\nI remember you!\pC'mon, c'mon.\nLet's go, let's go, let's go!$

label: Route14_Text_MalikDefeat
text: Blown away!$

label: Route14_Text_MalikIntro
text: POKéMON battle?\nCool! Rumble!$

label: Route14_Text_MalikPostBattle
text: You know who'd win, you and me\none-on-one!$

label: Route14_Text_MalikRematchIntro
text: POKéMON battle, right?\nCool! Rumble!$

label: Route14_Text_MarlonDefeat
text: Shot down in flames!$

label: Route14_Text_MarlonIntro
text: Have you taught your bird POKéMON\nhow to FLY?\pYou'll be able to soar with it into\nthe sky!$

label: Route14_Text_MarlonPostBattle
text: Bird POKéMON are my one true love.\nI don't want to raise anything else.$

label: Route14_Text_MarlonRematchIntro
text: Have you taught your bird POKéMON\nhow to FLY?\pYou'll be able to soar with it into\nthe sky! Give it a try.$

label: Route14_Text_MitchDefeat
text: Not ready yet!$

label: Route14_Text_MitchIntro
text: My bird POKéMON should be ready\nfor battle.$

label: Route14_Text_MitchPostBattle
text: My bird POKéMON need to learn\nbetter moves.$

label: Route14_Text_MitchRematchIntro
text: My bird POKéMON should be ready\nfor battle this time.$

label: Route14_Text_RouteSign
text: ROUTE 14\nWest to FUCHSIA CITY$

label: Route15_Text_AlexDefeat
text: That can't be true!$

label: Route15_Text_AlexIntro
text: Fork over all your cash when you\nlose to me, kid!$

label: Route15_Text_AlexPostBattle
text: I was just joking about the money.\nDon't take me all serious.$

label: Route15_Text_AlexRematchIntro
text: Fork over all your cash when you\nlose to me, kid!$

label: Route15_Text_BeckyDefeat
text: No, wrong!$

label: Route15_Text_BeckyIntro
text: You look gentle, so I think I can\nbeat you.\pI'll give it a go!$

label: Route15_Text_BeckyPostBattle
text: I'm afraid of BIKERS. They look so\nugly and mean!$

label: Route15_Text_BeckyRematchIntro
text: You look gentle, so I think I can\nbeat you.\pI'll give it one more go!$

label: Route15_Text_CeliaDefeat
text: I said trade!$

label: Route15_Text_CeliaIntro
text: What's cool and happening?\nTrading POKéMON!$

label: Route15_Text_CeliaPostBattle
text: I trade POKéMON with my friends\nall the time.$

label: Route15_Text_CeliaRematchIntro
text: What's cool and happening?\nTrading POKéMON, of course.$

label: Route15_Text_ChesterDefeat
text: Just as I thought!$

label: Route15_Text_ChesterIntro
text: Hmm? My birds are shivering!\nYou're good, aren't you?$

label: Route15_Text_ChesterPostBattle
text: This is so obvious, you should know\nthis, but…\pMoves like EARTHQUAKE and FISSURE\nhave no effect on bird POKéMON.$

label: Route15_Text_ChesterRematchIntro
text: Hmm? My birds are shivering!\nWait, aren't you that TRAINER…$

label: Route15_Text_EdwinDefeat
text: Ow!\nThat's tragic!$

label: Route15_Text_EdwinIntro
text: When I whistle, I can summon bird\nPOKéMON.$

label: Route15_Text_EdwinPostBattle
text: Maybe I'm not cut out for battles.\nI'm not the right type, I guess.$

label: Route15_Text_EdwinRematchIntro
text: When I whistle, bird POKéMON\ngather around.\pThey're amazingly cute!$

label: Route15_Text_ErnestDefeat
text: Why not?$

label: Route15_Text_ErnestIntro
text: Hey, kid! C'mon!\nI just got these off some loser!$

label: Route15_Text_ErnestPostBattle
text: Life's too short.\nIt's cool to live as an outlaw.\lTEAM ROCKET RULES!$

label: Route15_Text_ErnestRematchIntro
text: Hey, kid! C'mon!\nI got these off some loser!$

label: Route15_Text_GraceDefeat
text: You looked so cute, too!$

label: Route15_Text_GraceIntro
text: Oh, you're a little cutie!\nSo like a darling POKéMON!$

label: Route15_Text_GracePostBattle
text: I forgive you.\nI can take it.\lI'm a big girl now.$

label: Route15_Text_GraceRematchIntro
text: Oh, you're a little cutie!\nSo like a darling POKéMON!\lI remember you now!$

label: Route15_Text_KindraDefeat
text: Not good enough!$

label: Route15_Text_KindraIntro
text: I just got some POKéMON in trades.\nCan I try them out on you?$

label: Route15_Text_KindraPostBattle
text: You can't change the nickname of\nany POKéMON you get in a trade.\pOnly the Original TRAINER can get\nthe nickname changed.$

label: Route15_Text_KindraRematchIntro
text: I'm going to keep battling with the\nPOKéMON I got in trades.$

label: Route15_Text_MyaDefeat
text: MYA: RON, you have to focus!\nConcentrate on what you're doing!$

label: Route15_Text_MyaIntro
text: MYA: You're perfect.\nHelp me train my little brother?$

label: Route15_Text_MyaNotEnoughMons
text: MYA: Do you want to challenge us?\nYou'll need two POKéMON, though.$

label: Route15_Text_MyaPostBattle
text: MYA: Okay, we'll turn it up.\nI'll add to our training menu!$

label: Route15_Text_MyaRematchIntro
text: MYA: Hi, we keep meeting,\ndon't we?\pHelp me train my little brother\nagain?$

label: Route15_Text_OliviaDefeat
text: POKéMON isn't about winning or\nlosing for me.$

label: Route15_Text_OliviaIntro
text: I raise POKéMON for protection\nbecause I live alone.$

label: Route15_Text_OliviaPostBattle
text: I love having my POKéMON greet me\nwhen I get home.\pIt's so reassuring.$

label: Route15_Text_OliviaRematchIntro
text: I raise POKéMON for protection\nbecause I live alone.\pThat hasn't changed.$

label: Route15_Text_RonDefeat
text: RON: Oh, no, no…\nSis, I'm sorry!$

label: Route15_Text_RonIntro
text: RON: My sister gets scary when we\nlose.$

label: Route15_Text_RonNotEnoughMons
text: RON: Did you want to battle with\nmy sister and me?\pYou need two POKéMON, then.$

label: Route15_Text_RonPostBattle
text: RON: Oh, bleah…\nI wish I had a nice sister…$

label: Route15_Text_RonRematchIntro
text: RON: My sister's gotten more\npowerful…$

label: Route15_Text_RouteSign
text: ROUTE 15\nWest to FUCHSIA CITY$

label: Route15_Text_YazminDefeat
text: I was too impatient!$

label: Route15_Text_YazminIntro
text: Want to play with my POKéMON?$

label: Route15_Text_YazminPostBattle
text: I'll go train with weaker people.$

label: Route15_Text_YazminRematchIntro
text: Want to play with my POKéMON\nagain?$

label: Route15_WestEntrance_1F_Text_OaksAideCameByHere
text: Are you the kid who's working on\na POKéDEX?\pPROF. OAK's AIDE came by here.$

label: Route15_WestEntrance_2F_Text_ExplainExpShare
text: EXP. SHARE is an item to be held\nby a POKéMON.\pThe POKéMON will receive a share\nof the EXP. Points without having\lto battle.$

label: Route15_WestEntrance_2F_Text_GiveItemIfCaughtEnough
text:
Hi! Remember me?
I'm one of PROF. OAK's AIDES.\pIf your POKéDEX has complete data
on {STR_VAR_1} species, I'm supposed to\lgive you a reward.\pPROF. OAK entrusted me with the
{STR_VAR_2} for you.\pSo, {PLAYER}, let me ask you.\pHave you gathered data on at least
{STR_VAR_1} kinds of POKéMON?$

label: Route15_WestEntrance_2F_Text_GreatHereYouGo
text: Great! You have caught or owned\n{STR_VAR_3} kinds of POKéMON!\pCongratulations!\nHere you go!$

label: Route15_WestEntrance_2F_Text_LargeShiningBird
text: Let's see what the binoculars have\nto show…\pA large, shining bird is flying\ntoward the sea.$

label: Route15_WestEntrance_2F_Text_ReceivedItemFromAide
text: {PLAYER} received the {STR_VAR_2}\nfrom the AIDE.$

label: Route15_WestEntrance_2F_Text_SmallIslandOnHorizon
text: Let's see what the binoculars have\nto show…\pIt looks like a small island on\nthe horizon!$

label: Route16_House_Text_DontHaveAnyRoomForThis
text: You don't have any room for this.$

label: Route16_House_Text_ExplainHM02
text: HM02 is FLY.\nIt's a wonderfully convenient move.\pPlease, put it to good use.$

label: Route16_House_Text_Fearow
text: FEAROW: Kyueen!$

label: Route16_House_Text_FoundMySecretRetreat
text: Oh, dear.\nYou've found my secret retreat.\pPlease don't tell anyone I'm here.\nI'll make it up to you with this!$

label: Route16_House_Text_ReceivedHM02FromGirl
text: {PLAYER} received HM02\nfrom the girl.$

text:
Hi! Remember me?
I'm one of PROF. OAK's AIDES.\pIf your POKéDEX has complete data
on 40 species, I'm supposed to\lgive you a reward.\pPROF. OAK entrusted me with an
AMULET COIN for you.\pSo, {PLAYER}, let me ask you.\pHave you gathered data on at least
40 kinds of POKéMON?$

text: What do you want?$

text: LEA: Sometimes, the intensity of\nour love scares me.$

label: Route19_Text_DouglasRematchIntro
text: What's beyond the horizon?\nHave you seen?$

text: LUC: I don't want to if I can't\nbattle you with my big sis.\pDon't you have two POKéMON?$

label: Route19_Text_LucPostBattle
text: LUC: My big sis is strong and nice.\nI think she's awesome!$

label: Route19_Text_MatthewRematchIntro

text: Thanks, kid!\nI'm ready for a swim.$

label: Route19_Text_RichardRematchIntro

Hi!

selling all sorts of items.\pPlease, visit us in VIRIDIAN CITY.\pI know, I'll give you a sample.

label: Route21_South_Text_ClaudeDefeat

label: Route21_South_Text_ClaudeIntro
text: Hey, don't scare away the fish!$

label: Route21_South_Text_ClaudePostBattle
text: Sheesh, I haven't caught a thing.\nCould this place actually be a\lgiant pool or something?$

label: Route21_South_Text_ClaudeRematchIntro
text: Hey, cut it out already.\nYou always scare away the fish!$

label: Route21_South_Text_JackDefeat
text: Diver!!\nDown!!$

label: Route21_South_Text_JackIntro
text: I caught my POKéMON at sea.$

label: Route21_South_Text_JackPostBattle
text: Where'd you catch your POKéMON?$

label: Route21_South_Text_JackRematchIntro
text: I caught my POKéMON at sea.\nAnd that's where I train them.$

label: Route21_South_Text_JeromeDefeat
text: Pant…\nPant… Pant…$

label: Route21_South_Text_JeromeIntro
text: Right now, I'm in a triathlon meet.$

label: Route21_South_Text_JeromePostBattle
text: I'm beat! But, I still have the\nbike race and marathon left!$

label: Route21_South_Text_JeromeRematchIntro
text: Right now, I'm in another triathlon\nmeet!$

label: Route21_South_Text_NolanDefeat
text: That burned some time.$

label: Route21_South_Text_NolanIntro
text: Keep me company till I get a hit.$

label: Route21_South_Text_NolanPostBattle
text: Oh wait!\nI got a bite! Yeah!$

label: Route21_South_Text_NolanRematchIntro
text: Keep me company till I get a hit.$

label: Route21_South_Text_RolandDefeat
text: Yow!\nI lost!$

label: Route21_South_Text_RolandIntro
text: Ahh!\nFeel the sun and the wind!$

label: Route21_South_Text_RolandPostBattle
text: I'm sunburnt to a crisp!$

label: Route21_South_Text_RolandRematchIntro
text: Ahh!\nFeel the sun and the wind!$

label: Route22_Text_EarlyRivalDefeat
text: Awww!\nYou just lucked out!$

label: Route22_Text_EarlyRivalIntro
text:
{RIVAL}: Hey! {PLAYER}!\pYou're off to the POKéMON LEAGUE?
Forget about it!\pYou probably don't have any
BADGES, do you?\pThe guard won't let you through
without them.\pBy the way, did your POKéMON get
any stronger?$

label: Route22_Text_EarlyRivalPostBattle
text:
I heard the POKéMON LEAGUE is
crawling with tough TRAINERS.\pI have to figure out how to get
past them.\pYou should quit dawdling and get a
move on!$

label: Route22_Text_LateRivalDefeat
text: What!?\pI was just careless, you!$

label: Route22_Text_LateRivalIntro
text:
{RIVAL}: What? {PLAYER}!
What a surprise to see you here!\pSo you're going to the POKéMON
LEAGUE?\pYou collected all the BADGES, too?
That's cool!\pThen I'll whip you, {PLAYER}, as a
warm-up for the POKéMON LEAGUE!\pCome on!$

label: Route22_Text_LateRivalPostBattle
text: That loosened me up.\nI'm ready for the POKéMON LEAGUE!\p{PLAYER}, you need more practice.\pBut hey, you know that!\nI'm out of here. Smell ya!$

label: Route22_Text_LeagueGateSign
text: POKéMON LEAGUE\nFront Gate$

label: Route23_Text_VictoryRoadGateSign
text: VICTORY ROAD GATE -\nPOKéMON LEAGUE$

label: Route24_Text_AliDefeat
text: How could I lose?$

label: Route24_Text_AliIntro
text: I'm second!\nNow it's serious!$

label: Route24_Text_AliPostBattle
text: I did my best. I have no regrets!$

label: Route24_Text_AliRematchIntro
text: The time we battled…\pEven though I was the second in\nline, I was the best, wasn't I?$

label: Route24_Text_CaleDefeat
text: Whoo!\nGood stuff!$

label: Route24_Text_CaleIntro
text: People call this the NUGGET\nBRIDGE!\pBeat us five TRAINERS and win\na fabulous prize!\pThink you got what it takes?$

label: Route24_Text_CalePostBattle
text: I did my best. I have no regrets!$

label: Route24_Text_CaleRematchIntro
text:
People call this the NUGGET
BRIDGE!\pYou've already beaten us, so you're
not allowed to take the challenge…\p…But, you're welcome to battle with
us again.$

label: Route24_Text_EthanDefeat
text: Whoa!\nToo much!$

label: Route24_Text_EthanIntro
text: Okay! I'm No. 5!\nI'll stomp you!$

label: Route24_Text_EthanPostBattle
text: I did my best. I have no regrets!$

label: Route24_Text_EthanRematchIntro
text: Okay!\nI'll stomp you!$

label: Route24_Text_JoinTeamRocket
text:
By the way, how would you like to
join TEAM ROCKET?\pWe're a group of professional
criminals specializing in POKéMON!\pWant to join?\pAre you sure?\pCome on, join us!\pI'm telling you to join!\p…Okay, you need convincing!\pI'll make you an offer you can't
refuse!$

label: Route24_Text_JustEarnedFabulousPrize
text: Congratulations! You beat our\nfive contest TRAINERS!\pYou just earned a fabulous prize!$

label: Route24_Text_ReceivedNuggetFromMysteryTrainer
text: {PLAYER} received a NUGGET\nfrom the mystery TRAINER!$

label: Route24_Text_ReliDefeat
text: I lost, too!$

label: Route24_Text_ReliIntro
text: I'm No. 4!\nGetting tired?$

label: Route24_Text_ReliPostBattle
text: I did my best, so I've no regrets!$

label: Route24_Text_ReliRematchIntro
text: You always look so busy…\nAren't you getting tired?$

label: Route24_Text_RocketDefeat
text: Arrgh!\nYou are good!$

label: Route24_Text_ShaneDefeat
text: I thought not!$

label: Route24_Text_ShaneIntro
text: I saw your feat from the grass!$

label: Route24_Text_ShanePostBattle
text: I hid because the people on the\nbridge frightened me.$

label: Route24_Text_ShaneRematchIntro
text: I saw your feat from the grass!$

label: Route24_Text_TimmyDefeat
text: Ow!\nStomped flat!$

label: Route24_Text_TimmyIntro
text: Here's No. 3!\nI won't be easy!$

label: Route24_Text_TimmyPostBattle
text: I did my best. I have no regrets!$

label: Route24_Text_TimmyRematchIntro
text: You really must love coming to\nNUGGET BRIDGE.$

label: Route24_Text_YouDontHaveAnyRoom
text: You don't have any room!$

label: Route24_Text_YoudBecomeTopRocketLeader
text: With your ability, you'd become\na top leader in TEAM ROCKET.\pCome on, think of the opportunity!\nDon't let this chance go to waste.$

label: Route25_SeaCottage_Text_BillsFavoriteMonList
text: BILL's favorite POKéMON list!$

label: Route25_SeaCottage_Text_CheckOutRareMonsOnPC
text: BILL: Feel like checking out some\nof my rare POKéMON on my PC?\pGo on, check out my PC.$

label: Route25_SeaCottage_Text_ImBillHelpMeOutLady
text:
Hiya! I'm a POKéMON…
…No I'm not!\pCall me BILL!
I'm a true-blue POKéMANIAC!\pHey!
What's with that skeptical look?\pI'm not joshing you, lady.\pI screwed up an experiment and got
combined with a POKéMON!\pSo, how about it?
Help me out here!$

label: Route25_SeaCottage_Text_ImBillHelpMeOutPal
text:
Hiya! I'm a POKéMON…
…No I'm not!\pCall me BILL!
I'm a true-blue POKéMANIAC!\pHey!
What's with that skeptical look?\pI'm not joshing you, pal.\pI screwed up an experiment and got
combined with a POKéMON!\pSo, how about it?
Help me out here!$

label: Route25_SeaCottage_Text_InitiatedTeleportersCellSeparator
text: {PLAYER} initiated the TELEPORTER's\nCell Separator.$
