text:
No!?
Now don't be so cold!\pCome on, you gotta help a guy in
deep, deep trouble!\pWhat do you say, beautiful?
Please?\lOkay?\lAll right!$

label: Route25_SeaCottage_Text_NoPleaseChief
text:
No!?
Now don't be so cold!\pCome on, you gotta help a guy in
deep, deep trouble!\pWhat do you say, chief?
Please?\lOkay?\lAll right!$

label: Route25_SeaCottage_Text_ReceivedSSTicketFromBill
text: {PLAYER} received an S.S. TICKET\nfrom BILL.$

label: Route25_SeaCottage_Text_RunCellSeparationOnPC
text: Wait till I get inside the\nTELEPORTER.\pWhen I do, go to my PC and run\nthe Cell Separation System.$

label: Route25_SeaCottage_Text_SSAnnePartyYouGoInstead
text:
That cruise ship S.S. ANNE is in
VERMILION CITY.\pI hear there are lots of TRAINERS
on board, too.\pThey invited me to their party, but
I can't stand fancy do's.\pWhy don't you go instead of me?
Go on and have a good time.$

label: Route25_SeaCottage_Text_SeeWhichMon
text: Which POKéMON do you want to see?$

label: Route25_SeaCottage_Text_TeleporterIsDisplayed
text: TELEPORTER is displayed on the PC\nmonitor.$

label: Route25_SeaCottage_Text_ThanksBudTakeThis
text:
BILL: Yeehah!
Thanks, bud! I owe you one!\pSo, did you come to see my
POKéMON collection?\pYou didn't?
That's a bummer.\pI've got to thank you…
Oh, here, maybe this'll do.$

label: Route25_SeaCottage_Text_ThanksLadyTakeThis
text:
BILL: Yeehah!
Thanks, lady! I owe you one!\pSo, did you come to see my
POKéMON collection?\pYou didn't?
That's a bummer.\pI've got to thank you…
Oh, here, maybe this'll do.$

label: Route25_SeaCottage_Text_YouveGotTooMuchStuff
text: You've got too much stuff!$

label: Route25_Text_AreYouHereAlone
text: Hello, are you here alone?\pIf you're out at CERULEAN's cape…\nWell, it should be as a couple.$

label: Route25_Text_ChadDefeat
text: I knew I'd lose, too!$

label: Route25_Text_ChadIntro
text: I had this feeling…\nI knew I had to battle you!$

label: Route25_Text_ChadPostBattle
text: If your POKéMON gets confused,\nswitch it out.\pThat's a good tactic.$

label: Route25_Text_ChadRematchIntro
text: I had this feeling…\nI knew I had to battle you again!$

label: Route25_Text_DanDefeat
text: I'm not mad!$

label: Route25_Text_DanIntro
text: Dad took me to a great party on\nthe S.S. ANNE at VERMILION CITY.$

label: Route25_Text_DanPostBattle
text: On the S.S. ANNE, I saw TRAINERS\nfrom around the world.$

label: Route25_Text_DanRematchIntro
text: Dad took me to a great party on\nthe S.S. ANNE at VERMILION CITY.$

label: Route25_Text_FlintDefeat
text: Aww, darn…$

label: Route25_Text_FlintIntro
text: I'm a cool guy.\nI've got a girlfriend!$

label: Route25_Text_FlintPostBattle
text: Oh, well.\nMy girlfriend will cheer me up.$

label: Route25_Text_FlintRematchIntro
text: I'm a cool guy.\nI've got a girlfriend!\pI'll show her how cool I am for\nsure this time!$

label: Route25_Text_FranklinDefeat
text: You worked hard!$

label: Route25_Text_FranklinIntro
text: I just got down from MT. MOON,\nbut I've still got gas in the tank!$

label: Route25_Text_FranklinPostBattle
text: Drat!\nA ZUBAT bit me back in that cave.$

label: Route25_Text_FranklinRematchIntro
text: I just trained up on MT. MOON,\nbut I've still got gas in the tank!$

label: Route25_Text_HaleyDefeat
text: I'm not so jealous!$

label: Route25_Text_HaleyIntro
text: My friend has many cute POKéMON.\nI'm so jealous!$

label: Route25_Text_HaleyPostBattle
text: You came from MT. MOON?\nMay I have a CLEFAIRY?$

label: Route25_Text_HaleyRematchIntro
text: My friend has many cute POKéMON.\nI'm so jealous!$

label: Route25_Text_JoeyDefeat
text: You're decent.$

label: Route25_Text_JoeyIntro
text: Local TRAINERS come here to\npractice.$

label: Route25_Text_JoeyPostBattle
text: All POKéMON have weaknesses.\nEven the strongest ones.\pThat's why it's best to raise\nPOKéMON of different types.$

label: Route25_Text_JoeyRematchIntro
text: I won't lose while I'm here!$

label: Route25_Text_KelseyDefeat
text: My conditioning isn't the best…$

label: Route25_Text_KelseyIntro
text: Hi!\nMy boyfriend is cool!$

label: Route25_Text_KelseyPostBattle
text: I wish my boyfriend was as good\nas you.$

label: Route25_Text_KelseyRematchIntro
text: Hi!\nMy boyfriend is cool!\lMy conditioning's good today!$

label: Route25_Text_MistyHighHopesAboutThisPlace
text: This cape is a famous date spot.\pMISTY, the GYM LEADER, has high\nhopes about this place.$

label: Route25_Text_NobDefeat
text: You done got me, and real good,\ntoo!$

label: Route25_Text_NobIntro
text: I'm off to see a POKéMANIAC's\ncollection at the cape.$

label: Route25_Text_NobPostBattle
text: The POKéMANIAC sure lives up to\nhis name.\pHis collection includes many rare\nspecies of POKéMON.$

label: Route25_Text_NobRematchIntro
text: A POKéMANIAC lives on the cape.\nHave you seen his collection?$

label: Route25_Text_SeaCottageSign
text: SEA COTTAGE\nBILL lives here!$

label: Route25_Text_WayneDefeat
text: You're something.$

label: Route25_Text_WayneIntro
text: You're going to see BILL?\nFirst, we battle!$

label: Route25_Text_WaynePostBattle
text: The trail below is a shortcut to\nCERULEAN CITY.$

label: Route25_Text_WayneRematchIntro
text: You're going to see BILL again?\nFirst, we battle!$

label: Route2_EastBuilding_Text_CanGetThroughRockTunnel
text: Once a POKéMON learns FLASH, you\ncan get through ROCK TUNNEL.$

label: Route2_EastBuilding_Text_ExplainHM05
text: HM05 contains the hidden move\nFLASH.\pFLASH lights up even the darkest\nof caves and dungeons.$

label: Route2_EastBuilding_Text_GiveHM05IfSeen10Mons
text:
Hi! Remember me?
I'm one of PROF. OAK's AIDES.\pIf your POKéDEX has complete data
on ten species, I'm supposed to\lgive you a reward.\pPROF. OAK entrusted me with
HM05 for you.\pSo, {PLAYER}, let me ask you.\pHave you gathered data on at least
ten kinds of POKéMON?$

label: Route2_EastBuilding_Text_GreatHereYouGo
text: Great! You have caught or owned\n{STR_VAR_3} kinds of POKéMON!\pCongratulations!\nHere you go!$

label: Route2_EastBuilding_Text_ReceivedHM05FromAide
text: {PLAYER} received HM05\nfrom the AIDE.$

label: Route2_House_Text_FaintedMonsCanUseFieldMoves
text: A fainted POKéMON just has no\nenergy left to battle.\pIt can still use moves like CUT\noutside of battle.$

label: Route2_Text_DiglettsCave
text: DIGLETT'S CAVE$

label: Route2_Text_RouteSign
text: ROUTE 2\nVIRIDIAN CITY - PEWTER CITY$

label: Route2_ViridianForest_NorthEntrance_Text_CanCancelEvolution
text:
Do you know the evolution-cancel
technique?\pWhen a POKéMON is evolving, you
can stop the process.\pIt's a technique for raising
POKéMON the way they are.$

label: Route2_ViridianForest_NorthEntrance_Text_CanCutSkinnyTrees
text: Have you noticed the skinny trees\non the roadside?\pThey can be cut down by a special\nPOKéMON move, I hear.$

label: Route2_ViridianForest_NorthEntrance_Text_ManyMonsOnlyInForests
text: Many POKéMON live only in forests \nand caves.\pYou need to be persistent and look\neverywhere to get different kinds.$

label: Route2_ViridianForest_SouthEntrance_Text_ForestIsMaze
text: Are you going to VIRIDIAN FOREST?\nIt's a natural maze in there.\lBe careful you don't get lost.$

label: Route2_ViridianForest_SouthEntrance_Text_RattataHasWickedBite
text: RATTATA may be small, but don't\nunderestimate its wicked bite.\pHave you caught one already?$

label: Route3_Text_BenDefeat
text: I don't believe it!$

label: Route3_Text_BenIntro
text: Hi!\nI like shorts!\pThey're delightfully comfy and\neasy to wear!$

label: Route3_Text_BenPostBattle
text: Are you using a POKéMON CENTER's\nPC for storing your POKéMON?\pEach BOX can hold up to\n30 POKéMON.$

label: Route3_Text_BenRematchIntro
text: Hi! I like shorts!\nThey're comfy and easy to wear!\pYou should be wearing shorts, too!$

label: Route3_Text_CalvinDefeat
text: Lost!\nLost! Lost!$

label: Route3_Text_CalvinIntro
text: Hey! You're not wearing shorts!\nWhat's wrong with you?$

label: Route3_Text_CalvinPostBattle
text: I always wear shorts, even in\nwinter. That's my policy.$

label: Route3_Text_CalvinRematchIntro
text: Hey! What's wrong with you?\nYou're still not wearing shorts!$

label: Route3_Text_ColtonDefeat
text: You beat me again!$

label: Route3_Text_ColtonIntro
text: Hey!\nI saw you in VIRIDIAN FOREST!$

label: Route3_Text_ColtonPostBattle
text: There are other kinds of POKéMON\nthan the ones you find in forests.$

label: Route3_Text_ColtonRematchIntro
text: Hey!\nI saw you in VIRIDIAN FOREST!$

label: Route3_Text_GregDefeat
text: If I had new POKéMON, I would've\nwon!$

label: Route3_Text_GregIntro
text: Are you a TRAINER?\nLet's get with it right away!$

label: Route3_Text_GregPostBattle
text: If a POKéMON BOX on the PC gets\nfull, just switch to another BOX.$

label: Route3_Text_GregRematchIntro
text: You're a TRAINER, aren't you?\nLet's get with it right away!$

label: Route3_Text_JamesDefeat
text: Done like dinner!$

label: Route3_Text_JamesIntro
text: I'll battle you with the POKéMON\nI just caught.$

label: Route3_Text_JamesPostBattle
text: Trained POKéMON are stronger than\nthe wild ones.$

label: Route3_Text_JamesRematchIntro
text: I'll battle you with the POKéMON\nI started raising.$

label: Route3_Text_JaniceDefeat
text: You're mean!$

label: Route3_Text_JaniceIntro
text: Excuse me!\nYou looked at me, didn't you?$

label: Route3_Text_JanicePostBattle
text: You shouldn't be staring if you\ndon't want to battle!$

label: Route3_Text_JaniceRematchIntro
text: Excuse me!\nYou keep looking at me, don't you?$

label: Route3_Text_RobinDefeat
text: That's it?$

label: Route3_Text_RobinIntro
text: Eek!\nDid you touch me?$

label: Route3_Text_RobinPostBattle
text: ROUTE 4 is at the foot of\nMT. MOON.$

label: Route3_Text_RobinRematchIntro
text: Eek!\nDid you push me?$

label: Route3_Text_RouteSign
text: ROUTE 3\nMT. MOON AHEAD$

label: Route3_Text_SallyDefeat
text: Be nice!$

label: Route3_Text_SallyIntro
text: That look you gave me…\nIt's so intriguing!$

label: Route3_Text_SallyPostBattle
text: You can avoid battles by not\nletting TRAINERS see you.$

label: Route3_Text_SallyRematchIntro
text: That look you give me…\nIt intrigues me so!$

label: Route3_Text_TunnelFromCeruleanTiring
text: Whew… I better take a rest…\nGroan…\pThat tunnel from CERULEAN takes a\nlot out of you!$

label: Route4_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_CanHaveSixMonsWithYou
text: Okay, set six POKé BALLS in my\nbelt…\pYeah, that'll do it. At most, you\ncan have six POKéMON with you.$

label: Route4_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_IDontGiveRefunds
text: MAN: Well, I don't give refunds.\nYou knew what you were getting!$

label: Route4_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_ItsANewspaper
text: It's a newspaper.$

label: Route4_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_LaddieBuyMagikarpForJust500
text: MAN: Hello there, laddie!\nHave I got a deal just for you!\pI'll let you have a secret POKéMON\n- a MAGIKARP - for just ¥500!\pSo, you'll buy it, am I right?$

label: Route4_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_NoRoomForMorePokemon
text: There's no more room for any more\nPOKéMON, it looks like.$

label: Route4_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_OnlyDoingThisAsFavorToYou
text: No? You say no? I'm only doing this\nas a favor to you!$

label: Route4_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_PaidOutrageouslyForMagikarp
text: {PLAYER} paid an outrageous ¥500\nand bought the MAGIKARP…$

label: Route4_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_ShouldStoreMonsUsingPC
text: Sometimes, you'll have too many\nPOKéMON with you to add any more.\pIn that case, you should just\nstore some using any PC.$

label: Route4_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_SweetieBuyMagikarpForJust500
text: MAN: Hello there, sweetie pie!\nHave I got a deal just for you!\pI'll let you have a secret POKéMON\n- a MAGIKARP - for just ¥500!\pSo, you'll buy it, am I right?$

label: Route4_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_TeamRocketAttacksCerulean
text: TEAM ROCKET attacks CERULEAN\ncitizens…\pNot a day goes by without TEAM\nROCKET being in the news.$

label: Route4_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_YoullNeedMoreMoney
text: You'll need more money than that!$

label: Route4_Text_CrissyDefeat
text: After all I did to catch them!$

label: Route4_Text_CrissyIntro
text: I came to MT. MOON in search of\nmushroom POKéMON.$

label: Route4_Text_CrissyPostBattle
text: There might not be any more\nmushrooms here.\pI think I got them all.$

label: Route4_Text_CrissyRematchIntro
text: I always catch mushroom POKéMON\non MT. MOON.$

label: Route4_Text_MtMoonEntrance
text: MT. MOON\nTunnel Entrance$

label: Route4_Text_PeopleLikeAndRespectBrock
text:
Oh, wow, that's the BOULDERBADGE!
You got it from BROCK, didn't you?\pBROCK is cool. He's not just tough.
People like and respect him.\pI want to become a GYM LEADER
like him.$

label: Route4_Text_RouteSign
text: ROUTE 4\nMT. MOON - CERULEAN CITY$

label: Route4_Text_TrippedOverGeodude
text: Ouch! I tripped over a rocky\nPOKéMON, GEODUDE!$

label: Route5_PokemonDayCare_Text_ComeAgain
text: Come again.$

label: Route5_PokemonDayCare_Text_ComeAnytimeYouLike
text: Fine.\nCome anytime you like.$

label: Route5_PokemonDayCare_Text_ComeSeeMeInAWhile
text: Come see me in a while.$

label: Route5_PokemonDayCare_Text_DontHaveEnoughMoney
text: You don't have enough money.$

label: Route5_PokemonDayCare_Text_LookAfterMonForAWhile
text: Fine, I'll look after your\n{STR_VAR_1} for a while.$

label: Route5_PokemonDayCare_Text_MonHasGrownByXLevels
text: Your {STR_VAR_1} has grown a lot.\nYes, quite a lot, I'd say.\pLet me see…\nBy level, it's grown by {STR_VAR_2}.\pAren't I great?$

label: Route5_PokemonDayCare_Text_MonNeedsToSpendMoreTime
text: You're back already?\pYour {STR_VAR_1} needs to spend\nsome more time with me.$

label: Route5_PokemonDayCare_Text_OnlyHaveOneMonWithYou
text: Oh? You only have one POKéMON\nwith you.$

label: Route5_PokemonDayCare_Text_OweMeXForMonsReturn
text: You owe me ¥{STR_VAR_2} for the return\nof this POKéMON.$

label: Route5_PokemonDayCare_Text_PlayerGotMonBack
text: {PLAYER} got {STR_VAR_1} back\nfrom the DAY-CARE MAN.$

label: Route5_PokemonDayCare_Text_ThankYouHeresMon
text: Thank you!\nHere's your POKéMON.$

label: Route5_PokemonDayCare_Text_WantMeToRaiseMon
text: I run the DAY-CARE service.\pWould you like me to raise one of\nyour POKéMON?$

label: Route5_PokemonDayCare_Text_WhatWillYouBattleWith
text: If you leave me that POKéMON,\nwhat will you battle with?$

label: Route5_PokemonDayCare_Text_WhichMonShouldIRaise
text: Which POKéMON should I raise?$

label: Route5_PokemonDayCare_Text_YouveGotNoRoomForIt
text: You can't take this POKéMON back\nif you've got no room for it.$

label: Route5_SouthEntrance_Text_HiHowsItGoing
text: Hi, how's it going?$

label: Route5_SouthEntrance_Text_ThanksIllShareTeaWithGuards
text: Huh? I can have this drink?\nGee, thanks!\l… …\lGlug, glug…\l… …\lGulp…\lIf you want to go to SAFFRON\lCITY…\l… …\lYou can go on through.\pI'll share this TEA with the other\nguards!$

label: RustboroCity_CuttersHouse_Text_DadHelpedClearLandOfTrees
text: When they were expanding the city of\nRUSTBORO, my dad helped out.\pHe made his POKéMON use CUT to clear\nthe land of trees.$

label: RustboroCity_CuttersHouse_Text_ExplainCut
text:
That HIDDEN MACHINE, or HM for
short, is CUT.\pAn HM move is one that can be used
by POKéMON outside of battle.\pAny POKéMON that's learned CUT can
chop down thin trees if the TRAINER\lhas earned the STONE BADGE.\pAnd, unlike a TM, an HM can be used
more than once.$

label: RustboroCity_CuttersHouse_Text_YouCanPutThisHMToGoodUse
text:
That determined expression…
That limber way you move…\lAnd your well-trained POKéMON…\pYou're obviously a skilled TRAINER!\pNo, wait, don't say a word.
I can tell just by looking at you.\pI'm sure that you can put this
HIDDEN MACHINE to good use.\pNo need to be modest or shy.
Go on, take it!$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_1F_Text_HowCouldWeGetRobbed
text: It's beyond stupid.\nHow could we get robbed?$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_1F_Text_OnlyAuthorizedPeopleEnter
text: I'm sorry, only authorized people\nare allowed to enter here.$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_1F_Text_ProductDisplay
text:
Prototypes and test products fill
the glass display case.\pThere's a panel with a description…\p“In addition to industrial products,
DEVON now markets sundries and\lpharmaceuticals for better lifestyles.\p“Recently, DEVON has begun marketing
tools for POKéMON TRAINERS, including\lPOKé BALLS and POKéNAV systems.”$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_1F_Text_RobberWasntVeryBright
text: That stolen parcel…\pWell, sure it's important, but it's not\nanything that anyone can use.\pIn my estimation, that robber must not\nhave been very bright.$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_1F_Text_RocksMetalDisplay
text:
Samples of rocks and metal are
displayed in the glass case.\pThere's a panel with some writing
on it…\p“DEVON CORPORATION got its start as
a producer of stones from quarries.\p“The company also produced iron from
filings in the sand.\p“From that humble start as a producer
of raw materials, DEVON developed.\p“DEVON is now a manufacturer of a wide
range of industrial products.”$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_1F_Text_SoundsLikeStolenGoodsRecovered
text: It sounds like they've recovered\nthe ripped-off DEVON GOODS.$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_1F_Text_StaffGotRobbed
text: One of our research staff stupidly\ngot robbed of an important parcel.$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_1F_Text_ThoseShoesAreOurProduct
text: Hey, those RUNNING SHOES!\nThey're one of our products!\pIt makes me happy when I see someone\nusing something we made.$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_1F_Text_WelcomeToDevonCorp
text: Hello and welcome to the DEVON\nCORPORATION.\pWe're proud producers of items and\nmedicine that enhance your life.$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_1F_Text_YoureAlwaysWelcomeHere
text: Hi, there!\nYou're always welcome here!$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_DevelopDeviceToResurrectFossils
text: I've been trying to develop a device\nthat resurrects POKéMON from fossils…\pAnd, it's working!$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_DevelopNewPokenavFeature
text: I'm trying to develop a new feature\nfor the POKéNAV…\pBut it's not going well.$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_DevelopingNewBalls
text: I'm developing new kinds of\nPOKé BALLS…\pBut I haven't made much headway…$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_DeviceForTalkingToPokemon
text: We're developing a device for talking\nwith POKéMON.\pBut we haven't had much success…$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_DeviceToVisualizePokemonDreams
text: I'm trying to develop a device that\nvisually reproduces the dreams of\lPOKéMON…\pBut it's not going well.$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_FossilRegeneratorTakesTime
text:
The FOSSIL REGENERATOR, which I made,
is incredible.\pBut it has one drawback--it takes
a long time to work.\pSo, uh… How about you go for a stroll
and look around for a while?$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_FossilizedMonBroughtBackToLife
text: Thanks for waiting!\pYour fossilized POKéMON has been\nbrought back to life!\pThe fossil was an ancient POKéMON.\n{STR_VAR_2}, it was!$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_HandedFossilToResearcher
text: Excellent!\nLet's do this right away.\p{PLAYER} handed the {STR_VAR_1} to\nthe DEVON RESEARCHER.$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_IMadePokenav
text: I made the POKéNAV!\pAs an engineer, I feel blessed to have\nmade something so great!$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_OhIsThatSo
text: Oh, is that so?\pDEVON's technological expertise\nis outstanding, I tell you.$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_ReceivedMonFromResearcher
text: {PLAYER} received {STR_VAR_2} from\nthe DEVON RESEARCHER.$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_TwoFossilsPickOne
text:
Oh, now that's a surprise!
You have not one, but two, fossils?\pUnfortunately, my machine can only
regenerate one POKéMON at a time.\pWould you like to pick one of your
fossils for regeneration?$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_WantToBringFossilBackToLife
text:
Wait! That thing you have there…
Is that a POKéMON fossil?\pWould you like to bring that POKéMON
back to life?\pI can with my newly developed
FOSSIL REGENERATOR.$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_WeFinallyMadeNewBalls
text:
We finally made new kinds of
POKé BALLS!\pThe REPEAT BALL makes it easier to
catch POKéMON you've caught before.\pThe TIMER BALL gets better at catching
POKéMON the longer a battle runs.\pBoth are proudly developed by
the DEVON CORPORATION.\pPlease give them a try!$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_WhatToWorkOnNext
text:
Well, now what shall I work on
developing next?\pOur company allows us to make our
inspirations into reality.\pOne couldn't ask for a better
environment as an engineer.$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_WowThatsAPokenav
text:
Oh, wow!
That's a POKéNAV!\pIt came about as a result of our
PRESIDENT's desire to learn about\lthe feelings of POKéMON.\pWould you like me to describe its
features in detail?\pNo, no. I think you'll find out just by
trying the POKéNAV out.$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_CountingOnYou
text: MR. STONE: I'm counting on you!$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_ExplainExpShare
text:
MR. STONE: A POKéMON holding that
EXP. SHARE will be given some of the\lEXP Points from battle.\pIt will get EXP Points even if it didn't
actually battle.\pI would say EXP. SHARE is quite useful
for raising weak POKéMON.$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_MrStoneExplainPokenavRestUp
text:
MR. STONE: That device…\pIt's a POKéMON NAVIGATOR, or POKéNAV
for short.\pIt's an indispensable tool for any
TRAINER on an adventure.\pIt has a map of the HOENN region.\pYou can check the locations of
DEWFORD and SLATEPORT easily!\pBy the way, I've heard that sinister
criminals--MAGMA and AQUA, I believe--\lhave been making trouble far and wide.\pI think it would be best if you rested
up before you go on your way.$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_MrStoneGoWithCautionAndCare
text: MR. STONE: Well, then, {PLAYER}{KUN},\ngo with caution and care!$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_MrStoneIHaveFavor
text:
I'm MR. STONE, the PRESIDENT of
the DEVON CORPORATION.\pI'd just got word about you!\pYou saved our staff not just once,
but twice!\pI have a favor to ask of an amazing
person like you.\pI understand that you're delivering
a package to SLATEPORT's SHIPYARD.\pWell, on the way, could you stop off in
DEWFORD TOWN?\pI was hoping that you'd deliver a
LETTER to STEVEN in DEWFORD.$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_MrStoneWantYouToHaveThis
text: MR. STONE: Now, you should know that\nI am a great PRESIDENT.\pSo, I'd never be so cheap as to ask\na favor for nothing in return.\pThat's why I want you to have this!$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_NotFamiliarWithTrends
text:
MR. STONE: Since my youth, I've immersed
myself in work.\pConsequently, I'm not familiar with
trends and that sort of thing.\pBut do young people all want to be
TRAINERS in the POKéMON LEAGUE?$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_PleaseGoAhead
text: Please, go ahead.$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_RareRocksDisplay
text: It's a collection of rare rocks and\nstones assembled by the PRESIDENT.$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_ReceivedPokenav
text: {PLAYER} received a POKéNAV.$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_RepeatAndTimerHugelyPopular
text: DEVON's new products, the REPEAT BALL\nand TIMER BALL, have become hugely\lpopular among TRAINERS.$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_ThankYouForDeliveringLetter
text: MR. STONE: You delivered my LETTER?\nThank you kindly!\pThis is my way of thanking you.\nIt should help you, a TRAINER.$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_ThisIs3rdFloorWaitHere
text:
This is the DEVON CORPORATION's
third floor.\pOur PRESIDENT's OFFICE is on
this floor.\pAnyway, I can't tell you how much I'm
grateful for what you've done.\pUm… By the way, that parcel
you got back for us…\pCould I get you to deliver that to
the SHIPYARD in SLATEPORT?\pIt would be awful if those robbers
tried to take it again.\pUh… Hehehe, so, uh, could I count
on you to do that for me?\pOh, that's right.
Could you wait here a second?$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_VisitCaptSternShipyard
text: If you visit the SHIPYARD in SLATEPORT,\nyou should go see CAPT. STERN.$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_WordWithPresidentComeWithMe
text: Our PRESIDENT would like to have\na word with you.\pPlease come with me.$

label: RustboroCity_Flat1_1F_Text_EveryPokemonHasAbility
text: Every POKéMON has a special ability\nthat it can use.$

label: RustboroCity_Flat1_1F_Text_PokemonStrange
text: POKéMON are such strange creatures.$

label: RustboroCity_Flat1_2F_Text_BeenSayingXDoYouKnowBetterPhrase
text: I've been saying “{STR_VAR_1}”\nto amuse her lately.\pDo you know of a better word or\na phrase that might work?$

label: RustboroCity_Flat1_2F_Text_ComingUpWithMealsIsHard
text:
Oh, it's so hard every day…\pWhat's hard?
You need to ask?\pIt's trying to figure out what to
make for meals every day.\pIt really isn't easy coming up with
meals every day.$

label: RustboroCity_Flat1_2F_Text_HelloDoYouKnowFunnyPhrase
text:
Oh, hello!
Welcome to the PEPPER household.\pI have a question for you.
Have you ever baby-sat?\pYou see, I'm a new father, so raising
a child is all new to me.\pAnd I have a problem. My daughter
WALDA doesn't laugh enough.\pI think she'd laugh for me if I told
her something funny.\pDo you know of a funny word or
phrase you can tell me?$

label: RustboroCity_Flat1_2F_Text_ItsAPokemonPlushDoll
text: It's a POKéMON plush DOLL!$

label: RustboroCity_Flat1_2F_Text_LetsGiveItATry
text: Ah, I see.\nWell, let's give it a try, shall we?$

label: RustboroCity_Flat1_2F_Text_LetsGiveItATry2
text: Ah, I see.\nWell, let's give it a try, shall we?$

label: RustboroCity_Flat1_2F_Text_OhIsThatRight
text: Oh, is that right?\pWell, if you come up with a good\nsuggestion, I'm all ears.$

label: RustboroCity_Flat1_2F_Text_OhShesLaughing
text: {STR_VAR_1}.\n{STR_VAR_1}.\pOh, yes! She's laughing!\nOh, I am as delighted as she!$

label: RustboroCity_Flat1_2F_Text_OhYouDontKnowAny
text: Oh, so you don't know any good words.\nI guess I'll try to amuse her with\lthe saying I used before.\pAnyways, if you have a good suggestion,\ndon't hesitate in telling me, okay?$

label: RustboroCity_Flat1_2F_Text_ShesNotSmilingAtAll
text: {STR_VAR_1}.\n{STR_VAR_1}.\pHmmm… She's not smiling at all.\nMaybe WALDA is one serious child…$

label: RustboroCity_Flat1_2F_Text_ShesNotSmilingAtAll2
text: {STR_VAR_1}.\n{STR_VAR_1}.\pHmmm… She's not smiling at all.\nMaybe WALDA is one serious child…$

label: RustboroCity_Flat1_2F_Text_ThankYouIllGiveYouWallpaper
text:
Thank you!\pThanks to you, my darling WALDA
laughed for me!\pActually, I may not look all that
special, but I'm one of DEVON\lCORPORATION's top researchers.\pSo, how about I do something in return
for you?\pI know, I'll add some new wallpaper
patterns for the BOXES in the PC\lPOKéMON Storage System.\pIn the wallpaper pattern menu,
select “FRIENDS.”\pThat will give you access to the new
wallpaper patterns.$

label: RustboroCity_Flat1_2F_Text_ThinkOfMyOwnPhrase
text: Oh, so you don't know any good words.\nI'd better think for myself, then.\pHmm…\nHow about “{STR_VAR_1}”?\lLet's see if that will work.$

label: RustboroCity_Flat1_2F_Text_WonderfulLetsHearSuggestion
text: Oh, that's wonderful.\nSo, let's hear it, your suggestion.$

label: RustboroCity_Flat2_1F_Text_DevonWorkersLiveHere
text: DEVON CORPORATION's workers live in\nthis building.$

label: RustboroCity_Flat2_1F_Text_Skitty
text: SKITTY: Gyaaaah!$

label: RustboroCity_Flat2_2F_Text_DevonWasTinyInOldDays
text: Way back in the old days, DEVON was just\na teeny, tiny company.$

label: RustboroCity_Flat2_2F_Text_GoingToWorkAtDevonToo
text: My daddy's working at the CORPORATION.\pWhen I grow up, I'm going to work for\nDEVON, too.$

label: RustboroCity_Flat2_2F_Text_MyDaddyMadeThisYouCanHaveIt
text: My daddy's working at the CORPORATION.\pMy daddy made this!\nBut I can't use it, so you can have it.$

label: RustboroCity_Flat2_3F_Text_PresidentCollectsRareStones
text: DEVON's PRESIDENT likes to collect\nrare stones.$

label: RustboroCity_Flat2_3F_Text_PresidentsSonAlsoCollectsRareStones
text: I think the PRESIDENT's son also\ncollects rare stones.$

label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_ExplainRockTomb
text:
That TECHNICAL MACHINE, TM39,
contains ROCK TOMB.\pIt not only inflicts damage by dropping
rocks, it also lowers SPEED.\pIf you use a TM, it instantly teaches
the move to a POKéMON.\pRemember, a TM can be used only once,
so think before you use it.$

label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_GymGuideAdvice
text:
Yo, how's it going?\pListen, my friend!
Would you like to become the CHAMPION?\pI'm no TRAINER, not me, but I can
sure give you winning advice.\pThat's settled, then! We'll aim for the
POKéMON CHAMPIONSHIP together!\pIt's your job as a TRAINER to collect
GYM BADGES, am I right?\pBut GYM LEADERS aren't pushovers!\pAnd that's where I come in!
I'm here to provide expert advice!\pROXANNE, the GYM LEADER, is a user
of ROCK-type POKéMON.\pThe ROCK type is very durable, but
it can't stand WATER-type and\lGRASS-type moves.\pCome see me afterwards, if you beat
the GYM LEADER.\pWell, go for it!$

label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_GymGuidePostVictory
text:
Whoa! What a breathtaking victory!
My cheering must've worked!\pGreat!
Check your TRAINER CARD.\pThe STONE BADGE you got should be
properly recorded on it.\pIn other words…\pYou've climbed the first step on
the stairs to the CHAMPIONSHIP!\pThat's got to feel awesome!$

label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_GymStatue
text: RUSTBORO CITY POKéMON GYM$

label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_GymStatueCertified
text: RUSTBORO CITY POKéMON GYM\pROXANNE'S CERTIFIED TRAINERS:\n{PLAYER}$

label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_JoshDefeat
text: You were too good for me…$

label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_JoshIntro
text: Don't take us GYM TRAINERS lightly!\nI'll show you why we're better!$

label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_JoshPostBattle
text: You haven't seen anything of the ROCK\ntype's terrifying power!$

label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_MarcDefeat
text: Oh, man oh man!\nOur challenger is one feisty customer!$

label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_MarcIntro
text: We might be in the middle of town,\nbut so what?\pMy ROCK POKéMON need room to\nrampage!$

label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_MarcPostBattle
text: I have to hand it to our LEADER.\pIt took smarts and sense for her to\npick the ROCK type at her young age.$

label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_ReceivedStoneBadge
text: {PLAYER} received the STONE BADGE\nfrom ROXANNE.$

label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_RoxanneDefeat
text:
So…
I lost…\pIt seems that I still have much more
to learn…\pI understand.\pThe POKéMON LEAGUE's rules state
that TRAINERS are to be given this\lif they defeat a GYM LEADER.\pPlease accept the official POKéMON
LEAGUE STONE BADGE.$

label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_RoxanneIntro
text:
Hello, I am ROXANNE, the RUSTBORO
POKéMON GYM LEADER.\pI became a GYM LEADER so that I might
apply what I learned at the POKéMON\lTRAINER'S SCHOOL in battle.\pWould you kindly demonstrate how you
battle, and with which POKéMON?$

label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_RoxannePostBattle
text: Since you are so strong, you should\nchallenge other GYM LEADERS.\pBy battling many TRAINERS, you should\nlearn many things.$

label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_RoxannePostRematch
text: ROXANNE: I still have much to learn\nwhen it comes to battling POKéMON.\pThat awareness makes me love battling\nall that much more!$

label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_RoxannePreRematch
text:
ROXANNE: I'm so glad to see you again.
I'm ROXANNE, the GYM LEADER here.\pI'm sure we've both experienced many
battles since we last met.\pI would like to see how much better
we've become. Let us battle!$

label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_RoxanneRematchDefeat
text: Grr…\nAgain, I have lost…$

label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_RoxanneRematchNeedTwoMons
text:
ROXANNE: I'm so glad to see you again.
I'm ROXANNE, the GYM LEADER here.\pI'm sure we've both experienced many
battles since we last met.\pI would like to see how much better
we've become…\pOh, no…
You only have one POKéMON with you?\pPlease return with at least one more
POKéMON.$

label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_StoneBadgeInfoTakeThis
text: The STONE BADGE heightens the ATTACK\npower of your POKéMON.\pIt also enables them to use the HM move\nCUT outside of battle.\pPlease take this with you, too.$

label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_TommyDefeat
text: Wow! You've got some potential!$

label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_TommyIntro
text: If you can't beat me, you won't stand\na chance against ROXANNE!$

label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_TommyPostBattle
text: ROXANNE is stronger than me by\nseveral times.\pYou'd better be on your guard!$

label: RustboroCity_House1_Text_AllSortsOfPlaces
text: In all sorts of places, there are all\nsorts of POKéMON and people.\pI find that fascinating, so I go to all\nsorts of places.$

label: RustboroCity_House1_Text_AnyPokemonCanBeCute
text: Any POKéMON can be cute if you raise\nit with care and kindness.$

label: RustboroCity_House1_Text_DoesntLookLikeMonToMe
text: Huh? That doesn't look anything like\na {STR_VAR_1} to me.$

label: RustboroCity_House1_Text_IllTradeIfYouWant
text:
Huh? My POKéMON is cute?
Sure, I knew that.\pBut if you really want, I'm willing
to trade it to you.\pI'll trade you my {STR_VAR_2} for
a {STR_VAR_1} if you want.$

label: RustboroCity_House1_Text_PleaseBeGoodToMyPokemon
text: Eheheh…\nPlease be good to my POKéMON.$

label: RustboroCity_House1_Text_YouDontWantToThatsOkay
text: Oh, if you don't want to, that's okay.\nBut my POKéMON is cute, you know…$

label: RustboroCity_House2_Text_RoxanneKnowsALot
text: ROXANNE, the GYM LEADER, really knows\na lot about POKéMON.\pShe's really strong, too!$

label: RustboroCity_House2_Text_TrainerSchoolExcellent
text: The TRAINER'S SCHOOL is excellent.\pIf you study there, you could even\nbecome a GYM LEADER.$

label: RustboroCity_House3_Text_IGivePerfectlySuitedNicknames
text: For my own POKéMON, I give them\nperfectly suited nicknames!\pIt's my expression of, uh…\noriginality, yes, that's it!$

label: RustboroCity_House3_Text_NamingPikachuPekachu
text: But giving the name PEKACHU to\na PIKACHU? It seems pointless.\pI suppose it is good to use a name\nthat's easy to understand, but…$

label: RustboroCity_House3_Text_Pekachu
text: PEKACHU: Peka!$

label: RustboroCity_Mart_Text_BuyingHealsInCaseOfShroomish
text: I'm buying some PARLYZ HEALS and\nANTIDOTES.\pJust in case I run into SHROOMISH\nin PETALBURG WOODS.$

label: RustboroCity_Mart_Text_GettingEscapeRopeJustInCase
text: I'm getting an ESCAPE ROPE just in\ncase I get lost in a cave.\pI just need to use it to get back to\nthe entrance.$

label: RustboroCity_Mart_Text_ShouldBuySuperPotionsInstead
text: My POKéMON evolved.\nIt has a lot of HP now.\pI should buy SUPER POTIONS for it\ninstead of ordinary POTIONS.$

label: RustboroCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_HMCutNextDoor
text: The man next door gave me an HM!\pI used it to teach my POKéMON how to\nCUT down skinny trees.$

label: RustboroCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_MaleAndFemalePokemon
text: Just like people, there are male and\nfemale POKéMON.\pBut no one seems to have any idea how\nthey're different.$

label: RustboroCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_PokemonHavePersonalities
text: My POKéMON has a NAIVE nature, and my\nfriend's has a JOLLY nature.\pIt's fascinating how POKéMON have\npersonalities!$

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_AlwaysWantedSeedot
text: I always wanted a SEEDOT, and\nI'm finally getting one!$

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_BlackboardListsStatusChanges
text: The blackboard lists status changes\nthat may affect POKéMON in battle.$

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_ConfusedPokemonAttacksItself
text:
You know how some POKéMON moves can
confuse a POKéMON?\pA confused POKéMON will sometimes
attack itself without meaning to.\pBut once it leaves battle, it will
return to normal.$

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_ExplainBurn
text: A burn reduces ATTACK power, and it\nsteadily reduces the victim's HP.\pA burn lingers after battle.\nCure a burn using a BURN HEAL.$

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_ExplainFreeze
text: If a POKéMON is frozen, it becomes\ncompletely helpless.\pIt will remain frozen after battle.\nThaw it out using an ICE HEAL.$

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_ExplainParalysis
text:
If a POKéMON becomes paralyzed,
its SPEED drops.\pIt may also not be able to move while
it is in battle.\pParalysis remains after battle.
Cure it using a PARLYZ HEAL.$

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_ExplainPoison
text:
If a POKéMON is poisoned, it will
steadily lose HP.\pThe effects of poison remain after
a battle.\pA poisoned POKéMON's HP will drop
while it is traveling.\pHeal a poisoning using an ANTIDOTE.$

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_ExplainQuickClaw
text:
A POKéMON holding the QUICK CLAW will
occasionally speed up and get to move\lbefore its opponent.\pThere are many other items that are
meant to be held by POKéMON.\pJust those alone will give you many
topics to study!$

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_ExplainSleep
text: If a POKéMON falls asleep, it will be\nunable to attack.\pA POKéMON may wake up on its own,\nbut if a battle ends while it is\lsleeping, it will stay asleep.\pWake it up using an AWAKENING.$

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_PokemonHealItselfWithBerry
text:
A POKéMON holding a BERRY will heal
itself…\pThere are many kinds of items that
POKéMON can hold…\pBoy, it sure is hard taking notes
down…$

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_PokemontCantUseManMadeItems
text: POKéMON can hold items, but they\ndon't know what to do with man-made\litems like POTION and ANTIDOTE.$

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_ReadWhichTopic
text: Which topic do you want to read?$

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_ScottMetAlreadyCut
text:
Hello? Didn't we meet before?
I think back in PETALBURG CITY.\pLet me introduce myself.
My name's SCOTT.\pI've been traveling everywhere in
search of outstanding TRAINERS.\pMore specifically, I'm looking for
POKéMON battle experts.\pSo, what brings you to this SCHOOL?
Are you a TRAINER, too?\pThe first thing you should do is to
have a POKéMON learn the move CUT.\pIf I remember correctly, someone in
this town has CUT.$

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_ScottMetAlreadyStoneBadge
text:
Hello? Didn't we meet before?
I think back in PETALBURG CITY.\pLet me introduce myself.
My name's SCOTT.\pI've been traveling everywhere in
search of outstanding TRAINERS.\pMore specifically, I'm looking for
POKéMON battle experts.\pOh, what's that?
It's a STONE BADGE, isn't it?\pThat's pretty impressive, I'd say, for
a starting TRAINER like yourself.\pBut, you know, I would've loved to see
you in battle.\pIt's hard to tell what you're like as
a TRAINER from a LEAGUE BADGE.$

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_ScottStoneBadge
text:
SCOTT: Oh, what's that?\pIt's a STONE BADGE, isn't it?
That's pretty impressive, I'd say.\pBut, you know, I would've loved to see
you in battle.\pIt's hard to tell what you're like as
a TRAINER from a LEAGUE BADGE.$

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_StudentTalentLevelUnknown
text: SCOTT: Hmm…\pThe talent levels of the students here\nare unknown. The potential's there.$

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_StudentsNotes
text:
It's this student's notebook…\pPOKéMON are to be caught using
POKé BALLS.\pUp to six POKéMON can accompany
a TRAINER.\pA TRAINER is someone who catches
POKéMON, raises them, and battles\lwith them.\pA TRAINER's mission is to defeat
the strong TRAINERS who await\lchallengers in POKéMON GYMS.$

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_StudentsWhoDontStudyGetQuickClaw
text: Students who don't study get a little\ntaste of my QUICK CLAW.\pWhether or not you are a good student \nwill be evident from the way you use\lthis item.$

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_TradingRightNow
text: I'm trading POKéMON with my friend\nright now.$

label: RustboroCity_Text_AddedMatchCallPleaseCallMrStone
text:
There you go, {PLAYER}!\pI added a new feature named
MATCH CALL to your POKéNAV.\pUsing the MATCH CALL feature,
you can chat with people who have\lbeen registered in your POKéNAV.\p{PLAYER}, our PRESIDENT STONE should
be registered in your POKéNAV.\pTest it out.
Please give our PRESIDENT a call.$

label: RustboroCity_Text_BrendanDefeat
text: Hmm…\nYou're pretty good.$

label: RustboroCity_Text_BrendanHiLetsRegister
text: BRENDAN: Oh, hey, {PLAYER}!\pYou had a MATCH CALL feature put\non your POKéNAV! Cool!\pLet's register each other so we can\nget in touch anytime!\p… … … … … …$

label: RustboroCity_Text_BrendanIWontGoEasy
text: BRENDAN: I know you just became\na TRAINER, but I won't go easy!$

label: RustboroCity_Text_BrendanMrBrineyHint
text: BRENDAN: By the way, you know\nMR. BRINEY? The guy I just passed?\pI bet you didn't know this, since you\njust moved here, {PLAYER}, but\lMR. BRINEY was once a great sailor.$

label: RustboroCity_Text_BrendanNoConfidenceInPokemon
text: BRENDAN: What's the matter? Don't have\nany confidence in your POKéMON?$

label: RustboroCity_Text_BrendanPassedBrineyWantToBattle
text:
BRENDAN: By the way, {PLAYER}, I walked
by MR. BRINEY in PETALBURG WOODS.\pI bet he was on his way home to his
cottage by the sea.\p{PLAYER}, how's your POKéDEX?
Have you filled in any pages yet?\pMine rules.\pWant to have a battle to test how
far you've progressed?$

label: RustboroCity_Text_BrendanWantToBattle
text: BRENDAN: What's up?\nWant to have a battle with me?$

label: RustboroCity_Text_CatchRarePokemonIfIGoToSchool
text: POKéMON TRAINER'S SCHOOL!\pIf I go to this school, will I be able\nto catch rare POKéMON easily?$

label: RustboroCity_Text_CitySign
text: RUSTBORO CITY\p“The city probing the integration of\nnature and science.”$

label: RustboroCity_Text_CuttersHouse
text: CUTTER'S HOUSE$

label: RustboroCity_Text_DevelopedNewPokenavFeature
text: I've been developing an added feature\nfor the POKéNAV…\pAnd it turned out great!\p{PLAYER}, may I see that POKéNAV?\nThe one our PRESIDENT gave you?$

label: RustboroCity_Text_DevonCorpSign
text: DEVON CORPORATION\p“For all your living needs, we make\nit all.”$

label: RustboroCity_Text_GymLeaderIsntEasyWithFire
text: I challenged the GYM LEADER, but…\pIt's not going to be easy winning with\nmy FIRE-type POKéMON…\pFIRE-type POKéMON don't match up\nwell against ROCK-type POKéMON…$

label: RustboroCity_Text_GymSign
text: RUSTBORO CITY POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: ROXANNE\p“The ROCK-loving honors student!”$

label: RustboroCity_Text_HaveYouChallengedGym
text: Have you taken the POKéMON GYM\nchallenge?\pWhen you get that shiny GYM BADGE\nin hand, I guess TRAINERS begin to\lrealize what is required of them.$

label: RustboroCity_Text_HelpMeIWasRobbed
text:
Oh, it's you!\pYou're that fantastic TRAINER who
helped me in PETALBURG WOODS!\pHelp me! I was robbed by TEAM AQUA!
I have to get the DEVON GOODS back!\pIf I don't…
I'm going to be in serious trouble.$

label: RustboroCity_Text_HeyThatsRustborosGymBadge
text: Hey, that's RUSTBORO's GYM BADGE!\pOut of all the POKéMON GYM BADGES,\nRUSTBORO's is the coolest, I'd say.$

label: RustboroCity_Text_IdBetterGetBackToWork
text: Okay, I'd better get back to work.\nPlease take care, {PLAYER}!$

label: RustboroCity_Text_MayDefeat
text: Yikes!\nYou're better than I expected!$

label: RustboroCity_Text_MayHiLetsRegister
text: MAY: Oh, hi, {PLAYER}{KUN}!\pYou had a MATCH CALL feature put\non your POKéNAV!\pLet's register each other so we can\ncontact one another anytime!\p… … … … … …$

label: RustboroCity_Text_MayImNotGoingToLose
text: MAY: You just became a TRAINER,\n{PLAYER}{KUN}. I'm not going to lose!$

label: RustboroCity_Text_MayMrBrineyHint
text: MAY: Oh, by the way, MR. BRINEY, who\nI just passed…\p{PLAYER}{KUN}, you just moved here so you\nmight not know this, but MR. BRINEY\lwas once a revered seafarer.$

label: RustboroCity_Text_MayOhHaventRaisedPokemonEnough
text: MAY: Oh, what's the matter?\pHaven't you caught or raised your\nPOKéMON very much?\pThat's not very good for a TRAINER!$

label: RustboroCity_Text_MayPassedBrineyWantToBattle
text:
MAY: Oh, by the way, I passed
MR. BRINEY in PETALBURG WOODS.\pI guess he's on his way home to his
cottage by the sea.\pHow's your POKéDEX coming along,
{PLAYER}{KUN}? Mine's looking pretty decent!\pSo…
How about a little battle?$

label: RustboroCity_Text_MayWantToBattle
text: MAY: So, what do you think?\nHow about a little battle here?$

label: RustboroCity_Text_MrBrineyLovesPeeko
text:
The old sailor MR. BRINEY lives in
a cottage by the sea.\pHe said he was going shopping in
SLATEPORT for his pet, PEEKO.\pThat old sea dog, he must really love
that PEEKO.$

label: RustboroCity_Text_MrBrineyWalksInTheTunnel
text: The old sailor MR. BRINEY lives in\na cottage by the sea.\pHe goes for walks in the tunnel every\nso often.$

label: RustboroCity_Text_OutOfTheWay
text: Get out!\nOut of the way!$

label: RustboroCity_Text_PleaseComeWithMe
text: Excuse me, please!\nPlease come with me!$

label: RustboroCity_Text_PleaseSelectPokenav
text: Please select the POKéNAV.$

label: RustboroCity_Text_PokemonCanChangeLookFromExp
text: If a POKéMON gains experience in\nbattles, it can sometimes change in\lthe way it looks.$

label: RustboroCity_Text_PokemonChangeShape
text: A POKéMON changes shape?\nIf one did that, I would be shocked!$

label: RustboroCity_Text_RegisteredBrendan
text: Registered BRENDAN\nin the POKéNAV.$

label: RustboroCity_Text_RegisteredMay
text: Registered MAY\nin the POKéNAV.$

label: RustboroCity_Text_ShadyCharacterTookOffTowardsTunnel
text: That shady character, I think he took\noff towards the tunnel over there.$

label: RustboroCity_Text_SneakyLookingManWentAroundCorner
text: Hm? A sneaky-looking man?\pCome to think of it, yes, a shady-\nlooking guy went around the corner.$

label: RustboroCity_Text_TradePokemonGrowFast
text: A POKéMON you get in a trade from\nsomeone grows fast.\pBut if you don't have certain GYM\nBADGES, it may not obey you…$

label: RustboroCity_Text_TrainersSchoolSign
text: POKéMON TRAINER'S SCHOOL\p“We'll teach you anything about\nPOKéMON!”$

label: RustboroCity_Text_TunnelNearingCompletion
text: “Timesaving tunnel nearing\ncompletion!”\p…Is what it says on the sign, but\nthere's also a big “X” splashed\lacross it in red paint…$

label: RustboroCity_Text_WaitDontTakeMyGoods
text: Wait! Pleeeaaase!\pDon't take my GOODS!$

label: RustboroCity_Text_WeShortenItToDevon
text: The DEVON CORPORATION…\nWe all just shorten it to DEVON.\pThat company makes all sorts of\nconvenient products.$

label: RustboroCity_Text_WowYouHavePokemon
text: Wow, you have POKéMON with you, too.\pWhen I get bigger, I'm going to go\nplaces with POKéMON, too.$

label: RustboroCity_Text_YouCanHave2On2Battle
text:
Did you know this?\pYou can have a 2-on-2 battle even
if you're not with another TRAINER.\pIf you catch the eyes of two TRAINERS
when you have two or more POKéMON,\lthey'll both challenge you.\pDon't you think it'd be cool if you
could beat two TRAINERS by yourself?$

label: RustboroCity_Text_YouGotItThankYou
text:
Oh! How did it go?
The DEVON GOODS?\pYou did!
You got them back!\pYou really are a great TRAINER!\pI know! As my thanks, I'll give you
another GREAT BALL!$

label: RustboroCity_Text_YoureLoadedWithItems
text: You're loaded with items.\nI can't give you this GREAT BALL.$

label: RustboroCity_Text_YoureNewAroundHere
text: Oh? Who might you be?\nYou're a new face around these parts.\pHave you just transferred into the\nPOKéMON TRAINER'S SCHOOL?$

label: RusturfTunnel_Text_BoyfriendOnOtherSideOfRock
text:
On the other side of this rock…
My boyfriend is there.\pHe… He's not just digging the tunnel
to come see me.\pHe works his hands raw and rough
for the benefit of everyone.$

label: RusturfTunnel_Text_ComeAndGetSome
text: What, are you coming?\nCome and get some, then!$

label: RusturfTunnel_Text_ExplainStrength
text: That HM contains STRENGTH.\pIf a muscular POKéMON were to learn\nthat, it would be able to move even\llarge boulders.$

label: RusturfTunnel_Text_GruntDefeat
text: Urrrggh! My career in crime comes to\na dead end!$

label: RusturfTunnel_Text_GruntIntro
text:
Grah, keelhaul it all!\pThat hostage POKéMON turned out to
be worthless!\pAnd to think I made a getaway…
In this tunnel to nowhere!\pHey! You!
So you want to battle me?$

label: RusturfTunnel_Text_GruntTakePackage
text:
This is plain not right…\pThe BOSS told me this would be a
slick-and-easy job to pull.\pAll I had to do was steal some package
from DEVON.\pTch!
You want it back that badly, take it!$

label: RusturfTunnel_Text_MikeDefeat
text: My POKéMON…\nRan out of power…$

label: RusturfTunnel_Text_MikeIntro
text: What do you call a wild man up in the\nmountains? A mountain man, right?\pSo why don't they call a POKéMON in\nthe mountains a mountain POKéMON?$

label: RusturfTunnel_Text_MikePostBattle
text: They halted development here to\nprotect POKéMON, right?\lThere's a feel-good story!$

label: RusturfTunnel_Text_Peeko
text: PEEKO: Pii pihyoh!$

label: RusturfTunnel_Text_PeekoGladToSeeYouSafe
text: PEEKO!\nAm I glad to see you're safe!$

label: RusturfTunnel_Text_ThankYouLetsGoHomePeeko
text:
PEEKO owes her life to you!\pThey call me MR. BRINEY.
And, you are?\p… … … … … … … …
… … … … … … … …\pAh, so you are {PLAYER}{KUN}!
I sincerely thank you!\pNow, if there's anything that troubles
you, don't hesitate to tell me!\pYou can usually find me in my cottage
by the sea near PETALBURG WOODS.\pCome, PEEKO, we should make our way
home.\pPEEKO: Pihyoh!$

label: RusturfTunnel_Text_ToGetToVerdanturf
text: To get from RUSTBORO to VERDANTURF,\nyou need to go to DEWFORD, then pass\lthrough SLATEPORT and MAUVILLE…$

label: RusturfTunnel_Text_WandaReunion
text: WANDA!\nNow I can see you anytime!\pWANDA: That's…wonderful.\pPlease, take some rest at my home.$

label: RusturfTunnel_Text_WhyCantTheyKeepDigging
text:
… …\pWhy can't they keep digging?
Is the bedrock too hard?\pMy beloved awaits me in VERDANTURF
TOWN just beyond here…\pIf RUSTBORO and VERDANTURF were
joined by this tunnel, I could visit\lher every day…\pBut this…
What am I to do?$

label: RusturfTunnel_Text_YouShatteredBoulderTakeHM
text: Wow! You shattered that boulder\nblocking the way.\pTo show you how much I appreciate it,\nI'd like you to have this HM.$

label: SSAnne_1F_Corridor_Text_LeStrongSilentType
text:
Bonjour!
I am le waiter on this ship!\pI will be happy to serve you
anything you please!\p… … …
Ah! Le strong silent type!$

label: SSAnne_1F_Corridor_Text_PassengersAreRestless
text: The passengers are restless from\nthis long voyage.\pYou might be challenged by the\nmore bored ones!$

label: SSAnne_1F_Room1_Text_ImAGlobalPoliceAgent
text: Ssh…!\nI'm a GLOBAL POLICE agent.\pI'm on the trail of TEAM ROCKET.\nThey're up to nothing good!$

label: SSAnne_1F_Room2_Text_AnnDefeat
text: Oh, no!\nI went around the world for these!$

label: SSAnne_1F_Room2_Text_AnnIntro
text: I collected these POKéMON\nfrom all around the world!$

label: SSAnne_1F_Room2_Text_AnnPostBattle
text: You hurt my poor POKéMON!\pI demand that you heal them at a\nPOKéMON CENTER!$

label: SSAnne_1F_Room2_Text_CruisingAroundWorld
text: We are cruising around the world,\nmy children and I.$

label: SSAnne_1F_Room2_Text_TylerDefeat
text: Wow! \nYou're great!$

label: SSAnne_1F_Room2_Text_TylerIntro
text: I love POKéMON!\nDo you?$

label: SSAnne_1F_Room2_Text_TylerPostBattle
text: Listen, listen!\nLet me be your friend, okay?\pThen we can trade POKéMON and\ndo stuff.$

label: SSAnne_1F_Room3_Text_AlwaysTravelWithWigglytuff
text: I always travel with WIGGLYTUFF.\nI never leave home without it.$

label: SSAnne_1F_Room3_Text_CruiseIsElegantAndCozy
text: A world cruise is so elegant yet\ncozy!$

label: SSAnne_1F_Room3_Text_Wigglytuff
text: WIGGLYTUFF: Puup pupuu!$

label: SSAnne_1F_Room4_Text_WaiterCherryPiePlease
text: Waiter, I would like a cherry pie,\nplease!$

label: SSAnne_1F_Room4_Text_WaitressCherryPiePlease
text: Waitress, I would like a cherry\npie, please!$

label: SSAnne_1F_Room5_Text_ArthurDefeat
text: Humph! You rude child!\nYou have no sense of courtesy!$

label: SSAnne_1F_Room5_Text_ArthurIntro
text: You insolent pup!\nHow dare you barge in!$

label: SSAnne_1F_Room5_Text_ArthurPostBattle
text: I wish to be left alone!\nGet out!$

label: SSAnne_1F_Room6_Text_GladEveryoneIsRefreshed
text: I'm glad to see that everyone is\nlooking refreshed and chipper.$

label: SSAnne_1F_Room6_Text_SorryYouLookLikeMyBrother
text: Oh, I'm sorry for fussing over you.\nYou look like my little brother…$

label: SSAnne_1F_Room6_Text_SorryYouLookLikeMySister
text: Oh, I'm sorry for fussing over you.\nYou look like my little sister…$

label: SSAnne_1F_Room6_Text_TakeAShortRest
text: You look tired. Would you like to\ntake a short rest?$

label: SSAnne_1F_Room7_Text_ThomasDefeat
text: My, my friends…$

label: SSAnne_1F_Room7_Text_ThomasIntro
text: I am but a solitary traveler…\pMy sole companions and friends are\nPOKéMON I caught on my journeys…$

label: SSAnne_1F_Room7_Text_ThomasPostBattle
text: You should be nice to friends!$

label: SSAnne_2F_Corridor_Text_RivalDefeat
text: Humph!\pAt least you're raising your\nPOKéMON!$

label: SSAnne_2F_Corridor_Text_RivalIntro
text:
{RIVAL}: Bonjour!
{PLAYER}!\pImagine seeing you here!
{PLAYER}, were you really invited?\pSo how's your POKéDEX coming?\pI already caught 40 kinds, pal.
Different kinds are everywhere.\pCrawl around in grassy areas, and
look hard for them.$

label: SSAnne_2F_Corridor_Text_RivalPostBattle
text:
{RIVAL}: I heard there was a CUT
master on board.\pBut he was just a seasick old man!\pCUT itself is really useful.
Yup, it'll be handy.\pYou should go see him, too.
Smell ya!$

label: SSAnne_2F_Corridor_Text_ThisShipIsLuxuryLiner
text: This ship, she is a luxury liner for\nTRAINERS of the world!\pAt every port, we hold parties with\ninvited TRAINERS.$

label: SSAnne_2F_Room1_Text_SleepingMonLookedLikeThis
text: I've journeyed far and wide, but in\nall my travels I've never seen\lany POKéMON sleep like this one!\pIt was something like this!$

label: SSAnne_2F_Room2_Text_BrooksDefeat
text: Good match!\nAh, I feel young again!$

label: SSAnne_2F_Room2_Text_BrooksIntro
text: Competing against the young keeps\nme youthful.$

label: SSAnne_2F_Room2_Text_BrooksPostBattle
text: Fifteen years ago, I would\nhave won!$

label: SSAnne_2F_Room2_Text_DaleDefeat
text: I'm all out!$

label: SSAnne_2F_Room2_Text_DaleIntro
text: Check out what I fished up!$

label: SSAnne_2F_Room2_Text_DalePostBattle
text: Party?\pThe cruise ship's party should be\nover by now.$

label: SSAnne_2F_Room3_Text_SeenMonsFerryPeople
text: Ah, yes, I have seen some POKéMON\nferry people across the water!$

label: SSAnne_2F_Room3_Text_SomeTreesCanBeCutDown
text:
Small trees can be chopped down
using the move CUT.\pBut remember this!
CUT is an HM technique.\pOnce learned, it is not so easily
discarded.$

label: SSAnne_2F_Room4_Text_DawnDefeat
text: Take it easy!$

label: SSAnne_2F_Room4_Text_DawnIntro
text: I don't believe I saw you at the\nparty?$

label: SSAnne_2F_Room4_Text_DawnPostBattle
text: Oh, I adore your strong POKéMON!\nOh, how I envy you for them!$

label: SSAnne_2F_Room4_Text_LamarDefeat
text: I must salute you!$

label: SSAnne_2F_Room4_Text_LamarIntro
text: Which do you find more worthy,\na strong or a rare POKéMON?$

label: SSAnne_2F_Room4_Text_LamarPostBattle
text: Personally, I prefer strong and\nrare POKéMON.$

label: SSAnne_2F_Room5_Text_HaveYouGoneToSafariZone
text: Have you gone to the SAFARI ZONE\nin FUCHSIA CITY?\pThere are many kinds of rare\nPOKéMON.$

label: SSAnne_2F_Room5_Text_WeThinkSafariZoneIsAwesome
text: Me and my daddy think the SAFARI\nZONE is awesome!\lI wish we could go there again.$

label: SSAnne_2F_Room6_Text_CaptainIsAwfullySick
text: The CAPTAIN said he's awfully sick.\nHe was all pale.$

label: SSAnne_2F_Room6_Text_ManyPeopleGetSeasick
text: I hear many people get seasick.$

label: SSAnne_3F_Corridor_Text_CaptainTeachesCutToMons
text: Our CAPTAIN is a sword master.\nHe's awesome at using CUT.\pThey say he even teaches CUT\nto POKéMON!$

label: SSAnne_B1F_Room1_Text_BarnyDefeat
text: Darn!\nI let that one get away!$

label: SSAnne_B1F_Room1_Text_BarnyIntro
text: Hello, stranger!\pI can't tell if you're from the seas\nor mountains, but stop and chat.\pAll my POKéMON are from the sea.$

label: SSAnne_B1F_Room1_Text_BarnyPostBattle
text: I was going to make you my\nassistant, too!$

label: SSAnne_B1F_Room1_Text_PhillipDefeat
text: Argh!\nBeaten by a newcomer!$

label: SSAnne_B1F_Room1_Text_PhillipIntro
text: Matey, you're walking the plank if\nyou lose!$

label: SSAnne_B1F_Room1_Text_PhillipPostBattle
text: When we're out at sea, jellyfish\nPOKéMON sometimes drift by.$

label: SSAnne_B1F_Room2_Text_HueyDefeat
text: Okay, you're not bad.$

label: SSAnne_B1F_Room2_Text_HueyIntro
text: Even us sailors have POKéMON, too!$

label: SSAnne_B1F_Room2_Text_HueyPostBattle
text: We caught all our POKéMON while\nwe were out at sea.$

label: SSAnne_B1F_Room3_Text_DylanDefeat
text: Argh!\nLost it!$

label: SSAnne_B1F_Room3_Text_DylanIntro
text: I like feisty kids like you!$

label: SSAnne_B1F_Room3_Text_DylanPostBattle
text: Sea POKéMON live in deep water.\nYou'll need a ROD to fish them up!$

label: SSAnne_B1F_Room4_Text_DuncanDefeat
text: Your spirit sank me!$

label: SSAnne_B1F_Room4_Text_DuncanIntro
text: Come on, then!\nMy sailor's pride is at stake!$

label: SSAnne_B1F_Room4_Text_DuncanPostBattle
text: Did you see the FISHING GURU in\nVERMILION CITY?$

label: SSAnne_B1F_Room4_Text_LeonardDefeat
text: Right!\nGood battle, mate!$

label: SSAnne_B1F_Room4_Text_LeonardIntro
text: You know what they say about\nsailors and battling!$

label: SSAnne_B1F_Room4_Text_LeonardPostBattle
text: Hahaha!\nWant to be a sailor, mate?$

label: SSAnne_B1F_Room5_Text_Machoke
text: MACHOKE: Gwoh! Goggoh!$

label: SSAnne_B1F_Room5_Text_MachokeHasStrengthToMoveRocks
text: My buddy MACHOKE is super strong!\pHe has enough STRENGTH to move\nbig rocks!$

label: SSAnne_CaptainsOffice_Text_CaptainIFeelSeasick
text: CAPTAIN: Ooargh…\nI feel hideous…\lUrrp! Seasick…$

label: SSAnne_CaptainsOffice_Text_ExplainCut
text: Using CUT, you can chop down\nsmall trees.\pWhy not try it with the trees\naround VERMILION CITY?$

label: SSAnne_CaptainsOffice_Text_HowToConquerSeasickness
text: How to Conquer Seasickness…\nThe CAPTAIN's reading this!$

label: SSAnne_CaptainsOffice_Text_ObtainedHM01FromCaptain
text: {PLAYER} obtained HM01\nfrom the CAPTAIN!$

label: SSAnne_CaptainsOffice_Text_RubbedCaptainsBack
text: {PLAYER} rubbed the CAPTAIN's\nback!\pRub-rub…\nRub-rub…$

label: SSAnne_CaptainsOffice_Text_SSAnneWillSetSailSoon
text: CAPTAIN: …Whew!\pNow that I'm not sick anymore,\nI guess it's time.\pThe S.S. ANNE will set sail soon!\pFarewell, until our return to\nVERMILION CITY!$

label: SSAnne_CaptainsOffice_Text_ThankYouHaveHMForCut
text:
CAPTAIN: Whew! Thank you!
I'm feeling much better now.\pYou want to see my hidden CUT
technique?\pI could show you my prized CUT
technique if I weren't so ill…\pI know! You can have this!
This HIDDEN MACHINE!\pTeach CUT to your POKéMON, and
you can see it CUT anytime!$

label: SSAnne_CaptainsOffice_Text_YuckShouldntHaveLooked
text: Yuck!\nShouldn't have looked!$

label: SSAnne_Deck_Text_EdmondDefeat
text: You're impressive!$

label: SSAnne_Deck_Text_EdmondIntro
text: Hey, matey!\pLet's do a little jig!$

label: SSAnne_Deck_Text_EdmondPostBattle
text: How many kinds of POKéMON do you\nthink there are in this big world?$

label: SSAnne_Deck_Text_FeelSeasick
text: Urf… I feel ill…\pI got seasick, so I stepped out to\nget some air…$

label: SSAnne_Deck_Text_ScrubbingDecksHardWork
text: Whew!\nScrubbing decks is hard work!$

label: SSAnne_Deck_Text_ShipDepartingSoon
text: The party's over.\nThe ship will be departing soon.$

label: SSAnne_Deck_Text_TrevorDefeat
text: I was just careless!$

label: SSAnne_Deck_Text_TrevorIntro
text: Ahoy, there!\nAre you seasick?$

label: SSAnne_Deck_Text_TrevorPostBattle
text: My pa said there are 100 kinds of\nPOKéMON. I think there are more.$

label: SSAnne_Kitchen_Text_BusyOutOfTheWay
text: You, mon petit!\nWe're busy here!\lOut of the way!$

label: SSAnne_Kitchen_Text_EelsAuBarbecue
text: Eels au Barbecue!\pLes guests will mutiny, I fear.$

label: SSAnne_Kitchen_Text_HearAboutSnorlaxItsAGlutton
text: Did you hear about SNORLAX?\nIt's a glutton.\pNo other POKéMON eats and sleeps\nthe way SNORLAX can and does!$

label: SSAnne_Kitchen_Text_IAmLeChefMainCourseIs
text: Er-hem!\nIndeed I am le CHEF!\pLe main course is$

label: SSAnne_Kitchen_Text_OnlyGetToPeelOnions
text: Snivel… Sniff…\pI only get to peel onions…\nSnivel…$

label: SSAnne_Kitchen_Text_PeelSpudsEveryDay
text: Hum-de-hum-de-ho…\pI peel spuds every day!\nHum-hum…$

label: SSAnne_Kitchen_Text_PrimeBeefsteak
text: Prime Beefsteak!\pBut, have I enough fillets du\nbeef?$

label: SSAnne_Kitchen_Text_SalmonDuSalad
text: Salmon du Salad!\pLes guests may gripe it's fish\nagain, however!$

label: SSAnne_Kitchen_Text_SawOddBerryInTrash
text: I saw an odd BERRY in the trash.\nI wonder what that was?$

label: SSAnne_Kitchen_Text_SoBusyImDizzy
text: I'm so busy I'm getting dizzy!\nYou have to give me room here!$

label: SSTidalCorridor_Text_BrineyWelcomeAboard
text:
MR. BRINEY: Welcome aboard, {PLAYER}{KUN}!\pThey made me honorary captain of
the S.S. TIDAL!\pYou can call me CAPTAIN BRINEY now!\pYou know, I retired once before,
but when I saw this majestic ship…\pLet me just say, it stirred my sleeping
soul as a sailor!$

label: SSTidalCorridor_Text_Cabin1
text: Cabin 1$

label: SSTidalCorridor_Text_Cabin2
text: Cabin 2$

label: SSTidalCorridor_Text_Cabin3
text: Cabin 3$

label: SSTidalCorridor_Text_Cabin4
text: Cabin 4$

label: SSTidalCorridor_Text_CanRestInCabin2
text:
It'll be some time before we make land,
I reckon.\pYou can rest up in your cabin if you'd
like. Your cabin's No. 2.\pThe bed in there is soft and plushy.
I can attest to how comfy it is!$

label: SSTidalCorridor_Text_EnjoyYourCruise
text: Enjoy your cruise!$

label: SSTidalCorridor_Text_HorizonSpreadsBeyondPorthole
text: The horizon spreads beyond\nthe porthole.$

label: SSTidalCorridor_Text_Peeko
text: PEEKO: Pihyo pihyohyo…$

label: SSTidalCorridor_Text_ScottBattleFrontierInvite
text:
SCOTT: Well, hi, hi!
{PLAYER}{KUN}, {PLAYER}{KUN}!\pSomething's come up, so I have to
disembark, but am I glad to see you!\pCongratulations, LEAGUE CHAMPION!\pThere's a place I'd like to invite
someone like you.\pIt's the…
BATTLE FRONTIER!\pWhat's the place like?
You'll understand when you see it!\pI've spoken with the ship's CAPTAIN
about this.\pThe next time you take a ferry,
you should be able to sail to\lthe BATTLE FRONTIER.\pOkay, {PLAYER}{KUN}, I'll be waiting for you
at the BATTLE FRONTIER!$

label: SSTidalCorridor_Text_VisitOtherCabins
text: Go visit other cabins.\nTRAINERS bored of the boat trip will\lbe itching to battle.$

label: SSTidalCorridor_Text_WeveArrived
text: We've arrived!$

label: SSTidalLowerDeck_Text_LeonardDefeat
text: Big bro, I lost!$

label: SSTidalLowerDeck_Text_LeonardIntro
text: This is the bottom of the ship's hull.\nThere's plenty of room.\lIt'll be alright for a POKéMON battle.$

label: SSTidalLowerDeck_Text_LeonardPostBattle
text: We're the CLEANUP BROTHERS!\pThe old one dumps the detergent,\nand the young one does the scrubbing!$

label: SSTidalLowerDeck_Text_PhillipDefeat
text: Little bro, I lost!$

label: SSTidalLowerDeck_Text_PhillipIntro
text: Arrrgh! I'm fed up and dog-tired of\ncleaning this huge place!\pLet's have a quick battle!$

label: SSTidalLowerDeck_Text_PhillipPostBattle
text: We're the CLEANUP BROTHERS!\pThe old one dumps the detergent,\nand the young one does the scrubbing!$

label: SSTidalRooms_Text_ColtonDefeat
text: That was an enjoyable match!$

label: SSTidalRooms_Text_ColtonIntro
text: I often sail to LILYCOVE CITY.\pI enjoy attending CONTESTS,\nyou see.$

label: SSTidalRooms_Text_ColtonPostBattle
text: I get so excited imagining what kinds\nof POKéMON I'll get to see in the next\lCONTEST. The anticipation of it thrills!$

label: SSTidalRooms_Text_ExplainSnatch
text: SNATCH steals the beneficial effects\nof certain moves before they can be\lused by a foe or ally.$

label: SSTidalRooms_Text_GarretDefeat
text: …That will do.$

label: SSTidalRooms_Text_GarretIntro
text: Ah, you've come just in time.\pI'm bored, you see.\nYou may entertain me.$

label: SSTidalRooms_Text_GarretPostBattle
text: Perhaps I shall get Father to acquire\na yacht for me.\lA yacht for me and POKéMON!$

label: SSTidalRooms_Text_JedDefeat
text: JED: Sigh…$

label: SSTidalRooms_Text_JedIntro
text: JED: I feel a little shy about this, but…\nWe'll show you our lovey-dovey power!$

label: SSTidalRooms_Text_JedNotEnoughMons
text: JED: You only have one POKéMON?\nIsn't that just too lonesome?$

label: SSTidalRooms_Text_JedPostBattle
text: JED: It's the first time that our lovey-\ndovey power couldn't prevail!\lYou must be an awesome TRAINER!$

label: SSTidalRooms_Text_LeaDefeat
text: LEA: Oh, boo!$

label: SSTidalRooms_Text_LeaIntro
text: LEA: I feel a little silly, but…\nWe'll show you our lovey-dovey power!$

label: SSTidalRooms_Text_LeaNotEnoughMons
text: LEA: I wanted to battle…\nBut you don't even have two POKéMON…$

label: SSTidalRooms_Text_LeaPostBattle
text: LEA: I can't believe it!\nOur lovey-dovey power failed…\lYou must be an awesome TRAINER!$

label: SSTidalRooms_Text_MicahDefeat
text: Your friends are, indeed, strong.$

label: SSTidalRooms_Text_MicahIntro
text: Are your friends strong?$

label: SSTidalRooms_Text_MicahPostBattle
text: Friends need not be human.\nFor me, POKéMON are treasured friends!$

label: SSTidalRooms_Text_NaomiDefeat
text: I see.\nYou're the active sort.$

label: SSTidalRooms_Text_NaomiIntro
text: Oh, you're such an adorable TRAINER.\nWould you like to have tea?\lOr would you rather battle?$

label: SSTidalRooms_Text_NaomiPostBattle
text: A world cruise on a luxury liner has its\ncharms, I must say…\pBut, I will admit there is an appealing\nside to touring HOENN by ferry.$

label: SSTidalRooms_Text_NotSuspiciousTakeThis
text: Uh… Hi! I… I'm not acting suspicious!\nUh… You can have this! For free!\pIt… Honestly, I didn't SNATCH it from\nsomeone! I'd never do such a thing!\lIt's clean! You can use it!$

label: SSTidalRooms_Text_TakeRestOnBed
text: There's a bed…\nLet's take a rest.$

label: SSTidalRooms_Text_ThomasDefeat
text: A loss is to be accepted without haste\nor panic.$

label: SSTidalRooms_Text_ThomasIntro
text: Child…\nDid you knock on the door?$

label: SSTidalRooms_Text_ThomasPostBattle
text: To be never ruffled in any situation is\nthe GENTLEMAN's code of conduct.$

label: SSTidal_Text_FastCurrentsHopeYouEnjoyVoyage
text: This ferry is built to plow through\nfast-running currents.\pWe hope you enjoy your voyage with us.\nFeel free to explore the ship.$

label: SSTidal_Text_HopeYouEnjoyVoyage
text: We hope you enjoy your voyage on\nour ferry.$

label: SSTidal_Text_MadeLandInLilycove
text: We have made land in LILYCOVE CITY.\nThank you for sailing with us.$

label: SSTidal_Text_MadeLandInSlateport
text: We have made land in SLATEPORT CITY.\nThank you for sailing with us.$

label: SafariZone_Center_Text_CatchingMonsAsGifts
text: I'm catching POKéMON to take home\nas gifts.$

label: SafariZone_Center_Text_CenterArea
text: CENTER AREA$

label: SafariZone_Center_Text_PressStartToCheckTime
text: TRAINER TIPS\pPress START to check\nremaining time.$

label: SafariZone_Center_Text_RestHouse
text: REST HOUSE$

label: SafariZone_Center_Text_WhereDidErikGo
text: SARA: Where did my boyfriend,\nERIK, go?$

label: SafariZone_East_Text_AreaSign
text: AREA 1\nWEST: CENTER AREA$

label: SafariZone_East_Text_CaughtChanseyAllWorthwhile
text: I caught a CHANSEY!\pThat makes this all worthwhile.$

label: SafariZone_East_Text_HowManyDidYouCatch
text: How many did you catch?\nI'm bushed from the effort!$

label: SafariZone_East_Text_KeepAnyItemFoundOnSafari
text: You can keep any item you find in\nthe SAFARI ZONE.\pBut, you'll run out of time if you\ntry for all of them at once.$

label: SafariZone_East_Text_MyEeveeEvolvedIntoFlareon
text: My EEVEE evolved into FLAREON.\pBut, a friend's EEVEE turned into a\nVAPOREON. I wonder why?$

label: SafariZone_East_Text_PrizeInDeepestPartOfSafariZone
text: Go to the deepest part of the\nSAFARI ZONE. You will win a prize!$

label: SafariZone_East_Text_RestHouse
text: REST HOUSE$

label: SafariZone_East_Text_TimeDeclinesOnlyWhileYouWalk
text: TRAINER TIPS\pThe remaining time declines only\nwhile you walk.$

label: SafariZone_East_Text_TiredFromAllTheFun
text: Whew!\nI'm tired from all the fun!$

label: SafariZone_North_Text_Area2
text: AREA 2$

label: SafariZone_North_Text_Fisherman
text: I'm on a mission to find WATER POKéMON\nyou don't see in HOENN.\pDo you have any idea where the lake is?$

label: SafariZone_North_Text_Man
text: I'm going to catch a lot of rare POKéMON\nhere and trade them with my friends!$

label: SafariZone_North_Text_RestHouse
text: REST HOUSE$

label: SafariZone_North_Text_SecretHouseStillAhead
text: TRAINER TIPS\pThe SECRET HOUSE is still ahead.$

label: SafariZone_North_Text_WinFreeHMFindSecretHouse
text: TRAINER TIPS\pWin a free HM for finding the\nSECRET HOUSE.$

label: SafariZone_North_Text_ZigzagThroughTallGrass
text: TRAINER TIPS\pPOKéMON hide in tall grass.\pZigzag through grassy areas to\nflush them out.$

label: SafariZone_Northeast_Text_Boy
text: I only have a couple SAFARI BALLS left.\pI'm having a hard time trying to\ndecide what I should catch.$

label: SafariZone_Northeast_Text_Girl
text: Oh, boo!\nI can't seem to catch anything!\pI'll end up wasting the admission\nprice if I don't catch something!$

label: SafariZone_Northeast_Text_Woman
text: I heard that you can see PIKACHU here.\nWhere might one be?$

label: SafariZone_Northwest_Text_Man
text: Gasp… Gasp…\nI…made it out here…but…\pI'm exhausted… I don't have the\nenergy to catch POKéMON…$

label: SafariZone_RestHouse_Text_FatMan
text: If you put a {POKEBLOCK} on the FEEDER,\nPOKéMON are attracted to it.\pI think POKéMON with the same sort of\nnature are drawn by a certain {POKEBLOCK}.$

label: SafariZone_RestHouse_Text_PsychicM
text: If you use {POKEBLOCK}S, wild POKéMON won't\nbe so quick to run away.\pIt's not much use to give {POKEBLOCK}S to\nPOKéMON that don't flee easily.$

label: SafariZone_RestHouse_Text_Youngster
text: I don't have any {POKEBLOCK}S, but I caught\na good number of POKéMON.\pYou can improve your chances of making\na catch by getting closer to them\lbefore throwing a SAFARI BALL.$

label: SafariZone_SecretHouse_Text_CongratsYouveWon
text:
Ah! Finally!\pYou're the first person to reach
the SECRET HOUSE!\pAlthough I made a campaign
for our grand opening,\pI was getting worried that no one
would win our campaign prize.\pCongratulations!
You have won!$

label: SafariZone_SecretHouse_Text_DontHaveRoomForPrize
text: You don't have room for this\nfabulous prize!$

label: SafariZone_SecretHouse_Text_ExplainSurf
text:
HM03 is SURF.\pPOKéMON will be able to ferry you
across water using it.\pAnd, this HM isn't disposable, so
you can use it over and over.\pYou're super lucky for winning this
fabulous prize!$

label: SafariZone_SecretHouse_Text_ReceivedHM03FromAttendant
text: {PLAYER} received HM03\nfrom the attendant!$

label: SafariZone_South_Text_AreaOffLimits1
text: This area is still under construction.\nIt's off-limits, sorry!$

label: SafariZone_South_Text_AreaOffLimits2
text: This area is still under construction.\nIt's off-limits, sorry!$

label: SafariZone_South_Text_Boy
text: Did you know?\pIf you put a {POKEBLOCK} in that square box,\nPOKéMON gather around.$

label: SafariZone_South_Text_EnjoyTheRestOfYourAdventure
text: Please enjoy the rest of your wild\nadventure!$

label: SafariZone_South_Text_ExitEarlyThankYouForPlaying
text: Okay.\pI'll take back your remaining SAFARI\nBALLS.\pThank you for playing.\nWe hope to see you again.$

label: SafariZone_South_Text_GoodLuck
text: Good luck!\pIf you need anything, don't hesitate\nto tell me, please!$

label: SafariZone_South_Text_Man
text: I want to keep going deeper, but I\nforgot to bring a BIKE.\pSomething tells me that rare POKéMON\nlive in the outlying areas.$

label: SafariZone_South_Text_StillHaveTimeExit
text: You still have time left. Would you like\nto exit the SAFARI ZONE now?$

label: SafariZone_South_Text_Youngster
text: I put a {POKEBLOCK} on the {POKEBLOCK} FEEDER.\nBut it seems to have disappeared.\pI guess POKéMON must have eaten it\nwithout me noticing.$

label: SafariZone_Southeast_Text_ExpansionIsFinished
text: The SAFARI ZONE's expansion project\nis finished now.\pWe hope you will enjoy the new area.$

label: SafariZone_Southeast_Text_FatMan
text: The POKéMON in this area are all\nnew to me.\pAnd I'm allowed to catch these rare\nPOKéMON! Too cool!$

label: SafariZone_Southeast_Text_LittleGirl
text: Wow! Whee! I haven't seen any of\nthese POKéMON before!$

label: SafariZone_Southeast_Text_RichBoy
text: The POKéMON around here seem to be\nfrom somewhere other than HOENN.$

label: SafariZone_Southwest_Text_RestHouseSign
text: “Relieve your tired feet.”\nREST HOUSE$

label: SafariZone_Southwest_Text_Woman
text: Sometimes, when I toss a {POKEBLOCK} at \nPOKéMON, it gets ignored.\pDo POKéMON have likes and dislikes\nabout what they eat?$

label: SafariZone_Text_PlacePokeblockOnFeeder
text: Would you like to place a {POKEBLOCK}\non the {POKEBLOCK} FEEDER?$

label: SafariZone_Text_PokeblockStillHere
text: The {STR_VAR_1} you left\nbefore is still here.$

label: SafariZone_Text_PokeblockWasPlaced
text: The {STR_VAR_1} was placed\non the {POKEBLOCK} FEEDER.$

label: SafariZone_West_Text_AreaSign
text: AREA 3\nEAST: CENTER AREA$

label: SafariZone_West_Text_BaitMakesMonStickAround
text: Using BAIT will make POKéMON more\nlikely to stick around if they get\lbusy eating.$

label: SafariZone_West_Text_HikedLotsDidntSeeMonIWanted
text: I hiked a lot, but I didn't see any\nPOKéMON I wanted.$

label: SafariZone_West_Text_KogaPatrolsSafariEverySoOften
text:
The SAFARI ZONE's huge, wouldn't
you say?\pFUCHSIA's GYM LEADER, KOGA, 
patrols the grounds every so often.\pThanks to him, we can play here
knowing that we're safe.$

label: SafariZone_West_Text_PleaseFindWardensLostTeeth
text: REQUEST NOTICE\pPlease find the SAFARI WARDEN's\nlost GOLD TEETH.\lThey're around here somewhere.\pReward offered!\nContact: WARDEN$

label: SafariZone_West_Text_RestHouse
text: REST HOUSE$

label: SafariZone_West_Text_RocksMakeMonRunButEasierCatch
text: Tossing ROCKS at POKéMON might\nmake them run, but they'll be\leasier to catch.$

label: SafariZone_West_Text_SearchForSecretHouse
text: TRAINER TIPS\pZone Exploration Campaign!\nThe Search for the SECRET HOUSE!$

label: SaffronCity_CopycatsHouse_1F_Text_Chansey
text: CHANSEY: Chaan! Sii!$

label: SaffronCity_CopycatsHouse_1F_Text_DaughterIsSelfCentered
text: My daughter is so self-centered.\nShe has but a few friends.$

label: SaffronCity_CopycatsHouse_1F_Text_DaughterLikesToMimicPeople
text: My daughter likes to mimic people.\nIt's rather vexing.\pHer mimicry has earned her the\nnickname COPYCAT around here.$

label: SaffronCity_CopycatsHouse_2F_Text_Doduo
text: DODUO: Giiih!\pPRETTY MIRROR LOOK AT ME,\nSEE HOW PRETTY I CAN BE?$

label: SaffronCity_CopycatsHouse_2F_Text_MarioWearingABucket
text: A game with MARIO wearing a bucket\non his head!$

label: SaffronCity_CopycatsHouse_2F_Text_MimickingFavoriteHobbyFemale
text:
{PLAYER}: Hi.
You must like POKéMON.\p{PLAYER}: No, not me.
I asked you.\p{PLAYER}: Pardon?
You're weird!\l \lCOPYCAT: Hmm? Quit mimicking?\lBut that's my favorite hobby!$

label: SaffronCity_CopycatsHouse_2F_Text_MimickingFavoriteHobbyMale
text:
{PLAYER}: Hi!
Do you like POKéMON?\p{PLAYER}: Uh, no, I just asked you.\p{PLAYER}: Huh?
You're strange!\pCOPYCAT: Hmm? Quit mimicking?
But, that's my favorite hobby!$

label: SaffronCity_CopycatsHouse_2F_Text_MySecrets
text: …\pMy Secrets!\pSkill: Mimicry!\nHobby: Collecting dolls!\lFavorite POKéMON: CLEFAIRY!$

label: SaffronCity_CopycatsHouse_2F_Text_RareMonOnlyDoll
text: This is a rare POKéMON!\nHuh? It's only a doll!$

label: SaffronCity_Dojo_Text_AaronDefeat
text: Yow!\nStubbed fingers!$

label: SaffronCity_Dojo_Text_AaronIntro
text: Hiyah!\nI have no fear for anything tough!\pI shatter boulders for training\nevery day!$

label: SaffronCity_Dojo_Text_AaronPostBattle
text: The only thing that frightens us is\npsychic power!$

label: SaffronCity_Dojo_Text_BetterNotGetGreedy
text: Better not get greedy…$

label: SaffronCity_Dojo_Text_ChoosePrizedFightingMon
text: Indeed, I have lost!\pBut, I beseech you, do not take\nour emblem as your trophy!\pIn return, I will give you a prized\nFIGHTING POKéMON!\pChoose whichever one you like!$

label: SaffronCity_Dojo_Text_EnemiesOnEverySide
text: Enemies on every side!$

label: SaffronCity_Dojo_Text_FightingDojo
text: FIGHTING DOJO$

label: SaffronCity_Dojo_Text_GoesAroundComesAround
text: What goes around comes around.$

label: SaffronCity_Dojo_Text_HidekiDefeat
text: Judge!\nOne point!$

label: SaffronCity_Dojo_Text_HidekiIntro
text: I hear you're good!\nShow me!$

label: SaffronCity_Dojo_Text_HidekiPostBattle
text: Our MASTER is a pro fighter.\nBe prepared to lose!$

label: SaffronCity_Dojo_Text_HitoshiDefeat
text: Oof!\nI give up!$

label: SaffronCity_Dojo_Text_HitoshiIntro
text: Hwaah!\pYou're trespassing in our\nFIGHTING DOJO!$

label: SaffronCity_Dojo_Text_HitoshiPostBattle
text: The prime fighters across the land\ntrain here.$

label: SaffronCity_Dojo_Text_MasterKoichiDefeat
text: Hwa!\nArrgh! Beaten!$

label: SaffronCity_Dojo_Text_MasterKoichiIntro
text: Grunt!\pI am the KARATE MASTER!\nI am the LEADER here!\pYou wish to challenge us?\nExpect no mercy!\pFwaaa!$

label: SaffronCity_Dojo_Text_MikeDefeat
text: I give up!$

label: SaffronCity_Dojo_Text_MikeIntro
text: Hoargh!\nTake your shoes off!$

label: SaffronCity_Dojo_Text_MikePostBattle
text: You wait 'til you see our MASTER!\nI'm a small fry compared to him!$

label: SaffronCity_Dojo_Text_ReceivedMonFromKarateMaster
text: {PLAYER} received the {STR_VAR_1}\nfrom the KARATE MASTER.$

label: SaffronCity_Dojo_Text_StayAndTrainWithUs
text: Grunt!\nStay and train at karate with us!$

label: SaffronCity_Dojo_Text_YouWantHitmonchan
text: You want the piston-punching\nHITMONCHAN?$

label: SaffronCity_Dojo_Text_YouWantHitmonlee
text: You want the hard-kicking\nHITMONLEE?$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_AmandaDefeat
text: Not good enough!$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_AmandaIntro
text: SABRINA is far younger than I,\nbut she has earned my respect.$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_AmandaPostBattle
text: In a battle of equals, the one\nwith the stronger will wins.\pIf you wish to beat SABRINA, focus\nand will yourself to victory.$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_BagFullOfOtherItems
text: Your BAG is full of other items.$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_CameronDefeat
text: Ow!\nDown and out!$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_CameronIntro
text: SABRINA is young, but she's also\nour highly skilled LEADER.\pYou won't reach her easily!$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_CameronPostBattle
text:
There used to be two POKéMON GYMS
in SAFFRON.\pThe FIGHTING DOJO next door lost
its GYM status, though.\pWe simply creamed them when we
decided to have just one GYM.$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_ExplainMarshBadgeTakeThis
text:
The MARSHBADGE makes POKéMON up
to Lv. 70 obey you.\pStronger POKéMON will become wild,
ignoring your orders in battle.\pJust don't raise your POKéMON too
much to avoid that problem.\pWait, please take this TM with you.$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_ExplainTM04
text: TM04 is CALM MIND.\pIt makes the POKéMON concentrate\nto raise both SP. ATK and SP. DEF.$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_GymGuyAdvice
text:
Yo!
Champ in the making!\pSABRINA's POKéMON use psychic
power instead of force.\pFIGHTING POKéMON are especially
