weak against PSYCHIC POKéMON.\pThey'll get destroyed before they
can even aim a punch!$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_GymGuyPostVictory
text: Psychic power, huh?\pIf I had that, I'd make a bundle\nat the slots!$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_GymStatue
text: SAFFRON POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: SABRINA\pWINNING TRAINERS:\n{RIVAL}$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_GymStatuePlayerWon
text: SAFFRON POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: SABRINA\pWINNING TRAINERS:\n{RIVAL}, {PLAYER}$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_JohanDefeat
text: I never foresaw this!$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_JohanIntro
text: Does our unseen power scare you?$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_JohanPostBattle
text: PSYCHIC POKéMON fear only ghosts\nand bugs!$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_PrestonDefeat
text: Arrrgh!$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_PrestonIntro
text: SAFFRON POKéMON GYM is famous for\ntraining psychics.\pYou want to see SABRINA, don't\nyou? I can tell!$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_PrestonPostBattle
text: That's right! I used telepathy to\nread your mind!$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_ReceivedTM04FromSabrina
text: {PLAYER} received TM04 from\nSABRINA.$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_SabrinaDefeat
text:
This loss shocks me!
But, a loss is a loss.\pI admit, I didn't work hard enough
to win.\pYour victory has earned you the
MARSHBADGE.$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_SabrinaIntro
text:
I had a vision of your arrival.\pI have had psychic powers since
I was a child.\pIt started when a spoon I
carelessly tossed, bent.\pI dislike battling, but if you wish,
I will show you my powers!{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_RG_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_SabrinaPostBattle
text: Psychic power isn't something that\nonly a few people have.\pEveryone has psychic power.\nPeople just don't realize it.$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_StacyDefeat
text: I knew it!$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_StacyIntro
text: POKéMON take on the appearance of\ntheir TRAINERS.\pYour POKéMON must be tough, then!$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_StacyPostBattle
text: I have much to learn still…\pI must master PSYCHIC and teach it\nto my POKéMON…$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_TashaDefeat
text: I lost after all!$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_TashaIntro
text: You and I, our POKéMON shall\nbattle!$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_TashaPostBattle
text: I knew that this was going to take\nplace.$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_TyronDefeat
text: I don't believe this!$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_TyronIntro
text: You understand, don't you?\pThat power alone isn't enough to\nwin in the world of POKéMON?$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_TyronPostBattle
text: SABRINA just wiped out the KARATE\nMASTER next door.$

label: SaffronCity_House_Text_DontLookAtMyLetter
text: …Thank you for writing.\nI hope to see you soon!\p…Hey!\nDon't look at my letter!$

label: SaffronCity_House_Text_ExplainPPUp
text: I was given a PP UP as a gift.\pIt's used to increase the PP of\na POKéMON's move.\pI should use it on a powerful move\nwith only a few PP.$

label: SaffronCity_House_Text_GettingCopycatPokeDoll
text: The COPYCAT is cute!\nI'm getting her a POKé DOLL.$

label: SaffronCity_House_Text_Pidgey
text: PIDGEY: Kurukkoo!$

label: SaffronCity_Mart_Text_MaxRepelMoreEffectiveThanSuper
text: MAX REPEL keeps weaker POKéMON\nfrom appearing.\pMAX REPEL stays effective longer\nthan SUPER REPEL.$

label: SaffronCity_Mart_Text_ReviveIsCostly
text: REVIVE is costly, but it revives\nfainted POKéMON!$

label: SaffronCity_MrPsychicsHouse_Text_ExplainTM29
text: You already know, don't you?\nTM29 is PSYCHIC.\pIt's an attack that may also lower\nthe target's special stats.$

label: SaffronCity_MrPsychicsHouse_Text_ReceivedTM29FromMrPsychic
text: {PLAYER} received TM29\nfrom MR. PSYCHIC.$

label: SaffronCity_MrPsychicsHouse_Text_YouWantedThis
text: …Wait! Don't say a word!\pYou wanted this!$

label: SaffronCity_MrPsychicsHouse_Text_YouveNoRoom
text: Where do you plan to put this?\nYou've no room.$

label: SaffronCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_GreatIfEliteFourCameBeatRockets
text: Sigh…\nWouldn't this be great?\pIf the ELITE FOUR came and\nstomped TEAM ROCKET?$

label: SaffronCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_GrowthRatesDifferBySpecies
text: POKéMON growth rates differ from\nspecies to species.$

label: SaffronCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_SilphCoVictimOfFame
text: SILPH CO. is widely known to all.\pIt's a victim of its own fame - it\nattracted TEAM ROCKET.$

label: SaffronCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_TeamRocketTookOff
text: TEAM ROCKET took off!\nWe can go out safely again!\lThat's great!$

label: SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_AdoreWayYouBattle
text:
Oh, my goodness!
Is it really you, {PLAYER}?\pI have to tell you, I adore the
way you battle.\pI hope you'll keep at it.
I'll be your number one fan!$

label: SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_AlwaysCheerForYou
text: I'll always be cheering for you!\pGo, {PLAYER}, go!$

label: SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_BelieveInMasterWithAllMyHeart
text:
I believe in Master {STR_VAR_1}
with all my heart.\pEven if I am the only one to
believe in him.\pI won't ever feel lonesome, though.\pNot if I keep thinking about Master
{STR_VAR_1}.$

label: SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_BrocksFanToBitterEnd
text: …  …\p…  …\nI'm BROCK's fan!\pEven if I were his only fan,\nI swear it on my rock-hard will,\land on my shorts!\pI'll be his fan to the bitter end!$

label: SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_BrocksLastWordOnCool
text: BROCK's the last word on cool,\nend of story!\pNow there's a guy who I want to\nbe like!$

label: SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_BrocksMyHero
text:
BROCK's my hero!
He's a man among men!\pHeheh, I got my mom to do
something for me.\pI got her to embroider “BROCK”
on my shorts!$

label: SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_CanIBecomeCoolTrainerOneDay
text: I wonder if I can become a cool\nTRAINER one day?$

label: SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_CanYouAutographShorts
text:
Oh! It's {PLAYER}!
Too cool!\pOh!
Oh, yeah!\pCan you autograph something?
How about my shorts?$

label: SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_CountingOnYou
text:
However hot it's been…\pAnd however cold it may get…\pI've always believed in, and worn,
shorts!\pI'm counting on you to keep
winning!\pI believe in you just as much as
I believe in shorts!$

label: SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_EveryoneButMeStoppedBeingYourFan
text:
Everyone stopped being {PLAYER}'s
fan…\pBut that means I can have {PLAYER}
all to myself!\pYay! Go for it!
My one and only {PLAYER}!$

label: SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_EveryoneTalksAboutYou
text:
Oh, hello!
If it isn't {PLAYER}!\pLately, all everyone talks about
is you.\pI'm feeling lonesome because I
prefer {STR_VAR_1}.$

label: SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_EveryonesYourFanButICantBe
text:
Oh!
{PLAYER}!\pEveryone's been all excited about
you recently.\pI can understand why.
I know that you're strong.\pBut, do you know what?\pOnce I became {STR_VAR_1}'s fan,
I can't just stop being a fan.$

label: SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_HadPleasureOfWatchingYouBattle
text:
{PLAYER}, I've had the pleasure of
watching you battle.\pIt brings back sweet memories of
my own long-lost youth.\pMay you continue to find success.
You have a fan in me!$

label: SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_HmmAndYouAre
text: Hmm…\nAnd you are?\pWere you hoping to sign up for\na membership in our FAN CLUB?$

label: SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_HuhYou
text: Huh?\nYou…$

label: SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_IllAlwaysBelieveInYou
text: I'll always believe in you,\n{PLAYER}.\pPlease show the others what you're\nlike when you battle seriously.$

label: SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_ImLoneTrainerFan
text:
Huh, can you believe it?
Everyone turned into your fans.\pSo after all we've been through,
I'm the lone {STR_VAR_1} fan?\pEh, being the one and only
{STR_VAR_1} fan's my style, anyway.$

label: SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_ImOnlyOneLeftOfYourFans
text: Yo, {PLAYER}!\pLooks like I'm the only one left\nout of your fans.\pBut, you know, I like being an only\nfan… It's less stressful.\pKeep up and at it!$

label: SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_ImYourNumberOneFan
text:
Oh, my goodness!
If it isn't {PLAYER}!\pIt's so disappointing… I realized
I'm your number-one-and-only fan!\pWell, it can't be helped!
Let me cheer you on, at least!\pHurray, hurray, {PLAYER}!$

label: SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_ImYourOnlyFan
text: I'm your only fan…\nSigh… This is lonely…\pCan't you try harder and make the\nothers take notice of you?$

label: SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_LoveWayTrainerTalks
text: {STR_VAR_1}'s cool, huh?\nI love the way he talks.\pI'd really relish a chance to meet\nhim in person once.$

label: SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_NeverBeFanOfAnyoneButMaster
text:
Hiyah! I respect my MASTER at the
FIGHTING DOJO.\pI will never become a fan of
anyone other than my MASTER!\pI will even sneak out of the DOJO
to spread word of his greatness.\pHiyah!$

label: SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_NeverSeenTrainerOfYourMagnificence
text:
I have journeyed far and wide
across the lands.\pBut never have I seen a TRAINER
of your magnificence.\pTake courage in your abilities
and keep battling on!\pMake that a promise to me,
my young idol!$

label: SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_OnlyMasterHasMyRespect
text:
Hiyah! There is but one TRAINER
who has my respect.\pAnd that is none other than my
MASTER at the FIGHTING DOJO.\pYou should become a fan of my
MASTER like me! Hiyah!$

label: SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_TheWayYouBattleIsCool
text:
Oh, man, oh, man!
Cool! Too cool!\p…Huh?
No, not you.\pJust the way you battle.
That's cool.$

label: SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_TrainerHasBeenOnFire
text: Recently, {STR_VAR_1} has been on\nfire.\pThe way he battles… It's just \nthe way that I like it!$

label: SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_TrainersCoolWhenBattling
text: I think TRAINERS are so cool when\nthey're battling.\pDon't you think so, too?$

label: SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_WantToBeLikeSabrina
text: Do you know what?\nI want to be like SABRINA!\pI want to be a psychic girl just\nlike her!$

label: SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_WantToBeLikeYouOneDay
text: It's {PLAYER}!\nIt's {PLAYER}!\pI want to be like {PLAYER} one day!$

label: SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_WasYourFanNotAnymore
text:
I'm sorry.
I was your fan before.\pBut now, you seem to have lost
the drive you had before.\pLately, I think {STR_VAR_1} has been
a lot cooler.$

label: SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_WhyCantOthersSeeMastersDignity
text: Master {STR_VAR_1} is so dignified…\nHe is so my type.\pWhy can't the others see the\ndignity he simply oozes?$

label: SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_WontStopBeingSabrinasFan
text:
Even if I'm the only one, I won't
stop being SABRINA's fan.\pMy dream is to be like SABRINA,
cute, but cool.\pI want to be a psychic girl just
like her!$

label: SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_WontStopBeingYourFan
text:
Instead of just watching others
battle, battle yourself!\p…My DOJO's MASTER chewed me out
like that…\pBut I won't let that stop me from
being your fan!\pI can't stop being your fan!$

label: SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_YouReallyAreAmazing
text: Amazing!\n{PLAYER}, you really are amazing!\pInstead of just watching, maybe\nI should become a TRAINER, too.$

label: SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_YoullBeTalkedAboutIfYouKeepWinning
text:
All of us gathered here are fans
of POKéMON TRAINERS.\pThe way they look in battle…
They are the picture of coolness.\pPerhaps you will be talked about
here, too, if you keep winning.$

label: SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_YourBattleStyleIsEducational
text: Hiyah!\pYour battling style is most\neducational.\pI hope that you will keep plugging\naway at success, hiyah!$

label: SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_YourePlayerWereYourFansNow
text:
Are you maybe…
… …\pYou are!
You are {PLAYER}!\pWe were just talking about you!\pWe were talking about how an
incredibly good TRAINER appeared.\pAnd that someone is you!
You're so cool!\pSo, we decided that we'll become
your FAN CLUB!\pWe all hope you'll keep battling
and show us how cool you are.\pThat way, maybe other people will
become fans just like me.$

label: SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_YouveStillAWaysToGo
text:
Ah, so you are the much-
talked-about {PLAYER}.\pYou certainly do have the look of
a winner.\pBut for me to accept you as
a true POKéMON great…\p… …\pYou've still a ways to go!$

label: SaffronCity_Text_BossTakeTownForTeamRocket
text: BOSS said he'll take this town\nin the name of TEAM ROCKET!$

label: SaffronCity_Text_CitySign
text: SAFFRON CITY\nShining, Golden Land of Commerce$

label: SaffronCity_Text_CriminalLifeMakesMeFeelAlive
text: My life as a criminal makes me feel\nso alive!$

label: SaffronCity_Text_DontGetDefiantOrIllHurtYou
text: Don't get defiant!\nOr I'll have to hurt you!$

label: SaffronCity_Text_FightingDojo
text: FIGHTING DOJO$

label: SaffronCity_Text_FlewHereOnPidgeot
text: I flew here on my PIDGEOT when\nI read about SILPH.\pIt's already over?\nI missed the media action…$

label: SaffronCity_Text_FullHealCuresStatus
text: TRAINER TIPS\pFULL HEAL cures all ailments like\nburns, paralysis, poisoning,\lfreezing, and sleep.\pIt costs a bit more, but it's more\nconvenient than buying other items.$

label: SaffronCity_Text_GreatBallImprovedCatchRate
text: TRAINER TIPS\pThe new GREAT BALL offers improved\ncatching rates.\pTry it on those hard-to-catch\nPOKéMON.$

label: SaffronCity_Text_GymSign
text: SAFFRON CITY POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: SABRINA\lThe Master of PSYCHIC POKéMON!$

label: SaffronCity_Text_HesTakingASnooze
text: …\nSnore…\pHah! He's taking a snooze!$

label: SaffronCity_Text_HowCanClubNotRecognizeLance
text:
This FAN CLUB…
No one here has a clue!\pHow could they not recognize
the brilliance that is LANCE?\pHe stands for justice!
He's cool, and yet passionate!\lHe's the greatest, LANCE!$

label: SaffronCity_Text_ImASecurityGuard
text: I'm a security guard.\pSuspicious kids I don't allow in!$

label: SaffronCity_Text_MrPsychicsHouse
text: MR. PSYCHIC'S HOUSE$

label: SaffronCity_Text_PeopleComingBackToSaffron
text: People fled from here in droves\nwhen those ROCKETS came.\pThey should be flocking back to\nSAFFRON now.$

label: SaffronCity_Text_Pidgeot
text: PIDGEOT: Bi bibii!$

label: SaffronCity_Text_SafeToGoOutAgain
text: Yeah! TEAM ROCKET is gone!\nIt's safe to go out again!$

label: SaffronCity_Text_SaffronBelongsToTeamRocket
text: SAFFRON belongs to TEAM ROCKET!$

label: SaffronCity_Text_SawRocketBossEscaping
text: I saw the ROCKET BOSS escaping\nSILPH's building.$

label: SaffronCity_Text_SilphCoSign
text: SILPH CO. OFFICE BUILDING$

label: SaffronCity_Text_SilphsLatestProduct
text: SILPH's latest product!\nRelease to be determined…$

label: SaffronCity_Text_TrainerFanClubSign
text: POKéMON TRAINER FAN CLUB\pMany TRAINERS have scribbled their\nnames on this sign.$

label: SaffronCity_Text_WatchWhereYoureWalking
text: Ow!\nWatch where you're walking!$

label: SaffronCity_Text_WeCanExploitMonsAroundWorld
text: With SILPH under control, we can\nexploit POKéMON around the world!\pWe'll get stinking rich, yeahah!$

label: SaffronCity_Text_WhatDoYouWantGetLost
text: What do you want?\nGet lost!$

label: SaffronCity_Text_YouBeatTeamRocket
text: You beat TEAM ROCKET all alone?\nThat's amazing!$

label: SeafloorCavern_Entrance_Text_HearMagmaNearMossdeep
text:
Hey!
I remember your face!\pIf you're here, it must mean that
you're about to mess with us again!\pA punk like you, do you really think
you can take on TEAM AQUA?\pI'd say you're too early by about
a trillion years!\pYou're a perfect fit for the likes of
TEAM MAGMA!\pSpeaking of TEAM MAGMA, I hear they
were spotted near MOSSDEEP.\pThat bunch of goons, they sure don't
look good near the sea!$

label: SeafloorCavern_Entrance_Text_HearMagmaNearMossdeepShort
text:
A punk like you, do you really think
you can take on TEAM AQUA?\pI'd say you're too early by about
a trillion years!\pYou're a perfect fit for the likes of
TEAM MAGMA!\pSpeaking of TEAM MAGMA, I hear they
were spotted near MOSSDEEP.\pThat bunch of goons, they sure don't
look good near the sea!$

label: SeafloorCavern_Room1_Text_Grunt1Defeat
text: I want to go home…$

label: SeafloorCavern_Room1_Text_Grunt1Intro
text: We don't need a kid around!\nGo on home already!$

label: SeafloorCavern_Room1_Text_Grunt1PostBattle
text: I want to get a promotion so I can\nboss around the GRUNTS…$

label: SeafloorCavern_Room1_Text_Grunt2Defeat
text: Losing makes me sore!$

label: SeafloorCavern_Room1_Text_Grunt2Intro
text: That submarine… It's tiny inside.\nI'm sore all over!$

label: SeafloorCavern_Room1_Text_Grunt2PostBattle
text: That submarine we jacked, man,\nit's brutal as a ride.\lIt's way too tight in there!$

label: SeafloorCavern_Room3_Text_Grunt5Defeat
text: Gwah!$

label: SeafloorCavern_Room3_Text_Grunt5Intro
text:
For our dream to become real, we need
the power of POKéMON.\pBut meddlers like you use the power of
POKéMON to mess with us even at\la place like this!\pLife just doesn't work the way we
need it to!$

label: SeafloorCavern_Room3_Text_Grunt5PostBattle
text:
You know, we don't dare question
the motives of our leader.\pBut here you are, just some punk,
going up against our BOSS.\pMaybe…
You must be something…$

label: SeafloorCavern_Room3_Text_ShellyDefeat
text: Ahahahaha!\pOuch!$

label: SeafloorCavern_Room3_Text_ShellyIntro
text:
Ahahahaha!\pHow did you manage to get here without
a submarine?\lWhat an impressive child!\pBut… It won't do to have you
meddling about here.\pAnd, I do want payback for what
happened at the WEATHER INSTITUTE…\pI'm going to give you a little taste
of pain! Resign yourself to it!$

label: SeafloorCavern_Room3_Text_ShellyPostBattle
text:
Ahahahaha!
You're so darn strong.\pIt's terribly disappointing that you're
not a TEAM AQUA member.\pYou could have enjoyed the fabulous
world our BOSS has promised as\lone of us…$

label: SeafloorCavern_Room4_Text_Grunt3Defeat
text: Lost it…$

label: SeafloorCavern_Room4_Text_Grunt3Intro
text: Who are you?\nWhere did you come in from?$

label: SeafloorCavern_Room4_Text_Grunt3PostBattle
text: I can't find the way out!\pI'm not afraid. Don't get me wrong!$

label: SeafloorCavern_Room4_Text_Grunt4Defeat
text: I failed to win!$

label: SeafloorCavern_Room4_Text_Grunt4Intro
text: Who are you?\nWhere do you think you're going?$

label: SeafloorCavern_Room4_Text_Grunt4PostBattle
text: My partner forgot the map in that\nsubmarine!\pHow's that for being useless?$

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieAMessageFromOutside
text: ARCHIE: Hm? It's a message from our\nmembers outside…$

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieBeholdKyogre
text: ARCHIE: Behold!\pSee how beautiful it is, the sleeping\nform of the ancient POKéMON KYOGRE!\pI have waited so long for this day to\ncome…$

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieDefeat
text: What?!\nI lost to a mere child like you?!$

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieDontGetAllHighAndMighty
text:
ARCHIE: W-what?!
Don't get all high and mighty with me!\pWasn't it you, TEAM MAGMA, that
infuriated GROUDON?\pSo long as I have this RED ORB,
I should be able to control KYOGRE…\pI should be able to control it…$

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieHoldItRightThere
text: ARCHIE: Hold it right there.$

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieSoItWasYou
text: ARCHIE: Fufufu…\nSo it was you, after all.$

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieWhatRainingTooHard
text:
ARCHIE: Yes, what is it?\pHm…
It's raining heavily?\pGood… That should have happened.
That is why we awakened KYOGRE,\lto realize TEAM AQUA's vision of\lexpanding the sea.\pWhat?!\pIt's raining far harder than we
envisioned? You're in danger?\pThat can't be…
That's just not possible…\pHold your position and monitor
the situation!$

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieWhereDidKyogreGo
text: ARCHIE: What?!\pI didn't do anything.\nWhy did the RED ORB…\pWhere did KYOGRE go?$

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieWhyDidKyogreDisappear
text: ARCHIE: There's something wrong…\pThe RED ORB is supposed to awaken\nand control KYOGRE…\pBut… Why?\nWhy did KYOGRE disappear?\pWhy?!$

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieWithThisRedOrb
text: ARCHIE: Fufufu…\pI commend you. I must recognize that\nyou are truly gifted.\pBut!\nI have this in my possession!\pWith this RED ORB, I can make KYOGRE…$

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieYouMustDisappear
text: ARCHIE: It surprises me, how you've\nmanaged to chase me here.\pBut that's all over now.\pFor the realization of my dream,\nyou must disappear now!$

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_MaxieComeOnPlayer
text: MAXIE: {PLAYER}, come on, you have\nto get out of here, too!$

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_MaxieWeDontHaveTimeToArgue
text: MAXIE: We don't have the time to\nargue about it here!\pGet outside and see for yourself!\pSee if what you've wrought is the\nworld that we desired!$

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_MaxieWhatHaveYouWrought
text:
MAXIE: What have you wrought?\pARCHIE… You've finally awoken KYOGRE,
haven't you?\pWhat will happen to the world if this
downpour continues for all eternity?\pThe world's landmass will drown in
the deepening sea…$

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_RedOrbShinesByItself
text: The RED ORB suddenly began shining\nby itself!$

text: Hint: Boulders might change the\nflow of water.$

label: SecretBase_Text_RegistryInfo
text:
Once registered, a SECRET BASE will not
disappear unless the other TRAINER\lmoves it to a different location.\pIf a SECRET BASE is deleted from the
registered list, another one may take\lits place.\pUp to ten SECRET BASE locations
may be registered.$

text: What do you think of my SECRET BASE?\nCome visit me again tomorrow.$

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer0PreChampion
text: Have you made a SECRET BASE already?\pI went here, there, everywhere before\nchoosing this place.\pFeel free to hang out!$

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer1AcceptBattle
text: Okay!\nI'm going to defend my SECRET BASE!$

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer1DeclineBattle
text: Hunh? Is that right?\nYou're not interested in this spot?$

text:
This is a popular spot.
It's always taken.\pOh! Were you thinking about
taking this spot, too?\pI'll tell you what, you can have this
spot if you can beat me.$

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer1PostBattle
text: Okay, when I move one day,\nthis place will be yours!$

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer1PreChampion
text: This is a popular spot.\nIt's always taken.\pI waited a long time for it to open.\nI finally got to use it!$

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer2AcceptBattle
text: That's the way!$

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer2DeclineBattle
text: When you're ready, give me a shout!$

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer2Intro
text: A big mansion is nice, but I like this\nsort of place more.\pI like it because all kinds of people\ncome visit me.\pSo, how would you like a battle?$

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer2PostBattle
text: Well, anyway, I should go buy some\ndecorations and furniture.\pI want my SECRET BASE to be a place\nother people can enjoy.$

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer2PreChampion
text: A big mansion is nice, but I like this\nsort of place more.\pI like it because all kinds of people\ncome visit me.$

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer3AcceptBattle
text: I'm not going down easily!$

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer3DeclineBattle
text: Oh… Are you maybe tired from searching\nfor this place?$

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer3Intro
text: Some people make their SECRET BASES in\nhard-to-find places.\lDo they want to just lie low?\pBut since you found me, how about we\nhave a battle?$

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer3PostBattle
text: Where's your SECRET BASE?\nI should go visit you there.$

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer3PreChampion
text: Some people make their SECRET BASES in\nhard-to-find places.\lDo they want to just lie low?$

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer4AcceptBattle
text: Show me what you're made of!$

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer4DeclineBattle
text: I guess there are times when you're not\ninto it.$

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer4Intro
text:
I found a spot I liked, and I did it up
with my favorite decorations.\pI raise my favorite POKéMON and grow
stronger with it.\pThat's what I do.
Want to battle with me?$

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer4PostBattle

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer4PreChampion
text: I found a spot I liked, and I did it up\nwith my favorite decorations.\pI raise my favorite POKéMON and grow\nstronger with it.\pEvery day is a great day.$

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer5AcceptBattle

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer5DeclineBattle

text: There're a lot of places where\nyou can make a SECRET BASE.\pBut I like this spot best.\nDon't you think it's nice?\pOh, would you like to have a battle?$

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer5PostBattle

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer5PreChampion
text: There're a lot of places where you can\nmake a SECRET BASE.\pBut I like this spot best.\nDon't you think it's nice?$

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer6AcceptBattle
text: I'm going to go all out!$

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer6DeclineBattle
text: Oh.\nSome other time, then!$

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer6PostBattle

I simply adore shopping for decorations
and furniture.\pI also love raising POKéMON just
as much.\pIf you would be so kind, will you battle
with my POKéMON?$

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer7PostBattle
text: That was all in good fun!\nI should go enjoy shopping now.$

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer7PreChampion
text: I simply adore shopping for decorations\nand furniture.\pI also love raising POKéMON just\nas much.$

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer8AcceptBattle
text: This is my SECRET BASE.\nI can't lose!$

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer8DeclineBattle

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer8PostBattle
text: I won't lose at collecting decorations.\nCome visit again!$

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer8PreChampion
text: People have told me that you can get\ndecorations in several ways.\pWe should have a race to see who can\nget nicer decorations and furniture!$

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer9AcceptBattle
text: There's no holding back!$

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer9DeclineBattle
text: I'll be happy to demonstrate my style\nanytime.$

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer9Intro
text: You can learn a lot about the taste\nand sense of people by the kinds of\ldecorations they have, and how they\ldisplay them.\pWhat do you think of my taste?\nAre you speechless?\pWant to see my taste in battling?$

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer9PostBattle

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer9PreChampion
text: You can learn a lot about the taste\nand sense of people by the kinds of\ldecorations they have, and how they\ldisplay them.\pWhat do you think of my taste?\nAre you speechless?$

label: SevenIsland_House_Room1_Text_AstoundingBattle
text:
Bravo!\pBravo, indeed!
What an astounding battle!\pIt was so astounding, why, it keeps
filling my eyes with tears!\pThe thrust and parry of expertly
used techniques!\pThe clash of power upon power!\pYes!
It was sheer magnificence!$

label: SevenIsland_House_Room1_Text_ChallengeVisitingTrainer
text:
Ah!
Welcome, my friend!\pLet me tell you something. There's
a hidden room in the basement.\pA TRAINER named {STR_VAR_1} is
waiting there now.\pTell me, you did come to challenge
{STR_VAR_1}, am I right?$

label: SevenIsland_House_Room1_Text_DontHoldAnythingBack
text: All right.\nDon't hold anything back!$

label: SevenIsland_House_Room1_Text_DrawWasIt
text: A draw, was it?\pHowever, let me say that it was\na worthy spectacle.\pI'd say it was a wonderful battle\nwith a real sense of depth!$

label: SevenIsland_House_Room1_Text_FeelYourDisappointment
text:
Too bad!
I feel your disappointment.\pHowever, that disappointment is
what will make you better.\pUse it, learn from it, and make it
motivate you to seek greatness.\pForget not this disappointment
and redouble your training!$

label: SevenIsland_House_Room1_Text_LimitThreeMonsPerSide
text:
Ah!
You will battle for me?\pIt was worth my time moving the
box aside, then.\p… …
But there is one slight problem.\pThis hidden room is not built very
sturdy.\pCan I get you to limit it to
battles of three POKéMON per side?$

label: SevenIsland_House_Room1_Text_OhYouWontBattle
text:
Oh…
You won't battle…\pI see, I see.
… …\pWell, perhaps if you change your
mind, do come back.$

label: SevenIsland_House_Room1_Text_OnlyEnjoymentWatchingBattles
text:
I may not look like much now,
but when I was younger…\pI flew everywhere, challenging
TRAINERS wherever I found them.\pNow, my only source of enjoyment
is reminiscing about the past while\lwatching battles.$

label: SevenIsland_House_Room1_Text_SaveProgressBeforeBattle
text: Fine! Before your battle, would\nyou like to save your game?$

label: SevenIsland_House_Room1_Text_SlightBreezeAroundBox
text: There is a slight breeze blowing\naround the box.$

label: SevenIsland_House_Room2_Text_MatchEndedUpDraw
text: The match ended up a draw.$

label: SevenIsland_Mart_Text_MonHavePersonalitiesOfTheirOwn
text: POKéMON have personalities of their\nown, just like people.\pMy PIKACHU has a HASTY nature,\nso it grew to be a speedy POKéMON.$

label: SevenIsland_Mart_Text_NeedToFishOnSevenIsland
text: I need to fish on SEVEN ISLAND.\pThat will complete my fishing tour\nof the SEVII ISLANDS.\pI'd better stock up on some\nPOKé BALLS first, though.$

label: SevenIsland_Mart_Text_PreparationsCompleteForRuins
text: Okay, preparations are complete\nfor me to explore the RUINS.$

label: SevenIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_CheckOutTrainerTower
text: If you're confident, you should\ncheck out TRAINER TOWER.$

label: SevenIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_DidYouRideSeagallopHere
text:
Did you ride a SEAGALLOP ferry
to get here?\pThere are at least ten of those
high-speed ships.\pI don't know where they all go,
though.$

label: SevenIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_EventsDependingOnConnections
text: On this island, different events\noccur depending on connections.\pWhat are those connections?\pThey are for you to discover on\nyour own.$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Entrance_Text_EveDefeat
text: EVE: Me and JON, we lost.\nEhehe.$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Entrance_Text_EveIntro
text: EVE: I'll team up with JON and\nbattle together.$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Entrance_Text_EveNotEnoughMons
text: EVE: I want to team up with JON\nwhen I battle you.\pCome back with two POKéMON, okay?$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Entrance_Text_EvePostBattle
text: EVE: I'm going to work harder with\nJON.$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Entrance_Text_EveRematchIntro
text: EVE: I'll team up with JON and\nbattle together again.$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Entrance_Text_JonDefeat
text: JON: When I'm with EVE,\nit doesn't feel like I've lost!$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Entrance_Text_JonIntro
text: JON: When I'm with EVE, it feels\nlike we could never lose.$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Entrance_Text_JonNotEnoughMons
text: JON: If it's with EVE, I'll be\nhappy to battle with you.\pSo, I'd like to make it a\ntwo-on-two battle, if I may.$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Entrance_Text_JonPostBattle
text: JON: When I'm with EVE, I feel\ngiddy whether I win or lose.\pIt's magical!$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Entrance_Text_JonRematchIntro
text: JON: When I'm with EVE, it feels\nlike we could never lose, not ever.$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Entrance_Text_MadelineDefeat
text: You don't seem to be a problem\nTRAINER.$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Entrance_Text_MadelineIntro
text: I punish people who abuse\nPOKéMON!$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Entrance_Text_MadelinePostBattle
text: If you treat your POKéMON with\nkindness, they'll understand.$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Entrance_Text_MadelineRematchIntro
text: I don't forgive people who abuse\nPOKéMON!$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Entrance_Text_MasonDefeat
text: Oh, so you're not a fan…\pWell, I can change that.\nLet me sing for you!$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Entrance_Text_MasonIntro
text: Howdy!\nAre you a member of my fan club?$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Entrance_Text_MasonPostBattle
text: Lalalah…\nMy POKéMON, I send them out,\lall the girls scream and shout!$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Entrance_Text_MasonRematchIntro
text: Howdy! You're a member of my\nfan club, isn't that right?$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Entrance_Text_MiahDefeat
text: Tch!\nToo strong for me!$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Entrance_Text_MiahIntro
text: Kyahaha!\nI'll flick you away effortlessly!$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Entrance_Text_MiahPostBattle
text: What's that?\nI don't act the way I look?\pHeh, that's a part of my strategy!$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Entrance_Text_MiahRematchIntro
text: Kyahaha!\pComing back won't change a thing.\nI'll flick you away effortlessly!$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Entrance_Text_NicolasDefeat
text: Uh-huh…$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Entrance_Text_NicolasIntro
text: This island is too spread out…\nIt's not easy patrolling the place.$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Entrance_Text_NicolasPostBattle
text: TRAINERS like you from cities,\nthey sure are tough.\pYou'll be headed for the TOWER,\nwon't you?$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Entrance_Text_NicolasRematchIntro
text: This island is too spread out…\nPatrolling the place is a drag…$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Entrance_Text_RouteSign
text: SEVAULT CANYON ENTRANCE\pTRAINERS are asked to refrain from\ndamaging plants in the CANYON.$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_House_Text_Chansey
text: CHANSEY: Chansi! Chansi!$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_House_Text_ChanseyDanceJoinIn
text: Dance, dance!\nCHANSEY Dance!\pYou join in, too!\nDance, dance!$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_House_Text_ComeOnDance
text: Come on, dance!$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_House_Text_DancedChanseyDance
text: {PLAYER} danced the CHANSEY Dance!$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_House_Text_WouldYouLikeToDance
text: Would you like to dance?$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_House_Text_YoureAllChipperNow
text: Ahahahaha!\pThere, you're all chipper now!\nLucky!$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_TanobyKey_Text_MysteriousRumbleFarAway
text: A mysterious rumble echoed\nsomewhere far away.$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_BrunoTrainedWithBrawly
text:
Training by oneself is certainly
not a bad thing.\pBut it's also not bad to aim for
the top with a partner.\pEven BRUNO…
He trained with a fellow by the\lname of BRAWLY before.$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_CyndyDefeat
text: Huh?\nSomething's not right…$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_CyndyIntro
text: My conditioning's in top form!$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_CyndyPostBattle
text: The way I am now, I may have to\nhold off on TRAINER TOWER…$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_CyndyRematchIntro
text: Let's have another battle.\nMy conditioning's in top form!$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_EvanDefeat
text: You're a master at this.$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_EvanIntro
text: It doesn't matter if you happen to\nhave the strongest POKéMON…\pIt doesn't mean a thing if you don't\nknow how to use them properly!$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_EvanPostBattle
text: You see them every so often,\nTRAINERS with awesome POKéMON\lwho have no idea what to do.\pBefore training POKéMON, TRAINERS\nthemselves need to grow up.$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_EvanRematchIntro
text: It doesn't matter if you happen to\nhave the strongest POKéMON…\pIt doesn't mean a thing if you don't\nknow how to use them properly!$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_JacksonDefeat
text: Whoa! You're tough!\nHow about protecting me?$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_JacksonIntro
text: I work to protect the environment.\nIn turn, nature protects me!$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_JacksonPostBattle
text: From far out among the stars, our\nplanet is just a drop of water.\pBut we want to protect that drop\nof water for everyone.$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_JacksonRematchIntro
text: I work to protect the environment.\nIn turn, nature protects me!$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_KatelynDefeat
text: You're hot stuff in spite of your\ncute looks.$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_KatelynIntro
text: Those shoes you have are pretty\nsnazzy.$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_KatelynPostBattle
text: Your mom bought those snazzy\nRUNNING SHOES for you?\pShe must adore you.$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_KatelynRematchIntro
text: Every time we meet, you have those\nsnazzy shoes on.$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_LeroyDefeat
text: I knew it!\nYou're as tough as I thought!$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_LeroyIntro
text: You look strong.\nLet me battle you, please!$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_LeroyPostBattle
text: The way you battle has given me\na lot of useful data.\pThanks so much!$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_LeroyRematchIntro
text: You must have gotten tougher.\nLet me battle you, please!$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_LexDefeat
text: LEX: I seem to have been too\ncareless…$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_LexIntro
text: LEX: My darling NYA, together\nwe could win!$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_LexNotEnoughMons
text: LEX: May I ask you to battle the\nboth of us at the same time?$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_LexPostBattle
text: LEX: I think it was a good\nexperience for NYA.\pYou have my gratitude.$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_LexRematchIntro
text: LEX: My darling NYA, together\nwe will win for certain!$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_MichelleDefeat
text: Thank you. I feel like I've been\nset free by losing to you.$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_MichelleIntro
text: I was given the best possible\neducation to become this strong.\pI don't want to lose to anyone!$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_MichellePostBattle
text: For some reason, I get furious\nover the slightest thing.\pI'll calm myself by breathing\ndeeply.$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_MichelleRematchIntro
text: I was given the best possible\neducation to become this strong.\pI won't lose this time.\nAbsolutely not!$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_NyaDefeat
text: NYA: Oh, no…\nI'm so sorry, I…$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_NyaIntro
text: NYA: I'll do my best so I won't\ndrag down my mentor, LEX!$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_NyaNotEnoughMons
text: NYA: I'm sorry, but may we battle\nin two-on-two style?$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_NyaPostBattle
text: NYA: I think I'm going to need\nmuch more seasoning and tutoring\lunder LEX…\p…So, LEX, please, may I stay with\nyou like this?$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_NyaRematchIntro
text: NYA: I won't drag down my mentor\nLEX! We're going to win!$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_RouteSign
text: SEVAULT CANYON\nTANOBY RUINS AHEAD$

label: SevenIsland_TanobyRuins_Text_BenjaminDefeat
text: I'm not much good in battle.$

label: SevenIsland_TanobyRuins_Text_BenjaminIntro
text: A mystic POKéMON is said to sleep\ninside here.$

label: SevenIsland_TanobyRuins_Text_BenjaminPostBattle
text: I hear there are other ruins like\nthe one here.\pMight they be the resting places\nof other mystic POKéMON?$

label: SevenIsland_TanobyRuins_Text_BenjaminRematchIntro
text: A mystic POKéMON is said to sleep\ninside here.$

label: SevenIsland_TanobyRuins_Text_BrandonDefeat
text: That was uncalled for.\nYou didn't have to be so rough.$

label: SevenIsland_TanobyRuins_Text_BrandonIntro
text: Do you know anything about this\nstone chamber?$

label: SevenIsland_TanobyRuins_Text_BrandonPostBattle
text: The TANOBY RUINS date back at\nleast 1,500 years.\pBut it's a baffling mystery as to\nwhy it was built in the first place.$

label: SevenIsland_TanobyRuins_Text_BrandonRematchIntro
text: Have you discovered anything about\nthis stone chamber?$

label: SevenIsland_TanobyRuins_Text_CliffordDefeat
text: My, how extraordinary.$

label: SevenIsland_TanobyRuins_Text_CliffordIntro
text: Today, in addition to our lesson,\nwe came to see the chamber.$

label: SevenIsland_TanobyRuins_Text_CliffordPostBattle
text: Ah, so you are studying POKéMON\non your own…\pYes, you certainly are quite the\nextraordinary person, indeed.$

label: SevenIsland_TanobyRuins_Text_CliffordRematchIntro
text: Today, in addition to our lesson,\nwe came to see the chamber again.$

label: SevenIsland_TanobyRuins_Text_EdnaDefeat
text: We might get in trouble for being\nnoisy here.$

label: SevenIsland_TanobyRuins_Text_EdnaIntro
text: CLIFFORD is teaching me how to\npaint.$

label: SevenIsland_TanobyRuins_Text_EdnaPostBattle
text: I said that I wanted to paint an\nold building.\pSo CLIFFORD brought me here.$

label: SevenIsland_TanobyRuins_Text_EdnaRematchIntro
text: My teacher is showing me how to\npaint some more.$

label: SevenIsland_Text_IslandSign
text: SEVEN ISLAND\nQuest Island of Infinity$

label: SevenIsland_Text_IslandVirtuallyUntouched
text: This island has been left virtually\nuntouched in its natural state.\pIt could be a little difficult to\nhike around because of that.$

label: SevenIsland_Text_IslandsMadeInSevenDays
text:
These islands are called the SEVII
ISLANDS because there are seven.\p…Or at least that's what the young
people believe.\pThe truth is, these islands are so
named because they are said to\lhave been made in seven days.$

label: SevenIsland_TrainerTower_Text_DarioDefeat
text: Give up…$

label: SevenIsland_TrainerTower_Text_DarioIntro
text: I sensed your approach.$

label: SevenIsland_TrainerTower_Text_DarioPostBattle
text: In your future, I sense that you\nwill meet many others.\pI think you will be linked to each\nother by a strange power.$

label: SevenIsland_TrainerTower_Text_DarioRematchIntro
text: I sensed your approach.$

label: SevenIsland_TrainerTower_Text_RodetteDefeat
text: What an amazing TRAINER!$

label: SevenIsland_TrainerTower_Text_RodetteIntro
text: Somewhere on this island, peculiar\nPOKéMON are sleeping.$

label: SevenIsland_TrainerTower_Text_RodettePostBattle
text: Somewhere on this island, peculiar\nPOKéMON are sleeping.\pCould it be that they're waiting\nfor you?$

label: SevenIsland_TrainerTower_Text_RodetteRematchIntro
text: Somewhere on this island, peculiar\nPOKéMON are sleeping.$

label: SevenIsland_TrainerTower_Text_TrainerTowerAhead
text: TRAINER TOWER AHEAD$

label: SevenIsland_TrainerTower_Text_TrainerTowerSign
text: TRAINER TOWER ENTRANCE\nRise to the Challenge, TRAINERS!$

label: ShoalCave_LowTideEntranceRoom_Text_AreYouPlanningOnGoingInThere
text:
Are you planning on going deep
in there?\pHow about bringing me back some
SHOAL SALT and SHOAL SHELLS?\pI can make you something good if
you bring me the ingredients.$

label: ShoalCave_LowTideEntranceRoom_Text_BringMe4ShoalSaltAndShells
text: If you bring me four each of the\nSHOAL SALT and SHOAL SHELLS,\lI can make you a SHELL BELL…\pYou can get those ingredients\nevery day.$

label: ShoalCave_LowTideEntranceRoom_Text_ExplainShellBell
text:
Have a POKéMON hold on to that.
It'll love it, that's for certain.\pWhy, the SHELL BELL's chime…
It's simply sublime!\pYou can get its ingredients every day,
so I can make you more.$

label: ShoalCave_LowTideEntranceRoom_Text_MakeShellBellRightAway
text: All righty, then! I'll make you\na SHELL BELL right away.\p… … … … … … … …\n… … … … … … … …\pThere! Done!$

label: ShoalCave_LowTideEntranceRoom_Text_NoSpaceInYourBag
text: You don't have space in your BAG\nif I were to make it for you.\pYou should make room and come back\nfor a SHELL BELL.$

label: ShoalCave_LowTideEntranceRoom_Text_WantedToMakeShellBell
text: Oh… Is that so…\nI wanted to make a SHELL BELL…$

label: ShoalCave_LowTideEntranceRoom_Text_WouldYouLikeShellBell
text: Oh, hey! SHOAL SALT and SHOAL SHELLS!\nAnd enough of them, too!\pWould you like me to make you\na SHELL BELL with them?$

label: ShoalCave_LowTideLowerRoom_Text_CanOvercomeColdWithFocus
text: The penetrating cold around these\nparts is an impediment to training.\pBut with focus, one can overcome!\pWith this FOCUS BAND, buckle down and\nwithstand the cold!$

label: ShoalCave_LowTideLowerRoom_Text_EverythingStartsWithFocus
text: Everything starts with focus!$

label: ShoalCave_Text_WasShoalSaltNowNothing
text: There was some SHOAL SALT here.\nBut, there's nothing here now.$

label: ShoalCave_Text_WasShoallShellNowNothing
text: There was a SHOAL SHELL here.\nBut, there's nothing here now.$

label: SilphCo_10F_Text_FloorSign
text: SILPH CO. HEAD OFFICE\n10F$

label: SilphCo_10F_Text_GruntDefeat
text: I'm stunned!$

label: SilphCo_10F_Text_GruntIntro
text: Welcome to 10F!\nSo good of you to join me!$

label: SilphCo_10F_Text_GruntPostBattle
text: Nice try, but the boardroom is up\none more floor.$

label: SilphCo_10F_Text_KeepMeCryingASecret
text: About me crying…\nPlease keep it a secret.$

label: SilphCo_10F_Text_TravisDefeat
text: No continues left!$

label: SilphCo_10F_Text_TravisIntro
text: Enough of your silly games!$

label: SilphCo_10F_Text_TravisPostBattle
text: Are you satisfied with beating me?\nThen go on home!$

label: SilphCo_10F_Text_WaaaImScared
text: Waaaaa!\nI'm scared!$

label: SilphCo_11F_Text_FloorSign
text: SILPH CO. HEAD OFFICE\n11F$

label: SilphCo_11F_Text_GiovanniDefeat
text: Arrgh!!\nI lost again!?$

label: SilphCo_11F_Text_GiovanniIntro
text:
Ah, {PLAYER}!
So we meet again!\pThe PRESIDENT and I are discussing
a vital business proposition.\pKeep your nose out of grown-up
matters…\pOr, experience a world of pain!$

label: SilphCo_11F_Text_GiovanniPostBattle
text: Blast it all!\nYou ruined our plans for SILPH!\pBut, TEAM ROCKET will never fall!\p{PLAYER}! Never forget that all\nPOKéMON exist for TEAM ROCKET!\pI must go, but I shall return!$

label: SilphCo_11F_Text_Grunt1Defeat
text: Gaah!\nDemolished!$

label: SilphCo_11F_Text_Grunt1Intro
text: Halt! Do you have an appointment\nwith my BOSS?$

label: SilphCo_11F_Text_Grunt1PostBattle
text: Watch your step…\nMy BOSS likes his POKéMON tough!$

label: SilphCo_11F_Text_Grunt2Defeat
text: Don't…\nPlease!$

label: SilphCo_11F_Text_Grunt2Intro
text: Stop right there!\nDon't you move!$

label: SilphCo_11F_Text_Grunt2PostBattle
text: So, you want to see my BOSS?$

label: SilphCo_11F_Text_ObtainedMasterBallFromPresident
text: {PLAYER} obtained a MASTER BALL\nfrom the PRESIDENT!$

label: SilphCo_11F_Text_ThanksForRescuingUs
text: SECRETARY: Thank you for rescuing\nall of us.\pWe, from the PRESIDENT down,\nare indebted to you.$

label: SilphCo_11F_Text_ThanksForSavingMeDearBoy
text:
PRESIDENT: Oh, dear boy!
Thank you for saving SILPH.\pI will never forget you saved us in
our moment of peril.\pI have to thank you in some way.\pBecause I am rich, I can give you
anything.\pHere, maybe this will do.$

label: SilphCo_11F_Text_ThanksForSavingMeDearGirl
text:
PRESIDENT: Oh, dear girl!
Thank you for saving SILPH.\pI will never forget you saved us in
our moment of peril.\pI have to thank you in some way.\pBecause I am rich, I can give you
anything.\pHere, maybe this will do.$

label: SilphCo_11F_Text_ThatsOurSecretPrototype
text:
PRESIDENT: You can't buy that
anywhere.\pIt's our secret prototype MASTER
BALL.\pIt will catch any POKéMON without
fail!\pYou should be quiet about using it,
though.$

label: SilphCo_11F_Text_YouHaveNoRoomForThis
text: You have no room for this.$

label: SilphCo_1F_Text_FloorSign
text: SILPH CO. HEAD OFFICE\n1F$

label: SilphCo_1F_Text_WelcomePresidentInBoardroom
text: Welcome.\pThe PRESIDENT is in the boardroom\non 11F.$

label: SilphCo_2F_Text_ConnorDefeat
text: How did you know\nI was a ROCKET?$

label: SilphCo_2F_Text_ConnorIntro
text: Help!\nI'm a SILPH employee.$

label: SilphCo_2F_Text_ConnorPostBattle
text: I work for both SILPH and TEAM\nROCKET.$

label: SilphCo_2F_Text_FloorSign
text: SILPH CO. HEAD OFFICE\n2F$

label: SilphCo_2F_Text_Grunt1Defeat
text: Tough!$

label: SilphCo_2F_Text_Grunt1Intro
text: No kids are allowed in here!$

label: SilphCo_2F_Text_Grunt1PostBattle
text: Diamond-shaped tiles are teleport\nblocks.\pThey're transporters for this\nhigh-tech building.$

label: SilphCo_2F_Text_Grunt2Defeat
text: I goofed!$

label: SilphCo_2F_Text_Grunt2Intro
text: Hey, kid!\nWhat are you wandering here for?$

label: SilphCo_2F_Text_Grunt2PostBattle
text: SILPH CO. will be associated with\nTEAM ROCKET!$

label: SilphCo_2F_Text_JerryDefeat
text: You're good.$

label: SilphCo_2F_Text_JerryIntro
text: It's off-limits here!\nGo home!$

label: SilphCo_2F_Text_JerryPostBattle
text: Can you solve the maze in here?\nIt's not easy, I tell you!$

label: SilphCo_3F_Text_FloorSign
text: SILPH CO. HEAD OFFICE\n3F$

label: SilphCo_3F_Text_GruntDefeat
text: I give up!$

label: SilphCo_3F_Text_GruntIntro
text: Quit messing with us, kid!$

label: SilphCo_3F_Text_GruntPostBattle
text: A hint? You can open doors with\na CARD KEY!$

label: SilphCo_3F_Text_JoseDefeat
text: You really got me!$

label: SilphCo_3F_Text_JoseIntro
text: I support TEAM ROCKET more than\nI support SILPH CO.!$

label: SilphCo_3F_Text_JosePostBattle
text: Humph…\pTEAM ROCKET said that if I helped\nthem, they'd let me study POKéMON.$

label: SilphCo_3F_Text_WhatAmIToDo
text: I work for SILPH CO.\nWhat am I to do?$

label: SilphCo_3F_Text_YouAndYourMonsSavedUs
text: {PLAYER}!\nYou and your POKéMON saved us!$

label: SilphCo_4F_Text_CantYouSeeImHiding
text: Sssh!\nCan't you see I'm hiding?$

label: SilphCo_4F_Text_FloorSign
text: SILPH CO. HEAD OFFICE\n4F$

label: SilphCo_4F_Text_Grunt1Defeat
text: Arrgh!$

label: SilphCo_4F_Text_Grunt1Intro
text: TEAM ROCKET has taken control\nof SILPH CO.!$

label: SilphCo_4F_Text_Grunt1PostBattle
text: Fwahahaha!\nMy BOSS has been after this place!$

label: SilphCo_4F_Text_Grunt2Defeat
text: Who are you?$

label: SilphCo_4F_Text_Grunt2Intro
text: Intruder spotted!$

label: SilphCo_4F_Text_Grunt2PostBattle
text: I better tell the BOSS on 11F!$

label: SilphCo_4F_Text_RodneyDefeat
text: Darn!\nYou weak POKéMON!$

label: SilphCo_4F_Text_RodneyIntro
text: My POKéMON is my loyal servant.$

label: SilphCo_4F_Text_RodneyPostBattle
text: The doors are electronically\nlocked.\pIt takes a CARD KEY to open the\ndoors here.$

label: SilphCo_4F_Text_TeamRocketIsGone
text: Huh?\nTEAM ROCKET is gone?$

label: SilphCo_5F_Text_BeauDefeat
text: Dang!\nBlast it!$

label: SilphCo_5F_Text_BeauIntro
text: We study POKé BALL technology on\nthis floor.$

label: SilphCo_5F_Text_BeauPostBattle
text: We worked on the ultimate POKé\nBALL which would catch anything.$

label: SilphCo_5F_Text_DaltonDefeat
text: Oh, goodness!$

label: SilphCo_5F_Text_DaltonIntro
text: Whaaat?\pThere shouldn't be any children\nhere!$

label: SilphCo_5F_Text_DaltonPostBattle
text: You're only on 5F.\nIt's a long way to my BOSS!$

label: SilphCo_5F_Text_FloorSign
text: SILPH CO. HEAD OFFICE\n5F$

label: SilphCo_5F_Text_Grunt1Defeat
text: Boom!$

label: SilphCo_5F_Text_Grunt1Intro
text: I heard a trainer was wandering\naround.$

label: SilphCo_5F_Text_Grunt1PostBattle
text: It's not smart to pick a fight with\nTEAM ROCKET!$

label: SilphCo_5F_Text_Grunt2Defeat
text: Cough…\nCough…$

label: SilphCo_5F_Text_Grunt2Intro
text: Show TEAM ROCKET a little respect!$

label: SilphCo_5F_Text_Grunt2PostBattle
text: Which reminds me.\pKOFFING evolves into WEEZING!$

label: SilphCo_5F_Text_Over350TechniquesConfirmed
text: It's a POKéMON REPORT!\pOver 350 POKéMON techniques have\nbeen confirmed.$

label: SilphCo_5F_Text_PorygonFirstVRMon
text: It's a POKéMON REPORT!\pPOKéMON LAB created PORYGON,\nthe first virtual-reality POKéMON.$

label: SilphCo_5F_Text_RocketBossLookingForStrongMons
text:
Those thugs that took over our
building…\pTheir BOSS said he was looking for
strong POKéMON.\pI hope our PRESIDENT managed to
avoid trouble…$

label: SilphCo_5F_Text_RocketsInUproarAboutIntruder
text: TEAM ROCKET is in an uproar over\nsome intruder.\pThat's you, right?$

label: SilphCo_5F_Text_SomeMonsEvolveWhenTraded
text: It's a POKéMON REPORT!\pSome POKéMON have been confirmed\nto evolve when they are traded.$

label: SilphCo_5F_Text_YoureOurHeroThankYou
text: TEAM ROCKET took off!\nYou're our hero! Thank you!$

label: SilphCo_6F_Text_BetterGetBackToWork
text: Well, better get back to work.$

label: SilphCo_6F_Text_ComeWorkForSilphWhenYoureOlder
text: Come work for SILPH when you\nget older.$

label: SilphCo_6F_Text_FloorSign
text: SILPH CO. HEAD OFFICE\n6F$

label: SilphCo_6F_Text_Grunt1Defeat
text: Flame out!$

label: SilphCo_6F_Text_Grunt1Intro
text: I am one of the four ROCKET\nBROTHERS!$

label: SilphCo_6F_Text_Grunt1PostBattle
text: No matter!\nMy brothers will avenge me!$

label: SilphCo_6F_Text_Grunt2Defeat
text: You traitor!$

label: SilphCo_6F_Text_Grunt2Intro
text: You dare betray TEAM ROCKET?$

label: SilphCo_6F_Text_Grunt2PostBattle
text: If you stand for justice, you\nbetray us bad guys!$

label: SilphCo_6F_Text_HelpMePlease
text: Oh dear, oh dear.\nHelp me, please!$

label: SilphCo_6F_Text_NeedsMeToLookAfterHim
text: He's so helpless, he needed\nsomeone like me to look after him.$

label: SilphCo_6F_Text_RocketsRanAwayBecauseOfYou
text: TEAM ROCKET ran away, and it's all\nbecause of you!$

label: SilphCo_6F_Text_RocketsTookOverBuilding
text: The ROCKETS came and took over\nthe building!$

label: SilphCo_6F_Text_RocketsTryingToConquerWorld
text: TEAM ROCKET is trying to conquer\nthe world with POKéMON.$

label: SilphCo_6F_Text_TargetedSilphForOurMonProducts
text: They must have targeted SILPH for\nour POKéMON products.$

label: SilphCo_6F_Text_TaylorDefeat
text: Shoot!$

label: SilphCo_6F_Text_TaylorIntro
text: That rotten PRESIDENT!\pServes him right for shipping me\noff to the TIKSI BRANCH!\pThat's why TEAM ROCKET came after\nus, I'm sure of it!$

label: SilphCo_6F_Text_TaylorPostBattle
text: TIKSI BRANCH?\nIt's in Russian no-man's-land!$

label: SilphCo_6F_Text_ThatManIsSuchACoward
text: That man next to me…\nHe's such a coward!$

label: SilphCo_6F_Text_WeGotEngaged
text: We got engaged.\nHeheh!$

label: SilphCo_7F_Text_BadIfTeamRocketTookOver
text: It would be bad if TEAM ROCKET\ntook over SILPH or our POKéMON.$

label: SilphCo_7F_Text_CanceledMasterBallProject
text: We canceled the MASTER BALL\nproject because of TEAM ROCKET.$

label: SilphCo_7F_Text_ExplainLapras
text:
It's a LAPRAS.
It's a very intelligent POKéMON.\pWe kept it in our lab, but it will
be much better off with you.\pI think you will be a good TRAINER
for LAPRAS!\pIt's a good swimmer.
It'll give you a lift across water!$

label: SilphCo_7F_Text_FloorSign
text: SILPH CO. HEAD OFFICE\n7F$

label: SilphCo_7F_Text_Grunt1Defeat
text: Aack!\nBrothers, I lost!$

label: SilphCo_7F_Text_Grunt1Intro
text: I am one of the four ROCKET\nBROTHERS!$

label: SilphCo_7F_Text_Grunt1PostBattle
text: Doesn't matter.\nMy brothers will repay the favor!$

label: SilphCo_7F_Text_Grunt2Defeat
text: Fine!\nI lost!$

label: SilphCo_7F_Text_Grunt2Intro
text: An intruding trainer?\nThat must be you!$

label: SilphCo_7F_Text_Grunt2PostBattle
text: Go on home before my BOSS gets\nticked off!$

label: SilphCo_7F_Text_Grunt3Defeat
text: Lights out!$

label: SilphCo_7F_Text_Grunt3Intro
text: Uh-oh!\nI smell a little mouse!$

label: SilphCo_7F_Text_Grunt3PostBattle
text: You won't find my BOSS by just\nscurrying around!$

label: SilphCo_7F_Text_HaveMonForSavingUs
text: Oh! Hi! You're not a ROCKET!\nYou came to save us?\lWhy, thank you!\pI want you to have this POKéMON\nfor saving us.$

label: SilphCo_7F_Text_JoshuaDefeat
text: I'm done!$

label: SilphCo_7F_Text_JoshuaIntro
text: Heheh!\pYou mistook me for a SILPH worker?$

label: SilphCo_7F_Text_JoshuaPostBattle
text: Despite your age, you are a\nskilled TRAINER!$

label: SilphCo_7F_Text_ObtainedLaprasFromEmployee
text: {PLAYER} obtained a LAPRAS from\nthe SILPH employee!$

label: SilphCo_7F_Text_ReallyDangerousHere
text: You!\nIt's really dangerous here!\pYou came to save me?\nYou can't!$

label: SilphCo_7F_Text_RivalDefeat
text: Oh, man!\nSo, you are ready for BOSS\lROCKET!$

label: SilphCo_7F_Text_RivalIntro
text:
{RIVAL}: Hahaha! I thought you'd
turn up if I waited here!\pI guess TEAM ROCKET slowed you
down! Not that I care!\pI saw you in SAFFRON, so I decided
to see if you got better!$

label: SilphCo_7F_Text_RivalPostBattle
text:
Well, {PLAYER}!
I'm moving on up and ahead!\pBy checking my POKéDEX, I'm
starting to see what's strong and\lhow they evolve!\pAm I a genius or what?\pI'm going to the POKéMON LEAGUE to
boot out the ELITE FOUR.\pI'll become the world's most
powerful TRAINER!\p{PLAYER}, well, good luck to you!
Don't sweat it!\lSmell ya!$

label: SilphCo_7F_Text_RivalWhatKeptYou
text: {RIVAL}: What kept you, {PLAYER}?$

label: SilphCo_7F_Text_RocketBossWentToBoardroom
text: TEAM ROCKET's BOSS went to the\nboardroom!\pIs our PRESIDENT okay?\nI'm worried.$

label: SilphCo_7F_Text_RocketsAfterMasterBall
text: TEAM ROCKET was after the MASTER\nBALL, which catches any POKéMON.$

label: SilphCo_7F_Text_ThankYouSoMuch
text: Thank you so much!$

label: SilphCo_7F_Text_WowYouChasedOffTeamRocket
text: Wow!\pYou chased off TEAM ROCKET all by\nyourself?$

label: SilphCo_8F_Text_FloorSign
text: SILPH CO. HEAD OFFICE\n8F$

label: SilphCo_8F_Text_Grunt1Defeat
text: Not enough grit!$

label: SilphCo_8F_Text_Grunt1Intro
text: That's as far as you'll go!$

label: SilphCo_8F_Text_Grunt1PostBattle
text: If you don't turn back…\nI'll call for backup!$

label: SilphCo_8F_Text_Grunt2Defeat
text: Whoo!\nOh, Brothers!$

label: SilphCo_8F_Text_Grunt2Intro
text: I am one of the four ROCKET\nBROTHERS!$

label: SilphCo_8F_Text_Grunt2PostBattle
text: I'll leave you up to my brothers.$

label: SilphCo_8F_Text_ParkerDefeat
text: Huh?\nI lost?$

label: SilphCo_8F_Text_ParkerIntro
text: You're causing us problems!$

label: SilphCo_8F_Text_ParkerPostBattle
text: So, what do you think of SILPH\nBUILDING's maze?$

label: SilphCo_8F_Text_ThanksForSavingUs
text: Thanks for saving us!$

label: SilphCo_8F_Text_ToRocketBossMonsAreTools
text:
TEAM ROCKET's BOSS is terribly
cruel!\pTo him, POKéMON are just tools to
be used.\pWhat will happen if that tyrant
takes over our company…$

label: SilphCo_8F_Text_WonderIfSilphIsFinished
text: I wonder if SILPH is finished…$

label: SilphCo_9F_Text_DontGiveUp
text: Don't give up!$

label: SilphCo_9F_Text_EdDefeat
text: You hammered me!$

label: SilphCo_9F_Text_EdIntro
text: Your POKéMON have weak points!\nI can nail them!$

label: SilphCo_9F_Text_EdPostBattle
text: Exploiting weak spots does work.\nThink about type advantages.$

label: SilphCo_9F_Text_FloorSign
text: SILPH CO. HEAD OFFICE\n9F$

label: SilphCo_9F_Text_Grunt1Defeat
text: Ghaaah!$

label: SilphCo_9F_Text_Grunt1Intro
text: Your POKéMON seem to adore you,\nkid!$

label: SilphCo_9F_Text_Grunt1PostBattle
text: If I had started as a TRAINER at\nyour age…$

label: SilphCo_9F_Text_Grunt2Defeat
text: Warg!\nBrothers, I lost!$

label: SilphCo_9F_Text_Grunt2Intro
text: I am one of the four ROCKET\nBROTHERS!$

label: SilphCo_9F_Text_Grunt2PostBattle
text: My brothers will avenge me!$

label: SilphCo_9F_Text_ThankYouSoMuch
text: Thank you so much.$

label: SilphCo_9F_Text_YouShouldTakeQuickNap
text: You look tired.\nYou should take a quick nap.$

label: SixIsland_DottedHole_SapphireRoom_Text_FoundSapphire
text: {PLAYER} found a SAPPHIRE!$

label: SixIsland_DottedHole_SapphireRoom_Text_IWasRightInTailingYou
text: Fufu… Fufufufu…\nI guessed right.\pI was right in tailing you!$

label: SixIsland_DottedHole_SapphireRoom_Text_SellToTeamRocketTellPassword
text:
I knew that there was a SAPPHIRE
here, so it belongs to me!\pI'll sell it to TEAM ROCKET for
serious money.\p…D-don't glare at me like that!\pIf you want it back, why don't you
go get it after I sell it?\pI'll even tell you one of the
passwords to TEAM ROCKET's\lWAREHOUSE.\pThe WAREHOUSE password I know is
“Yes, nah, CHANSEY.”\pI'm done.
Don't think badly of me!$

label: SixIsland_GreenPath_Text_JaclynDefeat
text: Big boo-boo!$

label: SixIsland_GreenPath_Text_JaclynIntro
text: …Huh?\pI was envisioning my house, but\nthis is where I TELEPORT?$

label: SixIsland_GreenPath_Text_JaclynPostBattle
text: I am so scatterbrained!\pI need to focus so I can TELEPORT\nproperly to my house!$

label: SixIsland_GreenPath_Text_JaclynRematchIntro
text: …Huh?\pI envision my house, but TELEPORT\nalways brings me here!$

label: SixIsland_GreenPath_Text_LeftRouteSign
text: GREEN PATH\nPATTERN BUSH AHEAD$

label: SixIsland_GreenPath_Text_RightRouteSign
text: GREEN PATH\nThink Green, Keep Nature Clean!$

label: SixIsland_House_Text_GoodPlaceForNatureAndHistory
text: There's nothing that young people'd\nfind exciting here on this island.\pBut, this is a good place in terms\nof nature and history.\pRelax and enjoy your stay.$

label: SixIsland_Mart_Text_AgathaOldestEverEliteFourMember
text: Play with POKéMON lots and live\na long life!\pTake AGATHA, for example.\pShe set a record for being the\noldest-ever ELITE FOUR member.\pShe spurs me to do bigger things.$

label: SixIsland_Mart_Text_ShouldBuyMailAndWriteLetter
text: I should buy some MAIL and write\nhim a letter…$

label: SixIsland_OutcastIsland_Text_AvaDefeat
text: AVA: Oh, you're amazing!\nEven better, you're on your own!$

label: SixIsland_OutcastIsland_Text_AvaIntro
text: AVA: Let's have a two-on-two\nmarine battle!$

label: SixIsland_OutcastIsland_Text_AvaNotEnoughMons
text: AVA: You're challenging us to\na battle?\pYou'll need at least two POKéMON\nif you want to do that.$

label: SixIsland_OutcastIsland_Text_AvaPostBattle
text: AVA: You know, I do prefer the\nsea over any pool.$

label: SixIsland_OutcastIsland_Text_AvaRematchIntro
text: AVA: Let's have another\ntwo-on-two marine battle today!$

label: SixIsland_OutcastIsland_Text_GebDefeat
text: GEB: Wow, Big Sister, this person's\nreally good!$

label: SixIsland_OutcastIsland_Text_GebIntro
text: GEB: Big Sister, help!\nPlease battle with me!$

label: SixIsland_OutcastIsland_Text_GebNotEnoughMons
text: GEB: Please battle against me and\nmy sister!\p…Oh, you don't have two POKéMON?$

label: SixIsland_OutcastIsland_Text_GebPostBattle
text: GEB: I'm hanging onto my sister\nbecause I can't touch the bottom.$

label: SixIsland_OutcastIsland_Text_GebRematchIntro
text: GEB: My big sister and I are way\ntougher than before!$

label: SixIsland_OutcastIsland_Text_MymoDefeat
text: Gasp…\nGasp…$

label: SixIsland_OutcastIsland_Text_MymoIntro
text: Gasp… Gasp…\pI swam here from SIX ISLE PORT\nin one go.$

label: SixIsland_OutcastIsland_Text_MymoPostBattle
text: I'm only at the halfway point…\nI'm beat…$

label: SixIsland_OutcastIsland_Text_MymoRematchIntro
text: Gasp… Gasp…\pI swam here from SIX ISLAND's port\nin one go again.$

label: SixIsland_OutcastIsland_Text_NicoleDefeat
text: I didn't lose to you at swimming.\nThis doesn't bother me.$

label: SixIsland_OutcastIsland_Text_NicoleIntro
text: It's not so easy sending POKéMON\nout while swimming, you know?$

label: SixIsland_OutcastIsland_Text_NicolePostBattle
text: Are you headed for the island up\npast here?\pI didn't see anything interesting\nthere.$

label: SixIsland_OutcastIsland_Text_NicoleRematchIntro
text: You always come along while I'm\nswimming.$

label: SixIsland_OutcastIsland_Text_RocketDefeat
text: …Huh?$

label: SixIsland_OutcastIsland_Text_RocketIntro
text: There're no rare POKéMON around\nthese parts! Not a one!\pThat burns me up, man.\nI'll take it out on you!$

label: SixIsland_OutcastIsland_Text_RocketPostBattle
text: So listen, you haven't seen any\nrare POKéMON, have you?$

label: SixIsland_OutcastIsland_Text_TylorDefeat
text: Nope, no luck at all…$

label: SixIsland_OutcastIsland_Text_TylorIntro
text: I'm having no luck at all.\nA battle'd be a change of pace!$

label: SixIsland_OutcastIsland_Text_TylorPostBattle
text: I can't very well go home without\ncatching something, though.$

label: SixIsland_OutcastIsland_Text_TylorRematchIntro
text: I'm still having no luck at all.\nA battle'd be a change of pace!$

label: SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_AllisonDefeat
text: Oh, for someone so young, you are\ntremendous!$

label: SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_AllisonIntro
text: I'm working to preserve the natural\necology of POKéMON here.$

label: SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_AllisonPostBattle
text: I'm not saying that you shouldn't\ncatch POKéMON.\pI just want people to raise their\nPOKéMON responsibly.$

label: SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_BethanyDefeat
text: You raise your POKéMON with a\nwhole lot of love!$

label: SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_BethanyIntro
text: I'm curious, how do you raise your\nPOKéMON?$

label: SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_BethanyPostBattle
text: In the same way your mother raised\nyou full of love, you should raise\lyour POKéMON.$

label: SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_CordellDefeat
text: I bet you think I'm weak,\ndon't you, eh?$

label: SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_CordellIntro
text: I bet you think I'm just some guy,\ndon't you, eh?$

label: SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_CordellPostBattle
text: Ayup, you townies come around all\nso dandy with a hat that flashy…\pHow about giving me that?$

label: SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_DaliaDefeat
text: If you'd like, I can teach you how\nto breathe properly.$

label: SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_DaliaIntro
text: Take a deep breath.\nIsn't the air delicious?$

label: SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_DaliaPostBattle
text: First, exhale.\nBlow everything out.\pWhen you can't exhale anymore,\ninhale the clean air!\pIsn't it refreshing?$

label: SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_GarretDefeat
text: Heheh…\nIsn't my POKéMON awesome?$

label: SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_GarretIntro
text: I caught a BUG POKéMON that lives\nonly around here!$

label: SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_GarretPostBattle
text: There's a girl near the BUSH who\nmeasures HERACROSS for TRAINERS.$

label: SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_JoanaDefeat
text: I lost, but I'm still laughing.\nAm I the only girl like that?$

label: SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_JoanaIntro
text: I love BUG POKéMON.\nThat's why I'm here all the time.\pAm I the only girl like that?$

label: SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_JoanaPostBattle
text: I'm going to keep on collecting\nBUG POKéMON.\pAm I the only girl like that?$

label: SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_JonahDefeat
text: It's okay, losing is a fun part of\nPOKéMON's appeal, too.$

label: SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_JonahIntro
text: You know, it just doesn't feel right\nif I don't use BUG POKéMON.$

label: SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_JonahPostBattle
text: By the way, “appeal” is a weird\nword, if you think about it.\pLike, is it like an orange peel?\nOr like a ringing bell?$

label: SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_LaytonDefeat
text: Have you taken a good look around\nyour feet?$

label: SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_LaytonIntro
text: Have you noticed something odd\nabout these parts?$

label: SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_LaytonPostBattle
text: There are places here in PATTERN\nBUSH where grass won't grow.\pWhat could be the cause of such\na phenomenon?$

label: SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_MarcyDefeat
text: It wasn't a bug.\nI cut my shin on some grass.$

label: SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_MarcyIntro
text: Oh, yuck!\nI think a bug stung me!$

label: SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_MarcyPostBattle
text: A little cut like that…\nA little spit's enough to cure it!$

label: SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_NashDefeat
text: Super awesome!$

label: SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_NashIntro
text: Look, look! There are funny\npatterns on the ground.$

label: SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_NashPostBattle
text: The funny patterns on the ground…\pThey look like the patterns on my\ngrandpa's clothes.$

label: SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_RileyDefeat
text: Wimped out…$

label: SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_RileyIntro
text: This is a good spot.\nI'll pitch my tent here.$

label: SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_RileyPostBattle
text: I'm going to observe the night sky\nhere.$

label: SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_VanceDefeat
text: I got beat while I was still busy\ncelebrating!$

label: SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_VanceIntro
text: Yeah, yeah, yeah!\nLook at all the BUG POKéMON!$

label: SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_VancePostBattle
text: I'm going to bring my little brother\nhere next time.$

label: SixIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_RivalImpossibleToGetAllMonsAroundHere
text:
{RIVAL}: Hey, {PLAYER}!
How's your POKéDEX filling up?\pIt looks like it's impossible to get
all the POKéMON by hanging around\ljust these parts.\pMaybe there are POKéMON we don't
know about somewhere far away…\p… … …  … … …  … … …\pWell, if I can't do it, there's no
way for you to get it done.\pI'm not going to get all desperate
over this.\pI'll keep collecting POKéMON at my
own pace while I train them.\pThat's what I'll do.
So there's no point staying here.\lI may as well leave for home.\pThat's that, then!
Smell ya later!$

label: SixIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_SomeMonsEvolveByTradingWithHeldItem
text:
You know of POKéMON that evolve
only upon trading, yes?\pBut did you know that there are
still others?\pSome POKéMON evolve only when
traded while holding specific items.$

label: SixIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_SomethingHiddenOnThisIsland
text: For ten years, I've searched for\nRUINS.\pNo, make that twenty years.\pI get this feeling that there's\nsomething hidden on this island.$

label: SixIsland_RuinValley_Text_CantFigureOutHowToGetInside
text: I can't figure out how I'm supposed\nto get inside.$

label: SixIsland_RuinValley_Text_CheckDoorMoreThoroughly
text: The door doesn't budge at all.\nCheck it more thoroughly?$

label: SixIsland_RuinValley_Text_DarylDefeat
text: Oh, the heartbreak of losing so\neasily to you!$

label: SixIsland_RuinValley_Text_DarylIntro
text: A battle with you, so high up!$

label: SixIsland_RuinValley_Text_DarylPostBattle
text: Experience the joy of climbing!$

label: SixIsland_RuinValley_Text_DarylRematchIntro
text: A rematch with you, so high up!$

label: SixIsland_RuinValley_Text_DoorIsOpen
text: The door is open.$

label: SixIsland_RuinValley_Text_FosterDefeat
text: It's been so long since I battled,\nmy instincts are off.$

label: SixIsland_RuinValley_Text_FosterIntro
text: I'm curious, what compelled you to\ncome here?$

label: SixIsland_RuinValley_Text_FosterPostBattle
text: There are several ruins on the\nSEVII ISLANDS.\pThe majority of them date back\na long way.$

label: SixIsland_RuinValley_Text_FosterRematchIntro
text: Hi, didn't we meet before?\nWhat compelled you to come back?$

label: SixIsland_RuinValley_Text_HectorDefeat
text: You don't need to be so pushy.\nI'll be happy to tell you.$

label: SixIsland_RuinValley_Text_HectorIntro
text: I'm pretty familiar with the land\naround these parts.$

label: SixIsland_RuinValley_Text_HectorPostBattle
text: The door to the ruins…\nIt has these strange patterns\lengraved on the outside.\pI don't know what they mean,\nthough.$

label: SixIsland_RuinValley_Text_HectorRematchIntro
text: I'm pretty familiar with the land\naround these parts.$

label: SixIsland_RuinValley_Text_IFoundThisPlace
text: Let me tell you, I found this\nplace.\pDon't look so envious, will you?$

label: SixIsland_RuinValley_Text_LarryDefeat
text: Oh, interesting.$

label: SixIsland_RuinValley_Text_LarryIntro
text: It's been said that there are\nmysterious stones on this island.\pI suspect it has something to do\nwith the ruins here.$

label: SixIsland_RuinValley_Text_LarryPostBattle
text: Those ruins over there…\pI haven't had any luck in finding\nhow I can get inside.$

label: SixIsland_RuinValley_Text_LarryRematchIntro
text: It's been said that there are\nmysterious stones on this island.\pHave you discovered anything since\nwe last met?$

label: SixIsland_RuinValley_Text_LeftDoorAlone
text: {PLAYER} left the door alone.$

label: SixIsland_RuinValley_Text_SeveralDotsOnTheDoor
text: On closer inspection, there are\nseveral dots on the door…$

label: SixIsland_RuinValley_Text_StanlyDefeat
text: Hmm…$

label: SixIsland_RuinValley_Text_StanlyIntro
text: There appear to be many secrets\nstill unsolved in this world.$

label: SixIsland_RuinValley_Text_StanlyPostBattle
text: I suggest to you that you, too,\ngive a thought to the secrets and\lmysteries of our world once a day.$

label: SixIsland_RuinValley_Text_StanlyRematchIntro
text: There appear to be many secrets\nstill unsolved in this world.$

label: SixIsland_Text_IslandSign
text: SIX ISLAND\nFortune Island of Aged Wisdom$

label: SixIsland_Text_SkyAtNightIsFantastic
text: When you're this far away from the\ncity, the sky at night is fantastic.$

label: SixIsland_Text_ThatWayToWaterPathRuinValley
text: Keep going this way and you'll get\nto the WATER PATH.\pStay on that and you'll get to\nthe RUIN VALLEY.$

label: SixIsland_WaterPath_House1_Text_BiggestHeracrossIsXSize
text: The biggest HERACROSS that I have\never seen measured so far is:\p{STR_VAR_3}!$

label: SixIsland_WaterPath_House1_Text_BlankChartOfSomeSort
text: It's a blank chart of some sort.\pIt has spaces for writing in\nrecords of some kind.$

label: SixIsland_WaterPath_House1_Text_ItsXSizeDeserveReward
text: Eeeek, it's {STR_VAR_2}!\nI've never seen anything like this!\lYou deserve a reward!$

label: SixIsland_WaterPath_House1_Text_ItsXSizeSameAsBefore
text: Huh? This {STR_VAR_2} measurement…\nOh, boo! It's the same as before.$

label: SixIsland_WaterPath_House1_Text_ItsXSizeYSizeWasBiggest
text: Oh, it's just {STR_VAR_2}.\nThe HERACROSS before was bigger.\pIt was {STR_VAR_3}, the biggest\nHERACROSS you've brought me.$

label: SixIsland_WaterPath_House1_Text_LoveItNeedItHeracross
text: Hera, hera, HERACROSS!\nBig and shiny, it's the bug boss!\lLove it, need it, HERACROSS!$

label: SixIsland_WaterPath_House1_Text_MayIMeasureHeracross
text: Eeeeek!\nThat's a HERACROSS!\pPlease, please, may I measure how\nbig it is?$

label: SixIsland_WaterPath_House1_Text_ThisWontDo
text: Oh, no! This won't do!\pHERACROSS looks much more macho\nand cool, and has a lovely horn!$

label: SixIsland_WaterPath_House1_Text_WantToSeeBiggerOne
text: I want to see a much, much bigger\nHERACROSS than that one.\pOh, how I adore them, big\nHERACROSS!$

label: SixIsland_WaterPath_House1_Text_YourBagIsFull
text: Your BAG is full.\nMy reward won't fit.$

label: SixIsland_WaterPath_House2_Text_MyNeighborMeasuredMe
text: My height is 67.0 inches on the\nbutton.\pI know it is this precisely because\nmy neighbor measured me.$

label: SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_DeniseDefeat
text: Awww, I knew this would happen!$

label: SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_DeniseIntro
text: My boyfriend's always busy, so I\ncome swimming by myself.$

label: SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_DenisePostBattle
text: When I can't be with my boyfriend,\nI spend time with the POKéMON he\lgave me.$

label: SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_DeniseRematchIntro
text: Sigh…\nMy boyfriend's busy again…$

label: SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_EarlDefeat
text: I lost my way while I was busy\nbattling!$

label: SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_EarlIntro
text: Tell me, where are the mountains\naround these parts?$

label: SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_EarlPostBattle
text: Aren't there any mountains around\nthese parts?$

label: SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_EarlRematchIntro
text: Come on, tell me, where are the\nmountains around these parts?$

label: SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_EdwardDefeat
text: Nobody saw me losing, right?$

label: SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_EdwardIntro
text: I'm practicing in secret so no one\ncan see me.$

label: SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_EdwardPostBattle
text: As a performer, I don't want people\nto know about the effort I put in.$

label: SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_EdwardRematchIntro
text: Hehehe, I'm practicing in secret\nagain.$

label: SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_MiaDefeat
text: MIA: You're mean!\nYou're bad for winning!$

label: SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_MiaIntro
text: MIA: Hello, POKéMON!\nIt's time to battle!$

label: SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_MiaNotEnoughMons
text: MIA: Oh, you only have one\nPOKéMON?\pDon't you feel lonesome?$

label: SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_MiaPostBattle
text: MIA: Ohh…\nI'm sorry, my POKéMON…$

label: SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_MiaRematchIntro
text: MIA: Hello, POKéMON!\nIt's time to battle again!$

label: SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_MiuDefeat
text: MIU: Oh, no!\nMommy!$

label: SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_MiuIntro
text: MIU: Hello, POKéMON!\nIt's time to play!$

label: SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_MiuNotEnoughMons
text: MIU: MIA and I are TWINS.\nWe want to battle together.$

label: SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_MiuPostBattle
text: MIU: It makes me all sad inside\nwhen we lose…$

label: SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_MiuRematchIntro
text: MIU: Hello, POKéMON!\nIt's time to play again!$

label: SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_RoseDefeat
text: Giggle… You're so cute when you're\ndetermined.$

label: SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_RoseIntro
text: I let a pleasant breeze lead me\nall the way here.$

label: SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_RosePostBattle
text: I want to go to the woods over\nthere, but…\pThere are lots of BUG POKéMON.\nThey scare me a little.$

label: SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_RoseRematchIntro
text: Oh, hello.\nA pleasant breeze is blowing again.$

label: SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_RouteSign
text: WATER PATH\nLeads to RUIN VALLEY$

label: SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_SamirDefeat
text: Oh, no, no, no.$

label: SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_SamirIntro
text: What, you're suggesting that you're\nsick of seeing SWIMMERS like me?\pAww, don't be hatin'!$

label: SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_SamirPostBattle
text: I couldn't lift the stigma of being\na SWIMMER…$

label: SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_SamirRematchIntro
text: What, you're sick of seeing\nSWIMMERS like me?\pAww, don't be hatin'!\nBattle with me again.$

label: SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_WantedUltimateHorn
text: Wanted!\nThe Ultimate Horn!$

label: SkyPillar_Outside_Text_DoorIsClosed
text: The door is closed.$

label: SkyPillar_Outside_Text_EarthquakeNotMomentToWaste
text: WALLACE: It's an earthquake!\pThere's not a moment to waste!\nWe've got to hurry!$

label: SkyPillar_Outside_Text_GotToGoBackForSootopolis
text:
WALLACE: This isn't good…\pThe weather distortion is spreading
even here…\p{PLAYER}{KUN}.\pRAYQUAZA should be farther up
from here.\pI'm worried about SOOTOPOLIS.
I've got to go back.\pEverything is in your hands now.
Don't fail us!$

label: SkyPillar_Outside_Text_OpenedDoorToSkyPillar
text: WALLACE: Oh, my, I'm terribly sorry!\pIn my haste, I didn't notice that\nI'd left you behind!\pI've opened the locked door of\nthe SKY PILLAR.\p{PLAYER}{KUN}, let's be on our way!$

label: SkyPillar_Outside_Text_SituationGettingWorse
text: WALLACE: Hmm…\nThe situation is getting worse…$

label: SkyPillar_Top_Text_RayquazaFlewOff
text: The awakened RAYQUAZA flew off…$

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_AwardYouThisPrize
text: In recognition of your 3-win streak,\nwe award you this prize.$

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_BattleEvenWithoutToughMons
text: You can battle all you want here even\nif you don't have any tough POKéMON.$

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_BeenWaitingForYou
text: We've been waiting for you!\pBefore we resume your challenge,\nI must save the game.$

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_CouldntFindMonForMe
text:
So, like, I couldn't find myself any
POKéMON that were, like, for me.\pSo, I figured, like, hey, I should file
a complaint to the guy there?\pAnd he wouldn't hear me out, like, hey!
So, like, total bummer, man!\pHey, like, you! Zip it, you know?
Just, you know, take this!$

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_DidntSaveBeforeQuitting
text: I'm sorry to say this, but you didn't\nsave before you quit playing last time.\pAs a result, you have been disqualified\nfrom your challenge.$

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainBasicRules
