text: In a Battle Swap event, you may use\nonly three POKéMON.\pWhether you are renting or swapping,\nyour team may not have two or more\lof the same POKéMON.$

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainMonRules
text: The POKéMON of the SLATEPORT\nBATTLE TENT are all rentals.\pAll rental POKéMON are kept at\nLevel 30.$

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainSwapNotes
text:
There are two key points to be aware
of when swapping POKéMON.\pFirst, when swapping, you can't check
the stats of the POKéMON you are\labout to receive.\pSecond, the POKéMON on your team
are lined up in sequence, depending on\lthe order in which you rented them.\pThis sequence remains unchanged
even when swaps are made.$

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainSwapNumberRules
text: After every battle you win, you may\nswap for one of your defeated\lopponent's POKéMON.\pYou will not be able to swap POKéMON\nwith the third TRAINER in the event.$

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainSwapPartnerRules
text: You may swap POKéMON only with\nthe TRAINER you have just defeated.\pYou may swap for only those POKéMON\nused by the beaten TRAINER.$

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainTorment
text:
That's, like, TM41, you know?
Hey, it's TORMENT, you hearing me?\pLike, it won't let the other guy
use the same move twice in a row, see?\pHey, now, you listen here, like,
I'm not laying a torment on you!$

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_IllTryUsingBugMons
text: I don't really like BUG POKéMON,\nbut maybe I'll try using some for\la change of pace.\pWho knows, I might even get to like\nthem!$

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_LookForwardToNextVisit
text: We look forward to your next visit.$

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_NiceIfMoreSelection
text: Wouldn't it be nice if they had more of\na selection?$

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_NoRoomInBagMakeRoom
text: Oh?\nYou seem to have no room for this.\pPlease make room in your BAG and\nlet me know.$

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_ReturnRentalMonsSaveResults
text: Thank you for participating!\pI will return your POKéMON in exchange\nfor our rental POKéMON.\pI must also save your event results.\nPlease wait.$

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_StepThisWay
text: Please step this way.$

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_WelcomeToBattleTent
text: Welcome to the BATTLE TENT\nSLATEPORT SITE!\pI am your guide to the Battle Swap\nTournament.$

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_WonThreeMatchesReturnMons
text:
Congratulations!
You've won three straight matches!\pI will return your POKéMON in exchange
for our rental POKéMON.\pI must also save your event results.
Please wait.$

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_AbnormalWeather
text:
For a ship to sail safely, we need to
know about the weather!\pSpeaking of weather, I heard something
from a guy at the WEATHER INSTITUTE.\pHe was saying abnormal weather has
been reported all over the place!\pYou should visit the WEATHER INSTITUTE
and ask around!$

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_ArchieYouAgainHideoutInLilycove
text:
ARCHIE: Oh?
Not you again…\pYou are tenacious to track us here,
that much I will give you.\pBut now…
No one can stop us! No one!\pOr, will you follow us back to our
HIDEOUT in LILYCOVE CITY?\pFwahahahaha…$

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_BattleFrontierItIs
text: BATTLE FRONTIER it is, then!$

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_CaptSternWhyStealMySubmarine
text:
CAPT. STERN: Why…\pWhy would TEAM AQUA steal my
SUBMARINE EXPLORER 1?\pThey can't be after the slumbering
POKéMON at the bottom of the sea…\pBut even if I were to chase them,
I don't stand a chance against them…$

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_FerryServiceUnavailable
text: I beg your pardon?\nYou're looking for a ship?\pI'm sorry, the ferry service isn't\navailable at present…$

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_FinishedMakingFerry
text: CAPT. STERN: {PLAYER}{KUN}!\pWe finally finished making the ferry\nS.S. TIDAL!\pWe couldn't have done it without\nyour friend MR. BRINEY.\pPlease go for a short cruise on it!$

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_FlashedTicketWhereTo
text: {PLAYER} flashed the TICKET.\pPerfect! That's all you need!\pAnd where would you like to go?$

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_HandedScannerToStern
text: {PLAYER} handed the SCANNER to\nCAPT. STERN.$

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_IfYouWantToTradeLetMeKnow
text: CAPT. STERN: Are you certain?\nIt's useless to you, {PLAYER}{KUN}…\pWell, okay, then. If you want to trade\nyour SCANNER, let me know.$

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_LilycoveItIs
text: LILYCOVE CITY it is, then!$

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_LoveToGoDeepUnderwaterSomeday
text: A journey to the bottom of the sea…\nI wonder what it'd be like?\pI'd love to go deep underwater like\nthat someday.$

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_MayISeeYourTicket
text: Hello, are you here for the ferry?\nMay I see your TICKET?$

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_NeedDiveToCatchSub
text:
CAPT. STERN: Trying to catch a
submarine… It's impossible.\pYou would need a POKéMON that knows
how to DIVE…\pPerhaps if you went out to
MOSSDEEP CITY…\pA lot of divers live out there, so
someone might teach you…$

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_PleaseBoardFerry
text: Please board the ferry and wait for\ndeparture.$

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_SailAnotherTime
text: Please sail with us another time!$

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_SameThugsTriedToRobAtMuseum
text: CAPT. STERN: Those thugs…\pThey're the same lot who tried to rob\nthe DEVON GOODS at the MUSEUM.$

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_SubTooSmallForMe
text: I wanted to go with CAPT. STERN on\nthe ocean floor exploration.\pBut the sub's too small for me.\pIf I squeezed in, there wouldn't be\nany room for the CAPTAIN…$

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_TeamAquaLeftNeedDive
text:
CAPT. STERN: Oh, {PLAYER}{KUN}…\pOkay… So TEAM AQUA left before you
could stop them…\pOh, no, don't blame yourself.
You're not responsible for this.\pTrying to catch a submarine…
It's impossible for most people.\pYou would need a POKéMON that knows
how to DIVE…\pPerhaps if you went out to
MOSSDEEP CITY…\pA lot of divers live out there, so
someone might teach you…$

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_ThisWillHelpResearch
text: CAPT. STERN: Thanks, {PLAYER}{KUN}!\nThis will help our research a lot!$

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_TradeForDeepSeaScale
text: CAPT. STERN: So you'll trade it for\nmy DEEPSEASCALE?$

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_TradeForDeepSeaTooth
text: CAPT. STERN: So you'll trade it for\nmy DEEPSEATOOTH?$

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_WhereWouldYouLikeToGo
text: Then, where would you like to go?$

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_WhichOneDoYouWant
text: CAPT. STERN: Which one do you want?$

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_WontBeLongBeforeWeFinishFerry
text: CAPT. STERN: Oh, yes.\nMR. BRINEY came to our SHIPYARD.\pIt won't be long now before we finish\nmaking the ferry!$

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_WouldYouTradeScanner
text:
CAPT. STERN: Oh?
{PLAYER}{KUN}, that item you have…\pThat's a SCANNER! That would sure
help us on our explorations.\p{PLAYER}{KUN}, would you trade your
SCANNER for something?\pLike, say, a DEEPSEATOOTH or
a DEEPSEASCALE that I have?$

label: SlateportCity_House_Text_MustBeGoingToBattleTent
text: You're a TRAINER, aren't you?\pSince you came to SLATEPORT CITY,\nyou must be going to the BATTLE TENT.$

label: SlateportCity_House_Text_NatureToDoWithStatGains
text: My POKéMON has a HASTY nature.\pIt has higher SPEED compared to\nmy other POKéMON.\pMaybe their nature has something to\ndo with the stat gains of POKéMON.$

label: SlateportCity_Mart_Text_GreatBallIsBetter
text: A GREAT BALL is better than a POKé BALL\nat catching POKéMON.\pWith this, I should be able to get that\nelusive POKéMON…$

label: SlateportCity_Mart_Text_SomeItemsOnlyAtMart
text: The MARKET does have some interesting\nmerchandise.\pBut there are some items you can only\nget at a POKéMON MART.$

label: SlateportCity_NameRatersHouse_Text_CritiqueWhichMonNickname
text: Which POKéMON's nickname should\nI critique?$

label: SlateportCity_NameRatersHouse_Text_DoVisitAgain
text: I see.\nDo come visit again.$

label: SlateportCity_NameRatersHouse_Text_FineNameSuggestBetterOne
text: Hmmm… {STR_VAR_1}, is it? That is\nquite a fine name you bestowed.\pBut! What say you, if I were to\nsuggest a slightly better name?$

label: SlateportCity_NameRatersHouse_Text_MagnificentName
text: Hmmm… {STR_VAR_1} it is!\pThis is a magnificent nickname!\nIt is impeccably beyond reproach!\pYou'll do well to cherish your\n{STR_VAR_1} now and beyond.$

label: SlateportCity_NameRatersHouse_Text_MonShallBeKnownAsName
text: Done! From now on, this POKéMON\nshall be known as {STR_VAR_1}!\pIt is a better name than before!\nHow fortunate for you!$

label: SlateportCity_NameRatersHouse_Text_NameNoDifferentYetSuperior
text: Done! From now on, this POKéMON\nshall be known as {STR_VAR_1}!\pIt looks no different from before,\nand yet, this is vastly superior!\pHow fortunate for you!$

label: SlateportCity_NameRatersHouse_Text_PleasedToRateMonNickname
text: Hi, hi! I'm the NAME RATER!\nI'm the fortune-teller of names!\pI shall be pleased to rate your\nPOKéMON's nickname.$

label: SlateportCity_NameRatersHouse_Text_ThatIsMerelyAnEgg
text: Now, now.\nThat is merely an EGG!$

label: SlateportCity_NameRatersHouse_Text_WhatShallNewNameBe
text: Ah, good. Then, what shall the new\nnickname be?$

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_AquaExistForGoodOfAll
text: We, TEAM AQUA, exist for the good\nof all!$

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_BeachSandDisplay
text: It's a sample of beach sand.\p“Stones from mountains are washed\ndown by rivers where they are\lchipped and ground down.\p“They are reduced to grains and end\nup as sand on beaches.”$

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_BetterWriteUpStory
text: Hmmm…\nI've got a good story for a TV program.\pI'd better write it up in a hurry!$

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_CanLearnForNefariousDeeds
text: What I learn here, I can put to use on\nnefarious deeds…$

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_CatchUpWithYourGroup
text: Oh? You're with that group that\nwent in earlier?\pYou're the only one who's late.\nYou'd better go catch up to them!$

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_DepthMeasuringMachine
text: A strange machine is rotating under\na glass dome.\pMaybe it's for measuring the depth\nof something…$

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_DidntHaveMoney
text: I didn't have ¥50, so it took a long\ntime getting by the receptionist.$

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_FossilDisplay
text:
It's a fossil with wavy ridges on it.\p“Soil on the ocean floor gets scoured
by the tide.\p“The flowing seawater marks the soil
with small ridges and valleys.\p“If this soil becomes fossilized, it is
called a ripple mark.”$

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_HopeINeverSeeYouAgain
text: That TM, it suits you more than it\ndoes me.\pHope I never see you again!\nWahahaha!$

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_InterviewRequest
text:
Oh?
Do you perhaps like POKéMON?\pI'm on assignment with the TV network.\pI'm gathering stories on POKéMON and
TRAINERS that occurred recently.\pIf you don't mind, could you tell me
something about yourself?$

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_InterviewRequestShort
text: I'm gathering stories on POKéMON and\nTRAINERS that occurred recently.\pIf you don't mind, could you tell me\nsomething about yourself?$

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_LearnAboutSeaForBattling
text: I want to learn about the sea and\nuse that knowledge for battling.$

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_LetMeKnowIfYouHaveStory
text: Oh, I see…\pWell, if you do have an interesting\nstory to tell, please let me know.$

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_MustBePokemonWeDontKnow
text: The sea is vast without end, and\ninfinitely deep…\pThere must be many POKéMON that\nwe don't know about.$

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_NotEnoughMoney
text: Oh? I'm sorry, but you don't seem to\nhave enough money.$

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_OceanSoilDisplay
text:
It's a sample of soil from the ocean
floor.\p“Over many years, the remains of
life-forms settle at the bottom of\lthe sea, making sedimentary layers.\p“By analyzing these layers, the
ancient past is revealed.”$

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_OceanicMinifact1
text:
“OCEANIC MINIFACT 1
Why is seawater blue?\p“Light is composed of many colors.\p“When light passes through water,
most kinds of light lose color.\p“However, blue light retains its
color, making the sea appear blue.”$

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_OceanicMinifact2
text:
“OCEANIC MINIFACT 2
Why is the sea salty?\p“Seawater contains dissolved salt in
the form of sodium and chlorine ions.\p“These ions leech out of rocks
and are carried out to sea by rain.\p“The concentration of dissolved salt
makes the sea salty.”$

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_OceanicMinifact3
text:
“OCEANIC MINIFACT 3
Which is bigger? The sea or land?\p“The sea covers about 70% of
the planet, and the rest is land.\p“The sea is therefore more than twice
the size of land.”$

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_OurBossIsntHere
text: We were told to assemble here,\nso we did, but…\pOur BOSS, the linchpin, isn't here.$

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_PleaseEnjoyYourself
text: Please enjoy yourself.$

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_RememberMeTakeThis
text:
Aiyeeeh!
What are you doing here?\pMe? I'm the TEAM AQUA member
you thumped before, remember?\lBack in RUSTURF TUNNEL?\pHere, take this!
You have to forgive me!$

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_RustboroBungled
text: If our goons didn't bungle things\nin RUSTBORO, we wouldn't be here!$

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_SternIsRoleModel
text: I get all giddy and gooey when\nI see the sea!\pFor me, CAPT. STERN is the number\none role model!$

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_TellMeExperienceInvolvingPokemon
text: Oh, you will?\nThank you!\pThen, please, tell me anything of\ninterest that you experienced recently\linvolving POKéMON.$

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_ThatsAllForInterview
text: Oh, what an uplifting story!\pI'll be sure to get your story told\non television.\pIt should be aired sometime, I think,\nso please look forward to it.$

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_WantSeaPokemon
text: I want a sea POKéMON.\pI think it would feel cool and nice\nto hug.$

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_WaterfallExperiment
text: A red ball is bobbing up and down\ninside a glass vessel.\p“This is an experiment simulating a\nWATERFALL using the ball's buoyancy.”$

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_WhirlpoolExperiment
text: A blue fluid is spiraling inside\na glass vessel.\p“This is an experiment to create a\nWHIRLPOOL artificially using wind.”$

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_WouldStuffHereMakeMeRich
text: If I ripped off the stuff here,\nwould it make me rich?$

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_WouldYouLikeToEnter
text: Welcome to the OCEANIC MUSEUM.\pThe entrance fee is ¥50.\nWould you like to enter?$

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_YouHaveToTakeThis
text: Awww, come on!\nYou have to take this and let me go!$

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_ArchieWarning
text:
We are TEAM AQUA,
and we love the sea!\pAnd I am TEAM AQUA's leader,
ARCHIE!\pWhat makes you interfere with us?\p…No! You can't be!
You're not one of TEAM MAGMA?\pWait, that can't be right.
You're not dressed for the part.\p… … … … … …
… … … … … …\pPOKéMON, people… All life depends on
the sea.\pSo, TEAM AQUA is dedicated to
the expansion of the sea.\pDon't you agree? What we are doing
is a magnificent undertaking.\pAh, fine…
You're still too young to understand\lour noble objective.\pBut, I warn you, don't even consider
interfering with our plans again.\pThe consequences will cost you
dearly!\pAnd don't you forget it!$

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_BossGoingToBeFurious
text: Oh, man, what a disaster…\nThe BOSS is going to be furious…$

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_CameToSeeWhatsTakingSoLong
text: I came to see what was taking so\nlong to snatch some parts, and you\lsimps are held up by a mere child?$

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_DeepSeawaterDisplay
text: It's a display on the flow of seawater.\p“Near the bottom of the sea, water\nflows due to differences in such\lfactors as temperature and salinity.”$

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_DontRunInMuseum
text: Don't you dare run around inside\nthe MUSEUM!$

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_Grunt1Defeat
text: Awaaaah!\nA kid beat me!$

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_Grunt2Defeat
text: What?!\nI lost, too!$

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_HoennModel
text: “MODEL OF HOENN REGION”\pIt's a miniature diorama of the\nHOENN region.\pWhere is LITTLEROOT TOWN on this?$

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_LetMeTakeCareOfThis
text: Humph, sniveling wimp!\nLet me take care of this!$

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_MeddlingKid
text: Now what? If we don't get the parts,\nwe're in for it!\pArrgh, I didn't count on being meddled\nwith by some meddling kid!$

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_PressureExperiment
text:
A rubber ball is expanding and
shrinking.\p“In the sea, the weight of water itself
exerts pressure.\p“In shallow water, the pressure is not
very heavy.\p“However, in extremely deep water,
the pressure can reach even tens of\lthousands of tons on a small area.”$

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_RemindsMeOfAbandonedShip
text: I saw a model of a ship here.\pIt reminded me of the ABANDONED SHIP\nnear DEWFORD TOWN…$

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_SSAnneReplica
text: “S.S. ANNE\p“A replica of the luxury liner that\ncircles the globe.”$

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_SSTidalReplica
text: “THE FERRY S.S. TIDAL\p“A scale replica of the ship under\nconstruction at STERN'S SHIPYARD.”$

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_SternIveGotToGo
text:
CAPT. STERN: Whoops!
There's no time to lose!\pWe have to set out on our ocean-floor
expedition really soon.\pThanks again, but now I've got
to go!\pFeel free to wander around and check
out our facilities, though.$

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_SternThankYouForSavingUs
text:
CAPT. STERN: You're…
Ah, okay, you're {PLAYER}{KUN}…\pAnyway, that was a tense situation!
Thank you for saving us!\pOh, yes, I almost forgot that you
even brought the parts from DEVON!$

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_SternWhoAreYou
text: CAPT. STERN: Wh-what?\nWho are you people?$

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_SubmarineReplica
text: “SUBMARINE EXPLORER 1\p“A replica of the high-performance\nocean floor exploration submarine.”$

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_SumbersibleReplica
text: “SUBMERSIBLE POD\p“A replica of a compact, unmanned\npod for seafloor exploration.”$

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_SurfaceSeawaterDisplay
text: It's a display on the flow of seawater.\p“Toward the surface, seawater flows\nas currents driven by the winds.”$

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_ThankYouForTheParts
text:
Yes? If you're looking for STERN,
that would be me.\pAh! Those must be the parts I ordered
from MR. STONE of DEVON.\pThank you! That's great!
We can prepare for our expedition now.$

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_WantToRideSubmarine
text: Wow, the submarine's awesome!\nI want to go for a ride!$

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_WaterQualitySample1
text: “WATER QUALITY SAMPLE 1,” the\nlabel says.\pThe sea is all connected, but the\nwater seems to differ by region.$

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_WaterQualitySample2
text: “WATER QUALITY SAMPLE 2,” the\nlabel says.\pDoes the saltiness of seawater differ\nby region, too?$

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_WellTakeThoseParts
text: Hehehe, hold it!\nWe'll take those parts!$

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_WereTeamAqua
text: We're TEAM AQUA!\pOur BOSS wants those parts!\nShut your yap and fork them over!$

label: SlateportCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_RaiseDifferentTypesOfPokemon
text:
Want a tip for battling?\pI'd say it's raising different kinds
of POKéMON in a balanced manner.\pIt's no good to make just one
POKéMON strong.\pIf it has a type disadvantage,
it might not stand a chance.$

label: SlateportCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_TradedMonWithFriend
text: I trade POKéMON with my friends.\pIf a traded POKéMON is holding an\nitem, it makes me twice as happy!$

label: SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_AllowMeToExamineYourPokemon
text:
Er-hem! I see you've participated in
a POKéMON CONTEST!\pPlease! Allow me to examine how you
have raised your POKéMON.\pIt delights me no end to see POKéMON
raised by other TRAINERS.\pThe happy expressions of POKéMON
raised with proper care…\pThe kindly eyes of the TRAINER that
nurtured and raised the POKéMON…\pThe very thought fills my heart to
overwhelming with joy.\pOh! I do beg your pardon!
Forgive me for prattling on so!\pPlease! Allow me to examine how much
your POKéMON has grown!$

label: SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_Azumarill
text: AZUMARILL: Marimari?$

label: SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_DescribeFeelingsFirstMetMon
text: When you first met {STR_VAR_1},\nwhat did you feel?\pHow would you describe your feelings\nat the time?$

label: SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_EnjoyDoingInterviews
text: I enjoy this job--you get to learn\nabout POKéMON by doing interviews.$

label: SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_ExplainBlueScarf
text: Let a POKéMON hold that BLUE SCARF.\pIts beauty will be accentuated much\nmore than now!$

label: SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_ExplainGreenScarf
text: Let a POKéMON hold that GREEN SCARF.\pThat will enhance the\nsmartness of POKéMON!$

label: SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_ExplainPinkScarf
text: Let a POKéMON hold that PINK SCARF.\pIt will draw out the cuteness of\nthe POKéMON some more!$

label: SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_ExplainRedScarf
text: Let a POKéMON hold that RED SCARF.\pEveryone will recognize the coolness\nof that POKéMON!$

label: SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_ExplainYellowScarf
text: Let a POKéMON hold that YELLOW SCARF.\pIt will bolster your POKéMON's\ntoughness so much more!$

label: SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_GiveMonMorePokeblocks
text:
Hmmm… It's not bad, but it's not
good, either…\pYou, the TRAINER, must put more
effort into raising this POKéMON!\pFor instance, may I suggest that
you give it more {POKEBLOCK}S?$

label: SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_HereGoesQuickAnswers
text: Great! Thank you!\pOkay, here goes.\nI just need quick answers, okay?$

label: SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_HereIfYouGetUrgeToTellMe
text: Oh, okay…\pWell, if you get the urge to tell me\nabout POKéMON, I'll be here!$

label: SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_HmHmISee
text: Hm, hm…\nI see…$

label: SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_HowIsYourPokemonGrowing
text: How is your POKéMON growing?\nAllow me to examine it.$

label: SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_InterviewRequest
text:
Hi, you seem to be very close to your
{STR_VAR_1}.\pDo you know what?
I'm a TV reporter.\pI travel around interviewing people
about POKéMON.\pI'm wondering if you'd be willing to tell
me a little about your {STR_VAR_1}?$

label: SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_InterviewRequestHasName
text:
Wow!\pIt's plain to see that you lavish your
love on your {STR_VAR_1}.\pOkay, it's named {STR_VAR_2}.\pCan I ask you a favor?\pI'm a TV reporter, and I'm running
a survey on POKéMON.\pWould you be willing to answer a few
simple questions for me?$

label: SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_LikeToSeeEnteredContestPokemon
text: The POKéMON of a TRAINER who has\nentered a POKéMON CONTEST…\lThat, I would like to see.$

label: SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_LikenMonToSomethingYouLike
text: Your {STR_VAR_1} is cared for lovingly.\pIf you were to liken it to something\nthat you like, what would it be?$

label: SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_MeetChairman
text:
Er-hem! I am the CHAIRMAN of the
POKéMON FAN CLUB!\pBeing the CHAIRMAN, I am naturally
the most important!\pNo one can best me when it comes
to raising POKéMON. No one!\pWell, let me tell you about
POKéMON CONTESTS.\pThey're events where one can show off
POKéMON for the world to see!\pHowever, they're held in far-off towns,
so I cannot participate often enough.\pThat is why we gather here to show
off our POKéMON, and have others\lshow us theirs.$

label: SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_MonEnjoyedProtein
text: Do POKéMON enjoy having items used\non them?\pMine acted really happy when I gave\nit some PROTEIN.$

label: SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_MonMostImpressiveGiveItThis
text: Your {STR_VAR_1}, it is growing in\na most impressive manner!\lIt is one fine specimen!\pBut! If you were to give it this,\nit would grow even better! Indeed!$

label: SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_NoSpaceForReward
text: Oh, my…\pYour POKéMON is growing quite well,\nso you deserve a reward.\pUnfortunately, you have no space for\nthis in your BAG.$

label: SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_NothingElseToGiveYou
text: I'm sorry, but I've nothing else to\ngive you! None at all!\pAfter all, you're blessed with the gift\nof raising POKéMON without resorting\lto any items!$

label: SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_PokemonAdoresYou
text: Your POKéMON really adores you.\pFor you, a most compassionate\nTRAINER, a gift from the FAN CLUB!$

label: SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_PokemonDontLikeFainting
text:
If you keep letting a POKéMON faint
in battle, it'll come to resent it.\pSoon, it will become less trusting
of the TRAINER.\pIn other words, it certainly won't
like you very much.$

label: SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_ShowMePokemonThatLoveYou
text:
I love seeing POKéMON that love
their TRAINERS.\pPOKéMON are very sensitive to
the feelings of their TRAINERS.\pIf you treat your POKéMON with love
and care, they'll love you back.\pWhen your POKéMON grow to love you,
please come show me.$

label: SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_Skitty
text: SKITTY: Fffnyaaaah…$

label: SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_TellMeAnythingAboutYourMon
text: Wow, thank you!\pOkay, then, please tell me anything\nyou'd like about your {STR_VAR_1}.$

label: SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_ThatsAllForInterview
text:
I see!\pHmhm…\pOkay!
Thanks for helping me out.\pIt was fun and enlightening
chatting with you.\pIt's possible that our interview will
end up on TV. Tune in and check!\pOkay, that's all.
Bye-bye!$

label: SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_ThatsAllForInterview2
text:
Wow…
That's an interesting account.\pYou really are tight with {STR_VAR_1},
aren't you?\pI get the feeling that your account
will make a great TV story.\pI promise that I'll turn this into
an entertaining show.\lKeep your eyes out for it.\pOkay, that's all.
Bye-bye!$

label: SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_TreatPokemonWithLove
text: POKéMON are very sensitive to\nthe feelings of their TRAINERS.\pIf you treat your POKéMON with love\nand care, they'll love you back.$

label: SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_WhatAttractedYouAboutMon
text: This question also relates to your\nbeloved {STR_VAR_1}.\pWhat was it about {STR_VAR_1} that\nattracted you?$

label: SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_WhatDoPokemonMeanToYou
text: Okay, that makes sense.\pThe next question might be a little\non the tough side.\pHere goes…\pWhat do POKéMON mean to you?$

label: SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_Zigzagoon
text: ZIGZAGOON: Kyuuu…$

label: SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1F_Text_BrineyJoinedUs
text: DOCK: Hi! MR. BRINEY's joined us to\nlend us his help.\pThanks to the veteran sailor, the\nferry is steadily coming together.$

label: SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1F_Text_CantMakeHeadsOrTails
text:
Umm… If this goes here, and that
goes over there…\pThen where does this thing go?
And what about that doohickey?\pAaargh! I can't make heads or tails
of this!$

label: SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1F_Text_CouldUseAdviceFromVeteran
text: DOCK: Shipbuilding is an art.\pA lot of things can't be figured out\njust by calculating.\pI really could use advice from a veteran\nwho knows the seas…$

label: SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1F_Text_CouldYouFindStern
text: DOCK: Where could CAPT. STERN have\ngone off to?\pCould you go find CAPT. STERN and\ndeliver that parcel to him?$

label: SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1F_Text_DecidedToHelpDock
text:
MR. BRINEY: Ah, {PLAYER}{KUN}!
It's been too long!\pAye, since I met you, this old sea dog's
been feeling frisky!\pSo I've decided to help DOCK make
a ferry.\pAye, after all, a ferry would be able
to carry a lot of people.\pBut, you know, that DOCK is really
something special.\pWith his knack for technology and
my experience, I'm sure that we can\lbuild one great ship, aye!$

label: SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1F_Text_FerryIsReady
text:
DOCK: The ferry is finally ready!\pThe new S.S. TIDAL is truly a marvel
of technology!\pBut, I get the feeling that we can
make something even better.\pYou know, there's never an end to
technology's march.$

label: SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1F_Text_GetSeasickEasily
text: I get seasick real easily.\nSo I get to help out here instead.$

label: SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1F_Text_MeetDockDeliverToStern
text:
Hm?
Hi, I'm DOCK.\pCAPT. STERN commissioned me to
design a ferry.\pOh! That there…
Are they DEVON GOODS?\pBut, hmm…
This won't do…\pCAPT. STERN went off somewhere.
He said he had some work to do.\pCould I get you to go find CAPT.
STERN and deliver that to him?$

label: SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1F_Text_SeaIsLikeLivingThing
text:
The seasons, the weather, where
the moon sits in the sky…\pThese and other conditions make
the sea change its expression.\pThat's right!
The sea is like a living thing!$

label: SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_2F_Text_FloatsBecauseBuoyancy
text: Don't you think it's strange that\na ship made of heavy iron floats?\pIt floats because of a principle\ncalled buoyancy.$

label: SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_2F_Text_ShipDesignMoreLikeBuilding
text: Designing a large ship is more like\nmaking a big building than putting\ltogether a transportation vehicle.$

label: SlateportCity_Text_AmIOnTV
text: Hey! Are you watching?\nAm I on TV?$

label: SlateportCity_Text_AquaHasPolicy
text: TEAM AQUA has a policy of\nassembling and dispersing at\lthe operation site.$

label: SlateportCity_Text_AquaWillAssumeControlOfSubmarine
text:
Fufufu…
CAPT. STERN, I presume.\pWe of TEAM AQUA will assume
control of your submarine!\pYour objections are meaningless!
We expect your total cooperation!\pFufufu…
Just watch and learn what TEAM\lAQUA has planned!$

label: SlateportCity_Text_BattleTentBuiltRecently
text:
Recently, a BATTLE TENT was built
in SLATEPORT.\pGYMS are fun, but the BATTLE TENT's
awesome in its own way.\pYou should go find tough POKéMON
for the BATTLE TENT!$

label: SlateportCity_Text_BattleTentSign
text: BATTLE TENT SLATEPORT SITE\n“Find it! The ultimate POKéMON!”$

label: SlateportCity_Text_BigSmileForCamera
text: TY: Okay, CAPT. STERN, a big smile\nfor the camera!$

label: SlateportCity_Text_BossIsBrilliant
text: Our BOSS is brilliant.\pWhat would he want to do with\na MUSEUM now?$

label: SlateportCity_Text_BroughtMeSomeBerryPowder
text: Have you brought me some\nBERRY POWDER?$

label: SlateportCity_Text_BushedHikingFromMauville
text: Whew… I'm just bushed…\pI hiked over from MAUVILLE CITY.\nBut, boy, this city's huge.\pIf I'd known this, I would've ridden\nmy BIKE here.$

label: SlateportCity_Text_BuyBricksSoDecorWontGetDirty
text: If you put DOLLS or CUSHIONS on\nthe floor, they'll get dirty.\pI'm going to buy some BRICKS so my\nDOLLS and CUSHIONS won't get dirty\lwhen I leave them out.$

label: SlateportCity_Text_BuyTooMuch
text: Whenever I visit here, I get carried\naway and buy too much.$

label: SlateportCity_Text_CantChangeTradeMonName
text: Any POKéMON you get in a trade,\nyou can't change its nickname.\pThe original TRAINER's love for that\nPOKéMON is in the nickname.$

label: SlateportCity_Text_CaptSternBeingInterviewed
text: I was hoping that it was a famous star\nso I could get an autograph.\pBut who's that being interviewed?\nIsn't that CAPT. STERN?$

label: SlateportCity_Text_CaptainComeBackWithBigFish
text: What's going on here?\pDid the good CAPTAIN come back with\na big fish from the ocean floor?$

label: SlateportCity_Text_CaptainsACelebrity
text: A TV interview! Here!\nThe CAPTAIN's a celebrity!$

label: SlateportCity_Text_CitySign
text: SLATEPORT CITY\p“The port where people and POKéMON\ncross paths.”$

label: SlateportCity_Text_ComeBackToTradeBerryPowder
text: Come back if you'd like to trade your\nBERRY POWDER for some medicine.\pI'm always running a bazaar here.\pDid you know?$

label: SlateportCity_Text_DontButtIn
text: Hey, you there!\nDon't butt in!$

label: SlateportCity_Text_DontHaveEnoughBerryPowder
text: Oh, dear. You don't have enough\nBERRY POWDER.$

label: SlateportCity_Text_EffortRibbonLooksGoodOnIt
text: Oh! Your {STR_VAR_1}, that EFFORT\nRIBBON looks good on it!$

label: SlateportCity_Text_EnergyGuruSellWhatYouNeed
text: I'm the ENERGY GURU! I'll go for it and\nsell you what you need!$

label: SlateportCity_Text_EveryoneCallsHimCaptStern
text: STERN, the fellow who built the\nMUSEUM, also happens to be the leader\lof an undersea exploration team.\pSo, everyone calls him CAPT. STERN.$

label: SlateportCity_Text_ExchangeBerryPowderForItem
text: Okay, you want to exchange your\nBERRY POWDER for one {STR_VAR_1}?$

label: SlateportCity_Text_ExchangeWhatWithIt
text: What would you like to exchange\nit with?$

label: SlateportCity_Text_ExplainBerries
text:
If a wild POKéMON gets hurt, it heals
itself by chewing on BERRIES.\pDid you know that?\pSomebody saw that and got the idea
of making medicine from BERRIES.\pDid you know that?\pTo turn BERRIES into medicine,
they must be crushed into powder.\pDid you know that?\pYou seem to have an interest
in BERRIES!\pI've got something good for someone
like you.$

label: SlateportCity_Text_ExplainBerryPowder
text:
I recently had machines installed at
POKéMON CENTERS for crushing BERRIES.\pThe BERRY CRUSH machines are at
the DIRECT CORNER upstairs.\pDid you know?\pCould you make BERRY POWDER for
me using those machines?\pI can make you all sorts of medicine
if you bring me lots of BERRY POWDER.$

label: SlateportCity_Text_FineBerryPowderTradeSomethingElse
text: This is fine BERRY POWDER.\nIt will make excellent medicine.\pWould you like to trade more of your\nBERRY POWDER for something else?$

label: SlateportCity_Text_FromHarborTryingToTakeSub
text: It's from the HARBOR!\pThe submarine!\nThey're trying to take it!$

label: SlateportCity_Text_GabbyWonderfulThanksForInterview
text: GABBY: That's wonderful, CAPT. STERN!\nThank you for taking the time from\lyour busy schedule to talk to us.\pWe hope we can interview you again\nwith news of more discoveries!$

label: SlateportCity_Text_GetNameRaterToHelpYou
text: If you want to change your POKéMON's\nnickname, you'll have to get the NAME\lRATER to help you.$

label: SlateportCity_Text_GoForItLittleHarder
text: You have to go for it a little harder.\pIf you do, I'll give your POKéMON\nsomething nice.$

label: SlateportCity_Text_GoingToCompeteInBattleTent
text: Wroooar! I'm going to compete in\nthe BATTLE TENT, too!\pBut before that, I need to catch\nsome POKéMON!$

label: SlateportCity_Text_HarborFerryUnderConstruction
text: SLATEPORT HARBOR\p“The ferry S.S. TIDAL is under\nconstruction in the SHIPYARD.\p“Service is scheduled to begin\nshortly.”$

label: SlateportCity_Text_HarborSign
text: SLATEPORT HARBOR\p“Enjoy a delightful cruise on\nthe ferry S.S. TIDAL.”$

label: SlateportCity_Text_HotSpringsAfterOperation
text: When this operation's over, I'll take\nyou to a hot spring spa!\pThat's what our leader said.\nI can't wait!$

label: SlateportCity_Text_HowTownIsBornAndGrows
text: Where the water is clean, the fruits\nof bountiful harvest gather.\pAnd where people gather, a market\nsoon starts.\pThat is how a town is born and grows.$

label: SlateportCity_Text_IllReadSignForYou
text: You want to read this sign?\nI'll read it for you!$

label: SlateportCity_Text_InterviewerSoCool
text: That lady interviewer is so cool\nand pretty.\pWhen I grow up, I'm going to be\nan international journalist!$

label: SlateportCity_Text_KeepEyeOnTrainersBeSeeingYou
text: SCOTT: What I'd like to do is tag along\nwith you, but I do want to keep an eye\lon the talents of other people, too.\pSo, I'll be off to roam other towns\na bit more.\pBe seeing you, {PLAYER}{KUN}!$

label: SlateportCity_Text_LetsRegisterEachOther
text: SCOTT: All right! I think you're going\nto become a good friend.\pSo, let's register each other in our\nPOKéNAVS.\p… … … … … …$

label: SlateportCity_Text_MarketSign
text: SLATEPORT MARKET\n“Unique items found nowhere else!”$

label: SlateportCity_Text_MaybeThisTrainer
text: SCOTT: Hmm…\nMaybe, just maybe, this TRAINER…$

label: SlateportCity_Text_MostInvaluableExperience
text: GABBY: I see, I see. You've had a most\ninvaluable experience…$

label: SlateportCity_Text_NameRatersHouseSign
text: NAME RATER'S HOUSE\n“POKéMON nicknames rated.”$

label: SlateportCity_Text_OceanicMuseumSign
text: “The endless sea sustains\nall life.”\pOCEANIC MUSEUM$

label: SlateportCity_Text_OhPlayerWeMadeDiscovery
text:
Oh! {PLAYER}{KUN}!
You're looking great!\pWe made a huge discovery on our last
seafloor exploration.\pWe found an underwater cavern on
ROUTE 128.\pWe think it's the habitat of a POKéMON
that's said to have been long extinct.$

label: SlateportCity_Text_OhYourPokemon
text: Oh?\nYour {STR_VAR_1}…$

label: SlateportCity_Text_PleaseComeWithMe
text: {PLAYER}{KUN}!\nPlease, come with me!$

label: SlateportCity_Text_PleaseGiveItThisEffortRibbon
text: Went for it stupendously!\pAs its reward, please give it this\nEFFORT RIBBON.$

label: SlateportCity_Text_PokemonFanClubSign
text: POKéMON FAN CLUB\n“Calling all fans of POKéMON!”$

label: SlateportCity_Text_PutEffortRibbonOnMon
text: {PLAYER} put the EFFORT RIBBON\non {STR_VAR_1}.$

label: SlateportCity_Text_QuitPushing
text: Hey, there! Quit pushing!\nThis is the line, can't you see?$

label: SlateportCity_Text_ReceivedEffortRibbon
text: {PLAYER} received the EFFORT RIBBON.$

label: SlateportCity_Text_RegisteredScott
text: Registered this SCOTT person\nin the POKéNAV.$

label: SlateportCity_Text_RemindsMeOfLongLineForGames
text: A long line, huh?\pIt reminds me of the times I lined up to\nbuy smash-hit games…$

label: SlateportCity_Text_SaysSomethingLikeSeaIsEndless
text: Let's see…\pUm… I think it says something like\n“the life in the sea is endless.”\pYup, I'm pretty sure that's what\nit says.$

label: SlateportCity_Text_SeaIsSoWet
text: The sea is just so vast…\pCould the sea have been made by\nthe tears shed by POKéMON?$

label: SlateportCity_Text_SeaweedFullOfLife
text: Ooh, look at this!\pThe seaweed you can get around these\nparts is fresh and full of life.\pWhy, it looks like it can even rear up\nand attack!$

label: SlateportCity_Text_ShouldTakeItAll
text: If there's something we need in\nthe MUSEUM, we should take it all!$

label: SlateportCity_Text_ShouldveBroughtMyGameBoy
text: Grumble…\pI should've brought my Game Boy\nAdvance so I wouldn't get bored in line…\pGrumble…$

label: SlateportCity_Text_SinkOldBoats
text: Do you know what they do with old\nships that become too creaky to sail?\pThey sink them in the sea so they\nbecome habitats for POKéMON.$

label: SlateportCity_Text_SlateportWonderfulPlace
text: Shopping where you can breathe the\nscent of the ocean…\pSLATEPORT is such a wonderful place!$

label: SlateportCity_Text_SternMoveAheadWithExploration
text: CAPT. STERN: Yes, indeed. We intend to\nmove ahead with our exploration.$

label: SlateportCity_Text_SternSaysDiscoveredSomething
text: CAPT. STERN says they discovered\nsomething at the bottom of the sea.\pI wonder what it is?\nWhat could it be?$

label: SlateportCity_Text_SternWhatWasAllThat
text: CAPT. STERN: What was that all about?\pIt sounded like someone using\na megaphone…\pWhere did it come from?$

label: SlateportCity_Text_SternWhewFirstInterview
text: CAPT. STERN: Whew…\pThat was my first time to be filmed for\nTV. That was nerve-wracking.$

label: SlateportCity_Text_SternsShipyardFerryComplete
text: STERN'S SHIPYARD\p“Boarding of the SLATEPORT-LILYCOVE\nferry S.S. TIDAL is handled at the\lHARBOR.”$

label: SlateportCity_Text_SternsShipyardNearsCompletion
text: STERN'S SHIPYARD\p“The ferry S.S. TIDAL nears\ncompletion for serving the ports of\lSLATEPORT and LILYCOVE.”$

label: SlateportCity_Text_SternsShipyardWantedSign
text: STERN'S SHIPYARD\p“Wanted: A sailor capable of sailing\nin all currents.”$

label: SlateportCity_Text_TakingBattleTentChallenge
text:
SCOTT: Oh, hey!
If it isn't {PLAYER}{KUN}!\p{PLAYER}{KUN}, let me guess--you're going
to take the BATTLE TENT challenge?\pYeah! That's a good idea!
That's a really great idea!\pAfter all, a tough TRAINER is
the perfect fit for the BATTLE TENT!\pGive it your best effort!$

label: SlateportCity_Text_VisitedMuseumOften
text: When I was a child, I visited\nthe MUSEUM often.\pI used to dream about the mysteries of\nthe sea after seeing the exhibits.$

label: SlateportCity_Text_WhatDoYouWant
text: What?\nWhat do you want?$

label: SlateportCity_Text_WhatsLongLineOverThere
text: What is that over there?\nThat long line…$

label: SlateportCity_Text_WhatsNewSchemeIWonder
text: What's the new scheme, I wonder?\pOur BOSS is scary when he's mad, so\nI'd better not screw things up…$

label: SlateportCity_Text_WhenYouGetMoreBringItToMe
text: Okay! When you get some more\nBERRY POWDER, bring it to me, please!$

label: SlateportCity_Text_WhyAreWeLiningUp
text: Why are we even lining up and paying?\nWe should just march in!$

label: SlateportCity_Text_WonderIfLighthouseStartlesPokemon
text: The light of the lighthouse reaches\ndozens of miles away.\pI wonder if it doesn't startle POKéMON\nin the sea.$

label: SlateportCity_Text_YouDroveTeamAquaAway
text:
SCOTT: Huh?
I'm sure I met you somewhere before.\pHave I introduced myself to you?
If not, my name's SCOTT.\pI just saw TEAM AQUA run away from
here like they were stung.\pLet me guess--you drove them away?$

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_ExplainRainBadgeTakeThis
text:
Having the RAIN BADGE shall assure you
the full obedience of all your POKéMON\lto your every command.\pThe RAIN BADGE also allows the use
of the HM move WATERFALL to scale\lwalls of cascading water.\pAnd, so that you never forget the
battle we shared, take this…$

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_ExplainWaterPulse
text: The TECHNICAL MACHINE I handed you\ncontains WATER PULSE.\pIn use, it will occasionally confuse\nthe target with ultrasonic waves.\p… … … … … …$

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_GoGetFortreeBadge
text: There remains but one BADGE to\nobtain in HOENN.\pIf you wish to challenge the POKéMON\nLEAGUE, you must obtain the last\lBADGE from the GYM in FORTREE.$

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_GymGuideAdvice
text:
Yo! How's it going, CHAMPION-
bound {PLAYER}?\pSOOTOPOLIS's GYM LEADER JUAN is
a master of WATER-type POKéMON.\pAnd, to get to JUAN, an icy floor
will hamper your progress…\pListen, I'm sorry, but that's all the
advice that I have for you.\pThe rest of the way, you have to
go for it yourself!$

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_GymGuidePostVictory
text: Yow! You've beaten even JUAN, who\nwas supposedly the best in all HOENN!\pOkay! Check out your TRAINER CARD.\pIf you've gotten all the BADGES, you're\nset for the POKéMON LEAGUE challenge!$

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_GymStatue
text: SOOTOPOLIS CITY POKéMON GYM$

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_GymStatueCertified
text: SOOTOPOLIS CITY POKéMON GYM\pJUAN'S CERTIFIED TRAINERS:\n{PLAYER}$

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_JuanDefeat
text:
Ahahaha, excellent!
Very well, you are the winner.\pFrom you, I sense the brilliant shine
of skill that will overcome all.\pHowever, compared with me or even
WALLACE, you are lacking in elegance.\pPerhaps I should make you a loan
of my outfit?\p… … … … … …
… … … … … …\pHahaha, I merely jest!\pRather than my clothes, I shall reward
you with this, the RAIN BADGE!$

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_JuanIntro
text:
Let me ask you.
Did you know?\lAh, I should not be so coy.\pIt was I who taught WALLACE everything
there is to know about POKéMON.\pOnce, I had given up my position as
the GYM LEADER.\pIn my place, I had entrusted WALLACE
with the GYM.\pHowever, a compelling reason arose for
me to make a comeback.\pAh, but enough chatter.
Let us begin our match, shall we?\pPlease, you shall bear witness to
our artistry.\pA grand illusion of water sculpted
by POKéMON and myself!$

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_JuanPostBattle
text:
The TRAINERS who have gathered all
the GYM BADGES of HOENN should make\lway to the ultimate destination.\pThe POKéMON LEAGUE.\pTravel to the easternmost reaches
of HOENN, to the island EVER GRANDE.\pThere, you shall find the POKéMON
LEAGUE.$

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_JuanPostRematch
text:
JUAN: If I told you to become my
apprentice, you will refuse, I am sure.\pI would like to make a gift of my coat
to you.\pBut again, you will refuse.
I imagine that to be so.\pAnd that, my friend, is a certain sign
of nobility!$

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_JuanPreRematch
text:
JUAN: Ah, this GYM had returned to its
usual state of serenity…\pBut our young typhoon has returned
to put us to the test again!\pWell, my friend, most certainly!\pI shall be delighted to dance with you
as often as you wish!$

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_JuanRematchDefeat
text: Ahahaha, you are the winner!\nYou have defeated me again!$

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_JuanRematchNeedTwoMons
text:
JUAN: Ah, this GYM had returned to its
usual state of serenity…\pBut our young typhoon has returned
to put us to the test again!\pWell, my friend, most certainly!
I shall be delighted to dance with you…\pAh, no, no, no.
You have with you but one POKéMON.\pI wish that you would return with
two, perhaps more, POKéMON, please.$

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_ReceivedRainBadge
text: {PLAYER} received the RAIN BADGE\nfrom JUAN.$

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_RegisteredJuan
text: Registered GYM LEADER JUAN\nin the POKéNAV.$

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_AndreaDefeat
text: Please forgive me, JUAN…$

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_AndreaIntro
text: I'll show you the sublime techniques\nI learned from our LEADER JUAN!$

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_AndreaPostBattle
text: Watch what happens if you crack all\nthe floor tiles.$

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_AnnikaDefeat
text: Oh, there now! Did you have a good look\nat my POKéMON?$

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_AnnikaIntro
text: I can battle with really rare POKéMON\nif you'd like.$

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_AnnikaPostBattle
text: I came to this GYM because JUAN\npraised me for my darling POKéMON.\pOh, if only I'd met JUAN years ago\nwhen I was younger…$

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_BethanyDefeat
text: Oops!$

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_BethanyIntro
text: When I'm with my POKéMON, the time\nflies by before you can say, “Oops!”$

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_BethanyPostBattle
text: I wish I could forget about lost causes\nbefore I can manage an “Oops!”$

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_BriannaDefeat
text: Oh, dear.\nI went much too easy on you.$

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_BriannaIntro
text: Giggle…\nYour grim look is so charming.$

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_BriannaPostBattle
text: You couldn't lay a finger on JUAN,\nI'm sure. Giggle…$

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_BridgetDefeat
text: What a high level you are!$

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_BridgetIntro
text: The POKéMON GYM of the highest level\nin the HOENN region…\pThat's the SOOTOPOLIS GYM.$

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_BridgetPostBattle
text: Rather than being satisfied by being\nin a strong GYM, I imagine training in\lother places will make you stronger.\lBut above all, it looks more fun.$

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_ConnieDefeat
text: Oh.\nYou're strong.$

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_ConnieIntro
text: I should teach you how harsh battles\ncan be.$

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_ConniePostBattle
text: I'll tell you something good.\pIf you want to reach JUAN, you\nneed to walk on each floor tile once.$

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_CrissyDefeat
text: You're strong!\nI was fooled by your cute looks!$

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_CrissyIntro
text: You came all the way here, but you won't\nget to see JUAN.\pNot if you lose to me, you won't!$

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_CrissyPostBattle
text: You might be good enough to avoid\nbeing wiped out in one hit by JUAN.$

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_DaphneDefeat
text: You battled with more beauty than\nI could muster…$

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_DaphneIntro
text: The sight of JUAN conducting\na battle…\pThe very beauty of it compelled me to\nbecome a TRAINER.$

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_DaphnePostBattle
text: The grace you bring to battle is\nfabulous.\pOh… I'm so fortunate to have found\nPOKéMON.$

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_OliviaDefeat
text: I was beaten…$

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_OliviaIntro
text: I train my POKéMON together with\nJUAN.\pDon't think I'm a pushover.$

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_OliviaPostBattle
text: I think you have potential.\nWhy don't you stay and train with us?$

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_TiffanyDefeat
text: Well, excuse me?!$

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_TiffanyIntro
text: A graceful glide across the ice while\ncrossing no lines…\pA TRAINER putting on that performance\nwould be elegantly beautiful!$

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_TiffanyPostBattle
text: This is really obvious, but how strong\nyou are as a TRAINER has nothing to do\lwith how young or old you are.$

label: SootopolisCity_House1_Text_DevelopedThisTM
text: For thirty years I've remained in\nSOOTOPOLIS honing my skills.\pI developed a shattering TM.\nI bequeath it to you!$

label: SootopolisCity_House1_Text_ExplainBrickBreak
text: TM31 contains BRICK BREAK! It's a move\nso horrible that I can't describe it.$

label: SootopolisCity_House1_Text_Kecleon
text: KECLEON: Puu puhyaah.$

label: SootopolisCity_House2_Text_DidYouKnowAboutMtPyreOrbs
text: MT. PYRE…\pAt its peak are two orbs placed side\nby side. Did you know?$

label: SootopolisCity_House2_Text_OughtToVisitAndSee
text: Is that so?\nPerhaps you ought to visit and see…$

label: SootopolisCity_House2_Text_YesTwoOrbsSideBySide
text: Yes, two orbs side by side…\pThe sight of them together…\nIt is somehow soothing…$

label: SootopolisCity_House3_Text_JuanHasManyFansDoYou
text: You're a POKéMON TRAINER, aren't you?\pSOOTOPOLIS's JUAN has many fans.\nEven more than his student WALLACE!\pDo you have any?$

label: SootopolisCity_House3_Text_LonesomeTryWorkingHarder
text: Oh, dear…\nThat's a little lonesome.\pTry working a little harder to get\na fan following.$

label: SootopolisCity_House3_Text_TrainerFanClubWasWild
text: Dedicated fans come over from even\noutside of HOENN.\pIt was really wild when I went to the\nTRAINER FAN CLUB in LILYCOVE.$

label: SootopolisCity_House3_Text_YouMustBePrettyStrong
text: Oh, then you must be pretty strong.$

label: SootopolisCity_House4_Text_AncientTreasuresWaitingInSea
text:
Listen up, and I'll tell you something
good.\pThere's supposed to be an ancient
ruin in the sea around here.\pThere could be treasures just waiting
to be discovered down there.$

label: SootopolisCity_House4_Text_Azumarill
text: AZUMARILL: Marurii.$

label: SootopolisCity_House4_Text_StrollUnderwaterWithPokemon
text: Ancient treasures…\pIt would be nice if they existed, but\neven if they didn't, it would be so\lbeautiful to take an underwater\lstroll with my POKéMON.$

label: SootopolisCity_House5_Text_BrotherUsedToStudySea
text: My big brother used to study the sea.$

label: SootopolisCity_House5_Text_SootopolisMtPyreConnection
text: There appears to be some connection\nbetween SOOTOPOLIS and MT. PYRE.\pMy friends and I did some research on\nit at the lab where I used to work.$

label: SootopolisCity_House6_Text_DontWantThisDoll
text: Are you sure?\nYou don't want this DOLL?$

label: SootopolisCity_House6_Text_FirstGuestInWhileTakeDoll
text: Hello! You're our first guest in\na good while.\pYou've brightened up my day, so I'll\ngive you a big WAILMER DOLL.$

label: SootopolisCity_House6_Text_IllHoldItForYou
text: Oh, you want it, but not right now?\nOkay, then I'll hold it for you.$

label: SootopolisCity_House6_Text_LovePlushDolls
text: I love plush DOLLS!$

label: SootopolisCity_House6_Text_TakeGoodCareOfIt
text: Take good care of it!$

label: SootopolisCity_House7_Text_CaveMadeToKeepSomething
text: The cave that links SOOTOPOLIS and\nthe outside world…\pIt seems as if the cave was made to\nkeep something from getting out.\pOr am I just imagining things?$

label: SootopolisCity_House7_Text_CityFromEruptedVolcano
text:
An underwater volcano erupted and
forced itself up from the depths.\pIts crater emerged from the sea and
became filled with rainwater.\pThat's how SOOTOPOLIS CITY came into
being.$

label: SootopolisCity_LotadAndSeedotHouse_Text_BagCrammedFull1
text: Hunh?\nYour BAG is crammed full.$

label: SootopolisCity_LotadAndSeedotHouse_Text_BagCrammedFull2
text: Hunh?\nYour BAG is crammed full.$

label: SootopolisCity_LotadAndSeedotHouse_Text_BiggestLotadInHistory
text: The biggest LOTAD in history!\n{STR_VAR_2}'s {STR_VAR_3} colossus!\pA LOTAD bigger than a SEEDOT\nalways wanted!$

label: SootopolisCity_LotadAndSeedotHouse_Text_BiggestSeedotInHistory
text: The biggest SEEDOT in history!\n{STR_VAR_2}'s {STR_VAR_3} giant!\pA SEEDOT bigger than a LOTAD\nalways wanted!$

label: SootopolisCity_LotadAndSeedotHouse_Text_DontHaveBigLotad
text: Don't you have a big LOTAD?\nHow disappointing…\pIf you get a big LOTAD, please\ncome show me!$

label: SootopolisCity_LotadAndSeedotHouse_Text_DontHaveBigSeedot
text: You don't have a big SEEDOT?\nThat's too bad…\pIf you get a big SEEDOT, please\ncome show me.$

label: SootopolisCity_LotadAndSeedotHouse_Text_GoshMightBeBiggerThanLotad
text:
{STR_VAR_2}!
Oh, my gosh, this is a big one!\pIt might even beat the big LOTAD
my younger brother saw!\pThanks for showing me.
This is my thanks!$

label: SootopolisCity_LotadAndSeedotHouse_Text_PleaseShowMeBigLotad
text:
Do you know the POKéMON LOTAD?
It's rarely seen in SOOTOPOLIS.\pI love, I mean love, big LOTAD!\pMy big brother says that SEEDOT is
bigger.\pBut that's wrong! Everyone knows that
LOTAD is a lot bigger.\pHunh? Do you have a LOTAD?
P-p-please show me!$

label: SootopolisCity_LotadAndSeedotHouse_Text_PleaseShowMeBigSeedot
text:
Do you know the POKéMON SEEDOT?
It's hardly ever seen in SOOTOPOLIS.\pAnyway, I love big SEEDOT.
The bigger the better.\pBut my younger brother, he says that
LOTAD is bigger.\pThat's silly.
SEEDOT has to be bigger than that!\pHuh? Do you have a SEEDOT with you?
P-p-please, show me!$

label: SootopolisCity_LotadAndSeedotHouse_Text_SeenBiggerLotad
text: {STR_VAR_2}?\pHmm… I've seen a bigger LOTAD\nthan this one here.$

label: SootopolisCity_LotadAndSeedotHouse_Text_SeenBiggerSeedot
text: {STR_VAR_2}, is it?\pHmm… I've seen a bigger SEEDOT\nthan this one.$

label: SootopolisCity_LotadAndSeedotHouse_Text_ThatsNotLotad
text: Well, isn't this something!\nBut it's no LOTAD!$

label: SootopolisCity_LotadAndSeedotHouse_Text_ThatsNotSeedot
text: Oh, now this is quite something…\nBut it's not a SEEDOT!$

label: SootopolisCity_LotadAndSeedotHouse_Text_WowMightBeBiggerThanSeedot
text:
{STR_VAR_2}!
Wow, that is big!\pIt might be even bigger than the huge
SEEDOT my big brother saw.\pThanks for showing me!
This is my thanks!$

label: SootopolisCity_Mart_Text_DidSomethingAwaken
text: This weather…\nDid something awaken?$

label: SootopolisCity_Mart_Text_FullRestoreItemOfDreams
text: Do you know FULL RESTORE?\pFull restoration of HP!\nEradication of all status problems!\pIt's truly an item of your dreams!$

label: SootopolisCity_Mart_Text_PPUpIsGreat
text: PP UP is great!\pIt raises the POWER POINTS, the PP,\nof a POKéMON move.$

label: SootopolisCity_Mart_Text_TooScaryOutside
text: What…\nWhat is happening?\pI really want to know, but it's too\nscary to go outside.$

label: SootopolisCity_MysteryEventsHouse_1F_Text_BrilliantStandoff
text: So, it became a standoff.\pIt was a brilliant match in which\nneither side conceded a step!$

label: SootopolisCity_MysteryEventsHouse_1F_Text_ChallengeVisitingTrainer
text: A TRAINER named {STR_VAR_1}\nis visiting my home.\pWould you like to challenge\n{STR_VAR_1}?$

label: SootopolisCity_MysteryEventsHouse_1F_Text_HopeToSeeGoodMatch
text: I hope to see a good match!$

label: SootopolisCity_MysteryEventsHouse_1F_Text_KeepItTo3On3
text: Oh, good, good!\pBut my house isn't all that sturdy.\pCould I ask you to keep it down to\na 3-on-3 match?$

label: SootopolisCity_MysteryEventsHouse_1F_Text_OnlyAmusementWatchingBattles
text: When I was young, I traveled the world\nas a POKéMON TRAINER.\pNow that I've become an old buzzard,\nmy only amusement is watching young\lTRAINERS battle.$

label: SootopolisCity_MysteryEventsHouse_1F_Text_SaveProgressBeforeBattle
text: Before you two battle, you should\nsave your progress.$

label: SootopolisCity_MysteryEventsHouse_1F_Text_ThatWasSuperlative
text: That was superlative!\pWhy, it was like seeing myself in\nmy youth again!$

label: SootopolisCity_MysteryEventsHouse_1F_Text_TooBadForYou
text: Ah, too bad for you!\pBut it was a good match.\nI hope you can win next time.$

label: SootopolisCity_MysteryEventsHouse_1F_Text_YouWontBattle
text: You won't battle? I'm disappointed\nthat I can't see you battle…$

label: SootopolisCity_MysteryEventsHouse_B1F_Text_MatchEndedUpDraw
text: The match ended up a draw.$

label: SootopolisCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_AlwaysBeFriendsWithPokemon
text: Whenever, wherever, and whatever\nhappens, I will always be friends with\lPOKéMON.\pBecause it's fun to be with POKéMON!$

label: SootopolisCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_ArentPokemonOurFriends
text: Aren't POKéMON our friends?\pWhy are they going wild this way?$

label: SootopolisCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_EveryoneTakenRefuge
text: Everyone in town has taken refuge\nand won't come out of their homes.\pEven I would rather not venture\noutside.$

label: SootopolisCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_WallaceToughestInHoenn
text:
WALLACE is rumored to be the toughest
TRAINER in the whole HOENN region.\pThis town's GYM is led by the TRAINER
who taught WALLACE.\pBut the ELITE FOUR… They're said to be
even stronger than WALLACE's mentor.\pHow strong could they be?$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_AfterAllOurScheming
text:
MAXIE: So the super-ancient POKéMON
weren't only GROUDON and KYOGRE…\pAfter all our fruitless scheming and
frantic efforts, that one POKéMON's\lsimple action puts everything right\lagain as if nothing had happened…\pFu…
Fuhahaha…$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_AquaMagmaDidntMeanHarm
text: WALLACE: {PLAYER}{KUN}…\pThe leaders of TEAM MAGMA and AQUA,\nI don't think they meant harm.\pIt wouldn't hurt to hear what they\nhave to say for themselves.$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_AwakenedPokemonClash
text: Oh, my…\pThe clash between the two awakened\nPOKéMON was quelled by the awakening\lof a third POKéMON…$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_BigPokemonFighting
text: A big POKéMON is fighting with\nanother big POKéMON!\pPlease, someone make them stop!$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_CaveOfOriginPleaseLeave
text: Who might you be?\pThis is the CAVE OF ORIGIN.\pThe spirits of POKéMON, becalmed at\nMT. PYRE, are said to be revived here.\pPlease leave.$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_CaveOfOriginSleepsToo
text: This is the CAVE OF ORIGIN…\pWith the passing of the crisis,\nthe cave, too, shall sleep…$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_CityRegainedCalm
text: The city has regained its calm…$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_CitySign
text: SOOTOPOLIS CITY\p“The mystical city where history\nslumbers.”$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_DazzledByMentor
text: WALLACE: I'm sure that you will be\ndazzled by my mentor's breathtakingly\lelegant battle style.$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_DoYouKnowMonNames
text: … … … … … …\pHi, do you know the names of those\nPOKéMON fighting over there?$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_DoesThisMakeYourFearPokemon
text:
STEVEN: Listen, {PLAYER}{KUN}.\pDoes seeing GROUDON and KYOGRE make
you think POKéMON are to be feared?\pBut that's not true.
POKéMON are really more…\p…Why am I asking you this?
You already know.$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_DoorIsClosed
text: The door is closed.$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_ExplainWaterfallGoToGym
text:
That HIDDEN MACHINE contains
WATERFALL.\pIf you have the RAIN BADGE, a POKéMON
that has learned that HM move can\lforce its way up waterfalls.\pAnd where does one get the RAIN BADGE?
You know, don't you?\pThat's right! You have to beat
the SOOTOPOLIS GYM LEADER.\pWhen you're all set to go, step through
that door.$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_FearedWorstWhenPokemonFlewDown
text: When that third POKéMON flew down,\nI feared the worst.$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_FlyingMonStoppedRampage
text: That flying POKéMON came down from\nthe sky and stopped the rampaging\lPOKéMON…$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_GiantPokemonSuddenlyAppeared
text:
These giant POKéMON suddenly appeared
in the middle of the city!\pAnd, I've never seen them before!\pWhy are they smashing into each
other like that?\pWhy can't they be friends, those
POKéMON?$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_GiganticPokemonFight
text: When two POKéMON that gigantic\nare fighting that savagely, there's\lnot much that we can do.$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_GiveYouThisBerryToo
text: KIRI will give you this BERRY, too!\nI really like it lots!$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_GoRedAndBlueMon
text: Go for it, red POKéMON!\nDon't back off, blue POKéMON!$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_GreenOneSettlesThings
text: I was wondering which one would win,\nthe red one or the blue one, but, oh no,\lit's the green one that settles things!\pTalk about a huge turn of events!$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_GroudonPleaseStop
text: MAXIE: G… GROUDON…\nPlease! Stop what you're doing!\pI know the extent of your power now!\pIf you keep going, all HOENN, not just\nSOOTOPOLIS, will be utterly ruined!$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_GymSign
text: SOOTOPOLIS CITY POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: JUAN\p“The GYM LEADER with the beauty\nof pure water!”$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_HaventYouScaledSkyPillar
text:
WALLACE: Oh?
{PLAYER}{KUN}?\pHaven't you scaled the SKY PILLAR
yet?\pI'm sure that you can make it to
the top of the SKY PILLAR…$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_HereWereAreHelpWallace
text: STEVEN: Okay, here we are!\pInside here you'll find someone named\nWALLACE.\pI think you have what's needed to\nhelp him…$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_InvolvedWithCrisisComeWithMe
text:
STEVEN: Those POKéMON fighting…
GROUDON… And KYOGRE…\pThe two super-ancient POKéMON
were awakened from a long sleep…\pAnd now they are smashing each other
with their uncontrollable energy…\p…{PLAYER}{KUN}.\pYou being here now I'll take to mean
that you're prepared to become\linvolved in this crisis.\pWell, then, there's someone that
I'd like you to meet.\pCome with me, please.$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_KnowWhatsNeededToHelpHim
text: STEVEN: I think you have what's\nneeded to help him…$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_KyogreCalmDown
text:
ARCHIE: KYOGRE! What's wrong?!
Look over here! It's the RED ORB!\lCalm down! KYOGRE!\p… … … … … …
… … … … … …\pIt's no good!
It's not responding at all!$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_LeadSuperiorTrainerToCave
text:
A person with a strong will and
superior talent…\pA TRAINER who has knowledge and
experience of many kinds of POKéMON…\pIf such a person were to appear, I was
instructed by WALLACE to lead that\lTRAINER to this CAVE.$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_LikeSeasonBornIn
text: Spring, summer, autumn, and winter.\pIf you're born in springtime, do you like\nthe spring, and if you're born in the\lsummer, do you like the summer?$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_MaxieArchieLeft
text: STEVEN: It looks like both MAXIE and\nARCHIE have gone away somewhere.\pPerhaps they've gone to MT. PYRE to\nreturn those ORBS…$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_NameIsKiriHaveOneOfThese
text: Hi, what's your name?\p… … …  … … …  … … …\nOkay. That's nice!\pMy name is KIRI.\pMy mommy and daddy named me that so\nI would grow healthy and warmhearted.\lThat's what they wished.\pYou can have one of these.$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_NeverBeenToSkyPillar
text: STEVEN: The SKY PILLAR…\pI've never been there.\nI wonder where it could be?$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_NightSkyFavoriteScenery
text: A circle of a night sky framed by\nthe crater of a volcano…\pAnd in that ring, stars flicker and\nblink as if they were alive…\lIt's my favorite scenery.$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_NoOrdinaryTourist
text: Hm!\nYou've come all the way to SOOTOPOLIS?\lYou're no ordinary tourist.\pBut I suppose that doesn't make you\nan extraordinary tourist, either.$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_OhDoesntMatter
text: Oh…\nIt doesn't matter…\pThere's so much that I want to know…$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_PhysicallyFitLivingHere
text: Diving in the sea. Climbing up and\ndown stairs all the time…\pIf you live in this town, you end up\ngetting physically fit.$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_PrettyMonCameFromSky
text: A pretty POKéMON came down from\nthe sky…$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_SawLegendWithOwnEyes
text:
There's an ancient legend that claims
the land and sea were shaped by\la colossal battle between POKéMON.\pWell, I saw that happen with
my very own eyes!\pWhoa! I never expected to be
witness to something this huge!$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_SeeingLegendWithOwnEyes
text:
There's an ancient legend that claims
the land and sea were shaped by\la colossal battle between POKéMON.\pWell, I'm seeing that happen with
my very own eyes!\pWhoa! I never expected to be
witness to something this huge!$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_SoThatsRayquaza
text: STEVEN: So that's RAYQUAZA…\pIt's incredible how the two rampaging\nPOKéMON would flee from it in fear…$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_SootopolisDidntGetWrecked
text: SOOTOPOLIS CITY didn't get wrecked!$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_SootopolisSkyBeautiful
text:
SOOTOPOLIS sprang up as a town in
the crater of a volcano.\pIf you look up at the sky, the lip of
the crater is also visible.\lSo, all you see is the sky in a circle.\pBut that's what makes the sky above
SOOTOPOLIS the most beautiful.$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_SootopolisWillBeWrecked
text: Oh, no!\nSOOTOPOLIS CITY will get wrecked!$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_ThankYouForHelpAcceptThis
text:
WALLACE: {PLAYER}{KUN}…
My eyes didn't deceive me.\pThanks to your help, SOOTOPOLIS…
No, all of HOENN was saved.\pOn behalf of the people, I thank you.\pThis is a gift from me.
Please accept it.$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_ThatWasWicked
text: Wow!\nThat was wicked!$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_ThenILoveAutumn
text: Then KIRI was born in the autumn,\nso I love the autumn!\pWhich season do you like?$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_ThisIsWicked
text: Wow!\nThis is wicked!$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_TryingMeaninglessToPokemon
text:
ARCHIE: KYOGRE and GROUDON both
flew off to who knows where.\pThe weather in HOENN has returned
to its normal state…\pHaha…
Hahaha…\pMaybe what we were trying to do was
something small, even meaningless,\lto POKéMON…$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_TwoPokemonArentAngry
text: I just get this sense somehow that\nthe two POKéMON aren't angry.\pI think… They probably can't control\ntheir own power…$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_WeatherWentWild
text:
The weather was clear this morning,
but…\pAll of a sudden, dark clouds brewed up,
rain started falling in sheets, and\lthere was thunder and lightning, too.\pThe weather just went completely
wild!\pIs all of this because of those
POKéMON?$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_WhatIsThatGreenPokemon
text: What? What? What?\nWhat is that green POKéMON?!$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_WhatKindOfWishInYourName
text: I wonder what kind of wish is included\nin your name.$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_WhereDidLegendariesGo
text: GROUDON and KYOGRE…\nWhere did they go?\pWill they cause droughts or downpours\nsomewhere else?$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_WonderWhatWorldIsLike
text: I… I've never been out of this city.\pI wonder what the world is like on\nthe other side of this round sky?$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_YouBroughtFlyingMon
text: Oh?\pIt was you who brought that flying\nPOKéMON here?\pWell, aren't you amazing!$

label: SouthernIsland_Exterior_Text_Sign
text: “Those whose memories fade seek to\ncarve them in their hearts…”$

label: SouthernIsland_Interior_Text_Sign
text: “All dreams are but another reality.\nNever forget…”$

label: Text_AdapterNotConnectedMinigame_Frlg
text: The Wireless Adapter isn't\nconnected.\pCome back when it's hooked up!$

label: Text_AdvertisingPoster
text: It's an advertising poster about\nall kinds of products.$

label: Text_AllAboardSeagallopNum
text: All right!\nAll aboard SEAGALLOP HI-SPEED {STR_VAR_1}!$

label: Text_AllGoodToGo_Frlg
text: Okay, you're all good to go.\nDon't let the others beat you!$

label: Text_AllowMeToTeachMonUltimateMove
text:
Oh! This is the one!
This is the POKéMON!\pThis {STR_VAR_1} is worthy of
learning my ultimate move!\pWill you allow it?\pWill you allow your {STR_VAR_1} to
learn my {STR_VAR_2}?$

label: Text_AppearsToBeUndergoingAdjustments
text: It appears to be undergoing\nadjustments…$

label: Text_BlinkingLights
text: Lights in different colors are\nflashing on and off.$

label: Text_Blueprint
text: A blueprint of some sort?\nIt's too complicated!$

label: Text_Blueprints
text: It's a blueprint of some sort.\nIt's filled with diagrams and text.$

label: Text_BodySlamDeclined
text: Come again!\nBoing!$

label: Text_BodySlamTaught
text: Boioing!$

label: Text_BodySlamTeach
text:
Ready?
Boing!\pWe're having a BODY SLAM match
to see who wimps out first.\pIf you were to join us, you'd be
squashed like a bug, though…\pHow about I teach BODY SLAM to
a POKéMON of yours instead?$

label: Text_BodySlamWhichMon
text: Which POKéMON wants to learn how\nto BODY SLAM?$

label: Text_BookShelf
text: It's filled with all sorts of books.$

label: Text_BootUpPC
text: {PLAYER} booted up the PC.$

label: Text_Burglary
text: There are obvious signs of burglary\nhere…$

label: Text_CantCut
text: This tree looks like it can be\nCUT down!$

label: Text_CantLetYouPass
text: Rules are rules.\nI can't let you pass.$

label: Text_CantRockClimb
text: The cliff is steep.\nA Pokémon may be able to climb it.$

label: Text_CantSmash
text: It's a rugged rock, but a POKéMON\nmay be able to smash it.$

label: Text_CantStrength
text: It's a big boulder, but a POKéMON\nmay be able to push it aside.$

label: Text_CardKeyOpenedDoor
text: Bingo!\nThe CARD KEY opened the door!$

label: Text_ChangeYourProfile
text: Would you like to change your\nprofile?$

label: Text_Computer
text: It's all complicated words and\nnumbers that make no sense…$

label: Text_CounterDeclined
text: You're not interested? Come see\nme if you change your mind.$

label: Text_CounterTaught
text: Are you using that COUNTER move\nI taught your POKéMON?$

label: Text_CounterTeach
text:
Oh, hi!
I finally finished POKéMON.\pNot done yet? How about I teach
you a good move?\pThe move I have in mind is
COUNTER.\pNot like the one I'm leaning on,
mind you!$

label: Text_CounterWhichMon
text: Which POKéMON should I teach\nCOUNTER to?$

label: Text_Cup
text: It's a cup with a POKéMON mark\non it.$

label: Text_DecidedNotTo
text: Oh, you've decided not to?\nYou're fickle, aren't you?$

label: Text_DescribeWhichGame_Frlg
text: I can explain game rules to you,\nif you'd like.\pWhich game should I describe?$

label: Text_DishesPlatesNeatlyLinedUp
text: Dishes and plates are neatly\nlined up.$

label: Text_DodrioBerryPickingInfo_Frlg
text:
“DODRIO BERRY-PICKING”\pCommand DODRIO's three heads to
catch falling BERRIES.\pPress right, up, or left on the
{PLUS} Control Pad to move the heads.\pTo play this game, you must have
a DODRIO.$

label: Text_DontBeLikeThat
text: Aww… Don't be like that.\nYou can tell me your profile.$

label: Text_DoubleEdgeDeclined
text: I'll teach you the technique\nanytime.$

label: Text_DoubleEdgeTaught
text: Keep that drive going for the\nPOKéMON LEAGUE!\pTake a run at them and knock 'em\nout!$

label: Text_DoubleEdgeTeach
text:
You should be proud of yourself,
having battled your way through\lVICTORY ROAD so courageously.\pIn recognition of your feat,
I'll teach you DOUBLE-EDGE.\pWould you like me to teach that
technique?$

label: Text_DoubleEdgeWhichMon
text: Which POKéMON should I teach\nDOUBLE-EDGE?$

label: Text_DreamEaterDeclined
text: …Snore…$

label: Text_DreamEaterTaught
text: …ZZZ…\nI…can't eat…anymore…$

label: Text_DreamEaterTeach
text:
Yawn!
I must have dozed off in the sun.\pI had this weird dream about
a DROWZEE eating my dream.\pAnd…
I learned how to eat dreams…\pOogh, this is too spooky!\pLet me teach it to a POKéMON so
I can forget about it!$

label: Text_DreamEaterWhichMon
text: Which POKéMON wants to learn\nDREAM EATER?$

label: Text_Dresser
text: It's a nicely made dresser.\nIt will hold a lot of stuff.$

label: Text_EmptyTrashCan
text: It's empty.$

label: Text_EnterWhichPokemon_Frlg
text: Which POKéMON would you like to\nenter?$

label: Text_ExplainProfile
text:
A profile is written using four
words or phrases.\pThere're plenty of words to choose
from for your profile.\pThe words and phrases are placed
in several convenient groups.\pFirst, choose a group, then choose
a word or phrase.\p…It's easier than it sounds.
Why don't you try it?$

label: Text_ExplosionDeclined
text: Yeah, you're right.\nIt is too terrifying.$

label: Text_ExplosionTaught
text: Using EXPLOSION while on this\nvolcano…\pWhat a terrifying thrill!$

label: Text_ExplosionTeach
text:
Can you imagine?
If this volcano were to erupt?\pThe explosion would be the end of
us. How terrifying is that?\pWhile we're terrified, would you
like me to teach EXPLOSION?$

label: Text_ExplosionWhichMon
text: You're terribly brave!\pWhich POKéMON should I teach\nEXPLOSION?$

label: Text_FeelRejuvenated
text: After I passed on my knowledge to\nyou, I felt so much relief.\pIn fact, I feel rejuvenated,\nas if I were younger again!$

label: Text_Food
text: It should be packed with all kinds\nof delicious things to eat.$

label: Text_Gyaoo
text: Gyaoo!$

label: Text_HeardThatBefore
text: Oh, I've heard that before…\pMy cousin, who lives far away,\nalways used to say that, I think.$

label: Text_HiWeMeetAgain
text: Hi!\nWe meet again!$

label: Text_IdLoveToHearYourProfile
text: Hi, glad to meet you!\p…That's unfriendly of you.\nHow about saying hi back?\pSo, come on, tell me about\nyourself.\pI'd love to hear your profile!$

label: Text_ImpressiveMachine
text: It's a machine of some sort.\nIt sure is impressive.$

label: Text_Indigo_HighestAuthority
text: INDIGO PLATEAU\pThe highest POKéMON authority!\nPOKéMON LEAGUE HQ$

label: Text_Indigo_UltimateGoal
text: INDIGO PLATEAU\pThe ultimate goal of TRAINERS!\nPOKéMON LEAGUE HQ$

label: Text_ItNeedsCardKey
text: No!\nIt needs a CARD KEY!$

label: Text_JustMistaken
text: …No…\nI was just mistaken.$

label: Text_Kitchen
text: It smells delicious!\nSomebody's been cooking here.$

label: Text_LetMeConferUltimateMove
text: You will allow it?\pThen, let me confer my ultimate\n{STR_VAR_2} on your {STR_VAR_1}.\pGgggrah-awooo!$

label: Text_LikeProfileWayItIs
text: Okay, you like your profile the\nway it is.\pI think so, too.$

label: Text_LinkErrorPleaseReset
text: Sorry, we have a link error…\nPlease reset and try again.$

label: Text_MakeBestUseOfMove
text: I implore you to make the best\nuse of that move and gain power!$

label: Text_MegaKickDeclined
text: You'll come crawling back when you\nrealize the value of MEGA KICK.$

label: Text_MegaKickTaught
text: Now, we are soul mates in the way\nof kicking!\pYou should run before you're seen\nby the deluded nitwit who trains\lonly simple punching over there.$

label: Text_MegaKickTeach
text: A kick of brutal ferocity!\pPacked with destructive power!\pWhen you get right down to it,\nMEGA KICK is the ultimate attack!\lDon't you agree?\pOkay!\nI'll teach it to your POKéMON!$

label: Text_MegaKickWhichMon
text: All right!\nWhich POKéMON wants to learn it?$

label: Text_MegaPunchDeclined
text: You'll be back when you understand\nthe worth of MEGA PUNCH.$

label: Text_MegaPunchTaught
text: Now, we are comrades in the way of\npunching!\pYou should go before you're seen\nby the misguided fool who trains\lonly his silly kicking over there.$

label: Text_MegaPunchTeach
text: A punch of roaring ferocity!\pPacked with destructive power!\pWhen the chips are down,\nMEGA PUNCH is the ultimate attack!\lYou agree, yes?\pNow!\nLet me teach it to your POKéMON!$

label: Text_MegaPunchWhichMon
text: Fine!\nWhich POKéMON will learn it?$

label: Text_MetronomeDeclined
text: I tell you, it's a lot of fun!$

label: Text_MetronomeTaught
text: Tch-tch-tch!\nThat's the sound of a METRONOME.\pIt tweaks your POKéMON's brain into\nusing moves it doesn't even know.$

label: Text_MetronomeTeach
text:
Tch-tch-tch!
I'll teach you a nifty move.\pTeach it to a POKéMON, and watch
the fun unfold!\pIt's a move called METRONOME.
Does it strike your fancy?$

label: Text_MetronomeWhichMon
text: Okay!\nWhich POKéMON should I teach?$

label: Text_MimicDeclined
text: Don't you like MIMIC?$

label: Text_MimicTaughtFemale
text:
{PLAYER}: Hi!
Thanks for what you did for us.\p{PLAYER}: Pardon?\p{PLAYER}: Is it really that fun to
copy what I say and do?\pCOPYCAT: You bet!
It's a scream!$

label: Text_MimicTaughtMale
text:
{PLAYER}: Hi!
Thanks for earlier!\p{PLAYER}: Pardon?\p{PLAYER}: Is it that fun to mimic my
every move?\pCOPYCAT: You bet!
It's a scream!$

label: Text_MimicTeach
text:
Oh wow!
A POKé DOLL!\pFor me?
Thank you!\pYou know what?
I can teach the move MIMIC.$

label: Text_MimicWhichMon
text: I really love MIMIC!\nWho's going to learn it?$

label: Text_MonFlewAway
text: The {STR_VAR_1} flew away!$

label: Text_MonUsedFieldMove
text: {STR_VAR_1} used {STR_VAR_2}!$

label: Text_MonUsedRockClimb
text: {STR_VAR_1} used Rock Climb!$

label: Text_MonUsedStrength
text: {STR_VAR_1} used STRENGTH!\p{STR_VAR_1}'s STRENGTH made it\npossible to move boulders around!$

label: Text_MoveCanOnlyBeLearnedOnce
text: This move can be learned only\nonce. Is that okay?$

label: Text_NeatlyLinedUpTools
text: All sorts of tools are lined up\nneatly.$

label: Text_OhThatsBadgeGoRightAhead
text: Oh! That is the {STR_VAR_1}!\nGo right ahead.$

label: Text_OnlyDodrioAllowed_Frlg
text: “DODRIO BERRY-PICKING”…\nWell, the name says it all.\pYou have to have a DODRIO to play\nthis game.$

label: Text_OnlyPassWithBadgeDontHaveYet
text:
You can pass here only if you have
the {STR_VAR_1}.\pYou don't have the {STR_VAR_1}
yet.\pYou have to have it to get to
the POKéMON LEAGUE.$

label: Text_OnlyPassWithBadgeOhGoAhead
text: You can pass here only if you have\nthe {STR_VAR_1}.\pOh! That is the {STR_VAR_1}!{PAUSE_MUSIC}{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_LEVEL_UP}{PAUSE 0x60}{RESUME_MUSIC}\pOkay, then.\nPlease, go right ahead.$

label: Text_OnlySkilledTrainersAllowedThrough
text: Only truly skilled TRAINERS are\nallowed through.\pYou don't have the {STR_VAR_1}\nyet!$

label: Text_Painting
