text: It's a pretty picture of a POKéMON.\nIt looks like it's feeling good.$

label: Text_PassedOnEverythingIKnow
text: Gasp, gasp, gasp…\pI have no regrets now.\nI've passed on everything I know.\pNow I can live out my life knowing\nmy work is done.$

label: Text_PictureBookShelf
text: There's a set of POKéMON picture books.$

label: Text_PlayWhichGame_Frlg
text: All right, which game did you want\nto play?$

label: Text_PlayedPokeFlute
text: {PLAYER} played the POKé FLUTE.$

label: Text_PlayerFacingTVScreen
text: There's a POKéMON on TV!\nIt looks like it's having fun.$

label: Text_PlayerIsPlayingRightNowGoForIt_Frlg
text: It appears as if {STR_VAR_1} is playing\nright now.\lGo for it!$

label: Text_PlayersMadeDifferentSelections
text: The link partners appear to have\nmade different selections.$

label: Text_PokemonCenterBookShelf
text: POKéMON magazines!\nPOKéMON PAL…\pPOKéMON HANDBOOK…\nADORABLE POKéMON…$

label: Text_PokemonJumpInfo_Frlg
text:
“POKéMON JUMP”\pMake your POKéMON skip the
VINE WHIP rope with the A Button.\pOnly mini POKéMON around 28 inches
or less may participate.\pPOKéMON that only swim, burrow, or
fly are not good at jumping.\pAs a result, those POKéMON may not
participate.\pGood things happen if everyone
jumps in time.$

label: Text_PowerPlantMachine
text: What could this machine be?\nBetter not mess around with it!$

label: Text_ProfileSaysSomethingAboutYou
text: Hmhm…\pYour profile really says something\nabout who you are.\pNow that I know you better, it \nmakes us better friends than ever!$

label: Text_ReceivedItemFromLittleGirl
text: {PLAYER} received a {STR_VAR_2}\nfrom the little girl.$

label: Text_RestoredPkmnToFullHealth_Frlg
text: Thank you for waiting.\nWe've restored your POKéMON to\lfull health.$

label: Text_RivalVictory
text: {RIVAL}: Yeah!\nAm I great or what?$

label: Text_RockSlideDeclined
text: Oh, so you are scared after all.$

label: Text_RockSlideTaught
text: It might be scary to use it in this\ntunnel…$

label: Text_RockSlideTeach
text:
When you're up on a rocky mountain
like this, rockslides are a threat.\pCan you imagine?
Boulders tumbling down on you?\pThat'd be, like, waaaaaaaaaaah!
Total terror!\pYou don't seem to be scared.
Want to try using ROCK SLIDE?$

label: Text_RockSlideWhichMon
text: Which POKéMON should I teach\nROCK SLIDE?$

label: Text_SeismicTossDeclined
text: Is that so?\nI'm sure you'll be back for it.$

label: Text_SeismicTossTaught
text: I hope you won't toss in the towel.\nKeep it up.$

label: Text_SeismicTossTeach
text:
The secrets of space…
The mysteries of earth…\pThere are so many things about
which we know so little.\pBut that should spur us to study
harder, not toss in the towel.\pThe only thing you should toss…\pWell, how about SEISMIC TOSS?
Should I teach that to a POKéMON?$

label: Text_SeismicTossWhichMon
text: Which POKéMON wants to learn\nSEISMIC TOSS?$

label: Text_ShopShelf
text: The shelves brim with all sorts of\nPOKéMON merchandise.$

label: Text_ShortJumpingPokemonAllowed_Frlg
text:
“POKéMON JUMP” is open to POKéMON
around 28 inches or less.\pWhat you can't enter are those
POKéMON that can't jump.\pYou know, like POKéMON that only
swim, burrow, or fly.\pThat's all you need to know.$

label: Text_Snacks
text: There's a pile of snacks here.$

label: Text_SnorlaxReturnedToMountains
text: SNORLAX calmed down.\nIt gave a huge yawn…\lAnd returned to the mountains.$

label: Text_SnorlaxWokeUp
text: SNORLAX woke up!\pIt attacked in a grumpy rage!$

label: Text_SoftboiledDeclined
text: I'll always be keeping an eye out\nfor you.\pI hope we can chat again.$

label: Text_SoftboiledTaught
text: I wish you the best of luck!$

label: Text_SoftboiledTeach
text:
Hello, there!\pI've seen you about, but I never
had a chance to chat.\pIt must be good luck that brought
us together finally.\pI'd like to celebrate by teaching
you the move SOFTBOILED.$

label: Text_SoftboiledWhichMon
text: So, who's the POKéMON that gets\nthe chance to learn SOFTBOILED?$

label: Text_SomeoneIsNotReadyToLink
text: Someone is not ready to link.\pPlease come back after everyone\nhas made preparations.$

label: Text_StrengthActivated
text: STRENGTH made it possible to move\nboulders around.$

label: Text_SubstituteDeclined
text: Oh, really?\nSUBSTITUTE seems so fun…$

label: Text_SubstituteTaught
text: Boy, what I'd give to crawl inside\na KANGASKHAN belly pouch…$

label: Text_SubstituteTeach
text:
Aww, I wish I was a KANGASKHAN
baby.\pI'd love to be a substitute for the
baby…\pAnd snuggle in the mother
KANGASKHAN's belly pouch.\pBut only POKéMON can use the
technique SUBSTITUTE…\pWant me to teach SUBSTITUTE to
one of your POKéMON?$

label: Text_SubstituteWhichMon
text: Which POKéMON wants to learn\nSUBSTITUTE?$

label: Text_SwordsDanceDeclined
text: Well, that's fine, too.$

label: Text_SwordsDanceTaught
text: If only we could keep getting\nstronger and stronger, eh?$

label: Text_SwordsDanceTeach
text: Not many people come out here.\pIf I train here, I'm convinced that\nI'll get stronger and stronger.\pYep, stronger and stronger…\pHow would you like to learn a move\nlike that? It's SWORDS DANCE.$

label: Text_SwordsDanceWhichMon
text: All right, pick which POKéMON\nI should teach it to.$

label: Text_TakeSeatStartBattle_Frlg
text: Please take your seat and start\nyour battle.$

label: Text_TakeSeatStartTrade_Frlg
text: Please take your seat and start\nyour trade.$

label: Text_TakeYourPkmnForFewSeconds_Frlg
text: Okay, I'll take your POKéMON for a\nfew seconds.$

label: Text_TalkToManToPlay_Frlg
text: If you want to play a game,\nplease tell the man beside me.$

label: Text_TastyFood
text: Oh, that smells tasty!\nIt might get the stomach growling!$

label: Text_TaughtMove
text: Gasp, gasp, gasp…\pI didn't think I could teach that\nmove while I still lived…$

label: Text_Telephone
text: It's a telephone.\nBetter not use it.$

label: Text_TellMeWhatsYourProfile
text: Tell me something good about\nyourself. What's your profile?$

label: Text_TellMoreNextTime
text: Please tell me more about\nyourself next time!$

label: Text_TheDoorIsOpen
text: The door is open…$

label: Text_ThunderWaveDeclined
text: Oh…\nBut THUNDER WAVE is convenient…$

label: Text_ThunderWaveTaught
text:
THUNDER WAVE causes paralysis in
the target POKéMON.\pA paralyzed POKéMON may be unable
to move in battle.\pIt's an ELECTRIC-type move, so it
won't work on some POKéMON.$

label: Text_ThunderWaveTeach
text:
Eeek!
No! Stop! Help!\pOh, you're not with TEAM ROCKET.
I'm sorry, I thought…\pWill you forgive me if I teach
you the THUNDER WAVE technique?$

label: Text_ThunderWaveWhichMon
text: Which POKéMON should I teach\nTHUNDER WAVE?$

label: Text_UltimateMoveThatMon
text:
I perfected the ultimate move of
its type…\pBut will no one take it for
future use?\p…Hm? Hmmm!\pY-you…
Th-that {STR_VAR_1}…$

label: Text_Vase
text: This vase looks expensive…\nPeered inside…\pBut, it was empty.$

label: Text_VideoGame
text: It's the latest video game!\nIt sure looks fun!$

label: Text_WantToCut
text: This tree looks like it can be\nCUT down!\pWould you like to CUT it?$

label: Text_WantToRockClimb
text: The cliff is steep.\nWould you like to use Rock Climb?$

label: Text_WantToSmash
text: This rock appears to be breakable.\nWould you like to use ROCK SMASH?$

label: Text_WantToStrength
text: It's a big boulder, but a POKéMON\nmay be able to push it aside.\pWould you like to use STRENGTH?$

label: Text_WantToUsePokeFlute
text: Want to use the POKé FLUTE?$

label: Text_WeHopeToSeeYouAgain_Frlg
text: We hope to see you again!$

label: Text_WelcomeCanYouWait_Frlg
text: Hi, welcome!\nYou can play games over the\lWireless Communication System.\pCan you wait just a little bit?$

label: Text_WelcomeWantToHealPkmn_Frlg
text: Welcome to our POKéMON CENTER!\pWould you like me to heal your\nPOKéMON back to perfect health?$

label: Text_WhatAreYouLikeNow
text: What are you like now?\nI'd really like to know.$

label: Text_WhatsYourProfile
text: What's your profile?$

label: Text_WhereDoYouWantToSail
text: Ahoy, there!\nWhere do you want to sail?$

label: Text_WirelessClubUndergoingAdjustments
text: I'm terribly sorry.\nThe POKéMON WIRELESS CLUB is\lundergoing adjustments now.$

label: Text_YouRejectIt
text: Gaah! You reject it?\nNo, I won't be dissuaded!$

label: ThreeIsland_BerryForest_Text_BerryPouchIsFull
text: Your BERRY POUCH is full.\nI guess you don't want this.$

label: ThreeIsland_BerryForest_Text_BewareWildBerryLovingMons
text: Beware of wild, BERRY-loving\nPOKéMON!$

label: ThreeIsland_BerryForest_Text_HelpScaryPokemon
text:
LOSTELLE: Whimper… Sniff…
Oh! Please, help!\pA scary POKéMON appeared there
a little while ago.\pIt kept scaring.
It made LOSTELLE scared.\pI'm too scared to move!
But I want to go home…$

label: ThreeIsland_BerryForest_Text_HereItComesAgain
text: Oh! Here it comes again!\nNo! Go away! It's scaring me!\pWaaaaaaah!\nI want my daddy!$

label: ThreeIsland_BerryForest_Text_LetsGoHome
text: What's your name?\pLOSTELLE's scared, so can I go\nwith you to my daddy's house?\pOkay!\nLet's go home!$

label: ThreeIsland_BerryForest_Text_ThankYouHaveThis
text: Ohh! That was so scary!\nThank you!\pLOSTELLE came to pick some\nBERRIES.\pYou can have this!$

label: ThreeIsland_BerryForest_Text_WelcomeToBerryForest
text: Welcome to the BERRY FOREST\pBe friendly and share BERRIES with\nothers and POKéMON.$

label: ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_AlexisDefeat
text: What happens now?$

label: ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_AlexisIntro
text: Yay, yay!\nPOKéMON!$

label: ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_AlexisPostBattle
text: Did I just win?\nOr did I lose?$

label: ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_AlexisRematchIntro
text: Yay, yay!\nPOKéMON!$

label: ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_AmiraDefeat
text: Waaah!\nWaaah!$

label: ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_AmiraIntro
text: My mommy said that I can't swim\nwithout my float ring.$

label: ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_AmiraPostBattle
text: This year, I'm going to finally\nlearn how to swim!$

label: ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_AmiraRematchIntro
text: I want to swim without my float\nring soon.$

label: ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_BerryForestAhead
text: BERRY FOREST AHEAD$

label: ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_BondBridgeSign
text: BOND BRIDGE\nPlease be quiet when crossing.\pBERRY FOREST AHEAD$

label: ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_JoyDefeat
text: JOY: Ohh…\nMEG!$

label: ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_JoyIntro
text: JOY: We'll teach you what our\nfavorite POKéMON is!$

label: ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_JoyNotEnoughMons
text: JOY: I really want to battle with\nMEG.\pOne POKéMON isn't enough.$

label: ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_JoyPostBattle
text: JOY: Wasn't that fun?\nI hope we can battle again!$

label: ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_JoyRematchIntro
text: JOY: We've gotten stronger!\nLots and lots!$

label: ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_MegDefeat
text: MEG: Ohh…\nJOY!$

label: ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_MegIntro
text: MEG: We'll show you our favorite\nPOKéMON.$

label: ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_MegNotEnoughMons
text: MEG: I want to battle together\nwith JOY.\pOne POKéMON isn't enough.$

label: ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_MegPostBattle
text: MEG: JOY, wasn't that fun?$

label: ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_MegRematchIntro
text: MEG: You can't beat us today!$

label: ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_NikkiDefeat
text: …Sniff, sniff…\nSomething smells unpleasant…$

label: ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_NikkiIntro
text: The salty tang of the sea…\nIt tickles my heart.$

label: ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_NikkiPostBattle
text: Perhaps that reek is your sweaty\nPOKéMON's body odor…$

label: ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_NikkiRematchIntro
text: Are we to battle again?$

label: ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_TishaDefeat
text: Okay, you've won!\nNow will you please go away?$

label: ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_TishaIntro
text: Oh, no, don't come here!\nPlease, stay away from me!$

label: ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_TishaPostBattle
text: A POKéMON bit through my \nswimsuit.\pI can't get out of the water!$

label: ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_TishaRematchIntro
text: Oh, no, didn't I tell you already?\nPlease, stay away from me!$

label: ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_VioletDefeat
text: You're raising some wonderful\nPOKéMON.$

label: ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_VioletIntro
text: Where are you off to in such\na hurry?$

label: ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_VioletPostBattle
text: If you keep going this way, you'll\neventually reach BERRY FOREST.$

label: ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_VioletRematchIntro
text: From where have you come, and\nwhere are you bound?$

label: ThreeIsland_DunsparceTunnel_Text_ProspectingForGold
text:
Hey, there!
How's it going?\pWhat am I doing here, you ask?
Why, I'm prospecting for gold!\pWhen I strike it rich, I'm buying
a house in KANTO.$

label: ThreeIsland_DunsparceTunnel_Text_StruckGoldThisIsForYou
text:
Hey, there! How's it going?
Did you hear? I've struck gold!\pYou remembered that I was
prospecting, didn't you?\pYou can't begin to imagine just
how happy I am.\pSo, I'll show you!
This is for you!$

label: ThreeIsland_DunsparceTunnel_Text_ThatsANugget
text: That's a NUGGET!\pI can't give you any nuggets of\nwisdom, so that'll have to do!$

label: ThreeIsland_DunsparceTunnel_Text_WhoopsBagCrammedFull
text: Whoops, your BAG is crammed full!\nI'll give this to you later.$

label: ThreeIsland_House1_Text_RareRocksGemsDisplayed
text: Rare rocks and gems are displayed.$

label: ThreeIsland_House1_Text_YoureAlwaysSoCool
text: LOSTELLE: Hi, {PLAYER}!\nYou're always so cool!\pI'll make lunch for you, too, one\nday, {PLAYER}.$

label: ThreeIsland_House2_Text_CantMakeThisSpoonBend
text:
Urrrrrrrrgggghhhh…
Kwaaaaah!\p…It's useless! I can't make this
spoon bend with my mind.\pMaybe I really don't have any
psychic powers.$

label: ThreeIsland_House2_Text_IAdmireSabrina
text:
You know about a girl GYM LEADER
in SAFFRON CITY?\pShe uses PSYCHIC-type POKéMON,
right?\pI admire her, I really do.\pI've heard that she's one cool
customer and beautiful, too.$

label: ThreeIsland_House3_Text_WantedToLiveSomewhereQuiet
text: I bought this house because I\nwanted to live somewhere quiet.\pToday, I think I'll go out fishing.$

label: ThreeIsland_House4_Text_GhostsInBerryForest
text: You must never, ever go out to\nthe BERRY FOREST alone.\pWhy?\nThere are ghosts there.$

label: ThreeIsland_House4_Text_PapaKeepsLyingToMe
text: Papa keeps lying to me, and won't\nlet me go out and play!$

label: ThreeIsland_House5_Text_IllGoPlayWithLostelle
text: I think I'll go play with LOSTELLE\ntoday.$

label: ThreeIsland_House5_Text_ImNotLostelle
text:
Me?
I'm not LOSTELLE.\pShe's probably gone to the
BERRY FOREST, I think.\pShe picks BERRIES there for making
lunch.$

label: ThreeIsland_Mart_Text_BikersWereAboutToTrashMart
text: Those BIKERS were about to trash\nthis POKéMON MART.\pAm I glad they decided to leave!$

label: ThreeIsland_Mart_Text_PeopleHealWithBerriesFromForest
text: I sometimes buy medicine here.\pBut a lot of people heal POKéMON\nwith BERRIES from BERRY FOREST.\pAfter all, BERRIES are free and\nthey never run out.$

label: ThreeIsland_Mart_Text_TrueThatCeldadonDeptStoreBigger
text: Is it true?\pCELADON DEPT. STORE is several\ntimes bigger than this shop?$

label: ThreeIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_AlwaysBerriesInBerryForest
text: Let's crush BERRIES!\n…That'd be wasting BERRIES?\pYou can always find some BERRIES\non the ground in BERRY FOREST.$

label: ThreeIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_ImpossibleToSurfBetweenIslands
text: It's impossible to SURF between the\nislands around these parts.\pThe tides are too fast and\ntreacherous.$

label: ThreeIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_PCNetworkCanLinkWithKanto
text: Hey, did you hear the news?\pThe PC network here can now link\nwith PCs in KANTO.\pI don't know how that came about,\nbut it's fantastic!$

label: ThreeIsland_Port_Text_EverythingTurnedOutForBest
text: Those BIKERS ran off, and\nLOSTELLE was found safe.\pEverything turned out for the best!$

label: ThreeIsland_Port_Text_ForkOverMoney
text: Hey, hey, lady!\nFork over some spending money!$

label: ThreeIsland_Port_Text_IllCallThePolice
text: Aiyeeh!\pWh-who are you?!\nI… I'll call the police!$

label: ThreeIsland_Port_Text_ThankGoodnessBikersGone
text: Those BIKERS…\nAre they gone?\pOh, thank goodness!\nThey certainly had me terrified!$

label: ThreeIsland_Port_Text_WereKantoRiderFederation
text: We're the KANTO RIDER FEDERATION!\nVroom! Vavavavooom! Vroom!\pMy bike's wimpy, so I have to\nmake exhaust noises myself!$

label: ThreeIsland_Text_AreYouBossGoBackToKanto
text: Are you the boss?\nGo back to KANTO right now!$

label: ThreeIsland_Text_Biker1Defeat
text: Wha…\nWhat is this kid?!$

label: ThreeIsland_Text_Biker1Intro
text: Heh, I like your guts.\nYou'll be losing money to me, but…$

label: ThreeIsland_Text_Biker1PostBattle
text: Aww, man…\nDon't you dare laugh!$

label: ThreeIsland_Text_Biker2Defeat
text: Stop fooling around!$

label: ThreeIsland_Text_Biker2Intro
text: Aren't you from KANTO?\nYou should be on our side!$

label: ThreeIsland_Text_Biker2PostBattle
text: What's the matter with you,\ngetting all hot like that?\pTotally uncool, man!$

label: ThreeIsland_Text_Biker3Intro
text: We invited the boss out here,\nbut you had to mess it up!\pYou embarrassed us, man!$

label: ThreeIsland_Text_Biker3PostBattle
text: Boss, I'm telling you, you've gotta\ndo something about this kid!$

label: ThreeIsland_Text_BossIsOnHisWay
text: Hey, go cry somewhere else.\nOur boss is on his way.\pWhen he gets here, we'll give you\na k-rad motorbike show you won't\lsoon forget!$

label: ThreeIsland_Text_Doduo
text: DODUO: Gigiih!$

label: ThreeIsland_Text_FollowersRaisingHavoc
text: Your gang of followers have been\nraising havoc on their bikes.\pDo you have any idea how much\ntrouble they've caused us on the\lisland?$

label: ThreeIsland_Text_GetOffIslandNow
text: W-what!? Not on your life!\nGet off the island now!$

label: ThreeIsland_Text_GivenFullRestore
text: {PLAYER} was given\na FULL RESTORE.$

label: ThreeIsland_Text_GoBackToKanto
text: We don't need you people bringing\nyour noise and trouble here!\pWe're asking you to go back to\nKANTO!$

label: ThreeIsland_Text_IslandBelongsToUs
text: Hyahoo!\pFrom this day on, this island\nbelongs to us!$

label: ThreeIsland_Text_IslandSign
text: THREE ISLAND\nKin Island of Family Bonding$

label: ThreeIsland_Text_JustGotHerePal
text: Hah?\pI just got here, pal.\pWhat's with the hostile attitude?\nIt's mighty cold of you!$

label: ThreeIsland_Text_LostelleWentOffTowardsBondBridge
text:
It'd be fantastic if someone as
strong as you lived here.\pI hope you'll at least stay here
a while.\p…I beg your pardon?
You're looking for LOSTELLE?\pLOSTELLE went off towards BOND
BRIDGE a while ago.$

label: ThreeIsland_Text_OhYourBagIsFull
text: Oh?\nYour BAG is full.$

label: ThreeIsland_Text_OughtToBeThankingUs
text:
No, man, I don't get it at all.\pLook at this place.
What do you do for entertainment?\pYou ought to be thanking us for
livening up this sleepy village.\pBut hey, if you insist, you can try
making us leave.$

label: ThreeIsland_Text_PaxtonDefeat
text: All right, enough!\nWe'll leave like you wanted!\pWe'll be happy to see the last of\nthis boring island!$

label: ThreeIsland_Text_PaxtonIntro
text:
I've been watching you, and I'd say
you've done enough.\pWhat are you, their friend or
something?\pThen I guess you'll be battling me
in their place.$

label: ThreeIsland_Text_PaxtonPostBattle
text: Humph! Yeah, go right on hanging\naround with these hayseeds!$

label: ThreeIsland_Text_ThankYouOhYourMonGotHurt
text: Thank you! Those goons were\nnothing but bad trouble.\pOh, look, your POKéMON got hurt\non my account.$

label: ThreeIsland_Text_ThatsSmart
text: That's smart.\nKeep your nose out of this.$

label: ThreeIsland_Text_WannaMakeSomethingOfYourStaring
text: You, what are you staring at?\nDon't you know it's not polite?\pYou wanna make something of it\nor what?$

label: ThreeIsland_Text_WhenDodouEvolvesGoingToPlayGame
text: I'm going to train my DODUO in the\nBERRY FOREST.\pWhen it evolves, I'm going to play\na game on TWO ISLAND.$

label: ThreeIsland_Text_WhosGonnaMakeMe
text: Who's gonna make me?$

label: ThreeIsland_Text_WouldntWantToSeeBikersHereAgain
text: THREE ISLAND is actually the most\npopulous of the islands here.\pStill, it could be less sleepy.\pBut I wouldn't want to see goons\nlike those BIKERS here again.$

label: ThreeIsland_Text_YouCowardsToughInPack
text: Grr… You cowards…\nSo tough in a pack…$

label: ThreeIsland_Text_YouveGotImpressiveMons
text: You've got seriously impressive\nPOKéMON with you.$

label: TradeCenter_Text_TakeSeatStartTrade
text: Please take your seat and start\nyour trade.$

label: Trade_Text_AwwOhWell
text: Awww!\nOh, well…$

label: Trade_Text_DoYouHaveMonWantToTradeForMon
text: Hi!\nDo you have a {STR_VAR_1}?\pWant to trade it for my\n{STR_VAR_2}?$

label: Trade_Text_DoYouHaveMonWouldYouTradeForMon
text: Hello, there! Do you happen to\nhave a {STR_VAR_1}?\pWould you agree to a trade for\nmy {STR_VAR_2}?$

label: Trade_Text_HasTradedMonGrownStronger
text: The {STR_VAR_2} that I traded you,\nhas it grown stronger?$

label: Trade_Text_HeyThanks
text: Hey, thanks!$

label: Trade_Text_HowIsMyOldMon
text: How is my old {STR_VAR_2}?\nMy {STR_VAR_1} is doing great!$

label: Trade_Text_IsntMyOldMonGreat
text: Isn't my old {STR_VAR_2} great?$

label: Trade_Text_LookingForMonWannaTradeForMon
text: I'm looking for the POKéMON\n{STR_VAR_1}!\pWanna trade one for my\n{STR_VAR_2}?$

label: Trade_Text_Thanks
text: Thanks!$

label: Trade_Text_ThanksYoureAPal
text: Thanks, you're a pal!$

label: Trade_Text_ThatsTooBad
text: That's too bad.$

label: Trade_Text_ThisIsNoMon
text: …This is no {STR_VAR_1}.\pIf you get one, trade it with me.$

label: Trade_Text_ThisIsntMon
text: Hmmm?\nThis isn't a {STR_VAR_1}.\pThink of me if you get one.$

label: Trade_Text_WellIfYouDontWantTo
text: Well, if you don't want to…$

label: Trade_Text_WhatThatsNoMon
text: What?\nThat's no {STR_VAR_1}!$

label: TrainerHill_Elevator_Text_ReturnToReception
text: Would you like to return to\nthe reception counter?$

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_CantWaitToTestTheWaters
text: I heard tough TRAINERS come to this\nTRAINER HILL from all over.\pI can't wait to test the waters!\pI'll knock aside anyone that stands\nin my way!$

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_ChallengeTime
text: {STR_VAR_1} min. {STR_VAR_2}.{STR_VAR_3} sec.$

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_DoYouKnowWhenTheyOpen
text: Do you know when they're opening\nthis place up?\pI'm waiting here to be the first\nchallenger ever!$

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_ExplainTrainerHill
text:
Here at the TRAINER HILL, we conduct
an event called the Time Attack.\pIt is a race that measures how long
you take to reach our owner on\lthe rooftop from this counter.\pThe fastest times are posted on
the Time Board--try competing with\lyour friends.\pIn TRAINER battles along the way,
neither Exp. Points nor money will\lbe awarded.$

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_FriendsTryingToReachTimeBoardTop
text: Do you see the Time Board over there?\pMy friends and I are trying to see who\ncan reach the top in the least time.$

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_HopeYouGiveItYourBest
text: I hope you give it your best.$

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_LikeToChallengeTrainers
text: Would you like to challenge the\nwaiting TRAINERS?$

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_MovedReceptionHereForSwitch
text: When the TRAINERS switch places,\nthe movement can be hectic.\pTo avoid the stampede, we moved\nthe reception counter here.\pI'm sorry for the inconvenience.$

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_PleaseVisitUsAgain
text: Please do visit us again!$

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_SaveGameBeforeEnter
text: Is this your first visit here?\pBefore you enter, please save\nyour game.$

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_StillGettingReady
text: This is the TRAINER HILL where\nyou may enjoy tag battles with many\lTRAINERS.\pUnfortunately, we're still getting\nthings ready. Please come back later!$

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_ThankYouForPlaying
text: Thank you for playing!$

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_TimeProgessGetSetGo
text: I will time your progress.\nBest of luck!\pOn your marks…\pGet set…\pGo!$

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_TooBadTremendousEffort
text: That was too bad.\pI think you put in a tremendous\neffort in your battling.\pPlease come back and try again!$

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_TrainersInEveryRoom
text: Let's see…\nThe TRAINERS here now are…\pThere appear to be TRAINERS gathered\nin every room.$

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_TrainersUpToFloorX
text: Let's see…\nThe TRAINERS here now are…\pUp to floor no. {STR_VAR_1}.$

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_WelcomeToTrainerHill
text: Welcome!\pThis is the TRAINER HILL where\nyou may enjoy tag battles with many\lTRAINERS!$

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_WhatSortOfTrainersAreAhead
text: Who knows what sort of TRAINERS\nand POKéMON combos are ahead?\pAll I know is that I'll knock aside\nanyone that stands in my way!$

label: TrainerHill_Roof_Text_ArriveZippierNextTime
text: Perhaps it would please me more if you\narrived zippier next time.\pThen, I should be pleased to form\na tag team with you!\pUntil we meet again, amigo!$

label: TrainerHill_Roof_Text_FullUpBeBackLaterForThis
text: Oh, no, full up with things!\nYou'll be back later for this!$

label: TrainerHill_Roof_Text_GotHereMarvelouslyQuickly
text:
Oh, hold on here! Did you possibly get
here marvelously quickly?\pHow splendid! You needn't have
hurried so to see me!\pThat is so delightful. I'll have the Time
Board at the reception updated!$

label: TrainerHill_Roof_Text_HaveTheMostMarvelousGift
text: For a marvelous someone like you,\nI have the most marvelous gift!$

label: TrainerHill_Roof_Text_YouFinallyCameBravo
text:
Hm! Hm!\pYou finally came!
Yes, you have arrived!\pWait! Don't say it!
I know why you came all the way\lhere by yourself!\pYou wanted to see me, the owner
of the TRAINER HILL, because…\pYou want to form a tag team with me!
Wa-hoo!\p…Uh?
That's not it?\pAnyway, I watched you on your way up.
Marvelous battling! Bravo, indeed!$

label: TrainerHill_Roof_Text_YouWerentVeryQuick
text: But, oh…\nYou weren't very quick getting here.$

label: TrainerTower_Lobby_Text_ExplainTrainerTower
text:
Here at TRAINER TOWER, there is an
event called TIME ATTACK.\pYou will be timed on how quickly
you can get from the reception\lcounter to the OWNER on the roof.\pThe best times will be recorded on
the Time Board.\pTry competing with friends to see
who can beat it the fastest.\pYou will not earn any EXP. Points
or money by beating TRAINERS here.$

label: TrainerTower_Lobby_Text_GiveItYourBest
text: I hope you give it your best.$

label: TrainerTower_Lobby_Text_LikeToChallengeTrainers
text: Would you like to challenge the\nwaiting TRAINERS?$

label: TrainerTower_Lobby_Text_MoveCounterHereWhenTrainersSwitch
text: When the TRAINERS switch places,\nthe movement can be hectic.\pTo avoid the stampede, we moved\nthe reception counter here.\pI'm sorry for the inconvenience.$

label: TrainerTower_Lobby_Text_NeedTwoMonsForDouble
text: This is a two-on-two battle.\pYou may not battle unless you have\nat least two POKéMON.$

label: TrainerTower_Lobby_Text_PleaseVisitUsAgain
text: Please do visit us again!$

label: TrainerTower_Lobby_Text_StairsTougherThanAnyBattle
text: Gasp, gasp…\nGasp…\pNever mind battling! These stairs…\nThey're tougher than any battle…$

label: TrainerTower_Lobby_Text_StartClockGetSetGo
text: Okay, I'll get the clock started,\nso give it everything you have.\pOn your marks…\pGet set…\pGo!$

label: TrainerTower_Lobby_Text_ThanksForCompeting
text: Thank you for competing!$

label: TrainerTower_Lobby_Text_TooBadComeBackTryAgain
text: That was too bad.\pI think you put in a tremendous\neffort in your battling.\pPlease come back and try again!$

label: TrainerTower_Lobby_Text_TrainersUpEighthFloor
text: TRAINERS are awaiting your\nchallenge up to the eighth floor.$

label: TrainerTower_Lobby_Text_TrainersUpToFloorNum
text: TRAINERS from all over the world\ngather here to battle.\pLet me see…\pRight now, there are TRAINERS only\nup to Floor {STR_VAR_1}.$

label: TrainerTower_Lobby_Text_WelcomeToTrainerTower
text: Hello!\pWelcome to TRAINER TOWER where\nTRAINERS gather from all over!$

label: TrainerTower_Lobby_Text_WonderWhatKindsOfTrainers
text: I'm here to see how good I am.\pI wonder what kinds of TRAINERS\nare waiting for me?\pIt's nerve-racking!$

label: TrainerTower_Roof_Text_DoneItInRecordTime
text:
Oh!
Stupendous!\pIt's marvelous how you've come up
here so quickly.\pThe fact is, you've done it in
record time…\pI'll have your record posted at
the reception counter.$

label: TrainerTower_Roof_Text_IdLikeToSeeBetterTime
text: What I would like to see is a\nbetter time out of you…\pI'm counting on you.\pUntil then, farewell…$

label: TrainerTower_Roof_Text_ImOwnerBattledPerfectly
text: Hello…\pI am the owner of this TOWER…\pHow the sky soars above this\nrooftop…\pThe caress of the winds up here…\pIt's all so perfect…\pThe way you battled…\nIt, too, was perfection…$

label: TrainerTower_Roof_Text_ThisIsForYou
text: This is for you…$

label: TrainerTower_Roof_Text_TookSweetTimeGettingHere
text: You seem to have taken your sweet\ntime getting here…$

label: TrainerTower_Text_XMinYZSec
text: {STR_VAR_1} min. {STR_VAR_2}.{STR_VAR_3} sec.$

label: TwoIsland_House_Text_CantTeachAnEgg
text: Hunh? There isn't a single move\nthat I can teach an EGG.$

label: TwoIsland_House_Text_HandedOverOneBigMushroom
text: {PLAYER} handed over one\nBIG MUSHROOM in exchange.$

label: TwoIsland_House_Text_HandedOverTwoTinyMushrooms
text: {PLAYER} handed over two\nTINYMUSHROOMS in exchange.$

label: TwoIsland_House_Text_IllNeedMushroomOrTwo
text: Then, I'll need a MUSHROOM or two.\nWhat are you going to give me?$

label: TwoIsland_House_Text_NeedMushroomOrTwoToLearnMove
text: If your POKéMON need to learn a\nmove, I need a MUSHROOM or two.$

label: TwoIsland_House_Text_NoMoveICanTeachThatMon
text: Sorry…\pIt doesn't appear as if I have a\nmove I can teach that POKéMON.$

label: TwoIsland_House_Text_TeachMonMoveForMushroom
text:
I'm the POKéMON MOVE MANIAC.\pI know every single move that
POKéMON learn growing up.\pI'm also a mushroom maniac.\pBring me two TINYMUSHROOMS,
or one BIG MUSHROOM.\pIf you do that for me, I'll teach
a move to one POKéMON.$

label: TwoIsland_House_Text_TeachWhichMove
text: Which move should I teach?$

label: TwoIsland_House_Text_TutorWhichMon
text: Which POKéMON needs tutoring?$

label: TwoIsland_House_Text_WantMeToTeachMove
text: Sniff, sniff…\nHm! You smell of MUSHROOMS!\pDo you want me to teach a move\nto a POKéMON of yours?$

label: TwoIsland_JoyfulGameCorner_Text_GetGamesGoingSoon
text: We'll get the games going soon\nfor you!$

label: TwoIsland_JoyfulGameCorner_Text_HandedMeteoriteToLostellesDaddy
text: {PLAYER} handed the METEORITE\nto LOSTELLE's daddy.$

label: TwoIsland_JoyfulGameCorner_Text_IllGetGameCornerRunning
text: All right, I'll get the GAME CORNER\nrunning right away.\pYou have to come visit with a\nfriend.$

label: TwoIsland_JoyfulGameCorner_Text_IsThisOnlyThreeIsland
text:
Hah? What is this GAME CORNER?
How much sadder can this get?\pThose clowns…\pThey said they'd be waiting on the
island, so where are they?\pHey, you! Is this the only THREE
ISLAND around here?$

label: TwoIsland_JoyfulGameCorner_Text_LostelleItsOkayDaddy
text: LOSTELLE: It's okay, Daddy.\nI got to be friends with {PLAYER}!$

label: TwoIsland_JoyfulGameCorner_Text_NotGoingToFitInBag
text: Your BAG's not going to fit another\nthing…$

label: TwoIsland_JoyfulGameCorner_Text_NotRunningAnyGamesToday
text: I'm sorry.\nWe're not running any games today.$

label: TwoIsland_JoyfulGameCorner_Text_OhThisIsFromBill
text: Oh, I see, this is from BILL!\nYou have to thank him for me!\pYou know, you've been fantastic.\nI want you to have this.$

label: TwoIsland_JoyfulGameCorner_Text_PleaseGoToThreeIsland
text:
Hey, but listen! I'm begging you,
you have to go to THREE ISLAND.\pIf anything were to happen to my
LOSTELLE…\pMy place is the house with the red
roof on THREE ISLAND.\pShe may just show up late here,
so I can't run off anywhere.\pThat's why I have to get you to do
me this big favor.$

label: TwoIsland_JoyfulGameCorner_Text_PleaseHelpFindLostelle
text:
Hm? You, there!
Are you a friend of LOSTELLE's?\pHave you seen LOSTELLE around?
I don't know where she might be.\lShe should've been here long ago.\pLOSTELLE's a cutie - she got my
looks - so what if someone…\pWhat if something's happened to
my LOSTELLE?!\pPlease, help me find her!
Please go search THREE ISLAND!$

label: TwoIsland_JoyfulGameCorner_Text_PleaseShowMeYouBeingCool
text: Listen, listen!\pPlease show me you being cool\nagain!$

label: TwoIsland_JoyfulGameCorner_Text_PunkScuffedUpMyFloor
text: Would you look at that?\nThat punk scuffed up my floor.$

label: TwoIsland_JoyfulGameCorner_Text_ReceivedMoonStoneFromLostellesDaddy
text: {PLAYER} received a MOON STONE\nfrom LOSTELLE's daddy.$

label: TwoIsland_JoyfulGameCorner_Text_TheseIslandsAreConfusing
text: Huh…\nOh, oh, gotcha.\pTch…\nThese islands are confusing…$

label: TwoIsland_JoyfulGameCorner_Text_ThisIsForMe
text:
Oh, what's that?
You're saying that this is for me?\pHow did you know that I love rare
rocks and gems?\pYou sure know how to make a guy
happy.$

label: TwoIsland_JoyfulGameCorner_Text_ThisIsTwoIslandMoveIt
text: Try waking up before you crawl out\nof bed, you punk.\pThis is TWO ISLAND!\pMove it! Get your filthy motorbike\nout of my place!$

label: TwoIsland_JoyfulGameCorner_Text_WhereHasLostelleGottenTo
text: Now, where's LOSTELLE gotten to\ntoday?\pShe always brings me lunch every\nday right about now…$

label: TwoIsland_JoyfulGameCorner_Text_YouRescuedLostelle
text: So you rescued LOSTELLE?\nHow can I thank you?\pLOSTELLE, darling, forgive me!\pDaddy didn't know you were scared\nand in trouble!$

label: TwoIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_HaveYouVisitedGameCorner
text: Have you visited the GAME CORNER\nalready?\pIt's no good to go alone.\nYou have to take a friend along.$

label: TwoIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_OldLadyLivesOutOnCape
text:
Not many people live on
TWO ISLAND.\pThere is this old lady who lives
out on the cape.\pShe's been there since I don't know
when.$

label: TwoIsland_Text_AddedMerchandiseForLostelle
text:
I can't tell you how grateful I am
for your rescue of LOSTELLE.\pThanks to your feat, the people of
THREE ISLAND have changed their\lattitudes about KANTO people.\pAnd, I'm from KANTO, you see.\pThe people of THREE ISLAND
helped me add to my merchandise.$

label: TwoIsland_Text_BringingItemsFromDistantLands
text:
Oh, hello, {PLAYER}!
Welcome!\pI've started bringing in items from
distant lands.\pI've got some rare items in, too.
Please have a look!$

label: TwoIsland_Text_BrunoCameToIslandWhileBack
text:
Listen, listen.
Did you know?\pA famous TRAINER came to the
ISLAND a little while back.\pHe's one of the ELITE FOUR.
His name is BRUNO.\pHe went away disappointed when he
found out that they were all sold\lout of Rage Candybars.$

label: TwoIsland_Text_BuyRareItemsHere
text: The discerning TRAINER knows to\nbuy rare items here!$

label: TwoIsland_Text_DangerFastCurrent
text: DANGER! FAST CURRENT!\nFishing and surfing prohibited!$

label: TwoIsland_Text_FellowMovedFromCeladonCity
text:
That fellow there, he moved here
from CELADON CITY.\pHe started up a shop with his
younger brother.\pYou have to wonder if he knew what
he was getting into.$

label: TwoIsland_Text_HaveYouTriedJumpingGame
text:
Boing! Boing!
Have you tried the jumping game?\pThe POKéMON you can enter…
Boing!\pSome go boing!\pAnd some go boooooooing!\pDid you know that?
Boing!$

label: TwoIsland_Text_HopeYouGiveItYourBest
text: Hi! I'm giving it my best here.\nI hope you do too, {PLAYER}.$

label: TwoIsland_Text_IslandSign
text: TWO ISLAND\nBoon Island for Two$

label: TwoIsland_Text_JoyfulGameCornerSign
text: Skip & Chomp!\nJoyful GAME CORNER$

label: TwoIsland_Text_OldWomanLivesOutOnCape
text: There's an old woman who lives in\na cottage out on the cape.\pShe gives the eye to POKéMON.\nIt's a bit unnerving.$

label: TwoIsland_Text_ShopkeepersBrotherWorksGameCorner
text: The shopkeeper's brother took\na job at the GAME CORNER.\pHe's trying to pull together money\nso they can buy more merchandise.$

label: TwoIsland_Text_WelcomeToShopMerchandiseLimited
text: Oh!\nHello, welcome to my shop!\pWe've only opened up recently.\pOur merchandise is limited, but I\nhope we can serve your needs.$

label: UndergroundPath_EastEntrance_Text_DoYouGoToCeladonDeptStore
text: The DEPARTMENT STORE in CELADON\nhas a great selection.\pDo you go there very often?$

label: UndergroundPath_SouthEntrance_Text_PeopleLoseThingsInTheDarkness
text: People often lose things in the\ndarkness of the UNDERGROUND PATH.$

label: UndergroundPath_WestEntrance_Text_SleepyMonNearCeladon
text: I heard a sleepy POKéMON appeared\nout near CELADON CITY, too.$

label: Underwater_SeafloorCavern_Text_SubExplorer1
text:
“SUBMARINE EXPLORER 1” is painted
on the hull.\pThis is the submarine TEAM AQUA
stole in SLATEPORT!\pTEAM AQUA must have gone
ashore here.$

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_AchievedThreeWinStreak
text: To achieve a 3-win streak…\pThe bonds that bind your heart with\nyour POKéMON seem firm and true.$

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_AttractionMutual
text: My feelings toward my POKéMON…\nI'm sure the attraction is mutual!\pThey battle exactly the way I want\nthem to!$

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_AttractionRunsDeep
text:
My feelings toward my POKéMON…
The attraction runs deep…\pOh, hi, you didn't see that, did you?
Well, it doesn't matter.\pHow would you like this TM for
your POKéMON?$

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_FeatWillBeRecorded
text: Your feat will be recorded.\nI must ask you to briefly wait.$

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_GentleMonsScaryIfAngry
text: My big sister is gentle usually.\nBut when she gets angry,\lshe's really, really scary!\pI bet a gentle POKéMON will be scary\nif it gets angry!$

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_MonsReluctantToUseDislikedMoves
text:
If it doesn't like a certain move,
a POKéMON will be reluctant to use it.\pIt doesn't matter how strong it is,
either.\pFor example, a POKéMON with a GENTLE
nature probably won't enjoy hurting\lits opponents.\pIf it can't seem to live up to its
potential, it's probably failing at\lusing a disliked move against its will.$

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_NowFollowMe
text: Good.\nNow, follow me.$

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_PresentYouWithPrize
text: For the feat of your 3-win streak,\nwe present you with this prize.$

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_ResultsWillBeRecorded
text: I feel privileged for having seen\nyour POKéMON's exploits.\pThe results will be recorded.\nI must ask you to briefly wait.$

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_ReturnFortified
text: When you have fortified your heart\nand POKéMON, you must return.$

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_RulesAreListed
text: The VERDANTURF BATTLE TENT\nrules are listed.$

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_ScottCanMeetToughTrainers
text:
SCOTT: Hey there, {PLAYER}{KUN}!
I thought I might see you here.\pA BATTLE TENT's a place where
you can meet tough TRAINERS.\pIt doesn't matter what the rules are,
or how battles are waged, either.\p{PLAYER}{KUN}, I expect you to do
the best you can!$

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_ScottVisitRegularly
text: SCOTT: I visit here regularly in hopes\nof seeing tough TRAINERS in action\lin whatever the situation.$

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_TaughtWhatKindsOfMoves
text: What kind of moves have you taught\nyour POKéMON?\pI think you would give yourself\nan advantage if they knew how to\lheal or protect themselves.$

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_WelcomeToBattleTent
text: I welcome you to the BATTLE TENT\nVERDANTURF SITE!\pHere, the TRAINER's trust toward\nPOKéMON is tested.$

label: VerdanturfTown_FriendshipRatersHouse_Text_AdoresYou
text: It adores you.\nIt can't possibly love you any more.\lI even feel happy seeing it.$

label: VerdanturfTown_FriendshipRatersHouse_Text_DetestsYou
text: This is a little hard for me to say…\pYour POKéMON simply detests you.\nDoesn't that make you uncomfortable?$

label: VerdanturfTown_FriendshipRatersHouse_Text_GettingUsedToYou
text: It's getting used to you.\nIt seems to believe in you.$

label: VerdanturfTown_FriendshipRatersHouse_Text_LikesYouQuiteALot
text: It likes you quite a lot.\nIt seems to want to be babied a little.$

label: VerdanturfTown_FriendshipRatersHouse_Text_NotUsedToYou
text: It's not very used to you yet.\nIt neither loves nor hates you.$

label: VerdanturfTown_FriendshipRatersHouse_Text_Pikachu
text: PIKACHU: Pika pika!$

label: VerdanturfTown_FriendshipRatersHouse_Text_SeeHowMuchPokemonLikesYou
text: Let me see your POKéMON.\nI'll check to see how much it likes you.\pOh.\nYour POKéMON…$

label: VerdanturfTown_FriendshipRatersHouse_Text_VeryHappy
text: It seems to be very happy.\nIt obviously likes you a whole lot.$

label: VerdanturfTown_FriendshipRatersHouse_Text_VeryWary
text: It's very wary.\nIt has scary viciousness in its eyes.\lIt doesn't like you much at all.$

label: VerdanturfTown_House_Text_DefeatEliteFourInARow
text: In the POKéMON LEAGUE, I think the\nrules say that you have to battle the\lELITE FOUR all in a row.\pIf you lose to any of them, you have\nto begin your challenge again from the\lfirst one.$

label: VerdanturfTown_House_Text_TrainersGatherAtPokemonLeague
text: Far away, deep in EVER GRANDE CITY,\nis the POKéMON LEAGUE.\pThe TRAINERS who gather there are\nall frighteningly well skilled.$

label: VerdanturfTown_Mart_Text_NestBallOnWeakenedPokemon
text: The NEST BALL works better on\nweakened POKéMON.\pVERDANTURF is the only place you can\nbuy it.$

label: VerdanturfTown_Mart_Text_NoStrategyGuidesForBattleTent
text: They don't seem to sell any winning\nstrategy guides for the BATTLE TENT…\pIt seems one must rely on one's\nown wits after all…$

label: VerdanturfTown_Mart_Text_XSpecialIsCrucial
text: For any POKéMON match, X SPECIAL\nis crucial.\pIt jacks up the power of some moves\neven though it's only for one battle.$

label: VerdanturfTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_FaithInYourPokemon
text: You can't consider yourself a real\nTRAINER if you don't have faith\lin your POKéMON.\pOnly those people who can believe\nin their battling POKéMON can win\lthrough to the very end.$

label: VerdanturfTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_VisitForBattleTent
text:
The reason why anyone would visit
VERDANTURF…\pIt's the BATTLE TENT. It goes without
saying.\pOr is there somebody here that you
came to see?$

label: VerdanturfTown_Text_AirCleanHere
text: The way the winds blow, volcanic ash\nis never blown in this direction.\pThe air is clean and delicious here.\nLiving here should do wonders for even\lfrail and sickly people.$

label: VerdanturfTown_Text_BattleTentSign
text: BATTLE TENT VERDANTURF SITE\n“Feast Your Eyes on Battles!”$

label: VerdanturfTown_Text_EasyToGetToRustboroNow
text: That cave next to the POKéMON MART\nis now a tunnel to the other side.\pIt's great--it's easy to go shop for\nnew DEVON products in RUSTBORO now.$

label: VerdanturfTown_Text_GuyTryingToBustThroughCave
text:
Did you see the cave next to the
POKéMON MART?\pThere's a guy in there who's trying to
bust up boulders so he can bust out\lthrough to the other side.\pIt'd be great if we could go through…
It'll make it easy to visit RUSTBORO.$

label: VerdanturfTown_Text_MakeBattleTentDebut
text: My POKéMON and I, we've been riding\na hot winning streak.\pSo I decided to make my BATTLE TENT\ndebut in this town.$

label: VerdanturfTown_Text_ManDugTunnelForLove
text: There was a man who dug a tunnel for\na lady he loved.\pI don't really get it, but hey!$

label: VerdanturfTown_Text_ManTryingToDigTunnel
text:
My papa told me.\pHe says this tunnel is full of
timid POKéMON.\pThey get all scared of loud noise and
make a big uproar.\pSo they had to stop the big tunnel
project.\pBut there's one man. He's trying to dig
the tunnel by himself!$

label: VerdanturfTown_Text_RusturfTunnelSign
text: RUSTURF TUNNEL\n“Linking RUSTBORO and VERDANTURF\p“The tunnel project has been\ncanceled.”$

label: VerdanturfTown_Text_TownSign
text: VERDANTURF TOWN\p“The windswept highlands with the\nsweet fragrance of grass.”$

label: VerdanturfTown_Text_WandasHouse
text: WANDA'S HOUSE$

label: VerdanturfTown_WandasHouse_Text_CanSeeGirlfriendEveryDay
text: Thanks to you, I can see my girlfriend\nevery day.\lHappy? You bet I am!$

label: VerdanturfTown_WandasHouse_Text_DaughtersBoyfriendDriven
text:
My daughter's boyfriend is a very
driven and passionate sort of person.\pHe's been digging a tunnel nonstop
just so he can see my daughter.\pMy daughter's a little concerned,
so she goes out to the tunnel a lot.$

label: VerdanturfTown_WandasHouse_Text_DaughtersBoyfriendWasDigging
text: It's amazing. My daughter's boyfriend\nwas digging the tunnel by hand!\pIt's so incredible!$

label: VerdanturfTown_WandasHouse_Text_DontWorryAboutWally
text: WANDA: Don't worry about WALLY.\nHe'll be just fine.\pI know my little cousin, and he has\nPOKéMON with him, too.$

label: VerdanturfTown_WandasHouse_Text_IfAnythingHappenedToWally
text: If anything were to happen to WALLY,\nI would never be able to look his\lparents in PETALBURG in the eye…$

label: VerdanturfTown_WandasHouse_Text_MeetWanda
text:
WANDA: You are?
Oh, right, I get it!\pYou're the {PLAYER} who WALLY was
telling me about.\pI'm WALLY's cousin.
Glad to meet you!\pI think WALLY's become a lot more lively
and healthy since he came here.$

label: VerdanturfTown_WandasHouse_Text_StrongerSpeech
text:
WALLY: I lost to you, {PLAYER}, but I'm
not feeling down anymore.\pBecause I have a new purpose in life.
Together with my RALTS, I'm going\lto challenge POKéMON GYMS and become\la great TRAINER.\pPlease watch me, {PLAYER}.
I'm going to be stronger than you.\pWhen I do, I'm going to challenge you
to another battle.$

label: VerdanturfTown_WandasHouse_Text_StrongerSpeechShort
text: WALLY: Please watch me, {PLAYER}.\nI'm going to get stronger than you.\pWhen I do, I'm going to challenge you\nto another battle.$

label: VerdanturfTown_WandasHouse_Text_WallyGoneThatFar
text: UNCLE: Is that right?\nWALLY's gone away that far all by\lhimself…\pWell, I have to give him credit--he is\nmy little brother's son.$

label: VerdanturfTown_WandasHouse_Text_WallySlippedOff
text: WALLY's gone away…\nHe slipped off on his own…$

label: VerdanturfTown_WandasHouse_Text_WallyWasInEverGrande
text: WALLY was in EVER GRANDE?\pHis parents in PETALBURG would be\nastonished to hear that!$

label: VerdanturfTown_WandasHouse_Text_WallysNextDoor
text:
UNCLE: Oh! {PLAYER}{KUN}!
WALLY's next door.\pBut, boy, there's something I have to
tell you.\pThis natural environment is doing
wonders for WALLY's health.\pMaybe it's not just the environment.
It could be POKéMON that are giving\lthe boy hope.$

label: VermilionCity_Gym_Text_BailyDefeat
text: Fried!$

label: VermilionCity_Gym_Text_BailyIntro
text: I'm a lightweight, but I'm good\nwith electricity!\pThat's why I joined this GYM.$

label: VermilionCity_Gym_Text_BailyPostBattle
text: Okay, I'll talk!\pLT. SURGE said he hid door\nswitches inside something.$

label: VermilionCity_Gym_Text_DwayneDefeat
text: Wow!\nSurprised me!$

label: VermilionCity_Gym_Text_DwayneIntro
text: This is no place for kids!\nNot even if you're good!$

label: VermilionCity_Gym_Text_DwaynePostBattle
text:
LT. SURGE installed the traps in
the GYM himself.\pHe set up double locks everywhere.
Let me give you a hint.\pWhen you open the first lock, the
second lock is right next to it.$

label: VermilionCity_Gym_Text_ExplainTM34
text: TM34 contains SHOCK WAVE!\pTeach it to an ELECTRIC POKéMON!$

label: VermilionCity_Gym_Text_ExplainThunderBadgeTakeThis
text:
The THUNDERBADGE cranks up your
POKéMON's SPEED!\pIt also lets your POKéMON FLY
lightning-quick anytime, kid!\pYou're special, kid!
Take this!$

label: VermilionCity_Gym_Text_GymGuyAdvice
text:
Yo!
Champ in the making!\pLT. SURGE has a nickname.\pPeople refer to him as the
Lightning American!\pHe's an expert on electric
POKéMON.\pBIRD/WATER-type POKéMON match
poorly against the ELECTRIC type.\pBeware of paralysis, too.\pLT. SURGE is very cautious.\pHe's locked himself in, so it won't
be easy getting to him.$

label: VermilionCity_Gym_Text_GymGuyPostVictory
text: Whew!\nThat match was electric!$

label: VermilionCity_Gym_Text_GymStatue
text: VERMILION POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: LT. SURGE\pWINNING TRAINERS:\n{RIVAL}$

label: VermilionCity_Gym_Text_GymStatuePlayerWon
text: VERMILION POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: LT. SURGE\pWINNING TRAINERS:\n{RIVAL}, {PLAYER}$

label: VermilionCity_Gym_Text_LtSurgeDefeat
text: Now that's a shocker!\pYou're the real deal, kid!\pFine, then, take the THUNDERBADGE!$

label: VermilionCity_Gym_Text_LtSurgeIntro
text:
Hey, kid! What do you think you're
doing here?\pYou won't live long in combat!
Not with your puny power!\pI tell you, kid, electric POKéMON
saved me during the war!\pThey zapped my enemies into
paralysis!\pThe same as I'll do to you!{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_RG_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}$

label: VermilionCity_Gym_Text_LtSurgePostBattle
text: A little word of advice, kid!\pElectricity is sure powerful!\pBut, it's useless against GROUND-\ntype POKéMON!$

label: VermilionCity_Gym_Text_MakeRoomInYourBag
text: Yo, kid, make room in your BAG!$

label: VermilionCity_Gym_Text_NopeOnlyTrashHere
text: Nope!\nThere's only trash here.$

label: VermilionCity_Gym_Text_OnlyTrashLocksWereReset
text: Nope!\nThere's only trash here.\pHey!\nThe electric locks were reset!$

label: VermilionCity_Gym_Text_ReceivedTM34FromLtSurge
text: {PLAYER} received TM34\nfrom LT. SURGE.$

label: VermilionCity_Gym_Text_SecondLockOpened
text: The second electric lock opened!\nThe motorized door opened!$

label: VermilionCity_Gym_Text_SwitchUnderTrashFirstLockOpened
text: Hey! There's a switch under the\ntrash! Turn it on!\pThe first electric lock opened!$

label: VermilionCity_Gym_Text_TuckerDefeat
text: Stop!\nYou're very good!$

label: VermilionCity_Gym_Text_TuckerIntro
text: When I was in the Army, LT. SURGE\nwas my strict CO.\pHe was a hard taskmaster.$

label: VermilionCity_Gym_Text_TuckerPostBattle
text: It's not easy opening that door.\pLT. SURGE was always famous for\nhis cautious nature in the Army.$

label: VermilionCity_House1_Text_FishingIsAWayOfLife
text: Fishing is a way of life!\nIt is like the finest poetry.\pFrom the seas to rivers, go out\nand land the big one, my friend.$

label: VermilionCity_House1_Text_HowAreTheFishBiting
text: Hello there, {PLAYER}!\pHow are the fish biting?$

label: VermilionCity_House1_Text_ImFishingGuruDoYouLikeToFish
text: I'm the FISHING GURU!\pI simply looove fishing!\nI can't bear to go without.\pTell me, do you like to fish?$

label: VermilionCity_House1_Text_NoRoomForNiceGift
text: Oh, no!\pI had a nice gift for you, but you\nhave no room for it!$

label: VermilionCity_House1_Text_OhThatsSoDisappointing
text: Oh…\nThat's so disappointing…$

label: VermilionCity_House1_Text_ReceivedOldRodFromFishingGuru
text: {PLAYER} received an OLD ROD from\nthe FISHING GURU.$

label: VermilionCity_House1_Text_TakeThisAndFish
text: Grand! I like your style.\nI think we can be friends.\pTake this and fish, young friend!$

label: VermilionCity_House2_Text_DoYouHaveMonWantToTradeForMyMon
text: Hi!\nDo you have a {STR_VAR_1}?\pWant to trade it for my\n{STR_VAR_2}?$

label: VermilionCity_House2_Text_HowIsMyOldMon
text: How is my old {STR_VAR_2}?\pMy {STR_VAR_1} is doing great!$

label: VermilionCity_House2_Text_ThankYou
text: Thank you!$

label: VermilionCity_House2_Text_ThatsTooBad
text: That's too bad.$

label: VermilionCity_House2_Text_ThisIsNoMon
text: …This is no {STR_VAR_1}.\pIf you get one, please trade it\nto me!$

label: VermilionCity_House3_Text_DearPippiLetter
text: Dear PIPPI,\nI hope to see you soon.\pI heard SAFFRON has problems with\nTEAM ROCKET.\pVERMILION appears to be safe.$

label: VermilionCity_House3_Text_Pidgey
text: PIDGEY: Kurukkoo!$

label: VermilionCity_House3_Text_PidgeyFlyLetterToSaffron
text: I'm getting my PIDGEY to fly a\nletter to SAFFRON in the north.$

label: VermilionCity_House3_Text_SendMyPidgeyToUnionRoom
text: I want to exchange MAIL with all\nsorts of people.\pI send my PIDGEY to a UNION ROOM\nto exchange MAIL for me.$

label: VermilionCity_Mart_Text_MonsGoodOrBadDependingOnTrainer
text: I think POKéMON can be good or\nbad. It depends on the TRAINER.$

label: VermilionCity_Mart_Text_TeamRocketAreWickedPeople
text:
There are wicked people who will
use POKéMON for criminal acts.\pTEAM ROCKET traffics in rare
POKéMON, for example.\pThey also abandon POKéMON that
they consider unpopular or useless.\pThat's the sort of horrid people
they are, TEAM ROCKET.$

label: VermilionCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_AllMonWeakToSpecificTypes
text:
It is true that a higher-level
POKéMON will be more powerful…\pBut, all POKéMON will have weak
points against specific types.\pSo, there appears to be no
universally strong POKéMON.$

label: VermilionCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_ExplainVSSeeker
text:
How do you use the VS SEEKER?
There's nothing to it.\pUse it like beep-beep-beep, and
TRAINERS around you will notice.\pIf any TRAINER wants a rematch,
it will let you know immediately.\pCharge its battery and use it
while you're on a road.$

label: VermilionCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_PoisonedMonFaintedWhileWalking
text: My POKéMON was poisoned!\nIt fainted while we were walking!$

label: VermilionCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_TrainerMonsStrongerThanWild
text: Even if they are the same level,\nPOKéMON can have very different\lstats and abilities.\pA POKéMON raised by a TRAINER is\nstronger than one in the wild.$

label: VermilionCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_UrgeToBattleSomeoneAgain
text:
The urge to battle with someone
you've tangled with before…\pHave you ever had that urge?
I'm sure you have.\pI wanted to battle certain people
again over and over, too.\pSo, I've been giving these away.
Please, take one!$

label: VermilionCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_UseDeviceForRematches
text: Use that device and you'll find\nTRAINERS looking for a rematch.\pYou have to charge its battery to\nuse it, though.$

label: VermilionCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_AdmirePikachusTail
text: Won't you admire my PIKACHU's\nadorable tail?$

label: VermilionCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_AdoreMySeel
text: I just adore my SEEL!\nIt's so lovable!\pIt squeals, “Kyuuuh,” when I\nhug it!$

label: VermilionCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_ChairmanReallyAdoresHisMons
text: Our CHAIRMAN really does adore his\nPOKéMON.\pBut the person who is most liked by\nPOKéMON is DAISY, I think.$

label: VermilionCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_ChairmanVeryVocalAboutPokemon
text: Our CHAIRMAN is very vocal about\nPOKéMON.$

label: VermilionCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_ChairmansStory
text:
Good!
Then listen up!\pMy favorite RAPIDASH…\pIt's…cute…lovely…smart… 
plus…amazing…you think so?…\loh yes…it's…stunning…\lkindly…love it!\pHug it…when…sleeping…warm
and cuddly…spectacular…\lravishing…\l…Oops! Look at the time!\lI kept you too long!\pThanks for hearing me out!
I want you to have this!$

label: VermilionCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_ComeBackToHearStory
text: Oh. Come back when you want to\nhear my story!$

label: VermilionCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_DidYouComeToHearAboutMyMons
text:
I chair the POKéMON Fan Club!\pI raise more than a hundred
POKéMON!\pI'm very fussy when it comes to
POKéMON! I surely am!\pSo…\pDid you come visit to hear about
my POKéMON?$

label: VermilionCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_DidntComeToSeeAboutMonsAgain
text: Hello, {PLAYER}!\pDid you come see me about my\nPOKéMON again?\pNo?\nToo bad!$

label: VermilionCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_ExplainBikeVoucher
text:
Take that BIKE VOUCHER to the
BIKE SHOP in CERULEAN CITY.\pExchange that for a BICYCLE
free of charge!\pDon't worry, my favorite FEAROW
will FLY me anywhere I need to go.\pSo, I have no need for a BICYCLE.\pI hope you like cycling!$

label: VermilionCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_ListenPolitelyToOtherTrainers
text: Let's all listen politely to other\nTRAINERS!$

label: VermilionCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_MakeRoomForThis
text: Make room for this!$

label: VermilionCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_Pikachu
text: PIKACHU: Chu! Pikachu!$

label: VermilionCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_PikachuTwiceAsCute
text: Humph!\pMy PIKACHU is twice as cute as\nthat one!$

label: VermilionCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_ReceivedBikeVoucherFromChairman
text: {PLAYER} received a BIKE VOUCHER\nfrom the CHAIRMAN.$

label: VermilionCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_Seel
text: SEEL: Kyuoo!$

label: VermilionCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_SeelFarMoreAttractive
text: Oh, dear!\pMy SEEL is far more attractive.\nBy double, I would say.$

label: VermilionCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_SomeoneBragsBragBack
text: If someone brags, brag right back!$

label: VermilionCity_Text_BoardSeagallopFerry
text: Would you like to board\na SEAGALLOP ferry?$

label: VermilionCity_Text_BoardSeagallopRainbowPass
text: Ah, you have a RAINBOW PASS.\pWould you like to board\na SEAGALLOP ferry?$

label: VermilionCity_Text_BoardSeagallopTriPass
text: Ah, you have a TRI-PASS.\pWould you like to board\na SEAGALLOP ferry?$

label: VermilionCity_Text_BuildingOnThisLand
text: I'm putting up a building on this\nplot of land. I own it all.\pMy POKéMON is tamping the land\nto lay the foundation.$

label: VermilionCity_Text_CitySign
text: VERMILION CITY\nThe Port of Exquisite Sunsets$

label: VermilionCity_Text_DidYouSeeSSAnneInHarbor
text: Did you see the S.S. ANNE moored\nin the harbor?$

label: VermilionCity_Text_DoYouHaveATicket
text: Welcome to the S.S. ANNE!\pExcuse me, do you have a ticket?$

label: VermilionCity_Text_DontHaveNeededSSTicket
text: {FONT_NORMAL}{PLAYER} doesn't have the needed\nS.S. TICKET.\p{FONT_MALE}Sorry!\pYou need a ticket to get aboard.$

label: VermilionCity_Text_FlashedSSTicket
text: {FONT_NORMAL}{PLAYER} flashed the S.S. TICKET!\p{FONT_MALE}Great!\nWelcome to the S.S. ANNE!$

label: VermilionCity_Text_GrimerMultipliesInSludge
text: We're careful about pollution here.\pWe've heard GRIMER multiplies in\ntoxic sludge.$

label: VermilionCity_Text_GymSign
text: VERMILION CITY POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: LT. SURGE\lThe Lightning American!$

label: VermilionCity_Text_Machop
text: MACHOP: Guoh! Gogogoh!$

label: VermilionCity_Text_MachopStompingLandFlat
text: A MACHOP is stomping the land flat.$

label: VermilionCity_Text_OhAuroraTicketTakeYouToBirthIsland
text: Oh! That's an AURORATICKET!\nNow that is rare.\pWe'll be happy to take you to\nBIRTH ISLAND anytime.$

label: VermilionCity_Text_OhMysticTicketTakeYouToNavelRock
text: Oh! That's a MYSTICTICKET!\nNow that is rare.\pWe'll be happy to take you to\nNAVEL ROCK anytime.$

label: VermilionCity_Text_PokemonFanClubSign
text: POKéMON FAN CLUB\nAll POKéMON fans welcome!$

label: VermilionCity_Text_Route2AideHasPackageForYou
text:
Oh, hello, {PLAYER}!
How are you doing?\pIt's me, one of PROF. OAK's AIDES.\pDid you meet the other AIDE?\pHe had a package from PROF. OAK
for you, {PLAYER}.\pHe said he'd look for you around
ROUTE 2, {PLAYER}.\pIf you're in the ROUTE 2 area,
please look for him.$

label: VermilionCity_Text_SSAnneHasDepartedForYear
text: So, the S.S. ANNE has departed?\pShe'll be back in VERMILION about\nthis time next year.$

label: VermilionCity_Text_SSAnneVisitsOnceAYear
text: The S.S. ANNE is a famous luxury\ncruise ship.\pIt visits VERMILION once a year.$

label: VermilionCity_Text_Seagallop10Departing
text: Okay, everything's in order for you\nto board a special ferry.\pSEAGALLOP HI-SPEED 10 will be\ndeparting immediately.$

label: VermilionCity_Text_Seagallop12Departing
text: Okay, everything's in order for you\nto board a special ferry.\pSEAGALLOP HI-SPEED 12 will be\ndeparting immediately.$

label: VermilionCity_Text_Seagallop7Departing
text: Okay, everything's in order.\pSEAGALLOP HI-SPEED 7 will be\ndeparting immediately.$

label: VermilionCity_Text_SnorlaxBlockingRoute12
text: NOTICE!\pROUTE 12 may be blocked off by a\nsleeping POKéMON.\pDetour through ROCK TUNNEL to\nLAVENDER TOWN.\pVERMILION POLICE$

label: VermilionCity_Text_TheShipSetSail
text: The ship set sail.$

label: VermilionCity_Text_VermilionHarbor
text: VERMILION HARBOR$

label: VermilionCity_Text_WelcomeToTheSSAnne
text: Welcome to the S.S. ANNE!$

label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_AlbertDefeat
text: Impossible…\nI lost?$

label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_AlbertIntro
text: I didn't come all this way to lose now.\nThat possibility doesn't exist!$

label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_AlbertPostBattle
text: I lost here…\pThat means I lack the qualifications\nto become the CHAMPION…$

label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_EdgarDefeat
text: My dream ends here again…$

label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_EdgarIntro
text: I've made it this far a couple times,\nbut the last stretch is so long…$

label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_EdgarPostBattle
text: You've made it this far. Keep the\nmomentum going and become the\lCHAMPION! If anyone can, it's you!$

label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_HopeDefeat
text: Your battle style is fantastic…$

label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_HopeIntro
text: This seemingly infinite and harsh road\nlives up to its name of VICTORY.$

label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_HopePostBattle
text: You seem to have the potential for\nbecoming the CHAMPION.$

label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_KatelynnDefeat
text: This is a disgrace…$

label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_KatelynnIntro
text: I have nothing to say to anyone\nthat's come this far. Come on!$

label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_KatelynnPostBattle
text: Humph, go right on ahead.\nSee if I care.$

label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_NaomiDefeat
text: I lost out…$

label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_NaomiIntro
text: I wonder if you are good enough\nfor me?$

label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_NaomiPostBattle
text: I never wanted to lose to anybody,\nespecially to a younger kid…$

label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_QuincyDefeat
text: Okay!\nWell done!$

label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_QuincyIntro
text: What is the VICTORY ROAD?\nI'll tell you if you win!$

label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_QuincyPostBattle
text: Getting through here safely--that's\nthe final test for any TRAINER aiming\lto become the POKéMON CHAMPION.\pThat's why it's called the VICTORY\nROAD.$

label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_RolandoDefeat
text: I had a chance…$

label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_RolandoIntro
text: I can see you're good.\nLet me see exactly how good!$

label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_RolandoPostBattle
text: Tch!\nI concede, you are better than I!$

label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_WallyDefeat
text: Wow!\n{PLAYER}, you are strong, after all!$

label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_WallyEntranceDefeat
text: Wow!\n{PLAYER}, you are strong, after all!$

label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_WallyIntro
text: WALLY: Hi! {PLAYER}!\pI've gotten stronger since that last\ntime! I wanted to show you, {PLAYER}!\pOkay… Here I come!$

label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_WallyNotGoingToLoseAnymore
text:
WALLY: Hi! {PLAYER}!\pI bet you're surprised to see me here!\pI made it all the way here, and it's
all thanks to you!\p{PLAYER}, losing to you that time
made me stronger!\pBut I'm not going to lose anymore!\pI'm going to win! For the POKéMON who
gave me courage and strength!\pOkay… Here I come!$

label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_WallyPostBattle
text: WALLY: I couldn't beat you this time,\ntoo… But one of these days, {PLAYER},\lI'm going to catch up to you…\pAnd challenge the POKéMON LEAGUE!$

label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_WallyPostEntranceBattle
text: WALLY: I couldn't beat you today,\n{PLAYER}, but one of these days, I'll\lcatch up to you!$

label: VictoryRoad_2F_Text_DaisukeDefeat
text: Atcho!$

label: VictoryRoad_2F_Text_DaisukeIntro
text: This here is VICTORY ROAD.\nIt's the final test for TRAINERS!$

label: VictoryRoad_2F_Text_DaisukePostBattle
text: If you get stuck, try moving some\nboulders around.$

label: VictoryRoad_2F_Text_DawsonDefeat
text: No!\nUnbelievable!$

label: VictoryRoad_2F_Text_DawsonIntro
text: If you can get through here,\nyou can go meet the ELITE FOUR.$

label: VictoryRoad_2F_Text_DawsonPostBattle
text: I can beat you when it comes to\nknowledge about POKéMON!$

label: VictoryRoad_2F_Text_GregoryDefeat
text: Well done!$

label: VictoryRoad_2F_Text_GregoryIntro
text: Is VICTORY ROAD too tough?$

label: VictoryRoad_2F_Text_GregoryPostBattle
text: Many TRAINERS give up their\nchallenge here and go home.$

label: VictoryRoad_2F_Text_NelsonDefeat
text: You got me!$

label: VictoryRoad_2F_Text_NelsonIntro
text: Ah, so you wish to challenge the\nELITE FOUR?$

label: VictoryRoad_2F_Text_NelsonPostBattle
text: {RIVAL} also came through here.$

label: VictoryRoad_2F_Text_VincentDefeat
text: I got whipped!$

label: VictoryRoad_2F_Text_VincentIntro
text: Come on!\nI'll whip you!$

label: VictoryRoad_2F_Text_VincentPostBattle
text: You earned the right to be on\nVICTORY ROAD…$

label: VictoryRoad_3F_Text_AlexaDefeat
text: Oh!\nSo strong!$

label: VictoryRoad_3F_Text_AlexaIntro
text: TRAINERS live to seek stronger\nopponents.$

label: VictoryRoad_3F_Text_AlexaPostBattle
text: By fighting tough battles, you get\nstronger.$

label: VictoryRoad_3F_Text_CarolineDefeat
text: I'm furious!$

label: VictoryRoad_3F_Text_CarolineIntro
text: I'll show you just how good you\nare. Not!$

label: VictoryRoad_3F_Text_CarolinePostBattle
text: You showed me just how good\nI was…$

label: VictoryRoad_3F_Text_ColbyDefeat
text: I don't believe it!$

label: VictoryRoad_3F_Text_ColbyIntro
text: Only the chosen can pass here!$

label: VictoryRoad_3F_Text_ColbyPostBattle
text: All TRAINERS here are headed to\nthe POKéMON LEAGUE.\pDon't let down your guard.$

label: VictoryRoad_3F_Text_GeorgeDefeat
text: The rumors were true!$

label: VictoryRoad_3F_Text_GeorgeIntro
text: I heard about a promising newcomer.$

label: VictoryRoad_3F_Text_GeorgePostBattle
text: So, it was you who beat GIOVANNI\nof TEAM ROCKET?$

label: VictoryRoad_3F_Text_RayDefeat
text: RAY: Ludicrous!\nThis can't be!$

label: VictoryRoad_3F_Text_RayIntro
text: RAY: Together, the two of us are\ndestined for greatness!$

label: VictoryRoad_3F_Text_RayNotEnoughMons
text: RAY: Together, the two of us are\nstriving for the pinnacle.\pWe need you to bring two POKéMON\ninto battle with us.$

label: VictoryRoad_3F_Text_RayPostBattle
text: RAY: You've beaten us.\nGreatness remains elusive…$

label: VictoryRoad_3F_Text_TyraDefeat
text: TYRA: Oh, but…$

label: VictoryRoad_3F_Text_TyraIntro
text: TYRA: We're trying to become\nchampions together.$

label: VictoryRoad_3F_Text_TyraNotEnoughMons
text: TYRA: You can't battle with us if\nyou have only one POKéMON.$

label: VictoryRoad_3F_Text_TyraPostBattle
text: TYRA: You've taught me that power\ncan be infinite in shape and form.$

label: VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_HalleDefeat
text: Whoa!\nWonderful!$

label: VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_HalleIntro
text: Okay, no need to get your back up!\nRelax, let's take it easy!$

label: VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_HallePostBattle
text: Sure, this is VICTORY ROAD.\pBut it's not all that different from\nthe path you've taken so far.\pTry to enjoy things the rest of\nthe way!$

label: VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_MichelleDefeat
text: That's the way!$

label: VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_MichelleIntro
text: This isn't the goal. It's only a place\non the way to the POKéMON LEAGUE.$

label: VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_MichellePostBattle
text: You'll do fine, for sure!\nYour POKéMON are all eager to go!$

label: VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_MitchellDefeat
text: I've never met anyone like you before.$

label: VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_MitchellIntro
text: My POKéMON are cosmically\nawe inspiring!$

label: VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_MitchellPostBattle
text: Even outside of battle, I sense\nincredible power emanating from you\land your POKéMON.$

label: VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_SamuelDefeat
text: I couldn't do a thing…$

label: VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_SamuelIntro
text: The thought that I'm getting closer to\nthe POKéMON LEAGUE…\pI'm getting stage fright…$

label: VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_SamuelPostBattle
text: The POKéMON LEAGUE became distant\nagain… What a letdown…$

label: VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_ShannonDefeat
text: Your relationship is based on\nsolid trust.$

label: VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_ShannonIntro
text: To win your way through the POKéMON\nLEAGUE, you need the trust of your\lPOKéMON.$

label: VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_ShannonPostBattle
text: By being together all the time, trust\ngrows between POKéMON and TRAINERS.$

label: VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_CarolineDefeat
text: No signs of tiring at all!$

label: VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_CarolineIntro
text: You must be getting a little tired.$

label: VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_CarolinePostBattle
text: VICTORY ROAD and the POKéMON LEAGUE\nare long and grueling challenges.\lBeware of fatigue!$

label: VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_DianneDefeat
text: Not rattled in the least bit!$

label: VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_DianneIntro
text: The elite among the elite gather in\nthis cave.\pHow are you finding it?$

label: VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_DiannePostBattle
text: You do have guts! I like that!\nKeep it going!$

label: VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_FelixDefeat
text: Ooh…\nIt hurts…$

label: VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_FelixIntro
text: I've come this far, but the tension's\ngiving me awful stomach pain…$

label: VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_FelixPostBattle
text: I can't help getting all tense knowing\nthat I'm nearing the POKéMON LEAGUE.\pIt's all I can do to feign calm.$

label: VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_JulieDefeat
text: You're better than me!$

label: VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_JulieIntro
text: You shouldn't get complacent just\nbecause you have a lot of GYM BADGES.\pThere's always going to be someone\nwho's better than you!$

label: VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_JuliePostBattle
text: Gaze on your collected BADGES and\nremember the TRAINERS you've faced.$

label: VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_OwenDefeat
text: The little shrimp is tough!$

label: VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_OwenIntro
text: I'd heard that there was a tough\nlittle kid around. Do they mean you?$

label: VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_OwenPostBattle
text: The rumors I heard, that tough little\nkid is from PETALBURG CITY.$

label: VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_VitoDefeat
text: Better than my family?!\nIs that possible?!$

label: VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_VitoIntro
text: I trained together with my whole family,\nevery one of us!\lI'm not losing to anyone!$

label: VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_VitoPostBattle
text: I was better than everyone in my\nfamily. I've never lost before…\pI've lost my confidence…\nMaybe I'll go home…$

label: ViridianCity_Gym_Text_AtsushiDefeat
text: Wargh!$

label: ViridianCity_Gym_Text_AtsushiIntro
text: Rrrroar!\nI'm working myself into a rage!$

label: ViridianCity_Gym_Text_AtsushiPostBattle
text: I'm still not worthy!$

label: ViridianCity_Gym_Text_ColeDefeat
text: Yowch!\nWhiplash!$

label: ViridianCity_Gym_Text_ColeIntro
text: Your POKéMON will cower at the\ncrack of my whip!$

label: ViridianCity_Gym_Text_ColePostBattle
text: Wait!\nI was just careless!$

label: ViridianCity_Gym_Text_ExplainEarthBadgeTakeThis
text:
The EARTHBADGE makes POKéMON of
any level obey without question.\pIt is evidence of your mastery as
a POKéMON TRAINER.\pWith it, you can challenge the
POKéMON LEAGUE.\pAlso, take this TM.\pConsider it a gift for your POKéMON
LEAGUE challenge.$

label: ViridianCity_Gym_Text_ExplainTM26
text: TM26 contains EARTHQUAKE.\pIt is a powerful attack that causes\na massive tremor.\pI made it when I ran the GYM here,\nfar too long ago… $

label: ViridianCity_Gym_Text_GiovanniDefeat
text: Ha!\nThat was a truly intense fight.\lYou have won!\pAs proof, here is the EARTHBADGE!\n{PAUSE_MUSIC}{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_OBTAIN_BADGE}{PAUSE 0xFE}{PAUSE 0x56}{RESUME_MUSIC}$

label: ViridianCity_Gym_Text_GiovanniIntro
text:
Fwahahaha!
Welcome to my hideout!\pIt shall be so until I can restore
TEAM ROCKET to its former glory.\pBut, you have found me again.
So be it.\lThis time, I'm not holding back!\pOnce more, you shall face
GIOVANNI, the greatest TRAINER!{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_RG_ENCOUNTER_ROCKET}$

label: ViridianCity_Gym_Text_GiovanniPostBattle
text:
Having lost in this fashion, 
I can't face my followers.\lI have betrayed their trust.\pAs of today, TEAM ROCKET is
finished forever!\pAs for myself, I shall dedicate
my life to training again.\pLet us meet again someday!
Farewell!$

label: ViridianCity_Gym_Text_GymGuyAdvice
text:
Yo!
Champ in the making!\pEven I don't know the VIRIDIAN
LEADER's identity.\pBut one thing's certain.
This will be the toughest of all\lthe GYM LEADERS.\pAlso, I heard that the TRAINERS
here like GROUND-type POKéMON.$

label: ViridianCity_Gym_Text_GymGuyPostVictory
text: Blow me away! GIOVANNI was the\nGYM LEADER of VIRIDIAN?$

label: ViridianCity_Gym_Text_GymStatue
text: VIRIDIAN POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: ?\pWINNING TRAINERS:\n{RIVAL}$

label: ViridianCity_Gym_Text_GymStatuePlayerWon
text: VIRIDIAN POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: GIOVANNI\pWINNING TRAINERS:\n{RIVAL}, {PLAYER}$

label: ViridianCity_Gym_Text_JasonDefeat
text: You are in perfect harmony!$

label: ViridianCity_Gym_Text_JasonIntro
text: POKéMON and I, we make wonderful\nmusic together!$

label: ViridianCity_Gym_Text_JasonPostBattle
text: Do you know the identity of our\nGYM LEADER?$

label: ViridianCity_Gym_Text_KiyoDefeat
text: Aiyah!$

label: ViridianCity_Gym_Text_KiyoIntro
text: Karate is the ultimate form of\nmartial arts!$

label: ViridianCity_Gym_Text_KiyoPostBattle
text: If my POKéMON were as good at\nkarate as I…$

label: ViridianCity_Gym_Text_ReceivedTM26FromGiovanni
text: {PLAYER} received TM26\nfrom GIOVANNI.$

label: ViridianCity_Gym_Text_SamuelDefeat
text: I was beaten?$

label: ViridianCity_Gym_Text_SamuelIntro
text: VIRIDIAN GYM was closed for a\nlong time.\pBut now, our LEADER is back!$

label: ViridianCity_Gym_Text_SamuelPostBattle
text: You can go on to the POKéMON\nLEAGUE only by defeating our GYM\lLEADER!$

label: ViridianCity_Gym_Text_TakashiDefeat
text: Ayah!$

label: ViridianCity_Gym_Text_TakashiIntro
text: I'm the KARATE KING!\nYour fate rests with me!$

label: ViridianCity_Gym_Text_TakashiPostBattle
text: The POKéMON LEAGUE?\nYou? Don't get cocky!$

label: ViridianCity_Gym_Text_WarrenDefeat
text: I lost my grip!$

label: ViridianCity_Gym_Text_WarrenIntro
text: The truly talented win with style.$

label: ViridianCity_Gym_Text_WarrenPostBattle
text: The LEADER will scold me for\nlosing this way…$

label: ViridianCity_Gym_Text_YouDoNotHaveSpace
text: You do not have space for this!$

label: ViridianCity_Gym_Text_YujiDefeat
text: I ran out of gas!$

label: ViridianCity_Gym_Text_YujiIntro
text: Heh!\nYou must be running out of steam\lby now!$

label: ViridianCity_Gym_Text_YujiPostBattle
text: You'll need power to keep up with\nour GYM LEADER.$

label: ViridianCity_House_Text_MyDaddyLovesMonsToo
text: My daddy loves POKéMON, too.$

label: ViridianCity_House_Text_NicknamingIsFun
text: Coming up with nicknames is fun,\nbut it's not so easy to do.\pClever names are nice, but simple\nnames are easier to remember.$

label: ViridianCity_House_Text_SpearowNameSpeary
text: SPEAROW\nName: SPEARY$

label: ViridianCity_House_Text_Speary
text: SPEARY: Tetweet!$

label: ViridianCity_Mart_Text_GotToBuySomePotions
text: I've got to buy some POTIONS.\pYou never know when your POKéMON\nwill need quick healing.$

label: ViridianCity_Mart_Text_ReceivedOaksParcelFromClerk
text: {PLAYER} received OAK'S PARCEL\nfrom the POKéMON MART clerk.$

label: ViridianCity_Mart_Text_SayHiToOakForMe
text: Okay, thanks! Please say hi to\nPROF. OAK for me, too.$

label: ViridianCity_Mart_Text_ShopDoesGoodBusinessInAntidotes
text: This shop does good business in\nANTIDOTES, I've heard.$

label: ViridianCity_Mart_Text_TakeThisToProfOak
text: You know PROF. OAK, right?\pHis order came in.\nCan I get you to take it to him?$

label: ViridianCity_Mart_Text_YouCameFromPallet
text: Hey!\nYou came from PALLET TOWN?$

label: ViridianCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_FeelFreeToUsePC
text: Please feel free to use that PC in\nthe corner.\pThe receptionist told me so.\nIt's so kind of her!$

label: ViridianCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_PokeCenterInEveryTown
text: There's a POKéMON CENTER in every\ntown ahead.\pThey charge no money, so don't\nbe shy about healing POKéMON.$

label: ViridianCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_PokeCentersHealMons
text: POKéMON CENTERS heal your tired,\nhurt, or fainted POKéMON.\pThey make all POKéMON completely\nhealthy.$

label: ViridianCity_School_Text_BlackboardListsStatusProblems
text: The blackboard lists POKéMON\nSTATUS problems during battles.$

label: ViridianCity_School_Text_ExplainBurn
text: A burn reduces ATTACK power.\nIt also causes ongoing HP loss.\pA burn remains after a battle.\nUse BURN HEAL to cure a burn.$

label: ViridianCity_School_Text_ExplainFreeze
text:
A frozen POKéMON becomes
helplessly immobile.\pIt stays frozen even after the
battle ends.\pUse ICE HEAL to thaw out the
suffering POKéMON.$

label: ViridianCity_School_Text_ExplainParalysis
text: Paralysis reduces SPEED and may\nprevent the POKéMON from moving.\pParalysis remains after battles.\nUse PARLYZ HEAL for treatment.$

label: ViridianCity_School_Text_ExplainPoison
text: When poisoned, a POKéMON's health\nsteadily drops.\pPoison lingers after battles.\nUse an ANTIDOTE to cure poison!$

label: ViridianCity_School_Text_ExplainSleep
text:
A POKéMON can't attack if it's
asleep.\pPOKéMON will stay asleep even
after battles.\pUse AWAKENING to awaken one
from sleep.$

label: ViridianCity_School_Text_HeyDontLookAtMyNotes
text: GIRL: Hey!\nDon't look at my notes!$

label: ViridianCity_School_Text_NotebookFirstPage
text:
Let's check out the notebook.\pFirst page…\pPOKé BALLS are used to catch
POKéMON.\pUp to six POKéMON can be carried
in your party.\pPeople who raise and battle
with POKéMON are called TRAINERS.$

label: ViridianCity_School_Text_NotebookFourthPage
text:
Fourth page…\pThe ultimate goal for all POKéMON
TRAINERS is simple.\pIt is to defeat the top eight
POKéMON GYM LEADERS.\pDo so to earn the right to face…\pThe ELITE FOUR of the POKéMON
LEAGUE!$

label: ViridianCity_School_Text_NotebookSecondPage
text: Second page…\pA healthy POKéMON may be hard to\ncatch, so weaken it first.\pPoison, burn, or cause another\nstatus problem to weaken it.$

label: ViridianCity_School_Text_NotebookThirdPage
text:
Third page…\pPOKéMON TRAINERS seek others to
engage in POKéMON battles.\pTo TRAINERS, the taste of victory
is sweet, indeed.\pBattles are constantly waged at
POKéMON GYMS everywhere.$

label: ViridianCity_School_Text_ReadBlackboardCarefully
text: Okay!\pBe sure to read what's on the\nblackboard carefully!$

label: ViridianCity_School_Text_ReadWhichTopic
text: Which topic do you want to read?$

label: ViridianCity_School_Text_TryingToMemorizeNotes
text: Whew! I'm trying to memorize all my\nnotes.$

label: ViridianCity_School_Text_TurnThePage
text: Turn the page?$

label: ViridianCity_Text_CanCarryMonsAnywhere
text: Those POKé BALLS at your waist!\nYou have POKéMON, don't you?\pIt's great that you can carry and\nuse POKéMON anytime, anywhere.$

label: ViridianCity_Text_CatchMonsForEasierBattles
text: TRAINER TIPS\pCatch POKéMON and expand your\ncollection.\pThe more you have, the easier it\nis to battle.$

label: ViridianCity_Text_CitySign
text: VIRIDIAN CITY \nThe Eternally Green Paradise$

label: ViridianCity_Text_ExplainCaterpieWeedle
text: CATERPIE has no poison,\nbut WEEDLE does.\pWatch that your POKéMON aren't\nstabbed by WEEDLE's POISON STING.$

label: ViridianCity_Text_GoShoppingInPewterOccasionally
text: I go shopping in PEWTER CITY\noccasionally.\pI have to take the winding trail in\nVIRIDIAN FOREST when I go.$

label: ViridianCity_Text_GrandpaHasntHadCoffeeYet
text: Oh, Grandpa!\nDon't be so mean!\pI'm so sorry.\nHe hasn't had his coffee yet.$

label: ViridianCity_Text_GymClosedWonderWhoLeaderIs
