text: This POKéMON GYM is always closed.\pI wonder who the LEADER is?$

label: ViridianCity_Text_GymDoorsAreLocked
text: VIRIDIAN GYM's doors are locked…$

label: ViridianCity_Text_GymSign
text: VIRIDIAN CITY POKéMON GYM$

label: ViridianCity_Text_HowsTeachyTVHelping
text:
Well, now, I've had my coffee, and
that's what I need to get going!\pBut I made it too strong.
It gave me a headache…\pIncidentally, is my old TEACHY TV
helping you?$

label: ViridianCity_Text_MovesLimitedByPP
text: TRAINER TIPS\pThe battle moves of POKéMON are\nlimited by their POWER POINTS, PP.\pTo replenish PP, rest your tired\nPOKéMON at a POKéMON CENTER.$

label: ViridianCity_Text_MyGrandsonOnTheShow
text: Wahaha!\nIt's my grandson on the show!\pSince he's the one doing the\nteaching, you're bound to learn.$

label: ViridianCity_Text_OhOkayThen
text: Oh, okay then!$

label: ViridianCity_Text_ShowYouHowToCatchMons
text:
Well, now, I've had my coffee, and
that's what I need to get going!\pHm?
What is that red box you have?\pAh, so you're working on your
POKéDEX.\pThen let me give you a word of
advice.\pWhenever you catch a POKéMON,
the POKéDEX automatically updates\lits data.\p…You don't know how to catch
a POKéMON?\pI suppose I had better show you
then!$

label: ViridianCity_Text_ThatWasEducationalTakeThis
text: There! Now tell me, that was\neducational, was it not?\pAnd here, take this, too.$

label: ViridianCity_Text_ThisIsPrivateProperty
text: I absolutely forbid you from\ngoing through here!\pThis is private property!$

label: ViridianCity_Text_TooBusyForTeachyTV
text: Hm… You're too busy to not even\nhave the time for TEACHY TV…\pTime is money, and neither should\nbe ill spent…$

label: ViridianCity_Text_ViridiansGymLeaderReturned
text: VIRIDIAN GYM's LEADER returned!$

label: ViridianCity_Text_WantToKnowAboutCaterpillarMons
text: You want to know about the two\nkinds of caterpillar POKéMON?$

label: ViridianCity_Text_WatchThatToLearnBasics
text: If there's something you don't\nunderstand, watch that.\pIt will teach you about the basics\nof being a POKéMON TRAINER.$

label: ViridianCity_Text_WeakenMonsFirstToCatch
text:
Well, now, I've had my coffee, and
that's what I need to get going!\pBut I made it too strong.
It gave me a headache…\pIncidentally, are you filling your
POKéDEX?\pAt first, focus on weakening the
POKéMON before trying to catch it.$

label: ViridianForest_Text_AnthonyDefeat
text: Oh, boo.\nNothing went right.$

label: ViridianForest_Text_AnthonyIntro
text: I might be little, but I won't like\nit if you go easy on me!$

label: ViridianForest_Text_AnthonyPostBattle
text: I lost some of my allowance…$

label: ViridianForest_Text_AvoidGrassyAreasWhenWeak
text: TRAINER TIPS\pIf your POKéMON are weak and you\nwant to avoid battles, stay away\lfrom grassy areas!$

label: ViridianForest_Text_CantCatchOwnedMons
text: TRAINER TIPS\pYou can't catch a POKéMON that\nbelongs to someone else.\pThrow POKé BALLS only at wild\nPOKéMON to catch them!$

label: ViridianForest_Text_CharlieDefeat
text: Oh!\nI lost!$

label: ViridianForest_Text_CharlieIntro
text: Did you know that POKéMON evolve?$

label: ViridianForest_Text_CharliePostBattle
text: BUG POKéMON evolve quickly.\nThey're a lot of fun!$

label: ViridianForest_Text_ContactOakViaPCToRatePokedex
text: TRAINER TIPS\pContact PROF. OAK via a PC to\nget your POKéDEX evaluated!$

label: ViridianForest_Text_DougDefeat
text: Huh?\nI ran out of POKéMON!$

label: ViridianForest_Text_DougIntro
text: Yo!\nYou can't jam out if you're a\lPOKéMON TRAINER!$

label: ViridianForest_Text_DougPostBattle
text: That totally stinks! I'm going to\ncatch some stronger ones!$

label: ViridianForest_Text_FriendsItchingToBattle
text: I came here with some friends to\ncatch us some BUG POKéMON!\pThey're all itching to get into\nsome POKéMON battles!$

label: ViridianForest_Text_LeavingViridianForest
text: LEAVING VIRIDIAN FOREST\nPEWTER CITY AHEAD$

label: ViridianForest_Text_RanOutOfPokeBalls
text: I was throwing POKé BALLS to\ncatch POKéMON, and I ran out.\pThat's why you can never have too\nmany POKé BALLS.$

label: ViridianForest_Text_RickDefeat
text: No!\nCATERPIE can't hack it!$

label: ViridianForest_Text_RickIntro
text: Hey! You have POKéMON!\nCome on!\lLet's battle 'em!$

label: ViridianForest_Text_RickPostBattle
text: Ssh! You'll scare the bugs away.\nAnother time, okay?$

label: ViridianForest_Text_SammyDefeat
text: I give!\nYou're good at this!$

label: ViridianForest_Text_SammyIntro
text: Hey, wait up!\nWhat's the hurry? Why the rush?$

label: ViridianForest_Text_SammyPostBattle
text: Sometimes, you can find stuff on\nthe ground.\pI'm looking for the stuff I\ndropped. Can you help me?$

label: ViridianForest_Text_UseAntidoteForPoison
text: For poison, use ANTIDOTE!\nGet it at POKéMON MARTS!$

label: ViridianForest_Text_WeakenMonsBeforeCapture
text: TRAINER TIPS\pWeaken POKéMON before attempting\ncapture!\pWhen healthy, they may escape!$

label: World_Rare0_Accept
text: It checks your pockets, then settles\ninto a battle stance. A tryout,\lapparently. You can catch it in this\lbattle.$

label: World_Rare0_DeclineText
text: It returns to surveying the road. The\nsnack research continues.$

label: World_Rare0_Intro
text: This SENTRET stands on its tail to\ninspect the crossroads. It seems to\lbe interviewing travelers about the\lquality of their snacks.$

label: World_Rare0_RestText
text: It is resting its tail. Perhaps come\nback after taking a walk.$

label: World_Rare10_Accept
text: It swims closer. Perhaps it wants to\nsee what makes circles somewhere\lelse. It offers you a battle; you can\lcatch it.$

label: World_Rare10_DeclineText
text: It settles back by the bank. You\nwatch a few more circles together.$

label: World_Rare10_Intro
text: This DRATINI is watching raindrops\nmake circles in the water. It seems\lreluctant to leave, but keeps\lglancing toward the road.$

label: World_Rare10_RestText
text: It is sheltering quietly after the\nbattle. Visit again later.$

label: World_Rare11_Accept
text: It turns to you and takes a\ntheatrical battle pose. An audition\lwith a live audience! You can catch it\lin this battle.$

label: World_Rare11_DeclineText
text: It returns to the mushrooms. Their\nreview remains difficult to read.$

label: World_Rare11_Intro
text: This CROAGUNK is performing to an\naudience of mushrooms. The\lmushrooms have maintained a very\lprofessional silence.$

label: World_Rare11_RestText
text: The performer is taking an interval.\nTry again later.$

label: World_Rare12_Accept
text: It focuses on your bag. A journey may\noffer useful data. It initiates a wild\lbattle; you can catch it.$

label: World_Rare12_DeclineText
text: It resumes studying the sign. The\noutdoors remains under evaluation.$

label: World_Rare12_Intro
text: This PORYGON is facing a sign, turning\naround, then facing it again. It\lappears to be deciding whether going\loutside was a software update.$

label: World_Rare12_RestText
text: It appears to be processing the last\nbattle. Come back after a walk.$

label: World_Rare13_Accept
text: It demonstrates its power and waits\nfor you. A battle seems to be its\lpractical exam; you can catch it.$

label: World_Rare13_DeclineText
text: It returns to monitoring the launch\nfacilities. Nobody has requested a\lhand crank yet.$

label: World_Rare13_Intro
text: This ELEKID keeps pointing at the\nSPACE CENTER, then winding its arms.\lIt seems convinced the rocket needs\lan enthusiastic hand crank.$

label: World_Rare13_RestText
text: It is recharging after the\ndemonstration. Visit again later.$

label: World_Rare14_Accept
text: It looks at your team with interest.\nPerhaps travel would broaden its\lmenu. It wants a battle first; you can\lcatch it.$

label: World_Rare14_DeclineText
text: It returns to its reviews. One pebble\nreceives an unusually thoughtful\lnod.$

label: World_Rare14_Intro
text: This LARVITAR has taken one bite\nfrom several stones. It appears to be\lreviewing the local geology, with\lstrong opinions about the texture.$

label: World_Rare14_RestText
text: The reviewer is resting. Please come\nback on another visit.$

label: World_Rare15_Accept
text: It hears you and approaches. Maybe\nfollowing a real companion would be\leasier. It challenges you; you can\lcatch it.$

label: World_Rare15_DeclineText
text: It returns to the trail, still hopeful.\nYou leave its path clear.$

label: World_Rare15_Intro
text: This DEINO has been carefully\nfollowing its own footsteps in a\lcircle. It seems determined to find\lthe trainer whose trail smells\lexactly like itself.$

label: World_Rare15_RestText
text: It is resting after the battle. Come\nback on another visit.$

label: World_Rare1_Accept
text: It notices you watching and wants a\nproper audience. Win its trust in a\lwild battle; you can catch it.$

label: World_Rare1_DeclineText
text: It tries again, a little louder. You\ntactfully look impressed.$

label: World_Rare1_Intro
text: This SHINX is practicing a fearsome\nroar. Each attempt surprises it\lslightly more than the listener.$

label: World_Rare1_RestText
text: It is taking a quiet break between\nvery small roars. Come back later.$

label: World_Rare2_Accept
text: It adds adventure to the list, then\nchallenges you to a battle. You can\lcatch it if you are ready.$

label: World_Rare2_DeclineText
text: It resumes the debate. Being able to\nnap wherever it likes remains a\lpowerful argument.$

label: World_Rare2_Intro
text: This EEVEE appears to be weighing\nthe pros and cons of being wild\lversus having a trainer. The trainer\lcolumn currently contains regular\lmeals.$

label: World_Rare2_RestText
text: It has put the debate on hold for a\nnap. Try visiting again later.$

label: World_Rare3_Accept
text: It approaches you cautiously.\nPerhaps traveling together would\lmean fewer arguments with rocks. It\lwants a battle first; you can catch\lit.$

label: World_Rare3_DeclineText
text: It returns to the rock. Negotiations\nare not going well.$

label: World_Rare3_Intro
text: This MAREEP keeps rubbing against a\nrock, then looking offended when its\lwool crackles. It seems to blame the\lrock.$

label: World_Rare3_RestText
text: Its wool is settling down. Give it a\nlittle time before another battle.$

label: World_Rare4_Accept
text: It bows to you. A friendly battle\nseems to be its interview. You can\lcatch it during the match.$

label: World_Rare4_DeclineText
text: It bows again and returns to its\nfootwork. No hard feelings.$

label: World_Rare4_Intro
text: This RIOLU mirrors the footsteps of\ntrainers leaving the GYM. It appears\lto be searching for a partner who will\lpractice rather than just pose.$

label: World_Rare4_RestText
text: It is stretching after the match.\nCome back after a walk.$

label: World_Rare5_Accept
text: It gives you one petal and bounces\ninto a playful battle stance. You can\lcatch it in this battle.$

label: World_Rare5_DeclineText
text: It adds another petal to the parade.\nYou have been allowed to watch.$

label: World_Rare5_Intro
text: This TOGEPI has gathered several\nfallen petals. It appears to be\lmaking the quietest parade in the\lworld.$

label: World_Rare5_RestText
text: The parade has stopped for a nap.\nPlease visit again later.$

label: World_Rare6_Accept
text: It seems willing to supervise your\ntravels instead. A wild battle will\lsettle the appointment; you can\lcatch it.$

label: World_Rare6_DeclineText
text: It nods at the puddle. Important\nwork remains.$

label: World_Rare6_Intro
text: This WOOPER is sitting beside a\npuddle with a leaf on its head. It\llooks deeply satisfied with its\lrecent promotion to pond supervisor.$

label: World_Rare6_RestText
text: The supervisor is on a break. Come\nback after some exploring.$

label: World_Rare7_Accept
text: It sniffs your shoes and steps\nforward. It wants to test a\lprospective traveling partner in\lbattle. You can catch it.$

label: World_Rare7_DeclineText
text: It resumes its duties. The patch is in\nsafe paws.$

label: World_Rare7_Intro
text: This HOUNDOUR is guarding a patch of\nwarm ground. It has apparently\ldecided the patch is a very small hot\lspring and it is the attendant.$

label: World_Rare7_RestText
text: It is cooling off after the battle.\nGive it some time.$

label: World_Rare8_Accept
text: It notices your team and becomes\ninterested in a more portable\lproject. It challenges you; you can\lcatch it during battle.$

label: World_Rare8_DeclineText
text: It returns to the stone with renewed\nand slightly alarming determination.$

label: World_Rare8_Intro
text: This GIBLE is trying to fit a round\nstone into a square gap. It looks\lprepared to change the stone, the\lgap, or possibly the mountain.$

label: World_Rare8_RestText
text: It is resting beside its project. Try\nagain on another visit.$

label: World_Rare9_Accept
text: It studies your bag and decides a\ntrainer might help with provisions. It\lwants a battle first; you can catch\lit.$

label: World_Rare9_DeclineText
text: It resumes the sorting. The later pile\nis in considerable trouble.$

label: World_Rare9_Intro
text: This MUNCHLAX has sorted its lunch\ninto now and later. It keeps moving\litems from later into now, which\lappears to be a serious\ladministrative problem.$

label: World_Rare9_RestText
text: Lunch has become a nap. Come back on\nanother visit.$

label: World_Scene0_After
text: MAP CLUB SECRETARY: The map is now\naccurate. His confidence has been\lmoved to the margins.$

label: World_Scene0_Before
text: MAP CLUB SECRETARY: His house is the\nsame size as mine. He has drawn a\lsecond floor containing his\lconfidence.$

label: World_Scene0_DoneText
text: MAP CLUB: We voted to use actual\nmeasurements. Democracy has been\ldifficult for my house.$

label: World_Scene0_Intro
text: MAP CLUB: We are drawing a map of\ntown. Our first disagreement is\lwhether my house should be larger.$

label: World_Scene10_After
text: PAINTER: He asked to buy it. I said\nthe sandwich was extra.$

label: World_Scene10_Before
text: PAINTER: It is a picture of my lunch.\nHe is holding it sideways.$

label: World_Scene10_DoneText
text: ART CRITIC: I have reclassified it as\nan ambitious still life.$

label: World_Scene10_Intro
text: ART CRITIC: A masterpiece needs\nmystery. This painting has it. I\lcannot tell which way is up.$

label: World_Scene11_After
text: LADDER ASSISTANT: We do know a STAR\nPIECE is not an actual star. The\ldisplay label is very careful about\lthat.$

label: World_Scene11_Before
text: LADDER ASSISTANT: I hold it steady.\nScience is mostly making sure\lsomeone does not fall.$

label: World_Scene11_DoneText
text: JUNIOR ASTRONOMER: A little piece of\nthe sky, at a very sensible height!\lThe SCOPE LENS is yours. We finally\lhave a display the ladder assistant\lcan visit safely.$

label: World_Scene11_Intro
text: JUNIOR ASTRONOMER: We built a ladder\nto study the stars. Early results\lsuggest we need a taller ladder.\lCould you spare a STAR PIECE for our\ldisplay? Our spare SCOPE LENS would\lbe yours.$

label: World_Scene12_After
text: STAIR COMMITTEE CHAIR: The minutes\nsay everyone should bring water.\lRemember yours on the next flight of\lstairs.$

label: World_Scene12_Before
text: STAIR COMMITTEE CHAIR: I am the\nchair. It is a title, which has caused\lsome disappointment.$

label: World_Scene12_DoneText
text: STAIR COMMITTEE: We rested on the\nlanding and discovered we had\laccidentally held a meeting.$

label: World_Scene12_Intro
text: STAIR COMMITTEE: We are requesting a\nbench halfway up the stairs. The\lpetition has reached a landing.$

label: World_Scene13_After
text: BOTTLE OWNER: I have written thank\nyou on a piece of paper. We may never\lsee that bottle again.$

label: World_Scene13_Before
text: BOTTLE OWNER: That is mine. I have\ndeveloped a very slow postal service.$

label: World_Scene13_DoneText
text: MAIL SORTER: The bottle is home. We\nare discussing whether to charge it\lpostage.$

label: World_Scene13_Intro
text: MAIL SORTER: I found a message in a\nbottle. It says please return bottle.$

label: World_Scene14_After
text: START LINE CREW: You are allowed to\ncome here twice. Or leave and come\lback ready.$

label: World_Scene14_Before
text: START LINE CREW: Somebody has to\nmake sure there is a beginning to go\lback to.$

label: World_Scene14_DoneText
text: FINISH LINE CREW: That FULL RESTORE\nis for whenever you decide to press\lon. You can decide what this place\lmeans after you have had a rest.$

label: World_Scene14_Intro
text: FINISH LINE CREW: I welcome people\nat the end of their journey. She\lkeeps saying this is also a beginning.$

label: World_Scene15_After
text: BUG TRANSLATOR: I believe in being\nprecise.$

label: World_Scene15_Before
text: BUG TRANSLATOR: That one said leaf.\nThe previous one also said leaf.\lStrong theme.$

label: World_Scene15_DoneText
text: BUG LISTENER: We heard a new call!\nShe says it means slightly different\lleaf.$

label: World_Scene15_Intro
text: BUG LISTENER: I am listening for bug\ncalls. My friend has been translating.$

label: World_Scene16_After
text: WALK PARTICIPANT: The walk is much\nnicer with someone to point out the\lsea.$

label: World_Scene16_Before
text: WALK PARTICIPANT: I thought the\nmeeting point was the destination. I\lam very good at the travel part.$

label: World_Scene16_DoneText
text: WALK ORGANIZER: We are walking\ntogether now. I have confiscated the\lschedule.$

label: World_Scene16_Intro
text: WALK ORGANIZER: I organize walks. He\nkeeps arriving early and finishing\lbefore we start.$

label: World_Scene17_After
text: SUN SURVEYOR: The samples were\nentirely avoidable. I wish this to be\lin the report.$

label: World_Scene17_Before
text: SUN SURVEYOR: The shade is winning. I\nwould like the experiment to be over.$

label: World_Scene17_DoneText
text: SHADE SURVEYOR: Thank you for the\nANTIDOTE. The GREAT BALL is yours.\lThe report will recommend looking at\lsamples from a sensible distance.$

label: World_Scene17_Intro
text: SHADE SURVEYOR: We are comparing\nshade to sunshine. My partner\lbrushed a poison barb collecting\lsamples. Could we trade our GREAT\lBALL for one ANTIDOTE?$

label: World_Scene18_After
text: GUIDE TRAINEE: It was a very decisive\nrock.$

label: World_Scene18_Before
text: GUIDE TRAINEE: They are all made of\nsand. I stand by my findings.$

label: World_Scene18_DoneText
text: DESERT GUIDE: He identified a rock.\nWe are celebrating this development.$

label: World_Scene18_Intro
text: DESERT GUIDE: My trainee has\nidentified every sand dune as the\lsame sand dune.$

label: World_Scene19_After
text: FOOTPRINT MAKER: I have donated one\nfootprint. By appointment.$

label: World_Scene19_Before
text: FOOTPRINT MAKER: He set up the\ncollection on the path. I have\lexplained my position with several\lfootprints.$

label: World_Scene19_DoneText
text: FOOTPRINT KEEPER: We moved the\ncollection beside the path. It is less\lpopular, but much safer.$

label: World_Scene19_Intro
text: FOOTPRINT KEEPER: I preserve\nfootprints in the ash. She keeps\lwalking through my collection.$
